creators.name: Shengzhi Wu
creators.role: Staff product designer for AR and AI (Meta; formerly Google AR and Android XR)
creators.bio: Interaction designer and creative coder trained at Carnegie Mellon's School of Design and ETC. At Google he designed ARCore, AR in Search, Google Lens and Android XR features; his CMU thesis prototypes on multi-device hand gestures in AR reached over a million views on Twitter and became a CHI 2020 paper.
creators.why: His short prototype videos turn abstract AR interaction ideas (slurping, pulling a note out of a tablet, an eyedropper for the real world) into instantly understandable, copyable patterns.
creators.role_zh: AR 与 AI 方向的资深产品设计师（Meta；曾任职 Google AR 与 Android XR）
creators.bio_zh: 交互设计师、创意编程者，毕业于卡内基梅隆大学设计学院，并在 ETC 修读课程。在 Google 期间参与设计 ARCore、Google 搜索 AR、Google Lens 和 Android XR；他在 CMU 的毕业设计探索 AR 中跨设备的手势交互，原型视频在 Twitter 上获得上百万次曝光，并发表为 CHI 2020 论文。
creators.why_zh: 他用几十秒的原型视频，把抽象的 AR 交互想法（“吸管”式搬运内容、把便签从平板里拉出来、给现实世界用的取色器）变成一看就懂、马上能模仿的交互范式。

creators.name: Ian Curtis
creators.role: Product designer & creative technologist (XRarchitect); designer at World Labs
creators.bio: Architect-turned-XR designer known online as @XRarchitect; worked on AR at 8th Wall, Niantic and Niantic Spatial and now designs world-model tools at World Labs.
creators.why: One of the most consistent public AR prototypers on X, turning each new AR capability into a short, shareable design experiment.
creators.role_zh: 产品设计师、创意技术专家（XRarchitect）；World Labs 设计师
creators.bio_zh: 由建筑师转型的 XR 设计师，网名 @XRarchitect；曾先后在 8th Wall、Niantic 和 Niantic Spatial 从事 AR 工作，现于 World Labs 设计世界模型工具。
creators.why_zh: 他是 X 上最持续产出的 AR 原型创作者之一，每当 AR 出现新能力，他都会把它做成一段简短、易于传播的设计实验。

creators.name: Abhishek Singh
creators.role: Indie AR developer & inventor (Peeqo, Super Mario AR); founder of Rara
creators.bio: NYC-based developer and former NYU ITP resident researcher who recreates pop-culture games and films as life-size AR experiences and builds playful gadgets like the GIF robot Peeqo.
creators.why: His life-size Super Mario Bros in Central Park and street-scale Street Fighter became defining viral images of what consumer AR could feel like.
creators.role_zh: 独立 AR 开发者、发明者（Peeqo、Super Mario AR）；Rara 创始人
creators.bio_zh: 常驻纽约的开发者，曾任 NYU ITP 驻留研究员。他把流行文化中的游戏和电影重现为真人尺寸的 AR 体验，也制作 GIF 机器人 Peeqo 这类趣味装置。
creators.why_zh: 他在中央公园重现的真人尺寸《超级马里奥兄弟》和街头尺度的《街头霸王》，成为消费级 AR 体验的标志性病毒式画面。

creators.name: Laan Labs (Chris Laan)
creators.role: Independent computer-vision & AR studio (AirMeasure, 3d Scanner App)
creators.bio: Small independent lab run by Chris Laan and Jason Laan that ships computer-vision and AR apps such as AirMeasure, 3d Scanner App and AirDraw.
creators.why: From day one of ARKit they posted a stream of inventive prototypes—3D drawing, levitating phones, neural brush textures, Gaussian splats in AR—that set the tone for the scene.
creators.role_zh: 独立计算机视觉与 AR 工作室（AirMeasure、3d Scanner App）
creators.bio_zh: 由 Chris Laan 和 Jason Laan 经营的小型独立实验室，推出了 AirMeasure、3d Scanner App 和 AirDraw 等计算机视觉与 AR 应用。
creators.why_zh: 从 ARKit 发布第一天起，他们就接连发布富有创意的原型——3D 绘画、悬浮手机、神经网络笔刷纹理、AR 中的高斯泼溅——为整个 AR 创作圈定下了基调。

creators.name: Matthew Hallberg
creators.role: AR developer and YouTuber; Snap Spectacles developer
creators.bio: Unity AR developer whose YouTube channel mixes tutorials with ambitious builds, from ARKit Minecraft and Portal to Iron Man HUDs and Snap Spectacles games.
creators.why: He turned the first weeks of ARKit into iconic open-source demos (AR Minecraft, Pokémon Go-style GPS AR, Portal) that a generation of developers learned from.
creators.role_zh: AR 开发者、YouTuber；Snap Spectacles 开发者
creators.bio_zh: Unity AR 开发者，他的 YouTube 频道既有教程也有野心勃勃的作品，从 ARKit 版 Minecraft、Portal，到钢铁侠头盔界面和 Snap Spectacles 游戏。
creators.why_zh: 在 ARKit 问世的最初几周，他就做出了一批标志性的开源演示（AR Minecraft、Pokémon Go 式 GPS AR、Portal），影响了一代开发者的学习路径。

creators.name: Jerome Etienne
creators.role: Creator of AR.js; WebGL/three.js developer (learningthreejs)
creators.bio: French web developer behind learningthreejs and AR.js, the open-source library that brought 60fps marker-based AR to any phone browser in 2017.
creators.why: AR.js made AR run in a plain web page on cheap phones, and his playful demos—portals, refraction, invisibility cloaks—showed the web could do magic.
creators.role_zh: AR.js 作者；WebGL/three.js 开发者（learningthreejs）
creators.bio_zh: 法国 Web 开发者，创办了 learningthreejs，并开发了开源库 AR.js——它在 2017 年让任何手机浏览器都能以 60fps 运行基于标记的 AR。
creators.why_zh: AR.js 让 AR 可以在普通网页和廉价手机上运行；他那些趣味十足的演示——传送门、折射、隐身斗篷——证明了网页也能创造魔法。

creators.name: Takashi Yoshinaga
creators.role: AR/VR researcher & rapid prototyper (ISIT Fukuoka); Microsoft MVP for Mixed Reality
creators.bio: Researcher at ISIT Fukuoka with a PhD in AR-based remote healthcare, who has posted hundreds of AR prototypes since 2009 and runs the AR Fukuoka community; creator of HoloTuberKit.
creators.why: An extraordinarily prolific prototyper who keeps inventing ways to stream, copy and share real space—point-cloud telepresence over YouTube, spatial copy-paste, LiDAR room sharing—across every AR device.
creators.role_zh: AR/VR 研究者、快速原型开发者（ISIT 福冈）；Microsoft 混合现实 MVP
creators.bio_zh: 福冈 ISIT 研究员，博士研究方向为基于 AR 的远程医疗。自 2009 年以来已发布数百个 AR 原型，运营 AR Fukuoka 社区，并开发了 HoloTuberKit。
creators.why_zh: 他是一位极其高产的原型创作者，在各类 AR 设备上不断发明流式传输、复制和共享真实空间的新方法——通过 YouTube 实现点云远程呈现、空间复制粘贴、LiDAR 房间共享。

creators.name: Kitasenju Design (Takayuki Watanabe)
creators.role: Programmer & digital artist; real-time CG studio
creators.bio: One-person studio of programmer-artist Takayuki Watanabe that experiments with real-time visual expression and ships AR effect apps like MEISAI and SUPER SLIT SCAN.
creators.why: His ARKit experiments—LiDAR boxelization, human-segmentation glitch and pixel effects—treat AR as a new visual medium rather than a utility.
creators.role_zh: 程序员、数字艺术家；实时 CG 工作室
creators.bio_zh: 程序员兼艺术家 Takayuki Watanabe的个人工作室，探索实时视觉表达，并推出了 MEISAI、SUPER SLIT SCAN 等 AR 特效应用。
creators.why_zh: 他的 ARKit 实验——LiDAR 体素化、人像分割故障效果与像素效果——把 AR 视为一种新的视觉媒介，而不仅是实用工具。

creators.name: Lucas Rizzotto
creators.role: XR creator, inventor and YouTuber (Lucas Builds the Future); founder of Where Thoughts Go
creators.bio: Brazilian-born immersive designer and inventor behind the 'Lucas Builds the Future' channel and AR House in LA, known for absurd yet insightful AR, VR and AI builds.
creators.why: He storifies AR prototypes—a working Marauder's Map, a portal to his best friend, clothes that play music—into viral narratives that make the future feel personal.
creators.role_zh: XR 创作者、发明者、YouTuber（Lucas Builds the Future）；Where Thoughts Go 创始人
creators.bio_zh: 出生于巴西的沉浸式设计师和发明者，运营“Lucas Builds the Future”频道并创办了洛杉矶的 AR House，以荒诞却富有洞见的 AR、VR 与 AI 作品闻名。
creators.why_zh: 他把 AR 原型讲成故事——一张真正可用的活点地图、一扇通往挚友的传送门、会播放音乐的衣服——以病毒式传播的叙事让未来显得切身可感。

creators.name: Andrew Hart
creators.role: iOS developer; creator of ARKit+CoreLocation; founder of Dent Reality / Hyper
creators.bio: iOS developer who open-sourced ARKit+CoreLocation in 2017, pioneering phone AR navigation, then founded Dent Reality (now Hyper) for indoor AR wayfinding.
creators.why: His July 2017 tweets showing AR turn-by-turn arrows on real streets defined location-based AR for the ARKit era.
creators.role_zh: iOS 开发者；ARKit+CoreLocation 作者；Dent Reality / Hyper 创始人
creators.bio_zh: iOS 开发者，2017 年开源了 ARKit+CoreLocation，开创了手机 AR 导航；随后创办 Dent Reality（现名 Hyper），专注室内 AR 导览。
creators.why_zh: 他在 2017 年 7 月发布的推文展示了真实街道上的 AR 逐向导航箭头，定义了 ARKit 时代基于位置的 AR。

creators.name: Nathan Gitter
creators.role: Designer & engineer; human interface designer at Apple
creators.bio: Designer-engineer who shared playful ARKit and TrueDepth prototypes in 2017–2018, wrote the widely read 'What I Learned Making 5 ARKit Prototypes', and later joined Apple's human interface team.
creators.why: His image-tracking prototypes (living newspapers, time-travelling graffiti) were among the clearest demonstrations of AR as interface design, cited in Apple's WWDC18 AR design talk.
creators.role_zh: 设计师、工程师；Apple 人机界面设计师
creators.bio_zh: 设计师兼工程师，2017–2018 年间分享了一系列有趣的 ARKit 与 TrueDepth 原型，撰写了广为流传的《What I Learned Making 5 ARKit Prototypes》，后加入 Apple 人机界面团队。
creators.why_zh: 他的图像追踪原型（会动的报纸、穿越时间的涂鸦）是把 AR 作为界面设计来展示的最清晰案例之一，曾被 Apple 在 WWDC18 的 AR 设计讲座中引用。

creators.name: Matt Moss
creators.role: iOS developer & founder (Hawkeye Access, Locket Camera)
creators.bio: Young iOS developer whose 2018 ARKit 2 eye-tracking prototype went viral and became Hawkeye Access; later founded the widget photo app Locket.
creators.why: He showed on WWDC week 2018 that ARKit face tracking could turn gaze and blinks into a hands-free interface for the whole phone.
creators.role_zh: iOS 开发者、创业者（Hawkeye Access、Locket Camera）
creators.bio_zh: 年轻的 iOS 开发者，2018 年基于 ARKit 2 的眼动追踪原型走红，并发展为 Hawkeye Access；之后创办了桌面小组件照片应用 Locket。
creators.why_zh: 2018 年 WWDC 那一周，他展示了 ARKit 面部追踪可以把注视和眨眼变成操控整部手机的免手操作界面。

creators.name: Brad Dwyer
creators.role: Developer & founder (Hatchlings, Magic Sudoku; co-founder of Roboflow)
creators.bio: Des Moines developer whose studio Hatchlings shipped Magic Sudoku and Nose Zone at the ARKit and iPhone X launches before he co-founded the computer-vision company Roboflow.
creators.why: Magic Sudoku was an early proof that ARKit plus on-device machine learning could read the real world and write answers back onto it.
creators.role_zh: 开发者、创业者（Hatchlings、Magic Sudoku；Roboflow 联合创始人）
creators.bio_zh: 得梅因的开发者，他的工作室 Hatchlings 在 ARKit 和 iPhone X 发布时推出了 Magic Sudoku 和 Nose Zone，之后他联合创办了计算机视觉公司 Roboflow。
creators.why_zh: Magic Sudoku 较早证明了 ARKit 结合端侧机器学习，可以读懂现实世界并把答案写回现实之上。

creators.name: Morten Just
creators.role: Designer & indie developer (Rotato, Design Camera); former Google designer
creators.bio: Danish designer and indie Mac/iOS developer who prototypes interface ideas in public; his ARKit experiments led to the Design Camera and Rotato apps.
creators.why: His everyday-object AR prototypes—kitchen timers on pots, web pages wrapped around books, stencils for drawing—are precise, human-scale interface ideas.
creators.role_zh: 设计师、独立开发者（Rotato、Design Camera）；前 Google 设计师
creators.bio_zh: 丹麦设计师、独立 Mac/iOS 开发者，习惯公开地为界面构想制作原型；他的 ARKit 实验催生了 Design Camera 和 Rotato 两款应用。
creators.why_zh: 他以日常物品为对象的 AR 原型——锅上的厨房计时器、包裹在书本上的网页、辅助绘画的模板——都是精准、合乎人体尺度的界面构想。
creators.based_zh: 哥本哈根，丹麦 / 旧金山，美国

creators.name: Mark Dawson
creators.role: Software engineer; author of 'ARKit by Example'
creators.bio: Engineer whose 2017 'ARKit by Example' blog series and demos taught many early ARKit developers, later followed by LiDAR meshing experiments on the 2020 iPad Pro.
creators.why: His Van Gogh bedroom in a kitchen and LiDAR Matrix room were memorable early proofs of how ARKit could restage real space.
creators.role_zh: 软件工程师；《ARKit by Example》作者
creators.bio_zh: 工程师，2017 年的博客系列《ARKit by Example》及配套演示为许多早期 ARKit 开发者提供了入门指引；之后又在 2020 款 iPad Pro 上进行了 LiDAR 网格重建实验。
creators.why_zh: 他把梵高的卧室搬进厨房、把房间变成 LiDAR 版“黑客帝国”，这些都是 ARKit 能够重新布置真实空间的早期经典例证。

creators.name: Glen Rhodes
creators.role: Game developer & technologist
creators.bio: Game developer who published some of the very first Unity + ARKit experiments in June 2017, days after the iOS 11 beta, testing scale, occlusion and placement.
creators.why: His first-week demos—a Titanic sailing across a lake, an armada over his house, real-wall occlusion—captured the initial shock of stable phone AR.
creators.role_zh: 游戏开发者、技术专家
creators.bio_zh: 游戏开发者，2017 年 6 月 iOS 11 测试版发布仅数天后，便发表了最早一批 Unity + ARKit 实验，测试尺度、遮挡和放置效果。
creators.why_zh: 他在第一周发布的演示——驶过湖面的泰坦尼克号、飞越自家房屋的舰队、真实墙面的遮挡——捕捉到了稳定手机 AR 初现时带来的震撼。

creators.name: Isaac Cohen (Cabbibo)
creators.role: Artist & creative coder; VR/AR experience designer
creators.bio: Artist-coder known as Cabbibo who makes joyful, tactile interactive worlds in WebGL, VR and AR, such as Blarp! and ARQUA!.
creators.why: ARQUA! used your body as the controller to fill real rooms with rainbow aquarium life, treating ARKit as a medium for delight and agency.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、创意编程者；VR/AR 体验设计师
creators.bio_zh: 网名 Cabbibo 的艺术家兼程序员，用 WebGL、VR 和 AR 创作充满欢乐与触感的互动世界，如 Blarp! 和 ARQUA!。
creators.why_zh: ARQUA! 以观者的身体作为控制器，让真实房间里游满彩虹般的水族生物，把 ARKit 当作传递愉悦与能动感的媒介。

creators.name: Keiichi Matsuda
creators.role: Designer and filmmaker; founder of Liquid City
creators.bio: Architect-trained designer and filmmaker whose speculative AR films (Augmented City, HYPER-REALITY, Merger) became the reference images of what an overlaid city could feel like. He later led design at Leap Motion and founded the XR/AI studio Liquid City.
creators.why: HYPER-REALITY is arguably the most-cited piece of critical AR design fiction ever made.
creators.role_zh: 设计师、电影人；Liquid City 创始人
creators.bio_zh: Keiichi Matsuda（松田圭一）受过建筑学训练，是设计师兼电影人。他的思辨性 AR 短片（Augmented City、HYPER-REALITY、Merger）成为人们想象“被叠加的城市”时的参照图像。他后来曾领导 Leap Motion 的设计工作，并创办了 XR/AI 工作室 Liquid City。
creators.why_zh: HYPER-REALITY 可以说是有史以来被引用最多的批判性 AR 设计虚构作品。

creators.name: Julian Oliver
creators.role: Critical engineer and artist
creators.bio: New Zealand-born artist and co-author of the Critical Engineering Manifesto, working with networks, surveillance and 'improved reality'. His early AR works used hacked binoculars and marker-tracked cubes to question who owns the view.
creators.why: The Artvertiser (2008) is one of the first artworks to use AR to take back public visual space from advertising.
creators.role_zh: 批判工程师、艺术家
creators.bio_zh: 出生于新西兰的艺术家，《批判工程宣言》（Critical Engineering Manifesto）的合著者，创作围绕网络、监控和“改良现实”展开。他早期的 AR 作品利用改装的望远镜和标记追踪立方体，追问“视野究竟归谁所有”。
creators.why_zh: The Artvertiser（2008）是最早利用 AR 从广告手中夺回公共视觉空间的艺术作品之一。

creators.name: Nobumichi Asai
creators.role: Technical and creative director (WOW / Asai studio)
creators.bio: Japanese visual artist who pioneered real-time face-tracking projection mapping, painting moving digital makeup onto performers' faces with near-zero latency.
creators.why: OMOTE and INORI turned the human face into a live, tracked AR canvas years before phone face filters.
creators.role_zh: 技术总监、创意总监（WOW / Asai 工作室）
creators.bio_zh: 日本视觉艺术家，开创了实时面部追踪投影映射，以几乎零延迟的方式在表演者脸上绘制流动的数字妆容。
creators.why_zh: OMOTE 和 INORI 早在手机面部滤镜出现之前，就把人脸变成了实时追踪的 AR 画布。

creators.name: Bot & Dolly
creators.role: Robotics and film studio (acquired by Google, 2013)
creators.bio: Studio that repurposed industrial robot arms for film motion control. With director Bradley 'GMUNK' Munkowitz they made Box, a live performance of projection mapping onto robot-moved surfaces shot in-camera.
creators.why: Box showed projection mapping synchronised with robots and camera as a new 'in-camera' mixed-reality language.
creators.role_zh: 机器人与电影工作室（2013 年被 Google 收购）
creators.bio_zh: 将工业机械臂改造用于电影运动控制的工作室。他们与导演 Bradley “GMUNK” Munkowitz 合作创作了 Box：一场在由机器人移动的表面上进行投影映射、并直接在镜头内拍摄完成的现场表演。
creators.why_zh: Box 展示了投影映射与机器人、摄影机同步联动，构成一种全新的“镜头内”混合现实语言。

creators.name: Daito Manabe / Rhizomatiks
creators.role: Artist, programmer and DJ; co-founder of Rhizomatiks
creators.bio: Daito Manabe and Rhizomatiks (with Motoi Ishibashi and choreographer MIKIKO / ELEVENPLAY) build live shows that mix drones, projection, motion capture and AR broadcast, including Perfume's stage shows and the Rio 2016 Tokyo handover.
creators.why: They made AR a live-performance medium, from mixed-reality wheelchair dance (border) to AR sports broadcasts (Fencing Visualized).
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、程序员、DJ；Rhizomatiks 联合创始人
creators.bio_zh: Daito Manabe（真锅大度）与 Rhizomatiks（与 Motoi Ishibashi、编舞家 MIKIKO / ELEVENPLAY 合作）打造融合无人机、投影、动作捕捉和 AR 转播的现场演出，包括 Perfume 的舞台表演和 2016 年里约奥运会闭幕式上的东京交接仪式。
creators.why_zh: 他们让 AR 成为现场表演的媒介，从混合现实轮椅舞蹈（border）到 AR 体育转播（Fencing Visualized）。

creators.name: Universal Everything (Matt Pyke)
creators.role: Digital art and design studio founded by Matt Pyke
creators.bio: Matt Pyke's studio makes digital lifeforms, crowds and walking figures for galleries, brands and architecture, increasingly as camera-driven mirrors and AR apps that let audiences see themselves transformed.
creators.why: Future You and Chameleon turned motion-capture mirrors into poetic, public-facing mixed-reality portraits of the viewer.
creators.role_zh: 由 Matt Pyke 创立的数字艺术与设计工作室
creators.bio_zh: Matt Pyke 的工作室为美术馆、品牌和建筑创作数字生命体、人群与行走的形象，并越来越多地以摄像头驱动的“镜子”和 AR 应用呈现，让观众看到被转化后的自己。
creators.why_zh: Future You 和 Chameleon 把动作捕捉镜像变成了面向公众、富有诗意的混合现实观者肖像。

creators.name: Acute Art
creators.role: AR/VR art production platform (director Daniel Birnbaum)
creators.bio: Production studio and app that commissions blue-chip artists (Olafur Eliasson, KAWS, Marina Abramović, Precious Okoyomon and others) to make AR sculptures placeable anywhere through a phone.
creators.why: Acute Art brought AR into the contemporary-art canon at museum and global public-space scale.
creators.role_zh: AR/VR 艺术制作平台（总监 Daniel Birnbaum）
creators.bio_zh: 制作工作室兼应用平台，委约顶级艺术家（Olafur Eliasson、KAWS、Marina Abramović、Precious Okoyomon 等）创作可通过手机放置在任何地方的 AR 雕塑。
creators.why_zh: Acute Art 以美术馆级别和全球公共空间的规模，将 AR 带入了当代艺术的正典。

creators.name: Tamiko Thiel
creators.role: Media artist; co-founder of Manifest.AR
creators.bio: Pioneering VR/AR artist (and designer of the Connection Machine CM-1/CM-2) who uses geolocated AR to insert political and ecological 'what-ifs' into specific sites, from the Venice Biennale to the Whitney.
creators.why: A founding figure of AR public art whose site-specific interventions span 15 years.
creators.role_zh: 媒体艺术家；Manifest.AR 联合创始人
creators.bio_zh: 先锋 VR/AR 艺术家（也是 Connection Machine CM-1/CM-2 的设计者），她用地理定位 AR 在特定场所植入政治与生态层面的“假如”，从威尼斯双年展到惠特尼美术馆。
creators.why_zh: 她是 AR 公共艺术的奠基人物之一，其场域特定的介入实践已跨越 15 年。

creators.name: John Craig Freeman
creators.role: Artist; professor at Emerson College; Manifest.AR founding member
creators.bio: Public artist who uses geolocated AR to build memorials and stories in real landscapes, most famously marking migrant deaths along the US-Mexico border.
creators.why: Border Memorial showed AR as a tool for memorialising the invisible at the exact place it happened.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家；Emerson College 教授；Manifest.AR 创始成员
creators.bio_zh: 公共艺术家，用地理定位 AR 在真实地景中建造纪念碑、讲述故事，最为人知的是标记美墨边境沿线移民死亡地点的作品。
creators.why_zh: Border Memorial 展示了 AR 如何在事件发生的确切地点，纪念那些不可见的存在。

creators.name: Mark Skwarek
creators.role: Artist; NYU Mobile AR Lab director; Manifest.AR co-founder
creators.bio: AR activist-artist behind unauthorised AR interventions such as 'The Leak in Your Hometown', which turned every BP logo into a gushing oil pipe during the 2010 spill.
creators.why: He made marker-based AR a medium of protest and culture jamming.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家；NYU 移动 AR 实验室主任；Manifest.AR 联合创始人
creators.bio_zh: AR 行动主义艺术家，发起过多次未经授权的 AR 介入，例如在 2010 年漏油事件期间，《The Leak in Your Hometown》把每一个 BP 标志都变成了喷涌石油的管道。
creators.why_zh: 他让基于标记的 AR 成为抗议和文化干扰的媒介。

creators.name: Sander Veenhof
creators.role: AR artist; co-organiser of 'We AR in MoMA'
creators.bio: Dutch artist who has staged uninvited AR interventions since 2010 (MoMA, Venice Biennale) and now prototypes playful social experiments for AR glasses.
creators.why: His guerrilla 'We AR in MoMA' show launched AR as a medium for occupying institutions without permission.
creators.role_zh: AR 艺术家；“We AR in MoMA”联合组织者
creators.bio_zh: 荷兰艺术家，自 2010 年起在 MoMA、威尼斯双年展等场所发起不请自来的 AR 介入，如今为 AR 眼镜设计充满趣味的社会实验原型。
creators.why_zh: 他的游击式展览“We AR in MoMA”开启了以 AR 未经许可“占领”艺术机构的先河。

creators.name: Nancy Baker Cahill
creators.role: Artist; founder of the 4th Wall AR app
creators.bio: Artist who builds monumental drawn AR sculptures and sited public artworks (Desert X, Liberty Bell) through her free 4th Wall app.
creators.why: She uses AR to make large-scale, politically charged public art that needs no permit or plinth.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家；4th Wall AR 应用创始人
creators.bio_zh: 艺术家，通过她的免费应用 4th Wall 创作宏大的手绘 AR 雕塑和场域公共艺术作品（Desert X、Liberty Bell）。
creators.why_zh: 她用 AR 创作大尺度、富有政治意味的公共艺术，无需许可证，也无需基座。

creators.name: Jeremy Bailey
creators.role: Artist, 'Famous New Media Artist'
creators.bio: Canadian performance artist who has used webcam tracking and AR since the mid-2000s to satirise the art world and tech industry with deadpan software demos.
creators.why: His AR performances made camera-based AR a comic, self-aware art form before the ARKit wave.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家，“著名新媒体艺术家”（Famous New Media Artist）
creators.bio_zh: 加拿大行为艺术家，自 2000 年代中期起便运用摄像头追踪和 AR，以一本正经的软件演示讽刺艺术界和科技行业。
creators.why_zh: 早在 ARKit 浪潮之前，他的 AR 表演就让基于摄像头的 AR 成为一种幽默而自觉的艺术形式。

creators.name: Theo Triantafyllidis
creators.role: Artist working with games, simulation and mixed reality
creators.bio: Greek-born artist whose live simulations and mixed-reality performances (Anti-Gone, All My Confusing Pets) blur performer, avatar and game engine.
creators.why: He treats mixed reality as a stage for absurd, feral performance rather than utility.
creators.role_zh: 以游戏、模拟与混合现实为媒介的艺术家
creators.bio_zh: 出生于希腊的艺术家，他的实时模拟和混合现实表演（Anti-Gone、All My Confusing Pets）模糊了表演者、虚拟化身与游戏引擎之间的界限。
creators.why_zh: 他把混合现实当作荒诞、狂野表演的舞台，而非实用工具。

creators.name: Sutu (Stuart Campbell)
creators.role: Artist, comic creator and XR director
creators.bio: Australian comic artist and XR director whose Modern Polaxis was one of the first AR comic books, later known for Tilt Brush work and XR art at festivals and museums.
creators.why: Modern Polaxis made printed comics come alive through the phone camera in 2014.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、漫画创作者、XR 导演
creators.bio_zh: 澳大利亚漫画艺术家和 XR 导演，他的 Modern Polaxis 是最早的 AR 漫画书之一；后来以 Tilt Brush 创作以及在各大艺术节和博物馆展出的 XR 艺术闻名。
creators.why_zh: 2014 年，Modern Polaxis 让印刷漫画通过手机摄像头活了起来。

creators.name: James Alliban
creators.role: Media artist and AR developer
creators.bio: One of the first artists to make webcam AR widely shared online (2009's AR business card), later building Kinect installations and co-creating CELL with Keiichi Matsuda.
creators.why: His Flash-era AR experiments showed millions what marker-based AR could feel like before smartphones.
creators.role_zh: 媒体艺术家、AR 开发者
creators.bio_zh: 最早让网络摄像头 AR 在网上广泛传播的艺术家之一（2009 年的 AR 名片），后来创作 Kinect 装置，并与 Keiichi Matsuda 合作完成了 CELL。
creators.why_zh: 他在 Flash 时代的 AR 实验，早在智能手机普及之前就让数百万人体验到了基于标记的 AR。

creators.name: Nexus Studios
creators.role: Film, animation and interactive studio
creators.bio: Oscar-nominated animation studio whose interactive arm made some of the best-known narrative AR apps for Google, the BBC and The New Yorker.
creators.why: They brought character animation craft to phone AR, from HotStepper wayfinding to BBC Civilisations AR.
creators.role_zh: 电影、动画与互动工作室
creators.bio_zh: 曾获奥斯卡提名的动画工作室，其互动部门为 Google、BBC 和《纽约客》制作了多款知名的叙事型 AR 应用。
creators.why_zh: 他们把角色动画的手艺带入手机 AR，从 HotStepper 导航到 BBC Civilisations AR。

creators.name: Pablo Valbuena
creators.role: Artist working with light, space and time
creators.bio: Spanish artist whose 2007 'Augmented Sculpture' at Ars Electronica fused projected light with physical geometry, a founding work of art projection mapping.
creators.why: He named and defined 'augmented' sculpture and space with projection before the term was mainstream.
creators.role_zh: 以光、空间与时间为媒介的艺术家
creators.bio_zh: 西班牙艺术家，2007 年在 Ars Electronica 展出的《Augmented Sculpture》将投影光与实体几何融为一体，是艺术投影映射的奠基之作。
creators.why_zh: 早在这个词流行之前，他就用投影命名并定义了“增强”的雕塑与空间。

creators.name: Joanie Lemercier (AntiVJ)
creators.role: Visual artist; co-founder of the AntiVJ label
creators.bio: French artist who co-founded AntiVJ and pioneered projection mapping on architecture and on drawn landscapes, later turning to environmental activism.
creators.why: His projections on line drawings (Eyjafjallajökull, FUJI) made light itself look like matter.
creators.role_zh: 视觉艺术家；AntiVJ 厂牌联合创始人
creators.bio_zh: 法国艺术家，联合创办 AntiVJ，开创了在建筑和手绘风景上进行投影映射的实践，后来转向环境行动主义。
creators.why_zh: 他在线描作品上的投影（Eyjafjallajökull、FUJI）让光本身看起来像是物质。

creators.name: teamLab
creators.role: Art collective (founded by Toshiyuki Inoko)
creators.bio: Interdisciplinary art collective building room-scale interactive projection worlds where visitors' drawings and bodies change the artwork.
creators.why: Sketch Aquarium made 'your drawing comes alive in the room' a mass-audience mixed-reality experience.
creators.role_zh: 艺术团体（由 Toshiyuki Inoko 创立）
creators.bio_zh: 跨学科艺术团体，打造房间尺度的互动投影世界，参观者的绘画与身体都会改变作品本身。
creators.why_zh: Sketch Aquarium 让“你的画在房间里活过来”成为面向大众的混合现实体验。

creators.name: Moment Factory
creators.role: Multimedia entertainment studio
creators.bio: Studio known for architectural projection mapping, illuminated night walks (Lumina) and interactive projected play spaces worldwide.
creators.why: They scaled projection AR to cathedrals, forests and arenas as public storytelling.
creators.role_zh: 多媒体娱乐工作室
creators.bio_zh: 以建筑投影映射、灯光夜游（Lumina）和遍布全球的互动投影游乐空间而闻名的工作室。
creators.why_zh: 他们把投影 AR 扩展到大教堂、森林和体育场的规模，用于公共叙事。

creators.name: The Heavy Projects (B.C. Biermann)
creators.role: AR public art studio; Re+Public
creators.bio: B.C. 'Heavy' Biermann's studio behind Re+Public, which animated large street murals and billboards with AR from the early 2010s.
creators.why: Early, large-scale AR street art that reclaimed urban surfaces.
creators.role_zh: AR 公共艺术工作室；Re+Public
creators.bio_zh: B.C. “Heavy” Biermann 的工作室，Re+Public 的幕后团队，自 2010 年代初就用 AR 让大型街头壁画和广告牌动起来。
creators.why_zh: 早期的大规模 AR 街头艺术，重新夺回了城市表面。

creators.name: Studio DRIFT
creators.role: Artist duo Lonneke Gordijn and Ralph Nauta
creators.bio: Dutch studio known for kinetic and drone light works; made one of the first gallery mixed-reality artworks for HoloLens.
creators.why: Concrete Storm used spatial MR to make viewers physically feel virtual architecture.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家二人组 Lonneke Gordijn 与 Ralph Nauta
creators.bio_zh: 荷兰工作室，以动态装置和无人机灯光作品著称；曾为 HoloLens 创作最早一批进入画廊的混合现实艺术作品之一。
creators.why_zh: Concrete Storm 利用空间混合现实，让观者身体性地感受到虚拟建筑的存在。

creators.name: Marina Abramović
creators.role: Performance artist
creators.bio: The 'grandmother of performance art', who worked with Acute Art (Rising, VR) and Tin Drum (The Life, mixed reality) to extend presence into virtual bodies.
creators.why: The Life was billed as the first mixed-reality performance artwork sold at auction.
creators.role_zh: 行为艺术家
creators.bio_zh: 被誉为“行为艺术之母”，曾与 Acute Art（Rising，VR）和 Tin Drum（The Life，混合现实）合作，将“在场”延伸至虚拟身体。
creators.why_zh: The Life 被宣传为第一件在拍卖会上售出的混合现实行为艺术作品。

creators.name: Kimchi and Chips
creators.role: Art studio of Mimi Son and Elliot Woods
creators.bio: Korean-British duo working with light fields, projection and robotic mirrors to make images that occupy real space.
creators.why: Light Barrier made projected light hang in mid-air as volumetric drawings.
creators.role_zh: Mimi Son 与 Elliot Woods 的艺术工作室
creators.bio_zh: 韩英二人组，运用光场、投影和机器人镜面，创造占据真实空间的影像。
creators.why_zh: Light Barrier 让投影的光悬浮在半空中，化为立体的体积绘画。

creators.name: MIT Fluid Interfaces — Pattie Maes & Pranav Mistry
creators.role: Research group at the MIT Media Lab led by Pattie Maes; Pranav Mistry was its best-known PhD student
creators.bio: Pattie Maes' Fluid Interfaces group builds wearable and augmented interfaces that blend digital information into everyday life. Pranav Mistry's SixthSense (2009) turned a pocket projector, a camera and colored finger caps into a gestural wearable computer and became one of the most-watched TED demos ever.
creators.why: SixthSense defined the popular image of 'the world as your screen' years before AR hardware existed.
creators.role_zh: MIT Media Lab 由 Pattie Maes 领导的研究组；Pranav Mistry 是其最知名的博士生
creators.bio_zh: Pattie Maes 的 Fluid Interfaces 研究组致力于打造可穿戴与增强型界面，将数字信息融入日常生活。Pranav Mistry 的 SixthSense（2009）将一台袖珍投影仪、一个摄像头和彩色指套组合成手势驱动的可穿戴计算机，成为 TED 史上观看次数最多的演示之一。
creators.why_zh: 在 AR 硬件出现之前多年，SixthSense 就定义了“世界即屏幕”的大众想象。

creators.name: Valentin Heun
creators.role: Creator of the Reality Editor (MIT Media Lab); VP Innovation Engineering / Reality Lab at PTC (Vuforia Spatial Toolbox)
creators.bio: Valentin Heun did his PhD in Pattie Maes' Fluid Interfaces group, where he built Smarter Objects and the Reality Editor, an AR 'digital screwdriver' for wiring together connected objects. At PTC he turned it into the open-source Vuforia Spatial Toolbox for industrial AR.
creators.why: He reframed AR as a way to see and reprogram the invisible behavior of physical objects by drawing lines between them.
creators.role_zh: Reality Editor 创造者（MIT Media Lab）；PTC 创新工程副总裁 / Reality Lab 负责人（Vuforia Spatial Toolbox）
creators.bio_zh: Valentin Heun 在 Pattie Maes 的 Fluid Interfaces 研究组攻读博士，期间开发了 Smarter Objects 和 Reality Editor——一把用于连接各种联网物体的 AR“数字螺丝刀”。在 PTC，他将其发展为面向工业 AR 的开源工具 Vuforia Spatial Toolbox。
creators.why_zh: 他把 AR 重新定义为一种方式：通过在物体之间画线，看见并重新编程实体物品不可见的行为。
creators.based_zh: 波士顿（马萨诸塞州），美国

creators.name: MIT Tangible Media Group — Hiroshi Ishii
creators.role: Research group at the MIT Media Lab led by Hiroshi Ishii (Tangible Bits, Radical Atoms)
creators.bio: Hiroshi Ishii's Tangible Media Group has pursued 'Tangible Bits' and 'Radical Atoms': interfaces where digital information takes physical, shape-changing form. Daniel Leithinger, Sean Follmer and others built the inFORM and TRANSFORM pin displays and combined them with projection and see-through AR.
creators.why: They pushed augmentation beyond pixels to physical matter that moves, reshapes and can be touched remotely.
creators.role_zh: MIT Media Lab 由 Hiroshi Ishii 领导的研究组（Tangible Bits、Radical Atoms）
creators.bio_zh: Hiroshi Ishii（石井裕）的 Tangible Media Group 长期探索“Tangible Bits”与“Radical Atoms”：让数字信息获得可变形的实体形态的界面。Daniel Leithinger、Sean Follmer 等人打造了 inFORM 和 TRANSFORM 针阵显示装置，并将其与投影和透视式 AR 相结合。
creators.why_zh: 他们把“增强”从像素推向物质本身——会移动、会变形、还能被远程触摸。

creators.name: Microsoft Research — Hrvoje Benko & Andy Wilson
creators.role: Principal researchers at Microsoft Research Redmond (Benko later at Meta Reality Labs Research)
creators.bio: Andy Wilson (PlayAnywhere, TouchLight, Surface) and Hrvoje Benko led a decade of projector-and-depth-camera spatial AR at Microsoft Research, with interns such as Brett Jones, Rajinder Sodhi and Tomislav Pejsa. Their rooms turn every wall, table and body into an interactive display.
creators.why: IllumiRoom and RoomAlive showed that a whole living room can become a game or a portal without anyone wearing a headset.
creators.role_zh: Microsoft Research 雷德蒙德首席研究员（Benko 后任职于 Meta Reality Labs Research）
creators.bio_zh: Andy Wilson（PlayAnywhere、TouchLight、Surface）与 Hrvoje Benko 在 Microsoft Research 主导了长达十年的投影仪加深度相机空间 AR 研究，参与者还包括 Brett Jones、Rajinder Sodhi、Tomislav Pejsa 等实习生。在他们的房间里，每一面墙、每一张桌子乃至每一个身体都能变成互动显示屏。
creators.why_zh: IllumiRoom 和 RoomAlive 表明，无需任何人佩戴头显，整个客厅就能变成游戏场或传送门。
creators.based_zh: 雷德蒙德（华盛顿州），美国

creators.name: Microsoft Research Cambridge / I3D — Shahram Izadi
creators.role: Led the Interactive 3D Technologies group at Microsoft Research (KinectFusion, HoloDesk, Holoportation); now leads Android XR at Google
creators.based: Cambridge, UK / Redmond, WA / Mountain View, CA
creators.bio: Shahram Izadi's teams at Microsoft Research built KinectFusion real-time 3D reconstruction, the HoloDesk situated see-through display and Holoportation, live 3D capture of people streamed into HoloLens. He later co-founded perceptiveIO and now leads AR/XR at Google.
creators.why: Holoportation made volumetric 'beam me in' telepresence real, and KinectFusion gave AR its modern dense spatial mapping.
creators.role_zh: 曾领导 Microsoft Research 交互式 3D 技术组（KinectFusion、HoloDesk、Holoportation）；现负责 Google 的 Android XR
creators.bio_zh: Shahram Izadi 在 Microsoft Research 的团队打造了 KinectFusion 实时三维重建、HoloDesk 情境化透视显示装置，以及 Holoportation——将人物实时三维捕捉并传送进 HoloLens。他后来联合创办了 perceptiveIO，现负责 Google 的 AR/XR 业务。
creators.why_zh: Holoportation 让体积化的“把我传送过去”式远程呈现成为现实，而 KinectFusion 则为 AR 带来了现代意义上的稠密空间建图。
creators.based_zh: 剑桥，英国 / 雷德蒙德（华盛顿州），美国 / 山景城（加利福尼亚州），美国

creators.name: David Lindlbauer
creators.role: Assistant Professor, Carnegie Mellon HCII; leads the Augmented Perception Lab
creators.bio: David Lindlbauer works on mixed reality that adapts to people and context, from Remixed Reality (with Andy Wilson), which edits space and time in a live 3D copy of the room, to optimization-driven MR interfaces at ETH Zurich and CMU.
creators.why: Remixed Reality treated physical reality itself as editable media: copy, erase, replay and rearrange your room in real time.
creators.role_zh: 卡内基梅隆大学 HCII 助理教授；领导 Augmented Perception Lab
creators.bio_zh: David Lindlbauer 研究能够适应人与情境的混合现实：从与 Andy Wilson 合作的 Remixed Reality——在房间的实时三维副本中编辑空间与时间——到他在苏黎世联邦理工学院和 CMU 开展的优化驱动型 MR 界面研究。
creators.why_zh: Remixed Reality 把物理现实本身当作可编辑的媒介：实时复制、擦除、回放和重新布置你的房间。
creators.based_zh: 匹兹堡（宾夕法尼亚州），美国

creators.name: Chris Harrison — CMU Future Interfaces Group
creators.role: Professor at Carnegie Mellon HCII; director of the Future Interfaces Group (FIGLAB)
creators.bio: Chris Harrison invents new ways to turn skin, walls, tables and everyday surfaces into interactive displays and sensors. Skinput and OmniTouch (built with Microsoft Research) projected interfaces onto the body, and FIGLAB keeps producing on-body and on-world AR input techniques.
creators.why: He made 'any surface, including your arm, is a touchscreen' a working reality through a long string of memorable CHI/UIST demos.
creators.role_zh: 卡内基梅隆大学 HCII 教授；Future Interfaces Group（FIGLAB）主任
creators.bio_zh: Chris Harrison 不断发明新方法，把皮肤、墙面、桌面和各种日常表面变成交互式显示屏与传感器。与 Microsoft Research 合作的 Skinput 和 OmniTouch 将界面投射到身体上，FIGLAB 也持续产出面向身体和环境的 AR 输入技术。
creators.why_zh: 通过一系列令人难忘的 CHI/UIST 演示，他让“任何表面——包括你的手臂——都是触摸屏”成为可运行的现实。
creators.based_zh: 匹兹堡（宾夕法尼亚州），美国

creators.name: Robert Xiao
creators.role: Assistant Professor, University of British Columbia; former PhD student at CMU FIGLAB
creators.bio: Robert Xiao built many of FIGLAB's projected-AR systems (WorldKit, Desktopography, LumiWatch) and MRTouch with Microsoft Research, which added touch on real surfaces to HoloLens.
creators.why: His projects make virtual interfaces cohabit gracefully with real desks, walls and arms.
creators.role_zh: 不列颠哥伦比亚大学助理教授；曾为 CMU FIGLAB 博士生
creators.bio_zh: Robert Xiao 构建了 FIGLAB 的多个投影式 AR 系统（WorldKit、Desktopography、LumiWatch），并与 Microsoft Research 合作开发了 MRTouch，为 HoloLens 加入了在真实表面上的触控功能。
creators.why_zh: 他的项目让虚拟界面与真实的桌面、墙壁和手臂优雅共处。

creators.name: Ryo Suzuki — Programmable Reality Lab
creators.role: Assistant Professor, University of Colorado Boulder (previously University of Calgary); directs the Programmable Reality Lab
creators.bio: Ryo Suzuki builds AR tools that make the real world dynamic and programmable: sketches that respond to physical motion, textbooks whose diagrams come alive, and robots and physical objects bound to virtual content. He did his PhD with Daniel Leithinger and Mark Gross at CU Boulder.
creators.why: His RealitySketch/RealityCanvas line turns hand-drawn sketches into live graphics bound to moving real objects, a new medium for explanation and play.
creators.role_zh: 科罗拉多大学博尔德分校助理教授（此前任职于卡尔加里大学）；主持 Programmable Reality Lab
creators.bio_zh: Ryo Suzuki 开发让现实世界变得动态、可编程的 AR 工具：能响应物理运动的草图、图示会活起来的教科书，以及与虚拟内容绑定的机器人和实体物件。他在科罗拉多大学博尔德分校师从 Daniel Leithinger 和 Mark Gross 获得博士学位。
creators.why_zh: 他的 RealitySketch/RealityCanvas 系列把手绘草图变成与运动中的真实物体绑定的实时图形，成为一种用于讲解和游戏的新媒介。
creators.based_zh: 博尔德（科罗拉多州），美国

creators.name: Rubaiat Habib Kazi
creators.role: Senior Research Scientist, Adobe Research
creators.bio: Rubaiat Habib Kazi studies sketching and animation as dynamic, expressive media (Kitty, Draco, Kinetic Texture). In AR he co-created RealitySketch, RealityTalk and Augmented Physics with Ryo Suzuki, and Pronto for sketch-based AR video prototyping.
creators.why: He brings the expressiveness of hand-drawn animation into live AR, letting anyone explain ideas by sketching on reality.
creators.role_zh: Adobe Research 高级研究科学家
creators.bio_zh: Rubaiat Habib Kazi 将草图与动画作为动态、富有表现力的媒介来研究（Kitty、Draco、Kinetic Texture）。在 AR 领域，他与 Ryo Suzuki 共同创作了 RealitySketch、RealityTalk 和 Augmented Physics，并开发了基于草图的 AR 视频原型工具 Pronto。
creators.why_zh: 他把手绘动画的表现力带入实时 AR，让任何人都能通过在现实上画草图来解释想法。

creators.name: Ken Perlin — NYU Future Reality Lab
creators.role: Professor of Computer Science at NYU; director of the Future Reality Lab; inventor of Perlin noise
creators.bio: Oscar-winning graphics pioneer Ken Perlin now builds shared, co-located mixed reality: Chalktalk, a sketch language whose drawings come alive as simulations, and Holojam, untethered multi-user VR/AR in a motion-captured room.
creators.why: Chalktalk imagines a future where people talk by drawing living, computational objects in the air between them.
creators.role_zh: 纽约大学计算机科学教授；Future Reality Lab 主任；Perlin 噪声发明者
creators.bio_zh: 获得过奥斯卡奖的图形学先驱 Ken Perlin 如今致力于共享、同处一地的混合现实：Chalktalk 是一种草图语言，画出的图形会作为模拟活起来；Holojam 则在动作捕捉房间中实现无线缆的多人 VR/AR。
creators.why_zh: Chalktalk 描绘了这样一种未来：人们通过在彼此之间的空中绘制鲜活的计算对象来交谈。

creators.name: Dynamicland — Bret Victor & collaborators
creators.role: Nonprofit research lab in Oakland/Berkeley led by Bret Victor with Luke Iannini, Toby Schachman, Josh Horowitz, Omar Rizwan, Paula Te and others
creators.bio: Dynamicland grew out of Bret Victor's Communications Design Group (HARC). Its Realtalk system uses ceiling cameras and projectors so that ordinary paper, cards and objects become live, programmable computing, shared by everyone in the room.
creators.why: They reinvented the computer as a room where people compute together with their hands on real paper, with no screens or headsets.
creators.role_zh: 位于奥克兰/伯克利的非营利研究实验室，由 Bret Victor 领导，成员包括 Luke Iannini、Toby Schachman、Josh Horowitz、Omar Rizwan、Paula Te 等
creators.bio_zh: Dynamicland 脱胎于 Bret Victor 的 Communications Design Group（HARC）。其 Realtalk 系统利用天花板上的摄像头和投影仪，让普通的纸张、卡片和物件成为鲜活、可编程、由房间里所有人共享的计算。
creators.why_zh: 他们把计算机重新发明为一个房间：人们用双手在真实纸张上共同计算，无需屏幕，也无需头显。
creators.based_zh: 奥克兰 / 伯克利（加利福尼亚州），美国

creators.name: Oliver Kreylos
creators.role: Researcher at UC Davis (KeckCAVES, W. M. Keck Center for Active Visualization in the Earth Sciences); creator of the Vrui VR toolkit
creators.bio: Oliver Kreylos built the open-source Augmented Reality Sandbox, where a Kinect scans real sand and a projector paints live topography and flowing water onto it, now installed in hundreds of museums and classrooms. He also pioneered Kinect-based 3D video capture for immersive telepresence.
creators.why: The AR Sandbox is perhaps the most widely replicated AR installation in the world, a hands-on way to understand landscapes and water.
creators.role_zh: 加州大学戴维斯分校研究员（KeckCAVES，W. M. Keck 地球科学主动可视化中心）；Vrui VR 工具包作者
creators.bio_zh: Oliver Kreylos 开发了开源的 Augmented Reality Sandbox：Kinect 扫描真实的沙子，投影仪在沙面上实时绘制地形和流水。这套装置如今已进驻数百家博物馆和教室。他还开创了基于 Kinect 的三维视频捕捉，用于沉浸式远程呈现。
creators.why_zh: AR Sandbox 或许是全世界被复制最多的 AR 装置，让人通过动手来理解地形与水。
creators.based_zh: 戴维斯（加利福尼亚州），美国

creators.name: Mark Billinghurst — HIT Lab NZ & Empathic Computing Lab
creators.role: Professor at the University of South Australia and University of Auckland; founder of HIT Lab NZ and the Empathic Computing Lab
creators.bio: Mark Billinghurst co-created ARToolKit-based collaborative AR with Hirokazu Kato and the MagicBook (2001), then founded HIT Lab NZ. His Empathic Computing Lab now builds mixed reality systems that share gaze, emotion and viewpoint between remote collaborators.
creators.why: He has spent 25 years defining collaborative AR, from books that pop up into virtual worlds to remote partners who appear as tiny avatars on your shoulder.
creators.role_zh: 南澳大学与奥克兰大学教授；HIT Lab NZ 与 Empathic Computing Lab 创始人
creators.bio_zh: Mark Billinghurst 与 Hirokazu Kato 共同开创了基于 ARToolKit 的协作式 AR 和 MagicBook（2001），随后创立 HIT Lab NZ。他的 Empathic Computing Lab 如今打造能在远程协作者之间共享注视、情绪和视角的混合现实系统。
creators.why_zh: 25 年来，他一直在定义协作式 AR：从能弹出虚拟世界的书，到以迷你化身出现在你肩头的远程伙伴。
creators.based_zh: 阿德莱德，澳大利亚 / 奥克兰，新西兰

creators.name: TU Graz Handheld AR — Daniel Wagner & Dieter Schmalstieg
creators.role: Dieter Schmalstieg (professor, TU Graz; Studierstube) and Daniel Wagner (Christian Doppler Lab for Handheld AR; later Qualcomm Vuforia, DAQRI, Snap Spectacles)
creators.bio: Schmalstieg's Studierstube group and Wagner's Christian Doppler Laboratory for Handheld Augmented Reality ran AR on PDAs and feature phones years before smartphones, including the Invisible Train (2004) and the first real-time natural-feature tracking on a mobile phone (2008), which fed into Qualcomm's Vuforia.
creators.why: They proved phone AR was possible a decade before ARKit and invented much of the tracking every AR app now relies on.
creators.role_zh: Dieter Schmalstieg（格拉茨技术大学教授；Studierstube）与 Daniel Wagner（手持 AR Christian Doppler 实验室；后任职于 Qualcomm Vuforia、DAQRI、Snap Spectacles）
creators.bio_zh: Schmalstieg 的 Studierstube 研究组和 Wagner 的手持增强现实 Christian Doppler 实验室，早在智能手机出现前多年就在 PDA 和功能手机上运行 AR，包括 Invisible Train（2004）以及首个在手机上实时运行的自然特征追踪（2008），后者成为 Qualcomm Vuforia 的技术基础之一。
creators.why_zh: 他们比 ARKit 早十年证明了手机 AR 的可行性，并发明了如今每个 AR 应用所依赖的大部分追踪技术。

creators.name: Steven Feiner — Columbia Computer Graphics & User Interfaces Lab
creators.role: Professor of Computer Science, Columbia University; director of the CGUI Lab
creators.bio: Steven Feiner built KARMA (1993) and the Touring Machine (1997), the first outdoor mobile AR system, and has led decades of research on AR task guidance, maintenance and 3D interaction with students such as Steve Henderson and Carmine Elvezio.
creators.why: His lab showed how AR can guide real hands through real work, from tank turrets to the International Space Station.
creators.role_zh: 哥伦比亚大学计算机科学教授；CGUI 实验室主任
creators.bio_zh: Steven Feiner 打造了 KARMA（1993）和 Touring Machine（1997）——后者是首个户外移动 AR 系统。数十年来，他与 Steve Henderson、Carmine Elvezio 等学生一起，领导了 AR 任务引导、维修和三维交互方面的研究。
creators.why_zh: 他的实验室展示了 AR 如何引导真实的双手完成真实的工作，从坦克炮塔到国际空间站。

creators.name: Blair MacIntyre — Georgia Tech Augmented Environments Lab
creators.role: Professor at Georgia Tech (Augmented Environments Lab); later principal research scientist at Mozilla (WebXR) and JP Morgan
creators.bio: Blair MacIntyre (Feiner's former student) ran Georgia Tech's Augmented Environments Lab, which produced AR games and narrative experiments like AR Façade, ARhrrrr! and NerdHerder, and the Argon AR web browser. At Mozilla he helped create the WebXR Viewer and WebXR AR standards.
creators.why: He championed AR as a medium for games, drama and the open web long before app stores embraced it.
creators.role_zh: 佐治亚理工学院教授（Augmented Environments Lab）；后任 Mozilla（WebXR）及 JP Morgan 首席研究科学家
creators.bio_zh: Blair MacIntyre（Feiner 的学生）主持佐治亚理工学院的 Augmented Environments Lab，产出了 AR Façade、ARhrrrr!、NerdHerder 等 AR 游戏和叙事实验，以及 Argon AR 网页浏览器。在 Mozilla，他参与创建了 WebXR Viewer 和 WebXR AR 标准。
creators.why_zh: 早在应用商店接纳 AR 之前，他就倡导将 AR 作为游戏、戏剧和开放网络的媒介。
creators.based_zh: 亚特兰大（佐治亚州），美国

creators.name: Disney Research — Ivan Poupyrev, Robert Sumner & colleagues
creators.role: Disney's research labs in Pittsburgh, Zurich and Los Angeles; Ivan Poupyrev led interaction research there before Google ATAP
creators.bio: Disney Research explored playful and magical AR: Ivan Poupyrev's REVEL and AIREAL added touch to projected and virtual content, Robert Sumner's Zurich team brought children's coloring pages to life in AR, and Magic Bench let people share a bench with a CG character without glasses.
creators.why: They designed AR for wonder and touch, making virtual characters feel physically present to kids and families.
creators.role_zh: Disney 位于匹兹堡、苏黎世和洛杉矶的研究实验室；Ivan Poupyrev 在加入 Google ATAP 之前曾在此领导交互研究
creators.bio_zh: Disney Research 探索充满趣味和魔力的 AR：Ivan Poupyrev 的 REVEL 和 AIREAL 为投影与虚拟内容加入了触感，Robert Sumner 的苏黎世团队让儿童涂色画在 AR 中活了起来，Magic Bench 则让人无需佩戴眼镜就能与 CG 角色同坐一张长椅。
creators.why_zh: 他们为惊奇与触感而设计 AR，让虚拟角色在孩子和家庭面前显得真实在场。
creators.based_zh: 匹兹堡（宾夕法尼亚州），美国 / 苏黎世，瑞士

creators.name: Ishikawa Watanabe Laboratory (University of Tokyo)
creators.role: Lab of Masatoshi Ishikawa with Yoshihiro Watanabe, pioneers of 1,000 fps vision and high-speed projection
creators.bio: Masatoshi Ishikawa's lab builds high-speed vision chips and the DynaFlash 1,000 fps projector, enabling dynamic projection mapping that sticks to moving, bending and deforming surfaces with no visible lag.
creators.why: They made projection mapping keep up with the real world, so images cling to a waving sheet or a gymnast's ribbon as if printed on it.
creators.role_zh: Masatoshi Ishikawa 与 Yoshihiro Watanabe 的实验室，1000 fps 视觉与高速投影的先驱
creators.bio_zh: Masatoshi Ishikawa（石川正俊）的实验室研发高速视觉芯片和 1000 fps 的 DynaFlash 投影仪，实现了动态投影映射：影像能紧贴运动、弯曲和变形的表面，且没有可察觉的延迟。
creators.why_zh: 他们让投影映射跟上了真实世界的速度，影像紧贴在飘动的布料或体操运动员的彩带上，仿佛印在上面一样。

creators.name: Thomas Van Bouwel
creators.role: Solo indie developer (Cubism, Laser Dance); former architect
creators.bio: Belgian architect-turned-solo game developer behind the hand-tracked puzzle game Cubism and the mixed-reality game Laser Dance.
creators.why: Laser Dance turns any living room's own geometry into a procedurally fitted laser obstacle course, one of the purest uses of Quest scene understanding.
creators.role_zh: 独立游戏开发者（Cubism、Laser Dance）；前建筑师
creators.bio_zh: 由建筑师转型的比利时独立游戏开发者，作品包括手势追踪解谜游戏 Cubism 和混合现实游戏 Laser Dance。
creators.why_zh: Laser Dance 把任何客厅自身的几何结构变成程序化适配的激光障碍赛道，是对 Quest 场景理解能力最纯粹的运用之一。

creators.name: Greg Madison
creators.role: XR interaction designer; former UX/interaction designer at Unity Labs
creators.bio: Interaction designer and futurist who spent years at Unity Labs prototyping how real objects, surfaces and bodies can become interfaces in mixed reality.
creators.why: His 'Tangible Mixed Reality' series and surface-based hand-tracking prototypes are some of the clearest demonstrations of blending physical objects with virtual UI.
creators.role_zh: XR 交互设计师；前 Unity Labs UX/交互设计师
creators.bio_zh: 交互设计师与未来学家，在 Unity Labs 工作多年，为真实物体、表面和身体如何在混合现实中成为界面制作原型。
creators.why_zh: 他的“Tangible Mixed Reality”系列以及基于表面的手势追踪原型，是将实体物件与虚拟 UI 相融合的最清晰示范之一。

creators.name: Leap Motion Design Research (Barrett Fox, Martin Schubert, Keiichi Matsuda et al.)
creators.role: Hand-tracking interaction design team at Leap Motion / Ultraleap
creators.bio: Leap Motion's small design research group published a stream of hand-interaction experiments and built Project North Star, an open-source wide-field AR headset.
creators.why: They defined much of the bare-hand vocabulary of headset AR (palm menus, wearable UI, desk interfaces) and open-sourced the hardware to explore it.
creators.role_zh: Leap Motion / Ultraleap 的手势追踪交互设计团队
creators.bio_zh: Leap Motion 的小型设计研究团队持续发布手部交互实验，并打造了开源宽视场 AR 头显 Project North Star。
creators.why_zh: 他们定义了头显 AR 中大部分徒手交互语汇（掌上菜单、可穿戴 UI、桌面界面），并开源硬件供人探索。

creators.name: Greg Broadmore (Weta Workshop / Weta Gameshop)
creators.role: Concept artist; creator of Dr. Grordbort; studio director of Weta Gameshop
creators.bio: Weta Workshop concept artist who created the retro-sci-fi Dr. Grordbort universe and led Weta Gameshop's multi-year collaboration with Magic Leap.
creators.why: His robot-invasion demos were the first widely seen vision of headset AR where characters burst out of your real walls.
creators.role_zh: 概念艺术家；Dr. Grordbort 创作者；Weta Gameshop 工作室总监
creators.bio_zh: Weta Workshop 概念艺术家，创造了复古科幻世界 Dr. Grordbort，并领导 Weta Gameshop 与 Magic Leap 展开了多年合作。
creators.why_zh: 他的机器人入侵演示是第一个广为人知的头显 AR 愿景：角色从你家真实的墙壁中破墙而出。

creators.name: Asobo Studio
creators.role: Game developer; HoloLens launch-title studio (later HoloForge Interactive)
creators.bio: Bordeaux game studio that built the most ambitious HoloLens launch titles and later spun out HoloForge Interactive for holographic work.
creators.why: Fragments and Young Conker were the first games to rebuild their levels around the player's real room, placing characters on real sofas and walls.
creators.role_zh: 游戏开发商；HoloLens 首发游戏工作室（后分拆出 HoloForge Interactive）
creators.bio_zh: 位于波尔多的游戏工作室，打造了最具雄心的 HoloLens 首发游戏，后来分拆出专注全息内容的 HoloForge Interactive。
creators.why_zh: Fragments 和 Young Conker 是最早围绕玩家真实房间重建关卡的游戏，把角色放在真实的沙发和墙面上。

creators.name: Sigur Rós
creators.role: Icelandic post-rock band; co-creators of the Magic Leap soundscape Tónandi
creators.bio: Icelandic band that spent five years with Magic Leap Studios building Tónandi, an interactive audio-visual soundscape.
creators.why: Tónandi recast music as something you touch in space: sounds grow as creatures around your room when you reach for them.
creators.role_zh: 冰岛后摇乐队；Magic Leap 声景作品 Tónandi 的共同创作者
creators.bio_zh: 这支冰岛乐队与 Magic Leap Studios 合作五年，打造了互动视听声景作品 Tónandi。
creators.why_zh: Tónandi 把音乐重塑为可以在空间中触摸的存在：当你伸手触碰时，声音会化作生物在你房间里生长。

creators.name: Ryan McLeod
creators.role: Indie designer-developer of Blackbox (Apple Design Award winner)
creators.bio: Solo designer of Blackbox, a puzzle game with no buttons that uses the device's own sensors, twice an Apple Design Award winner, later rebuilt for Apple Vision Pro.
creators.why: He turns a device's sensors into the puzzle itself; on Vision Pro, puzzles respond to your gaze, hands, voice and the space around you.
creators.role_zh: Blackbox 的独立设计师兼开发者（Apple 设计大奖得主）
creators.bio_zh: Blackbox 的独立设计师。这是一款没有按钮、利用设备自身传感器来解谜的游戏，两度获得 Apple 设计大奖，后来又为 Apple Vision Pro 重新打造。
creators.why_zh: 他把设备的传感器本身变成谜题；在 Vision Pro 上，谜题会响应你的目光、双手、声音和周围空间。

creators.name: realities.io
creators.role: Small XR studio (Puzzling Places)
creators.bio: Small studio that builds 3D jigsaw puzzles from photogrammetry scans of real places, with mixed-reality, hand-tracking and Vision Pro versions.
creators.why: Puzzling Places lets you rebuild miniature real-world landmarks piece by piece on your own table, alone or with a friend in the same room.
creators.role_zh: 小型 XR 工作室（Puzzling Places）
creators.bio_zh: 小型工作室，用真实地点的摄影测量扫描制作三维拼图，并推出了混合现实、手势追踪和 Vision Pro 版本。
creators.why_zh: Puzzling Places 让你在自家桌面上一块块重建真实世界地标的微缩模型，可以独自完成，也可以与同一房间的朋友一起。

creators.name: Resolution Games
creators.role: XR game studio (Angry Birds FPS, Demeo, Spatial Ops)
creators.bio: Stockholm studio founded by Tommy Palm that has shipped mixed-reality games on Magic Leap, Quest and Vision Pro since 2018.
creators.why: Spatial Ops turned any home or office into a co-located first-person shooter arena, one of the first large-scale multiplayer MR games.
creators.role_zh: XR 游戏工作室（Angry Birds FPS、Demeo、Spatial Ops）
creators.bio_zh: 由 Tommy Palm 创立的斯德哥尔摩工作室，自 2018 年起在 Magic Leap、Quest 和 Vision Pro 上陆续推出混合现实游戏。
creators.why_zh: Spatial Ops 把任何家庭或办公室变成同处一地的第一人称射击竞技场，是最早的大规模多人 MR 游戏之一。

creators.name: Botao 'Amber' Hu
creators.role: Designer-researcher; founder of Reality Design Lab; inventor of HoloKit
creators.bio: Creative technologist and experiential futures designer who invented HoloKit, an open-source stereo iPhone AR headset, and leads Reality Design Lab's research on embodied, social mixed reality.
creators.why: His work pushes co-located MR toward street play, handshakes and non-human senses (bat echolocation, felt navigation) on cheap, open hardware.
creators.role_zh: 设计师、研究者；Reality Design Lab 创始人；HoloKit 发明者
creators.bio_zh: 创意技术专家与体验式未来设计师，发明了开源的立体 iPhone AR 头显 HoloKit，并领导 Reality Design Lab 在具身化、社交化混合现实方面的研究。
creators.why_zh: 他的工作借助廉价、开放的硬件，把同处一地的 MR 推向街头游戏、握手和非人类感官（蝙蝠回声定位、可感知的导航）。
creators.based_zh: 牛津，英国 / 北京，中国

creators.name: Daniel Beauchamp (Pushmatrix)
creators.role: Spatial-computing experimentalist; Head of AR/VR at Shopify
creators.bio: Principal AR/VR engineer at Shopify who posts short, often viral hand-tracking and mixed-reality experiments under the name Pushmatrix.
creators.why: He finds the tiny everyday use case, such as vacuuming coverage or live 3D previews, that makes headset MR feel inevitable.
creators.role_zh: 空间计算实验者；Shopify AR/VR 负责人
creators.bio_zh: Shopify 首席 AR/VR 工程师，以 Pushmatrix 之名发布简短且常常走红的手势追踪与混合现实实验。
creators.why_zh: 他善于发现那些微小的日常用例——比如显示吸尘覆盖范围或实时 3D 预览——让头显 MR 显得势在必行。

creators.name: Max Weisel
creators.role: Co-founder of Normal (Normcore, Nock)
creators.bio: Designer-engineer who co-founded Normal, maker of the Normcore multiplayer framework and the VR sport Nock, and prototypes cross-device AR/VR interaction.
creators.why: His prototypes let phone-AR users and headset users share one space, an early template for cross-reality multiplayer.
creators.role_zh: Normal 联合创始人（Normcore、Nock）
creators.bio_zh: 设计师兼工程师，联合创办了 Normal——多人联机框架 Normcore 和 VR 运动游戏 Nock 的开发商，并为跨设备的 AR/VR 交互制作原型。
creators.why_zh: 他的原型让手机 AR 用户与头显用户共享同一空间，成为跨现实多人互动的早期范本。

creators.name: Julian Triveri (anaglyph)
creators.role: Solo developer of Lasertag for Quest
creators.bio: Independent developer who builds Lasertag, a co-located mixed-reality laser tag game for Quest 3 that uses real-time depth to map rooms.
creators.why: Lasertag uses the Quest depth sensor and synced room scanning so laser beams and hits respect every real obstacle, shared across all players.
creators.role_zh: Quest 游戏 Lasertag 的独立开发者
creators.bio_zh: 独立开发者，打造了 Lasertag——一款面向 Quest 3 的同处一地混合现实激光枪战游戏，利用实时深度信息为房间建图。
creators.why_zh: Lasertag 借助 Quest 深度传感器和同步的房间扫描，让激光束和命中判定尊重每一个真实障碍物，并在所有玩家之间共享。

creators.name: Stijn Spanhove
creators.role: XR developer at In The Pocket; Snap Spectacles creator
creators.bio: Belgian XR developer who builds rapid AR-glasses proofs of concept for Snap Spectacles and Meta AI glasses, often pairing them with generative AI.
creators.why: He prototypes what AR glasses plus AI can do in daily life, from a real-world ad blocker to drawings that become playable worlds.
creators.role_zh: In The Pocket XR 开发者；Snap Spectacles 创作者
creators.bio_zh: 比利时 XR 开发者，为 Snap Spectacles 和 Meta AI 眼镜快速构建 AR 眼镜概念验证，常与生成式 AI 结合。
creators.why_zh: 他为 AR 眼镜加 AI 在日常生活中的可能性制作原型，从现实世界的广告拦截器，到变成可玩世界的手绘图画。

creators.name: Pavlo Tkachenko
creators.role: AR developer and Snap Spectacles lens creator
creators.bio: AR developer who builds Spectacles lenses, often with Stijn Spanhove, and won a Spectacles Community Challenge with his generative lens Bubbles.
creators.why: His lenses make AR glasses feel playful and physical: generating objects from a prompt, or flying a plane with head movement.
creators.role_zh: AR 开发者、Snap Spectacles 镜头创作者
creators.bio_zh: AR 开发者，常与 Stijn Spanhove 合作开发 Spectacles 镜头，并凭借生成式镜头 Bubbles 赢得了 Spectacles 社区挑战赛。
creators.why_zh: 他的镜头让 AR 眼镜变得好玩又富有身体感：根据提示词生成物体，或者用头部动作驾驶飞机。

creators.name: Creature
creators.role: Small XR studio (Starship Home)
creators.bio: Small independent studio behind Starship Home, a narrative mixed-reality game for Quest 3.
creators.why: Starship Home rebuilds your real room as a spaceship interior, replacing windows and walls with space views while you care for alien plants.
creators.role_zh: 小型 XR 工作室（Starship Home）
creators.bio_zh: 小型独立工作室，推出了面向 Quest 3 的叙事型混合现实游戏 Starship Home。
creators.why_zh: Starship Home 把你的真实房间重建为宇宙飞船内部，用太空景观取代窗户和墙壁，而你则在其中照料外星植物。

creators.name: Niantic (John Hanke)
creators.role: Game studio; makers of Ingress, Pokémon GO and Peridot
creators.bio: Spun out of Google in 2015 under John Hanke, Niantic built the location-based AR games Ingress and Pokémon GO and the Lightship AR platform.
creators.why: Turned the whole planet into a shared game board and made phone AR a daily habit for hundreds of millions of players.
creators.role_zh: 游戏工作室；Ingress、Pokémon GO 和 Peridot 的开发商
creators.bio_zh: Niantic 于 2015 年在 John Hanke 带领下从 Google 独立出来，打造了基于位置的 AR 游戏 Ingress 和 Pokémon GO，以及 Lightship AR 平台。
creators.why_zh: 它把整个星球变成了共享的游戏棋盘，让手机 AR 成为数亿玩家的日常习惯。

creators.name: 8th Wall (Erik Murphy-Chutorian)
creators.role: WebAR platform, acquired by Niantic in 2022
creators.bio: 8th Wall, founded by Erik Murphy-Chutorian in 2016, made markerless AR run in the mobile browser without an app and powered thousands of WebAR campaigns.
creators.why: Removed the app-install barrier so any link could open an AR world.
creators.role_zh: WebAR 平台，2022 年被 Niantic 收购
creators.bio_zh: 8th Wall 由 Erik Murphy-Chutorian 于 2016 年创立，让无标记 AR 无需安装应用即可在手机浏览器中运行，支撑了数千个 WebAR 营销活动。
creators.why_zh: 它消除了安装应用的门槛，让任何一个链接都能打开一个 AR 世界。

creators.name: Novarama
creators.role: Game studio; creators of Invizimals
creators.bio: Barcelona studio founded by Daniel Sánchez-Crespo that made the Invizimals series for PSP, PS Vita and PS3, which used a camera and marker trap card to capture creatures on the player's table.
creators.why: Invizimals (2009) was one of the first mass-market handheld AR games and made marker-based AR a playground hit a decade before ARKit.
creators.role_zh: 游戏工作室；Invizimals 的创作者
creators.bio_zh: 由 Daniel Sánchez-Crespo 创立的巴塞罗那工作室，为 PSP、PS Vita 和 PS3 制作了 Invizimals 系列：玩家借助摄像头和标记“陷阱卡”在自己的桌面上捕捉生物。
creators.why_zh: Invizimals（2009）是最早的大众市场掌机 AR 游戏之一，比 ARKit 早十年就让基于标记的 AR 成为操场上的热门游戏。

creators.name: SCE London Studio
creators.role: Sony first-party studio (EyeToy, EyePet, Wonderbook)
creators.bio: Sony's London Studio pioneered camera games from EyeToy to EyePet and the Wonderbook, an AR book peripheral for PS3.
creators.why: Showed that a TV, a webcam and a printed card could make a believable virtual creature live in the living room.
creators.role_zh: Sony 第一方工作室（EyeToy、EyePet、Wonderbook）
creators.bio_zh: Sony 的 London Studio 开创了摄像头游戏，从 EyeToy 到 EyePet，再到 PS3 的 AR 书本外设 Wonderbook。
creators.why_zh: 它证明了一台电视、一个摄像头和一张印刷卡片，就能让一只可信的虚拟生物住进客厅。

creators.name: Nintendo
creators.role: Game and hardware company (3DS AR Games, Face Raiders)
creators.bio: Nintendo shipped AR Games and Face Raiders on every Nintendo 3DS in 2011, using AR cards and the handheld's cameras, and later co-created Mario Kart Live with Velan Studios.
creators.why: Put camera AR preinstalled in tens of millions of handhelds and kept finding playful uses for it.
creators.role_zh: 游戏与硬件公司（3DS AR Games、Face Raiders）
creators.bio_zh: Nintendo 于 2011 年在每台 Nintendo 3DS 上预装了 AR Games 和 Face Raiders，利用 AR 卡片和掌机摄像头进行游戏；后来又与 Velan Studios 合作推出了 Mario Kart Live。
creators.why_zh: 它将摄像头 AR 预装进数千万台掌机，并不断为其找到有趣的用法。

creators.name: Velan Studios (Karthik & Guha Bala)
creators.role: Game studio; Mario Kart Live and Hot Wheels Rift Rally
creators.bio: Founded by brothers Karthik and Guha Bala, Velan Studios builds mixed-reality games that pair real RC cars with camera-based AR tracks.
creators.why: Mario Kart Live turned the player's living room into a racetrack seen from a real kart's camera.
creators.role_zh: 游戏工作室；Mario Kart Live 与 Hot Wheels Rift Rally
creators.bio_zh: 由 Karthik Bala 和 Guha Bala 兄弟创立，Velan Studios 打造将真实遥控车与基于摄像头的 AR 赛道相结合的混合现实游戏。
creators.why_zh: Mario Kart Live 通过真实卡丁车上的摄像头，把玩家的客厅变成了赛道。

creators.name: Google Creative Lab
creators.role: Google's in-house creative team (Experiments with Google)
creators.bio: Google Creative Lab makes open-source experiments that show new uses of Google tech, including a series of ARCore experiments such as Just a Line, Drawalong AR, Sounds in Space and Lines of Play.
creators.why: Produced some of the most shareable, open-source phone AR experiments, often with artists and dancers.
creators.role_zh: Google 内部创意团队（Experiments with Google）
creators.bio_zh: Google Creative Lab 制作开源实验项目，展示 Google 技术的新用途，其中包括一系列 ARCore 实验，如 Just a Line、Drawalong AR、Sounds in Space 和 Lines of Play。
creators.why_zh: 他们常与艺术家和舞者合作，创作了一批最易于传播的开源手机 AR 实验。
creators.based_zh: 纽约 / 伦敦 / 悉尼

creators.name: Jonas Jongejan
creators.role: Creative technologist, Google Creative Lab
creators.bio: Danish creative technologist who built early ARCore experiments at Google Creative Lab and wrote the openFrameworks addon ofxARCore.
creators.why: His 2017 AR Wormhole and ARCore drawing prototypes helped set the playful tone of Google's AR experiments.
creators.role_zh: Google Creative Lab 创意技术专家
creators.bio_zh: 丹麦创意技术专家，在 Google Creative Lab 构建了早期 ARCore 实验，并编写了 openFrameworks 插件 ofxARCore。
creators.why_zh: 他在 2017 年制作的 AR Wormhole 和 ARCore 绘画原型，帮助奠定了 Google AR 实验轻松有趣的基调。

creators.name: Jeri Ellsworth
creators.role: Hardware engineer; co-founder of castAR and Tilt Five
creators.bio: Self-taught chip designer who built AR glasses at Valve, then spun them out as castAR (2013) and later Tilt Five, a retro-reflective tabletop AR game system.
creators.why: Two times she pushed a different idea of AR: glasses plus a retro-reflective board so shared holograms sit on a real table.
creators.role_zh: 硬件工程师；castAR 与 Tilt Five 联合创始人
creators.bio_zh: 自学成才的芯片设计师，曾在 Valve 开发 AR 眼镜，随后将其独立为 castAR（2013），之后又创办 Tilt Five——一套基于逆反射材料的桌面 AR 游戏系统。
creators.why_zh: 她两度推动了另一种 AR 理念：眼镜配合逆反射游戏板，让共享的全息影像稳稳地停在真实桌面上。

creators.name: Directive Games
creators.role: Game studio; The Machines (ARKit launch title)
creators.bio: Directive Games built The Machines, a tabletop multiplayer strategy game in Unreal Engine that Apple showed on stage when ARKit launched in 2017.
creators.why: The Machines was the first big demonstration of competitive multiplayer AR on a real table.
creators.role_zh: 游戏工作室；The Machines（ARKit 首发游戏）
creators.bio_zh: Directive Games 用 Unreal Engine 打造了桌面多人策略游戏 The Machines，Apple 在 2017 年 ARKit 发布时将其搬上了舞台演示。
creators.why_zh: The Machines 是在真实桌面上进行竞技多人 AR 的首次大型展示。

creators.name: Snap Inc. (Snapchat Lenses)
creators.role: Camera company; Snapchat Lenses and Lens Studio
creators.bio: Snap turned face filters into a mass medium with Snapchat Lenses (2015), then added World Lenses, Lens Studio for creators, Landmarkers and Local Lenses.
creators.why: Built the largest daily AR audience and opened it to independent lens artists.
creators.role_zh: 相机公司；Snapchat Lenses 与 Lens Studio
creators.bio_zh: Snap 通过 Snapchat Lenses（2015）把面部滤镜变成了大众媒介，随后又推出了 World Lenses、面向创作者的 Lens Studio、Landmarkers 和 Local Lenses。
creators.why_zh: 它建立了规模最大的日常 AR 受众群体，并向独立镜头艺术家开放。

creators.name: Ines Alpha
creators.role: 3D digital makeup artist
creators.bio: French artist who creates 3D 'e-makeup' that grows from faces as AR filters and face-tracked videos, working with musicians, fashion brands and Prada Beauty.
creators.why: Invented a new genre of surreal, non-human beauty made for the camera instead of the skin.
creators.role_zh: 3D 数字化妆艺术家
creators.bio_zh: 法国艺术家，以 AR 滤镜和面部追踪视频的形式创作从面孔上“生长”出来的 3D“电子妆容”，合作对象包括音乐人、时尚品牌和 Prada Beauty。
creators.why_zh: 她开创了一种为镜头而非皮肤而生的、超现实且非人类的美的新类型。

creators.name: Johanna Jaskowska
creators.role: AR designer; creator of Beauty3000
creators.bio: Polish designer whose Instagram effect Beauty3000 (2018), a glossy chrome face mask, went viral and helped launch the AR filter-artist scene.
creators.why: Beauty3000 reframed face filters as art about beauty and identity rather than puppy ears.
creators.role_zh: AR 设计师；Beauty3000 创作者
creators.bio_zh: 波兰设计师，她在 2018 年推出的 Instagram 特效 Beauty3000——一款光亮的铬金属质感面具——迅速走红，推动了 AR 滤镜艺术家群体的兴起。
creators.why_zh: Beauty3000 把面部滤镜重新定义为关于美与身份的艺术，而不只是小狗耳朵。

creators.name: Marc Wakefield
creators.role: AR effects artist; co-founder of Augmented Reality Design Studio
creators.bio: Illustrator turned AR artist whose Spark AR world effects and character filters have been used by millions, including work for U2; he runs Augmented Reality Design Studio with Susie Wakefield.
creators.why: One of the first illustrators to make a career of turning drawn worlds into Instagram AR.
creators.role_zh: AR 特效艺术家；Augmented Reality Design Studio 联合创始人
creators.bio_zh: 由插画师转型的 AR 艺术家，他的 Spark AR 世界特效和角色滤镜已被数百万人使用，其中包括为 U2 创作的作品；他与 Susie Wakefield 共同经营 Augmented Reality Design Studio。
creators.why_zh: 他是最早一批以把手绘世界变成 Instagram AR 为职业的插画师之一。

creators.name: Paige Piskin
creators.role: AR filter creator (Snap Lens Studio, Spark AR)
creators.bio: Official Snap Lens Creator whose makeup, fashion and cartoon filters have been used billions of times; she also teaches lens making.
creators.why: Made AR makeup and cartoon-face lenses a pop medium and documents her process openly.
creators.role_zh: AR 滤镜创作者（Snap Lens Studio、Spark AR）
creators.bio_zh: Snap 官方认证镜头创作者，她的妆容、时尚和卡通滤镜已被使用数十亿次；她也教授镜头制作。
creators.why_zh: 她让 AR 妆容和卡通脸镜头成为一种流行媒介，并公开分享自己的创作过程。

creators.name: Tonchidot (Takahito Iguchi)
creators.role: Startup; Sekai Camera AR app
creators.bio: Tonchidot, led by Takahito Iguchi, showed Sekai Camera at TechCrunch50 in 2008: an iPhone app that let people leave floating 'air tags' of text, photos and sound in places.
creators.why: Sekai Camera was one of the first social, location-anchored AR apps, years before AR clouds.
creators.role_zh: 初创公司；Sekai Camera AR 应用
creators.bio_zh: 由 Takahito Iguchi（井口尊仁）领导的 Tonchidot 在 2008 年 TechCrunch50 大会上发布了 Sekai Camera：这款 iPhone 应用让人们可以在各个地点留下漂浮的文字、照片和声音“空中标签”。
creators.why_zh: Sekai Camera 是最早的社交化、锚定于地点的 AR 应用之一，比“AR 云”概念早了好几年。

creators.name: Layar (Raimo van der Klein, Claire Boonstra, Maarten Lens-FitzGerald)
creators.role: Mobile AR browser company
creators.bio: Layar launched in 2009 as the first mobile AR browser, overlaying geolocated 'layers' of information on the camera view, and later moved to interactive print.
creators.why: Created the first open platform where anyone could publish geolocated AR content for phones.
creators.role_zh: 移动 AR 浏览器公司
creators.bio_zh: Layar 于 2009 年推出，是首个移动 AR 浏览器，在摄像头画面上叠加带地理位置的信息“图层”，后来转向互动印刷品领域。
creators.why_zh: 它创建了第一个开放平台，让任何人都能为手机发布基于地理位置的 AR 内容。

creators.name: Otavio Good (Quest Visual)
creators.role: Creator of Word Lens
creators.bio: Otavio Good founded Quest Visual and built Word Lens (2010), which translated printed signs live in the camera view; Google acquired it for Google Translate.
creators.why: Word Lens was a 'magic' AR moment that replaced real-world text in place, on a 2010 iPhone.
creators.role_zh: Word Lens 创作者
creators.bio_zh: Otavio Good 创立了 Quest Visual，并开发了 Word Lens（2010）——它能在摄像头画面中实时翻译印刷标识；后被 Google 收购并整合进 Google Translate。
creators.why_zh: 早在 2010 年的 iPhone 上，Word Lens 就能原地替换现实世界中的文字，带来了“魔法般”的 AR 时刻。

creators.name: Within (Wonderscope)
creators.role: Immersive studio; Wonderscope AR stories for kids
creators.bio: Within, co-founded by Chris Milk and Aaron Koblin, made Wonderscope (2018), an iOS app of AR stories where children speak characters' lines aloud to move the story forward.
creators.why: Wonderscope made voice-driven AR storytelling for children, with the child as an actor inside the story.
creators.role_zh: 沉浸式工作室；面向儿童的 Wonderscope AR 故事
creators.bio_zh: 由 Chris Milk 和 Aaron Koblin 联合创立的 Within 推出了 Wonderscope（2018）：一款 iOS AR 故事应用，孩子们需要大声念出角色台词来推动剧情发展。
creators.why_zh: Wonderscope 开创了面向儿童的语音驱动 AR 叙事，让孩子成为故事中的演员。

creators.name: Climax Studios
creators.role: Game studio; ARise, Towers for Tango
creators.bio: UK developer that made early phone AR games for Google Tango and ARKit, including the perspective puzzle game ARise.
creators.why: ARise made the player's physical viewpoint the puzzle mechanic.
creators.role_zh: 游戏工作室；ARise、Towers for Tango
creators.bio_zh: 英国开发商，为 Google Tango 和 ARKit 制作了早期手机 AR 游戏，其中包括视角解谜游戏 ARise。
creators.why_zh: ARise 把玩家的实际观察视角变成了解谜机制。

creators.name: Kunabi Brother
creators.role: Indie studio; Euclidean Lands
creators.bio: Small Viennese studio (Miro Straka) behind the rotating-cube puzzle game Euclidean Lands and one of the first ARKit ports.
creators.why: Brought a Monument Valley-style rotating puzzle onto the tabletop with ARKit on day one.
creators.role_zh: 独立工作室；Euclidean Lands
creators.bio_zh: 维也纳的小型工作室（Miro Straka），推出了旋转立方体解谜游戏 Euclidean Lands，也是最早移植到 ARKit 的游戏之一。
creators.why_zh: 在 ARKit 发布第一天，就把《纪念碑谷》式的旋转解谜搬上了桌面。

creators.name: Mighty Coconut
creators.role: Game studio; 57° North (Merge Cube), Walkabout Mini Golf
creators.bio: Indie studio that made 57° North, a choose-your-own-adventure story played on the handheld Merge Cube, before its VR hit Walkabout Mini Golf.
creators.why: Turned a foam cube held in the hand into a tiny diorama stage for a branching story.
creators.role_zh: 游戏工作室；57° North（Merge Cube）、Walkabout Mini Golf
creators.bio_zh: 独立工作室，在推出 VR 热门作品 Walkabout Mini Golf 之前，制作了 57° North——一款在手持 Merge Cube 上游玩的互动冒险故事。
creators.why_zh: 它把手中的泡沫立方体变成了分支故事的微型立体布景舞台。

creators.name: Merge Labs (Merge Cube)
creators.role: AR/VR toy and education company
creators.bio: Merge makes the Merge Cube, a patterned foam cube that phones track so a hologram can be held and turned in the hand, used widely in schools.
creators.why: Made a cheap physical tracker that turns AR into something children can hold.
creators.role_zh: AR/VR 玩具与教育公司
creators.bio_zh: Merge 生产 Merge Cube——一个印有图案的泡沫立方体，手机可以追踪它，让人把全息影像拿在手中翻转查看，已在学校中广泛使用。
creators.why_zh: 它做出了一个廉价的实体追踪器，让 AR 成为孩子们可以握在手里的东西。

creators.name: Novum Analytics
creators.role: Indie studio; Night Terrors AR horror
creators.bio: Small studio behind Night Terrors, a crowdfunded phone AR survival horror game played at home in the dark with headphones.
creators.why: Night Terrors used the player's own house, mapped by the phone, as the haunted set.
creators.role_zh: 独立工作室；Night Terrors AR 恐怖游戏
creators.bio_zh: 小型工作室，推出了众筹手机 AR 生存恐怖游戏 Night Terrors，玩家需要戴上耳机，在黑暗的家中游玩。
creators.why_zh: Night Terrors 把手机扫描出的玩家自家房屋当作闹鬼的布景。

creators.name: The LEGO Group (Hidden Side)
creators.role: Toy company; LEGO Hidden Side AR sets
creators.bio: LEGO's Hidden Side line (2019) combined physical building sets with a phone app that revealed ghosts haunting the model.
creators.why: Merged physical construction play with an AR layer that reacts to the built model.
creators.role_zh: 玩具公司；LEGO Hidden Side AR 套装
creators.bio_zh: LEGO 的 Hidden Side 系列（2019）把实体积木套装与手机应用相结合，应用能显现出盘踞在模型中的幽灵。
creators.why_zh: 它把实体搭建游戏与一个会对搭好的模型作出反应的 AR 图层融为一体。

creators.name: Mojang Studios (Minecraft Earth)
creators.role: Game studio; Minecraft Earth
creators.bio: Mojang and Microsoft built Minecraft Earth (2019–2021), a location-based AR game where players built life-size Minecraft structures in the real world.
creators.why: Let players build and play inside life-size voxel builds together on the street.
creators.role_zh: 游戏工作室；Minecraft Earth
creators.bio_zh: Mojang 与 Microsoft 合作打造了 Minecraft Earth（2019–2021），这是一款基于位置的 AR 游戏，玩家可以在现实世界中搭建真实尺寸的 Minecraft 建筑。
creators.why_zh: 它让玩家在街头一起搭建真实尺寸的体素建筑，并在其中游戏。
creators.based_zh: 斯德哥尔摩，瑞典 / 雷德蒙德，美国

creators.name: Zenka (Zenka Caro)
creators.role: AR artist
creators.bio: Artist who from 2012 made AR street art, murals, postcards and linoleum prints that came alive through Aurasma on phones.
creators.why: An early fine-art user of phone AR, turning prints and walls into animated works years before ARKit.
creators.role_zh: AR 艺术家
creators.bio_zh: 艺术家，自 2012 年起创作 AR 街头艺术、壁画、明信片和麻胶版画，通过手机上的 Aurasma 让它们活起来。
creators.why_zh: 她是早期将手机 AR 用于纯艺术创作的人之一，比 ARKit 早好几年就把版画和墙面变成了动态作品。

creators.name: Tender Claws (Samantha Gorman & Danny Cannizzaro)
creators.role: Immersive game and art studio
creators.bio: Studio led by Samantha Gorman and Danny Cannizzaro that makes experimental VR and AR works such as Virtual Virtual Reality, The Under Presents and the AR pet TendAR.
creators.why: TendAR made an AR creature that literally feeds on the player's facial expressions and emotions.
creators.role_zh: 沉浸式游戏与艺术工作室
creators.bio_zh: 由 Samantha Gorman 和 Danny Cannizzaro 领导的工作室，创作实验性 VR 与 AR 作品，如 Virtual Virtual Reality、The Under Presents 以及 AR 宠物 TendAR。
creators.why_zh: TendAR 创造了一只真正以玩家面部表情和情绪为“食物”的 AR 生物。

creators.name: SCE Japan Studio (The Eye of Judgment)
creators.role: Sony first-party studio
creators.bio: Sony's Japan Studio co-created The Eye of Judgment (2007) with Wizards of the Coast, a PS3 card battle game read by the PlayStation Eye camera.
creators.why: The Eye of Judgment was the first major console AR game, turning a physical trading-card mat into a 3D battlefield.
creators.role_zh: Sony 第一方工作室
creators.bio_zh: Sony 的 Japan Studio 与 Wizards of the Coast 合作推出了 The Eye of Judgment（2007）——一款通过 PlayStation Eye 摄像头读取卡牌的 PS3 卡牌对战游戏。
creators.why_zh: The Eye of Judgment 是第一款主流主机 AR 游戏，把实体集换式卡牌垫变成了三维战场。

creators.name: Scott Snibbe
creators.role: Interactive artist; founder of Snibbe Studio and Snibbe Interactive
creators.bio: Media artist whose late-1990s/2000s 'Screen Series' turned projector light and a viewer's shadow into an interactive medium; he later produced Björk's Biophilia app and led Snibbe Interactive's museum installations.
creators.why: Boundary Functions and the shadow works are the canonical examples of projection AR that needs no device: the body itself is the controller.
creators.role_zh: 互动艺术家；Snibbe Studio 与 Snibbe Interactive 创始人
creators.bio_zh: 媒体艺术家，他在 1990 年代末至 2000 年代的“Screen Series”把投影光和观者的影子变成了互动媒介；后来他制作了 Björk 的 Biophilia 应用，并领导 Snibbe Interactive 的博物馆装置项目。
creators.why_zh: Boundary Functions 和他的影子系列作品，是无需任何设备的投影 AR 的经典范例：身体本身就是控制器。

creators.name: Camille Utterback
creators.role: Interactive installation artist; MacArthur Fellow (2009)
creators.bio: Artist whose camera-based projections (Text Rain with Romy Achituv, the External Measures series, Liquid Time) render the moving body as a painterly, living trace. Associate professor at Stanford.
creators.why: Text Rain (1999) is one of the most taught interactive artworks ever: bodies catching falling letters is still the clearest demo of body-driven mixed reality.
creators.role_zh: 互动装置艺术家；麦克阿瑟学者（2009）
creators.bio_zh: 艺术家，她基于摄像头的投影作品（与 Romy Achituv 合作的 Text Rain、External Measures 系列、Liquid Time）把运动中的身体呈现为富有绘画感的鲜活痕迹。现任斯坦福大学副教授。
creators.why_zh: Text Rain（1999）是被教授最多的互动艺术作品之一：用身体接住飘落的字母，至今仍是身体驱动型混合现实最清晰的示范。

creators.name: Karolina Sobecka
creators.role: Artist and researcher (gravitytrap, Flightphase)
creators.bio: Polish-born artist who projects responsive animals and figures into public space — from shop windows to buildings passing by a moving car — and later turned to cloud and atmosphere research.
creators.why: Sniff and Wildlife put real-time, camera- or sensor-driven characters into the street years before phone AR, making public space itself the display.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、研究者（gravitytrap、Flightphase）
creators.bio_zh: 出生于波兰的艺术家，将能够回应观众的动物和人物投射到公共空间——从商店橱窗到在行驶车辆旁掠过的建筑——后来转向云与大气研究。
creators.why_zh: Sniff 和 Wildlife 早在手机 AR 出现前多年，就把由摄像头或传感器实时驱动的角色带上街头，让公共空间本身成为显示屏。
creators.based_zh: 纽约，美国 / 巴塞罗那

creators.name: Klaus Obermaier
creators.role: Media artist, director, choreographer and composer
creators.bio: Austrian artist who has projection-mapped moving dancers since 1998 (D.A.V.E., Vivisector) and, with Ars Electronica Futurelab, made real-time interactive body projection with Apparition (2004) and a stereoscopic Rite of Spring.
creators.why: He pioneered projection mapping onto live moving bodies — AR on the performer rather than on a screen.
creators.role_zh: 媒体艺术家、导演、编舞家、作曲家
creators.bio_zh: 奥地利艺术家，自 1998 年起在运动中的舞者身上进行投影映射（D.A.V.E.、Vivisector），并与 Ars Electronica Futurelab 合作，以 Apparition（2004）实现了实时互动身体投影，还创作了立体版《春之祭》。
creators.why_zh: 他开创了在运动中的真人身体上进行投影映射——让 AR 出现在表演者身上，而非屏幕上。

creators.name: MIKIKO / ELEVENPLAY
creators.role: Choreographer and stage director; founder of the dance company ELEVENPLAY
creators.bio: MIKIKO choreographs Perfume and BABYMETAL and leads ELEVENPLAY, whose decade-long collaboration with Rhizomatiks (Daito Manabe, Motoi Ishibashi) produced dances with drones, robot cubes, AR overlays and mixed-reality stages.
creators.why: She is the choreographer who made drones, projection and mixed reality into dance partners rather than stage effects.
creators.role_zh: 编舞家、舞台导演；舞团 ELEVENPLAY 创始人
creators.bio_zh: MIKIKO 为 Perfume 和 BABYMETAL 编舞，并领导 ELEVENPLAY。舞团与 Rhizomatiks（Daito Manabe、Motoi Ishibashi）长达十年的合作，诞生了与无人机、机器人立方体、AR 叠加以及混合现实舞台共舞的作品。
creators.why_zh: 正是这位编舞家让无人机、投影和混合现实成为舞伴，而不只是舞台特效。

creators.name: Random International (Hannes Koch & Florian Ortkrass)
creators.role: Art studio
creators.bio: Studio founded in 2005 that makes camera-driven installations where matter reacts to the viewer's presence — mirrors that turn to stare, light that paints your reflection, rain that stops where you walk.
creators.why: Rain Room made 'reality that responds to your body' a mass-audience experience without any headset or screen.
creators.role_zh: 艺术工作室
creators.bio_zh: 成立于 2005 年的工作室，创作由摄像头驱动的装置，让物质对观者的存在作出反应——会转过来凝视你的镜子、描绘你倒影的光、在你走过之处停下的雨。
creators.why_zh: Rain Room 让“回应你身体的现实”成为一种无需头显或屏幕的大众体验。
creators.based_zh: 伦敦，英国 / 柏林，德国

creators.name: Rafael Lozano-Hemmer
creators.role: Media artist; founder of Antimodular Research
creators.bio: Mexican-Canadian artist whose 'relational architecture' uses surveillance cameras, robotic projectors and biometric sensors to let the public take over city squares and façades; represented Mexico at the 2007 Venice Biennale.
creators.why: Body Movies and Under Scan are defining works of public-space projection AR, where your shadow reveals hidden portraits on a building or square.
creators.role_zh: 媒体艺术家；Antimodular Research 创始人
creators.bio_zh: 墨西哥裔加拿大艺术家，他的“关系建筑”利用监控摄像头、机器人投影仪和生物识别传感器，让公众接管城市广场和建筑立面；曾于 2007 年代表墨西哥参加威尼斯双年展。
creators.why_zh: Body Movies 和 Under Scan 是公共空间投影 AR 的代表作：你的影子会在建筑或广场上揭示隐藏的肖像。

creators.name: Daniel Rozin
creators.role: Artist; professor at NYU ITP
creators.bio: Israeli-American artist who builds 'mechanical mirrors': grids of wood, trash, pegs, steel or toy penguins moved by motors to reflect the viewer captured by a hidden camera.
creators.why: His mirrors turn a camera feed into physical pixels — the most tangible form of a reality filter.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家；NYU ITP 教授
creators.bio_zh: 以色列裔美国艺术家，打造“机械镜子”：由木块、垃圾、木钉、钢片或玩具企鹅组成的阵列，在电机驱动下映照出隐藏摄像头捕捉到的观者。
creators.why_zh: 他的镜子把摄像头画面变成了实体像素——这是“现实滤镜”最可触摸的形式。

creators.name: Adrien M & Claire B (Adrien Mondot & Claire Bardainne)
creators.role: Digital art and performance company
creators.bio: Company combining juggler-programmer Adrien Mondot and visual artist Claire Bardainne; their live, physics-driven projections (eMotion software) and AR books/exhibitions make drawings breathe around dancers and visitors.
creators.why: They extended projection-mapped dance into hand-held AR: pop-up books and drawn exhibitions come alive through a tablet.
creators.role_zh: 数字艺术与表演团体
creators.bio_zh: 由杂耍艺人兼程序员 Adrien Mondot 与视觉艺术家 Claire Bardainne 组成的团体；他们基于物理模拟的实时投影（eMotion 软件）以及 AR 书籍与展览，让手绘图像在舞者和观众周围呼吸起来。
creators.why_zh: 他们把投影映射舞蹈延伸到手持 AR：立体书和手绘展览通过平板电脑活了起来。

creators.name: Romain Tardy
creators.role: Visual artist; former core member of the AntiVJ label
creators.bio: French artist who co-shaped AntiVJ's architectural projection mapping (Déshérence, O (Omicron)) and now builds site-specific light and projection installations that treat buildings and landscapes as narrative surfaces.
creators.why: O (Omicron) on Wrocław's Centennial Hall is a reference piece for projection mapping that reveals — rather than decorates — the architecture.
creators.role_zh: 视觉艺术家；AntiVJ 厂牌前核心成员
creators.bio_zh: 法国艺术家，参与塑造了 AntiVJ 的建筑投影映射（Déshérence、O (Omicron)），如今创作场域特定的灯光与投影装置，把建筑和地景当作叙事的表面。
creators.why_zh: 在弗罗茨瓦夫百年厅上呈现的 O (Omicron) 是投影映射的参照之作——它揭示建筑，而非装饰建筑。

creators.name: Yannick Jacquet (Legoman)
creators.role: Media artist and art director; former AntiVJ member
creators.bio: Visual artist known as Legoman in the AntiVJ label; his mapped installations mix physical print, mechanism and projection so that drawn machines and images appear to move on paper and walls.
creators.why: Mécaniques Discursives shows how a static print plus precise projection becomes a living machine — a low-tech, highly teachable form of spatial AR.
creators.role_zh: 媒体艺术家、艺术总监；AntiVJ 前成员
creators.bio_zh: 在 AntiVJ 厂牌中以 Legoman 之名为人所知的视觉艺术家；他的映射装置融合了实体印刷品、机械结构与投影，让纸面和墙上的手绘机器与图像仿佛动了起来。
creators.why_zh: Mécaniques Discursives 展示了一张静态印刷品加上精准投影，就能变成一台鲜活的机器——这是一种低技术、非常适合教学的空间 AR 形式。

creators.name: URBANSCREEN
creators.role: Artist collective and studio for architectural projection
creators.bio: Collective founded in 2005 that pioneered large-scale 'architectural staging' — façade projections such as 555 KUBIK and the Sydney Opera House sails — and 'augmented sculptures' where projection and custom-built forms are designed together.
creators.why: 555 KUBIK (2009) is one of the viral works that defined 3D projection mapping as an art form.
creators.role_zh: 建筑投影艺术团体与工作室
creators.bio_zh: 成立于 2005 年的团体，开创了大规模“建筑演出”——如 555 KUBIK 和悉尼歌剧院风帆上的立面投影——以及“增强雕塑”，即投影与定制造型被一体设计。
creators.why_zh: 555 KUBIK（2009）是将 3D 投影映射确立为一种艺术形式的病毒式传播作品之一。

creators.name: Refik Anadol
creators.role: Media artist; founder of Refik Anadol Studio
creators.bio: Turkish-American artist who turns architecture into 'data paintings' with large-scale projection and, later, AI-generated 'data sculptures' on building façades and immersive rooms.
creators.why: WDCH Dreams projected a machine's 'memories' of an orchestra onto Frank Gehry's concert hall, extending projection mapping into data and AI.
creators.role_zh: 媒体艺术家；Refik Anadol Studio 创始人
