creators.bio_zh: 艺术家，审视监控、自动化和算法化生活之下的社会关系；p5.js 库的创建者，曾在 SFPC 任教。
creators.why_zh: 她运用面部分析、手势追踪和入耳式 AI 来增强亲密的社交情境，让 AR 成为质疑监控的工具。

creators.name: Memo Akten
creators.role: Artist and researcher; Assistant Professor, UC San Diego
creators.bio: Turkish-born artist and computer scientist working with code, computer vision and machine learning; author of the ofxMSAFluid tools widely used in the openFrameworks community.
creators.why: Turned webcams into instruments and paintbrushes for the whole body, and later made live AI 'reality filters' of everyday objects.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、研究者；加州大学圣迭戈分校助理教授
creators.bio_zh: 出生于土耳其的艺术家和计算机科学家，创作涉及代码、计算机视觉和机器学习；他开发的 ofxMSAFluid 工具在 openFrameworks 社区中被广泛使用。
creators.why_zh: 他把网络摄像头变成供全身使用的乐器和画笔，后来又为日常物品制作了实时 AI“现实滤镜”。

creators.name: Chris O'Shea
creators.role: Artist and creative technologist
creators.bio: British artist and designer making playful camera-based installations for public screens, museums and hospitals; long-time openFrameworks contributor.
creators.why: Made public-space mixed reality that plays pranks on passers-by, like a giant hand that plucks people off the street on BBC Big Screens.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、创意技术专家
creators.bio_zh: 英国艺术家和设计师，为公共屏幕、博物馆和医院创作趣味性的摄像头互动装置；长期为 openFrameworks 贡献代码。
creators.why_zh: 他创作了会捉弄路人的公共空间混合现实作品，比如在 BBC Big Screens 上把行人从街上拎起来的巨手。

creators.name: Nicole He
creators.role: Programmer and artist; former Google Creative Lab creative technologist
creators.bio: Programmer and artist making playful work with voice interfaces, games and AI; SFPC and ITP community member.
creators.why: Combined speech recognition with ARCore so you grow AR plants by talking to them.
creators.role_zh: 程序员、艺术家；前 Google Creative Lab 创意技术专家
creators.bio_zh: 程序员和艺术家，用语音界面、游戏和 AI 创作趣味作品；SFPC 与 ITP 社区成员。
creators.why_zh: 她将语音识别与 ARCore 结合，让你通过对 AR 植物说话来让它们生长。

works.title: A 20-million-splat San Francisco on the table
works.description: A 20M-splat scan of San Francisco runs on a phone in WebAR; moving the phone closer zooms into individual streets.
works.idea_zh: 把整座旧金山缩成桌上模型，手机靠近就钻进街道。

video.video_title:
20 million Gaussian splat of SF running all on a mobile device in WebAR. It’s really fun to move the phone around to zoom into different streets. Crazy to see the amount of detail in this scan 

Three

works.technique: A very large splat city is streamed with level-of-detail chunking, placed on a detected tabletop plane, and the renderer loads finer splats as the camera distance to each chunk shrinks.
works.exercise_zh: 把一张城市或校园的 3D 模型按三级 LOD 放在桌面上，手机靠近时切换到高精度版本；变体：靠近某栋楼时弹出一句关于它的语音介绍。
works.description_zh: 一份由 2000 万个高斯点（splat）组成的旧金山扫描，通过 WebAR 在手机上运行；把手机凑近，就能放大到一条条具体的街道。
works.idea_en: Shrink all of San Francisco into a tabletop model, then move the phone closer to dive into its streets.
works.technique_zh: 超大规模的高斯点城市按细节层级（LOD）分块流式加载，放置在检测到的桌面平面上；随着相机与各分块的距离缩短，渲染器会逐步加载更精细的高斯点。
works.exercise_en: Place a 3D model of a city or campus on a tabletop with three LOD levels, and switch to the high-detail version when the phone moves closer. Twist: when the phone approaches a particular building, play a one-line voice introduction about it.

works.title: A picture frame that is a window
works.description: A WebXR picture frame on the office wall that shows a persistent generated 3D world behind it, like a window into another place.
works.idea_zh: 墙上挂一个“相框”，里面其实是通往另一个 3D 世界的窗户。

video.video_title:
New picture frame in the office 

WebXR + Cursor + GPT-5.5 + Marble

I tried XR dev again with cursor earlier this year and still was a frustrating process. This past week I tried again and the tools

works.technique: A frame is anchored to a wall via plane detection, and a stencil mask limits rendering of a persistent 3D world to the frame's rectangle, so parallax makes it read as a window.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 在墙上检测平面并放置一个相框，框内用 Stencil 渲染一个远景场景；变体：让框内的时间和天气跟随真实时钟变化。
works.description_zh: 办公室墙上挂着一个 WebXR 相框，框后是一个持续存在的生成式 3D 世界，看上去就像一扇通往别处的窗户。
works.idea_en: A 'picture frame' on the wall is really a window into another 3D world.
works.technique_zh: 通过平面检测把相框锚定在墙上，再用模板遮罩（stencil mask）把一个持续存在的 3D 世界的渲染限制在相框的矩形范围内，借助视差让它看起来像一扇窗。
works.exercise_en: Use AR Foundation to detect a wall plane and place a picture frame on it, then render a distant scene inside the frame with a stencil. Twist: make the time of day and weather inside the frame follow the real clock.

works.title: A pocket holodeck in WebAR
works.description: Gaussian splats of about 5 MB each, generated from single images, placed around him in web AR like a miniature holodeck.
works.idea_zh: 每个 AI 生成的场景只有 5MB，放在身边就是随身全息甲板。

video.video_title:
Web augmented reality 

Each Gaussian Splat is only 5mb in size and generated from a single image. It’s like a mini sized Holodeck https://t.co/jANStJCIWk

works.technique: Several small single-image splats (about 5 MB each) are placed at fixed offsets around the user's starting pose in WebAR, forming a ring of scenes the user turns to face.
works.exercise_zh: 用单张图片生成 3D 场景的工具（或简单的 3D 模型替代）做 4 个小场景，按东南西北方向摆在自己周围；变体：让每个方向的场景对应一天中的一个时段。
works.description_zh: 由单张图片生成的高斯点场景，每个约 5 MB，通过网页 AR 摆放在他身边，宛如一座迷你全息甲板（holodeck）。
works.idea_en: Each AI-generated scene is only 5 MB, so a few of them placed around you become a holodeck you can carry in your pocket.
works.technique_zh: 在 WebAR 中，以用户初始位姿为中心、按固定偏移摆放若干个由单张图片生成的小型高斯点场景（每个约 5 MB），形成一圈场景，用户转身即可面对不同场景。
works.exercise_en: Make four small scenes with a single-image-to-3D tool (or simple 3D models as stand-ins) and place them around yourself facing north, south, east and west. Twist: let the scene in each direction stand for a different time of day.

works.title: Coit Tower in the living room
works.description: A 40M-splat scan of San Francisco's Coit Tower placed in his living room, running fully on-device on Quest 3 through WebXR.
works.idea_zh: 把一座真实地标的超大扫描模型搬进客厅，在头显里绕着看。

video.video_title:
40m Coit Tower Gaussian splat in my living room.

Built with GPT-5.5 + three.js (Spark 2.0 LoD). Running fully on-device via quest 3

If we could just get WebXR passthrough on Vision Pro too… https://

works.technique: A 40M-splat scan runs on a standalone headset through hierarchical LoD that culls and simplifies distant splats, keeping the per-frame splat budget within mobile GPU limits.
works.exercise_zh: 选一个高面数模型，分别测试原始版和减面版在 HoloKit 或手机上的帧率，找出流畅运行的上限；变体：用这个预算上限设计一个“把地标搬进客厅”的场景。
works.description_zh: 一份 4000 万个高斯点的旧金山科伊特塔（Coit Tower）扫描被放进他的客厅，通过 WebXR 在 Quest 3 上完全本地运行。
works.idea_en: Bring a huge scan of a real landmark into the living room and walk around it in a headset.
works.technique_zh: 这份 4000 万高斯点的扫描借助分层 LOD 在一体机头显上运行：远处的高斯点被剔除或简化，使每帧的高斯点数量保持在移动 GPU 的承受范围内。
works.exercise_en: Pick a high-poly model, measure the frame rate of the original and a decimated version on HoloKit or a phone, and find the limit for smooth playback. Twist: use that budget to design a scene that brings a landmark into your living room.

works.title: Cross-device product viewer (8th Wall open source)
works.description: After 8th Wall went open source, a single web codebase shows the same product visualisation on a phone, a desktop and Snap Spectacles, synced in real time and colocated between devices.
works.description_zh: 在 8th Wall 开源之后，用一套网页代码让同一个产品可视化同时运行在手机、电脑和 Snap Spectacles 上，并在设备间实时同步、共享同一空间。
works.idea_en: One link, every screen: the same AR object shared live across phones, laptops and glasses.
works.idea_zh: 一个链接、所有屏幕：同一个 AR 物体在手机、电脑和眼镜之间实时共享。
works.technique: Three.js with the open-source 8th Wall engine and the WebXR Device API renders the scene per device, while a realtime sync layer shares state and a common anchor.
works.technique_zh: 用 Three.js 加开源的 8th Wall 引擎和 WebXR Device API 在各设备上渲染场景，再通过实时同步层共享状态和共同锚点。
works.exercise_en: Build a WebAR page where rotating a 3D object on a laptop rotates it on every classmate's phone. Twist: each device shows a different material, as if seeing the object through a different lens.
works.exercise_zh: 制作一个 WebAR 页面：在电脑上旋转一个 3D 物体，所有同学手机里的物体也会同步旋转；变体：每台设备显示不同材质，就像透过不同的镜片看同一个物体。

video.video_title: 8th Wall Goes Open Source, So I Built This

works.title: DreamPark arcade vending machine
works.description: A DreamPark 'vending machine' installed at Dave & Buster's Hollywood turns the entire arcade floor into a mixed-reality game.
works.idea_zh: 一台'售卖机'把整个电玩城变成混合现实游戏场。

video.video_title: just installed the first DreamPark vending machine at Dave & Busters Hollywood turning the entire arcade floor into a game! This was just an idea one month ago and now it’s at a major arcade https

works.technique: A fixed physical kiosk serves as the localization anchor and entry point for location-specific MR content laid over the arcade floor.
works.exercise_zh: 设计一个实体'入口'（海报或纸箱机器），扫码后进入覆盖整个教室的 AR 游戏；加一个变化：入口每天出售不同的'道具'。
works.description_zh: DreamPark 在好莱坞 Dave & Buster's 电玩城里安放了一台“售卖机”，把整个电玩城的场地变成一场混合现实游戏。
works.idea_en: A 'vending machine' turns an entire arcade into a mixed-reality playground.
works.technique_zh: 一台固定的实体售卖亭既是定位锚点，也是入口，承载叠加在电玩城地面上的特定地点混合现实内容。
works.exercise_en: Design a physical 'entrance' (a poster or a cardboard machine) that, once scanned, starts an AR game covering the whole classroom. Twist: the entrance sells a different 'item' each day.

works.title: Echoes (JR, La Caverne du Pont Neuf)
works.description: Inside JR's 120-metre artificial cave wrapped around the Pont Neuf, visitors on phones or Spectacles see bats leaving sculptural light trails, echoes of the bodies around them, and a story told through a rift in the rock.
works.description_zh: 在 JR 包裹巴黎新桥、长达 120 米的人造洞穴里，观众用手机或 Spectacles 眼镜可以看到蝙蝠拖出雕塑般的光轨、身边人的身体留下“回声”，以及从岩壁裂缝中展开的故事。
works.idea_en: Layer an invisible, living cave over a physical monumental artwork so the installation keeps changing as people walk through it.
works.idea_zh: 在一件实体巨型艺术装置上叠加一层看不见的“活洞穴”，让作品随观众走动不断变化。
works.technique: Three Lenses run on both Snapchat and Spectacles, using body tracking to create delayed 'echo' copies of visitors and world tracking to anchor bats and story scenes in the cave.
works.technique_zh: 三个 Lens 同时支持 Snapchat 手机端和 Spectacles，用人体追踪生成观众的延迟“回声”分身，用世界追踪把蝙蝠和故事场景固定在洞穴里。
works.exercise_en: Prototype a Lens that leaves a fading ghost copy of anyone who walks through a corridor, delayed by three seconds. Twist: ghosts from different people merge when their paths cross.
works.exercise_zh: 制作一个原型 Lens：走过走廊的人都会留下一个延迟三秒、逐渐消散的“幽灵”分身；变体：不同人的幽灵在路径交叉时会融合在一起。

video.video_title: Echoes - JR x Snapchat

works.title: Game Boy graphics in real life
works.description: A living-room test that brings chunky Game Boy-style graphics into the real room.
works.idea_zh: 把 Game Boy 像素画风搬进真实客厅。

video.video_title: Love it. Bringing back gameboy graphics into real life is fun. I did a little test in my living room https://t.co/TbVGaDLIuc

works.technique: Low-poly content is rendered with nearest-neighbor texture filtering, a limited four-color palette and a pixelation post-process, then anchored to room planes so the retro style contrasts with the camera feed.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 场景中加一个像素化 + 四色调色板的后处理 Shader，把一个低多边形角色放在地面上；变体：把后处理也应用到相机画面上，让整个真实房间变成 Game Boy 画风。
works.description_zh: 一次在客厅里的测试：把粗颗粒的 Game Boy 风格画面带进真实房间。
works.idea_en: Bring the Game Boy pixel-art look into a real living room.
works.technique_zh: 低多边形内容使用最近邻纹理过滤、有限的四色调色板和像素化后处理进行渲染，再锚定到房间的平面上，让复古风格与相机画面形成对比。
works.exercise_en: Add a pixelation and four-color palette post-processing shader to an AR scene and place a low-poly character on the floor. Twist: apply the post-process to the camera feed too, so the whole real room turns into Game Boy style.

works.title: Gaussian splat capture in Quest mixed reality
works.description: A friend's Gaussian splat capture viewed in Quest passthrough MR via WebXR and Spark level-of-detail streaming.
works.idea_zh: 把真实场景的扫描放进 MR 里，和现实并排对照。

video.video_title: Really cool seeing this on the quest in mixed reality. I put together a quick demo using WebXR (Three.js), Spark (LoD), and Danny’s raspberry Gaussian splat capture. https://t.co/MMubdNpYci

works.technique: A captured splat is rendered over passthrough in WebXR immersive-ar mode, with LoD streaming loading detail progressively so the capture appears quickly and sharpens as it streams.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Scaniverse 或 Polycam 扫描一位同学或一件物品，导出后在 WebXR 中叠加到真实空间里查看；变体：把多份扫描放在一起，做成一个小型“扫描博物馆”。
works.description_zh: 通过 WebXR 和 Spark 的细节层级流式加载，在 Quest 透视混合现实中查看一位朋友拍摄的高斯点扫描。
works.idea_en: Put a scan of a real place into MR so it sits side by side with reality.
works.technique_zh: 在 WebXR 的 immersive-ar 模式下，把扫描得到的高斯点叠加在透视画面上渲染，并用 LOD 流式加载逐步补充细节，使扫描内容能很快出现，并在加载过程中越来越清晰。
works.exercise_en: Scan a classmate or an object with Scaniverse or Polycam, export it, and view it overlaid on real space in WebXR. Twist: gather several scans together into a small 'scan museum'.

works.title: LEGO AR glasses proof of concept
works.description: A Spectacles proof of concept that adds AR effects and characters to LEGO Smart Bricks builds, reacting to the physical bricks in play.
works.idea_zh: 给乐高智能积木叠加AR角色与特效，实体积木驱动虚拟内容。

video.video_title: Lego AR glasses proof of concept  - Spectacles

works.technique: Signals from the smart bricks (state, motion, identity) are read over a wireless link and mapped to AR effects anchored to the build's tracked position.
works.exercise_zh: 用一块 micro:bit 或手机传感器数据驱动 AR 效果：摇动真实积木时 AR 中喷出火花；变体：两块积木靠近时出现一段对话。
works.description_zh: 一个基于 Spectacles 的概念验证：为 LEGO Smart Bricks 搭建的作品加上 AR 特效和角色，它们会对游戏中的实体积木作出反应。
works.idea_en: AR characters and effects are layered onto LEGO smart bricks, so the physical bricks drive the virtual content.
works.technique_zh: 通过无线连接读取智能积木的信号（状态、运动、身份），并映射为锚定在作品追踪位置上的 AR 特效。
works.exercise_en: Drive an AR effect with a micro:bit or phone sensor data, so that shaking a real brick makes sparks burst out in AR. Twist: when two bricks come close, a short conversation appears.

works.title: Leap Motion-style hand tracker with Meta Ray-Ban glasses
works.description: Video from Meta Ray-Ban glasses is streamed to a phone and on to a laptop webpage, where hand gestures seen from the wearer's point of view pinch and rotate 3D models on screen.
works.description_zh: 把 Meta Ray-Ban 眼镜拍到的画面传到手机、再传到电脑网页上，佩戴者视角中的手势可以捏合并旋转屏幕上的 3D 模型。
works.idea_en: Turn camera glasses into a hand controller for any screen, even one with no webcam.
works.idea_zh: 把带摄像头的眼镜变成任何屏幕的手势控制器，哪怕那块屏幕没有摄像头。
works.technique: The Wearables Developer Access Toolkit streams glasses video to an iPhone, which forwards frames over WebSocket to a web page running MediaPipe hand tracking.
works.technique_zh: 用 Wearables Developer Access Toolkit 把眼镜视频传到 iPhone，再通过 WebSocket 转发帧到运行 MediaPipe 手部追踪的网页上。
works.exercise_en: Stream a phone camera held at eye level to a laptop and use MediaPipe hands to rotate a 3D model with a pinch. Twist: add a second gesture that switches between models.
works.exercise_zh: 把举在眼睛高度的手机摄像头画面传到电脑上，用 MediaPipe 手部追踪通过捏合手势旋转 3D 模型；变体：加一个切换模型的第二种手势。

video.video_title: 👋 Built a Leap Motion-style hand tracker using my Meta Ray-Ban glasses

works.title: Living room redesign as WebAR splat
works.description: A generated interior redesign of his living room rendered as a Gaussian splat and aligned in WebAR, so he can walk through the future room on his phone.
works.idea_zh: 把 AI 设计的新客厅以 1:1 叠在旧客厅上，用手机走进“未来的房间”。

video.video_title: Testing sol 5.6 tonight. Built this using 8thWall webAR + sparkjs (open source) with a world labs gaussian splat generation of new interior design of my living room https://t.co/kROA4d127B

works.technique: A generated splat of the redesigned room is placed at 1:1 scale and manually aligned (origin + yaw) to the real room, so SLAM tracking lets the user walk through the future interior on a phone.
works.exercise_zh: 拍一张自己房间的照片交给图像模型改造，再用任意 3D 工具摆出简化版家具，按 1:1 比例放进 AR 中与真实房间对齐；变体：加一个滑块在“现在”和“改造后”之间切换透明度。
works.description_zh: 他把 AI 生成的客厅改造方案渲染成高斯点场景，在 WebAR 中与真实客厅对齐，于是可以拿着手机走进未来的房间。
works.idea_en: Overlay an AI-designed living room on the old one at 1:1 scale, and walk into the 'future room' with a phone.
works.technique_zh: 把改造后房间的生成式高斯点场景按 1:1 比例放置，并手动与真实房间对齐（原点加偏航角），借助 SLAM 追踪，用户可以拿着手机在未来的室内空间中走动。
works.exercise_en: Photograph your room and have an image model redesign it, then lay out simplified furniture in any 3D tool and place it in AR at 1:1 scale, aligned with the real room. Twist: add a slider that fades between 'now' and 'after the makeover'.

works.title: Meta Ray-Ban AI City Tour Guide
works.description: A proof of concept built at In The Pocket: a location-aware AI tour guide on Meta Ray-Ban glasses that walks you through Ghent and describes what you look at.
works.idea_zh: 戴Ray-Ban Meta眼镜的AI城市导游，边走边讲解眼前所见。

video.video_title: Meta Ray-Ban AI City Tour Guide

works.technique: GPS location and a captured camera frame are sent to a multimodal LLM, which returns a spoken description through the glasses, giving audio-first AR without a display.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个校园语音导览：拍照 + GPS 发给多模态模型，模型用 30 秒语音介绍眼前建筑；变体：让导游用某位历史人物的口吻说话。
works.description_zh: 在 In The Pocket 完成的一个概念验证：运行在 Meta Ray-Ban 眼镜上的位置感知 AI 导游，带你漫步根特（Ghent），并讲解你眼前看到的东西。
works.idea_en: An AI city guide in Ray-Ban Meta glasses describes whatever you are looking at as you walk.
works.technique_zh: 把 GPS 位置和一帧相机画面发送给多模态大语言模型，模型返回的描述通过眼镜以语音播放，实现无需显示屏、以声音为主的 AR。
works.exercise_en: Build a campus audio tour: send a photo plus GPS to a multimodal model and have it introduce the building in front of you in a 30-second voice clip. Twist: make the guide speak in the voice of a historical figure.

works.title: Micro Art
works.description: An AR lens that reveals an imagined microscopic world inside plants, rocks and other things you point it at in nature.
works.idea_zh: 对准自然界的物体，揭示其中想象的微观世界。

video.video_title: This AR Lens Reveals the Hidden Micro-World Inside Everything 🔬

works.technique: The lens segments or classifies the pointed-at natural object and anchors a generated microscopic scene to it, likely using a pre-generated asset per category.
works.exercise_zh: 对准一片树叶或石头，AR 中在它表面放大显示一个想象中的微观世界；变体：每种材质对应一个不同的微观生物族群。
works.description_zh: 一个 AR 滤镜（lens）：把它对准自然中的植物、岩石等物体，就能看到藏在其中的想象中的微观世界。
works.idea_en: Point at an object in nature to reveal an imagined microscopic world inside it.
works.technique_zh: 滤镜对所指向的自然物体进行分割或分类，再把生成的微观场景锚定在物体上，大概率是为每个类别预先生成了一套资源。
works.exercise_en: Point the camera at a leaf or a stone and show an imagined microscopic world magnified on its surface in AR. Twist: give each material its own family of microscopic creatures.

works.title: Off-axis projection with face tracking
works.description: A head-coupled perspective demo: MediaPipe tracks the viewer's face so a 3D scanned shoe on a flat screen shifts perspective like a window.
works.idea_zh: 用摄像头追踪人脸，让普通屏幕变成有纵深的“窗口”，头动画面跟着变。

video.video_title:
Created an off-axis projection demo using mediapipe for face tracking, threejs and a 3D scanned shoe.

Try it out yourself… https://t.co/VMl2VTWimN

works.technique: MediaPipe face landmarks estimate the eye position relative to the screen, and an off-axis (asymmetric frustum) projection is recomputed each frame so the monitor behaves like a window with correct parallax.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe Face Mesh 估算头部位置，在 three.js 中按头部坐标更新非对称视锥投影，让屏幕里的一只鞋产生视差；变体：让物体“探出”屏幕平面，测试错觉在哪个角度失效。
works.description_zh: 一个头部耦合透视的演示：MediaPipe 追踪观看者的脸，让平面屏幕上的一只 3D 扫描鞋子像隔着窗户一样随视角变化。
works.idea_en: A webcam tracks your face and turns an ordinary screen into a window with depth that shifts as your head moves.
works.technique_zh: 利用 MediaPipe 人脸关键点估算眼睛相对屏幕的位置，每帧重新计算离轴（非对称视锥）投影，让显示器像一扇具有正确视差的窗户。
works.exercise_en: Estimate head position with MediaPipe Face Mesh and update an asymmetric frustum projection in three.js from the head coordinates, so a shoe on screen shows parallax. Twist: make the object 'lean out' past the screen plane and test at what angle the illusion breaks.

works.title: Off-axis window into a generated world
works.description: Blender layout turned into a detailed World Labs splat, viewed through a face-tracked off-axis projection so the monitor becomes a window.
works.idea_zh: 先用简单体块搭场景，再用 AI 生成细节，最后用人脸追踪把屏幕变成通往世界的窗。

video.video_title:
Testing off-axis projection demo.

Basic scene layout in Blender 
glb -> detailed splat via World Labs
Three.js for engine
MediaPipe for face tracking

Next step is to add a character you can move

works.technique: A generated splat world is rendered with a head-coupled off-axis projection driven by webcam face tracking, placing the scene behind the monitor plane so it reads as a view through glass.
works.exercise_zh: 沿用人脸追踪的离轴投影，把屏幕后面换成一条长走廊或峡谷场景来放大纵深感；变体：头部靠近屏幕时让场景里的雾逐渐散开。
works.description_zh: 先在 Blender 中搭好布局，再用 World Labs 生成细节丰富的高斯点世界，最后通过人脸追踪的离轴投影观看，让显示器变成一扇窗。
works.idea_en: Block out a scene with simple shapes, let AI fill in the detail, then use face tracking to turn the screen into a window onto that world.
works.technique_zh: 生成的高斯点世界采用由网络摄像头人脸追踪驱动的头部耦合离轴投影进行渲染，场景被放在显示器平面之后，看起来就像透过玻璃望出去。
works.exercise_en: Reuse the face-tracked off-axis projection and replace what lies behind the screen with a long corridor or canyon to exaggerate the sense of depth. Twist: as your head moves closer to the screen, let the fog in the scene gradually clear.

works.title: Physical Pokémon Cards in AR
works.description: Real Pokémon trading cards are recognised on Spectacles and their creatures appear on top of the table.
works.idea_zh: 识别实体宝可梦卡牌，让卡里的宝可梦跳上桌面。

video.video_title: Always wanteded to play with my physical Pokémon cards in AR: Astra + CLAD for SPECS. @specsfordevs

works.technique: Card artwork is recognized as image targets (or by a classifier) on Spectacles, and the matching 3D creature is spawned on the card's tracked pose on the table.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Lens Studio 或 AR Foundation 图像追踪识别三张自制卡牌，每张卡上出现对应的 3D 生物；变体：两张卡靠近时生物开始对战或互动。
works.description_zh: Spectacles 识别出真实的宝可梦集换式卡牌，卡上的精灵随即出现在桌面上。
works.idea_en: Recognize physical Pokémon cards and let the Pokémon jump out onto the table.
works.technique_zh: 在 Spectacles 上将卡面图案作为图像目标（或通过分类器）识别，并在卡牌于桌面上的追踪位姿处生成对应的 3D 精灵。
works.exercise_en: Use image tracking in Lens Studio or AR Foundation to recognize three homemade cards, each spawning its own 3D creature. Twist: when two cards come close, their creatures start to battle or interact.

works.title: Re-coaching a World Cup goal in AR
works.description: A real World Cup goal is rebuilt as a tabletop AR scene; you pause it, move a defender, and AI re-renders the alternate ending photorealistically.
works.idea_zh: 暂停真实世界杯进球，挪动防守球员，让AI重渲染另一种结局。

video.video_title: I Re‑Coached a Real World Cup Goal in AR, and AI Re‑Rendered It in Photoreal

works.technique: Player positions from match tracking data are replayed as tabletop 3D figures, and after the user edits a position the altered layout conditions a generative video model to render a new ending.
works.exercise_zh: 把一段球赛进球做成桌面 AR 回放（用简单小人和球的关键帧），允许暂停并拖动防守球员；变体：改动后让球的轨迹按简单物理重新计算。
works.description_zh: 一个真实的世界杯进球被重建成桌面 AR 场景：你可以暂停画面、挪动一名防守球员，再由 AI 以照片级真实感重新渲染出另一种结局。
works.idea_en: Pause a real World Cup goal, move a defender, and let AI re-render a different ending.
works.technique_zh: 用比赛追踪数据中的球员位置，把比赛以桌面 3D 小人的形式回放；用户修改某个位置后，调整后的布局作为条件输入生成式视频模型，渲染出新的结局。
works.exercise_en: Turn a goal from a match into a tabletop AR replay (keyframed simple figures and a ball) that can be paused so defenders can be dragged. Twist: after a change, recompute the ball's trajectory with simple physics.

works.title: Scorched Earth Policy (US Pavilion, Venice Biennale)
works.description: An uninvited AR intervention at the 2026 Venice Biennale US Pavilion in which the pavilion appears to dry up and disintegrate into a burning wasteland around visitors.
works.idea_zh: 用AR让国家馆在观众眼前干涸、燃烧、崩解
works.technique: Geolocated mobile AR overlays disintegration and fire effects registered to the pavilion architecture, recorded as screen captures.
works.exercise_zh: 选一栋校园建筑，用AR叠加“未来100年”的风化或气候效果；变化：观众可以选择“修复”还是“放任”，看到两种结局。

video.video_title: Scorched Earth Policy, AR - US Pavilion 2026 Venice Biennale

works.description_zh: 在 2026 年威尼斯双年展美国馆进行的一次未经邀请的 AR 介入：在观众眼中，展馆逐渐干涸、崩解，化作四周燃烧的荒原。
works.idea_en: AR makes a national pavilion dry up, burn and fall apart before visitors' eyes.
works.technique_zh: 基于地理定位的移动 AR 把崩解和火焰特效与展馆建筑对齐叠加，并以录屏形式记录。
works.exercise_en: Choose a campus building and overlay AR effects showing its weathering or climate damage '100 years from now'. Twist: let viewers choose between 'repair' and 'let it go' and see the two different outcomes.

works.title: Shrunk to action-figure size on the coffee table
works.description: In mixed reality he shrinks himself to action-figure scale and explores a tiny generated world sitting on his living-room coffee table.
works.idea_zh: 把自己缩小成手办大小，在茶几上的迷你世界里探险。

video.video_title:
I shrunk myself down to action figure size and can now interact with and explore the tiny world on my living room coffee table.

Wait until 7 seconds in 👀🛋️ https://t.co/2g2HqZTHPQ

works.technique: A miniature world is placed on the coffee table in passthrough MR, and scaling the user rig (or inversely scaling the world) changes the effective eye height so the table feels human-sized.
works.exercise_zh: 在 WebXR 或 Unity 中把一个小场景放在桌面上，按下按钮时把整个场景放大 20 倍并以桌面为原点；变体：放大后让桌上的真实物件（如杯子）成为场景中的“巨型地标”。
works.description_zh: 在混合现实中，他把自己缩小到手办大小，去探索摆在客厅茶几上的一个生成出来的微缩世界。
works.idea_en: Shrink yourself to action-figure size and explore a miniature world on the coffee table.
works.technique_zh: 在透视混合现实中把微缩世界放在茶几上，通过缩放用户的相机装置（或反向放大世界）改变有效视高，让桌面感觉像人类尺度的空间。
works.exercise_en: Place a small scene on a tabletop in WebXR or Unity, and when a button is pressed, scale the whole scene up 20 times around the tabletop origin. Twist: after scaling, let real objects on the table (like a cup) become 'giant landmarks' in the scene.

works.title: Splat worlds as AR camera stand-ins
works.description: Generated 3DGS environments act as a spatial reference for directing real-time AR camera moves; the capture is then restyled by a video model.
works.idea_zh: 用 AR 手机当“虚拟摄影机”，在生成的 3D 场景里走位拍镜头，再交给视频模型出成片。

video.video_title: Late night experiment. I built a demo that generates 3D environments from images into 3DGS, then uses them as a spatial reference for directing real-time AR camera movements. The capture is then run t

works.technique: A tracked phone acts as a virtual camera inside a splat environment, recording its 6DoF pose path as a camera move, and the rendered pass is then restyled frame-by-frame with a video diffusion model.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 录制手机的相机位姿轨迹，在 Unity 中用这段轨迹驱动虚拟相机穿过一个预制场景并导出视频；变体：把导出的视频交给视频风格化模型换成手绘风格。
works.description_zh: 生成的 3DGS 环境作为空间参照，用于实时调度 AR 摄像机运镜；拍下的画面再交给视频模型重新风格化。
works.idea_en: Use an AR phone as a virtual camera to block shots inside a generated 3D scene, then hand the footage to a video model for the final look.
works.technique_zh: 被追踪的手机在高斯点环境中充当虚拟摄像机，把自身的 6DoF 位姿路径记录为一条运镜轨迹；渲染出的画面再用视频扩散模型逐帧重新风格化。
works.exercise_en: Record the phone's camera pose path with AR Foundation, then use it in Unity to drive a virtual camera through a prebuilt scene and export the video. Twist: pass the exported video to a video stylization model to give it a hand-drawn look.

works.title: Tap to launch orbs into a generated world
works.description: A WebAR scene built from a World Labs Gaussian splat of his room; tapping the phone fires glowing orbs that fly through the space.
works.idea_zh: 把 AI 生成的 3D 世界叠在真实房间里，点一下就向其中发射光球。

video.video_title:
More late night builds with gpt sol, world labs and webAR. This one is interactive, I can now send off orbs when I tap which is cool

goodnight 🔘 https://t.co/gvvpg0JOba

works.technique: A pre-generated Gaussian splat of the room is aligned to the SLAM world origin, and each tap spawns an emissive sphere at the camera position with a forward velocity vector, so projectiles appear to fly through the captured space.
works.exercise_zh: 用 three.js + WebXR 在相机位置生成发光小球并沿视线方向发射，场景里放一个简单的房间模型作为“世界”；变体：让小球碰到墙面后反弹或留下光斑。
works.description_zh: 一个基于 World Labs 为他房间生成的高斯点场景搭建的 WebAR 作品：点击手机屏幕，就会发射出在空间中飞行的发光光球。
works.idea_en: Overlay an AI-generated 3D world on a real room and tap to fire glowing orbs into it.
works.technique_zh: 预先生成的房间高斯点场景与 SLAM 世界原点对齐，每次点击都会在相机位置生成一个带有前向速度向量的自发光球体，看起来就像弹丸飞过扫描空间。
works.exercise_en: Use three.js and WebXR to spawn glowing balls at the camera position and launch them along the line of sight, with a simple room model as the 'world'. Twist: make the balls bounce off walls or leave a spot of light where they hit.

works.title: The Incredible Unknowns of the Louvre
works.description: Six overlooked Louvre masterpieces, including the Code of Hammurabi and the Kore of Samos, get a QR-code Lens that restores their lost shapes and colours and animates hidden details live on camera.
works.description_zh: 卢浮宫六件“被忽视的杰作”（如《汉谟拉比法典》石碑、萨摩斯少女像）旁各有一个二维码，扫码打开 Lens，就能在镜头里看到它们失落的形状与色彩被复原，隐藏细节也动了起来。
works.idea_en: Make visitors stop at the works everyone walks past by giving each one an AR secret.
works.idea_zh: 给每件被人匆匆走过的作品藏一个 AR 秘密，让观众停下来。
works.technique: Each Lens tracks a specific artwork (likely 3D object or image tracking from museum scans) and overlays curator-validated reconstructions built from historical archives.
works.technique_zh: 每个 Lens 追踪一件特定作品（很可能基于博物馆扫描做 3D 物体或图像追踪），叠加经策展人核实、依据历史档案制作的复原模型。
works.exercise_en: Pick the most ignored object in a local museum or school display and build an AR layer that reveals one fact nobody knows about it. Twist: the reveal only triggers if the viewer stands still for ten seconds.
works.exercise_zh: 在本地博物馆或学校展柜中挑一件最没人看的展品，做一个 AR 图层揭示一个没人知道的事实；变体：只有观者站定十秒后才会触发揭示。

video.video_title: The Incredible Unknowns of the Louvre Museum - 6 Masterpieces in Augmented Reality

works.title: The Mora Constellation
works.description: In Palazzo Mora during the Venice Biennale, a field of slender glowing elements hangs in space and flickers more intensely as visitors walk by, like candle flames disturbed by a passing breath.
works.description_zh: 威尼斯双年展期间的莫拉宫里，一片细长的发光元件悬挂在空中，观众走过时它们闪烁得更强烈，像被经过的呼吸扰动的烛火。
works.idea_en: A light field that notices your presence the way a candle does.
works.idea_zh: 一片会像烛火一样“察觉”你存在的光场。
works.technique: Presence sensors (likely motion or depth sensors) modulate the brightness and flicker of individually controlled light elements in real time.
works.technique_zh: 存在感应器（很可能是运动或深度传感器）实时调节每个可单独控制的发光元件的亮度与闪烁。
works.exercise_en: Hang twelve LEDs at different heights and use a webcam's motion detection so the ones nearest a moving person flicker like candles. Twist: make them calm down only when the room is silent.
works.exercise_zh: 在不同高度挂十二颗 LED，用摄像头运动检测，让离移动者最近的几颗像烛火一样闪烁；变体：只有房间完全安静时，它们才会平静下来。

video.video_title: Mora Constellation — Interactive Light Installation | Studio Waldemeyer

works.title: TouchPort / Allow me into your dream
works.description: A mixed-reality sharing protocol in which a handshake and pull signals intent, negotiates consent and opens a temporary shared layer between two people's separate mixed realities.
works.idea_zh: 握手一拉就把两个人各自的混合现实临时连接成共享空间。

video.video_title: Allow me into your dream / TouchPort: Sharing mixed realities through handshakes | SIGGRAPH 2026

works.technique: Hand tracking detects a handshake-and-pull gesture between two users, which triggers a consent handshake over the network and merges their separate AR layers into a shared session.
works.exercise_zh: 设计一个两人手机 AR 流程：双方同时做出某个手势后，才能看到对方放在空间里的私人物品；变体：任何一方松手，共享层立即消失。
works.description_zh: 一种混合现实共享协议：一次握手加一拉的动作表达意图、协商同意，并在两个人各自独立的混合现实之间开启一个临时的共享层。
works.idea_en: A handshake and a pull temporarily join two people's separate mixed realities into one shared space.
works.technique_zh: 手部追踪识别两位用户之间“握手再拉”的手势，由此通过网络触发一次同意确认，并把双方各自的 AR 图层合并为一个共享会话。
works.exercise_en: Design a two-person phone AR flow in which each person can see the private objects the other has placed in space only after both make a certain gesture at the same time. Twist: the shared layer vanishes the moment either person lets go.

works.title: Touching grass: two-prompt WebAR
works.description: An outdoor WebAR prototype with SLAM tracking, built with two prompts to an AI coding model, where he drags virtual objects across real grass.
works.idea_zh: 用两句 prompt 生成一个户外 WebAR 原型：AI 写代码，人直接在草地上摆弄虚拟物体。

video.video_title:
Finally touching grass. 

I’m testing fable5 tonight via web augmented reality. Using threejs + 8thWall (SLAM tracking), this took two prompts. Really exciting to see the potential here 

I’m dragging

works.technique: Outdoor SLAM with ground-plane detection lets a raycast from the touch point move an object along the detected plane, so dragged objects stay pinned to the grass.
works.exercise_zh: 只用两三条提示词让 AI 写出一个 WebAR 拖拽场景，记录每条提示词和结果；变体：让被拖动的物体在草地上留下一条轨迹线。
works.description_zh: 一个带 SLAM 追踪的户外 WebAR 原型，只用了两条提示词让 AI 编程模型写成；他可以在真实草地上拖动虚拟物体。
works.idea_en: Two prompts produce an outdoor WebAR prototype: the AI writes the code, and you play with virtual objects right on the grass.
works.technique_zh: 户外 SLAM 结合地平面检测，从触摸点发出射线，使物体沿检测到的平面移动，被拖动的物体始终贴在草地上。
works.exercise_en: Get an AI to write a WebAR drag-and-drop scene using only two or three prompts, and record each prompt and its result. Twist: make the dragged object leave a trail line on the grass.

works.title: Ultrasound VR
works.description: An interactive music ecosystem for Apple Vision Pro: by drawing in the space around you, you place audio-reactive sound sculptures and layer them into compositions, with Spatial Audio putting each sound where its sculpture stands.
works.idea_zh: 在空中画画就是在作曲：每一笔都会变成一个声音雕塑，并从你画下它的位置发出声音。

video.video_title: Ultrasound VR - for Apple Vision Pro

works.description_zh: 一个为 Apple Vision Pro 打造的交互式音乐生态：你在身边的空间里画画，就会放置随音乐律动的声音雕塑，把它们一层层叠加成乐曲；空间音频让每个声音都从对应雕塑所在的位置传来。
works.idea_en: Draw in the air to compose music: every stroke becomes a sound sculpture that plays from where you drew it.
works.technique: Hand tracking captures drawing gestures that spawn generative, audio-reactive meshes; each one is bound to a looping sound layer rendered with Spatial Audio at its 3D position, and LiDAR scene understanding lets the sculptures sit on real surfaces.
works.technique_zh: 手部追踪捕捉作画手势，生成随音频律动的生成式网格；每个网格都绑定一条循环的声音图层，并用空间音频在它的三维位置播放；LiDAR 场景理解让这些雕塑能贴在真实表面上。
works.exercise_en: Build a WebXR or AR Foundation scene where each tap or drawn stroke places a shape that loops one sound sample from its position (use positional audio), so walking around the room remixes the piece. Twist: make each shape's size pulse with its own sound's volume.
works.exercise_zh: 用 WebXR 或 AR Foundation 做一个场景：每次点击或画一笔，就在该位置放置一个形体，并从这个位置循环播放一段声音采样（使用空间化音频），让人在房间里走动时就能重新混音；变体：让每个形体的大小随自身声音的音量跳动。

works.title: Ultrasound VR — virtual embellishment of surfaces
works.description: A test from Ultrasound VR in which audio-reactive sound sculptures attach to real walls and floors, embellishing the room's surfaces and pulsing with the music.
works.description_zh: Ultrasound VR 的一段测试：随音频律动的声音雕塑贴附在真实的墙面和地面上，装点房间的各个表面，并随音乐起伏。
works.idea_en: Let music grow on the walls: sound becomes living ornament on real surfaces.
works.idea_zh: 让音乐长在墙上：声音变成附着在真实表面上的活装饰。
works.technique: LiDAR scene reconstruction on Apple Vision Pro gives wall and floor planes; generative meshes are anchored to them and deformed by the audio spectrum in real time.
works.technique_zh: Apple Vision Pro 上的 LiDAR 场景重建提供墙面和地面平面，生成式网格锚定在这些平面上，并实时随音频频谱变形。
works.exercise_en: Detect vertical and horizontal planes with AR Foundation or WebXR, grow a pattern on each surface, and drive its scale or colour with an FFT of the microphone or a music track. Twist: give walls and floors different frequency bands, so the room becomes an equalizer.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 或 WebXR 检测竖直和水平平面，在每个表面上生长出图案，并用麦克风或音乐的 FFT 频谱驱动它的大小或颜色；变体：让墙面和地面分别响应不同的频段，把整个房间变成一台均衡器。

video.video_title: Ultrasound VR - virtual embellishment of surfaces

works.title: WireDrum
works.description: Several instructors' muscle signals are routed into one visitor's arms through EMS, so a novice can play a demanding drum rhythm by sharing their body with other people.
works.description_zh: 几位指导者的肌肉信号经电刺激汇入一位访客的手臂，让新手在与他人“共享身体”的状态下打出高难度的鼓点。
works.idea_en: Split a hard skill across several people and merge it inside one body.
works.idea_zh: 把一项难的技能拆给几个人，再在一具身体里合成。
works.technique: Combines custom biosignal sensing modules, a multi-channel electrical muscle stimulator, a visual-tactile tempo indicator and software that maps instructors' muscles onto the learner's.
works.technique_zh: 结合定制的生物信号采集模块、多通道肌肉电刺激器、视觉与触觉节拍提示，以及把指导者肌肉映射到学习者身上的软件。
works.exercise_en: Split a two-hand drum pattern among three students: two tap cues on the drummer's shoulders while a phone metronome flashes, and the drummer only follows touches. Twist: record it with a phone and overlay each person's contribution in a different colour.
works.exercise_zh: 把一段双手鼓点拆给三名学生：两人随着手机节拍器的闪光在鼓手肩上点拍，鼓手只按触觉提示击鼓；变体：用手机录下来，用不同颜色标出每个人的贡献。

video.video_title: WireDrum: An Interpersonal and Multimodal Skill-Sharing System for an Augmented Drumming Experience

works.title: 1D ARCADE
works.description: Visitors play arcade and pinball-style games made from a single line of light pixels, discovering the rules without instructions by pressing buttons and moving.
works.description_zh: 观众在一条由单行像素光组成的装置上玩街机和弹球风格的小游戏，没有说明，靠按按钮和身体移动自己摸索规则。
works.idea_en: A whole video game squeezed into one line of light.
works.idea_zh: 把一整个电子游戏压缩进一条光线里。
works.technique: Each game is coded in MadMapper and output to LED pixel strips, reading simple physical controls in real time.
works.technique_zh: 每个游戏都在 MadMapper 中编写，输出到 LED 像素灯带，并实时读取简单的实体按钮输入。
works.exercise_en: Program a one-dimensional game on a 60-pixel LED strip (or a 1-pixel-tall canvas) with two buttons, such as tug-of-war or dodge the bullet. Twist: make it a two-player game where players stand at each end of a corridor.
works.exercise_zh: 用一条 60 像素的 LED 灯带（或只有一像素高的画布）和两个按钮编一个一维游戏，比如拔河或躲子弹；变体：做成双人游戏，两位玩家分别站在走廊两端。

video.video_title: 1D ARCADE - 1024 architecture

works.title: AI Teleport
works.description: A portal lens for Spectacles that uses Google Gemini to generatively restyle the user's surroundings in real time.
works.idea_zh: 用生成式AI实时把周围环境'传送'成另一种世界。

video.video_title: AI Teleport - Spectacles

works.technique: Camera frames are sent to a multimodal image model that restyles the scene, and the result is displayed back as a portal overlay aligned to the view.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机拍下眼前场景，发给图像编辑模型改成另一种风格，再以 AR 画框的形式贴回原位置；变体：让同学只用一个词决定目标风格。
works.description_zh: 一个用于 Spectacles 的传送门滤镜，借助 Google Gemini 实时对用户周围的环境进行生成式风格重绘。
works.idea_en: Generative AI 'teleports' your surroundings into another world in real time.
works.technique_zh: 相机画面被发送给多模态图像模型进行风格重绘，结果再以与视野对齐的传送门叠加层的形式显示回来。
works.exercise_en: Photograph the scene in front of you with a phone, send it to an image-editing model to change its style, then paste it back in place as an AR picture frame. Twist: let a classmate choose the target style with a single word.

works.title: AI wayfinding companion (Spatial 1)
works.description: A 3D-printed wearable that sees what you see, localizes with VPS, and speaks directions with Gemini and ElevenLabs.
works.idea_zh: 一个挂在胸前、能看路并说话的 AI 导航伙伴。

video.video_title:
Built my first hardware + software project in just a couple days for our internal hackathon: AI wayfinding companion

Used Midjourney, Bolt, Supabase, Gemini, Eleven Labs, and Niantic Spatial VPS to b

works.technique: A worn camera sends frames for VPS localization and to a multimodal LLM, which turns the pose and scene description into spoken directions through text-to-speech, giving audio-only AR guidance.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机摄像头拍一张照片发给多模态模型，让它结合预设目的地给出一句语音指路；变体：把指路者设定成一个有性格的角色，比如只会用比喻说话。
works.description_zh: 一个 3D 打印的可穿戴设备，能看到你所看到的东西，通过 VPS 定位，并借助 Gemini 和 ElevenLabs 用语音为你指路。
works.idea_en: An AI wayfinding companion worn on the chest that watches the road and talks to you.
works.technique_zh: 佩戴的摄像头把画面发送去做 VPS 定位，同时发给多模态大语言模型，模型把位姿和场景描述转化为方向指引，经文字转语音播出，实现纯音频的 AR 导航。
works.exercise_en: Take a photo with a phone camera and send it to a multimodal model, asking it to give a one-sentence spoken direction toward a preset destination. Twist: make the guide a character with a personality, for example one who only speaks in metaphors.

works.title: AI-scripted Playable Character
works.description: A cute robot character that walks, runs, jumps and emotes around a real room, with its behaviour written entirely by AI through Figmin's scripting API.
works.idea_zh: 用AI写脚本，让一个小机器人在你房间里跑跳玩耍。

video.video_title: 💥 A fully playable character in #FigminXR 💥

works.technique: An LLM generates Lua-style scripts against the app's API that drive character animation states and collisions with the room mesh.
works.exercise_zh: 让学生用ChatGPT生成一个Unity/Reality Composer行为脚本，使AR小角色在桌上巡逻并在碰到真实杯子时跳起；变化：用自然语言临时修改角色性格。
works.description_zh: 一个可爱的机器人角色在真实房间里走、跑、跳、做表情，它的行为完全由 AI 通过 Figmin 的脚本 API 编写。
works.idea_en: AI writes the script that makes a little robot run and jump around your room.
works.technique_zh: 大语言模型针对应用的 API 生成类 Lua 脚本，驱动角色的动画状态以及与房间网格的碰撞。
works.exercise_en: Have students use ChatGPT to generate a Unity or Reality Composer behavior script that makes a small AR character patrol the table and jump when it bumps into a real cup. Twist: change the character's personality on the fly with natural language.

works.title: AR Blasters on Snap Spectacles
works.description: A phone becomes a blaster controller over BLE for a shooting game on Snap Spectacles AR glasses.
works.idea_zh: 手机变成光枪控制器，在 Spectacles 眼镜里打 AR 射击。

video.video_title: AR Blasters on Specs AR Glasses with the Phone Controller and BLE API.

works.technique: The phone's IMU orientation and button presses are sent over BLE to Spectacles, where they drive the aim direction of a raycast blaster in the glasses' world-tracked scene.
works.exercise_zh: 用 WebSocket 把手机陀螺仪方向实时传给另一台运行 WebXR 的设备，作为射击方向打飞虚拟目标；变体：把手机换成挥动的真实物品（如扫帚）绑上手机。
works.description_zh: 手机通过 BLE 变成射击控制器，用于 Snap Spectacles AR 眼镜上的一款射击游戏。
works.idea_en: A phone becomes a blaster controller for AR shooting in Spectacles.
works.technique_zh: 手机 IMU 的朝向和按键信息通过 BLE 发送到 Spectacles，用于控制眼镜世界追踪场景中射线式光枪的瞄准方向。
works.exercise_en: Stream the phone's gyroscope orientation over WebSocket to another device running WebXR and use it as the aiming direction to shoot down virtual targets. Twist: swap the phone for a real object you swing (such as a broom) with the phone strapped to it.

works.title: Ad Block
works.description: An experimental Spectacles app that works as a real-world ad blocker: Gemini detects billboards and ads in view and covers them.
works.idea_zh: 现实世界的广告拦截器：识别并遮挡眼前的广告牌。

video.video_title: Ad Block - Spectacles

works.technique: A vision-language model detects ads and returns bounding boxes, which are projected into 3D and covered with opaque or replacement quads in the wearer's view.
works.exercise_zh: 用物体检测找到画面中的标志或海报，在 AR 中用一块纯色或自己的画作盖住；变体：不遮挡，而是把广告文字改写成一句诚实的话。
works.description_zh: 一款实验性的 Spectacles 应用，相当于现实世界的广告拦截器：Gemini 检测视野中的广告牌和广告，并把它们遮住。
works.idea_en: A real-world ad blocker that finds the billboards in front of you and covers them up.
works.technique_zh: 视觉语言模型检测广告并返回边界框，这些边界框被投射到 3D 空间，在佩戴者的视野中用不透明或替换内容的四边形面片覆盖。
works.exercise_en: Use object detection to find logos or posters in the frame and cover them in AR with a solid color block or your own artwork. Twist: instead of hiding the ad, rewrite its text into one honest sentence.

works.title: An Ark
works.description: Billed as the first play written for mixed reality, An Ark seats the audience in a circle while four volumetric actors, including Ian McKellen, appear among them in headsets and speak directly to them.
works.description_zh: 《An Ark》被称为第一部为混合现实创作的戏剧：观众围坐成一圈，戴上头显后，包括伊恩·麦克莱恩在内的四位体积捕捉演员出现在他们中间，直接对他们说话。
works.idea_en: Theater where actors sit among you in your own space instead of on a stage.
works.idea_zh: 演员不在舞台上，而是坐在你身边、在你的空间里演戏。
works.technique: Actors were captured volumetrically and placed in the shared physical room through synchronized mixed-reality headsets with spatial audio.
works.technique_zh: 演员通过体积捕捉录制，再借助同步的混合现实头显和空间音频放置进共享的实体房间中。
works.exercise_en: Write a 2-minute monologue addressed to someone sitting in a specific chair, record it volumetrically or as a cut-out video, and place it in AR facing that chair. Twist: the monologue changes if the listener stands up.
works.exercise_zh: 写一段两分钟的独白，对象是坐在某把特定椅子上的人；用体积捕捉或抠像视频录下来，以 AR 方式面向那把椅子放置；变体：如果听者站起来，独白就会改变。

video.video_title: A Communal Vision for Mixed Reality | AN ARK at THE SHED

works.title: Android XR glasses live demo (TED)
works.description: On the TED stage Izadi demos prototype Android XR glasses with Gemini: live translation, memory of where you left objects, and contextual help overlaid in a see-through display.
works.idea_zh: 戴着AI眼镜上台，眼镜记得你刚把钥匙放在哪里。

video.video_title: The Next Computer? Your Glasses | Shahram Izadi | TED

works.technique: The glasses stream camera frames and audio to a multimodal model (Gemini), which returns translations, object memory and answers that are rendered as text in a monocular see-through display.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机摄像头 + 多模态大模型 API 做一个“记忆眼镜”原型：每隔几秒拍一帧并让模型记录物品位置，之后问“我的钥匙在哪”时在 AR 画面中标出上次看到的位置；变体：让它只记住一种你常丢的东西，并讨论隐私边界。
works.description_zh: Izadi 在 TED 舞台上演示了搭载 Gemini 的 Android XR 原型眼镜：实时翻译、记住你把东西放在了哪里，以及在透视显示屏中叠加情境化的帮助信息。
works.idea_en: Walk on stage wearing AI glasses that remember where you just put your keys.
works.technique_zh: 眼镜把相机画面和音频流式发送给多模态模型（Gemini），模型返回翻译、物品记忆和回答，以文字形式呈现在单目透视显示屏上。
works.exercise_en: Build a 'memory glasses' prototype with a phone camera and a multimodal LLM API: capture a frame every few seconds and have the model log where objects are, so that when you ask 'where are my keys?' it marks the last place it saw them in the AR view. Twist: have it remember only one thing you often lose, and discuss where the privacy boundaries should be.

works.title: Audio Augmentation of Manual Interactions for Mindfulness
works.description: Ordinary actions like pouring water or folding cloth are paired with gentle, responsive sounds, turning chores into a mindful audio experience.
works.description_zh: 倒水、叠衣服这样的日常动作被配上轻柔、随动作变化的声音，让家务变成一种正念的听觉体验。
works.idea_en: Add sound to everyday hand actions so people slow down and notice them.
works.idea_zh: 给日常的手部动作配上声音，让人放慢脚步、留意当下。
works.technique: Senses hand and object manipulation and maps motion features to real-time generated audio feedback delivered to the user.
works.technique_zh: 感知手部与物体的操作，把动作特征实时映射为生成的音频反馈传给用户。
works.exercise_en: Use a phone's accelerometer in a web page to play a soft tone whose pitch follows how slowly you pour a glass of water, then try the chore with and without it. Twist: map a different sound to washing hands.
works.exercise_zh: 在网页里调用手机加速度计，倒水时播放一段柔和的音调，音高随倒水的快慢变化，然后比较有无声音时做这件事的感受；变体：为洗手配上另一种声音。

video.video_title: Audio Augmentation of Manual Interactions to Support Mindfulness

works.title: Audio Personas
works.description: Each person in a room carries a personal sound, a short audio cue anchored to their body, so as you walk around you hear who is nearby and what they are like before you even look.
works.description_zh: 房间里的每个人都带着一段专属声音，这段简短的音频线索锚定在他们身上；你四处走动时，还没抬头就能听出谁在附近、对方是什么样的人。
works.idea_en: Give people an audible aura that others hear in space, a sound-based profile picture.
works.idea_zh: 给每个人一个能在空间中被听见的“声音光环”，就像用声音做的头像。
works.technique: Tracks people's positions and renders body-anchored spatial audio cues to each listener through headphones, studied for how they shape social perception.
works.technique_zh: 追踪人们的位置，通过耳机向每位听者渲染锚定在他人身上的空间音频线索，并研究其如何影响社交感知。
works.exercise_en: Give each student a phone playing a chosen looped sound in a pocket and walk around blindfolded partners who guess who is approaching. Twist: let the sound change with the person's mood or walking speed.
works.exercise_zh: 让每个学生在口袋里放一部循环播放自选声音的手机，在蒙眼的同伴周围走动，让他们猜是谁在靠近；变体：让声音随这个人的情绪或步速变化。

video.video_title: Audio Personas: Augmenting Social Perception via Body-Anchored Audio Cues

works.title: Augmented Reality Portal
works.description: A walk-in web AR portal that anyone can try from a link.
works.idea_zh: 一个打开链接就能走进去的 AR 传送门。

video.video_title:
Augmented Reality Portal🔮

Try it yourself… ⬇️ https://t.co/PuikPccuZI

works.technique: A walk-in portal uses a stencil or depth-mask shader on the doorway so the inner world is visible only through the frame, and it is distributed as a link through browser-based SLAM.
works.exercise_zh: 用 8th Wall 或 WebXR 做一个可以从链接打开的传送门，门内放一个 360 全景图；变体：门外能听到门内的声音，越近越清晰。
works.description_zh: 一个可以走进去的网页 AR 传送门，任何人点开链接就能体验。
works.idea_en: An AR portal you can walk into just by opening a link.
works.technique_zh: 这个可进入的传送门在门框上使用模板或深度遮罩着色器，使内部世界只能透过门框看到，并借助基于浏览器的 SLAM 以链接形式分发。
works.exercise_en: Build a portal that opens from a link using 8th Wall or WebXR, with a 360 panorama inside the door. Twist: let people outside hear sounds from inside, getting clearer as they approach.

works.title: BPlane Adventures
works.description: A relaxing flow game for Spectacles: you steer a small plane with head movements and use your hands to boost it through the space around you.
works.idea_zh: 用头部转动驾驶小飞机，用手加速，在身边空间穿梭飞行。

video.video_title: BPlane Adventures

works.technique: Head orientation steers the plane's heading, while a hand gesture triggers a speed boost, both mapped in world space around the user.
works.exercise_zh: 用头部朝向（HoloKit 或手机陀螺仪）控制一架纸飞机穿过房间里的 AR 圆环，张开手掌加速；变体：圆环摆放位置根据房间平面自动生成。
works.description_zh: 一款适合 Spectacles 的放松型心流游戏：用头部动作驾驶一架小飞机，再用手为它加速，穿梭于你身边的空间。
works.idea_en: Steer a small plane by turning your head and boost it with your hand as it weaves through the space around you.
works.technique_zh: 头部朝向控制飞机的航向，手势触发加速，二者都映射在用户周围的世界空间中。
works.exercise_en: Use head orientation (HoloKit or the phone gyroscope) to fly a paper plane through AR rings in the room, opening your palm to speed up. Twist: generate ring positions automatically from the room's planes.

works.title: Body Oracle Translator
works.description: A handheld MR device translates people's body postures in real time into speculative AI-generated hieroglyphs inspired by Chinese oracle-bone script.
works.idea_zh: 把身体姿态实时翻译成AI生成的“甲骨文”。

video.video_title: “Body Oracle” Translator

works.technique: Classifies body poses with a pose-estimation model and maps them to a pre-generated glyph set rendered as AR overlays next to the person.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机人体姿态识别（Effect House/MediaPipe）把5种姿势映射成5个自创象形字，拍照时叠在人旁边；变化：连续姿势拼成一句“身体句子”。
works.description_zh: 一个手持式混合现实设备，把人的身体姿态实时翻译成受中国甲骨文启发、由 AI 生成的思辨性象形文字。
works.idea_en: Translate body postures into AI-generated 'oracle-bone script' in real time.
works.technique_zh: 用姿态估计模型对身体姿势进行分类，再映射到一套预先生成的字形，以 AR 叠加的方式显示在人物旁边。
works.exercise_en: Use phone body-pose recognition (Effect House or MediaPipe) to map five poses to five invented pictographs and overlay them next to the person when taking a photo. Twist: string a sequence of poses into a 'body sentence'.

works.title: Boulderverse
works.description: A Meta Quest 3 prototype for bouldering that overlays routes, holds and challenges on a climbing wall in mixed reality.
works.description_zh: 一款 Meta Quest 3 攀岩原型应用，用混合现实在攀岩墙上叠加路线、岩点和挑战。
works.idea_en: Turn any climbing wall into an endlessly re-settable game board.
works.idea_zh: 把任何一面攀岩墙都变成可以无限重新“定线”的游戏棋盘。
works.technique: Quest 3 passthrough and spatial anchors align virtual holds and route markers to a physical wall (likely).
works.technique_zh: 利用 Quest 3 的透视画面和空间锚点，把虚拟岩点和路线标记对齐到真实墙面上（推测）。
works.exercise_en: Design an AR 'floor is lava' course by placing virtual stepping stones on a real floor, then time classmates crossing it. Twist: the stones slowly move while you walk.
works.exercise_zh: 在真实地面上摆放虚拟踏脚石，设计一条 AR“地板是岩浆”赛道，并给同学计时通过；变体：你走的时候踏脚石会慢慢移动。

video.video_title: BOULDERVERSE

works.title: Bubbles
works.description: A Spectacles lens where you type a prompt, generate 3D models with Snap3D generative AI, and place several objects around you inside floating bubbles.
works.idea_zh: 输入文字即生成3D物体，装在泡泡里摆满你周围。

video.video_title: Spectacles Bubbles

works.technique: A text prompt is sent to a text-to-3D service, and the returned mesh is scaled into a transparent sphere container placed around the user via world tracking.
works.exercise_zh: 用文生 3D 工具生成三个小物体，在 AR 中分别放进透明泡泡，点破泡泡物体才会落地；变体：泡泡里的物体来自同学之间互相出题。
works.description_zh: 一个 Spectacles 滤镜：输入一段提示词，用 Snap3D 生成式 AI 生成 3D 模型，再把多个物体装进漂浮的泡泡里摆在你周围。
works.idea_en: Type some words to generate 3D objects, then fill the space around you with them, each sealed in a bubble.
works.technique_zh: 文本提示词被发送到文本生成 3D 服务，返回的网格被缩放后装进一个透明球体容器，并通过世界追踪放置在用户周围。
works.exercise_en: Generate three small objects with a text-to-3D tool and place each in a transparent bubble in AR, so an object only drops to the ground when its bubble is popped. Twist: have classmates set the prompts for each other's bubbles.

works.title: Buoyancé
works.description: Mobile robots reel helium balloons up and down by strings, forming floating 3D displays and interactive mid-air objects above a tabletop.
works.idea_zh: 机器人拉着氦气球升降，在空中形成可交互的立体显示。

video.video_title: Buoyancé: Reeling Helium-Inflated Balloons with Mobile Robots for Display and Interaction [UIST2025]

works.technique: Each tabletop robot winds a tether to set balloon height while driving to set x-y position, so a swarm places floating points in 3D space.
works.exercise_zh: 用气球、线和手动升降把桌面变成空中柱状图，再用手机AR给每个气球叠加标签；变化：同学拉动气球改变高度，AR中的数据随之更新。
works.description_zh: 移动机器人用细绳收放氦气球，让它们升降，在桌面上方形成漂浮的三维显示和可交互的空中物体。
works.idea_en: Robots reel helium balloons up and down to form an interactive 3D display in mid-air.
works.technique_zh: 每台桌面机器人通过收放系绳设定气球高度，同时移动自身来设定 x-y 位置，于是整个机器人集群可以在三维空间中布置漂浮的点。
works.exercise_en: Use balloons, string and manual raising and lowering to turn a tabletop into a mid-air bar chart, then add a label to each balloon with phone AR. Twist: when classmates pull a balloon to change its height, the data in AR updates with it.

works.title: Dansez Versailles
works.description: Four Lenses placed in the gardens of the Palace of Versailles dress visitors in Baroque costume and put them into historical court dances, with wigs and hats on the front camera and full-body dancers on the rear camera.
works.description_zh: 凡尔赛宫花园里的四个 Lens 让游客换上巴洛克服装、跳起宫廷舞：前置摄像头戴上假发和帽子，后置摄像头则把整个人变成舞者。
works.idea_en: Let visitors physically perform history in the exact place it happened.
works.idea_zh: 让游客在历史发生的原地，用身体把历史“跳”一遍。
works.technique: Face tracking dresses the selfie view while full-body tracking and garment/body-mesh templates restyle the whole figure, triggered at specific garden locations inside the palace app via Camera Kit.
works.technique_zh: 前置镜头用人脸追踪做装扮，后置镜头用全身追踪和服装/身体网格模板重塑整个人，并通过 Camera Kit 集成进凡尔赛官方应用，在花园特定地点触发。
works.exercise_en: Build a body-tracked Lens that teaches one historical or folk dance step by showing a ghost dancer to copy and a costume that appears only when you match the pose. Twist: two people must dance mirrored to unlock the full costume.
works.exercise_zh: 制作一个人体追踪 Lens，展示一个“幽灵舞者”教你跳一段历史或民间舞步，只有动作对上时服装才会出现；变体：必须两个人镜像对跳才能解锁完整服装。

video.video_title: Dansez versailles - Chateau de Versailles x Snapchat

works.title: DejaViewer: Replaying Past Motion in AR
works.description: Records motion in the field of view from Quest colour and depth cameras and replays it on the spot as a ghostly point cloud.
works.idea_zh: 把刚才发生在眼前的动作录下来，原地以点云“回放过去”。

video.video_title: DejaViewer: Replaying Past Motion in AR

works.technique: Passthrough color and depth frames are recorded, frame differencing isolates moving regions, and those regions are unprojected to point clouds that replay in place with fading transparency.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机深度相机录下一段人走过的画面，只保留运动部分转成点云，在原地以半透明“残影”循环回放；变体：残影越旧越碎。
works.description_zh: 利用 Quest 的彩色相机和深度相机记录视野中的动作，并在原地以幽灵般的点云回放出来。
works.idea_en: Record the motion that just happened in front of you and replay the past on the spot as a point cloud.
works.technique_zh: 记录透视的彩色帧和深度帧，通过帧差分离出运动区域，再把这些区域反投影为点云，在原地以逐渐变淡的透明度回放。
works.exercise_en: Use a phone depth camera to record someone walking past, keep only the moving parts as a point cloud, and loop them in place as semi-transparent 'afterimages'. Twist: the older an afterimage is, the more it breaks apart.

works.title: Desk-side web AR experiment
works.description: A quick web AR sketch built at his desk.
works.idea_zh: 桌面上的即兴 WebAR 小实验。

video.video_title: built a quick web AR experiment at the desk today. https://t.co/sZIzm3OgCq

works.technique: A minimal WebAR sketch most likely uses surface detection plus a hit test to place a single object, showing how fast a browser AR idea can be tested.
works.exercise_zh: 给自己 30 分钟，在桌边用 WebXR 模板做一个最小可运行的 AR 草图并录屏；变体：规定只能用一种几何体，但要表达一种情绪。
works.description_zh: 他在书桌前快速搭建的一个网页 AR 草图。
works.idea_en: A quick, improvised WebAR experiment on the desk.
works.technique_zh: 这个极简的 WebAR 草图大概率使用表面检测加命中测试（hit test）来放置一个物体，展示了在浏览器里验证一个 AR 想法可以有多快。
works.exercise_en: Give yourself 30 minutes to build a minimal working AR sketch at your desk from a WebXR template, and screen-record it. Twist: you may use only one kind of geometry, but it has to express an emotion.

works.title: Dream Park street access point
works.description: A public Dream Park access point on Santa Monica's Third Street Promenade turns the whole street into a mixed-reality game for passers-by.
works.idea_zh: 在街上装一个'入口'，整条街就变成可下载的混合现实主题乐园。

video.video_title: just installed the first public Dream Park access point on Third St Promenade turning the entire street into a game, coming soon to Quest 3 with camera access! First of many AR theme parks we’ll be se

works.technique: Game content is authored to a specific mapped location so devices localize against it and see the same attractions in the real street.
works.exercise_zh: 给校园设计一条'AR 主题乐园'路线，放三处可玩的 AR 小游戏点（Lens Studio/8th Wall）；加一个变化：只有凑齐三人才能开启最后一个景点。
works.description_zh: 在圣莫尼卡第三街步行街上设置的一个公共 Dream Park 接入点，把整条街变成路人都能参与的混合现实游戏。
works.idea_en: Install an 'entrance' on a street, and the whole street becomes a downloadable mixed-reality theme park.
works.technique_zh: 游戏内容针对某个已建图的具体地点制作，设备在该地点完成定位后，就能在真实街道上看到同样的游乐项目。
works.exercise_en: Design an 'AR theme park' route across campus with three playable AR mini-game stops (Lens Studio or 8th Wall). Twist: the last attraction opens only when three people are there together.

works.title: EchoVision (Ars Electronica Deep Space 8K edition)
works.description: A projection edition of EchoVision in Ars Electronica's Deep Space 8K: visitors' voices become visualised echolocation waves across the giant wall and floor, alongside AI-composed bat songs.
works.idea_zh: 在巨大的墙面和地面上，把观众的叫声变成蝙蝠的回声定位波
works.technique: Microphone input is analysed for pitch and loudness and rendered as expanding echo waves in the 8K wall-and-floor projection, likely with floor tracking of visitors.
works.exercise_zh: 在教室地面投影，用麦克风把喊声转成从中心扩散的波纹，碰到“障碍物”（放在地上的纸箱）会反射；变化：只有低沉的声音能看见远处的障碍。

video.video_title: EchoVision - Ars Electronica Deep Space 8k

works.description_zh: EchoVision 在电子艺术中心（Ars Electronica）Deep Space 8K 中的投影版本：观众的声音被可视化为回声定位波，在巨大的墙面和地面上扩散，同时伴随着 AI 创作的蝙蝠之歌。
works.idea_en: On a giant wall and floor, visitors' calls turn into bat-like echolocation waves.
works.technique_zh: 对麦克风输入进行音高和响度分析，在 8K 墙面与地面投影中渲染为不断扩散的回声波，可能还结合了对地面上观众位置的追踪。
works.exercise_en: Project onto a classroom floor and use a microphone to turn shouts into ripples spreading from the center that bounce off 'obstacles' (cardboard boxes placed on the floor). Twist: only low-pitched sounds can reveal distant obstacles.

works.title: FeltSight
works.description: A mixed-reality haptic experience inspired by the tactile navigation of animals like the star-nosed mole: you feel your way through space via fingertip haptics instead of sight.
works.idea_zh: 模仿星鼻鼹鼠的触觉导航，用指尖触感而非视觉感知空间。

video.video_title: FeltSight

works.technique: Distance from the fingertip to scanned geometry is mapped to vibration intensity on a wearable actuator, while visual feedback is reduced so touch becomes the main sense.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机 LiDAR 或深度估计测量摄像头前方物体的距离，映射成手机震动强度，闭眼在教室里摸索前进；变体：把震动节奏换成不同“动物”的触觉语言。
works.description_zh: 一个混合现实触觉体验，灵感来自星鼻鼹鼠等动物的触觉导航：你不靠视觉，而是通过指尖的触觉反馈来摸索空间。
works.idea_en: Borrowing the star-nosed mole's tactile navigation, you sense space through your fingertips rather than your eyes.
works.technique_zh: 把指尖到扫描几何体的距离映射为可穿戴执行器的振动强度，同时削弱视觉反馈，让触觉成为主要感官。
works.exercise_en: Measure the distance to objects in front of the camera with phone LiDAR or depth estimation, map it to vibration strength, and feel your way across the classroom with your eyes closed. Twist: replace the vibration rhythm with the tactile 'language' of different animals.

works.title: Fireside Tales
works.description: Players on Snap Spectacles sit as marshmallow avatars around a virtual campfire, take turns telling a story, and watch AI generate artwork from what they say in real time.
works.description_zh: 戴着 Snap Spectacles 的玩家化身棉花糖角色围坐在虚拟篝火旁，轮流讲故事，AI 会根据他们说的话实时生成画面。
works.idea_en: A campfire where the spoken story instantly becomes pictures floating in the shared space.
works.idea_zh: 一堆篝火，大家讲出的故事立刻变成漂浮在共享空间里的画面。
works.technique: Speech is transcribed and sent through Snap Cloud/Supabase to an image-generation model, with results synced to all co-located Spectacles players.
works.technique_zh: 把语音转成文字，经由 Snap Cloud/Supabase 发送给图像生成模型，再把结果同步给同一空间里的所有 Spectacles 玩家。
works.exercise_en: Build a phone AR circle where each student speaks one sentence and an AI-generated image appears above their head. Twist: each new image must be generated from the previous two sentences combined.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个手机 AR 围圈游戏：每位同学说一句话，头顶就出现一张 AI 生成的图；变体：每张新图都要由前两句话合并生成。

video.video_title: We Built an AI Storytelling Game for AR Glasses (Snap Spectacles Hackathon)

works.title: Foldiverse
works.description: An MR origami trainer for autistic children: a virtual 3D origami model and a voice assistant called FoFo guide each fold step-by-step over the real paper.
works.idea_zh: AR折纸老师一步步引导孩子折纸。

video.video_title: Foldiverse

works.technique: Shows animated 3D fold steps registered near the child's paper with voice prompts from an assistant, advancing when a step is complete.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机AR在桌面上播放一步一步的3D折纸动画，并用语音按钮进入下一步；变化：让手机识别纸张形状自动判断是否完成当前步骤。
works.description_zh: 一款面向自闭症儿童的混合现实折纸训练工具：虚拟 3D 折纸模型和名为 FoFo 的语音助手在真实纸张上方，一步一步引导每一次折叠。
works.idea_en: An AR origami teacher guides a child through folding, step by step.
works.technique_zh: 在孩子的纸张附近对齐显示 3D 折叠步骤动画，并配合助手的语音提示，完成一步后再进入下一步。
works.exercise_en: Play a step-by-step 3D origami animation on a tabletop with phone AR, using a voice button to go to the next step. Twist: have the phone recognize the paper's shape to decide automatically whether the current step is done.

works.title: Fruit Defense
works.description: A single- and multiplayer Spectacles game in which real-world objects detected around you become active gameplay elements to defend.
works.idea_zh: 眼镜识别身边真实物体，把它们变成塔防游戏的一部分。

video.video_title: Fruit Defense - Spectacles

works.technique: An on-device object detection model finds real objects in view, and their estimated 3D positions become gameplay entities that enemies target.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Lens Studio 或手机上的物体识别找出桌上的水杯，把它设为需要保护的“基地”，AR 小怪从四周涌来；变体：换一个物体，敌人的类型随之变化。
works.description_zh: 一款支持单人和多人的 Spectacles 游戏：你周围被检测到的真实物体会变成需要守护的游戏元素。
works.idea_en: The glasses recognize real objects around you and make them part of a tower-defense game.
works.technique_zh: 设备端物体检测模型找出视野中的真实物体，并把估算出的 3D 位置变成敌人会攻击的游戏实体。
works.exercise_en: Use object recognition in Lens Studio or on a phone to find a cup on the table, make it the 'base' you must protect, and send small AR monsters swarming in from all sides. Twist: switch to a different object and the enemy type changes with it.

works.title: Guided Reality
works.description: LLMs and vision models generate step-by-step AR task guidance that highlights the exact real objects to touch, turning any instruction into visual in-situ help.
works.idea_zh: 大模型自动生成贴在真实物体上的AR操作指引。

video.video_title: [UIST 2025] Guided Reality: Generating Visually-Enriched AR Task Guidance with LLMs and Vision Model

works.technique: An LLM decomposes an instruction into steps, and a vision-language or detection model grounds each step to the relevant objects in the camera view, whose image locations are highlighted in MR.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机拍下桌面，把照片和一条任务指令（“冲一杯手冲咖啡”）发给多模态大模型，要求返回每一步对应物体的框坐标，并在画面中依次高亮；变体：让系统在你做错时给出提示，而不只是给步骤。
works.description_zh: 大语言模型和视觉模型生成分步骤的 AR 任务指引，高亮出需要触碰的具体真实物体，把任何一条指令都变成现场可见的视觉帮助。
works.idea_en: An LLM automatically generates AR instructions pinned to the real objects you need to handle.
works.technique_zh: 大语言模型把一条指令拆解为若干步骤，再由视觉语言模型或检测模型把每一步对应到相机画面中的相关物体，并在混合现实中高亮这些物体在图像中的位置。
works.exercise_en: Photograph a tabletop with a phone and send the photo plus a task instruction ('make a cup of pour-over coffee') to a multimodal LLM, asking it to return box coordinates for the object in each step, then highlight them one by one on screen. Twist: have the system give a hint when you make a mistake instead of only listing steps.

works.title: Hand-tracking watercolor
works.description: Moving your hands in front of a webcam leaves blooming watercolor strokes that bleed and dry over the live image.
works.idea_zh: 在空中挥手，就在画面上晕开水彩。

video.video_title: New TouchDesigner tutorial on creating a hand tracking watercolor effect is live! #mediapipe #touchdesigner https://t.co/G6QZdRwwhj

works.technique: Fingertip positions inject color into a feedback/diffusion shader that simulates pigment spreading and edge darkening.
works.exercise_zh: 用 p5.js 反馈缓冲区 + MediaPipe 指尖做空中水彩；加一个变化：握拳时颜料'干掉'固定下来。
works.description_zh: 在网络摄像头前挥动双手，实时画面上就会留下不断晕开的水彩笔触，它们会渗开，也会慢慢变干。
works.idea_en: Wave your hands in the air and watercolor blooms across the picture.
works.technique_zh: 指尖位置把颜色注入一个反馈/扩散着色器，模拟颜料的扩散和边缘加深效果。
works.exercise_en: Make mid-air watercolor with a p5.js feedback buffer and MediaPipe fingertip tracking. Twist: when you make a fist, the paint 'dries' and stays fixed.

works.title: I/O Brush re-creation (Genuary)
works.description: Re-creating MIT Tangible Media's I/O Brush, a webcam-tracked hand 'picks up' colors and textures from real objects and paints with them on screen.
works.idea_zh: 用手从现实里'蘸取'颜色和纹理，再拿来画画。

video.video_title:
Genuary Day 2 Prompt: Layers upon layers upon layers.
 I wanted to re-create the I/O brush from the Tangible Media Group at the Media Lab for this experiment. It’s pretty wild that it’s possible to cr

works.technique: MediaPipe hand tracking finds the fingertip, samples the camera pixels under it as the brush, then paints strokes into a feedback canvas.
works.exercise_zh: 用 p5.js + MediaPipe Hands，让指尖碰到真实物体时吸取它的颜色，再在空中画画；加一个变化：吸取的是一小段动态视频而不是颜色。
works.description_zh: 复刻 MIT Tangible Media 小组的 I/O Brush：被网络摄像头追踪的手从真实物体上“蘸取”颜色和纹理，再用它们在屏幕上作画。
works.idea_en: Dip your hand into reality to pick up colors and textures, then paint with them.
works.technique_zh: MediaPipe 手部追踪找到指尖，把指尖下方的相机像素采样作为笔刷，再把笔触画进一个反馈画布。
works.exercise_en: Use p5.js and MediaPipe Hands so that touching a real object with your fingertip picks up its color, then paint in the air with it. Twist: pick up a short clip of live video instead of a color.

works.title: InSituTale
works.description: Physical objects on a table act as tangible handles for augmented data stories: moving and arranging objects drives AR charts and narration.
works.idea_zh: 用桌上的实物摆放来驱动AR数据故事的讲述。

video.video_title: [UIST 2025] InSituTale: Enhancing Augmented Data Storytelling with Physical Objects

works.technique: Tabletop objects are tracked by the camera (markers or object detection), and their positions and arrangement are mapped to parameters of AR charts and narration segments, making physical layout the story controller.
works.exercise_zh: 给 3 个杯子贴上 ArUco 或图像标记，用手机 AR 追踪它们的位置，把杯子间的距离映射成柱状图的高度或一段数据故事的播放进度；变体：用这些实体讲一个关于你自己作息或消费的数据故事。
works.description_zh: 桌上的实体物件成为增强数据故事的可触摸“把手”：移动和摆放这些物件，就能驱动 AR 图表和旁白叙述。
works.idea_en: Arranging real objects on a table drives how an AR data story unfolds.
works.technique_zh: 相机追踪桌面上的物体（通过标记或物体检测），并把它们的位置和排布映射为 AR 图表的参数和旁白片段，让实体布局成为讲述故事的控制器。
works.exercise_en: Put ArUco or image markers on three cups, track their positions with phone AR, and map the distances between cups to bar heights or to the playback progress of a data story. Twist: use these objects to tell a data story about your own daily routine or spending.

works.title: Inside[JOB]
works.description: JobBot leaps into your real room on Android XR; you fix quirky system settings, 'phish' for data and stream updates in playful hand-tracked mini-jobs across MR and VR.
works.idea_zh: JobBot机器人闯进你的真实房间，用双手完成搞笑的小工作。

video.video_title: Inside[JOB] Gameplay Trailer - 4K

works.technique: Uses high-fidelity hand tracking with physics-based grabbing so every virtual prop can be poked, pulled and thrown in passthrough space.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机AR手势识别做三个“荒诞小工作”（捏住虚拟插头插到真实插座旁、拍打故障屏幕等）；变化：每个任务只能用一只手完成。
works.description_zh: 在 Android XR 上，JobBot 跳进你的真实房间：你要修理古怪的系统设置、“钓鱼”获取数据、推送更新，在混合现实和虚拟现实之间完成一个个好玩的手部追踪小工作。
works.idea_en: The JobBot robot bursts into your real room and has you finish silly little jobs with your bare hands.
works.technique_zh: 采用高精度手部追踪和基于物理的抓取，让每一件虚拟道具都能在透视空间中被戳、拉、扔。
works.exercise_en: Use phone AR gesture recognition to make three 'absurd little jobs' (pinching a virtual plug and plugging it in next to a real socket, slapping a glitching screen, and so on). Twist: each task can be done with one hand only.

works.title: Lasertag
works.description: A mixed-reality laser tag game that scans your space and turns it into an arena for friends in the same room; beams stop at real walls and furniture.
works.idea_zh: 把任何空间变成同场多人激光枪战场，光束会被真实墙体遮挡。

video.video_title: Lasertag for Meta Quest - v2 update trailer

works.technique: The Depth API provides real-time depth, so laser raycasts are truncated at the reconstructed surfaces and real walls and furniture block shots.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 遮挡（深度）让 AR 光束在真实物体处被截断，做一个躲在柜子后面的对战原型；变体：被打中的真实表面留下持续几秒的光斑。
works.description_zh: 一款混合现实激光枪战游戏：它扫描你所在的空间，把它变成同一房间内朋友们的竞技场；光束会被真实的墙壁和家具挡住。
works.idea_en: Turn any space into a same-room multiplayer laser-tag arena where real walls block the beams.
works.technique_zh: Depth API 提供实时深度，激光射线在重建出的表面处被截断，因此真实的墙壁和家具会挡住射击。
works.exercise_en: Use AR Foundation occlusion (depth) so that AR beams are cut off at real objects, and build a prototype where players duel from behind a cabinet. Twist: real surfaces that get hit keep a glowing spot for a few seconds.

works.title: Lasertag: synced room scanning
works.description: Demo of multiple Quest headsets building one shared depth reconstruction of a room in real time, so all players fight inside the same scanned geometry.
works.idea_zh: 多台头显实时同步扫描出同一个房间模型。

video.video_title: Meta Quest Lasertag - v2 synced room scanning demo

works.technique: Each headset fuses depth frames into a shared voxel or mesh reconstruction in a common anchor frame, and updates are merged over the network so all players see the same geometry.
works.exercise_zh: 两台带 LiDAR 的 iPhone 分别扫描房间的一半，通过共同的图像标记对齐后合成一个网格；变体：把扫描到的网格用两种颜色标出是谁扫的。
works.description_zh: 演示多台 Quest 头显实时共同构建同一个房间的深度重建，让所有玩家都在同一套扫描几何体中对战。
works.idea_en: Several headsets scan the same room together in real time, building one shared model.
works.technique_zh: 每台头显把深度帧融合进位于共同锚点坐标系中的共享体素或网格重建，更新通过网络合并，使所有玩家看到相同的几何体。
works.exercise_en: Have two LiDAR iPhones each scan half of a room, align them with a shared image marker, and merge the results into one mesh. Twist: color the scanned mesh in two colors to show who scanned which part.

works.title: Location-triggered AR scene
works.description: An older location-based AR experience: arrive at the spot, open the experience, and the scene comes to life in place.
works.idea_zh: 走到特定地点，AR 故事才会出现。

video.video_title:
A quick visual example of what I mean—this is from an older AR experience I built. 

You’d arrive at the location, open the app, launch the specific experience, and see it come to life. On your phone

works.technique: A location check (GPS geofence or VPS localization) gates the experience, and once the device is localized the scene is instantiated at a fixed real-world pose.
works.exercise_zh: 在校园里选一个地点，用 GPS 距离判断是否到达，到达后才在 AR 中出现一个角色；变体：只有两个人同时在场时角色才会出现。
works.description_zh: 一个较早的基于位置的 AR 体验：走到指定地点、打开体验，场景就在原地活了过来。
works.idea_en: The AR story only appears once you walk to a particular place.
works.technique_zh: 通过位置判断（GPS 地理围栏或 VPS 定位）控制体验的开启；设备完成定位后，场景在一个固定的真实世界位姿处实例化。
works.exercise_en: Pick a spot on campus, use GPS distance to check whether someone has arrived, and only then make a character appear in AR. Twist: the character appears only when two people are there at the same time.

works.title: Midjourney → splat → AR
works.description: A generated image turned into an 8 MB Gaussian splat and viewed in web AR.
works.idea_zh: 从一张 AI 图片到可以站进去的 AR 场景。

video.video_title:
Building on this workflow:

-> Midjourney 
-> Gaussian Splat  
-> Augmented Reality

All running on the web, not the best fps in AR but still pretty mind-bending. Exported splat as .spz 8mb i

works.technique: An AI image is lifted into a Gaussian splat by an image-to-3D pipeline, then compressed and rendered in a WebAR splat viewer on a hit-tested surface.
works.exercise_zh: 用文生图工具生成一张场景图，再转成 3D 放进手机 AR，比较生成前后的构图差异；变体：让全班用同一个提示词，把结果摆成一条 AR 画廊。
works.description_zh: 一张生成的图像被转换成 8 MB 的高斯点场景，并在网页 AR 中查看。
works.idea_en: Go from one AI image to an AR scene you can stand inside.
works.technique_zh: 通过图生 3D 流程把一张 AI 图像提升为高斯点场景，经过压缩后，在 WebAR 高斯点查看器中渲染到命中测试得到的表面上。
works.exercise_en: Generate a scene image with a text-to-image tool, convert it to 3D and place it in phone AR, then compare how the composition changed. Twist: have the whole class use the same prompt and line the results up as an AR gallery.

works.title: MiniMates
works.description: Remote meeting participants appear as miniature avatars that fit on your desk, so AR meetings work even in small physical spaces.
works.idea_zh: 把远程会议的人缩成桌上的小人，小房间也能开AR会议。

video.video_title: MiniMates: Miniature Avatars for AR Remote Meetings within Limited Physical Spaces

works.technique: Remote participants are represented as scaled-down avatars, and a layout algorithm fits them onto available tabletop area while retargeting their gaze and pointing toward the corresponding local objects.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR Foundation 中检测桌面，把三位远程同学的视频头像放在迷你化身上并排布在桌上，头像朝向正在说话的人；变体：让化身的大小随发言时长或音量变化。
works.description_zh: 远程会议的参与者以迷你化身的形式出现在你的桌面上，即使物理空间很小，AR 会议也能进行。
works.idea_en: Shrink remote colleagues into tiny figures on your desk, so even a small room can host an AR meeting.
works.technique_zh: 远程参与者以缩小的化身呈现，布局算法把他们安排在可用的桌面区域内，同时对他们的视线和指向进行重定向，使其对准本地对应的物体。
works.exercise_en: Detect a tabletop in AR Foundation, put the video faces of three remote classmates on mini avatars arranged across the table, and turn the faces toward whoever is speaking. Twist: make each avatar's size change with how long or how loudly that person speaks.

works.title: Mixed Reality Map of San Francisco
works.description: A web app for discovering location-based AR across San Francisco: open it on a phone, tap a pin, and launch the AR on the spot with no download.
works.idea_zh: 一张城市地图，点地图上的针就在原地打开 AR。

video.video_title:
Been working on a side project. A web app to discover location-based AR experiences across San Francisco

Open on your phone, tap a pin, and launch on the spot. No downloads. And AR glasses soon...

S

works.technique: A Mapbox web map lists geotagged AR experiences as pins, and tapping a pin deep-links to a WebAR URL, avoiding app installs.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Mapbox 或 Leaflet 做一张校园地图，每个图钉链接到一个 WebAR 页面；变体：只有走到图钉 50 米内时才解锁链接。
works.description_zh: 一个用来发现旧金山各处基于位置的 AR 作品的网页应用：在手机上打开，点一下图钉，就能在原地启动 AR，无需下载。
works.idea_en: A city map where tapping a pin opens AR right where you stand.
works.technique_zh: 一张 Mapbox 网页地图把带地理标签的 AR 体验列为图钉，点击图钉会深度链接到一个 WebAR 网址，免去安装应用。
works.exercise_en: Make a campus map with Mapbox or Leaflet where each pin links to a WebAR page. Twist: a link unlocks only when you are within 50 meters of its pin.

works.title: Mixed Reality RC Airplane
works.description: An AI-generated model airplane, coded entirely by an LLM, flies around the living room under the player's control and collides with real walls.
works.idea_zh: AI生成的遥控飞机在客厅里飞行，会撞上真实墙壁。

video.video_title: A #MixedReality RC Airplane!

works.technique: Uses the room mesh as colliders and an LLM-written flight script mapping controller input to lift, thrust and roll.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机陀螺仪控制AR中的纸飞机在教室飞行，撞到检测到的墙面就坠落；变化：设置穿过真实门框的“环”作为赛道。
works.description_zh: 一架由 AI 生成、代码完全由大语言模型编写的模型飞机，在玩家操控下绕着客厅飞行，还会撞上真实的墙壁。
works.idea_en: An AI-made RC plane flies around the living room and crashes into real walls.
works.technique_zh: 把房间网格用作碰撞体，并由大语言模型编写飞行脚本，把控制器输入映射为升力、推力和滚转。
works.exercise_en: Use the phone gyroscope to fly an AR paper plane around the classroom, and make it crash when it hits a detected wall. Twist: set up 'rings' through real doorframes to form a race course.

works.title: Monster Hunter Now Palico AR
works.description: In Monster Hunter Now, made with Capcom, the player's Palico cat companion can be placed in AR for photos alongside the monsters hunted in the real world.
works.idea_zh: 把陪伴狩猎的艾露猫放进现实世界合影。

video.video_title: Your Palico is making its AR debut! 🐾 #MHNow #monsterhunternow #PalicoAR #MHNowPhotoClub

works.technique: A companion character is placed on a detected surface in a photo mode with pose presets and camera capture, turning AR into a snapshot tool.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个 AR 拍照模式：放置角色、选择姿势、一键截图并保存；变体：截图时自动加一个与当前地点相关的边框。
works.description_zh: 在与 Capcom 合作开发的《Monster Hunter Now》中，玩家可以把自己的伙伴艾露猫放进 AR，和在现实世界中狩猎到的怪物合影。
works.idea_en: Bring your hunting companion, the Palico cat, into the real world for a photo together.
works.technique_zh: 在拍照模式中把伙伴角色放置在检测到的表面上，配合预设姿势和相机截图，让 AR 成为一个快照工具。
works.exercise_en: Build an AR photo mode: place a character, choose a pose, and capture and save a screenshot with one tap. Twist: automatically add a frame related to the current location when the photo is taken.

works.title: Morning stroll into a portal
works.description: Walking through a doorway-sized portal into a World Labs-generated environment.
works.idea_zh: 走进一扇门，门后是 AI 生成的世界。

video.video_title: Morning stroll into a @theworldlabs portal. I picture a future where you describe your environment and it instantly materializes around you. https://t.co/emyC26R1fN

works.technique: A doorway mesh placed on the ground uses a stencil buffer to show a generated environment only through the opening, and a camera-crossing check flips the render so the user ends up inside.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 平面检测放一扇门，门内用 Stencil 渲染一片森林，穿过门后切换为全景环境；变体：让门的另一侧是你小时候住过的地方。
works.description_zh: 穿过一扇门大小的传送门，走进一个由 World Labs 生成的环境。
works.idea_en: Walk through a door into a world generated by AI.
works.technique_zh: 放在地面上的门框网格利用模板缓冲区，只在门洞中显示生成的环境；当相机穿过门框时，检测逻辑会翻转渲染，让用户最终置身其中。
works.exercise_en: Place a door with AR Foundation plane detection, render a forest inside it with a stencil, and switch to a full surrounding environment once the user walks through. Twist: make the other side of the door the place where you lived as a child.

works.title: Niantic Spatial launch + WebAR portal
works.description: Brand and product vision for Niantic Spatial's debut, including a working WebAR portal released with the launch film.
works.idea_zh: 把公司发布会本身做成一个可以走进去的 WebAR 传送门。

video.video_title: Niantic Spatial - AI that understands the physical world

works.technique: A launch-film WebAR portal likely reuses stencil portal rendering on a hit-tested surface, so viewers can open the same world shown in the film on their own phones.
works.exercise_zh: 为一个虚构产品拍一段 30 秒的概念短片，并配一个观众可以打开的 AR 传送门；变体：让传送门里的场景是短片最后一帧的延续。
works.description_zh: 为 Niantic Spatial 首次亮相所做的品牌与产品愿景，其中包括一个随发布影片一同推出、可以实际体验的 WebAR 传送门。
