works.idea_en: Turn the company launch itself into a WebAR portal you can walk into.
works.technique_zh: 这个配合发布影片的 WebAR 传送门可能沿用了在命中测试表面上渲染模板传送门的做法，让观众能在自己的手机上打开影片中出现的同一个世界。
works.exercise_en: Shoot a 30-second concept film for a fictional product and pair it with an AR portal viewers can open. Twist: make the scene inside the portal continue from the film's last frame.

works.title: Photo to WebAR world in real time
works.description: A single photo becomes a 5 MB Gaussian splat scene that runs in real time as a WebAR experience.
works.idea_zh: 一张照片变成可以走进去的 AR 场景。

video.video_title: real-time WebAR experience + 5MB gaussian splat. Generated this scene from a photo using World Labs. https://t.co/73ro8L1Q57

works.technique: A single photo is converted by an image-to-3D model into a compact splat, which is then loaded in a WebAR viewer and placed on a detected surface.
works.exercise_zh: 拍一张照片用图生 3D 工具转成模型，导入 WebAR 放在桌面上，并对比原照片找出生成错误的部分；变体：故意选一张画作或老照片，看它“立体化”后的样子。
works.description_zh: 一张照片变成一个 5 MB 的高斯点场景，作为 WebAR 体验实时运行。
works.idea_en: A single photo becomes an AR scene you can walk into.
works.technique_zh: 图生 3D 模型把单张照片转换为一个紧凑的高斯点场景，随后在 WebAR 查看器中加载，并放置在检测到的表面上。
works.exercise_en: Take a photo, turn it into a model with an image-to-3D tool, import it into WebAR on a tabletop, and compare it with the original photo to find what the generation got wrong. Twist: pick a painting or an old photo on purpose and see what it looks like in 3D.

works.title: Pinball table in your room (WebXR)
works.description: A web pinball game that also runs in AR on a headset: the table appears in your real space, wired up with about 100 lines of react-three/xr.
works.idea_zh: 把网页弹珠台一键变成摆在你房间里的 AR 版本。
works.technique: The existing three.js scene is wrapped in a WebXR AR session via react-three/xr, with the table anchored to a hit-tested floor or table surface and controller/hand input mapped to flippers.
works.exercise_zh: 把你之前做过的一个网页 3D 小游戏用 WebXR 改成 AR 版，摆在真实桌面上玩；变体：让桌子的真实边缘成为游戏里的墙。

video.video_title:
And of course the pinball table works in AR! Thanks to the amazing @react-three/xr library. Only a 100 lines of code or so to wire it up.

Load it up on your fav headset to play it in your space! http

works.description_zh: 一款网页弹珠台游戏，也能在头显上以 AR 形式运行：球台出现在你的真实空间里，只用了大约 100 行 react-three/xr 代码接入。
works.idea_en: Turn a web pinball table into an AR version sitting in your room with one step.
works.technique_zh: 通过 react-three/xr 把现有的 three.js 场景包进一个 WebXR AR 会话，球台锚定在命中测试得到的地面或桌面上，并把控制器或手部输入映射到挡板上。
works.exercise_en: Convert a small 3D web game you made before into an AR version with WebXR and play it on a real tabletop. Twist: make the real edges of the table act as walls in the game.

works.title: Project Jade - Spatial Agents (Liquid City)
works.description: A spatial AI agent for AR glasses that sees what the wearer sees and responds with embodied, placed UI, shown at Snap Lens Fest 2025.
works.idea_zh: 能看见你所见、在空间中回应你的AI伙伴

video.video_title: Spatial Agents - Project Jade

works.technique: Egocentric camera frames are sent to a multimodal LLM, and responses are rendered as UI panels anchored near the referenced object using world tracking and raycasts.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个手机 AR 原型：拍下当前画面交给视觉语言模型，把回答作为标签钉在画面中对应物体附近；变体：让代理只能用图标和手势回应、不用文字，测试非语言的空间回答是否可理解。
works.description_zh: 一个面向 AR 眼镜的空间 AI 代理，能看到佩戴者所见，并以具身化、放置在空间中的界面作出回应，曾在 2025 年 Snap Lens Fest 上展示。
works.idea_en: An AI companion that sees what you see and answers you out in space.
works.technique_zh: 第一人称相机画面被发送给多模态大语言模型，回复则借助世界追踪和射线检测，渲染为锚定在所指物体附近的界面面板。
works.exercise_en: Build a phone AR prototype that sends the current view to a vision-language model and pins its answer as a label next to the matching object in the frame. Twist: let the agent reply only with icons and gestures, never text, and test whether nonverbal spatial answers can be understood.

works.title: Redesigned living room, 1.5 MB per splat
works.description: Nano Banana image → World Labs world → WebAR: several living-room redesigns as tiny .spz splats he can switch between in place.
works.idea_zh: 在原地切换多套 AI 生成的客厅设计方案。

video.video_title:
Visualizing my re-designed living room in 3D

Nano banana -> World Labs -> WebAR (threejs)

Each of these gaussian splats are only 1.5 mb in size (.spz file type) https://t.co/E3el0eAMh1

works.technique: Multiple compressed .spz splats share one aligned anchor in the room, and a UI toggle swaps which splat is visible so each redesign appears in the same place.
works.exercise_zh: 为同一个角落准备三种风格的布置模型，共用一个锚点，点击按钮切换；变体：让同学投票选出最喜欢的方案并在 AR 中显示票数。
works.description_zh: Nano Banana 生成图像 → World Labs 生成世界 → WebAR：几套客厅改造方案被做成体积很小的 .spz 高斯点文件，他可以在原地来回切换。
works.idea_en: Switch between several AI-generated living-room designs right where they will go.
works.technique_zh: 多个压缩后的 .spz 高斯点场景共用房间中的同一个对齐锚点，通过界面开关切换显示哪一个，让每套改造方案都出现在同一位置。
works.exercise_en: Prepare layout models in three styles for the same corner, share one anchor among them, and switch between them with a button. Twist: let classmates vote for their favorite and show the vote count in AR.

works.title: Shadow Tuner
works.description: A rotating, upside-down Earth is projected onto a giant spherical balloon; passers-by at a camera station cast their shadows onto the globe, reshaping how the planet appears.
works.idea_zh: 路人的影子被投到巨大的地球气球上，改变地球的样子
works.technique: A camera at a station captures the passer-by's silhouette and composites it into the projected (or LED) spherical Earth animation in real time.
works.exercise_zh: 在白色气球或球灯上投影旋转地球，用摄像头剪影在地球上“打出”阴影；变化：影子遮住的区域显示该地区的一个真实数据。

video.video_title: Shadow Tuner - Montreal - 2025

works.description_zh: 一个旋转、上下颠倒的地球被投影在巨大的球形气球上；路人在摄像站前把自己的影子投到这颗地球上，改变了星球的样貌。
works.idea_en: Passers-by cast their shadows onto a giant Earth balloon and change how the planet looks.
works.technique_zh: 站点处的摄像头捕捉路人的剪影，并实时合成到投影（或 LED）的球形地球动画中。
works.exercise_en: Project a spinning Earth onto a white balloon or globe lamp, and use a camera silhouette to 'cast' a shadow onto it. Twist: the area covered by the shadow shows a real data point about that region.

works.title: Shape n' Swarm
works.description: Users sculpt a shape with their hands and describe it in speech; an LLM plans how a swarm of small tabletop robots should arrange and move to represent and animate it.
works.idea_zh: 用手比划加一句话，机器人群就排出并动起你想要的形状。

video.video_title: Shape n’ Swarm: Hands-on, Shape-aware Generative Authoring with Swarm UI and LLMs [UIST2025]

works.technique: Combines hand-sketched shape input with an LLM that outputs robot target positions and motion scripts for a swarm UI.
works.exercise_zh: 让同学用语音描述一个动物，由ChatGPT生成一组坐标，再由几名同学手持纸片按坐标在地面上排出这个形状；变化：要求形状“动起来”（如鸟扇动翅膀）。
works.description_zh: 用户用双手塑造一个形状，再用语言描述它；大语言模型据此规划一群桌面小机器人该如何排列和移动，把这个形状表现出来并让它动起来。
works.idea_en: Sketch a shape with your hands and say one sentence, and a robot swarm forms it and brings it to life.
works.technique_zh: 把手绘形状输入与大语言模型结合，由模型为群体界面输出机器人的目标位置和运动脚本。
works.exercise_en: Have a classmate describe an animal by voice, let ChatGPT turn it into a set of coordinates, and have several classmates holding paper cards line up on the floor to form the shape. Twist: require the shape to move (for example, a bird flapping its wings).

works.title: Spectacular: The Art of Jonathan Yeo in Augmented Reality
works.description: The first AR art exhibition on Snap Spectacles: as visitors approach Jonathan Yeo's royal, celebrity and self-portraits, the paintings are recognised and transform and respond around the frame.
works.description_zh: 首个基于 Snap Spectacles 的 AR 艺术展：观众走近 Jonathan Yeo 的皇室、名人与自画像时，眼镜会识别画作，让画面在画框内外变化并对观众作出回应。
works.idea_en: Paintings that know you are looking and answer back.
works.idea_zh: 画作知道你在看它，并且会回应你。
works.technique: Snap trained recognition models on each painting so Spectacles detect and track the canvas, then play spatial animations registered to it.
works.technique_zh: Snap 针对每幅画训练了识别模型，让 Spectacles 检测并追踪画布，再播放与画面精确对齐的空间动画。
works.exercise_en: Choose one portrait and build an image-tracked AR layer where the subject reacts differently depending on how close the viewer stands. Twist: the portrait remembers the last visitor and greets the next one about them.
works.exercise_zh: 选一幅肖像，做一个图像追踪的 AR 图层，让画中人根据观者站得远近作出不同反应；变体：肖像会记住上一位观者，并向下一位观者“讲述”他。

video.video_title: Spectacular, the Art of Jonathan Yeo in Augmented Reality

works.title: Starship rocket in XR
works.description: A Spectacles experience that lets you launch a SpaceX Starship and guide the booster back to a 3D-printed launch tower on your table.
works.idea_zh: 发射星舰，再把助推器引导回桌上3D打印的发射塔。

video.video_title: Starship rocket in XR - Spectacles

works.technique: The printed tower is registered as a tracked object or placed anchor, and a simple physics or scripted trajectory lets the user steer the booster back to the physical catch point.
works.exercise_zh: 用一个真实物体（纸杯）作为着陆点，在 AR 中操控一枚火箭落回杯口，偏离太多就爆炸；变体：加入随机侧风。
works.description_zh: 一个 Spectacles 体验：你可以发射 SpaceX 星舰（Starship），再把助推器引导回桌上那座 3D 打印的发射塔。
works.idea_en: Launch a Starship, then guide the booster back to a 3D-printed launch tower on the table.
works.technique_zh: 打印的发射塔被注册为追踪物体或放置锚点，借助简单的物理模拟或脚本轨迹，用户可以把助推器操控回实体的回收点。
works.exercise_en: Use a real object (a paper cup) as the landing pad and steer a rocket in AR back into its mouth, making it explode if it drifts too far. Twist: add random crosswinds.

works.title: Step into a persistent redesign, 1:1
works.description: Gemini designs a new living room, World Labs generates it in 3D, and VPS localizes it to his real room at 1:1 scale so he can step into it.
works.idea_zh: AI 设计 + AI 生成 + 定位对齐：在自己家里 1:1 走进重新设计的客厅。

video.video_title:
I reimagined my living room with World Labs. Gemini helped design it, World Labs generated the 3D environment, and VPS localized it to my space 1:1 scale.

I can now step into a persistent redesign in

works.technique: VPS localizes the phone against a prior map of the room, so a 1:1 generated redesign loads at the same real-world pose every session instead of needing manual alignment.
works.exercise_zh: 用 ARKit ARWorldMap 或 AR Foundation 的持久化锚点保存房间里的布置，下次打开时自动恢复到原位；变体：让家具位置每次打开时根据当天天气略有变化。
works.description_zh: Gemini 设计新的客厅，World Labs 把它生成成 3D，再由 VPS 以 1:1 比例定位到他真实的房间里，让他可以走进去。
works.idea_en: AI design, AI generation and precise localization let you step into a redesigned living room at 1:1 scale in your own home.
works.technique_zh: VPS 根据房间事先建好的地图对手机进行定位，因此 1:1 的生成式改造方案每次都会加载在相同的真实世界位姿上，不需要手动对齐。
works.exercise_en: Save a room layout with ARKit ARWorldMap or persistent anchors in AR Foundation, and restore it to the same place automatically the next time the app opens. Twist: shift the furniture slightly each time based on that day's weather.

works.title: StickAR: Spatial Notes Beyond Typing
works.description: Hand-written or spoken notes are recognised and pinned as 3D sticky notes in space, avoiding keyboards in AR/VR.
works.idea_zh: 不用键盘，把手写或语音笔记变成贴在空间里的便利贴。

video.video_title: StickAR : Spatial notes & beyond typing (Final ver.)

works.technique: OCR or speech recognition converts handwritten or spoken input to text, which is spawned as a 3D sticky-note panel anchored at the hand or gaze position.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Web Speech API 把说的话变成文字，生成一张 3D 便利贴贴在屏幕中心射线命中的墙面上；变体：便利贴颜色根据内容类型（待办/想法）自动区分。
works.description_zh: 手写或口述的笔记被识别出来，以 3D 便利贴的形式钉在空间中，让人在 AR/VR 里不必再用键盘。
works.idea_en: Skip the keyboard and turn handwritten or spoken notes into sticky notes placed in space.
works.technique_zh: 通过 OCR 或语音识别把手写或语音输入转换为文字，生成一个锚定在手部或视线位置的 3D 便利贴面板。
works.exercise_en: Turn speech into text with the Web Speech API and generate a 3D sticky note on the wall hit by a ray from the center of the screen. Twist: color the notes automatically by content type (to-do or idea).

works.title: The Colours of Music (Royal Philharmonic Orchestra)
works.description: Scanning a musician or instrument with this Lens turns the notes being played into evolving 3D colours and shapes around the performer, inspired by chromesthesia.
works.description_zh: 用这个 Lens 扫描乐手或乐器，正在演奏的音符就会在演奏者周围化作不断变化的 3D 色彩与形状，灵感来自“色听联觉”。
works.idea_en: Let everyone, including people who are hard of hearing, see music the way synaesthetes do.
works.idea_zh: 让每个人（包括听力不便的人）都能像联觉者一样“看见”音乐。
works.technique: Machine learning detects instruments and analyses live audio pitch and timbre, mapping them to colour, form and motion of spatial particles anchored near the player.
works.technique_zh: 用机器学习识别乐器并分析现场音频的音高与音色，映射到锚定在演奏者附近的空间粒子的颜色、形态和运动上。
works.exercise_en: Build an AR visualiser that maps pitch to colour and loudness to size for sounds from one real instrument in class. Twist: each classmate designs their own colour mapping, and the class compares whose feels most 'right'.
works.exercise_zh: 为课堂上的一件真实乐器做一个 AR 可视化：音高对应颜色、音量对应大小；变体：每位同学设计自己的颜色映射，全班比较谁的最“对味”。

video.video_title: The Colours Of Music

works.title: The Long Fall: A descent into the Ocean's Living Memory
works.description: A 15-minute audiovisual performance (with Manu Prakash and others) that takes the audience on an immersive descent with plankton, projected across wall and floor.
works.idea_zh: 随浮游生物一起“下沉”，看见海洋如何记住碳
works.technique: Microscopy footage and simulations of plankton are composed into a live wall-and-floor projection performance with spatial sound.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机微距拍水滴或植物细胞，把影像投到地上做一段“下沉”视觉叙事；变化：观众走到不同深度区（地面标线）触发不同的声音。

video.video_title: The Long Fall: A descent into the Ocean's Living Memory

works.description_zh: 一场时长 15 分钟的视听表演（与 Manu Prakash 等人合作），通过墙面和地面的投影，带观众与浮游生物一起沉浸式地下潜。
works.idea_en: Sink down with the plankton and see how the ocean remembers carbon.
works.technique_zh: 把浮游生物的显微影像和模拟结果组合成一场结合空间声音的墙面与地面现场投影表演。
works.exercise_en: Shoot water droplets or plant cells with a phone macro lens and project the footage onto the floor as a visual 'descent' narrative. Twist: when viewers walk into different depth zones (marked on the floor), different sounds play.

works.title: VPS-anchored WebAR demo
works.description: A real-time WebAR experience anchored to a specific real-world location with a visual positioning system.
works.idea_zh: 内容钉在真实地点上，谁来都看到同一个位置的同一个东西。

video.video_title: real-time WebAR experience powered by VPS (anchored to a real world location) a fun demo I built. The web will also be spatial soon… https://t.co/bGccJmWg1R

works.technique: A browser-based VPS matches camera frames against a pre-scanned location map to recover a 6DoF pose, so content is anchored to an exact real-world spot rather than to the first detected plane.
works.exercise_zh: 用图像追踪（在真实地点贴一张海报作为标记）模拟 VPS，把内容锚定在固定位置；变体：内容只在特定时间段出现。
works.description_zh: 一个借助视觉定位系统（VPS）锚定在特定真实地点的实时 WebAR 体验。
works.idea_en: Content pinned to a real place, so everyone who comes sees the same thing in the same spot.
works.technique_zh: 基于浏览器的 VPS 把相机画面与预先扫描的地点地图进行匹配，恢复 6DoF 位姿，因此内容被锚定在一个精确的真实位置，而不是第一个检测到的平面上。
works.exercise_en: Simulate VPS with image tracking (put a poster at a real location as the marker) and anchor content at a fixed spot. Twist: the content appears only during a certain time window.

works.title: Wisp World (Liquid City)
works.description: An AR/AI game for Snap Spectacles and Vision Pro where the player talks with a small spirit character, Wisp, who explores and comments on the real room.
works.idea_zh: 与会说话的小精灵在真实房间里冒险的AI+AR游戏

video.video_title: Wisp World for Snap Spectacles - an AI / AR game

works.technique: Headset scene understanding (meshing/semantic labels) plus a camera-to-LLM loop lets a small animated character navigate real surfaces and speak about recognised objects.
works.exercise_zh: 在 Unity AR 中放一个会沿检测平面移动的小角色，用拍照 + 视觉语言模型让它对房间里的物品发表一句评论；变体：给角色一个固定性格（胆小、傲慢），让它的评论和行走路径都体现这种性格。
works.description_zh: 一款面向 Snap Spectacles 和 Vision Pro 的 AR/AI 游戏：玩家与一个名叫 Wisp 的小精灵角色对话，它会在真实房间里四处探索并发表评论。
works.idea_en: An AI and AR game in which you go on adventures with a talking little spirit in your real room.
works.technique_zh: 头显的场景理解（网格化和语义标签）加上“相机画面 → 大语言模型”的循环，让一个小动画角色能在真实表面上移动，并谈论它识别出的物体。
works.exercise_en: Place a small character in Unity AR that moves along detected planes, and use a photo plus a vision-language model to have it comment on an object in the room. Twist: give the character a fixed personality (timid or arrogant) that shows in both its comments and its walking path.

works.title: XR Worlds
works.description: A Spectacles proof of concept that turns a 2D drawing on paper into a playable XR world, using a generative world model.
works.idea_zh: 把纸上的二维涂鸦变成可玩的XR世界。

video.video_title: XR Worlds - Spectacles

works.technique: A camera capture of a paper drawing is sent to a generative world model that returns a playable environment, which is then displayed in the glasses.
works.exercise_zh: 拍一张手绘关卡草图，识别其中的线条作为平台，在 AR 中生成可以让小球滚动的关卡；变体：用不同颜色的笔代表不同物理材质。
works.description_zh: 一个 Spectacles 概念验证：借助生成式世界模型，把纸上的一幅二维涂鸦变成可以游玩的 XR 世界。
works.idea_en: Turn a 2D doodle on paper into a playable XR world.
works.technique_zh: 相机拍下纸上的画，发送给生成式世界模型，模型返回一个可游玩的环境，随后在眼镜中显示。
works.exercise_en: Photograph a hand-drawn level sketch, detect its lines as platforms, and generate an AR level a ball can roll through. Twist: use pens of different colors to stand for different physical materials.

works.title: three.js in real life
works.description: A three.js scene pulled off the screen and placed in the physical world with AR.
works.idea_zh: 把网页 3D 引擎的效果搬到现实里。

video.video_title: This is what three.js looks like in real life https://t.co/h71pIPc5CG

works.technique: An existing three.js scene is wrapped in a WebXR immersive-ar session, placed at a hit-test point, and scaled to real-world units.
works.exercise_zh: 从 three.js 官方示例中挑一个，加上 WebXR AR 会话和 hit-test 放到真实地面上；变体：调整比例让它变得非常大或非常小，观察感受的变化。
works.description_zh: 把一个 three.js 场景从屏幕里“拽”出来，通过 AR 放进物理世界。
works.idea_en: Move the effects of a web 3D engine out into the real world.
works.technique_zh: 现有的 three.js 场景被包进一个 WebXR immersive-ar 会话，放在命中测试点上，并按真实世界单位进行缩放。
works.exercise_en: Pick one of the official three.js examples, add a WebXR AR session and a hit test, and put it on the real floor. Twist: change its scale to make it very large or very small, and notice how the experience changes.

works.title: A Rubik's Cube Game with a Real Cube
works.description: A Bluetooth smart Rubik's cube becomes the controller: every real twist rotates and changes a puzzle world he built in Unity.
works.idea_zh: 拧真实的魔方来操控游戏世界。

video.video_title: Making a Rubik's Cube Game with a Real Cube

works.technique: The GAN smart cube reports each face turn over Bluetooth, and Unity maps those moves to rotations of the in-game level.
works.exercise_zh: 用带陀螺仪的手机或 micro:bit 当'魔方'，转动它来旋转屏幕里的迷宫让小球滚到出口；加一个变化：摇一摇会让迷宫重新生成。
works.description_zh: 一个蓝牙智能魔方成为游戏手柄：每次拧动真实魔方，都会旋转并改变他在 Unity 中搭建的解谜世界。
works.idea_en: Twist a real Rubik's cube to control a game world.
works.technique_zh: GAN 智能魔方通过蓝牙上报每一次面的转动，Unity 再把这些操作映射为游戏关卡的旋转。
works.exercise_en: Use a phone with a gyroscope or a micro:bit as the 'cube', and rotate it to tilt an on-screen maze so a ball rolls to the exit. Twist: shaking it regenerates the maze.

works.title: AirDraw – Finger Paint AR for Vision Pro
works.description: Finger-painting in 3D space on Apple Vision Pro, later extended with the Logitech Muse stylus for 3D calligraphy and a voxel brush.
works.idea_zh: 在 Vision Pro 里直接用手指在空中作画。

video.video_title: AirDraw - Finger Paint AR for Vision Pro

works.technique: visionOS hand tracking gives fingertip joint positions each frame, and a pinch gesture starts appending those points to a stroke mesh in RealityKit.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe Hands 在网页里追踪食指尖，捏合时在 three.js 场景中留下 3D 线条；变体：把笔刷换成方块体素，做一个空中积木。
works.description_zh: 在 Apple Vision Pro 上用手指在三维空间中作画，后来又加入了 Logitech Muse 触控笔，用于 3D 书法和体素笔刷。
works.idea_en: Paint in the air with your finger inside Vision Pro.
works.technique_zh: visionOS 手部追踪每帧提供指尖关节的位置，捏合手势开始后，这些点会被不断追加到 RealityKit 中的笔画网格上。
works.exercise_en: Track the index fingertip on a web page with MediaPipe Hands and leave 3D lines in a three.js scene while pinching. Twist: swap the brush for voxel cubes and build blocks in mid-air.

works.title: Augmented Burtonesque (The World of Tim Burton)
works.description: In the atrium of London's Design Museum, visitors raise their phones to open a space-themed Burtonesque fantasy world that extends Tim Burton's exhibition into the building itself.
works.description_zh: 在伦敦设计博物馆的中庭，观众举起手机就能打开一个太空主题的“伯顿风”奇幻世界，把 Tim Burton 的展览延伸到整栋建筑中。
works.idea_en: Extend an artist's exhibition beyond the gallery walls into the shared public space of the museum.
works.idea_zh: 把艺术家的展览延伸到展厅之外，进入博物馆的公共空间。
works.technique: A location-anchored world Lens (likely a custom Landmarker of the atrium) places large animated Burton-style characters and sets at architectural scale.
works.technique_zh: 用锚定在特定地点的世界 Lens（很可能是中庭的自定义地标）以建筑尺度摆放伯顿风格的大型动画角色与布景。
works.exercise_en: Pick a lobby or stairwell and design an AR 'takeover' in the visual style of an artist you admire, sized to the real architecture. Twist: the takeover only appears when the space is almost empty.
works.exercise_zh: 选一个大厅或楼梯间，按照你欣赏的艺术家的风格设计一次与真实建筑尺度匹配的 AR“占领”；变体：只有当空间几乎没人时，这次占领才会出现。

video.video_title: Augmented Burtonesque - The Design Museum x Snapchat

works.title: Augmented Inspection (Vision Hack)
works.description: An Apple Vision Pro app lets an operator monitor and teleoperate a Boston Dynamics Spot robot with hand gestures and voice, seeing its camera feed and point cloud in space.
works.idea_zh: 戴上头显，用手势和语音远程巡检、操控机器狗。

video.video_title: Team Circuit - Final Video Vision Hack (2024.09.15)

works.technique: Hand tracking and speech on Vision Pro drive robot commands, while the robot's camera stream and point cloud are rendered as spatial panels.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机 AR 和一个遥控小车，做'远程巡检'：手机上看到小车摄像头画面并用手势让它转向；加一个变化：发现某种颜色物体时自动标注。
works.description_zh: 一款 Apple Vision Pro 应用，操作员可以用手势和语音监控并远程操控 Boston Dynamics 的 Spot 机器狗，同时在空间中看到它的相机画面和点云。
works.idea_en: Put on a headset and use gestures and voice to inspect and steer a robot dog remotely.
works.technique_zh: Vision Pro 上的手部追踪和语音驱动机器人指令，同时把机器人的相机视频流和点云渲染为空间面板。
works.exercise_en: Use phone AR and a remote-control car to run a 'remote inspection': watch the car's camera feed on the phone and steer it with hand gestures. Twist: automatically tag objects of a certain color when they are spotted.

works.title: Augmented Physics
works.description: Photograph a static physics textbook diagram and it becomes an interactive simulation in place: pendulums swing, pulleys move and parameters can be changed.
works.idea_zh: 拍一张课本里的物理图，图就活过来成为可以调参数的模拟。

video.video_title: [UIST 2024] Augmented Physics: Creating Interactive and Embedded Physics Simulations from Static ...

works.technique: Diagram elements in a textbook image are segmented (e.g. with SAM), recognized as physics primitives such as pendulums, pulleys or ramps, and reconstructed as a 2D physics simulation overlaid on the original figure.
works.exercise_zh: 拍一张物理课本的示意图（斜面、单摆或滑轮），手动或用分割工具裁出各部件，在 Matter.js 中重建为可运动的模拟并叠加回原图；变体：允许读者改动一个“现实里改不了”的参数（比如重力朝上）。
works.description_zh: 拍下物理课本上一张静态的示意图，它就会在原处变成可交互的模拟：单摆摆动，滑轮转动，参数也可以修改。
works.idea_en: Photograph a physics diagram in a textbook and it comes alive as a simulation you can tune.
works.technique_zh: 对课本图像中的示意图元素进行分割（例如使用 SAM），识别为单摆、滑轮、斜面等物理基元，再重建为叠加在原图上的二维物理模拟。
works.exercise_en: Photograph a diagram from a physics textbook (an incline, a pendulum or a pulley), cut out each part by hand or with a segmentation tool, rebuild it as a moving simulation in Matter.js and overlay it on the original figure. Twist: let readers change a parameter that cannot be changed in real life (such as gravity pointing up).

works.title: Blackbox for Vision
works.description: Blackbox rebuilt for Apple Vision Pro: bubble-like puzzles float in your room and are solved by looking, reaching, speaking and moving through space instead of pressing buttons.
works.idea_zh: 没有按钮的谜题：用注视、手势、声音和身体移动去解开漂浮在房间里的谜。

video.video_title: Blackbox for Vision

works.technique: Puzzles hide their input rules in non-obvious channels such as gaze dwell, reach distance, voice and body movement, detected with visionOS gaze, hand tracking and audio input.
works.exercise_zh: 设计一个没有按钮的 AR 谜题，玩家必须通过走近、说话或保持静止等非常规方式解开；变体：谜题的提示只能通过声音获得。
works.description_zh: 为 Apple Vision Pro 重新打造的 Blackbox：泡泡般的谜题漂浮在你的房间里，解谜靠的不是按按钮，而是注视、伸手、说话和在空间中移动。
works.idea_en: Puzzles with no buttons: solve the riddles floating in your room with your gaze, gestures, voice and body movement.
works.technique_zh: 谜题把输入规则藏在不显眼的通道里，例如注视停留、伸手距离、声音和身体移动，并通过 visionOS 的视线追踪、手部追踪和音频输入来检测。
works.exercise_en: Design an AR puzzle with no buttons that players must solve in unusual ways such as walking closer, speaking or staying still. Twist: the hints can only be heard, never seen.

works.title: BlendScape
works.description: Video-call participants type or speak a theme and their separate backgrounds are blended by AI into one shared scene, like a single cafe or classroom that everyone appears to sit in.
works.description_zh: 视频通话的参与者输入或说出一个主题，AI 就把各自的背景融合成一个共享场景，比如大家仿佛坐在同一间咖啡馆或教室里。
works.idea_en: Let meeting participants generate the shared place they meet in.
works.idea_zh: 让开会的人自己生成他们见面的地点。
works.technique: Composites segmented participants into AI-generated environments that blend their physical or digital backgrounds, steered with multimodal prompts and direct manipulation.
works.technique_zh: 把分割出来的参与者合成进 AI 生成的环境，这些环境融合了他们的实体或数字背景，并可通过多模态提示和直接操作来调整。
works.exercise_en: Run a class video call where each student picks a virtual background that continues a shared panorama, so together the tiles form one scene. Twist: change the scene in the middle of a story each student tells.
works.exercise_zh: 开一次班级视频通话，每个学生选择一张能接续共享全景图的虚拟背景，让所有画面拼成一个完整场景；变体：在每个学生讲故事的过程中切换场景。

video.video_title: BlendScape: Enabling End-User Customization of Video-Conferencing Environments through Generative AI

works.title: Chameleon
works.description: A camera-driven digital being that mimics passers-by's movement and appearance, shown on screens in East London streets, malls and later Venice and Beijing.
works.idea_zh: 街头会模仿你的数字变色龙生物

video.video_title: Chameleon in the streets, East London

works.technique: Camera-based computer vision (pose estimation plus colour sampling) lets a generative creature copy the passer-by's movement and clothing colours on a public screen.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe Pose 和摄像头取色，做一个模仿观众姿态并采用其衣服颜色的抽象生物；变体：让生物只模仿画面中最安静的那个人。
works.description_zh: 一个由摄像头驱动的数字生命，会模仿路人的动作和外貌，曾在伦敦东区的街头和商场屏幕上展出，后来又去了威尼斯和北京。
works.idea_en: A digital chameleon creature on the street that imitates you.
works.technique_zh: 基于摄像头的计算机视觉（姿态估计加颜色采样）让一个生成式生物在公共屏幕上模仿路人的动作和衣服颜色。
works.exercise_en: Use MediaPipe Pose and camera color sampling to make an abstract creature that mimics a viewer's pose and takes on the colors of their clothes. Twist: let the creature imitate only the stillest person in the frame.

works.title: Coachella 'Luminous' filter
works.description: A glowing, light-reactive face effect created for Coachella on Instagram, with behind-the-scenes on the makeup design and technical build.
works.idea_zh: 音乐节主题的发光妆容滤镜，让脸像舞台灯一样闪耀。

video.video_title: How I Made the Coachella "Luminous" AR Instagram Filter using Spark AR

works.technique: Face-attached emissive materials with bloom are modulated by camera luminance or light estimation, so the glow reacts to the surrounding lighting.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个会根据环境亮度改变发光强度的脸部滤镜，暗处更亮、亮处更淡；变体：用麦克风音量代替亮度来驱动发光。
works.description_zh: 为 Coachella 在 Instagram 上制作的一款会发光、会对光线作出反应的面部特效，并附有妆容设计和技术搭建的幕后解析。
works.idea_en: A festival-themed glowing makeup filter that makes your face shine like stage lights.
works.technique_zh: 贴合面部的自发光材质配合泛光（bloom）效果，由相机亮度或光照估计进行调制，让光晕随周围光线变化。
works.exercise_en: Make a face filter whose glow changes with ambient brightness, getting brighter in the dark and fainter in bright light. Twist: drive the glow with microphone volume instead of brightness.

works.title: Coachella 'MetaButterfly' filter
works.description: An Instagram AR effect for a Coachella campaign with butterfly-themed makeup effects on the face; Piskin walks through the inspiration, makeup and tech.
works.idea_zh: 为音乐节设计的蝴蝶幻彩妆容与翅膀AR滤镜。

video.video_title: How I Made the Coachella "MetaButterfly" AR Instagram Filter Using Spark AR

works.technique: Face-tracked butterfly meshes and makeup textures are anchored to facial landmarks, with wing animations driven by time or facial movement.
works.exercise_zh: 在脸上放几只沿眉毛或颧骨停驻的 AR 蝴蝶，张嘴时它们飞走；变体：蝴蝶飞离后会停到画面中的真实物体上。
works.description_zh: 为 Coachella 宣传活动制作的一款 Instagram AR 特效，在脸上呈现以蝴蝶为主题的妆容效果；Piskin 分享了其中的灵感、妆容和技术。
works.idea_en: An AR filter of iridescent butterfly makeup and wings designed for a music festival.
works.technique_zh: 受面部追踪的蝴蝶网格和妆容纹理锚定在面部关键点上，翅膀动画由时间或面部动作驱动。
works.exercise_en: Place a few AR butterflies that rest along the eyebrows or cheekbones and fly away when the mouth opens. Twist: after flying off, the butterflies land on real objects in the frame.

works.title: Conducting a virtual choir like Jacob Collier
works.description: Hand gestures tracked from a webcam conduct pitches and harmonies, imitating how Jacob Collier conducts his audience as a choir.
works.idea_zh: 像 Jacob Collier 指挥观众合唱一样，用手势在空中'指挥'和声。

video.video_title: Trying to turn myself into a singer remotely as good as a @jacobcollier audience using TouchDesigner and the MediaPipe plugin developed by myself and Dom Scott https://t.co/MxjGOHJ3pb

works.technique: Hand landmark height and spread from MediaPipe are mapped to musical pitch and chord voicing, with graphics overlaid on the live camera image.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe Hands + Tone.js：手的高度控制音高，张开程度控制和弦；加一个变化：两个人一起合奏成二重唱。
works.description_zh: 通过网络摄像头追踪的手势来指挥音高与和声，模仿 Jacob Collier 把观众当作合唱团来指挥的方式。
works.idea_en: Conduct harmonies in the air with hand gestures, the way Jacob Collier conducts his audience as a choir.
works.technique_zh: 把 MediaPipe 手部关键点的高度和张开程度映射为音高与和弦排列，并把图形叠加在实时相机画面上。
works.exercise_en: Use MediaPipe Hands and Tone.js so that hand height controls pitch and hand spread controls the chord. Twist: have two people play together as a duet.

works.title: DexteriSync
works.description: A water-cooled exoskeleton chills or warms the fingers so the wearer's dexterity drops or recovers on demand, letting a designer feel what fine tasks are like for an older person or a cold hand.
works.description_zh: 一副通水冷却的外骨骼可以按需冷却或加温手指，让佩戴者的灵巧度下降或恢复，设计师因此能亲身体会老人或冻僵的手做精细动作的感觉。
works.idea_en: Temperature is a dial for dexterity: cool the fingers to borrow someone else's hands.
works.idea_zh: 温度是灵巧度的旋钮：把手指冷下来，就能“借用”别人的手。
works.technique: Circulates temperature-controlled water through silicone-copper tubes along each finger to change skin temperature and thus finger dexterity and thermal perception.
works.technique_zh: 让温控水流经沿手指布置的硅胶铜管，改变皮肤温度，从而改变手指的灵巧度和冷热感受。
works.exercise_en: Have students button a shirt and type on a phone after holding an ice pack for one minute, then redesign one app screen for cold, clumsy fingers. Twist: add gloves of different thickness and chart the error rate.
works.exercise_zh: 让学生握冰袋一分钟后去扣衬衫、在手机上打字，再为冻僵、笨拙的手指重新设计一个 App 界面；变体：戴上不同厚度的手套，画出错误率变化曲线。

video.video_title: DexteriSync: A Hand Thermal I/O Exoskeleton for Morphing Finger Dexterity Experience

works.title: Dialogue with Great Souls
works.description: A street exhibition on Daxue Road, Shanghai with Soul App: scan a code, place an AR 'Anywhere Door' anywhere and step through into a scene to converse with eight historical sages.
works.idea_zh: 在街头放下一扇AR任意门，穿过去与古代先贤对话。

video.video_title: SOUL APP Dialogue with Great Souls

works.technique: A phone AR portal with stencil masking hides the inner scene until the user walks through the door plane, anchored at user-chosen positions along the street.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机AR做一扇任意门，门后是你选的一位历史人物的场景和一段语音，穿门才能听到；变化：门只能放在校园里与该人物有关的地点。
works.description_zh: 与 Soul App 合作、在上海大学路举办的一场街头展览：扫码后，可以在任意位置放下一扇 AR“任意门”，穿门而入，与八位历史先贤对话。
works.idea_en: Set down an AR 'Anywhere Door' on the street and walk through it to talk with ancient sages.
works.technique_zh: 手机 AR 传送门采用模板遮罩，在用户穿过门所在平面之前隐藏门内场景，门可以锚定在街道上用户自选的位置。
works.exercise_en: Build an Anywhere Door with phone AR that hides a scene of a historical figure of your choice and a voice clip you can only hear after walking through. Twist: the door can only be placed at campus locations connected to that figure.

works.title: Dynamicland intro
works.description: An introduction to the current Dynamicland: communal, physical computing where every program is a visible, touchable object in the room.
works.idea_zh: 每一个程序都是房间里看得见摸得着的实物。

video.video_title: Dynamicland intro, Aug 2024

works.technique: A room-scale projector-camera system recognizes printed objects and runs Realtalk programs that are physically embodied on paper, making code, data and output co-located and visible to everyone in the space.
works.exercise_zh: 用一台投影仪和摄像头把教室墙面变成“公共程序墙”：任何人把带标记的纸贴上去就能改变墙上的共享动画；变体：规定所有状态都必须可见，禁止使用任何隐藏的屏幕或键盘。
works.description_zh: 对当下 Dynamicland 的介绍：一种共享的、实体化的计算方式，每一个程序都是房间里看得见、摸得着的物件。
works.idea_en: Every program is a physical object in the room that you can see and touch.
works.technique_zh: 房间尺度的投影仪-相机系统识别打印出来的物件，运行以纸张为实体载体的 Realtalk 程序，使代码、数据和输出处于同一位置，空间中的每个人都能看到。
works.exercise_en: Use a projector and a camera to turn a classroom wall into a 'public program wall', where anyone can change a shared animation by sticking a marked sheet of paper on it. Twist: require all state to be visible, and ban any hidden screen or keyboard.

works.title: EchoVision
works.description: A handheld mixed-reality mask that lets people experience bat echolocation: your voice triggers LiDAR-based 'echoes' that briefly reveal the surrounding space as a visualized sound wave.
works.idea_zh: 用声音触发LiDAR回声可视化，像蝙蝠一样'听见'空间。

video.video_title: EchoVision  A Handheld Mixed Reality Mask for Experiencing Bat Echolocation

works.technique: Microphone amplitude triggers a pulse, and a shader reveals the LiDAR scene mesh as an expanding spherical wavefront from the user that fades out, mimicking echolocation.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 网格重建和一个按距离扩散的 Shader，在检测到声音时让房间网格像声波一样短暂亮起；变体：声音越高，波速越快。
works.description_zh: 一个手持式混合现实面罩，让人亲身体验蝙蝠的回声定位：你的声音会触发基于 LiDAR 的“回声”，以可视化声波的形式短暂照亮周围的空间。
works.idea_en: Your voice triggers LiDAR echo visuals, so you 'hear' space the way a bat does.
works.technique_zh: 麦克风音量触发一次脉冲，着色器以用户为中心，让 LiDAR 场景网格随着一道不断扩张、逐渐淡去的球形波前显现出来，模拟回声定位。
works.exercise_en: Use AR Foundation mesh reconstruction and a distance-based spreading shader so that the room mesh briefly lights up like a sound wave whenever a sound is detected. Twist: the higher the pitch, the faster the wave travels.

works.title: EgoTouch
works.description: Uses the cameras already on AR/VR headsets to detect touches on your own skin, turning palm and forearm into buttons and sliders without extra hardware.
works.idea_zh: 只用头显自带摄像头，就能把手臂皮肤变成触控按钮。

video.video_title: EgoTouch: On-Body Touch Input Using AR/VR Headset Cameras (ACM UIST 2024)

works.technique: A CNN trained on headset camera images infers from the skin's appearance and shading whether a finger is touching the palm or forearm and where, without additional sensors.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机摄像头拍手掌，用 Teachable Machine 训练“触摸/悬停”两类图像，并结合 MediaPipe 指尖位置把手掌分成 4 个按钮；变体：用手掌上的按钮控制 HoloKit 或网页中的一个小游戏。
works.description_zh: 利用 AR/VR 头显上现有的摄像头检测你对自己皮肤的触摸，无需额外硬件，就能把手掌和前臂变成按钮和滑块。
works.idea_en: Using only a headset's built-in cameras, the skin on your arm becomes a set of touch buttons.
works.technique_zh: 一个基于头显相机图像训练的卷积神经网络（CNN）根据皮肤的外观和明暗推断手指是否触碰到手掌或前臂，以及触碰位置，不需要额外的传感器。
works.exercise_en: Photograph your palm with a phone camera, train two image classes ('touch' and 'hover') in Teachable Machine, and combine them with MediaPipe fingertip positions to divide the palm into four buttons. Twist: use the buttons on your palm to control a small game in HoloKit or on a web page.

works.title: Encounter Dinosaurs
works.description: On Vision Pro a portal opens in your wall; a butterfly lands on your outstretched finger and dinosaurs step toward you, reacting when you move or reach out.
works.idea_zh: 墙上开出一扇门，恐龙探头出来和你互动，蝴蝶停在你的指尖。

video.video_title: Apple Vision Pro App Review: 'Encounter Dinosaurs'

works.technique: Renders a portal into a full environment anchored to a wall and drives creature behaviours from the user's head and hand positions.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机AR在墙上放一个门户，里面的角色会随手机靠近而后退或前进；变化：伸出手（手部检测）时让一只虚拟蝴蝶停在手上。
works.description_zh: 在 Vision Pro 上，你的墙上打开了一扇传送门：一只蝴蝶落在你伸出的指尖上，恐龙朝你走来，并会对你的移动或伸手作出反应。
works.idea_en: A door opens in the wall, dinosaurs lean out to interact with you, and a butterfly lands on your fingertip.
works.technique_zh: 渲染一个锚定在墙上、通向完整环境的传送门，并根据用户头部和手部的位置驱动生物的行为。
works.exercise_en: Place a portal on a wall with phone AR so the character inside backs away or steps forward as the phone gets closer. Twist: when you hold out your hand (detected by hand tracking), have a virtual butterfly land on it.

works.title: Eternal rat prism AR pet
works.description: An internet meme, the spinning rat in a prism, becomes a Snapchat AR pet that follows you around wherever you go.
works.idea_zh: 把网络梗'旋转老鼠棱镜'变成一直跟着你走的 AR 宠物。

video.video_title: I brought the eternal rat prism to life as an AR pet that follows you around forever and ever and you can try it now on Snapchat! https://t.co/xfx3iiG4o7

works.technique: The pet is re-positioned each frame to trail the camera with smoothing so it appears to follow the user around.
works.exercise_zh: 把一个班级梗做成跟着你走的 AR 宠物（Lens Studio/Reality Composer）；加一个变化：你停下太久它会睡着。
works.description_zh: 一个网络梗——在棱镜里旋转的老鼠——被做成 Snapchat 上的 AR 宠物，你走到哪儿它就跟到哪儿。
works.idea_en: Turn the 'spinning rat in a prism' meme into an AR pet that follows you everywhere.
works.technique_zh: 每一帧都对宠物的位置进行平滑重定位，使它跟在相机后面，看起来就像一直跟着用户。
works.exercise_en: Turn a class in-joke into an AR pet that follows you around (Lens Studio or Reality Composer). Twist: if you stop for too long, it falls asleep.

works.title: EyeShadows
works.description: Glance at an object and a 'shadow' copy of it appears in the periphery; looking at the copy selects it or opens its settings, making eye-only interaction fast and less error-prone.
works.description_zh: 瞥一眼某个物体，它的“影子”副本就出现在视野边缘；再看向副本即可选中它或打开设置，让纯眼动交互又快又不易出错。
works.idea_en: Pull a copy of what you looked at into your periphery so selecting by eye is easy.
works.idea_zh: 把你看过的东西复制到视野边缘，让用眼睛选择变得轻松。
works.technique: Spawns peripheral virtual copies of gazed objects and uses a gaze transition onto the copy as a confirm action, avoiding accidental 'Midas touch' selections.
works.technique_zh: 为被注视的物体在周边视野生成虚拟副本，把视线移到副本上作为确认动作，避免误选的“点石成金”问题。
works.exercise_en: Using phone face or eye tracking in a web AR demo, show a small copy of a gazed icon in a screen corner and select it by looking there for half a second. Twist: let the copy offer three options placed in different corners.
works.exercise_zh: 在网页 AR 演示中借助手机的人脸或眼动追踪，把被注视的图标在屏幕角落显示一个小副本，注视那里半秒即可选中；变体：让副本在不同角落给出三个选项。

video.video_title: Eye Tracking for Easy Selection in AR and VR: EyeShadows

works.title: Figmin XR: Create, Collect & Play
works.description: The app's trailer: users sketch, import 3D models, animate and play physics-driven creations that bounce off the real room in mixed reality.
works.idea_zh: 在混合现实里创作、收藏并玩你的3D作品。

video.video_title: Figmin XR Trailer - Available NOW

works.technique: Integrates sketching, model import, animation and a physics engine that uses the room mesh as colliders.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机AR导入同学各自扫描的小物件模型，在桌上组成一个“混合现实收藏馆”并让它们受物理影响掉落；变化：每件作品配一段语音介绍。
works.description_zh: 这款应用的预告片：用户可以绘制草图、导入 3D 模型、制作动画，并在混合现实中把受物理驱动的作品玩起来，让它们在真实房间里弹来弹去。
works.idea_en: Create, collect and play with your 3D works in mixed reality.
works.technique_zh: 整合了草图绘制、模型导入、动画制作，以及一个把房间网格用作碰撞体的物理引擎。
works.exercise_en: Import small object models that classmates each scanned into phone AR, arrange them on a table as a 'mixed-reality collection', and let them fall under physics. Twist: give each piece a short voice introduction.

works.title: FungiSync
works.description: A mixed-reality participatory ritual: participants wear mushroom-decorated MR masks and exchange 'worldviews' through secret handshakes, blending each other's visual filters like a mycorrhizal network.
works.idea_zh: 戴上蘑菇面具，用握手交换彼此眼中的世界。

video.video_title: Fungi sync

works.technique: Likely co-located phone-based MR headsets share an anchor and detect handshake gestures to swap and mix each participant's visual shader.
works.exercise_zh: 让每组同学各做一个手机AR滤镜代表自己的“世界观”，两人击掌（靠近检测或扫码）后交换滤镜；变化：三人以上相遇时滤镜混合。
works.description_zh: 一场混合现实参与式仪式：参与者戴上饰有蘑菇的混合现实面具，通过秘密握手交换彼此的“世界观”，像菌根网络一样融合彼此的视觉滤镜。
works.idea_en: Put on a mushroom mask and trade the way you see the world through a handshake.
works.technique_zh: 可能是多台同处一地、基于手机的混合现实头显共享同一个锚点，并检测握手手势，从而交换和混合每位参与者的视觉着色器。
works.exercise_en: Have each group of classmates make a phone AR filter that represents their own 'worldview', and swap filters when two people high-five (detected by proximity or a QR scan). Twist: when three or more people meet, their filters blend.

works.title: Hand-frame photos left in space
works.description: At a Snap AR hackathon his team built a way to take a photo by framing a scene with your fingers and leave that photo floating in place for others to find.
works.idea_zh: 用手指比个取景框拍照，照片就留在原地等别人发现。

video.video_title: For the snap AR hackathon my team developed a new way to take photos with your hands and leave them in space for others to find! https://t.co/CnUYLoG8lV

works.technique: Hand tracking detects a two-hand frame gesture to crop the camera view, and the image is saved as a persistent anchored object (likely via cloud anchors).
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe 手势识别'双手取景框'来截取摄像头画面；加一个变化：照片被挂在拍摄位置的地图上供全班寻宝。
works.description_zh: 在一次 Snap AR 黑客松上，他的团队做出了一种拍照方式：用手指框出取景画面拍下照片，照片就留在原地漂浮，等着别人发现。
works.idea_en: Frame a shot with your fingers to take a photo, and the photo stays where it was taken for others to find.
works.technique_zh: 手部追踪识别双手比出的取景框手势，据此裁剪相机画面，并把图像保存为一个持久锚定的物体（可能借助云锚点）。
works.exercise_en: Use MediaPipe gesture recognition to detect a two-hand viewfinder and crop the camera image. Twist: pin each photo to a map at the spot where it was taken, for a class-wide treasure hunt.

works.title: Head-tracked Subtitles
works.description: Everything people around you say appears as live subtitles in a video see-through headset, following your head so conversation stays readable in noise or for hard-of-hearing users.
works.description_zh: 周围人说的话都以实时字幕出现在视频透视头显里，并随头部移动，让人在嘈杂环境或听力不佳时也能看懂对话。
works.idea_en: Caption the real world the way films are captioned.
works.idea_zh: 像给电影配字幕一样，给真实世界配字幕。
works.technique: Transcribes speech locally with Vosk, tidies it with the Llama 3 language model, and renders the text in Unity on a modified video see-through HTC Vive Pro.
works.technique_zh: 用 Vosk 在本地做语音转写，用 Llama 3 语言模型整理文本，再在 Unity 中渲染到改装为视频透视的 HTC Vive Pro 上。
works.exercise_en: Use a phone's live-caption or speech API in a web AR page to float captions under a detected face, then test it in a noisy hallway. Twist: colour each speaker differently and add live translation.
works.exercise_zh: 在网页 AR 页面中调用手机的实时字幕或语音识别接口，把字幕悬浮在识别到的人脸下方，然后到嘈杂的走廊测试；变体：用不同颜色区分说话人，并加上实时翻译。

video.video_title: Head-tracked Subtitles Using Augmented Reality

works.title: Hello, Dot
works.description: A mixed-reality Peridot experience for Meta Quest 3 in which a Dot hatches in your room, recognises furniture and plays with you through passthrough.
works.idea_zh: 在头显的透视画面中，AR宠物在你房间里孵化并认识你的家具。

video.video_title: Hello, Dot – A Mixed Reality Peridot Experience from Niantic

works.technique: Passthrough plus scene understanding labels furniture in the room, and the pet uses those labels as navigation targets and interaction affordances.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中检测桌面和地面两个层级，让宠物学会从地面跳上桌子找你；变体：你把手机放下不动时，宠物会在桌上睡着。
works.description_zh: 一款为 Meta Quest 3 打造的 Peridot 混合现实体验：一只 Dot 在你的房间里孵化，认识你的家具，并通过透视画面和你一起玩。
works.idea_en: In a headset's passthrough view, an AR pet hatches in your room and learns your furniture.
works.technique_zh: 透视画面加上场景理解为房间中的家具打上标签，宠物把这些标签作为导航目标和可交互的对象。
works.exercise_en: Detect two levels in AR, the tabletop and the floor, and teach a pet to jump from the floor onto the table to find you. Twist: when you set the phone down and leave it still, the pet falls asleep on the table.

works.title: Hybrid XRSpectator
works.description: At home, a fan watches a miniature stadium on the coffee table in AR, then dives into a surrounding 360 view of the real stadium with integrated stats and replays.
works.description_zh: 在家里，球迷先在茶几上用 AR 看一个微缩体育场，然后“潜入”环绕式的真实体育场 360 度画面，里面整合了数据和回放。
works.idea_en: Zoom between a toy-sized stadium on your table and being inside the crowd.
works.idea_zh: 在桌上玩具大小的体育场和置身人群之间自由缩放。
works.technique: Combines a tabletop AR stadium model with a transition into an indirect AR mode built on 360 video of the match.
works.technique_zh: 把桌面 AR 体育场模型与基于比赛 360 度视频的间接 AR 模式结合起来，并在两者之间过渡。
works.exercise_en: Build a tabletop AR mini-arena from a paper model and add a button that switches to a 360 photo taken from inside the real venue. Twist: let a tap on a tiny player open that player's first-person view.
works.exercise_zh: 用纸模型做一个桌面 AR 小场馆，再加一个按钮切换到在真实场馆内拍的 360 度照片；变体：点击一个小球员就进入他的第一人称视角。

video.video_title: Hybrid XRSpectator: A Hybrid Tabletop XR Sports Spectating Experience

works.title: Hydrogen Wave
works.description: An interactive space at Hyundai Motorstudio Senayan Park, Jakarta, where visitors' movements send waves through a large projected field of animated particles themed on hydrogen energy.
works.idea_zh: 用身体推动'氢能'粒子之浪

video.video_title: Hydrogen Wave – interactive space, Hyundai Motorstudio Senayan Park, Jakarta

works.technique: Depth cameras track visitors' positions and velocities, which inject forces into a GPU particle simulation projected across the floor and walls.
works.exercise_zh: 在 TouchDesigner 里用 Kinect 或摄像头光流驱动投影粒子场，让人的移动推出波纹；变体：把粒子换成代表一种你关心的看不见的物质（空气污染、Wi-Fi 信号）。
works.description_zh: 雅加达 Hyundai Motorstudio Senayan Park 中的一个互动空间：观众的动作会在一片以氢能为主题、大面积投影的粒子动画中掀起波浪。
works.idea_en: Push waves of 'hydrogen' particles with your body.
works.technique_zh: 深度相机追踪观众的位置和速度，并把它们作为力注入投影在地面和墙面上的 GPU 粒子模拟中。
works.exercise_en: Drive a projected particle field in TouchDesigner with a Kinect or camera optical flow, so people's movement pushes out ripples. Twist: make the particles stand for an invisible substance you care about (air pollution, Wi-Fi signals).

works.title: Immersive Memory (AlUla)
works.description: An interactive installation across three spaces in AlUla's Old Town, a UNESCO site of the incense trade, responds to visitors with visuals and a spatial audio score.
works.idea_zh: 在古城遗址里，观众的身体动作唤起香料之路的记忆影像与空间声音。

video.video_title:
I’m excited to share Immersive Memory, an interactive experience set in AlUla’s Old Town, a UNESCO World Heritage site with a rich history in incense trade.

This installation spans three distinct spa

works.technique: Camera-based body tracking drives projected generative visuals in each room, tied together by a multichannel spatial audio score (likely MediaPipe/depth tracking).
works.exercise_zh: 为校园一处老建筑做'记忆投影'：人靠近墙面时投影出老照片的粒子；加一个变化：多人同时靠近才能看清完整照片。
works.description_zh: 一件横跨 AlUla 古城三个空间的互动装置——这里是香料贸易之路上的联合国教科文组织世界遗产地——它以影像和空间音频配乐回应观众。
works.idea_en: Among the ruins of an old town, visitors' movements call up images and spatial sound from the memory of the incense route.
works.technique_zh: 每个房间中，基于摄像头的身体追踪驱动投影的生成式影像，再由多声道空间音频配乐将各个空间串联起来（可能使用 MediaPipe 或深度追踪）。
works.exercise_en: Make a 'memory projection' for an old building on campus, where old photos appear as particles when someone approaches the wall. Twist: the full photo only becomes clear when several people approach at once.

works.title: Laser Dance
works.description: A Quest 3 mixed-reality game that scans your living room and strings laser beams between your real walls and furniture; you dance, dodge and crawl through the beams to reach buttons.
works.idea_zh: 把自家客厅的真实墙面和家具变成激光迷阵，用全身躲避穿越。

video.video_title: Laser Dance - Early Access Trailer

works.technique: The Scene API supplies labeled room geometry (walls, floor, furniture boxes), and laser segments are generated between sampled points on those surfaces, with body collision checked against the headset and hand poses.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 平面检测拿到墙面和地面，在两面墙之间随机生成几条激光线，手机碰到激光就震动失败；变体：让激光随音乐节拍移动。
works.description_zh: 一款 Quest 3 混合现实游戏：它扫描你的客厅，在真实的墙壁和家具之间拉起激光束；你要跳舞、闪躲、匍匐穿过激光，去按下按钮。
works.idea_en: Turn the real walls and furniture of your living room into a laser maze you dodge through with your whole body.
works.technique_zh: Scene API 提供带标签的房间几何信息（墙面、地面、家具包围盒），激光线段在这些表面的采样点之间生成，并根据头显和手部位姿检测身体碰撞。
works.exercise_en: Get wall and floor planes with AR Foundation plane detection, generate a few random laser lines between two walls, and make the phone vibrate and fail when it touches a laser. Twist: make the lasers move to the beat of the music.

works.title: Lasertag: light VFX test
works.description: A test of laser shots that light up the real room: virtual beams cast light onto scanned walls and furniture in passthrough.
works.idea_zh: 虚拟激光照亮真实房间墙面的光效测试。

video.video_title: Meta Quest Lasertag - Light VFX test

works.technique: Virtual dynamic lights attached to laser beams illuminate an invisible scanned-room mesh with a shadow-receiving or additive-lighting material, so light appears to fall on real surfaces in passthrough.
works.exercise_zh: 在扫描得到的房间网格上用一个透明但能接收光照的材质，让虚拟手电筒在真实墙面上投出光斑；变体：光斑颜色随你说话的音量变化。
works.description_zh: 一次激光射击照亮真实房间的测试：在透视画面中，虚拟光束把光投在扫描出的墙壁和家具上。
works.idea_en: A lighting test in which virtual lasers light up the real walls of a room.
works.technique_zh: 附着在激光束上的虚拟动态光源照亮一个不可见的扫描房间网格，该网格使用可接收阴影或叠加光照的材质，从而在透视画面中呈现光线落在真实表面上的效果。
works.exercise_en: Give the scanned room mesh a transparent material that still receives light, so a virtual flashlight casts a spot of light on real walls. Twist: change the color of the light spot with the volume of your voice.

works.title: Live Blender preview on Vision Pro
works.description: A Blender scene streams live into Apple Vision Pro; edits made on the desktop appear instantly as a full-size object lit by your real room.
works.idea_zh: 在Blender里改模型，Vision Pro里即时出现被真实环境照亮的实物大小预览。

video.video_title:
Can't believe I got this working 🤯

Live preview of a Blender scene with the Vision Pro. https://t.co/F7DC9hj4fk

works.technique: Blender exports the scene (for example as USDZ) on each change and streams it to the headset, where RealityKit reloads the model and lights it with the room's environment probe.
works.exercise_zh: 写一个脚本，每次在 Blender 保存时导出 glTF，手机 WebAR 页面自动重新加载该模型；变体：让模型在 AR 中出现时带一段“生长”动画。
works.description_zh: Blender 场景实时串流到 Apple Vision Pro 中；在桌面电脑上做的修改会立刻呈现为一个被你真实房间光线照亮的等大物体。
works.idea_en: Edit a model in Blender and a life-size preview, lit by your real surroundings, appears instantly in Vision Pro.
works.technique_zh: Blender 在每次修改时导出场景（例如导出为 USDZ）并串流到头显，由 RealityKit 重新加载模型，并用房间的环境光探针为其照明。
works.exercise_en: Write a script that exports glTF every time you save in Blender, and have a phone WebAR page reload the model automatically. Twist: play a 'growing' animation when the model appears in AR.

works.title: Look Up - Augmented Reality Architecture
works.description: AR experiments that attach digital sculptures and animated beings to building facades, inviting people to look up at architecture.
works.idea_zh: 在建筑立面上长出AR雕塑，邀请人们抬头看城市

video.video_title: Look Up - Augmented Reality Architecture

works.technique: Likely geospatial or VPS anchoring (or image tracking of the facade) places animated sculptures on building faces, with scale set so they read correctly from street level.
works.exercise_zh: 选一栋校园建筑，用 8th Wall 图像追踪或 ARCore Geospatial 在立面上放一个会动的雕塑；变体：让雕塑只在抬头角度超过 45 度时出现，逼观众真的“抬头看”。
works.description_zh: 一系列 AR 实验：把数字雕塑和会动的生命体附着在建筑立面上，邀请人们抬头看看建筑。
works.idea_en: AR sculptures sprout from building facades and invite people to look up at the city.
works.technique_zh: 可能借助地理空间锚定或 VPS 锚定（或对立面进行图像追踪），把动画雕塑放在建筑立面上，并设定合适的尺度，使其从街面上看起来比例正确。
works.exercise_en: Pick a campus building and place a moving sculpture on its facade with 8th Wall image tracking or ARCore Geospatial. Twist: make the sculpture appear only when the viewing angle tilts up past 45 degrees, forcing viewers to actually look up.

works.title: Loóna: Cozy Puzzle Games (Apple Vision Pro)
works.description: Floating 3D dioramas hover in the player's room; pinching and placing their pieces with the hands completes each little world, which then comes alive with sound and a friendly AI creature called Lumo.
works.description_zh: 立体小场景漂浮在玩家的房间里；用手捏取并放置零件拼好每个小世界后，它便伴随声音活起来，还有一只名叫 Lumo 的友善 AI 小生物陪伴。
works.idea_en: Puzzle solving as a calm ritual that rewards you by animating the finished world.
works.idea_zh: 把解谜变成一种安静的仪式，完成后整个小世界动起来作为奖励。
works.technique: visionOS gaze-and-pinch plus direct hand manipulation snap pieces into RealityKit scenes, with spatial audio layered as each part locks in.
works.technique_zh: 用 visionOS 的注视加捏合以及直接手部操作，把零件吸附进 RealityKit 场景，每拼好一块就叠加一层空间音频。
works.exercise_en: Build a five-piece 3D jigsaw that floats at chest height; each correctly placed piece adds one audio loop and one animation. Twist: hide one piece somewhere in the real room so the player must look around to find it.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个由五块零件组成、漂浮在胸口高度的 3D 拼图；每放对一块就加入一段循环音效和一段动画。变体：把其中一块藏在真实房间的某处，玩家必须四处寻找。

video.video_title: Introducing Loóna Puzzle Game for Apple Vision Pro

works.title: MELODIX•R
works.description: An XR design-fiction prototype on Quest 3 imagining a mixed-reality music experience placed in your real room.
works.idea_zh: 设计虚构：放在真实房间里的混合现实音乐体验。

video.video_title: MELODIX•R  - Quest3 - XR Design fiction prototype

works.technique: Hand-tracked gestures likely act on room-anchored musical objects, so reaching, pinching and placing notes in space shapes the music.
works.exercise_zh: 在房间里放几个会发声的 AR 小球，用手势抓起并放到不同高度来改变音高；变体：把小球放在真实家具上时改变音色。
works.description_zh: 一个在 Quest 3 上实现的 XR 设计虚构原型，设想了一种放置在你真实房间中的混合现实音乐体验。
works.idea_en: Design fiction: a mixed-reality music experience set in your real room.
works.technique_zh: 手部追踪的手势可能作用于锚定在房间中的音乐物件，于是伸手、捏合以及在空间中摆放音符都会塑造音乐。
works.exercise_en: Place a few sound-making AR balls in the room and grab them with hand gestures, moving them to different heights to change their pitch. Twist: change the timbre when a ball is placed on real furniture.

works.title: MOFA: The Ghost
works.description: An asymmetric social exertion game in spontaneous co-located MR: an invisible ghost player hunts others who can only see it through their devices, played in public spaces.
works.idea_zh: 非对称捉鬼游戏：只有通过设备才能看见的'鬼'在公共空间里追逐玩家。

video.video_title: MOFA The Ghost: Demonstrating an Asymmetrical Social Exertion Game in Spontaneous Collocated Mixe...

works.technique: All players share a colocalized coordinate frame, and the ghost's tracked pose is rendered only on the hunters' devices, creating asymmetric visibility in the same physical space.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个两人非对称游戏：一个人的位置只能通过另一个人的手机 AR 看到；变体：“隐形者”每隔一段时间会短暂现身并发出声音。
works.description_zh: 一款在即兴、同处一地的混合现实中进行的非对称社交运动游戏：一名隐形的“鬼”玩家在公共空间里追捕其他人，而其他人只能通过设备看到它。
works.idea_en: An asymmetric ghost-hunting game: a 'ghost' visible only through devices chases players across a public space.
works.technique_zh: 所有玩家共享一个共同定位的坐标系，“鬼”的追踪位姿只在猎人的设备上渲染，从而在同一物理空间中形成不对称的可见性。
works.exercise_en: Make a two-player asymmetric game in which one person's position can only be seen through the other person's phone AR. Twist: every so often the 'invisible' player briefly appears and makes a sound.

works.title: MediaPipe TouchDesigner: Face-tracked Texture
works.description: A demo of the MediaPipe plugin for TouchDesigner that pins a 2D image onto a moving face in the webcam feed, following head rotation and position in real time.
works.description_zh: TouchDesigner MediaPipe 插件的演示：把一张 2D 图像钉在摄像头画面中移动的人脸上，实时跟随头部的转动和位置。
works.idea_en: Build your own face filter engine inside a visual programming tool instead of an app.
works.idea_zh: 不用滤镜 App，在可视化编程工具里自己搭一个脸部滤镜引擎。
works.technique: MediaPipe Face Landmarker runs on the GPU inside TouchDesigner and outputs a transformation matrix that drives a textured SOP aligned to the face.
works.technique_zh: MediaPipe Face Landmarker 在 TouchDesigner 中以 GPU 运行，输出变换矩阵，驱动一个贴图 SOP 与人脸对齐。
works.exercise_en: Use the free MediaPipe TouchDesigner plugin to attach a hand-drawn mask to your face and project the result on a wall. Twist: the mask changes drawing when you tilt your head.
works.exercise_zh: 用免费的 TouchDesigner MediaPipe 插件把一张手绘面具贴到脸上，并把结果投影到墙上；变体：歪头时面具会换成另一幅画。

video.video_title: MediaPipe TouchDesigner Transformation matrix example

works.title: Metafold 05, AR-activated digital print
works.description: A printed artwork from his Metafold series springs into an animated 3D sculpture when viewed through a phone, extending the static print into motion.
works.idea_zh: 一张静态版画，用手机一扫就长出会动的 3D 雕塑。

video.video_title: Metafold 05, AR activated Digital Print #bmw #bmw7series #i7 #ar #augmentedreality #digitalart

works.technique: Image-target tracking recognizes the print and overlays a registered animated 3D version on top of it (likely via an image-marker AR app).
works.exercise_zh: 把自己的一幅画当成图像识别标记（Artivive/Adobe Aero/8th Wall 都可），让画里的东西飞出来；加一个变化：从侧面看时显示画的'背面世界'。
works.description_zh: 他 Metafold 系列中的一幅版画作品，用手机观看时会跃然变成一座动态的 3D 雕塑，把静态的版画延伸为运动。
works.idea_en: Scan a static print with a phone and a moving 3D sculpture grows out of it.
works.technique_zh: 通过图像目标追踪识别版画，并在其上叠加一个对齐的动态 3D 版本（可能借助基于图像标记的 AR 应用）。
works.exercise_en: Use one of your own drawings as an image-recognition marker (Artivive, Adobe Aero or 8th Wall all work) and make things fly out of the picture. Twist: when viewed from the side, show the 'world behind' the picture.

works.title: Metavido VFX (WebGPU)
works.description: Volumetric clips captured with an iPhone Pro play back in a web browser, where the recorded person and space are re-rendered as particles and effects in 3D.
works.idea_zh: 把手机拍的'带深度的视频'放进网页，任何人都能在浏览器里围着它看特效。

video.video_title: I published a WebGPU build of the Metavido VFX sample (iPhone Lidar capture) https://t.co/GPVKZc6lZI https://t.co/IpBsQPUR7C

works.technique: Metavido stores LiDAR depth and camera metadata inside a standard video stream, which a Unity WebGPU build decodes to reconstruct points for VFX in the browser.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Record3D 或手机深度视频导入 three.js，在网页里把一段舞蹈重建成点云；加一个变化：观众点击后切换成'沙子'材质坍塌。
works.description_zh: 用 iPhone Pro 拍摄的体积视频片段在网页浏览器中播放，被记录下来的人和空间以粒子和特效的形式在 3D 中重新渲染。
works.idea_en: Put a phone video with depth onto a web page, so anyone can walk around its effects in a browser.
works.technique_zh: Metavido 把 LiDAR 深度和相机元数据存储在标准视频流中，Unity 的 WebGPU 构建版本对其解码，在浏览器中重建点云用于视觉特效。
works.exercise_en: Import a Record3D or phone depth video into three.js and rebuild a dance clip as a point cloud on a web page. Twist: when a viewer clicks, switch to a 'sand' material that collapses.

works.title: Mistral-OUI: contextual AR UI
works.description: On Magic Leap 2, a vision model recognizes what the wearer is looking at and a language model generates a custom interface for that context, shown floating in view.
works.idea_zh: 看到什么，AI 就当场为你生成对应的界面。

video.video_title: Augmented Reality Contextual UI (Mistral-OUI)

works.technique: Camera frames are captioned by a vision-language model, and an LLM turns the description into HTML UI rendered as a panel in the headset.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机拍一张照片，让多模态大模型识别物体并生成一个'AR 便签' UI（网页 AR 显示）；加一个变化：UI 的风格随物体情绪改变。
works.description_zh: 在 Magic Leap 2 上，视觉模型识别出佩戴者正在看的东西，语言模型再为这一情境生成定制的界面，漂浮显示在视野中。
works.idea_en: Whatever you look at, AI generates a matching interface for it on the spot.
works.technique_zh: 视觉语言模型为相机画面生成描述，再由大语言模型把描述转换为 HTML 界面，以面板形式渲染在头显中。
works.exercise_en: Take a photo with a phone and have a multimodal LLM identify the object and generate an 'AR sticky note' UI (shown in web AR). Twist: change the UI's style to match the object's mood.

works.title: Mixed Reality vs. Reality
works.description: Side-by-side POV captures compare playing ping-pong in Quest 3 passthrough mixed reality and with Ray-Ban Meta glasses in plain reality, noting how occlusion and gravity feel different.
works.idea_zh: 把同一个动作分别在混合现实和真实世界里做，对比两者的'物理感'。

video.video_title: Mixed Reality vs. Reality #metaquest3 #raybanmeta

works.technique: Quest 3 passthrough MR with scene understanding simulates the ball, while the glasses record the real throw for a direct comparison of occlusion and physics.
works.exercise_zh: 让同学同一动作（扔纸团进篮筐）在 AR 版本和真实版本里各做一次并并排剪辑；加一个变化：AR 版本里故意改变重力，让观众找不同。
works.description_zh: 并排的第一人称视角录像，对比在 Quest 3 透视混合现实中打乒乓球和戴着 Ray-Ban Meta 眼镜在真实世界中打乒乓球，指出遮挡和重力的感受有何不同。
works.idea_en: Do the same action once in mixed reality and once in the real world, and compare how 'physical' each feels.
works.technique_zh: 带场景理解的 Quest 3 透视混合现实负责模拟乒乓球，眼镜则记录真实的击球，从而直接对比遮挡和物理效果。
works.exercise_en: Have a classmate do the same action (tossing a paper ball into a basket) once in an AR version and once for real, then edit the two side by side. Twist: secretly change the gravity in the AR version and have viewers spot the difference.

works.title: Niantic Studio spatial anchoring
works.description: Developer workflow and demos for placing AR at real-world locations with VPS, including physics-driven content anchored to places.
works.idea_zh: 在编辑器里选一个真实地点，把 AR 内容精确钉上去。
works.technique: VPS-localized anchors give a stable real-world pose, and a physics engine simulates content relative to that anchor, so rigid bodies collide with approximated real geometry at a specific place.
works.exercise_zh: 在一个固定地点用图像标记定位，放置会滚下台阶的物理小球，并用简单碰撞体近似台阶；变体：让路过的人可以用手机“推”小球。
works.description_zh: 借助 VPS 把 AR 放置在真实世界地点的开发者工作流程和演示，其中包括锚定在具体地点、受物理驱动的内容。
works.idea_en: Pick a real place in the editor and pin AR content to it precisely.
works.technique_zh: 经 VPS 定位的锚点提供稳定的真实世界位姿，物理引擎则相对于该锚点模拟内容，使刚体在特定地点与近似的真实几何体发生碰撞。
works.exercise_en: Localize at a fixed spot with an image marker, place physics balls that roll down a set of steps, and approximate the steps with simple colliders. Twist: let passers-by 'push' the balls with their phones.

works.title: Nocturnal Fugue (with Matt McCorkle & Botao Hu)
works.description: A multisensory night journey beginning under Austin's Congress Bat Bridge, combining bat stories, sound and the EchoVision mixed-reality headsets to experience the bats' world.
works.idea_zh: 在蝙蝠桥下的夜晚，用声音与MR头显体验蝙蝠的感知世界
works.technique: Location-based sound composition is combined with HoloKit-based EchoVision headsets that visualise the participant's voice as echoes in the dark.
works.exercise_zh: 设计一条夜间校园“声音散步”路线，在每站用手机播放动物声音并用AR显示声波；变化：参与者必须用自己的声音“回声定位”找到下一站。

video.video_title: Nocturnal Fugue + EchoVision at the Contemporary Austin

works.description_zh: 一段从奥斯汀国会大道蝙蝠桥下出发的多感官夜间旅程，结合蝙蝠的故事、声音和 EchoVision 混合现实头显，让人体验蝙蝠的世界。
works.idea_en: On a night under a bat bridge, use sound and MR headsets to experience how bats perceive the world.
works.technique_zh: 把基于位置的声音创作与基于 HoloKit 的 EchoVision 头显相结合，后者把参与者的声音在黑暗中可视化为回声。
works.exercise_en: Design a nighttime 'sound walk' route across campus that plays animal sounds on a phone at each stop and shows the sound waves in AR. Twist: participants must use their own voices to 'echolocate' the next stop.

works.title: Paris 1924
works.description: Marking 100 years since Paris last hosted the Olympics, fans in the city see the streets around them transform into 1924 Paris, while fans elsewhere are transported to the 1924 Yves-du-Manoir stadium.
works.description_zh: 为纪念巴黎上一次举办奥运会一百周年，身在巴黎的人能看到身边街道变回 1924 年的样子，其他地方的人则被“传送”到 1924 年的 Yves-du-Manoir 体育场。
works.idea_en: Time-travel the street you are standing on back exactly one hundred years.
works.idea_zh: 把你脚下这条街倒回整整一百年前。
works.technique: Two modes of one Lens: City/Landmarker tracking re-skins real Paris buildings on site, and a portal scene reconstructs the stadium for remote users.
works.technique_zh: 同一 Lens 有两种模式：现场用城市级地标追踪给真实巴黎建筑“换皮”，异地用户则通过传送门场景进入重建的体育场。
works.exercise_en: Find an old photo of a spot on campus and build an AR view that overlays the historical scene aligned to the present. Twist: add a portal for people who are not on site.
works.exercise_zh: 找一张校园某处的老照片，做一个 AR 视图，把历史画面与当下场景对齐叠加；变体：为不在现场的人加一个传送门入口。

video.video_title: Paris 1924 - Snapchat

works.title: Parking-lot kart race
works.description: A mixed-reality game turns any empty parking lot into a Mario Kart-style race track with virtual boosts and items, playable at Two Bit Circus.
works.idea_zh: 把任何停车场变成马里奥赛车跑道。

video.video_title: I made a game that turns any parking lot into a mario kart-style race track and you can play it at two bit circus! https://t.co/QrcLHuGDO3

works.technique: A track, item boxes and boost pads are generated to fit the detected open ground and anchored in world space for players moving through it.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR 在篮球场上画出一条虚拟跑道和加速带，让同学推着椅子比赛；加一个变化：撞到虚拟香蕉皮要原地转一圈。
works.description_zh: 一款混合现实游戏，把任何一片空旷的停车场变成马里奥赛车风格的赛道，配有虚拟加速和道具，可以在 Two Bit Circus 体验。
works.idea_en: Turn any parking lot into a Mario Kart track.
works.technique_zh: 根据检测到的空旷地面生成适配的赛道、道具箱和加速垫，并锚定在世界空间中，供玩家穿行其间。
works.exercise_en: Draw a virtual track and boost strips on a basketball court in AR and have classmates race while pushing chairs. Twist: anyone who hits a virtual banana peel must spin around once on the spot.

works.title: Peridot Beyond
works.description: Peridot on Snap Spectacles: several people wearing glasses see and play with the same Dots in shared multiplayer AR.
works.idea_zh: 戴上Spectacles，几个人一起在现实中照顾同一只AR宠物。

video.video_title: Peridot Beyond – Experience the Magic of Multiplayer AR from Niantic on Snap’s Spectacles

works.technique: Multiple glasses join a shared session with colocalized coordinates, so the same pet entity and its state are replicated to every wearer.
works.exercise_zh: 让两三台设备共享同一只 AR 宠物，谁先扔球宠物就去追谁的球；变体：宠物会记住最常陪它玩的人。
works.description_zh: Snap Spectacles 上的 Peridot：几个戴着眼镜的人可以在共享的多人 AR 中看到同一群 Dot，并和它们一起玩。
works.idea_en: Wearing Spectacles, several people look after the same AR pet together in the real world.
works.technique_zh: 多副眼镜加入一个坐标共同定位的共享会话，同一只宠物实体及其状态会同步到每位佩戴者。
works.exercise_en: Have two or three devices share one AR pet that chases the ball of whoever throws first. Twist: the pet remembers who plays with it most.

works.title: Project Revival
works.description: At the Egyptian Museum and the National Museum of Egyptian Civilization in Cairo, visitors scan a QR code next to an artefact, such as Thutmose IV's chariot, to see it restored to its original state in Instagram AR.
works.description_zh: 在开罗的埃及博物馆和埃及国家文明博物馆，观众扫描文物旁的二维码（例如图特摩斯四世的战车），就能在 Instagram AR 中看到文物恢复原貌。
works.idea_en: Stand in front of a broken artefact and see it whole again, exactly where it sits.
works.idea_zh: 站在残缺的文物前，就在它原地看到它完整的模样。
works.technique: Artefacts were LiDAR-scanned and photogrammetry-captured, manually restored in 3D with museum experts, then delivered as Instagram AR effects aligned to the objects.
works.technique_zh: 先用 LiDAR 扫描和摄影测量采集文物，在博物馆专家指导下手工进行 3D 修复，再以与文物对齐的 Instagram AR 特效形式发布。
works.exercise_en: Photograph a chipped mug or broken object from 30 angles, build a 3D model, repair it digitally, and overlay the repaired version on the real object. Twist: show the break happening in reverse as an animation.
works.exercise_zh: 从 30 个角度拍摄一只有缺口的杯子或破损物件，建出 3D 模型并做数字修复，再把修好的版本叠加到实物上；变体：用倒放动画展示“破碎复原”的过程。

video.video_title: Thutmose IV's Chariot

works.title: Prototype: Someone - a random mirror
works.description: A mirror prototype that reflects the viewer's pose but replaces them with a randomly generated other person.
works.idea_zh: 镜子里照出的永远是'别人'

video.video_title: Prototype : Someone - a random mirror

works.technique: Pose estimation extracts the viewer's skeleton, which drives a randomly generated human avatar (or a generative image model conditioned on pose) shown as the reflection.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe Pose 驱动一个从素材库中随机挑选的 3D 人物模型，做成“镜子”；变体：每次有人进入画面时换一个人物，并让人物外观与观众正好相反。
works.description_zh: 一个镜子原型：它映出观看者的姿态，但把观看者本人替换成一个随机生成的陌生人。
works.idea_en: The mirror always shows 'someone else'.
works.technique_zh: 姿态估计提取观看者的骨架，用它驱动一个随机生成的人物化身（或以姿态为条件的生成式图像模型），作为镜中的倒影显示。
works.exercise_en: Use MediaPipe Pose to drive a 3D human model picked at random from an asset library, and present it as a 'mirror'. Twist: switch to a new person each time someone enters the frame, and make that person look the exact opposite of the viewer.

works.title: Puzzling Places on Apple Vision Pro
works.description: The 3D jigsaw game redesigned for Vision Pro, with scanned places assembled in your room using eye-and-pinch input.
works.idea_zh: 在Vision Pro上用注视加捏合在房间里拼真实地点的立体拼图。

video.video_title: Puzzling Places on Apple Vision Pro - Announcement Trailer

works.technique: Photogrammetry models are pre-split into pieces, and eye-gaze targeting plus a pinch gesture selects and moves pieces, with snap detection when a piece is near its correct pose.
works.exercise_zh: 扫描一件真实物品并切成几块，在 AR 中用拖拽拼回原样，接近正确位置时自动吸附；变体：拼完后物品开始动起来讲述它的来历。
works.description_zh: 这款 3D 拼图游戏为 Vision Pro 重新设计，你可以用注视加捏合的方式，在自己的房间里拼合扫描得到的真实地点。
works.idea_en: On Vision Pro, use gaze and pinch to assemble 3D puzzles of real places in your room.
works.technique_zh: 摄影测量模型被预先切分成碎片，通过视线瞄准加捏合手势来选取和移动碎片，当碎片接近正确位姿时触发吸附检测。
works.exercise_en: Scan a real object, cut it into a few pieces, and drag them back together in AR, snapping each piece into place when it gets close to the right position. Twist: once assembled, the object comes alive and tells its own story.

works.title: Puzzling Places: Local Mixed Reality Multiplayer
works.description: Two people in the same room assemble a photogrammetry-scanned miniature landmark together over a real table in passthrough, passing pieces by hand.
works.idea_zh: 两个人在同一张真实桌子上合拼现实地标的微缩3D拼图。

video.video_title: Puzzling Places: Local Mixed Reality Multiplayer (Walkthrough)

works.technique: Shared spatial anchors give both headsets the same table frame, and piece ownership is transferred over the network when one player grabs a piece from the other.
works.exercise_zh: 用两台手机和一个共同的图像标记对齐坐标，一起把一个拆成 4 块的 3D 模型拼回原样；变体：每个人只能看到一半碎片。
works.description_zh: 同一房间里的两个人在透视画面中，围着一张真实的桌子共同拼合一座通过摄影测量扫描得到的微缩地标，彼此用手传递拼图块。
works.idea_en: Two people assemble a miniature 3D puzzle of a real landmark together on the same real table.
works.technique_zh: 共享空间锚点让两台头显获得同一个桌面坐标系；当一名玩家从另一名玩家手中抓取拼图块时，其归属权通过网络转移。
works.exercise_en: Align coordinates on two phones with a shared image marker and work together to put a 3D model split into four pieces back together. Twist: each person can see only half of the pieces.

works.title: Rcam3 for Masaya Matsuura's concert
works.description: A fixed iPhone on stage captures the performers' depth, and Unity turns their silhouettes into large-scale VFX shown behind the band during Masaya Matsuura's concert.
works.idea_zh: 把手机 LiDAR 当成舞台上的体积摄像头，实时生成演出视觉。

video.video_title: Rcam3, my third Unity VFX project using the iPhone LiDAR. It was developed for Masaya Matsuura’s concert last night. This time, I focused on utilizing the depth sensing capability rather than AR VFX,

works.technique: An iPhone controller app streams color and LiDAR depth to a host PC, where the depth is converted to point positions that drive VFX Graph for projection.
works.exercise_zh: 用一台手机拍乐手，在 TouchDesigner 里把人体轮廓转成粒子投影到身后；加一个变化：鼓点触发粒子爆开。
works.description_zh: 在松浦雅也的演唱会上，舞台上固定的一部 iPhone 捕捉表演者的深度信息，Unity 把他们的剪影转化为大尺度视觉特效，显示在乐队身后。
works.idea_en: Use a phone's LiDAR as a volumetric camera on stage to generate live show visuals.
works.technique_zh: iPhone 控制端应用把彩色画面和 LiDAR 深度串流到主机，主机把深度转换为点的位置，驱动 VFX Graph 生成投影画面。
works.exercise_en: Film a musician with a phone and turn their body outline into particles in TouchDesigner, projected behind them. Twist: make the drum hits burst the particles apart.

works.title: RealityEffects
works.description: Volumetric videos are augmented with object-centric annotations and dynamic visual effects that follow people and objects through the 3D recording.
works.idea_zh: 给立体视频里的人和物体加上跟随式标注和特效。

video.video_title: [DIS 2024] RealityEffects: Augmenting 3D Volumetric Videos with Object-Centric Annotation and Dynami

works.technique: Objects and people are tracked across frames of a volumetric (RGB-D) recording, and annotation or particle effects are attached to those 3D tracks so they follow the subject when the recording is replayed from any viewpoint.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Record3D 或 Polycam 录一段带深度的视频，在 Unity 或 three.js 回放时给其中的人或球挂上尾迹、标签和爆炸粒子；变体：用特效把一段普通的生活片段剪成体育解说。
works.description_zh: 为体积视频添加以物体为中心的标注和动态视觉特效，它们会在 3D 录像中跟随人和物体移动。
works.idea_en: Add annotations and effects that follow the people and objects in a 3D video.
works.technique_zh: 在体积（RGB-D）录像的各帧中追踪物体和人物，并把标注或粒子特效附着在这些 3D 轨迹上，这样无论从哪个视角回放录像，特效都会跟随主体。
works.exercise_en: Record a video with depth using Record3D or Polycam, and during playback in Unity or three.js attach trails, labels and explosion particles to a person or a ball. Twist: use the effects to recut an ordinary everyday clip as a sports broadcast.

works.title: Reframe
works.description: An AR storyboarding tool where designers place characters and events in the real space to act out and analyse security and privacy threats of AR apps.
works.idea_zh: 在真实空间里用AR故事板演出隐私威胁场景。

video.video_title: Reframe: An Augmented Reality Storyboarding Tool for Character-Driven Analysis of Security & Priv...

works.technique: Provides placeable character and annotation primitives in AR plus a threat-modelling framework to structure character-driven scenarios.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机AR在教室里摆放“用户/旁观者/攻击者”的虚拟小人，演出一个AR眼镜偷拍场景并讨论如何设计防护；变化：每组为对方的场景设计一个隐私补丁。
works.description_zh: 一个 AR 故事板工具：设计师在真实空间中放置角色和事件，把 AR 应用的安全与隐私威胁演出来并进行分析。
works.idea_en: Act out privacy-threat scenarios with AR storyboards in real space.
works.technique_zh: 在 AR 中提供可放置的角色和标注基元，并配合一个威胁建模框架，用来组织由角色驱动的情景。
works.exercise_en: Use phone AR to place virtual figures for 'user', 'bystander' and 'attacker' in the classroom, act out a scene of someone secretly filming with AR glasses, and discuss how to design protections. Twist: each group designs a privacy patch for another group's scene.

works.title: Rodney Mullen's Skatrix Pro (Apple Vision Pro)
works.description: A launch title for Apple Vision Pro, co-published by Niantic: a Rodney Mullen-inspired skater rides over the player's sofa, tables and floor, which the headset scans and turns into a skate park.
works.description_zh: Apple Vision Pro 首发作品之一，由 Niantic 联合发行：一个受 Rodney Mullen 启发的滑手在玩家的沙发、桌子和地板上滑行，头显把这些扫描下来变成滑板公园。
works.idea_en: Your living room furniture becomes a miniature skate park you watch from above like a god.
works.idea_zh: 客厅家具变成一座迷你滑板公园，你像上帝一样俯瞰。
works.technique: visionOS scene reconstruction provides a room mesh used as physics geometry, and gaze-and-pinch or a game controller steers the skater.
works.technique_zh: visionOS 场景重建提供房间网格作为物理几何体，玩家用注视加捏合或游戏手柄操控滑手。
works.exercise_en: Use a headset or LiDAR phone mesh to find the three highest flat surfaces in a room and link them with a virtual ramp route. Twist: award extra points for routes that cross between two different pieces of furniture.
works.exercise_zh: 用头显或带 LiDAR 手机的网格找出房间里最高的三个平面，并用一条虚拟坡道路线把它们连起来。变体：跨越两件不同家具的路线获得额外加分。

video.video_title:
excited to play Rodney Mullen's Skatrix day one on Vision Pro, congratulations @KasimirLehto & @NianticEng !
https://t.co/34t7CiUJ7v https://t.co/ORxbuzm3aj

works.title: Sandworm (Meta Quest 3 + Apple Vision Pro)
works.description: A short mixed-reality sketch in which a Dune-style sandworm rises out of real, uneven outdoor ground, built by combining a Meta Quest 3 and an Apple Vision Pro.
works.description_zh: 一段混合现实小作品：一条《沙丘》风格的沙虫从真实、崎岖的户外地面钻出，由 Meta Quest 3 与 Apple Vision Pro 配合完成。
works.idea_en: Make giant fiction erupt from the actual terrain around you, not from a flat floor.
works.idea_zh: 让巨大的虚构生物从你身边真实的地形里冒出来，而不是从平整的地板上。
works.technique: The Quest 3 is likely used to scan and place the creature on uneven terrain, while the Vision Pro views or records the passthrough composite.
works.technique_zh: 很可能用 Quest 3 扫描崎岖地形并放置生物，再用 Vision Pro 观看或录制透视合成画面。
works.exercise_en: Scan an outdoor patch of ground with a phone's LiDAR or photogrammetry and make a creature emerge from it that follows the real bumps. Twist: the creature must hide again when someone walks toward it.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机 LiDAR 或摄影测量扫描一块户外地面，让一只生物顺着真实的起伏从地里钻出；变体：有人朝它走近时，它必须重新躲回去。

video.video_title: Meta Quest 3 & Vision Pro work well together to make a Sandworm #applevisionpro #dune

works.title: Scaniverse Gaussian splat map
works.description: UX for browsing Gaussian-splat captures of real places on a map, then jumping from map to 3D to AR views.
works.idea_zh: 在地图上浏览全世界人们扫描的真实地点，再一键放进 AR。

video.video_title: Scaniverse 4: Share your world in 3D

works.technique: Geotagged splat captures are indexed on a map, and the UI moves from 2D map to an orbitable 3D viewer to an AR placement mode, reusing the same asset at each step.
works.exercise_zh: 设计并用 Figma 或网页原型做出“地图 → 3D 预览 → AR 查看”的三步流程，放入 3 个自己扫描的物品；变体：每个扫描附带一段扫描者的语音留言。
works.description_zh: 一套在地图上浏览真实地点高斯点扫描的用户体验设计，可以从地图跳到 3D 视图，再跳到 AR 视图。
works.idea_en: Browse real places scanned by people around the world on a map, then drop one into AR with a single tap.
works.technique_zh: 带地理标签的高斯点扫描在地图上建立索引，界面依次从二维地图过渡到可环绕查看的 3D 查看器，再到 AR 放置模式，每一步复用同一份资源。
works.exercise_en: Design and prototype a three-step 'map → 3D preview → AR view' flow in Figma or on the web, featuring three objects you scanned yourself. Twist: attach a voice message from the person who made each scan.

works.title: SharedNeRF
works.description: A remote collaborator inspects a physical prototype in photorealistic 3D from any angle, while a live point cloud shows the local person's hands and moving parts as they change.
works.description_zh: 远程协作者可以从任意角度以照片级三维效果查看实体原型，同时实时点云会显示本地人员的手和正在移动的部件。
works.idea_en: Blend a slow but beautiful NeRF with a fast but rough point cloud to share a real workbench.
works.idea_zh: 把慢而精美的 NeRF 与快而粗糙的点云混合起来，共享一张真实的工作台。
works.technique: Renders a Neural Radiance Field of the static workspace and overlays a real-time RGB-D point cloud for dynamic elements, with the remote viewpoint driven by a head-mounted camera.
works.technique_zh: 为静态工作区渲染神经辐射场（NeRF），并叠加实时 RGB-D 点云表现动态元素，远程视角由头戴相机驱动。
works.exercise_en: Capture a desk with a phone 3D-scan app, share the model with a remote partner, then add a live phone video window for hands; have the partner guide an assembly. Twist: rescan only the part that changed.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机三维扫描 App 扫一张书桌，把模型分享给远程同伴，再加一个实时手机视频窗口拍手部，让同伴远程指导装配；变体：只重新扫描发生变化的部分。

video.video_title: SharedNeRF: Leveraging Photorealistic & View-dependent Rendering for Real-time, Remote Collaboration

works.title: Simulon AR VFX
works.description: Blender physics simulations composited into real locations using Simulon's AR capture and real-world lighting.
works.idea_zh: 用手机 AR 在现场“拍”特效，光照与真实环境一致。
works.technique: The tracked camera path and an estimated environment light probe from the real location are imported into Blender, where simulations are rendered with matching lighting and composited over the footage.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 的光照估计读取环境光强度和方向，让放在桌上的虚拟物体阴影和真实物体对齐；变体：关灯开灯时让虚拟物体做出不同反应。
works.description_zh: 利用 Simulon 的 AR 采集和真实世界光照，把 Blender 物理模拟合成到真实地点中。
works.idea_en: Shoot visual effects on location with phone AR, with lighting that matches the real environment.
works.technique_zh: 把从真实地点获取的追踪相机路径和估算出的环境光探针导入 Blender，以匹配的光照渲染模拟效果，再合成到实拍画面上。
works.exercise_en: Read ambient light intensity and direction with AR Foundation light estimation so that the shadows of virtual objects on a table line up with those of real objects. Twist: make the virtual objects react differently when the lights are switched off and on.

works.title: SpaceBlender
