Spatial Commerce powered by @Shopify will help brands immerse shoppers in a product story. ⛺🌲

With support for webXR, Vision Pro will help merchants deliver fully immersive VR experiences right from

works.title: Improvising cellular playgrounds in Realtalk
works.description: Live-improvised cellular automata and simulations built from paper and markers on a projected table, edited by hand in real time.
works.idea_zh: 用纸和马克笔即兴搭出会演化的细胞自动机游乐场。

video.video_title: Improvising cellular playgrounds in Realtalk, Aug 2023

works.technique: A camera reads marker-drawn cells and rule pages on paper, and a projector renders cellular automaton simulations directly over the drawings, so editing the paper edits the simulation live.
works.exercise_zh: 用摄像头读取纸上画的黑白格子作为初始状态，在投影中运行康威生命游戏并叠加回纸面，擦掉或添画格子后即时生效；变体：发明一条新的规则并写在一张规则卡上，换卡即换规则。
works.description_zh: 在投影桌面上用纸和马克笔现场即兴搭建细胞自动机和模拟，并能实时用手修改。
works.idea_en: Improvise an evolving cellular-automaton playground from paper and markers.
works.technique_zh: 摄像头读取纸上用马克笔画出的格子和规则页，投影仪把细胞自动机模拟直接渲染在这些图画上，因此修改纸面就能实时修改模拟。
works.exercise_en: Use a camera to read a black-and-white grid drawn on paper as the initial state, run Conway's Game of Life in a projection overlaid on the paper, and have erased or added cells take effect immediately. Twist: invent a new rule and write it on a rule card, so swapping cards swaps rules.

works.title: KAGAMI
works.description: Audiences sit in a circle wearing mixed-reality headsets and watch a volumetric recording of Ryuichi Sakamoto playing a grand piano in the middle of the room, surrounded by visual worlds that grow from his music.
works.description_zh: 观众围坐成一圈，戴着混合现实头显，看着坂本龙一的体积捕捉影像在房间中央弹奏三角钢琴，周围是从他的音乐中生长出来的视觉世界。
works.idea_en: A concert that can keep happening after the performer is gone, in the same room as you.
works.idea_zh: 一场在演奏者离开之后仍能继续、并且就在你身边发生的音乐会。
works.technique: Sakamoto's performance was captured volumetrically and rendered in synchronized mixed-reality headsets (Magic Leap), so every seat sees him from its own angle.
works.technique_zh: 坂本龙一的演奏被体积捕捉，在同步的混合现实头显（Magic Leap）中渲染，每个座位都能从自己的角度看到他。
works.exercise_en: Record a classmate playing an instrument with a phone depth or Gaussian-splat capture app and place the result on a real chair in AR for a small audience. Twist: let the room's lights dim as each piece builds.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机深度或高斯泼溅采集应用录下一位同学演奏乐器，再以 AR 方式把结果放到一把真实的椅子上给小观众观看；变体：随着每首曲子推进，让房间的灯光逐渐变暗。

video.video_title: KAGAMI: Ryuichi Sakamoto & Tin Drum | Asia TOPA | 19 February – 16 March 2025

works.title: Kohkoku: Reality and Illusion AR
works.description: AR artwork for the Japanese magazine Kohkoku's 'reality and illusion' issue, animating printed pages through the phone.
works.idea_zh: 为《广告》杂志“虚实”特辑做的 AR 作品，让纸面在手机里动起来。

video.video_title: 広告_虚実_AR

works.technique: Printed magazine pages are registered as tracking images, and animations or 3D elements are rendered on the tracked page pose.
works.exercise_zh: 用 8th Wall 或 MindAR 识别一张自己设计的海报，让画面元素从纸上浮起来动起来；变体：海报被翻转时显示隐藏的另一层内容。
works.description_zh: 为日本杂志《広告》（Kohkoku）“现实与幻象”专题创作的 AR 作品，通过手机让印刷页面动起来。
works.idea_en: An AR piece for the 'reality and illusion' issue of Kohkoku magazine that makes the printed pages move on a phone.
works.technique_zh: 把杂志印刷页注册为追踪图像，在追踪到的页面位姿上渲染动画或 3D 元素。
works.exercise_en: Use 8th Wall or MindAR to recognize a poster you designed, and make its elements lift off the paper and move. Twist: when the poster is flipped, reveal a hidden second layer of content.

works.title: Le Louvre: Egypt Augmented
works.description: Snapchat Lenses made with the Louvre bring ancient Egypt back to life: pointing the phone at the Obelisk on Place de la Concorde and at Egyptian antiquities restores their original gilding, colours and surroundings.
works.description_zh: 与卢浮宫合作的 Snapchat Lens 让古埃及“复活”：把手机对准协和广场上的方尖碑或埃及文物，就能看到它们原本的鎏金、色彩和周边环境。
works.idea_en: Use AR to show a monument as it looked on the day it was made, right on top of how it looks now.
works.idea_zh: 用 AR 把文物“刚完成那天”的样子叠加在它今天的样子上。
works.technique: Custom Landmarker / custom location tracking built from 3D scans locks restored models onto the real obelisk and artefacts in Lens Studio.
works.technique_zh: 在 Lens Studio 中用基于 3D 扫描的自定义地标（Custom Landmarker）追踪，把修复后的模型精准贴合到真实的方尖碑和文物上。
works.exercise_en: Scan a statue, doorway or old building on campus with a phone and build a Lens or AR scene that restores a missing part or its original colour. Twist: let a slider move the viewer through three different centuries.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机扫描校园里的一尊雕像、一道门或一栋老建筑，制作一个 Lens 或 AR 场景，补全它缺失的部分或还原原本的颜色；变体：加一个滑块，让观者在三个不同世纪之间切换。

video.video_title: Egypt Augmented

works.title: Look, Pinch, Ask (Vision Pro concept)
works.description: A Vision Pro concept that pairs eye, hand and voice input with conversational AI: a shopper sitting on a velvet sofa looks, pinches and asks, and instant personalised product insights appear.
works.description_zh: Vision Pro 概念：把眼、手、语音输入与对话式 AI 结合。坐在丝绒沙发上的购物者看一眼、捏一下、问一句，个性化的商品信息立刻出现。
works.idea_en: Ask about the thing you are looking at, the moment you are curious.
works.idea_zh: 好奇的那一刻，就问眼前这件东西。
works.technique: Likely a concept video: gaze selects the product, a pinch confirms, speech goes to a conversational AI, and the answer is shown as a floating panel next to the object.
works.technique_zh: 很可能是概念视频：视线选中商品，捏合确认，语音发送给对话式 AI，答案以悬浮面板显示在物体旁边。
works.exercise_en: Prototype a 'look and ask' interaction in phone AR: the object at the screen centre is selected, a tap records a question, and a short AI answer is pinned beside it. Twist: the answer must be spoken back in the object's own voice.
works.exercise_zh: 在手机 AR 中做一个“看了就问”的交互：屏幕中心对准的物体被选中，点一下录下问题，AI 的简短回答钉在物体旁边；变体：让物体用“自己的声音”把答案说出来。

video.video_title:
We’re always looking at better ways to shop @Shopify. 

Vision Pro’s intuitive eye, hand, and voice interactions could unlock instant, personalized insights when combined with the powers of conversati

works.title: MOFA: The Duel
works.description: A co-located magic duel in which players wearing HoloKit headsets cast spells with hand gestures while spectators on phones watch and join; CHI 2023 best interactivity demo.
works.idea_zh: 戴HoloKit用手势施法对决，旁观者用手机加入观看的同场魔法对战。

video.video_title: MOFA: Exploring Asymmetric Mixed Reality Design Strategy for Co-located Multiplayer Between Handh...

works.technique: Hand-pose recognition on the iPhone camera classifies spell gestures, and headsets and spectator phones share one coordinate system (likely via marker-based colocalization) so spells travel between real bodies.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe 或 Apple Vision 手势识别区分两种手势，分别释放火球和护盾，两台设备通过网络同步；变体：让旁观者用手机为某一方加油来增强法术。
works.description_zh: 一场同处一地的魔法对决：戴着 HoloKit 头显的玩家用手势施放法术，旁观者则用手机观战并参与其中；获得 CHI 2023 最佳互动演示奖。
works.idea_en: A same-room magic duel in which players wearing HoloKit cast spells with gestures while spectators join in on their phones.
works.technique_zh: 基于 iPhone 摄像头的手势识别对施法手势进行分类，头显和旁观者手机共享同一个坐标系（可能通过基于标记的共同定位实现），让法术在真实的身体之间飞行。
works.exercise_en: Use MediaPipe or Apple Vision hand-pose recognition to tell two gestures apart, one casting a fireball and one a shield, and sync the two devices over the network. Twist: let spectators cheer for one side on their phones to power up that side's spells.

works.title: Matrix Stockroom
works.description: A VR concept inspired by the infinite gun rack in The Matrix: a search spawns endless shelves of products around you, voice commands narrow them down, and any item can be pulled out for AR try-on.
works.description_zh: 向《黑客帝国》无限货架致敬的 VR 概念：一次搜索会在你周围生成无尽的商品货架，用语音指令逐步筛选，任何商品都能拿出来做 AR 试用。
works.idea_en: Show search results as an infinite room you walk through, then talk to narrow it down.
works.idea_zh: 把搜索结果变成一个可以走进去的无限房间，再用说话来筛选。
works.technique: A concept film combining Meta's Voice SDK with a large language model as the filter; the hands were motion-captured on a Quest with the team's open-source Handy tool and rendered in Blender (the filtering pipeline is likely simulated).
works.technique_zh: 概念影片设想用 Meta Voice SDK 加大语言模型做筛选；片中的手部动作由团队开源工具 Handy 在 Quest 上动捕后用 Blender 渲染（筛选流程很可能是模拟的）。
works.exercise_en: Build a VR or phone-AR scene that spawns a grid of 50 objects from a search word, then add two spoken filters ('only red', 'smaller') that remove items. Twist: sort the room by a feeling ('cozy', 'loud') instead of a category.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个 VR 或手机 AR 场景：输入一个搜索词就生成 50 个物体的阵列，再加两个语音筛选（“只要红色”“更小的”）去掉不符合的物体；变体：按感觉（“温馨”“吵闹”）而不是类别来整理房间。

video.video_title:
Do you love perusing a store, seeing what leaps out as you go? 👀

Do you love the infinite scale of the internet, with powerful filters and categories? 🗂️

What if you could have the best of both worl

works.title: MediaPipe body tracking plugin for TouchDesigner
works.description: A free, no-setup webcam plugin tracks face, hands and body in TouchDesigner, shown driving real-time visuals over the performer's body.
works.idea_zh: 零门槛的网页摄像头全身追踪插件，让任何人都能做体感视觉。

video.video_title: So excited launch my new body tracking plugin for TouchDesigner!  It runs off the webcam and works with no setup on both Mac and PC. I’ve refined this based off many motion tracking projects I’ve work

works.technique: MediaPipe models run inside an embedded browser in TouchDesigner and stream landmark data as channels to drive visuals.
works.exercise_zh: 用这个插件（或网页版 MediaPipe）做一个'身体乐器'：不同关节碰到屏幕上的区域发出不同音；加一个变化：只有闭眼时才能演奏。
works.description_zh: 一款免费、无需配置的网络摄像头插件，可在 TouchDesigner 中追踪人脸、手部和身体，演示中它驱动着叠加在表演者身体上的实时视觉。
works.idea_en: A no-barrier webcam body-tracking plugin that lets anyone make motion-driven visuals.
works.technique_zh: MediaPipe 模型在 TouchDesigner 内嵌的浏览器中运行，并把关键点数据以通道形式输出，用来驱动视觉效果。
works.exercise_en: Use this plugin (or MediaPipe on the web) to build a 'body instrument' in which different joints play different notes when they touch areas on the screen. Twist: you can only play with your eyes closed.

works.title: Minecraft remade in AR
works.description: He rebuilt Minecraft mechanics in AR so you can dig into, fight on and build blocks over the real ground around you.
works.idea_zh: 在真实地面上像史蒂夫一样挖、打、建。

video.video_title: I remade Minecraft in AR so you can dig, fight, and build like Steve but in the real world!! https://t.co/YEOMiUIPBF

works.technique: Real-world meshing aligns a voxel grid to the ground so placed and dug blocks stick to real surfaces (likely Lightship meshing).
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 做一个在地面网格上放方块的建造玩具；加一个变化：方块会被真实阳光方向投下影子。
works.description_zh: 他在 AR 中重建了 Minecraft 的玩法，让你可以在身边的真实地面上挖掘、战斗和搭建方块。
works.idea_en: Dig, fight and build on the real ground just like Steve.
works.technique_zh: 真实世界网格化把体素网格与地面对齐，使放置或挖掉的方块贴合真实表面（可能使用 Lightship 网格化）。
works.exercise_en: Build a block-placing construction toy on a ground mesh with AR Foundation. Twist: blocks cast shadows in the direction of the real sunlight.

works.title: Mixed Reality Door for Meta Quest 3
works.description: A real door in the room becomes a portal: opening it in passthrough reveals a virtual world behind it.
works.idea_zh: 把家里一扇真实的门变成通往虚拟世界的传送门。

video.video_title: Mixed Reality (MR) Door for Meta Quest3

works.technique: A virtual portal plane is aligned to the real door frame in passthrough, with a stencil or depth mask so the virtual world is visible only where the real door opening is.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 在一扇真实门框位置手动对齐一个 Stencil 门，门内渲染森林；变体：门后的世界根据当天日期或天气变化。
works.description_zh: 房间里一扇真实的门变成了传送门：在透视画面中打开它，门后便显露出一个虚拟世界。
works.idea_en: Turn a real door at home into a portal to a virtual world.
works.technique_zh: 在透视画面中把一个虚拟传送门平面与真实门框对齐，并使用模板或深度遮罩，让虚拟世界只在真实门洞处可见。
works.exercise_en: Manually align a stencil door to a real doorframe with AR Foundation and render a forest inside it. Twist: change the world behind the door based on the day's date or weather.

works.title: Morphing Identity
works.description: Two people face a screen where their live faces gradually morph into each other in real time, exploring where 'self' ends and 'other' begins.
works.idea_zh: 实时把你的脸慢慢变成对面那个人的脸。

video.video_title: Morphing Identity [CHI2023]

works.technique: Tracks facial landmarks on both live video feeds and warps and cross-dissolves the textures with a controllable blend ratio.
works.exercise_zh: 用Snap Lens Studio或Effect House做一个把自己脸与同桌脸按滑块比例融合的滤镜；变化：融合比例由两人说话音量决定。
works.description_zh: 两个人面对同一块屏幕，他们的实时面孔逐渐相互融合变形，借此探讨“自我”在哪里结束，“他者”又从哪里开始。
works.idea_en: Slowly morph your face into the face of the person opposite you, live.
works.technique_zh: 在两路实时视频中追踪面部关键点，对纹理进行变形和交叉溶解，混合比例可调。
works.exercise_en: Make a filter in Snap Lens Studio or Effect House that blends your face with your deskmate's face according to a slider. Twist: set the blend ratio by how loudly each person speaks.

works.title: Palm-Through Interaction
works.description: Wearing an AR headset, you hold up your palm so a distant lamp or fan appears through it, then tap your own palm like a phone screen to control that device.
works.description_zh: 戴着 AR 头显举起手掌，让远处的台灯或风扇“透过”掌心出现，再像点手机屏幕一样点自己的掌心来控制它。
works.idea_en: Your palm becomes a remote touchscreen aimed at whatever you look at through it.
works.idea_zh: 手掌变成一块遥控触摸屏，对准的就是你透过它看到的东西。
works.technique: Tracks the hand in the AR headset, casts a ray through the palm to select the IoT device behind it, and maps touches on the palm to that device's UI, giving natural haptic feedback.
works.technique_zh: 在 AR 头显中追踪手部，从掌心发出射线选中其后的物联网设备，并把在掌心的触碰映射为该设备的界面操作，从而获得自然的触觉反馈。
works.exercise_en: Prototype with a phone: when the camera sees a printed marker on a lamp, show that lamp's controls; students then 'press' the buttons drawn on their own palm while a partner switches the lamp. Twist: use the back of the hand for a second device.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机做原型：相机识别到台灯上的打印标记时显示它的控制按钮，学生在自己掌心画出的按钮上“按下”，同伴负责开关台灯；变体：用手背控制第二个设备。

video.video_title: A Palm-Through Interaction Technique

works.title: Peridot
works.description: An AR virtual pet game where each 'Dot' is a unique creature that understands the real ground, grass, water and sand around you and plays fetch or digs in them.
works.idea_zh: 一只能识别草地、水面和沙地的AR电子宠物，和真实环境玩耍。

video.video_title: Peridot | Available Now | Global Launch Trailer

works.technique: Semantic segmentation labels ground pixels as grass, water, sand and so on, and the pet's behavior tree picks actions such as digging or swimming based on the class under it.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Lightship 语义分割或简单的颜色判断区分草地和地板，让 AR 宠物在草地上打滚、在地板上走路；变体：把宠物放在水边时它会喝水。
works.description_zh: 一款 AR 虚拟宠物游戏，每只“Dot”都是独一无二的生物，它能理解你周围真实的地面、草地、水面和沙地，并在其中玩接球或挖土。
works.idea_en: An AR pet that recognizes grass, water and sand and plays with the real environment.
works.technique_zh: 语义分割把地面像素标注为草地、水面、沙地等类别，宠物的行为树再根据脚下的类别选择挖掘、游泳等动作。
works.exercise_en: Tell grass from floor with Lightship semantic segmentation or a simple color check, and make an AR pet roll on the grass and walk on the floor. Twist: when the pet is placed by water, it takes a drink.

works.title: Pillow – Mixed Reality in Bed
works.description: A Quest mixed-reality app designed to be used lying in bed, with games, journaling and meditation projected over the ceiling and room.
works.idea_zh: 专为躺在床上设计的混合现实应用。

video.video_title: Pillow - Mixed Reality in Bed (Trailer)

works.technique: The ceiling is identified from room setup or plane classification, and UI and game content are placed on it so they face a user lying down, with input adapted to a supine posture.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 检测天花板（朝下的平面），在上面显示一个躺着玩的冥想呼吸动画；变体：用手机麦克风检测呼吸节奏控制动画。
works.description_zh: 一款专为躺在床上使用而设计的 Quest 混合现实应用，把游戏、日记和冥想投射到天花板和房间中。
works.idea_en: A mixed-reality app designed for lying in bed.
works.technique_zh: 通过房间设置或平面分类识别天花板，把界面和游戏内容放在天花板上，使其朝向躺着的用户，输入方式也针对仰卧姿势做了调整。
works.exercise_en: Detect the ceiling (a downward-facing plane) with AR Foundation and display a breathing-meditation animation on it to use while lying down. Twist: control the animation with your breathing rhythm, picked up by the phone microphone.

works.title: Prada Beauty 'Rethinking Beauty' AR filter
works.description: As Prada Beauty's Global Creative E-Makeup Artist, Alpha designed a three-mode Instagram AR filter with FFFACE.ME that layers futuristic e-makeup on the user's face.
works.idea_zh: 为奢侈品美妆设计的三种模式数字妆容滤镜。

video.video_title: FFFACE.ME x Prada Beauty | AR Filter in collaboration with Ines Alpha

works.technique: A multi-mode face filter switches between makeup looks via tap or picker UI, each combining face-mesh textures, attached 3D pieces and animated shaders.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个有三种模式的人脸滤镜，点击屏幕在模式间切换，每种模式代表一种对“未来妆容”的理解；变体：模式切换由眨眼触发。
works.description_zh: 作为 Prada Beauty 的全球创意数字化妆师，Alpha 与 FFFACE.ME 合作设计了一款拥有三种模式的 Instagram AR 滤镜，在用户脸上叠加未来感的数字妆容。
works.idea_en: A digital makeup filter with three modes, designed for a luxury beauty brand.
works.technique_zh: 一个多模式人脸滤镜，通过点击或选择器界面在不同妆容之间切换，每种妆容都组合了面部网格纹理、附着的 3D 部件和动画着色器。
works.exercise_en: Make a face filter with three modes that you switch between by tapping the screen, each mode expressing a different idea of 'future makeup'. Twist: trigger the mode switch with a blink.

works.title: Product as Platform
works.description: A concept for AR glasses in which physical objects carry their own apps: pick up a film camera and its controls and tips appear anchored to it, selected by gaze-and-pinch or by virtual buttons on the object's hard surfaces.
works.description_zh: AR 眼镜概念：实体物品自带“应用”。拿起一台胶片相机，它的控制项和使用提示就锚定在机身上，用“注视+捏合”或贴在物体硬表面上的虚拟按钮来操作。
works.idea_en: Every object you own could have an app living inside it.
works.idea_zh: 你拥有的每件物品，都可以住着一个自己的应用。
works.technique: Likely a passthrough prototype in which each product is recognised and tracked so a small UI stays attached to it, using pinch-and-gaze selection or virtual buttons backed by the object's real surfaces.
works.technique_zh: 很可能是透视式原型：识别并追踪每件商品，让小界面始终附着在物体上，通过注视+捏合或以物体真实表面为依托的虚拟按钮来选择。
works.exercise_en: Choose one classroom object and design its 'app': anchor three AR controls to it with an image marker that only appear when the user touches or looks at it. Twist: give the object a personality so its app is quirky rather than useful.
works.exercise_zh: 选一件教室里的物品，为它设计“应用”：用图像标记把三个 AR 控件锚定在物品上，只有被触摸或注视时才出现；变体：给物品一个性格，让它的应用古灵精怪而不是实用。

video.video_title: Could AR glasses let us "install" apps onto any object? Hoping those @apple rumors prove true 🤞 https://t.co/KiNGBkCDYS

works.title: Pulling Products off the Web (Spatial Commerce)
works.description: A Vision Pro spatial-commerce concept: while browsing a store's web page, the shopper pinches a product and pulls a full-size 3D demo out of the page into the room.
works.description_zh: Vision Pro 空间商务概念：浏览店铺网页时，购物者捏住一件商品，把全尺寸的 3D 演示直接从网页里拉进房间。
works.idea_en: The web page becomes a doorway that products can be pulled through.
works.idea_zh: 网页变成一道门，商品可以从里面被拉出来。
works.technique: A concept video likely simulating visionOS, where a 3D model embedded in the page is grabbed with a look-and-pinch gesture and dropped as a world-anchored object.
works.technique_zh: 很可能是模拟 visionOS 的概念视频：网页中嵌入的 3D 模型被“注视+捏合”抓起，放到房间里成为锚定在空间中的物体。
works.exercise_en: Make a web page with a 3D product that jumps into WebXR AR when the user drags it off the page. Twist: products can be pushed back into the page to 'return' them.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个带 3D 商品的网页，用户把商品拖出页面时就进入 WebXR AR 模式；变体：把商品推回网页就算“退货”。

video.video_title:
Exploring Spatial Commerce opportunities @Shopify with Vision Pro on the horizon…

It's going to be fun pulling product demos right off the webpage and into the room 🤏✨🤯 https://t.co/QbDiCzPfxj

works.title: Real-Time AR Effect on Cat
works.description: Tracks his pet cat in real time and wraps it in animated AR effects that follow the animal as it moves.
works.idea_zh: 实时追踪家猫，给它身上叠加跟随的 AR 特效。

video.video_title: Real-time AR Effect on Cat

works.technique: An animal detection or segmentation model tracks the cat's bounding box or mask in real time, and particle effects are emitted from its position in screen or world space.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe Object Detection（或 YOLO）在网页中识别猫或宠物玩偶，在它周围生成跟随的粒子光环；变体：动物移动越快，特效越夸张。
works.description_zh: 实时追踪他家的猫，用动态 AR 特效把它包裹起来，特效会跟随猫的移动。
works.idea_en: Track a house cat in real time and wrap it in AR effects that follow it around.
works.technique_zh: 动物检测或分割模型实时追踪猫的边界框或遮罩，粒子特效从它在屏幕空间或世界空间中的位置发射出来。
works.exercise_en: Use MediaPipe Object Detection (or YOLO) on a web page to recognize a cat or a stuffed toy animal, and generate a halo of particles that follows it. Twist: the faster the animal moves, the more exaggerated the effect.

works.title: RealityCanvas
works.description: Scribble animation effects such as motion lines, smoke and speed lines onto real moving people and objects in AR, and they follow and react to the motion like a live cartoon.
works.idea_zh: 给真实世界加漫画式速度线和烟雾特效，跟着真人真物实时动起来。

video.video_title: [UIST 2023] RealityCanvas: Augmented Reality Sketching for Embedded and Responsive Scribble ...

works.technique: ARKit body tracking and object tracking give per-frame positions of moving targets, and hand-drawn strokes are attached to those points and animated with rules (trail, follow, emit) to produce cartoon effects.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe Pose 追踪同学的手腕或脚踝，让用户在画面上手绘一条速度线或一团烟，并将其绑定到关节随运动播放；变体：给运动的日常物品（开门、倒水）配上漫画音效字。
works.description_zh: 在 AR 中为真实移动的人和物体随手画上动画效果，比如运动线、烟雾和速度线，它们会像实时卡通一样跟随并回应运动。
works.idea_en: Add comic-style speed lines and smoke to the real world, moving live with real people and objects.
works.technique_zh: ARKit 身体追踪和物体追踪逐帧给出运动目标的位置，手绘笔画被附着到这些点上，并按规则（拖尾、跟随、发射）进行动画，产生卡通效果。
works.exercise_en: Track a classmate's wrist or ankle with MediaPipe Pose, let the user draw a speed line or a puff of smoke on screen, and bind it to the joint so it plays with the motion. Twist: add comic sound-effect lettering to everyday objects in motion (a door opening, water pouring).

works.title: RealityReplay
works.description: MR detects changes that happened in the room while you were not looking and replays them in place, e.g. showing who moved an object.
works.idea_zh: 在原地回放你没注意到的变化，看见刚刚发生过什么。

video.video_title: RealityReplay: Detecting and Replaying Temporal Changes In Situ using Mixed Reality

works.technique: The MR system keeps a 3D model of the room, detects geometric and appearance changes that happened outside the user's field of view, and replays the recorded change events in place as animated reconstructions.
works.exercise_zh: 用固定在角落的手机摄像头拍桌面，通过帧差检测物体被移动的时刻，并把这一段录像在 AR 中叠加回原位置回放；变体：只给用户提示“这里变了”，让他们猜发生了什么再揭晓。
works.description_zh: 混合现实系统检测你没在看的时候房间里发生的变化，并在原地回放，例如显示是谁挪动了某个物体。
works.idea_en: Replay the changes you missed right where they happened, so you can see what just took place.
works.technique_zh: 混合现实系统维护房间的 3D 模型，检测发生在用户视野之外的几何与外观变化，并在原地以动画重建的形式回放记录下来的变化事件。
works.exercise_en: Film a tabletop with a phone camera fixed in a corner, detect the moment an object is moved using frame differencing, and replay that clip in AR overlaid at its original location. Twist: only tell users 'something changed here', let them guess what happened, then reveal it.

works.title: RetroSphere
works.description: An IMWUT/UbiComp 2023 system with Google researchers: passive, battery-free controllers covered in retroreflective spheres are tracked in 3D by a self-contained AR headset.
works.description_zh: 与 Google 研究者合作的 IMWUT/UbiComp 2023 系统：表面覆盖回射小球的无源、无电池控制器，可以被一体式 AR 头显进行 3D 追踪。
works.idea_en: Tracked AR input does not need electronics: shiny passive markers are enough.
works.idea_zh: 可追踪的 AR 输入不一定需要电子元件：无源反光标记就够了。
works.technique: Near-infrared illumination makes the retroreflective spheres appear as bright blobs to the headset's cameras, and stereo triangulation recovers their 3D positions.
works.technique_zh: 近红外照明让回射小球在头显相机中呈现为亮点，再通过双目三角测量恢复它们的三维位置。
works.exercise_en: Tape retroreflective stickers to a stick and track the bright spots with a phone camera and flashlight in a browser. Twist: turn the stick into a light saber or paintbrush.
works.exercise_zh: 在一根棍子上贴回射贴纸，在浏览器里用手机摄像头和闪光灯追踪亮点。变体：把它变成光剑或画笔。

video.video_title: RetroSphere: Self-Contained Passive 3D Controller Tracking for Augmented Reality

works.title: ShadowClones
works.description: A single user controls several virtual bodies seen from multiple viewpoints; shadow-like cues keep track of where each body is so they can coordinate actions across perspectives.
works.idea_zh: 一个人分身成多个影子般的身体，并在多视角中协调它们。

video.video_title: ShadowClones [AHs' 23]

works.technique: Renders several avatar copies driven by one tracked body and overlays shadow projections of each clone to preserve body-space coordination across views.
works.exercise_zh: 在手机AR中放置三个会复制你动作的虚拟分身（用人体骨骼追踪），让你摆姿势让三个分身同时拍到目标；变化：每个分身动作延迟不同。
works.description_zh: 一个人同时操控多个虚拟身体，并从多个视角观看它们；影子般的提示标出每个身体的位置，让用户能在不同视角之间协调动作。
works.idea_en: One person splits into several shadow-like bodies and coordinates them across multiple viewpoints.
works.technique_zh: 由一个被追踪的身体驱动多个化身副本的渲染，并为每个分身叠加影子投影，以便在不同视角之间保持身体与空间的协调。
works.exercise_en: Place three virtual clones in phone AR that copy your movements using body skeleton tracking, and pose so that all three clones hit a target at the same moment. Twist: give each clone a different motion delay.

works.title: Shopping with Friends (SharePlay concept)
works.description: A Vision Pro concept in which a friend joins via FaceTime as a floating video tile and both see the same miniature tent and campsite on the coffee table while deciding what to buy.
works.description_zh: Vision Pro 概念：朋友通过 FaceTime 以悬浮视频窗口加入，两人同时看到茶几上同一个迷你帐篷和露营场景，一起商量买什么。
works.idea_en: Bring the fun of shopping with friends into shared AR.
works.idea_zh: 把和朋友一起逛街的乐趣带进共享 AR。
works.technique: Likely built on visionOS SharePlay, which syncs the same 3D product scene between participants while the FaceTime call runs beside it.
works.technique_zh: 很可能基于 visionOS 的 SharePlay，在参与者之间同步同一个 3D 商品场景，旁边同时进行 FaceTime 通话。
works.exercise_en: Build a two-phone shared AR scene where both users see and rotate the same product and then vote on it. Twist: one user can only point and the other can only speak.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个双手机共享 AR 场景，两人看到并能旋转同一件商品，最后投票决定；变体：一个人只能指，另一个人只能说。

video.video_title:
Shopping with friends IRL is a great vibe, but challenging to replicate online. 👯

Spatial Commerce powered by Shopify with VisionOS and SharePlay will enable a new generation of virtual try-on experi

works.title: Supermarket AR Navigation (QR anchor)
works.description: A shopper scans a QR code on a supermarket shelf and an AR path appears on the floor, guiding them aisle by aisle to the product on their list.
works.description_zh: 顾客扫一下超市货架上的二维码，地面上便出现一条 AR 路线，一排排货架地把人引到购物清单上的商品前。
works.idea_en: A printed QR code works as a cheap indoor GPS fix that re-anchors an AR route inside a store.
works.idea_zh: 一张打印的二维码就是廉价的室内定位点，能在商店里重新锚定 AR 路线。
works.technique: The QR code gives a known pose that aligns a pre-authored store map with the AR session, after which world tracking keeps the floor arrows in place.
works.technique_zh: 二维码提供一个已知位姿，把预先制作的商店地图与 AR 会话对齐，之后由世界追踪让地面箭头保持在原位。
works.exercise_en: Map a corridor of your school with three QR codes as anchors and draw an AR arrow path from the entrance to a classroom. Twist: when two users' routes cross, show each of them the other's arrow in a different colour.
works.exercise_zh: 用三个二维码作为锚点，给学校的一段走廊建图，并画出一条从入口到某间教室的 AR 箭头路线。变体：当两名用户的路线交叉时，用不同颜色让双方看到对方的箭头。

video.video_title: Unity: Supermarket AR Demo. AR Navigation (QR-code as anchor point)

works.title: Syn: Unfolded Horizons of Bodily Senses
works.description: The opening show of TOKYO NODE: audiences walk onto a 1,500 m² stage where 24 dancers, a transforming space and mixed-reality experiences blur performer and spectator.
works.idea_zh: 观众走上舞台，与24位舞者和混合现实影像共同组成演出
works.technique: Combines live dancers with MR content, tracked stage elements and projection so the space reconfigures as visitors move through it.
works.exercise_zh: 把教室分区，观众走到不同区域触发不同投影和音乐，同学在其中表演；变化：观众手机AR里看到的舞者比现场多一个。

video.video_title: ELEVENPLAY x Rhizomatiks "syn" (2023)  multicam

works.description_zh: TOKYO NODE 的开幕演出：观众走上一座 1,500 平方米的舞台，24 位舞者、不断变化的空间与混合现实体验交织在一起，模糊了表演者与观众的边界。
works.idea_en: The audience walks onto the stage and forms the show together with 24 dancers and mixed-reality imagery.
works.technique_zh: 将现场舞者与 MR 内容、被追踪的舞台元素和投影结合，使空间随观众的移动而重新组合。
works.exercise_en: Divide the classroom into zones where walking into each zone triggers different projections and music, and have classmates perform inside them. Twist: in the audience's phone AR, there is one more dancer than on the actual stage.

works.title: Synth Riders Mixed Reality mode
works.description: The rhythm game's notes, rails and obstacles fly out of a portal into the player's passthrough living room, so dancing along the rails happens among their own furniture.
works.description_zh: 这款节奏游戏的音符、轨道和障碍物从一个传送门飞进玩家透视画面中的客厅，让人在自家家具之间顺着轨道起舞。
works.idea_en: Turn your living room into the dance floor by letting the level pour in through a portal.
works.idea_zh: 让关卡从传送门里倾泻而出，把客厅变成舞池。
works.technique: Quest passthrough replaces the virtual stage, with a stencil-masked portal where notes spawn and colour-tinted effects blended over the camera feed.
works.technique_zh: 用 Quest 透视画面替代虚拟舞台，在一个用模板遮罩做成的传送门里生成音符，并把着色特效叠加在摄像头画面上。
works.exercise_en: Make a passthrough rhythm prototype where beat-synced orbs emerge from a portal on a real wall and must be touched with the hands on the beat. Twist: let the song's intensity grow the portal until the virtual world covers the whole wall.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个透视节奏原型：随节拍生成的光球从真实墙面上的传送门里飞出，玩家必须踩着节拍用手去触碰。变体：让歌曲强度控制传送门大小，直到虚拟世界铺满整面墙。

video.video_title: Meta Quest 3 Mixed Reality Gameplay | Synth Riders

works.title: Teachable Reality
works.description: Train an on-device model by demonstrating with everyday objects (a lid open or closed, a toy moved) and bind those states to AR effects, prototyping tangible AR without code.
works.idea_zh: 用身边任何物件示范几次，就能把它变成触发AR效果的实体控制器。

video.video_title: [CHI 2023] Teachable Reality: Prototyping Tangible Augmented Reality with Everyday Objects

works.technique: An on-device image classifier is trained from a few user demonstrations of object states (interactive machine teaching), and state changes detected in the camera feed trigger AR effects bound to the tracked scene.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Teachable Machine 训练“杯盖开/关”或“书翻开/合上”两个状态，在网页 AR 中把状态变化连接到一个特效（盖子打开时冒出蒸汽）；变体：把一个毫无电子功能的日常物品变成游戏手柄。
works.description_zh: 用日常物件做几次示范（盖子打开或合上、玩具被挪动），就能在设备端训练一个模型，并把这些状态与 AR 效果绑定，无需写代码就能制作实体交互 AR 的原型。
works.idea_en: Demonstrate with any object at hand a few times and it becomes a physical controller for AR effects.
works.technique_zh: 设备端的图像分类器通过用户对物体状态的少量示范完成训练（交互式机器教学），摄像头画面中检测到的状态变化会触发绑定在被追踪场景上的 AR 效果。
works.exercise_en: Train two states with Teachable Machine, such as cup lid open/closed or book open/shut, and link the state change to an effect in web AR, like steam rising when the lid opens. Twist: turn an everyday object with no electronics into a game controller.

works.title: Tetris in WebAR, written by ChatGPT
works.description: A playable Tetris board floating in the room, with the WebAR code generated by ChatGPT.
works.idea_zh: 让 AI 写代码，把俄罗斯方块立在客厅里玩。

video.video_title: @LinusEkenstam I used ChatGPT to create Tetris in WebAR 👀 using similar concepts

works.technique: A 2D Tetris grid is rendered as a world-anchored vertical plane of cube meshes placed via hit test, with standard game logic running on a tick timer and on-screen buttons for input.
works.exercise_zh: 让 AI 生成一个在 AR 中漂浮的俄罗斯方块，记录需要手动修正的错误；变体：方块落到底后变成真实地面上可推倒的物理积木。
works.description_zh: 一块可以真正玩的俄罗斯方块棋盘漂浮在房间里，其 WebAR 代码由 ChatGPT 生成。
works.idea_en: Let AI write the code and stand a game of Tetris up in the living room.
works.technique_zh: 二维俄罗斯方块网格被渲染为一块由立方体网格组成、锚定在世界空间中的竖直平面，通过命中测试（hit test）放置；标准游戏逻辑由定时器驱动，屏幕按钮负责输入。
works.exercise_en: Have AI generate a Tetris game floating in AR and log every bug you have to fix by hand. Twist: when blocks land, they become physics blocks on the real floor that can be knocked over.

works.title: The Floor Is Lava!
works.description: Using Figmin XR on Quest 3, the real living-room floor is covered with bubbling virtual lava while furniture remains safe islands.
works.idea_zh: 把客厅地板变成岩浆，只有家具是安全岛。

video.video_title: 🔥The floor is lava!🔥

works.technique: Places a lava material on the detected floor plane while the scene mesh keeps real furniture visible and occluding.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机AR检测地面铺满岩浆材质，并让玩家只能踩在贴有标记的“安全垫”上（图片识别）；变化：岩浆每30秒上涨一次。
works.description_zh: 在 Quest 3 上使用 Figmin XR，真实客厅的地板被翻滚冒泡的虚拟岩浆覆盖，而家具成了安全的小岛。
works.idea_en: The living-room floor turns into lava and only the furniture is safe to stand on.
works.technique_zh: 在检测到的地面平面上铺设岩浆材质，同时利用场景网格让真实家具保持可见并产生遮挡。
works.exercise_en: Use phone AR to detect the floor and cover it with a lava material, and only let players step on safe mats marked with images that the app recognizes. Twist: the lava rises every 30 seconds.

works.title: The Fool Tour (Jain)
works.description: Two Lenses for singer Jain's live show: the 'Jain Machine' deals anyone a playful prediction of their future, and a second Lens opens a cosmic world that fans see during the concert itself.
works.description_zh: 为歌手 Jain 的巡演制作的两个 Lens：“Jain Machine”给每个人抽一张俏皮的未来预言，另一个 Lens 则在演唱会现场为歌迷打开一个宇宙般的世界。
works.idea_en: Give a concert crowd a shared AR layer that only exists during the show.
works.idea_zh: 给演唱会观众一层只在演出期间存在的共享 AR 世界。
works.technique: A face-tracked fortune-telling Lens plus a world Lens timed to the live set, which likely anchors large-scale cosmic visuals to the stage direction.
works.technique_zh: 一个基于人脸追踪的占卜 Lens，加上一个与演出同步的世界 Lens，后者很可能把大尺度宇宙视觉锚定在舞台方向。
works.exercise_en: Create a Lens for a school performance that shows a different AR sky during each song of a three-song set. Twist: the audience's cheering volume decides how intense the sky becomes.
works.exercise_zh: 为一场学校演出做一个 Lens，三首歌分别对应三种不同的 AR 天空；变体：观众欢呼的音量决定天空的强烈程度。

video.video_title: The Fool Tour - Jain x Snapchat

works.title: The Real World Is Your Canvas
works.description: An artist paints glowing strokes and objects around a real room in Figmin XR; the art wraps around furniture and stays anchored in place.
works.idea_zh: 在真实房间的家具间作画，画作永远留在原处。

video.video_title: 🎨 With #MixedReality the real world is your canvas 🎨

works.technique: Combines 3D brush strokes with persistent spatial anchors so drawings stay registered to the room between sessions.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机AR绘画App（如Just a Line的继任或Reality Composer）在教室某个角落画3D装置并保存锚点，下节课重新打开；变化：两人在同一锚点上接力完成作品。
works.description_zh: 一位艺术家在 Figmin XR 中围绕真实房间绘制发光的笔触和物体；作品环绕着家具，并固定停留在原处。
works.idea_en: Paint among the furniture of a real room, and the artwork stays where you left it.
works.technique_zh: 将三维笔刷笔触与持久化空间锚点结合，使绘画在不同使用时段之间始终与房间对齐。
works.exercise_en: Use a phone AR drawing app (such as a successor to Just a Line, or Reality Composer) to paint a 3D installation in a corner of the classroom, save the anchor, and reopen it next class. Twist: two people take turns finishing the piece on the same anchor.

works.title: Touch Grass lens
works.description: A tongue-in-cheek AR lens detects when you actually touch grass and rewards you, so you can prove online that you go outside.
works.idea_zh: 识别你真的'摸了草'，给你一张出门证明。

video.video_title: I made an AR lens that detects when you touch grass so you can prove to other people on the internet you go outside! https://t.co/eYLm0umbXt

works.technique: Hand tracking combined with a ground/grass segmentation or classification model checks that the hand overlaps real grass (likely Lens Studio ML).
works.exercise_zh: 用 Teachable Machine 训练'草地/非草地'分类器，手机拍到手放在草上就发放徽章；加一个变化：换成识别树叶、石头等校园自然物收集图鉴。
works.description_zh: 一个带点调侃意味的 AR 滤镜：它能识别你是否真的摸到了草，并给你奖励，让你在网上证明自己确实出过门。
works.idea_en: It checks that you really touched grass and hands you proof that you went outside.
works.technique_zh: 将手部追踪与地面/草地分割或分类模型结合，判断手是否与真实草地重叠（大概率使用 Lens Studio 的机器学习功能）。
works.exercise_en: Train a grass/not-grass classifier with Teachable Machine and award a badge when the phone sees a hand on grass. Twist: switch to recognizing leaves, stones and other natural objects on campus to fill a collection guide.

works.title: Tracky
works.description: An open-source iOS app and Blender plugin: film a clip while the phone records camera pose, focal length, LiDAR depth, planes, anchors and a person mask, then import it into Blender to add AR effects that stay locked to the scene.
works.description_zh: 开源的 iOS 应用加 Blender 插件：拍视频时手机同时记录相机位姿、焦距、LiDAR 深度、平面、锚点和人像蒙版，导入 Blender 后加上的 AR 效果会稳稳贴合场景。
works.idea_en: Sketch AR ideas as believable videos without building the real app.
works.idea_zh: 不用先开发应用，也能把 AR 创意做成可信的概念视频。
works.technique: ARKit logs per-frame camera transforms, intrinsics, depth maps, segmentation masks and planes into a JSON-based .bren file, which the Blender add-on turns into an animated camera and aligned scene.
works.technique_zh: ARKit 逐帧记录相机变换、内参、深度图、分割蒙版和平面，存成基于 JSON 的 .bren 文件，Blender 插件据此还原动画相机和对齐的场景。
works.exercise_en: Record a 10-second phone clip with a camera-tracking tool (Tracky or Blender motion tracking), add one fake AR object in Blender, and render a concept video. Twist: the object must interact with something real in the shot, such as hiding behind it or bouncing on it.
works.exercise_zh: 用相机追踪工具（Tracky 或 Blender 运动追踪）拍一段 10 秒的手机视频，在 Blender 里加一个假的 AR 物体并渲染成概念视频；变体：这个物体必须和画面里的真实物体互动，比如躲到它后面或在上面弹跳。

works.title: Turning RC Cars into Pets
works.description: Overhead computer vision tracks several Arduino-controlled RC cars in real time and gives each one a personality, so they roam the floor like pets that react to him.
works.idea_zh: 给遥控车装上'性格'，让它们像宠物一样在地上游走、回应你。

video.video_title: I Turned My RC-Cars Into Pets

works.technique: A camera tracks each car with CV markers, and a behavior script sends steering commands back over radio so the physical cars act on virtual rules.
works.exercise_zh: 用 micro:bit 小车 + 头顶摄像头追踪，让小车'害怕'同学的脚并逃开；加一个变化：给每辆车一个投影在地上的情绪表情。
works.description_zh: 头顶的计算机视觉系统实时追踪几辆由 Arduino 控制的遥控车，并给每辆车赋予一种性格，让它们像宠物一样在地上游走，对他作出反应。
works.idea_en: Give RC cars personalities so they wander the floor and respond to you like pets.
works.technique_zh: 摄像头通过计算机视觉标记追踪每辆车，行为脚本再通过无线电发回转向指令，让实体小车按照虚拟规则行动。
works.exercise_en: Use micro:bit cars and an overhead camera for tracking, and make the cars afraid of classmates' feet so they run away. Twist: project an emotion face on the floor for each car.

works.title: Voice In My Head
works.description: Participants wear an earpiece through which an AI voice listens to their conversations and whispers real-time guidance, replacing their inner monologue as they move through social situations.
works.idea_zh: 耳机里有一个AI“内心声音”，在你与人交谈时实时耳语指导你。

video.video_title: Voice In My Head

works.technique: Speech recognition transcribes the wearer's surroundings, an LLM generates short suggestions conditioned on a personality profile, and text-to-speech delivers them through an earpiece with low latency.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机网页的语音识别加一个 LLM API，把对话摘要后生成一句建议，通过耳机用 TTS 悄悄念给你听；变体：给这个声音设定一个与你完全相反的性格，戴着它和同学聊 5 分钟再反思。
works.description_zh: 参与者戴上耳机，耳机里的 AI 声音会聆听他们的对话并实时低声给出指引，在各种社交场合中取代他们的内心独白。
works.idea_en: An AI inner voice in your earpiece whispers live advice while you talk to people.
works.technique_zh: 语音识别转写佩戴者周围的对话，LLM 根据设定的人格档案生成简短建议，再由文字转语音（TTS）以低延迟通过耳机播放。
works.exercise_en: Use speech recognition in a phone web page plus an LLM API to summarize a conversation into one suggestion, and have TTS read it quietly into your earphones. Twist: give the voice a personality that is the exact opposite of yours, chat with a classmate for 5 minutes while wearing it, then reflect.

works.title: Waking Products (Vision Pro concept)
works.description: A spatial-computing concept released after Vision Pro was announced: a physical indoor herb garden on a kitchen counter is 'woken up' by the user, revealing a layer of digital functionality around the real product.
works.description_zh: Vision Pro 发布后推出的空间计算概念：厨房台面上的一台室内种植机被用户“唤醒”，真实商品周围随即展开一层数字功能。
works.idea_en: Buying a physical product could also unlock a digital layer attached to it.
works.idea_zh: 买下一件实体商品，也同时解锁附着在它身上的数字层。
works.technique: Likely a mixed-reality concept in which the product is recognised and a UI is anchored to it, triggered by gaze and pinch.
works.technique_zh: 很可能是混合现实概念：识别出商品并把界面锚定在它身上，通过注视和捏合手势触发。
works.exercise_en: Pick a household product and design its 'awake' AR state: an image marker or object tracker opens a panel with one useful function and one playful one. Twist: the product falls asleep again when it is ignored.
works.exercise_zh: 选一件家用品，设计它被“唤醒”后的 AR 状态：用图像标记或物体追踪打开一个面板，包含一个实用功能和一个好玩的功能；变体：被冷落一段时间后，它会重新“睡着”。

video.video_title:
Devices like Vision Pro from @Apple create exciting opportunities for product extensions. Imagine “waking” a physical product to unlock digital functionality. 🤯

works.title: Wol: AI owl guide to the redwoods
works.description: An AR owl you talk to about the redwood forest ecosystem, running on phones and MR headsets from one web build.
works.idea_zh: 和一只 AR 猫头鹰对话，让它带你认识红杉林。

video.video_title: Wol - a mixed reality experience for the web powered by 8th Wall

works.technique: An anchored animated character is wired to speech recognition, an LLM prompted with forest-ecology context, and text-to-speech, and one web build adapts to phone or headset input.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中放一个动物角色，用语音识别 + LLM + TTS 让它回答关于某个生态系统的问题；变体：给角色设定它不知道的知识边界，让它在超出范围时承认不懂。
works.description_zh: 一只可以对话的 AR 猫头鹰，和你聊红杉林的生态系统；同一个网页版本可同时运行在手机和 MR 头显上。
works.idea_en: Talk with an AR owl that shows you around the redwood forest.
works.technique_zh: 一个锚定在空间中的动画角色接入了语音识别、带有森林生态背景提示词的 LLM 以及文字转语音；同一个网页版本可适配手机或头显的输入方式。
works.exercise_en: Place an animal character in AR and use speech recognition, an LLM and TTS so it answers questions about an ecosystem. Twist: give the character a boundary of knowledge and make it admit when a question goes beyond it.

works.title: WonkaVision
works.description: Johnny Lee's 2007 Wii head-tracking trick revived in Chrome with a normal webcam: as you move your head, a miniature 3D storefront shifts in perspective as if behind a window, and objects appear to pop out of the screen.
works.description_zh: 在 Chrome 里用普通摄像头复活 Johnny Lee 2007 年的 Wii 头部追踪技巧：头一动，屏幕里的迷你 3D 店铺就像窗外的景物一样改变透视，物体甚至像要跳出屏幕。
works.idea_en: Turn a flat screen into a window with nothing but a webcam.
works.idea_zh: 只靠一个摄像头，把平面屏幕变成一扇窗。
works.technique: MediaPipe Face Mesh iris landmarks estimate the eye's 3D position from the near-constant iris diameter (about 11.7 mm), and the scene is rendered with an off-axis perspective projection from that eye, all in the browser via WebAssembly.
works.technique_zh: 利用 MediaPipe Face Mesh 的虹膜关键点，根据人眼虹膜直径几乎恒定（约 11.7 毫米）推算眼睛的 3D 位置，再以该位置做离轴透视投影渲染，全部通过 WebAssembly 在浏览器中运行。
works.exercise_en: Use a browser face tracker to move a three.js camera with the viewer's head so a box scene behind the screen feels deep. Twist: make one object escape through the screen when the viewer leans in.
works.exercise_zh: 用浏览器人脸追踪让 three.js 相机跟随观众头部移动，让屏幕后面的盒子场景产生纵深感；变体：观众凑近时，让一个物体“钻出”屏幕。

video.video_title:
Johnny Lee famously hacked a Wii Remote to turn a 2D screen into a 3D window. We revived this trick in Chrome using a standard webcam.

Here’s how we did it. 🧵👇 https://t.co/lcKybr3pZD

works.title: AI Product Genie
works.description: Built right after Stable Diffusion came out: you speak a wish to a genie, it generates a custom product design such as a printed shirt or a plush toy, previews it in AR, and sends it to on-demand production.
works.description_zh: Stable Diffusion 一发布团队就做了这个“精灵”：你对它说出愿望，它生成定制商品图案（比如印花衬衫或毛绒玩具），在 AR 中预览，然后直接下单按需生产。
works.idea_en: Speak a wish, see the custom product in your room, buy it instantly.
works.idea_zh: 说出一个愿望，就能在房间里看到为你定制的商品并立刻买下。
works.technique: Speech becomes a Stable Diffusion prompt, the generated image is applied as a texture to a 3D product template shown in AR, and print-on-demand fulfilment likely sits behind the buy button.
works.technique_zh: 语音被转成 Stable Diffusion 提示词，生成的图像贴到 3D 商品模板上在 AR 中展示，购买按钮背后很可能接入按需印制。
works.exercise_en: Build a pipeline where a spoken prompt generates an image (any text-to-image API) that is wrapped onto a 3D mug or T-shirt and placed in AR. Twist: let a second student remix the wish by voice before it is placed.
works.exercise_zh: 搭一条流程：用语音提示生成图片（任意文生图 API），贴到 3D 马克杯或 T 恤上并放进 AR；变体：放置前让另一位同学用语音“改写”这个愿望。

video.video_title:
1/ As soon as StableDiffusion landed we dropped everything to build a GENIE! 🧞‍♂️

🎙 Voice UI
🖼 AI Art
😎 AR previews
🤑 Instant purchasing
📦 On-demand production

Could AI make every shopper’s wish com

works.title: Augmented Keyboard
works.description: A tracked physical keyboard on Quest 2 gets one smart virtual screen and context-aware overlays instead of a wall of virtual monitors.
works.idea_zh: 给实体键盘配一块智能虚拟屏幕，而不是一堆虚拟显示器。

video.video_title: In the Metaverse computers are semi-virtual : Augmented Keyboard - Meta Quest 2

works.technique: A tracked-keyboard SDK provides the keyboard pose, and a single virtual screen plus context overlays are placed relative to it instead of fixed in the room.
works.exercise_zh: 给真实键盘上方挂一块 AR 小屏幕，只显示当前正在输入的一行文字；变体：输入时根据文字情绪改变屏幕颜色。
works.description_zh: 在 Quest 2 上，被追踪的实体键盘配上一块智能虚拟屏幕和随情境变化的叠加信息，而不是一整面墙的虚拟显示器。
works.idea_en: Pair a physical keyboard with one smart virtual screen instead of a wall of virtual monitors.
works.technique_zh: 键盘追踪 SDK 提供键盘的位姿，单块虚拟屏幕和情境叠加信息都相对于键盘放置，而不是固定在房间中。
works.exercise_en: Hang a small AR screen above a real keyboard that shows only the line you are currently typing. Twist: change the screen color according to the mood of the text as you type.

works.title: Augmented Reality Dakota Landmap of the Twin Cities
works.description: An illustrated map of the Twin Cities with Dakota place names that becomes a 3D animated landscape when viewed through Adobe Aero.
works.idea_zh: 一张用达科他语地名重绘的城市地图，在AR中立体动起来
works.technique: An Adobe Aero scene anchors layered 3D illustrations and animations to the printed map image.
works.exercise_zh: 画一张本地区地图，标上老地名或方言名，用Adobe Aero让地标立体弹出；变化：每个地标点开后播放一段关于它的声音。

video.video_title: Augmented Reality Dakota Landmap of the Twin Cities

works.description_zh: 一幅标注了达科他语地名的双子城插画地图，通过 Adobe Aero 观看时会变成立体的动画地景。
works.idea_en: A city map redrawn with Dakota place names comes alive in 3D through AR.
works.technique_zh: Adobe Aero 场景将分层的三维插画和动画锚定在印刷地图的图像上。
works.exercise_en: Draw a map of your local area labeled with old or dialect place names, and use Adobe Aero to make the landmarks pop up in 3D. Twist: tapping each landmark plays a sound clip about it.

works.title: Biomolecular design in Realtalk
works.description: Scientists design proteins together on a Realtalk table, manipulating printed pages and physical controls that drive projected molecular models.
works.idea_zh: 科学家围着桌子，用纸和实物一起设计蛋白质分子。

video.video_title: Biomolecular design in Realtalk, Jul 2022

works.technique: Printed pages and physical controls such as knobs are tracked by Realtalk's camera system, and their state feeds a molecular modeling program whose output is projected onto the table for the group to manipulate together.
works.exercise_zh: 用俯视投影展示一个分子或数据模型，用贴了标记的纸条当“参数旋钮”（旋转角度被摄像头读取），多人同时操作不同参数；变体：换成你所在专业的一个复杂模型，看实体化是否帮助讨论。
works.description_zh: 科学家们在 Realtalk 桌面上一起设计蛋白质，通过操作打印的纸页和实体控件来驱动投影出的分子模型。
works.idea_en: Scientists gather around a table and design protein molecules together with paper and physical objects.
works.technique_zh: 打印纸页和旋钮等实体控件由 Realtalk 的摄像头系统追踪，其状态被输入分子建模程序，程序输出再投影到桌面上，供小组共同操作。
works.exercise_en: Show a molecule or data model with a top-down projector and use marker-tagged paper strips as parameter knobs whose rotation the camera reads, so several people can adjust different parameters at once. Twist: swap in a complex model from your own field and see whether making it physical helps the discussion.

works.title: Body Confetti lens
works.description: A Snapchat lens tracks the full body so bursts of confetti shoot out from the right limbs as you move and dance.
works.idea_zh: 跳舞时彩带从四肢喷出来。

video.video_title: Make Your Body a Confetti Party with Sallia Goldstein | Behind the Lens

works.technique: Lens Studio body-mesh tracking provides limb positions and velocities that trigger particle emitters attached to the body.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Lens Studio 身体追踪（或 MediaPipe Pose）让挥手时手上喷出彩纸；加一个变化：动作越快彩纸颜色越暖。
works.description_zh: 一个追踪全身的 Snapchat 滤镜：随着你移动和跳舞，彩色纸屑会从相应的肢体上喷射而出。
works.idea_en: Confetti bursts out of your limbs as you dance.
works.technique_zh: Lens Studio 的身体网格追踪提供肢体的位置和速度，用来触发附着在身体上的粒子发射器。
works.exercise_en: Use Lens Studio body tracking (or MediaPipe Pose) to make confetti spray from your hand when you wave. Twist: the faster you move, the warmer the confetti colors.

works.title: Bringing AR to the Streets of NYC
works.description: A short street intervention in which virtual objects appear among passers-by on New York sidewalks.
works.idea_zh: 把 AR 奇观直接投放到纽约街头路人中间。

video.video_title: Bringing AR to the streets of NYC

works.technique: Objects are placed on detected ground planes in world-tracked space outdoors, relying on SLAM stability while real passers-by move through the camera view (likely with people occlusion).
works.exercise_zh: 在校园人行道上放一组巨型虚拟物体并开启人体遮挡，拍一段路人从旁经过的视频；变体：让物体只在有人经过时才出现。
works.description_zh: 一次简短的街头介入：虚拟物体出现在纽约人行道上的往来行人之间。
works.idea_en: Drop AR spectacles straight into the crowds on New York streets.
works.technique_zh: 物体被放置在户外世界追踪空间中检测到的地面平面上，依赖 SLAM 的稳定性，同时有真实行人在摄像头画面中穿行（可能使用了人体遮挡）。
works.exercise_en: Place a group of giant virtual objects on a campus sidewalk with people occlusion turned on, and film passers-by walking past. Twist: make the objects appear only when someone walks by.

works.title: Character Mashup (Lensathon 2022)
works.description: Users custom-build a mashup avatar, bring it to life with body tracking, and share it with friends through connected lenses.
works.idea_zh: 拼一个自己的怪物化身，用身体驱动它，再和朋友同屏互动。

video.video_title: Character Mashup - Lensathon 2022

works.technique: Selected body parts are assembled onto a rig driven by full-body tracking, and connected lenses sync avatars between users.
works.exercise_zh: 让学生用纸画出头、身体、腿三部分，拼成一个角色并用 MediaPipe Pose 驱动；加一个变化：和同桌交换一个部件。
works.description_zh: 用户自己拼装一个混搭化身，用身体追踪让它活起来，再通过联机滤镜与朋友分享。
works.idea_en: Assemble your own monster avatar, drive it with your body, then play with friends on the same screen.
works.technique_zh: 选定的身体部件被组装到一套由全身追踪驱动的骨骼绑定上，联机滤镜在用户之间同步化身。
works.exercise_en: Have students draw a head, a body and legs on paper, combine them into a character and drive it with MediaPipe Pose. Twist: swap one part with your deskmate.

works.title: Charlie Parker memorial Custom Landmarker
works.description: Using Lens Studio's Custom Landmarker, a real Charlie Parker memorial statue is scanned so AR effects wrap precisely around the sculpture on site.
works.idea_zh: 把真实的纪念雕像变成 AR 的'舞台'，特效精确贴合雕像。

video.video_title: Snapchat Lens Studio - Custom Landmarkers w/ Charlie Parker memorial - Experiment #1

works.technique: A pre-scanned 3D model of the statue is used as a tracking target so the lens localizes against the physical monument and aligns effects to it.
works.exercise_zh: 选校园里一座雕塑或门牌，用 Lens Studio Custom Landmarker/8th Wall 做一个贴合它的 AR 特效；加一个变化：特效讲述这件物体的历史。
works.description_zh: 借助 Lens Studio 的 Custom Landmarker，对一座真实的 Charlie Parker 纪念雕像进行扫描，让 AR 特效在现场精确地环绕雕塑。
works.idea_en: Turn a real memorial statue into an AR stage, with effects fitted precisely to its shape.
works.technique_zh: 以预先扫描的雕像三维模型作为追踪目标，使滤镜相对实体纪念碑完成定位，并将特效与其对齐。
works.exercise_en: Pick a sculpture or door sign on campus and build an AR effect fitted to it with Lens Studio Custom Landmarker or 8th Wall. Twist: make the effect tell the history of the object.

works.title: Coachella: A Virtual Adventure
works.description: A case study of AR experiences built for Coachella that let festival-goers and remote fans unlock virtual worlds around the event.
works.idea_zh: 为音乐节做一场虚实混合的 AR 探险。

video.video_title: CASE STUDY: Coachella - A Virtual Adventure

works.technique: Location- and marker-triggered Instagram effects deliver themed AR scenes around the festival (likely world-anchored portals and target tracking).
works.exercise_zh: 为学校活动做一个 AR 寻宝：三个场地各扫出一个虚拟场景，集齐解锁终章；加一个变化：线上观众也能用同一特效参与。
works.description_zh: 一个为 Coachella 打造的 AR 体验案例：现场乐迷和远程粉丝都能在活动周边解锁虚拟世界。
works.idea_en: Build an AR adventure for a music festival that mixes the real and the virtual.
works.technique_zh: 由位置和标记触发的 Instagram 特效在音乐节各处呈现主题 AR 场景（大概率使用了锚定在世界空间中的传送门和目标追踪）。
works.exercise_en: Make an AR treasure hunt for a school event where each of three venues reveals a virtual scene and collecting all three unlocks the finale. Twist: online viewers can join with the same effect.

works.title: Colorfield Weather App Series
works.description: Virtual AR voxels fall from the sky or expand across a site, leaving trails that 'paint' colour-field paintings onto the environment's topography and architecture.
works.idea_zh: 让AR彩色方块从天而降，在建筑和地形上“画”出色域画
works.technique: AR voxel particles with gravity and forces collide with detected surfaces and leave persistent coloured trails.
works.exercise_zh: 用Unity AR Foundation或网页AR让彩色方块下落并在地面平面上留下颜色；变化：天气数据（温度/风速）决定颜色和下落方向。

video.video_title: Colorfield Weather App Series, 2022+

works.description_zh: 虚拟 AR 体素从天而降或在场地上蔓延，留下的轨迹在环境的地形和建筑上“画”出色域绘画。
works.idea_en: Colored AR blocks fall from the sky and paint color-field paintings across buildings and terrain.
works.technique_zh: 受重力和外力作用的 AR 体素粒子与检测到的表面发生碰撞，并留下持久的彩色轨迹。
works.exercise_en: Use Unity AR Foundation or web AR to drop colored blocks that leave color on the floor plane. Twist: weather data such as temperature and wind speed decides the colors and the direction of the fall.

works.title: Controlling a Soccer Game with a Real Ball
works.description: A webcam tracks a real football and his body pose so kicking the actual ball drives a digital football match in Unity.
works.idea_zh: 踢真球，屏幕里的比赛跟着动。

video.video_title: Controlling My Soccer Game With a REAL Ball

works.technique: Python computer vision detects the ball position and the player's pose from a webcam and streams them to Unity, which maps them into the game world.
works.exercise_zh: 用网页摄像头+颜色追踪让一个真实的纸团控制屏幕里的弹球；加一个变化：纸团撞到墙上的某块纸板区域时触发进球动画。
works.description_zh: 网络摄像头追踪一只真实足球和他的身体姿态，于是踢出真球就能驱动 Unity 中的一场数字足球比赛。
works.idea_en: Kick a real ball and the match on screen follows.
works.technique_zh: Python 计算机视觉程序从网络摄像头画面中检测球的位置和玩家姿态，并将数据实时传给 Unity，映射到游戏世界中。
works.exercise_en: Use a webcam and color tracking so a real paper ball controls a pinball on screen. Twist: trigger a goal animation when the paper ball hits a particular cardboard area on the wall.

works.title: Dakota Sacred Hoop Walk
works.description: An AR exhibit that helps visitors understand nature, land and culture from a Dakota perspective through artwork revealed at stations along a walk.
works.idea_zh: 沿着“神圣之环”步道，用AR从达科他视角理解土地
works.technique: Phone-based AR triggered at stations along the path overlays animated Dakota artwork and teachings.
works.exercise_zh: 在校园选4个方位点，用AR分别展示与东南西北相关的自然知识；变化：只有按顺序走完一圈才解锁最后的动画。

video.video_title: New augmented reality exhibit Dakota Sacred Hoop Walk opens

works.description_zh: 一场 AR 展览：沿步道设置的各个站点展示艺术作品，帮助参观者从达科他人的视角理解自然、土地与文化。
works.idea_en: Walk the Sacred Hoop trail and use AR to understand the land from a Dakota perspective.
works.technique_zh: 沿路各站点触发的手机 AR 叠加显示达科他艺术作品动画和相关教诲。
works.exercise_en: Choose four points on campus for the four directions and use AR to show nature knowledge tied to east, south, west and north. Twist: the final animation unlocks only after you walk the full circle in order.

works.title: DigituSync
works.description: Two people wear gloves linked by adjustable mechanical bars, so when a piano teacher curls a finger the learner's finger curls too, and both still feel the real keys.
works.description_zh: 两个人戴上由可调机械杆相连的手套：钢琴老师弯一下手指，学生的手指也跟着弯，而且两个人都还能感受到真实的琴键。
works.idea_en: Physically couple two hands so skills transfer by touch rather than by watching.
works.idea_zh: 把两只手在物理上连起来，让技能靠触觉而不是靠观看来传递。
works.technique: Uses passive four-bar linkages with a variable-length link to transmit finger motion and force between users and tune how strongly the leader intervenes.
works.technique_zh: 利用带可变长度连杆的被动四连杆机构，在两人之间传递手指的动作和力量，并调节引导者的干预强度。
works.exercise_en: Tie two students' index fingers together with elastic bands and a ruler splint, then play a simple phone piano app together; compare accuracy with watching a video tutorial. Twist: loosen the band halfway through to fade out the teacher.
works.exercise_zh: 用橡皮筋和尺子做成夹板，把两名学生的食指连在一起，用手机钢琴 App 合弹一首简单的曲子，并与看视频教程的准确率比较；变体：弹到一半把橡皮筋放松，让“老师”逐渐退出。

video.video_title: DigituSync: A Dual-User Passive Exoskeleton Glove That Adaptively Shares Hand Gestures

works.title: DreamStream
works.description: Instead of watching a flat Twitch stream, spectators step into the streamer's VR world, look over their shoulder, wander off to explore and chat with the player in 3D.
works.description_zh: 观众不再看平面的 Twitch 直播，而是走进主播的 VR 世界，从主播肩后观看、独自走开探索，并在三维空间里和玩家交流。
works.idea_en: Stream the whole world, not just the player's window into it.
works.idea_zh: 直播整个世界，而不只是玩家看世界的那扇窗。
works.technique: Streams 3D scene state and player poses from existing VR apps to remote spectators who render the environment locally with free viewpoints.
works.technique_zh: 从现有 VR 应用中把三维场景状态和玩家位姿流式传给远程观众，观众在本地渲染环境，可自由选择视角。
works.exercise_en: Run a tabletop AR game on one phone and let three spectator phones join the same shared AR anchor so they can walk around the table independently. Twist: give spectators one ability, like dropping a hint marker.
works.exercise_zh: 在一部手机上运行桌面 AR 游戏，让另外三部“观众”手机加入同一个共享 AR 锚点，自由绕着桌子观看；变体：给观众一个能力，比如放下一个提示标记。

video.video_title: DreamStream: Immersive and Interactive Spectating in VR

works.title: Electrical Head Actuation
works.description: Electrodes on the neck gently turn the wearer's head left, right, up or down, so a system can direct attention toward something in mixed reality without any arrow on screen.
works.description_zh: 贴在脖子上的电极能轻轻地把佩戴者的头转向左、右、上、下，系统无需在屏幕上画箭头，就能把注意力引向混合现实中的某个目标。
works.idea_en: Instead of drawing an arrow, the interface turns your head for you.
works.idea_zh: 界面不画箭头，而是直接帮你转头。
works.technique: Applies electrical muscle stimulation to specific neck muscles to actuate head yaw and pitch, calibrated per user for direction and strength.
works.technique_zh: 对特定的颈部肌肉施加电刺激来驱动头部的偏航和俯仰，并针对每个用户校准方向和强度。
works.exercise_en: Design a phone AR scene with a hidden object and compare three guidance cues: an arrow, spatial audio, and a partner gently tapping one shoulder; time how fast people find it. Twist: try the tap cue with eyes closed and describe how it feels to be steered.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机 AR 做一个藏着物体的场景，比较三种引导方式：箭头、空间音效、以及同伴轻拍一侧肩膀，记录找到目标所需时间；变体：闭上眼睛只用拍肩引导，描述“被操控”是什么感觉。

video.video_title: Electrical Head Actuation: Enabling Interactive Systems to Manipulate Head Orientation (CHI22)

works.title: FACING LIFE [In Doc Tri Nation]
works.description: A real-time rendered installation about social conditioning in which visitors' presence and faces animate child-like avatars that are gradually 'adapted' by social codes.
works.idea_zh: 你的脸与动作驱动一个逐渐被社会规训的虚拟孩子
works.technique: Unity real-time rendering driven by a camera, likely using face and body tracking to map the viewer onto the projected avatar.
works.exercise_zh: 用Unity或网页面部追踪让同学驱动一个卡通孩子形象，再加入“规则”逐步限制它的表情；变化：由观众投票决定下一个被禁止的表情。

video.video_title: FACING LIFE [In Doc Tri Nation] - interactive audiovisual installation, Unity

works.description_zh: 一件关于社会规训的实时渲染装置：参观者的在场与面孔驱动着孩童般的化身，而这些化身会逐渐被社会规范“改造”。
works.idea_en: Your face and movement drive a virtual child who is gradually disciplined by society.
works.technique_zh: 由摄像头驱动的 Unity 实时渲染，可能利用面部和身体追踪将观众映射到投影出的化身上。
works.exercise_en: Use Unity or web face tracking so classmates drive a cartoon child, then add rules that gradually restrict its expressions. Twist: the audience votes on which expression gets banned next.

works.title: Home Goods in AR (Shop app)
works.description: After Shopify brought on the Primer team (whose app previewed paint, tile and wallpaper on real walls), they shipped a 'Visualize before you buy' section in the Shop app where shoppers drop furniture and lamps into their own room.
works.description_zh: Shopify 收购 Primer 团队（其应用能在真实墙面上预览油漆、瓷砖和墙纸）后，团队在 Shop 应用里上线了“买之前先看看”板块，购物者可以把家具和灯具直接放进自己的房间。
works.idea_en: Put AR one tap away inside everyday shopping instead of in a separate app.
works.idea_zh: 把 AR 放进日常购物流程里，点一下就能用，而不是另开一个应用。
works.technique: Likely built on ARKit and AR Quick Look with USDZ product models, so any listing with a 3D model opens a true-scale preview in the shopper's room.
works.technique_zh: 很可能基于 ARKit 和 AR Quick Look，商品配有 USDZ 模型，任何带 3D 模型的商品都能一键以真实尺寸放进房间预览。
works.exercise_en: Build a three-product mini store page where each product opens a 1:1 AR preview (model-viewer or Quick Look), then run a quick 'which would you buy' test with classmates. Twist: add a 'will it fit?' check that warns when the model is larger than a measured spot.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个只有三件商品的迷你商店页面，每件商品都能打开 1:1 的 AR 预览（model-viewer 或 Quick Look），再让同学投票选出最想买的；变体：加一个“放得下吗？”检测，模型比量好的空位大时给出提醒。

video.video_title:

works.title: Instructional AR
works.description: Hands-free assembly with a Quest Pro: parts laid out on the floor are identified, wobbly guide lines show which pieces connect, tracked parts snap together with playful effects, and voice commands move between steps.
works.description_zh: 戴着 Quest Pro 免手持组装：地上摆好的零件被一一标出，弹性的引导线告诉你哪两个零件相连，被追踪的零件拼上时有俏皮的动效，用语音切换步骤。
works.idea_en: Replace a 15-page manual with instructions that live on the parts themselves.
works.idea_zh: 用长在零件上的指引，取代 15 页的说明书。
works.technique: Quest Pro controllers attached to physical parts give inside-out 6DoF tracking of the pieces, so Unity can draw 3D connection guides in passthrough while voice commands advance the steps.
works.technique_zh: 把 Quest Pro 手柄固定在实物零件上，利用手柄自带的 inside-out 六自由度追踪定位零件，Unity 在透视画面中绘制 3D 连接引导，语音指令切换步骤。
works.exercise_en: Pick a simple 3-5 step build (LEGO or a paper model) and make an AR guide that anchors each step's arrow or ghost part on the real pieces, with a voice command for 'next'. Twist: make the guide react when a step is done wrong.
works.exercise_zh: 选一个 3–5 步的简单拼装（乐高或纸模型），做一个 AR 指引，把每一步的箭头或半透明零件锚定在真实零件上，并用语音说“下一步”；变体：装错时让指引做出反应。

video.video_title:
Been there—15 pages deep in cryptic instructions, surrounded by scattered parts feeling like 😵‍💫

Now with headsets like Quest Pro enabling hands-free AR, you can see 3D build instructions right in yo

works.title: KAWS: FAMILY AR experience (AGO)
works.description: At the Art Gallery of Ontario, visitors open the Acute Art app to see KAWS's giant sculptures appear inside the Galleria Italia alongside the physical exhibition.
works.idea_zh: 在美术馆长廊里用手机召唤出巨型KAWS雕塑
works.technique: Acute Art's app uses plane detection and site-specific placement to anchor large animated 3D sculptures in the gallery space.
works.exercise_zh: 为学校走廊设计一个超大尺寸的AR雕塑（Reality Composer/Adobe Aero），研究比例带来的震撼；变化：雕塑会看向离它最近的观众。

video.video_title: KAWS: FAMILY instructional video for AR experience

works.description_zh: 在安大略美术馆（Art Gallery of Ontario），参观者打开 Acute Art 应用，就能看到 KAWS 的巨型雕塑出现在 Galleria Italia 长廊中，与实体展览并置。
works.idea_en: Summon giant KAWS sculptures into a museum gallery with your phone.
works.technique_zh: Acute Art 应用利用平面检测和针对场地的定点放置，将大型三维动画雕塑锚定在美术馆空间中。
works.exercise_en: Design an oversized AR sculpture for a school corridor with Reality Composer or Adobe Aero, and study the impact that scale creates. Twist: the sculpture turns to look at the nearest viewer.

works.title: Lightship VPS for Web
works.description: 8th Wall and Niantic brought centimetre-level visual positioning to the mobile browser, so WebAR content can be anchored to specific real-world locations without an app.
works.idea_zh: 无需下载App，在浏览器里就能把AR内容精确锚定在真实地点。

video.video_title: Introducing Lightship VPS for Web

works.technique: Browser camera frames are matched against a prebuilt map of a location to return a 6DoF pose, letting WebAR content be anchored to a specific place.
works.exercise_zh: 用图像标记在网页 AR 中模拟“地点定位”：扫描门口的海报后，内容固定出现在门框上；变体：每次打开时显示上一位访客留下的一句话。
works.description_zh: 8th Wall 与 Niantic 把厘米级的视觉定位带进了手机浏览器，WebAR 内容无需安装应用就能锚定在特定的真实地点。
works.idea_en: Anchor AR content precisely to real places right in the browser, with no app to download.
works.technique_zh: 将浏览器的摄像头画面与预先构建的地点地图进行匹配，返回 6DoF 位姿，从而把 WebAR 内容锚定在特定地点。
works.exercise_en: Simulate location-based positioning in web AR with an image marker: after scanning a poster by the door, content appears fixed on the door frame. Twist: each time it opens, show a sentence left by the previous visitor.

works.title: Live Music with My Clothes in AR
works.description: A live performance in which touching different parts of his outfit triggers AR instruments and visuals.
works.idea_zh: 拍打衣服的不同部位，就能用 AR 现场演奏音乐。

video.video_title: I used AR to make live music with my clothes #shorts

works.technique: Body or surface tracking locates regions of the outfit, and hand-to-region proximity triggers instrument samples and AR visuals (likely via body segmentation plus hand tracking).
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe Pose 把胸口、肩膀、膝盖设为“按键”，手碰到时播放对应乐器音色；变体：按键位置随衣服上贴的彩色贴纸决定。
works.description_zh: 一场现场表演：触碰服装的不同部位，就能触发 AR 乐器和视觉效果。
works.idea_en: Tap different parts of your clothes to play music live in AR.
works.technique_zh: 身体或表面追踪定位服装上的各个区域，手与区域的接近程度触发乐器采样和 AR 视觉效果（可能通过身体分割加手部追踪实现）。
works.exercise_en: Use MediaPipe Pose to turn your chest, shoulders and knees into keys that play different instrument sounds when your hand touches them. Twist: key positions are set by colored stickers on your clothes.

works.title: Look over there! Saliency Modulation
works.description: Instead of arrows or outlines, AR glasses subtly boost the target object and dampen its surroundings, so your eyes drift to the right place without any visible marker.
works.description_zh: AR 眼镜不用箭头或轮廓线，而是悄悄增强目标物体、弱化其周围，让你的视线在没有任何可见标记的情况下自然移向正确的位置。
works.idea_en: Guide attention by editing how noticeable reality is, not by adding more graphics.
works.idea_zh: 通过编辑现实的“显眼程度”来引导注意力，而不是再加更多图形。
works.technique: Computes a saliency map of the scene and applies local contrast and colour changes through the display to raise the target's saliency relative to distractors.
works.technique_zh: 计算场景的显著性图，并通过显示器施加局部对比度和色彩变化，提高目标相对于干扰物的显著性。
works.exercise_en: Build a phone camera filter that slightly desaturates everything except one tracked object, then ask classmates to name the first thing they notice. Twist: make the effect so subtle that people cannot say why they looked there.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个手机相机滤镜，除一个被追踪的物体外，其余一切都轻微去色，然后问同学最先注意到的是什么；变体：让效果细微到大家说不出自己为什么会看那里。

video.video_title: Investigating Saliency Modulation for Visual Guidance with Augmented Reality Glasses

works.title: Opportunistic Interfaces (Ad hoc UI)
works.description: A CHI 2022 Interactivity with Ruofei Du, Alex Olwal and colleagues at Google: any everyday object picked up from the desk, such as a cup or a marker, instantly becomes a tangible 6DoF controller for AR content.
works.description_zh: 与 Google 的 Ruofei Du、Alex Olwal 等人合作的 CHI 2022 互动展示：从桌上随手拿起的任何日常物品，比如杯子或马克笔，立刻就能变成控制 AR 内容的 6DoF 实体控制器。
works.idea_en: Whatever is at hand can become the controller.
works.idea_zh: 手边有什么，什么就能变成控制器。
works.technique: Likely real-time 6DoF pose estimation of arbitrary objects from the camera, mapping object translation and rotation to UI parameters on the fly.
works.technique_zh: 很可能是从相机实时估计任意物体的 6DoF 位姿，并即时把物体的平移和旋转映射到界面参数上。
works.exercise_en: Use a marker taped to any object and map its tilt and distance to two sliders in phone AR. Twist: let the user choose the mapping by shaking the object.
works.exercise_zh: 在任意物体上贴一个标记，把它的倾斜和距离映射到手机 AR 里的两个滑杆。变体：让用户通过摇动物体来选择映射方式。

video.video_title: [CHI 2022 Interactivity] Opportunistic Interfaces for Augmented Reality (Ad hoc UI preview)

works.title: Parallel Ping-Pong
works.description: One user in VR controls two robot arms playing table tennis at two tables simultaneously, switching perspective between bodies to hit both balls.
works.idea_zh: 一个人同时操控两个身体打两场乒乓球。

video.video_title: Parallel Ping-Pong: Demonstrating Parallel Interaction through Multiple Bodies by a Single User

works.technique: Streams two robot-mounted camera views into an HMD and maps the user's single arm motion to whichever robot body is currently selected or blended.
works.exercise_zh: 用两部手机分别拍两个桌面小游戏，把画面并排投到一块屏幕上，让一名同学同时用双手远程指挥两位“替身”同学；变化：两个画面每10秒左右对调。
works.description_zh: 一名用户在 VR 中操控两条机械臂，同时在两张球台上打乒乓球，在两个身体之间切换视角，把两颗球都打回去。
works.idea_en: One person controls two bodies to play two ping-pong matches at once.
works.technique_zh: 将两个机器人身上摄像头的画面实时传入头显，并把用户单臂的动作映射到当前选中或混合的机器人身体上。
works.exercise_en: Film two tabletop mini-games with two phones, show the feeds side by side on one screen, and have one classmate use both hands to remotely direct two stand-in classmates at once. Twist: swap the two feeds roughly every 10 seconds.

works.title: Playing Pompidou
works.description: An audio AR lens turns the Centre Pompidou into a musical instrument: visitors 'play' the building's surfaces and compose music from sounds recorded inside the museum.
works.idea_zh: 把整座蓬皮杜中心变成一件可以演奏的乐器。

video.video_title: Playing Pompidou: an audio AR Experience by Christian Marclay x Snapchat

works.technique: The lens localizes against the building and maps sound samples to architectural elements, so pointing and tapping at parts of the facade triggers and sequences them.
works.exercise_zh: 录下教学楼里的各种声音（门、楼梯、水管），用 AR 把它们贴到对应位置，点哪里就响哪里；加一个变化：把点击顺序录成一段旋律。
works.description_zh: 一个音频 AR 滤镜把蓬皮杜中心变成了一件乐器：参观者“演奏”建筑的各个表面，用在馆内录制的声音创作音乐。
works.idea_en: Turn the entire Centre Pompidou into an instrument you can play.
works.technique_zh: 滤镜相对建筑完成定位，并将声音采样映射到各个建筑构件上，指向并点击立面的不同部分即可触发和编排这些声音。
works.exercise_en: Record sounds around the teaching building (doors, stairs, water pipes), pin them to their locations in AR, and make each spot sound when tapped. Twist: record your tapping order as a melody.

works.title: Playing with realities in ShapeXR
works.description: Digital-twin experiments in ShapeXR where a virtual copy of his room lines up with the real one, letting him fade between passthrough and virtual versions of the same space.
works.idea_zh: 让房间的数字孪生与真实房间重合，在两者之间自由切换。

video.video_title: Playing with realities in ShapeXR - Meta Quest 2

works.technique: A digital-twin model of the room is aligned to the real room at 1:1, and a crossfade between passthrough and the twin lets the user compare or transition between the two.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Polycam 扫描教室一角，在 AR 中与真实空间对齐，并用滑块在真实和扫描版之间淡入淡出；变体：在扫描版里偷偷改动一个细节，让同学找出来。
works.description_zh: 在 ShapeXR 中进行的数字孪生实验：房间的虚拟副本与真实房间严丝合缝地重合，他可以在同一空间的透视画面与虚拟版本之间淡入淡出。
works.idea_en: Overlay a room's digital twin on the real room and switch freely between the two.
works.technique_zh: 房间的数字孪生模型以 1:1 比例与真实房间对齐，在透视画面与孪生模型之间交叉淡化，让用户对比或在两者之间过渡。
works.exercise_en: Scan a corner of the classroom with Polycam, align it with the real space in AR, and use a slider to fade between the real and scanned versions. Twist: secretly change one detail in the scan and have classmates find it.

works.title: Real Hole in the Wall Game
works.description: A full-body game based on Japan's Brain Wall: a webcam reads his pose and a heart-rate monitor adds pressure as walls with body-shaped holes rush toward him.
works.idea_zh: 根据《墙来了》：用身体摆出墙上洞的形状才能过关。

video.video_title: I Made a Real HOLE IN THE WALL Game

works.technique: MoveNet pose estimation extracts body keypoints from a webcam, which are compared against the silhouette of each incoming wall hole.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Teachable Machine 或 MoveNet 做一个'墙来了'：屏幕上出现姿势轮廓，同学要在 3 秒内摆出来；加一个变化：两个人合体才能过一面墙。
works.description_zh: 一款基于日本节目《墙来了》（Brain Wall）的全身游戏：网络摄像头读取他的姿态，心率监测器制造额外压力，而带着人形洞口的墙正朝他飞速逼近。
works.idea_en: Based on Brain Wall: shape your body to match the hole in the wall to get through.
works.technique_zh: MoveNet 姿态估计从网络摄像头画面中提取身体关键点，并与每面来袭墙体上洞口的轮廓进行比对。
works.exercise_en: Build a Hole in the Wall game with Teachable Machine or MoveNet where a pose outline appears on screen and a classmate has 3 seconds to match it. Twist: two people must combine their bodies to pass one wall.

works.title: Reality Channels (Liquid City)
works.description: A prototype of the 'real-world metaverse' in which users switch between channels that re-skin the same street with different AR layers, characters and information.
works.idea_zh: 像换电视频道一样切换城市的AR皮肤

video.video_title: Reality Channels, a slice of the Real-World Metaverse

works.technique: Shared world-scale AR using Niantic Lightship meshing/VPS so several content layers are anchored to the same street and swapped at runtime like channels.
works.exercise_zh: 在同一张桌面或同一面墙上做三个 AR“频道”（如童话、监控、广告），用滑动手势切换；变体：让两台手机看到的频道不同，讨论共同空间里的不同现实。
works.description_zh: “现实世界元宇宙”的一个原型：用户可以在不同频道之间切换，每个频道都用不同的 AR 图层、角色和信息为同一条街道换上新皮肤。
works.idea_en: Switch the city's AR skins like changing TV channels.
works.technique_zh: 利用 Niantic Lightship 的网格重建和 VPS 实现共享的城市尺度 AR，多个内容图层锚定在同一条街道上，并能像频道一样在运行时切换。
works.exercise_en: Make three AR channels on the same tabletop or wall (for example fairy tale, surveillance and advertising) and switch between them with a swipe. Twist: let two phones see different channels and discuss the different realities in a shared space.

works.title: RealityTalk
works.description: While a presenter speaks, keywords are recognized and turned into AR text, images and graphics that the presenter can grab and place with hand gestures around their body.
works.idea_zh: 边说话边让关键词变成AR图文漂浮在身边，用手抓过来讲故事。

video.video_title: [UIST 2022] RealityTalk: Real-time Speech-driven Augmented Presentation for AR Live Storytelling

works.technique: Streaming speech recognition extracts keywords, which are turned into text or images and placed in the camera view, while hand tracking lets the presenter grab and reposition them in the space around their body.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Web Speech API 识别演讲者说出的关键词，把对应的文字或 emoji 贴到摄像头画面中，并用 MediaPipe Hands 捏合手势移动它们；变体：做一个 60 秒的“AR 口头报告”，内容元素必须由你的话语召唤出来。
works.description_zh: 演讲者说话时，系统识别出关键词并把它们变成 AR 文字、图片和图形，演讲者可以用手势抓取这些元素，放到身体周围。
works.idea_en: As you talk, keywords turn into AR text and images floating around you that you can grab to tell your story.
works.technique_zh: 流式语音识别提取关键词，并将其转换为文字或图片放入摄像头画面中，同时手部追踪让演讲者能在身体周围的空间中抓取并重新摆放它们。
works.exercise_en: Use the Web Speech API to detect keywords a speaker says, stick matching text or emoji into the camera view, and move them with a MediaPipe Hands pinch gesture. Twist: give a 60-second AR talk in which every visual element must be summoned by your words.

works.title: Retail Research Kit
works.description: Volunteers wore a Quest Pro while shopping in Paxton Gate, a San Francisco curiosity shop; their gaze and touches were replayed on a 3D scan of the store as heatmaps so a small merchant can see what draws attention.
works.description_zh: 志愿者戴着 Quest Pro 在旧金山的奇物店 Paxton Gate 购物，他们的视线和触摸被映射到店铺 3D 扫描上生成热力图，让小商家看清顾客被什么吸引。
works.idea_en: Turn a headset's eye tracking into affordable shopper research for small shops.
works.idea_zh: 把头显的眼动追踪变成小店也用得起的顾客研究工具。
works.technique: The shop was scanned with Polycam and aligned in Unity; Quest Pro eye-tracking rays and hand-tracking contacts are painted onto the mesh with a texture-painting shader to build 3D gaze and touch heatmaps.
works.technique_zh: 用 Polycam 扫描店铺并在 Unity 中对齐，再把 Quest Pro 的眼动射线和手部接触点用纹理绘制着色器画到网格上，形成 3D 注视与触摸热力图。
works.exercise_en: Scan a classroom shelf, log where testers look or point (head direction in phone AR is fine), and paint the hits onto the scan as a heatmap. Twist: compare heatmaps for two different product arrangements.
works.exercise_zh: 扫描教室的一个书架，记录测试者看向或指向的位置（手机 AR 用头部朝向即可），把命中点画到扫描模型上形成热力图；变体：对比两种商品摆放方式的热力图。

video.video_title:

works.title: Reverse AR
works.description: Instead of placing a virtual sofa in a real room, a shopper sits on a real sofa in the store while the phone wraps a 3D scan of their own living room around it; two shoppers can share the view and spin the room with gestures.
works.description_zh: 不是把虚拟沙发放进真实房间，而是让顾客在店里坐上真沙发，手机把他家客厅的 3D 扫描包裹在沙发周围；两位顾客可以共享画面，并用手势旋转整个房间。
works.idea_en: Flip AR: keep the product real and make the room virtual.
works.idea_zh: 把 AR 反过来：商品是真的，房间是虚拟的。
works.technique: The home is captured with RoomPlan or photogrammetry, and in the store the real furniture is cut out of the camera feed with LiDAR depth-based segmentation inside a bounding box, then composited into the virtual room in Unity with AR Foundation.
works.technique_zh: 先用 RoomPlan 或摄影测量扫描家里；到了店里，用 LiDAR 深度在包围盒内把真实家具从画面中分割出来，再在 Unity + AR Foundation 中合成进虚拟房间。
works.exercise_en: Scan a room at home with a free photogrammetry app, bring it to class, and composite a real chair (cut out with a depth or person mask) into it on a phone. Twist: place the real object in an impossible room, such as underwater or on the Moon.
works.exercise_zh: 用免费摄影测量应用扫描家里的一个房间带到课堂，在手机上把一把真实椅子（用深度或人像蒙版抠出）合成进去；变体：把真实物体放进一个不可能的房间，比如海底或月球。

video.video_title:
Could you tell which room was virtual? 👀

Traditional AR can’t tell you how a couch feels. Our team @Shopify explored "Reverse AR" to wrap a virtual room around a real thing. Sit on a couch in-store w

works.title: SUPER SLIT SCAN
works.description: A slit-scan camera app that smears time across the frame, turning moving people into stretched, warped sculptures.
works.idea_zh: 用狭缝扫描把时间铺进画面，把人变成扭曲的时空雕塑。

video.video_title: SUPER SLIT SCAN - iOS app

works.technique: Recent camera frames are stored in a 3D texture (ring buffer), and a shader samples each pixel row or column from a different time slice to produce slit-scan distortion.
works.exercise_zh: 在 p5.js 或 three.js 中保存最近 120 帧摄像头画面，每一行像素取不同帧的内容做出时间扫描效果；变体：把时间偏移改为按离画面中心的距离分布。
works.description_zh: 一款狭缝扫描相机应用，把时间涂抹在画面上，让移动的人变成被拉长、扭曲的雕塑。
works.idea_en: Spread time across the frame with slit-scan and turn people into warped sculptures of space and time.
works.technique_zh: 最近的摄像头帧被存入一张三维纹理（环形缓冲区），着色器让每一行或每一列像素从不同的时间切片采样，形成狭缝扫描式的变形。
works.exercise_en: Store the last 120 camera frames in p5.js or three.js and take each pixel row from a different frame to create a time-scan effect. Twist: distribute the time offset by distance from the center of the frame instead.

works.title: SURF-AR
works.description: A fitness Lens that teaches anyone to surf on dry land in four steps, guiding each pose and capturing a 3D version of the learner so they can inspect their own form from any angle.
works.description_zh: 一个健身 Lens，用四个步骤在陆地上教任何人冲浪：逐步引导每个姿势，并捕捉学习者的 3D 分身，让人从任意角度检查自己的动作。
works.idea_en: Let learners walk around a 3D replay of their own body to see what a coach would see.
works.idea_zh: 让学习者绕着自己身体的 3D 回放走一圈，看到教练眼中的自己。
works.technique: Full-body tracking and a 3D body mesh record the user's pose at each step, then place the captured figure in world space for review.
works.technique_zh: 用全身追踪和 3D 身体网格记录用户每一步的姿势，再把捕捉到的人形放到世界空间里供回看。
works.exercise_en: Build a body-tracked Lens that teaches one sport or yoga pose in three steps and freezes a 3D snapshot of the student at each step. Twist: overlay the teacher's snapshot in a different colour for comparison.
works.exercise_zh: 制作一个人体追踪 Lens，分三步教一个运动或瑜伽动作，每一步都冻结一张学生的 3D 快照；变体：用另一种颜色叠加老师的快照做对比。

video.video_title: Become a SURF-AR | Lensathon Submission

works.title: Scanning My Son While He Slept
works.description: Mikko used Apple's Object Capture to scan his two-year-old son while he slept, imagining a future where he can put on a headset and see him at that age in perfect scale.
works.description_zh: Mikko 用苹果的 Object Capture 扫描了熟睡中两岁的儿子，想象将来戴上头显，就能以真实比例看到孩子这个年纪的样子。
works.idea_en: 3D scans as next-level family portraits and time capsules.
works.idea_zh: 把 3D 扫描当作升级版的全家福和时间胶囊。
