works.technique: Photos taken around the still subject are processed by Apple's Object Capture photogrammetry API on a Mac into a textured USDZ model that can be viewed at 1:1 scale in AR.
works.technique_zh: 围绕静止的对象拍摄照片，在 Mac 上用苹果 Object Capture 摄影测量 API 生成带纹理的 USDZ 模型，可在 AR 中以 1:1 比例查看。
works.exercise_en: Make a 1:1 AR time capsule: scan a meaningful object or a very still classmate and attach a short note that appears next to it in AR. Twist: design how and when the capsule may be opened in ten years.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个 1:1 的 AR 时间胶囊：扫描一件有意义的物品或一位保持不动的同学，并附上一段在 AR 中出现在旁边的留言；变体：设计十年后这个胶囊该如何、何时被打开。

video.video_title: Recently I scanned my son using Object Capture while he slept. It's mind blowing that when he's older I'll be able to slide on an AR/VR headset and see what he looked like at age 2 in perfect scale. N

works.title: Sketched Reality
works.description: Sketches in AR interact bidirectionally with small tabletop robots: a drawn ramp makes the robot move, and a robot bumping a drawn spring makes the sketch bounce.
works.idea_zh: 画出来的弹簧能弹开真实小机器人，机器人也能推动画出来的东西。

video.video_title: [UIST 2022] Sketched Reality: Sketching Bi-Directional Interactions Between Virtual & Physical World

works.technique: Small tabletop robots are tracked in the AR view and sketches are converted into physics bodies, so the simulation both sends motor commands to the robots and updates the sketch from the robots' measured positions.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机 AR 识别一个带标记的小车（或同学手推的玩具），在屏幕上画一条斜坡或墙壁，小车碰到时虚拟线条会弹动；变体：让画出来的东西去“指挥”真实小车（可用 micro:bit 小车）。
works.description_zh: AR 中的草图与桌面小机器人双向互动：画出的斜坡会让机器人移动，而机器人撞上画出的弹簧时，草图也会弹起来。
works.idea_en: A drawn spring can bounce a real little robot, and the robot can push drawn things too.
works.technique_zh: 桌面小机器人在 AR 视图中被追踪，草图被转换为物理刚体，因此物理模拟既向机器人发送电机指令，也根据机器人的实测位置更新草图。
works.exercise_en: Use phone AR to recognize a small marker-tagged car (or a toy a classmate pushes by hand), draw a ramp or wall on screen, and make the virtual line bounce when the car hits it. Twist: let the drawn objects command the real car, for example a micro:bit car.

works.title: Space Eraser
works.description: An iPhone scans a room with Apple's RoomPlan, textures the scanned boxes with live camera pixels and lays this digital twin 1:1 over the room, so you can erase the sofa, the dog or everything and then swipe through new furniture sets.
works.description_zh: iPhone 用苹果的 RoomPlan 扫描房间，用实时画面给扫描出的方块贴图，再把这个数字孪生 1:1 叠回真实房间；你可以擦掉沙发、狗甚至所有家具，再滑动切换整套新家具。
works.idea_en: Give your room a reset button before you shop for furniture.
works.idea_zh: 买家具之前，先给房间按一下“重置键”。
works.technique: RoomPlan's semantically labelled USDZ boxes are realigned to the room with ARWorldMap, textured from live camera frames plus LiDAR depth, and the hidden areas are likely filled with ML inpainting.
works.technique_zh: RoomPlan 输出带语义标签的 USDZ 方块，用 ARWorldMap 与真实房间对齐，再结合实时画面和 LiDAR 深度贴图；被擦除区域很可能用机器学习补全（inpainting）。
works.exercise_en: Scan one corner of the classroom (RoomPlan, Polycam or a hand-built box model), overlay it in AR, and let users tap an object to hide it behind a painted wall texture. Twist: instead of erasing, swap the object for a funny replacement of the same size.
works.exercise_zh: 扫描教室的一个角落（RoomPlan、Polycam 或手工搭的方块模型），在 AR 中叠回原位，让用户点一下某个物体就用墙面贴图把它“藏起来”；变体：不擦除，而是换成一个同尺寸的搞笑替代物。

video.video_title:
We've had fun playing with @Apple's new #RoomPlan API @Shopify 

What if your room had a reset button? ✨ https://t.co/H50aROpne7

works.title: Spatial Admin
works.description: A Quest Pro prototype for merchants: open a virtual photo studio on your desk, arrange and light a 3D product, and capture product shots through a floating live-camera viewfinder controlled by hand pinches.
works.description_zh: 面向商家的 Quest Pro 原型：在桌面上打开一个虚拟摄影棚，摆放 3D 商品、调整灯光，再用捏合手势操作一个悬浮的实时取景器拍摄商品图。
works.idea_en: Let AR glasses turn any table into a product-photo studio.
works.idea_zh: 让 AR 眼镜把任何桌面变成商品摄影棚。
works.technique: Built in Unity with Meta's Interaction SDK hand tracking in Quest Pro passthrough; the team tested several capture metaphors (instant camera, reaching into a photo, live camera preview) before choosing the live cam.
works.technique_zh: 在 Unity 中用 Meta Interaction SDK 的手部追踪和 Quest Pro 透视画面实现；团队试过多种拍照隐喻（拍立得、伸手进照片、实时取景），最后选定实时取景器。
works.exercise_en: Prototype two different 'take a photo' gestures for a virtual camera in a headset or phone AR scene and have classmates rate which is faster and clearer. Twist: the photo must be taken with no buttons, only with the body.
works.exercise_zh: 在头显或手机 AR 场景里为虚拟相机设计两种不同的“拍照”手势，让同学评价哪种更快、更清楚；变体：不能用任何按钮，只能用身体动作拍照。

video.video_title:
Next-gen pro headsets from @Meta and @Apple are dropping soon. Had us curious what the future of work might look like for Shopify merchants. 🤔

Could AR glasses revolutionize product photography? 

🧵

works.title: The <model> Element in iOS Safari
works.description: A quick test of WebKit's experimental HTML model element on iOS Safari: a Converse sneaker hosted on Shopify's CDN spins as a native 3D object inside an ordinary web page.
works.description_zh: 在 iOS Safari 上试用 WebKit 实验性的 HTML model 元素：一只托管在 Shopify CDN 上的 Converse 球鞋，作为原生 3D 对象在普通网页里旋转。
works.idea_en: Treat 3D objects as first-class web content, just like images.
works.idea_zh: 让 3D 物体像图片一样成为网页的一等公民。
works.technique: WebKit's experimental model tag embeds a USDZ file directly in HTML so the browser renders it and handles rotation without WebGL code, hinting at pages that can hand 3D straight to AR.
works.technique_zh: WebKit 实验性的 model 标签可以把 USDZ 文件直接嵌入 HTML，由浏览器负责渲染和旋转，无需写 WebGL 代码，也预示着网页能把 3D 内容直接交给 AR。
works.exercise_en: Build a product page that shows a 3D model with model-viewer (or the model element where supported) plus a 'view in your space' AR button. Twist: make the 3D model react to page scrolling.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个商品页面，用 model-viewer（或在支持的浏览器中用 model 元素）展示 3D 模型，并加一个“在你的空间中查看”的 AR 按钮；变体：让 3D 模型随页面滚动做出反应。

video.video_title: Interesting times ahead. This is the new <model> running in iOS Safari https://t.co/iaYZHXXSay

works.title: The World Beyond
works.description: A Presence Platform showcase where you shine a flashlight to dissolve your real walls into an alien world and play with Oppy, a pet that responds to hand gestures and voice.
works.idea_zh: 用“手电”把真实墙壁溶解成外星世界，还有一只听你话的宠物。

video.video_title: The Future Of VR: The World Beyond

works.technique: Uses the Scene model to know wall planes, then masks passthrough with a shader where the virtual flashlight hits, revealing the VR world behind.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机AR检测墙面，在手机指向处挖出一个圆形“洞”显示另一个世界（遮罩着色器或Portal组件）；变化：洞只在你说出咒语时打开。
works.description_zh: 一个 Presence Platform 展示项目：你用手电筒一照，真实的墙壁便溶解成一个外星世界，还能和一只会回应手势与语音的宠物 Oppy 玩耍。
works.idea_en: Use a flashlight to dissolve real walls into an alien world, with a pet that listens to you.
works.technique_zh: 利用 Scene 模型获取墙面平面，再用着色器在虚拟手电筒照到的位置遮罩透视画面，露出后面的 VR 世界。
works.exercise_en: Use phone AR to detect a wall and cut a round hole where the phone points to show another world, using a mask shader or a portal component. Twist: the hole only opens when you say a magic word.

works.title: Third-Person Perspective Avatar Embodiment in AR
works.description: Users see themselves from behind as a muscular avatar standing in the real room and moving with their body; after controlling it, their actual physical performance improves.
works.description_zh: 用户从身后以第三人称视角看到自己化身为一个肌肉发达的虚拟形象，站在真实房间里随身体一起动；操控它之后，他们真实的体能表现也有所提升。
works.idea_en: Wearing a stronger body in AR can make you physically stronger (the Proteus effect).
works.idea_zh: 在 AR 中“穿上”更强壮的身体，真的会让你更有力气（普罗透斯效应）。
works.technique: Tracks the user's body and drives a full-body avatar rendered from a third-person viewpoint in an AR headset.
works.technique_zh: 追踪用户身体，驱动一个在 AR 头显中以第三人称视角渲染的全身虚拟形象。
works.exercise_en: Film a classmate from behind with a phone running a body-tracking AR effect that swaps them for a superhero, show them the live feed while they do squats, and count reps against a normal-mirror round. Twist: try a tired, elderly avatar instead.
works.exercise_zh: 用运行人体追踪 AR 特效的手机从背后拍同学，把他换成超级英雄形象，让他一边看实时画面一边做深蹲，与照普通镜子时的次数比较；变体：换成一个疲惫的老人形象再试一次。

video.video_title: Third-Person Perspective Avatar Embodiment in Augmented Reality

works.title: Tilt Five — Gaming with Tabletop Holograms
works.description: Shipping Tilt Five games shown through the glasses: tabletop strategy, board games and toys that rise from the board and respond to the wand.
works.idea_zh: 游戏从桌面板上立起来，用魔杖直接操控全息棋子。

video.video_title: Tilt Five - Gaming With Tabletop Holograms!

works.technique: Content is authored in board-local coordinates in Unity, so miniatures appear to rise from the board and stay registered as players move their heads.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个从桌面“长出来”的小城市，城市建筑随你绕桌子行走的角度显示不同细节；变体：城市里的小人会朝你所在的方向看。
works.description_zh: 通过眼镜展示已发布的 Tilt Five 游戏：桌面策略游戏、棋盘游戏和玩具从游戏板上立起来，并对魔杖作出响应。
works.idea_en: Games rise up from the tabletop board and you move holographic pieces directly with a wand.
works.technique_zh: 在 Unity 中以游戏板的局部坐标系制作内容，因此微缩模型看起来像是从板面上升起，并在玩家移动头部时保持对齐。
works.exercise_en: Make a small city that grows out of the tabletop, with buildings revealing different details depending on the angle as you walk around the table. Twist: the little people in the city look toward wherever you are.

works.title: Ukemochi
works.description: A person in a social VR world can eat real food: the headset cuts out just the plate, food and hands from the passthrough camera and pastes them seamlessly into the virtual scene.
works.description_zh: 在社交 VR 世界里的人也能吃真实的饭：头显只从透视摄像头画面中抠出餐盘、食物和手，无缝贴进虚拟场景。
works.idea_en: Let only the food cross the boundary between the real and the virtual world.
works.idea_zh: 只让食物穿过现实与虚拟之间的边界。
works.technique: Segments food, dishes and hands from the video see-through feed with a neural network and composites that region into the rendered VR environment in real time.
works.technique_zh: 用神经网络从视频透视画面中分割出食物、餐具和手，并实时把该区域合成到渲染出的 VR 环境里。
works.exercise_en: Build a phone AR portal that shows a virtual scene everywhere except a colour-keyed placemat area where the real camera image shows through, then eat a snack through it. Twist: swap roles and show only people's hands from reality.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个手机 AR 场景：除了一块用颜色抠像的餐垫区域透出真实画面外，其他地方都显示虚拟场景，然后透过它吃一份零食；变体：反过来，只让现实中人的手透进来。

video.video_title: Ukemochi: A Video See-through Food Overlay System for Eating Experience in the Metaverse (Video)

works.title: Unity Slices: Table
works.description: A Unity Labs demo on Quest 2 passthrough that slides a real table along the reality spectrum, from pure passthrough to fully virtual, while you play chess and other tabletop games on it.
works.idea_zh: 在同一张真实桌子上连续滑动于现实与虚拟之间玩桌游。

video.video_title: Unity Slices: Table. Sliding along the spectrum of realities.

works.technique: A virtual table is registered to the real one, and a blend parameter crossfades passthrough and virtual rendering with a mask or opacity ramp, moving the same object along the reality-virtuality spectrum.
works.exercise_zh: 在真实桌子上对齐一个同尺寸的虚拟桌面，用滑块从“完全真实”到“完全虚拟”逐步替换材质；变体：在每一档上玩同一局小游戏，记录感受差异。
works.description_zh: Unity Labs 在 Quest 2 透视模式下的一个演示：一张真实桌子沿着“现实光谱”滑动，从纯透视画面一直过渡到完全虚拟，你还可以在上面下国际象棋、玩其他桌游。
works.idea_en: Play board games on one real table while sliding continuously between reality and the virtual.
works.technique_zh: 虚拟桌子与真实桌子配准，一个混合参数借助遮罩或透明度渐变在透视画面与虚拟渲染之间交叉淡化，让同一个物体沿着现实—虚拟连续体移动。
works.exercise_en: Align a same-sized virtual tabletop on a real table and use a slider to replace materials step by step from fully real to fully virtual. Twist: play the same mini-game at every step and record how it feels different.

works.title: Unlearning Language
works.description: An installation and performance where an AI tracks participants' speech, gestures and expressions and responds with light and sound, pushing them to invent ways of communicating that algorithms cannot detect.
works.idea_zh: 被AI持续监测的房间里，人们要发明机器看不懂的新交流方式。

video.video_title: Unlearning Language

works.technique: Machine-learning classifiers (pose estimation, facial expression, speech recognition) detect recognisable human signals, and detection events drive light and sound feedback that participants try to evade.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe 和 Teachable Machine 做一个会识别点头、挥手、微笑的系统，一识别到就亮灯报警，小组发明一种它识别不出的沟通方式；变体：成功“隐身”交流 1 分钟后，把你们发明的暗号教给另一组。
works.description_zh: 一件装置兼表演作品：AI 追踪参与者的语言、手势和表情，并用光和声音作出回应，迫使他们发明算法无法察觉的交流方式。
works.idea_en: In a room watched constantly by AI, people have to invent new ways of communicating that machines cannot read.
works.technique_zh: 机器学习分类器（姿态估计、面部表情识别、语音识别）检测可识别的人类信号，每次检测都会触发光和声音反馈，参与者则设法躲避检测。
works.exercise_en: Use MediaPipe and Teachable Machine to build a system that recognizes nods, waves and smiles and flashes an alarm light when it does, and have your group invent a way to communicate that it cannot detect. Twist: after one minute of undetected communication, teach your secret code to another group.

works.title: VFX with Unity AR Foundation
works.description: Live on an iPhone, glowing particles and lines grow over the real room and people in front of the camera, anchored to the LiDAR-scanned environment.
works.idea_zh: 直接在手机上实时让光效沿真实环境生长。

video.video_title: VFX with Unity AR Foundation https://t.co/ZuhkeYPRmY

works.technique: AR Foundation exposes the LiDAR environment depth and human stencil textures, which VFX Graph samples on-device to emit particles from real surfaces.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 或 Lens Studio 的深度纹理，让房间表面冒出萤火虫；加一个变化：人走过的地方萤火虫会散开。
works.description_zh: 在 iPhone 上实时运行：发光的粒子和线条在真实房间和镜头前的人身上生长，并锚定在 LiDAR 扫描出的环境中。
works.idea_en: Grow light effects along the real environment live on a phone.
works.technique_zh: AR Foundation 提供 LiDAR 环境深度和人体模板纹理，VFX Graph 在设备端对其采样，从真实表面发射粒子。
works.exercise_en: Use depth textures in AR Foundation or Lens Studio to make fireflies rise from the room's surfaces. Twist: fireflies scatter wherever a person walks.

works.title: Walking a Taiwanese street with iPhone LiDAR
works.description: A night walk through a street in Taiwan is visualized as a sparse point-cloud world built live from the iPhone LiDAR, showing both the magic and the 5-meter range limit of the sensor.
works.idea_zh: 用 LiDAR 的'看不远'这一缺陷，本身做成一种梦境般的街景风格。

video.video_title: Walking around in a Taiwanese street with an iPhone LiDAR sensor. https://t.co/VL6rFaxtjs

works.technique: LiDAR depth samples are reprojected into world-space points each frame and accumulated, so the scene is reconstructed as a trail of colored points around the walker.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Polycam/Scaniverse 扫一条走廊，导出点云并用 three.js 只显示离你 5 米内的点；加一个变化：点云随脚步声闪烁。
works.description_zh: 在台湾一条街道上的夜间漫步，被呈现为一个由 iPhone LiDAR 实时构建的稀疏点云世界，既展现了这种传感器的神奇之处，也暴露了它 5 米的探测距离限制。
works.idea_en: Turn LiDAR's short sight into a dreamlike style of street scene.
works.technique_zh: 每一帧的 LiDAR 深度采样被重投影为世界空间中的点并不断累积，让场景重建为行走者周围的一道彩色点迹。
works.exercise_en: Scan a corridor with Polycam or Scaniverse, export the point cloud, and use three.js to show only the points within 5 meters of you. Twist: make the point cloud flicker with your footsteps.

works.title: #1scanaday
works.description: Starting on New Year 2021, Mikko posted one 3D scan a day made with iPhone LiDAR and photogrammetry apps; day 100 was this bronze lion, and every scan was published on Sketchfab.
works.description_zh: 从 2021 年元旦起，Mikko 每天发布一个用 iPhone LiDAR 或摄影测量应用做的 3D 扫描，第 100 天是这只青铜狮子，所有扫描都公开在 Sketchfab 上。
works.idea_en: A daily capture habit teaches you what reality can and cannot be scanned.
works.idea_zh: 每天扫描一次，慢慢就知道现实中什么能扫、什么扫不了。
works.technique: Each object or space is captured with a LiDAR iPhone or with photo-based photogrammetry apps (3d Scanner App, Polycam, Trnio) and uploaded as a textured mesh to Sketchfab for web and AR viewing.
works.technique_zh: 每件物体或空间都用带 LiDAR 的 iPhone 或基于照片的摄影测量应用（3d Scanner App、Polycam、Trnio）捕捉，生成带纹理的网格上传到 Sketchfab，供网页和 AR 查看。
works.exercise_en: Scan one object a day for a week with a free phone scanner, log what failed (shiny, thin, dark), and place the best scan in AR. Twist: scan the same object with two different apps and compare.
works.exercise_zh: 一周内每天用免费手机扫描应用扫一个物体，记录失败原因（反光、太薄、太暗），把最好的扫描放进 AR；变体：用两个不同应用扫描同一物体并比较。

video.video_title:
Boom that's 1️⃣0️⃣0️⃣! 🦁

https://t.co/3aQKegBLz4 #1scanaday https://t.co/2GEBy0PB9p

works.title: A robot that tidies up ornaments
works.description: A virtual robot rolls around the real floor collecting fallen Christmas ornaments in WebAR.
works.idea_zh: 一个在真实地板上帮你收拾圣诞装饰的虚拟机器人。

video.video_title: Merry Christmas 🎄🙌🏼🎉 Here is a robot helping me collect some fallen ornaments this morning. #webar #8thwall #aframe https://t.co/u0ugtwmV4S

works.technique: Virtual ornaments and a robot share the detected floor plane, and the robot steers toward the nearest ornament with a simple seek behavior and collects it on contact.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 地面上随机撒下几个小物件，让一个小机器人按距离依次去捡；变体：你用手机点地面可以给机器人设路障。
works.description_zh: 在 WebAR 中，一个虚拟机器人在真实地板上滚来滚去，把掉落的圣诞装饰收集起来。
works.idea_en: A virtual robot tidies up Christmas ornaments on your real floor.
works.technique_zh: 虚拟装饰和机器人共享检测到的地面平面，机器人通过简单的寻的（seek）行为驶向最近的装饰，并在接触时将其收集。
works.exercise_en: Scatter a few small objects at random on the AR floor and have a small robot pick them up in order of distance. Twist: tap the floor with your phone to set up roadblocks for the robot.

works.title: AR Light Saber with MediaPipe and p5.js
works.description: A browser toy that detects your hand with MediaPipe and draws a glowing lightsaber extending from it on the webcam feed.
works.idea_zh: 网页里用手势识别，从手中长出一把光剑。

video.video_title: AR Light Saber with Mediapipe and p5js

works.technique: MediaPipe Hands returns 2D landmarks each frame, and a glowing line is drawn along the direction from the wrist through the knuckles in p5.js over the webcam feed.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe Hands + p5.js 从手腕沿手指方向画一根发光光剑，挥动时留下拖影；变体：两只手的光剑相交时发出火花和声音。
works.description_zh: 一个浏览器小玩具：用 MediaPipe 识别你的手，并在网络摄像头画面中从手里延伸出一把发光的光剑。
works.idea_en: Gesture tracking in a web page grows a lightsaber out of your hand.
works.technique_zh: MediaPipe Hands 每帧返回二维关键点，p5.js 沿着从手腕穿过指关节的方向，在摄像头画面上绘制一条发光的线。
works.exercise_en: Use MediaPipe Hands and p5.js to draw a glowing lightsaber from the wrist along the fingers that leaves a trail as you swing it. Twist: when the sabers in both hands cross, they throw sparks and make a sound.

works.title: AR Photoshop Plugin
works.description: A Photoshop plugin streams each layer of a document to a phone so the layers can be pulled out of the monitor and viewed in AR.
works.idea_zh: 把 Photoshop 图层从显示器里“拽”出来放进 AR。

video.video_title: Let’s Make an Augmented Reality Photoshop Plugin with UNITY.

works.technique: A Photoshop plugin exports each layer as an image over WebSockets, and the phone stacks them as quads offset in depth on the monitor (tracked by Vuforia), letting the user pull layers apart in space.
works.exercise_zh: 把一张分层海报的各图层导出为 PNG，在图像追踪的海报上按深度分层叠放，捏合手势拉开层间距；变体：让层间距随手机离海报的距离自动变化。
works.description_zh: 一个 Photoshop 插件把文档的每个图层实时传到手机上，让这些图层可以从显示器中被拉出来，在 AR 中查看。
works.idea_en: Pull Photoshop layers out of the monitor and into AR.
works.technique_zh: Photoshop 插件通过 WebSockets 把每个图层导出为图像，手机则在显示器上（由 Vuforia 追踪）将它们按深度错开叠放成若干四边形面片，用户可以在空间中把图层拉开。
works.exercise_en: Export each layer of a layered poster as a PNG, stack them by depth on the image-tracked poster, and use a pinch gesture to spread the layers apart. Twist: make the layer spacing change automatically with the phone's distance from the poster.

works.title: AR Shooter Shared Between Nreal Light and iPad
works.description: A co-located AR shooting game in which a glasses wearer and an iPad player see and fight the same virtual targets.
works.idea_zh: 眼镜玩家和 iPad 玩家在同一空间合作打 AR 射击。

video.video_title: AR Shooter: Sharing AR View Between Nreal Light and iPad

works.technique: Both devices align to a shared reference (likely a common image marker or anchor) so their coordinate frames match, and target states and hits are synced over the network.
works.exercise_zh: 用一张打印图片作为共同原点，让 HoloKit 头显和手机两端看到同一组靶子并同步击中状态；变体：两人能力不对称，一人射击一人移动靶子。
works.description_zh: 一款同处一地的 AR 射击游戏：戴眼镜的玩家和用 iPad 的玩家看到并攻击同一批虚拟目标。
works.idea_en: A glasses player and an iPad player team up for AR shooting in the same space.
works.technique_zh: 两台设备都对齐到一个共享参照物（大概率是同一个图像标记或锚点），使二者的坐标系一致，目标状态和命中情况通过网络同步。
works.exercise_en: Use a printed image as a shared origin so a HoloKit headset and a phone see the same set of targets and sync hit states. Twist: give the two players unequal abilities, with one shooting and the other moving the targets.

works.title: AR Task Guidance for ISS Stowage
works.description: Carmine Elvezio and colleagues guide astronauts' stowage operations with head-worn AR, highlighting where each item goes in cramped space-station racks.
works.idea_zh: 在空间站拥挤的货架上，用AR指出每件物品该放在哪里。

video.video_title: Augmented reality task guidance for international space station stowage operations

works.technique: A HoloLens is registered to the rack layout, and the application highlights the target stowage location with world-locked outlines and path cues while tracking task progress item by item.
works.exercise_zh: 给宿舍柜子或实验室抽屉建一份物品清单，在手机 AR 中逐件显示“这件放在哪一格”的高亮框；变体：反向设计为“找东西”模式，并测试比纯文字清单快多少。
works.description_zh: Carmine Elvezio 及其同事利用头戴式 AR 指导宇航员的货物存放作业，在空间站狭窄的货架中高亮标出每件物品应放的位置。
works.idea_en: On the space station's cramped racks, AR points out where each item belongs.
works.technique_zh: HoloLens 与货架布局完成配准，应用以锁定在世界空间中的轮廓和路径提示高亮目标存放位置，并逐件追踪任务进度。
works.exercise_en: Build an item list for a dorm cabinet or lab drawers and show a highlight box in phone AR for which slot each item goes in, one item at a time. Twist: reverse it into a find-things mode and test how much faster it is than a text-only list.

works.title: AR athletes in Google Search
works.description: Announced at Google I/O 2021: searching for athletes such as Simone Biles, Naomi Osaka or Megan Rapinoe lets you watch a captured 3D performance of their signature moves in your room; he worked on it from the early concept.
works.description_zh: 在 Google I/O 2021 上发布：搜索 Simone Biles、大坂直美或 Megan Rapinoe 等运动员，就能在自己的房间里观看他们招牌动作的 3D 捕捉表演；他从最初的概念阶段就参与了这个项目。
works.idea_en: Bring star athletes' movements into your living room at life size.
works.idea_zh: 把明星运动员的动作以真实大小带进你的客厅。
works.technique: Likely volumetric or motion-captured animations delivered as 3D assets through Search and placed with ARCore Scene Viewer.
works.technique_zh: 很可能是把体积捕捉或动作捕捉的动画作为 3D 资源，经搜索分发，并通过 ARCore Scene Viewer 放置。
works.exercise_en: Record a classmate doing one move with a phone and turn it into an animated 3D figure placed in AR. Twist: let viewers slow it down to study the form.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机拍下同学做一个动作，把它变成放在 AR 里的 3D 动画人物。变体：让观众可以放慢速度研究动作细节。

video.video_title: If you’ve ever wanted to see Megan Rapinoe, Naomi Osaka or Simone Biles perform their impressive feats up close, now you can. We’re bringing some of the world’s best athletes to AR in Search. #GoogleI

works.title: AR birding guide (Adobe Aero)
works.description: A postcard series for bird-lovers becomes an interactive AR birding guide: illustrated birds fly off the cards and can be explored in 3D.
works.idea_zh: 明信片上的鸟一扫就飞出来，变成可互动的观鸟图鉴。

video.video_title: Behind-the-Art: Adobe Aero Augmented Reality Experience by Velvet Spectrum | Adobe Creative Cloud

works.technique: Adobe Aero image anchors recognize each postcard and trigger animated 3D birds with tap behaviors.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Adobe Aero 把学生画的明信片做成 AR 图鉴，扫卡出现 3D 动物和科普文字；加一个变化：两张卡放在一起动物会互动。
works.description_zh: 一套为爱鸟人士设计的明信片变成了可互动的 AR 观鸟指南：插画中的鸟儿从卡片上飞出来，可以在三维中细细观察。
works.idea_en: Scan a postcard and its bird flies out, becoming an interactive birding guide.
works.technique_zh: Adobe Aero 的图像锚点识别每张明信片，并触发带有点击行为的三维鸟类动画。
works.exercise_en: Use Adobe Aero to turn postcards drawn by students into an AR field guide where scanning a card brings up a 3D animal and science facts. Twist: when two cards are placed together, their animals interact.

works.title: AR glasses superpowers for illustrators
works.description: A prototype imagining how AR glasses could let an illustrator or animator draw and see animated overlays directly on paper and the desk.
works.idea_zh: 想象 AR 眼镜给插画师的“超能力”：纸上的画直接动起来。
works.technique: Likely combines a tracked sheet of paper (image or plane tracking) with animated overlays rendered in-place so drawings and animation guides align with the physical page.
works.exercise_zh: 用图像追踪识别一张手绘稿，在纸上叠加一段会动的动画；变体：让画中角色能“走出”纸面到桌上。

video.video_title: AR glasses will give superpowers to illustrators and animators. https://t.co/6M1Av28322

works.description_zh: 一个原型，设想 AR 眼镜如何让插画师或动画师直接在纸上和桌面上绘画，并看到动态的叠加内容。
works.idea_en: Imagine the superpowers AR glasses could give illustrators: drawings on paper come to life.
works.technique_zh: 大概率将被追踪的纸张（图像追踪或平面追踪）与原位渲染的动画叠加层结合，使画作和动画辅助线与实体纸面对齐。
works.exercise_en: Use image tracking to recognize a hand-drawn sketch and overlay a moving animation on the paper. Twist: let a character in the drawing walk off the page onto the desk.

works.title: Adding VFX to a Bibcam clip
works.description: A recorded Bibcam walk is post-processed so that particles and light trails wrap around the real buildings and people, with the effect following the real depth of the street.
works.idea_zh: 对一段已录好的深度视频做'空间感知'的后期特效。

video.video_title:
Adding VFX to a Bibcam clip (recorded with iPhone 13 Pro Max)
https://t.co/HYIIG7pEyz https://t.co/vDB5I8Ffby

works.technique: Depth and pose embedded in the video let VFX Graph sample the real geometry per frame, so particles can spawn on and collide with surfaces in the footage.
works.exercise_zh: 把一段深度视频导入 TouchDesigner，用深度通道控制粒子密度，让近处的人变成光点；加一个变化：粒子颜色随时间从白天过渡到夜晚。
works.description_zh: 对一段用 Bibcam 录制的行走视频进行后期处理，让粒子和光迹环绕真实的建筑与行人，特效随街道的真实深度而变化。
works.idea_en: Add space-aware post effects to a depth video that has already been recorded.
works.technique_zh: 视频中嵌入的深度和位姿信息让 VFX Graph 能逐帧采样真实几何，使粒子可以在画面中的表面上生成并与之碰撞。
works.exercise_en: Import a depth video into TouchDesigner and use the depth channel to control particle density so nearby people turn into points of light. Twist: shift the particle colors over time from day to night.

works.title: Altering Perceived Softness of Real Rigid Objects
works.description: A thin device restricts how the fingerpad deforms, so pressing a hard real object feels softer or harder than it is, useful for MR props.
works.idea_zh: 改变指腹变形，让硬桌子摸起来变软。

video.video_title: Altering Perceived Softness of Real Rigid Objects by Restricting Fingerpad Deformation (Best Paper)

works.technique: Constrains lateral fingerpad spread with a rigid ring and nail mount, changing the tactile cue the brain uses to judge compliance.
works.exercise_zh: 让同学分别用裸指和戴胶带缠紧的手指按同一块海绵/桌面，评估软硬感差异；变化：配合手机AR显示“软/硬”的视觉提示看是否能强化错觉。
works.description_zh: 一种轻薄装置通过限制指腹的变形，让按压真实的坚硬物体时感觉比实际更软或更硬，可用于 MR 道具。
works.idea_en: Change how the fingerpad deforms and a hard table feels soft.
works.technique_zh: 用刚性指环和指甲支架限制指腹的横向扩展，从而改变大脑用来判断软硬程度的触觉线索。
works.exercise_en: Have classmates press the same sponge or tabletop with a bare finger and with a finger tightly wrapped in tape, and rate the difference in softness. Twist: add a soft or hard visual cue in phone AR and see whether it strengthens the illusion.

works.title: Augmented Games
works.description: Motion-tracked floor and wall projection that turns any space into a physical video-game playground and sports court.
works.idea_zh: 把任何场地变成可以跑跳的投影游戏场

video.video_title: Augmented Games | Transform Any Space Into Immersive Playground

works.technique: Overhead cameras or LiDAR track players' positions on the floor, and a game engine renders court graphics and game logic back through calibrated floor and wall projection.
works.exercise_zh: 用俯拍摄像头追踪地面上的人，在 TouchDesigner 或 Unity 中做一个投影到地面的小游戏（抢地盘、躲避方块）；变体：规则要求至少两人协作才能得分。
works.description_zh: 带动作追踪的地面与墙面投影，把任何空间变成可以跑跳的实体电子游戏场和运动场。
works.idea_en: Turn any space into a projected game field you can run and jump on.
works.technique_zh: 顶置摄像头或 LiDAR 追踪玩家在地面上的位置，游戏引擎渲染场地图形并运行游戏逻辑，再通过经过标定的地面与墙面投影呈现出来。
works.exercise_en: Track people on the floor with an overhead camera and build a small game projected onto the floor in TouchDesigner or Unity, such as claiming territory or dodging blocks. Twist: the rules require at least two people to cooperate to score.

works.title: Awkward Instance
works.description: Site-based AR 'paranormal apparitions' — glitchy dancing human forms made from stolen skins and mismatched motion-capture — appear in outdoor places.
works.idea_zh: 用错配的人皮与动捕数据做出会跳舞的“故障幽灵”
works.technique: Rigged 3D figures are driven by deliberately mismatched motion-capture clips and placed at sites with mobile AR.
works.exercise_zh: 从Mixamo下载角色和动作，故意把动作套到比例不对的角色上放进AR；变化：把全班录制的动作混搭给同一个角色。

video.video_title: Awkward Instance

works.description_zh: 出现在户外特定地点的 AR“灵异显现”：由盗用的人体皮肤贴图和错配的动作捕捉数据拼成、带着故障感的舞动人形。
works.idea_en: Mismatched human skins and motion-capture data become dancing glitch ghosts.
works.technique_zh: 绑定好骨骼的三维人形由刻意错配的动作捕捉片段驱动，并通过手机 AR 放置在特定场地。
works.exercise_en: Download characters and animations from Mixamo, deliberately apply motions to characters with the wrong proportions, and place them in AR. Twist: mix motions recorded by the whole class onto a single character.

works.title: Bibcam test in Shibuya
works.description: Street footage shot on an iPhone 13 Pro Max records depth and camera motion inside the video itself, so later the crossing in Shibuya can be re-lit and filled with 3D effects.
works.idea_zh: 录像时把深度和相机位姿一起'烙'进视频，之后就能给街景补上贴合空间的特效。

video.video_title: Bibcam Test with iPhone 13 Pro Max (Shibuya, 23rd Nov)

works.technique: Bibcam encodes the LiDAR depth map and camera pose as metadata burned into each recorded video frame, so Unity can later reconstruct the 3D scene for post-processed AR VFX.
works.exercise_zh: 用带 LiDAR 的手机录一段校园短片（或用 Record3D 导出），在 Unity/Blender 里给真实空间补上下雪或发光线条；加一个变化：特效只出现在离镜头 2 米之外。
works.description_zh: 用 iPhone 13 Pro Max 拍摄的街头影像把深度和相机运动直接记录在视频里，之后就能为涩谷十字路口重新打光，并填入三维特效。
works.idea_en: Burn depth and camera pose into the video as you record, so you can later add effects that fit the street space.
works.technique_zh: Bibcam 将 LiDAR 深度图和相机位姿作为元数据编码进每一帧录制画面，Unity 之后可据此重建三维场景，用于后期制作 AR 视觉特效。
works.exercise_en: Record a short campus clip with a LiDAR phone (or export one with Record3D), then add snow or glowing lines to the real space in Unity or Blender. Twist: make the effects appear only beyond 2 meters from the camera.

works.title: BodyPix visual effects (NNCam)
works.description: A webcam segments the person from the background and body parts in real time, so particles, outlines and glitches can wrap only the human body in the live image.
works.idea_zh: 实时把人从背景里'抠'出来，特效只作用在人身上。

video.video_title: BodyPix Visual Effects with Unity Barracuda

works.technique: The BodyPix person-and-part segmentation network runs through Unity Barracuda, and its mask texture is used to emit and confine VFX Graph particles to the body.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe Selfie Segmentation 或 TouchDesigner 把同学的身体变成流动的墨水而背景保持不动；加一个变化：只有举起的手会燃烧。
works.description_zh: 网络摄像头实时把人从背景中分割出来，并区分身体各部位，于是粒子、轮廓线和故障效果只会包裹实时画面中的人体。
works.idea_en: Cut the person out of the background in real time so effects only touch the body.
works.technique_zh: BodyPix 人体及部位分割网络通过 Unity Barracuda 运行，其遮罩纹理用于发射 VFX Graph 粒子，并把粒子限制在人体范围内。
works.exercise_en: Use MediaPipe Selfie Segmentation or TouchDesigner to turn a classmate's body into flowing ink while the background stays still. Twist: only a raised hand catches fire.

works.title: CMY Shadows Mirror
works.description: Rotating elements cast cyan, magenta and yellow shadows that mix on the wall into a coloured reflection of the viewer.
works.idea_zh: 用青、品、黄三色影子的叠加画出你的彩色镜像
works.technique: Motors rotate elements in front of coloured light sources so overlapping shadows subtractively mix into an image driven by the camera feed (likely).
works.exercise_zh: 用红绿蓝三盏手机灯照一个物体，观察彩色影子如何混合；变化：用舵机转动遮挡片，把摄像头亮度映射成彩色影子。

video.video_title: Daniel Rozin, "CMY Shadows Mirror", 2021 - MOA + L

works.description_zh: 旋转的元件投下青色、品红和黄色的影子，这些影子在墙上混合，形成观者的彩色映像。
works.idea_en: Overlapping cyan, magenta and yellow shadows paint a colored mirror image of you.
works.technique_zh: 电机转动彩色光源前方的元件，使重叠的影子以减色方式混合成由摄像头画面驱动的图像（可能如此实现）。
works.exercise_en: Light an object with three phone lights in red, green and blue and observe how the colored shadows mix. Twist: rotate blocking vanes with servos to map camera brightness into colored shadows.

works.title: Candy cane tower vs. robot
works.description: He stacks a physics-driven candy-cane tower on the floor in WebAR, and a small virtual robot knocks it down.
works.idea_zh: 在地板上搭一座会倒的虚拟糖果塔，再放一个捣蛋机器人。

video.video_title: I made a candy cane tower… but it was knocked down by my robot 😅🤖😖 #webxr #8thwall #aframe https://t.co/Jl3Sytu8kV

works.technique: A physics engine simulates stacked rigid bodies on an invisible ground collider at the detected floor, and a scripted robot applies forces on contact to topple the tower.
works.exercise_zh: 用 A-Frame 或 Unity 物理在地面上搭一座 AR 积木塔，再放一个会撞向它的小机器人；变体：让观众用手机倾斜角度控制机器人。
works.description_zh: 他在 WebAR 中于地板上搭起一座受物理驱动的拐杖糖塔，然后让一个小小的虚拟机器人把它撞倒。
works.idea_en: Build a topple-able virtual candy tower on the floor, then release a troublemaking robot.
works.technique_zh: 物理引擎在检测到的地面处放置一个不可见的地面碰撞体，模拟叠放的刚体；脚本控制的机器人在接触时施加力，把塔推倒。
works.exercise_en: Use A-Frame or Unity physics to build an AR block tower on the floor and add a small robot that crashes into it. Twist: let the audience steer the robot by tilting their phones.

works.title: Controlling Air Conditioning via Augmented Reality
works.description: The invisible airflow of a directional air conditioner is drawn as streams in AR, and the user steers it with touch gestures to aim cool air where people sit.
works.description_zh: 定向空调原本看不见的气流在 AR 中被画成一道道流线，用户用触控手势调整方向，把冷风送到有人坐的地方。
works.idea_en: Make invisible airflow visible, then let people grab and steer it.
works.idea_zh: 把看不见的气流显示出来，再让人伸手去“抓”和引导它。
works.technique: Likely simulates the AC's flow field from vane angles and renders it as animated particle streams registered to the unit, sending gesture edits back as control commands.
works.technique_zh: 很可能根据导风板角度模拟空调的气流场，把它渲染成与空调位置对齐的动画粒子流，再把手势修改转成控制指令发送回去。
works.exercise_en: Hang ribbons in front of a desk fan, film them, then build a phone AR scene that draws matching animated particle streams from the fan; let classmates 'drag' the stream to aim it. Twist: visualise Wi-Fi strength or sound instead of air.
works.exercise_zh: 在台扇前挂几条丝带并拍下来，然后做一个手机 AR 场景，从风扇处画出对应的动画粒子流，让同学“拖动”气流改变方向；变体：把可视化对象换成 Wi-Fi 信号强度或声音。

video.video_title: Controlling Air Conditioning via Augmented Reality - IEEEVR 2021

works.title: Dakota Spirit Walk
works.description: A permanent AR public-art trail at the Bruce Vento Nature Sanctuary in Saint Paul where phones reveal Dakota spirits, stories and language at sacred sites.
works.idea_zh: 在圣地步道上用AR让达科他族的神灵与语言重新出现
works.technique: Image-marker or location-triggered AR (likely Adobe Aero/app) anchors animated Dakota artwork and audio narration to signs along the trail.
works.exercise_zh: 为校园一条小路设计3个AR站点，每站用图像标记呈现一个地方的“原名”和故事；变化：邀请当地长者录音作为旁白。

video.video_title: Dakota Spirit Walk - Augmented Reality Public Art (Marlena Myles interview)

works.description_zh: 位于圣保罗 Bruce Vento 自然保护区的一条永久性 AR 公共艺术步道，手机在各处圣地呈现达科他族的神灵、故事和语言。
works.idea_en: On a sacred trail, AR brings Dakota spirits and language back into view.
works.technique_zh: 通过图像标记或位置触发的 AR（大概率使用 Adobe Aero 或专用应用），将达科他艺术动画和语音讲述锚定在步道沿途的标牌上。
works.exercise_en: Design three AR stations along a campus path, each using an image marker to show a place's original name and its story. Twist: invite local elders to record the narration.

works.title: Distant Hand
works.description: A hand-tracked AR prototype that extends your hand far into the space in front of you to touch distant objects.
works.idea_zh: 伸出一只能触到远方的AR长手

video.video_title: Distant Hand

works.technique: Hand tracking provides the wrist and finger joints, and a non-linear mapping extends the virtual hand far along the arm's ray so it can touch distant objects (akin to the Go-Go interaction technique).
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe Hands 或 HoloKit 手势追踪做一只随手臂伸展而非线性变长的虚拟手，去“碰”远处的虚拟物体；变体：让长手在经过真实物体时留下触碰的痕迹。
works.description_zh: 一个基于手部追踪的 AR 原型，把你的手远远伸向前方空间，去触碰远处的物体。
works.idea_en: Stretch out a long AR hand that can reach faraway things.
works.technique_zh: 手部追踪提供手腕和手指关节，非线性映射沿手臂射线把虚拟手延伸到远处，使其能触碰远处物体（类似 Go-Go 交互技术）。
works.exercise_en: Use MediaPipe Hands or HoloKit hand tracking to build a virtual hand that grows non-linearly as you extend your arm, and touch distant virtual objects with it. Twist: make the long hand leave touch marks on real objects it passes.

works.title: Doc Ock AR Digital Fashion
works.description: A wearable Snapchat filter that gives the user Doctor Octopus's animated mechanical tentacles, which move around the body as if attached to the spine.
works.description_zh: 一个可穿戴的 Snapchat 滤镜，给用户装上章鱼博士的机械触手，触手像连在脊柱上一样在身体周围摆动。
works.idea_en: Wear a movie character's signature prosthetic as digital fashion.
works.idea_zh: 把电影角色的标志性“义肢”当作数字时装穿在身上。
works.technique: Tentacles modelled and animated in Cinema 4D, textured in Substance 3D Painter, and attached to Lens Studio body tracking.
works.technique_zh: 触手在 Cinema 4D 中建模并制作动画，用 Substance 3D Painter 绘制材质，再绑定到 Lens Studio 的人体追踪上。
works.exercise_en: Design an extra limb (wing, tail or arm) as a body-tracked AR wearable that reacts to how fast you move. Twist: the limb must help you do something the real body cannot.
works.exercise_zh: 设计一个额外的肢体（翅膀、尾巴或手臂）作为人体追踪 AR 穿戴，它会根据你的动作快慢作出反应；变体：这个肢体必须帮你完成真实身体做不到的事。

video.video_title: DOC OCK AR Digital Fashion - wearable Filter

works.title: Dragon Duel (HoloKit X demo)
works.description: A player in a HoloKit X headset battles a dragon that flies around the real room, dodging its fire and casting spells back at it.
works.description_zh: 戴着 HoloKit X 头显的玩家与一条在真实房间里盘旋的巨龙对战，一边躲避龙焰，一边向它施放法术。
works.idea_en: A boss fight staged in your own room, with you moving your whole body to dodge.
works.idea_zh: 在自己房间里上演一场首领战，要靠整个身体移动来躲闪。
works.technique: ARKit world tracking renders a stereo view on the iPhone inside the HoloKit X, and the dragon's flight path is likely scripted around the user's tracked head position.
works.technique_zh: ARKit 世界追踪在 HoloKit X 内的 iPhone 上渲染双目画面，巨龙的飞行路径很可能围绕用户被追踪的头部位置编排。
works.exercise_en: Script a flying creature that circles the player's head position in AR and periodically fires a slow projectile the player must physically sidestep. Twist: the creature lands on the largest detected horizontal surface when it gets tired.
works.exercise_zh: 编写一只在 AR 中围绕玩家头部位置盘旋的飞行生物，它会定期发射慢速投射物，玩家必须真实侧身躲开。变体：当它累了，就降落在检测到的最大水平面上。

video.video_title: Unity: HoloKit X Dragon duel (Unity demo)

works.title: Drawing in the Air
works.description: Lines drawn in mid-air settle into the room as persistent 3D ribbons.
works.idea_zh: 在空中画出的线化作留在房间里的立体丝带。

video.video_title: Drawing in the air

works.technique: Strokes are recorded as world-space points from the camera pose and converted into ribbon meshes that persist at their anchors (likely with physics-based settling).
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 画出空中丝带，松手后让丝带受重力轻轻飘落到地面平面上；变体：丝带落地后变成花或文字。
works.description_zh: 在半空中画出的线条会落定在房间里，化作持久存在的三维丝带。
works.idea_en: Lines drawn in the air become 3D ribbons that stay in the room.
works.technique_zh: 根据相机位姿把笔画记录为世界空间中的点，再转换为丝带网格并持久保留在锚点处（大概率使用基于物理的沉降效果）。
works.exercise_en: Draw ribbons in the air with AR Foundation and, once you let go, let them drift down gently under gravity onto the floor plane. Twist: after landing, the ribbons turn into flowers or words.

works.title: Duel of Wizards (HoloKit X demo)
works.description: Two players wearing HoloKit X face each other in the same room and aim their controllers like wands; spells fly across the real space and hit the opponent's shared-anchored avatar.
works.description_zh: 两名戴着 HoloKit X 的玩家在同一房间面对面，把手柄当魔杖瞄准对方；法术穿过真实空间，击中共享锚点上的对手化身。
works.idea_en: A wand duel where the opponent is a real person across the room, not a computer character.
works.idea_zh: 一场魔杖决斗，对手是房间另一头的真人，而不是电脑角色。
works.technique: Players join an ARKit Collaboration session over Apple Multipeer Connectivity to share one coordinate frame, while game logic syncs over UNET.
works.technique_zh: 玩家通过 Apple Multipeer Connectivity 加入 ARKit 协作会话来共享同一坐标系，游戏逻辑则通过 UNET 同步。
works.exercise_en: Build a two-phone AR duel where both devices share an anchor and a tap fires a projectile from one phone's position toward the other's. Twist: make projectiles bounce off real walls detected by plane detection.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个双手机 AR 对决：两台设备共享同一锚点，点击屏幕就从一台手机的位置朝另一台发射投射物。变体：让投射物在平面检测到的真实墙面上反弹。

video.video_title: Unity: Duel of wizards (HoloKit X demo, AR Collaboration )

works.title: Enter the Plastocene
works.description: An AR/VR installation where plastic waste creatures swim through the exhibition space around visitors, shown at MEET Milan.
works.idea_zh: 塑料生物在展厅中游动的塑料纪

video.video_title: Enter the Plastocene @ MEET (15s pan with live AR video)

works.technique: ARKit world tracking places flocking creatures (boids-style steering) that swim through the exhibition volume around visitors.
works.exercise_zh: 在 Unity 里用简单 boids 算法让一群塑料瓶生物在房间中游动，并绕开观众（用相机位置作为排斥点）；变体：让生物数量随班级当天产生的塑料垃圾数量变化。
works.description_zh: 一件 AR/VR 装置：由塑料垃圾构成的生物在展厅中围绕观众游动，曾在米兰 MEET 展出。
works.idea_en: The Plastocene, where plastic creatures swim through the gallery.
works.technique_zh: ARKit 世界追踪放置成群游动的生物（boids 式转向行为），让它们在观众周围的展厅空间中穿梭。
works.exercise_en: Use a simple boids algorithm in Unity to make a school of plastic-bottle creatures swim around the room and avoid viewers, treating the camera position as a repulsion point. Twist: tie the number of creatures to the amount of plastic waste the class produces that day.

works.title: FaceMeshBarracuda face & eye tracker
works.description: A webcam face and iris tracker running in Unity overlays a dense face mesh and eye landmarks on the live video, ready for mask and gaze effects.
works.idea_zh: 在 Unity 里用一个摄像头实现脸部网格与眼球追踪，做面具和视线特效。

video.video_title: FaceMeshBarracuda: Face and Eye Landmark Tracker with Unity Barracuda

works.technique: MediaPipe face-mesh and iris models run via Barracuda to return 468 face vertices plus iris landmarks, which are used to texture and deform an overlay mesh.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Spark/Lens Studio 或 MediaPipe FaceMesh 做一个跟着眼球转动的'第三只眼'面具；加一个变化：眨眼时面具换一张脸。
works.description_zh: 一个在 Unity 中运行的网络摄像头面部与虹膜追踪器，在实时视频上叠加密集的面部网格和眼部关键点，可直接用于面具和视线特效。
works.idea_en: Get a face mesh and eye tracking from one camera in Unity for mask and gaze effects.
works.technique_zh: MediaPipe 面部网格与虹膜模型通过 Barracuda 运行，返回 468 个面部顶点和虹膜关键点，用于给叠加网格贴图并使其变形。
works.exercise_en: Use Spark, Lens Studio or MediaPipe FaceMesh to make a third-eye mask that follows your eye movements. Twist: the mask swaps to a different face when you blink.

works.title: Four Scanner Apps, One Object
works.description: On day 88 of his scan diary, Mikko captured the same object with four iPhone scanner apps and showed the results side by side: LiDAR had improved on small objects, but photogrammetry still won on detail.
works.description_zh: 在扫描日记的第 88 天，Mikko 用四款 iPhone 扫描应用扫描同一个物体并并排比较：LiDAR 在小物体上进步明显，但细节上摄影测量仍然更胜一筹。
works.idea_en: Compare tools on one subject to understand what each is good at.
works.idea_zh: 用同一个对象比较不同工具，看清各自擅长什么。
works.technique: The same subject is captured with LiDAR-based and photogrammetry-based apps and the meshes are compared for geometry and texture quality.
works.technique_zh: 用基于 LiDAR 和基于摄影测量的应用分别捕捉同一对象，再比较网格的几何精度和纹理质量。
works.exercise_en: In teams, scan the same classroom object with two to four capture methods and present a side-by-side AR comparison. Twist: pick the object that makes the methods disagree the most.
works.exercise_zh: 分组用两到四种捕捉方式扫描教室里的同一物体，做一个并排对比的 AR 展示；变体：专门挑一个让各种方法结果差异最大的物体。

video.video_title:
8️⃣8️⃣ days scanning

Today's scan compares four iPhone scanner apps

Seen improvements for scanning small objects with Lidar in the past 88 days but when photogrammetry works... It's so good

https:/

works.title: HandPoseBarracuda hand tracker
works.description: A single webcam tracks all finger joints in real time inside Unity, drawing a 3D hand skeleton over the live image as a building block for gesture-driven effects.
works.idea_zh: 只用普通摄像头就能在 Unity 里拿到手指关节，做手势特效的基础件。

video.video_title: HandPoseBarracuda: Hand Landmark Tracker with Unity Barracuda

works.technique: MediaPipe palm-detection and hand-landmark neural networks run on the GPU through Unity Barracuda to output 21 3D keypoints per frame.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe Hands（网页版即可）追踪手指，让指尖在摄像头画面上拖出彩色光带；加一个变化：捏合手指时光带变成可抓的绳子。
works.description_zh: 只用一个网络摄像头，就能在 Unity 中实时追踪所有手指关节，并在实时画面上绘制三维手部骨架，作为手势驱动特效的基础构件。
works.idea_en: Get finger joints in Unity from an ordinary camera as a building block for gesture effects.
works.technique_zh: MediaPipe 手掌检测与手部关键点神经网络通过 Unity Barracuda 在 GPU 上运行，每帧输出 21 个三维关键点。
works.exercise_en: Track fingers with MediaPipe Hands (the web version is enough) and make your fingertips drag colored light trails across the camera view. Twist: when you pinch, the light trail becomes a rope you can grab.

works.title: Holo Cat: Perspective Expression by Head Tracking
works.description: A flat screen shows his cat as a 3D hologram whose perspective shifts with the viewer's head, with no headset needed.
works.idea_zh: 用头部追踪让平面屏幕上的猫咪看起来立体。

video.video_title: Holo Cat: Perspective Expression Based on Head Tracking

works.technique: The viewer's head is tracked (likely by a webcam face tracker) and the 3D scene is rendered with an off-axis projection matched to the screen rectangle, creating motion parallax so the display acts as a window.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe Face Mesh 追踪头部位置，在 three.js 中做离轴投影，让屏幕里的小盒子像真的有深度；变体：盒子里的角色会转头看向你。
works.description_zh: 一块平面屏幕把他的猫呈现为立体全息影像，画面透视会随观者头部移动而变化，无需佩戴头显。
works.idea_en: Head tracking makes a cat on a flat screen look three-dimensional.
works.technique_zh: 追踪观者的头部（大概率使用网络摄像头面部追踪），并以与屏幕矩形匹配的离轴投影渲染三维场景，产生运动视差，让显示器像一扇窗户。
works.exercise_en: Track head position with MediaPipe Face Mesh and build an off-axis projection in three.js so a small box on screen seems to have real depth. Twist: the character inside the box turns its head to look at you.

works.title: HoloForge Lab: HoloParticles tennis
works.description: A HoloForge Lab experiment with holographic particle effects on HoloLens 2, ending in a mock holographic tennis rally with hand-tracked swings.
works.idea_zh: 用全息粒子与手部追踪打一场全息网球。

video.video_title: HoloForge Lab - Having fun with HoloParticles, ready for a holographic tennis match?

works.technique: GPU particle effects are world-anchored, and a hand-tracked palm or racket collider transfers velocity to a ball whose trajectory is simulated with simple physics.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机当球拍，挥动时根据加速度把 AR 小球打出去，并在轨迹上留下粒子尾迹；变体：让球撞到真实墙面后反弹回来。
works.description_zh: HoloForge Lab 在 HoloLens 2 上进行的全息粒子特效实验，最后以一场模拟的全息网球对打收尾，挥拍动作由手部追踪识别。
works.idea_en: Play a game of holographic tennis with holographic particles and hand tracking.
works.technique_zh: GPU 粒子特效锚定在世界空间中，经手部追踪的手掌或球拍碰撞体把速度传递给球，球的轨迹用简单物理进行模拟。
works.exercise_en: Use a phone as a racket that sends an AR ball flying based on acceleration when you swing, leaving a particle trail along its path. Twist: make the ball bounce back after hitting a real wall.

works.title: Hot Potato multiplayer lens
works.description: Friends pass a ticking virtual hot potato between their phones in a co-located Snapchat lens until it explodes on someone.
works.idea_zh: 在朋友之间传递会爆炸的虚拟土豆。

video.video_title: Multiplayer AR is now possible inside Snapchat so we made a Hot Potato game, play it now!! https://t.co/WsTQLKPbFE https://t.co/orY2zfqnUo

works.technique: A connected lens synchronizes ownership of a shared AR object and a countdown timer across participants.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个多人共享的'传炸弹' AR 游戏（Lens Studio 或 Unity Netcode）；加一个变化：只有对着对方手机才能把炸弹扔过去。
works.description_zh: 在一个同处一地的 Snapchat 滤镜中，朋友们在各自的手机之间传递一颗滴答作响的虚拟烫手山芋，直到它在某人手里爆炸。
works.idea_en: Pass an exploding virtual potato among friends.
works.technique_zh: 联机滤镜在参与者之间同步共享 AR 物体的归属权和倒计时。
works.exercise_en: Build a multiplayer pass-the-bomb AR game with Lens Studio or Unity Netcode. Twist: you can only throw the bomb by pointing at the other person's phone.

works.title: HyperSpace AR
works.description: A LiDAR-based AR app for iPhone 12 / iPad Pro that fills your room with generative forms that respond to the scanned walls and furniture.
works.idea_zh: 用LiDAR扫描房间，让生成形态沿真实表面生长

video.video_title: HyperSpace AR - LIDAR based app for iPhone 12 / iPad Pro

works.technique: LiDAR scene reconstruction yields a room mesh, and generative geometry is spawned and grown along the mesh normals with occlusion so forms appear to emerge from walls and furniture.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 网格重建（或平面检测）让藤蔓或晶体沿墙面与桌面生长，并开启遮挡；变体：让生长只发生在你长时间注视的表面上。
works.description_zh: 一款面向 iPhone 12 和 iPad Pro 的 LiDAR AR 应用，让生成式形态充满你的房间，并对扫描到的墙面和家具作出反应。
works.idea_en: Scan the room with LiDAR and let generative forms grow along real surfaces.
works.technique_zh: LiDAR 场景重建生成房间网格，生成式几何体沿网格法线生成和生长，并启用遮挡，让形态看起来像是从墙面和家具中冒出来。
works.exercise_en: Use AR Foundation meshing (or plane detection) to grow vines or crystals along walls and tabletops with occlusion turned on. Twist: growth happens only on surfaces you stare at for a long time.

works.title: I Turned My Girlfriend into a Musical Instrument
works.description: Body-tracked AR turns a dancer's limbs into triggers that play live music as she moves.
works.idea_zh: 用身体追踪让女友的每个动作都成为演奏的乐器。

video.video_title: I Turned My Girlfriend Into a Musical Instrument!

works.technique: Body tracking gives joint positions, and when limbs enter defined trigger zones or exceed a speed threshold, notes are played and visual effects spawn.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe Pose 在画面中划出几个区域，手或脚进入不同区域时弹奏不同音符；变体：两个人合奏，各自控制旋律和鼓点。
works.description_zh: 基于身体追踪的 AR 把舞者的四肢变成触发器，让她在移动时现场演奏音乐。
works.idea_en: Body tracking turns each of his girlfriend's movements into a playable instrument.
works.technique_zh: 身体追踪提供关节位置，当肢体进入设定的触发区域或速度超过阈值时，播放音符并生成视觉效果。
works.exercise_en: Mark out several zones in the frame with MediaPipe Pose so that a hand or foot entering each zone plays a different note. Twist: two people play together, one on melody and one on drums.

works.title: Infinity
works.description: A generative installation of endlessly evolving digital beings; the interactive version lets visitors' presence and movement influence the figures on screen.
works.idea_zh: 观众的出现改变无尽行走的人群

video.video_title: Infinity - User Interaction

works.technique: A crowd of procedurally animated walkers is rendered in real time, and camera-based presence tracking (likely blob or pose detection) modulates their speed, density or appearance.
works.exercise_zh: 在 p5.js 或 TouchDesigner 中做一队无限行走的抽象人形，用摄像头检测观众人数和位置来改变队伍节奏；变体：观众离开后，人群保留他们留下的某种痕迹。
works.description_zh: 一件生成式装置，展示无尽演化的数字生命；在互动版本中，观众的在场与动作会影响屏幕上的人形。
works.idea_en: The arrival of viewers changes an endless crowd of walkers.
works.technique_zh: 实时渲染一群程序化动画的行走者，基于摄像头的在场追踪（可能是斑点检测或姿态检测）调节它们的速度、密度或外观。
works.exercise_en: Make a line of endlessly walking abstract figures in p5.js or TouchDesigner, and use a camera to detect how many viewers there are and where they stand to change the rhythm of the line. Twist: after viewers leave, the crowd keeps some trace of them.

works.title: Innerworld Prism
works.description: A large-scale projection in Saint Paul commissioned by the Great Northern Festival: a dreamlike animation about losing the human ego to regain nature.
works.idea_zh: 用巨型投影讲述“放下自我、回到自然”的梦境
works.technique: Animated Dakota-inspired illustration is projected at architectural scale onto an urban surface.
works.exercise_zh: 以本地自然或文化符号画一段30秒的循环动画，晚上投到教学楼外墙；变化：让动画中的元素从墙上的窗户“钻出来”。

video.video_title: Innerworld Prism - Large-Scale Projection | Saint Paul, MN (2021)

works.description_zh: 受 Great Northern Festival 委托在圣保罗创作的大型投影：一段关于放下人类自我、重新回归自然的梦幻动画。
works.idea_en: A giant projection tells a dream about letting go of the self and returning to nature.
works.technique_zh: 受达科他文化启发的插画动画以建筑尺度投影到城市表面。
works.exercise_en: Draw a 30-second looping animation using local natural or cultural symbols and project it onto the outer wall of a school building at night. Twist: make elements of the animation crawl out through the windows in the wall.

works.title: KAWS × Reese's Puffs WebAR
works.description: Scanning a QR code on KAWS-designed cereal boxes launches a WebAR game in which KAWS characters appear around the box.
works.idea_zh: 扫早餐麦片盒就能在桌上和KAWS角色玩AR游戏
works.technique: An on-pack QR code opens a browser-based AR experience built with the ZapWorks Universal AR SDK for Unity, tracking the packaging as the anchor.
works.exercise_zh: 为一个零食包装设计网页AR（如MindAR或8th Wall），扫包装出现小游戏；变化：包装背面的不同图案解锁不同关卡。

video.video_title: WebAR for Packaging: Acute Art – KAWS Puffs X General Mills

works.description_zh: 扫描 KAWS 设计的早餐麦片盒上的二维码，就会启动一款 WebAR 游戏，KAWS 角色出现在盒子周围。
works.idea_en: Scan a cereal box and play an AR game with KAWS characters on your table.
works.technique_zh: 包装上的二维码打开一个基于浏览器的 AR 体验，使用 ZapWorks Universal AR SDK for Unity 构建，以包装本身作为追踪锚点。
works.exercise_en: Design web AR for a snack package with MindAR or 8th Wall so that scanning the package launches a mini-game. Twist: different patterns on the back of the package unlock different levels.

works.title: KID A MNESIA EXHIBITION
works.description: A free explorable virtual exhibition where visitors wander an upside-down analogue/digital building made from Thom Yorke's and Stanley Donwood's artwork, with rooms that react to Radiohead's music.
works.description_zh: 一座免费的可探索虚拟展馆，观众在一座由 Thom Yorke 和 Stanley Donwood 的作品构成、颠倒的模拟/数字建筑中游荡，每个房间都会对 Radiohead 的音乐做出反应。
works.idea_en: An album becomes architecture: each song is a room you walk through.
works.idea_zh: 把专辑变成建筑：每首歌都是一间可以走过的房间。
works.technique: Built in Unreal Engine with Namethemachine and Epic Games, the spaces use original drawings as textures and spatialized stems that respond to the visitor's position.
works.technique_zh: 与 Namethemachine 和 Epic Games 合作，用 Unreal Engine 打造，空间以原始绘画为贴图，并使用随观众位置变化的空间化分轨音频。
works.exercise_en: Pick three songs and design a small walkable 3D room for each in a game engine, using your own drawings as textures and placing sounds so they get louder as you approach. Twist: make one room only reachable by walking backwards.
works.exercise_zh: 选三首歌，在游戏引擎中为每首歌设计一个可行走的小房间，用自己的绘画做贴图，并摆放越靠近越响的声音；变体：让其中一个房间只能倒着走才能进入。

video.video_title: KID A MNESIA EXHIBITION - OFFICIAL TRAILER

works.title: Lil Cartoon Bratz Doll
works.description: A Snapchat lens that turns the user's face into a big-eyed, glossy-lipped 90s fashion-doll cartoon, inspired by Piskin's favourite childhood toy.
works.idea_zh: 把你的脸实时变成90年代时尚娃娃的卡通模样。

video.video_title: DREAM IT BUILD IT: LIL CARTOON BRATZ with PAIGE PISKIN

works.technique: A machine-learning face transformation (likely a GAN-based style model) restyles the face into a cartoon while keeping head pose and expression.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Lens Studio 的 ML 风格化或人脸变形工具，把脸变成一种你童年玩具的风格；变体：写一段说明，解释你保留了原脸的哪些特征。
works.description_zh: 一个 Snapchat 滤镜，把用户的脸变成大眼睛、亮晶晶嘴唇的 90 年代时尚娃娃卡通形象，灵感来自 Piskin 童年最爱的玩具。
works.idea_en: Turn your face into a 90s fashion-doll cartoon in real time.
works.technique_zh: 基于机器学习的人脸变换（大概率是基于 GAN 的风格模型）把脸部重绘为卡通风格，同时保留头部姿态和表情。
works.exercise_en: Use Lens Studio's ML stylization or face-distortion tools to turn a face into the style of a toy from your childhood. Twist: write a short note explaining which features of the original face you kept.

works.title: Lil Nas X Met Gala Armour Filter (in 4 hours)
works.description: Inspired by Lil Nas X's golden armour at the Met Gala, Don Allen III sculpts and publishes a wearable AR version on Snapchat within about four hours, showing every step.
works.description_zh: 受 Lil Nas X 在 Met Gala 上的金色盔甲启发，Don Allen III 在大约四小时内雕刻并发布了一个可穿戴的 Snapchat AR 版本，并展示了每一步。
works.idea_en: Treat AR fashion as real-time commentary: react to a pop-culture moment the same day.
works.idea_zh: 把 AR 时装当作实时评论：流行文化事件当天就作出回应。
works.technique: Armour sculpted in Gravity Sketch VR, refined in Cinema 4D and Substance 3D Painter, then skinned to the body mesh in Lens Studio.
works.technique_zh: 在 Gravity Sketch 中用 VR 雕刻盔甲，再在 Cinema 4D 和 Substance 3D Painter 中细化，最后在 Lens Studio 中蒙皮到身体网格上。
works.exercise_en: Pick a news or pop-culture moment from this week and make a wearable AR piece about it in under three hours. Twist: it must be readable without any text or logos.
works.exercise_zh: 挑选本周的一条新闻或流行文化事件，在三小时内做一件相关的可穿戴 AR 作品；变体：作品不能用任何文字或标志，也要让人看懂。

video.video_title: How to make LilNasX  fashion into an AR filter! In 4 hours Met Gala

works.title: Mirror Self-Portraits
works.description: Mirrors break LiDAR and photogrammetry, so Mikko turned the failure into an effect: the scanner reconstructs the reflection as a warped room behind the glass, creating trippy 3D self-portraits.
works.description_zh: 镜子会让 LiDAR 和摄影测量失效，Mikko 干脆把这个失败变成效果：扫描器把镜中倒影当成真实空间，重建出镜子后面一个扭曲的房间，形成迷幻的 3D 自画像。
works.idea_en: Use a scanner's failure mode as a creative effect.
works.idea_zh: 把扫描器的失败模式当作创作手法。
works.technique: LiDAR and photogrammetry assume opaque surfaces, so a mirror's reflection is reconstructed as extra geometry behind the glass, yielding mirrored self-portrait meshes.
works.technique_zh: LiDAR 和摄影测量都假设表面不透明，于是镜中倒影被重建成玻璃后方多出来的几何体，得到镜像式的自画像网格。
works.exercise_en: Deliberately scan 'unscannable' things (mirror, glass, water, a moving person) and curate the most beautiful failures into an AR glitch gallery. Twist: design a scene that only makes sense because of the scanning error.
works.exercise_zh: 故意去扫描“扫不了”的东西（镜子、玻璃、水、移动的人），把最美的失败挑出来办一个 AR 故障画廊；变体：设计一个只有依靠扫描错误才成立的场景。

video.video_title:
Lidar and Photogrammetry will both fail on reflective surfaces. You can use mirrors to create some pretty trippy self portraits though

https://t.co/oTtBbUAUdP

#1scanaday https://t.co/AMP3whMg81

works.title: ModularHMD
works.description: A VR headset with three removable side displays: pop a module off to see the real person next to you or your phone, snap it back for full immersion.
works.description_zh: 一款带三个可拆卸侧面显示模块的 VR 头显：拔掉一个模块就能看到身边的人或手机，插回去又恢复完全沉浸。
works.idea_en: Make the headset's walls physically removable so reality can be let in piece by piece.
works.idea_zh: 让头显的“墙”可以物理拆卸，一块一块地放现实进来。
works.technique: Mounts three removable display modules in the periphery of a commercial HMD cowl, reconfigured by hand to switch between immersion and peripheral real-world awareness.
works.technique_zh: 在商用头显外壳周边安装三个可拆卸显示模块，手动重组即可在沉浸和感知周围现实之间切换。
works.exercise_en: Build a cardboard viewer with three flaps that fold open to reveal the real room, then play a phone VR game and note when you open each flap. Twist: let a partner open the flaps for you as a social signal.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个带三块可翻开挡板的纸盒眼镜，翻开挡板即可看到真实房间，玩一款手机 VR 游戏并记录何时打开哪块挡板；变体：让同伴替你打开挡板，把它当成一种社交信号。

video.video_title: A Reconfigurable Mobile Head-Mounted Display Supporting Real World Interactions

works.title: Multi-person AR fashion
works.description: Real-time AR garments dress several people at once, exploring shared digital fashion on the street.
works.idea_zh: 多人同时穿上AR数字时装

video.video_title: Multi-person AR fashion

works.technique: Lens Studio multi-body tracking attaches garment meshes or cloth simulations to several detected skeletons in the same camera frame.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Lens Studio 多人体追踪给画面里所有人穿上一套统一的数字服装；变体：让服装的颜色或纹样由两个人之间的距离决定，靠近时融合。
works.description_zh: 实时 AR 服装同时为多人穿上衣服，探索街头共享的数字时尚。
works.idea_en: Several people wear AR digital fashion at the same time.
works.technique_zh: Lens Studio 的多人身体追踪把服装网格或布料模拟附着到同一摄像头画面中检测到的多个骨架上。
works.exercise_en: Use Lens Studio multi-body tracking to dress everyone in the frame in one matching digital outfit. Twist: let the distance between two people set the color or pattern of the clothes, blending when they come close.

works.title: National Geographic / NASA JPL Mars AR filter
works.description: Timed with the Perseverance landing, an Instagram AR portal let 220 million followers step into a 360° panorama of Jezero Crater made from images only hours old.
works.idea_zh: 毅力号着陆当天，用最新火星照片做成可走进的 AR 传送门。

video.video_title: Behind The Scenes: National Geographic / NASA JPL - Mars AR Instagram Filter

works.technique: A world-anchored portal masks a spherical 360° panorama so it is visible only through the door, updated with near-real-time rover imagery.
works.exercise_zh: 用一张真实的 360 全景照（学校、太空、海底）做一扇 AR 传送门；加一个变化：门里的场景每天自动换成新照片。
works.description_zh: 配合毅力号着陆，一个 Instagram AR 传送门让 2.2 亿关注者走进由仅数小时前拍摄的图像拼成的耶泽罗陨石坑 360° 全景。
works.idea_en: On the day Perseverance landed, the newest Mars photos became an AR portal you could walk into.
works.technique_zh: 锚定在世界空间中的传送门对球形 360° 全景进行遮罩，使其只能透过门看到，全景内容以近乎实时的火星车图像更新。
works.exercise_en: Make an AR portal from a real 360 panorama photo of your school, space or the sea floor. Twist: the scene inside the portal automatically switches to a new photo every day.

works.title: Neural Cameras
works.description: Virtual objects inserted into a phone video pick up the same noise, blur, colour and lens quirks as the real camera, so they stop looking pasted on.
works.description_zh: 插入手机视频的虚拟物体会带上与真实相机相同的噪点、模糊、色彩和镜头特征，不再显得像贴上去的。
works.idea_en: Make virtual objects look filmed by the same imperfect camera as everything else.
works.idea_zh: 让虚拟物体看起来是被同一台不完美的相机拍下来的。
works.technique: Trains neural networks on image databases from a physical camera to jointly simulate its imaging pipeline and applies them to rendered objects before compositing.
works.technique_zh: 用某台实体相机拍摄的图像数据库训练神经网络，联合模拟其成像流程，并在合成前作用于渲染出的物体。
works.exercise_en: Place a 3D model into a phone AR scene, then add grain, slight blur and a colour tint until classmates can no longer tell which object is real. Twist: match a vintage camera look instead.
works.exercise_zh: 在手机 AR 场景中放入一个三维模型，然后加上颗粒、轻微模糊和色调，直到同学分辨不出哪个物体是真的；变体：改为模仿复古相机的风格。

video.video_title: Neural Cameras: Learning Camera Characteristics for Coherent Mixed Reality Rendering

works.title: PONK connected lens
works.description: Two friends play classic Pong in AR, each hitting the ball from their own phone in a shared Snapchat lens.
works.idea_zh: 两个人在同一片现实空间里打 AR 版乒乓 Pong。

video.video_title: You can now play classic pong in AR with a friend in my new connected lens game PONK, try it out now! https://t.co/40DYMKGVmG https://t.co/kCqdwogo7f

works.technique: Snap Connected Lenses sync game state and a shared coordinate frame between devices so both players see the same ball and paddles.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Lens Studio Connected Lens 或 Photon 做双人 AR 小游戏；加一个变化：球拍由玩家的脸部位置控制。
works.description_zh: 两个朋友在 AR 中玩经典的 Pong，在同一个 Snapchat 共享滤镜里各自用自己的手机击球。
works.idea_en: Two people play AR Pong in the same real space.
works.technique_zh: Snap Connected Lenses 在设备之间同步游戏状态和共享坐标系，使两位玩家看到同一个球和同样的球拍。
works.exercise_en: Build a two-player AR mini-game with Lens Studio Connected Lens or Photon. Twist: players control their paddles with the position of their faces.

works.title: Pikmin Bloom
works.description: A walking game made with Nintendo: Pikmin sprout from your steps, follow you through the city and plant flowers along the path you walk, visible in AR.
works.idea_zh: 每走一步都在城市里种下花，皮克敏在AR里跟着你散步。

video.video_title: Pikmin Bloom Game Overview Trailer

works.technique: Pedometer and GPS trail data are drawn as a flower path on the map, and AR mode places followers on the ground plane behind the camera position.
works.exercise_zh: 记录一次散步的 GPS 轨迹，在地图上画成一条花径，并在 AR 中让一个小角色跟在你身后；变体：花的种类由你当时经过的地点类型决定。
works.description_zh: 与任天堂合作的一款步行游戏：皮克敏从你的脚步中萌发，跟着你穿过城市，沿你走过的路种下花朵，在 AR 中清晰可见。
works.idea_en: Every step plants flowers in the city, and Pikmin follow you on your walk in AR.
works.technique_zh: 计步器和 GPS 轨迹数据在地图上绘制成花径，AR 模式则把跟随的小角色放在相机位置后方的地面平面上。
works.exercise_en: Record the GPS track of a walk, draw it on a map as a flower path, and have a small character follow behind you in AR. Twist: the kind of flower depends on the type of place you were passing.

works.title: Poem World (Snap Spectacles)
works.description: A short poem by Shantell Martin laid out as lines of text in space that you read by walking through them, recorded through Snap's AR Spectacles.
works.idea_zh: 一首可以走进去读的诗：文字排布在空间里，读诗就是走路。
works.technique: World-tracked text meshes are placed along a path in Lens Studio; the reading order is set by where the wearer walks rather than by scrolling.
works.exercise_zh: 把一首短诗拆成词句，用 AR 摆放在走廊或操场上，让“读”变成一条行走路线；变体：让某些词只在你停下来时才出现。

video.video_title: 🔈 had the oppourtunity to work with the new snap AR spectacles — and had the idea of a poem you could walk through.  collaborated with the amazing @shantell_martin who made a beautiful short poem and

works.description_zh: Shantell Martin 的一首短诗被排布成空间中的一行行文字，你要穿行其间才能读完，全程通过 Snap 的 AR Spectacles 录制。
works.idea_en: A poem you walk into: the words are laid out in space, and reading means walking.
works.technique_zh: 在 Lens Studio 中沿一条路径放置世界追踪的文字网格；阅读顺序由佩戴者走到哪里决定，而不是靠滚动。
works.exercise_en: Break a short poem into words and phrases and place them in AR along a corridor or across a sports field, so reading becomes a walking route. Twist: some words appear only when you stop.

works.title: Pokémon GO AR Mapping
works.description: Players scan PokéStops and Gyms with their camera during field research tasks, producing 3D scans that build Niantic's map for persistent, location-anchored AR.
works.idea_zh: 玩家扫描现实地标，众包建起一张供AR使用的三维世界地图。

video.video_title: Pokémon GO: AR Mapping Tasks

works.technique: Players capture short camera scans with pose data around landmarks, which are reconstructed into 3D maps used to build a visual positioning system.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Polycam 或 Scaniverse 扫描校园中的一个地标，把扫描模型放回 AR 与原物对齐；变体：全班扫描同一个地标，比较不同扫描路径的效果。
works.description_zh: 玩家在完成实地调查任务时用摄像头扫描宝可梦补给站和道馆，产出的三维扫描用来构建 Niantic 的地图，以实现持久且锚定于地点的 AR。
works.idea_en: Players scan real landmarks and crowdsource a 3D world map for AR.
works.technique_zh: 玩家围绕地标拍摄带位姿数据的简短摄像头扫描，这些扫描被重建为三维地图，用于构建视觉定位系统。
works.exercise_en: Scan a campus landmark with Polycam or Scaniverse and place the scanned model back in AR aligned with the original. Twist: have the whole class scan the same landmark and compare how different scanning paths turn out.

works.title: Project LFX: Steerable Projected Interfaces
works.description: A pan-and-tilt projector that moves projected interfaces around the room onto tables, walls and objects wherever they are needed.
works.idea_zh: 会转头的投影仪，把界面送到房间里任何表面。

video.video_title: Lightform announces Project LFX | Steerable Projected Interfaces

works.technique: Mounts a projector-camera on a motorized pan-tilt head and re-warps content in real time for each target surface in a scanned room model.
works.exercise_zh: 把手机投影仪放在可转动的台灯臂或旋转底座上，手动转动把一个“计时器界面”投到桌面、墙面、门上；变化：用舵机+Arduino让它自动跟随一个人。
works.description_zh: 一台可水平与俯仰转动的投影仪，能把投影界面移动到房间里需要的任何地方，投在桌面、墙面和物体上。
works.idea_en: A projector that turns its head to deliver interfaces onto any surface in the room.
works.technique_zh: 把投影仪-相机组安装在电动云台上，并根据扫描得到的房间模型，为每个目标表面实时重新变形投影内容。
works.exercise_en: Put a phone projector on a rotating desk-lamp arm or turntable and turn it by hand to project a timer interface onto the desk, the wall and the door. Twist: use a servo and Arduino to make it follow a person automatically.

works.title: Resize your present with a photo scan
works.description: A real gift is photo-scanned into a 3D model and re-imported into AR, where it can be scaled up or down.
works.idea_zh: 把真实礼物扫描成 3D 模型，再在 AR 里随意放大缩小。

video.video_title: Don’t like the size of your present? 🎁 Just photo scan it and then import it into AR. #webar #8thwall #aframe https://t.co/WP29By9Ir0

works.technique: Photogrammetry turns photos of a real object into a textured mesh, which is re-imported into AR and placed with hit test, with a pinch gesture mapped to uniform scale.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Polycam 或 Object Capture 扫描一件小物品，放回 AR 中用双指缩放到房间那么大；变体：放大后可以“走进”它的内部。
works.description_zh: 把一件真实礼物用照片扫描成三维模型，再导回 AR 中，就可以随意放大或缩小。
works.idea_en: Scan a real gift into a 3D model and scale it freely in AR.
works.technique_zh: 摄影测量把真实物体的照片转换为带纹理的网格，再导回 AR 中通过命中测试放置，并将双指捏合手势映射为等比缩放。
works.exercise_en: Scan a small object with Polycam or Object Capture, bring it back into AR and pinch to scale it up to the size of the room. Twist: once enlarged, you can walk inside it.

works.title: Rift
works.description: A full-body Snapchat Lens co-created by Don Allen Stevenson III and Paige Piskin: crystal shards burst from the wearer's shoulders and chest, the eyes glow white, and the scene shifts into a psychedelic colour palette.
works.description_zh: Don Allen Stevenson III 与 Paige Piskin 合作的全身 Snapchat Lens：水晶碎片从佩戴者的肩膀和胸口迸出，双眼发出白光，整个画面变成迷幻的配色。
works.idea_en: Two creators co-design one Lens that restyles the entire body, not just the face.
works.idea_zh: 两位创作者共同设计一个改造整个身体、而不只是脸的 Lens。
works.technique: Lens Studio full-body tracking and 3D body mesh attach rigged costume pieces and VFX to the user's skeleton.
works.technique_zh: 用 Lens Studio 的全身追踪和 3D 身体网格，把绑定好骨骼的服装部件和特效挂到用户的骨架上。
works.exercise_en: In pairs, design a full-body Lens where one partner makes the costume and the other makes the environment effect, then merge them. Twist: the costume must change when the wearer raises both arms.
works.exercise_zh: 两人一组设计一个全身 Lens：一人负责服装，一人负责环境特效，最后合并；变体：佩戴者举起双臂时服装必须发生变化。

video.video_title: DREAM IT BUILD IT: Rift with Don Allen Stevenson III & Paige Piskin

works.title: Robot arm follows a toio car
works.description: A small myCobot robot arm always turns to face a moving toio toy car without any computer vision, and simple AR collision effects burst when the cars meet.
works.description_zh: 一个小型 myCobot 机械臂始终转向正在移动的 toio 小车，完全不用计算机视觉；小车相撞时还会出现简单的 AR 碰撞特效。
works.idea_en: Let robots and tiny toy cars share one coordinate system so AR effects can join the physical play.
works.idea_zh: 让机械臂和小玩具车共享同一个坐标系，使 AR 特效能加入实体游戏。
works.technique: toio cars report their absolute position from the printed mat, which is sent over Wi-Fi to the arm's board so it computes the facing angle, while an AR layer uses the same positions for collision effects.
works.technique_zh: toio 小车通过印刷底垫读出绝对位置，经 Wi-Fi 发给机械臂的控制板计算朝向角，AR 图层也用这些位置来触发碰撞特效。
works.exercise_en: Use a toio, a robot vacuum or a phone on wheels as a tracked object and make a phone-AR effect follow it. Twist: the effect should predict where it will be in one second.
works.exercise_zh: 用 toio、扫地机器人或装在小车上的手机作为被追踪物体，让手机 AR 特效跟随它。变体：特效要预测它一秒后的位置。

video.video_title: Got a robot arm from MyCobot, pretty lightweight and easy to develop. Made a small demo of robot always facing the toio car with no CV tracking, and added some simple AR collision effect. More fun exp

works.title: Siren Songs
works.description: An animated, immersive AR public artwork for Elevation 1049 in Gstaad and St. Moritz: drawn forms float in the Alpine landscape with a sung soundtrack.
works.idea_zh: 阿尔卑斯山间会唱歌的AR声音雕塑

video.video_title: Nancy Baker Cahill on the genesis of 'Siren Songs'

works.technique: Geolocated, large-scale animated drawings are anchored in open landscape with a synced spatial soundtrack, using GPS and compass for placement at distance.
works.exercise_zh: 选一处开阔景观，用 WebAR 放置随歌声起伏的漂浮线条，并录一段自己的哼唱作为声轨；变体：让线条形态由声音频谱实时生成。
works.description_zh: 为格施塔德和圣莫里茨的 Elevation 1049 创作的沉浸式 AR 动画公共艺术：手绘形态漂浮在阿尔卑斯山景中，伴随着一段歌声配乐。
works.idea_en: Singing AR sound sculptures among the Alps.
works.technique_zh: 带地理定位的大尺度绘画动画锚定在开阔景观中，配有同步的空间音轨，并借助 GPS 和指南针实现远距离放置。
works.exercise_en: Choose an open landscape and use WebAR to place floating lines that rise and fall with a song, recording your own humming as the soundtrack. Twist: generate the shape of the lines in real time from the sound spectrum.

works.title: Starry Interpose (with Sarah Slifer Swift)
works.description: A dance performance at the Manship Artists Residency in which live choreography interacts with Pappenheimer's AR artwork and poses from Paul Manship's sculptures.
works.idea_zh: 舞者与AR作品和雕塑姿态一起完成一场混合现实舞蹈
works.technique: Mobile AR content is placed at the performance site and filmed through devices while dancers enact sculpture poses around the virtual objects.
works.exercise_zh: 选校园一座雕塑，模仿它的姿势编一段舞，用手机AR在旁边放置虚拟元素一起拍摄；变化：观众手机里看到的虚拟元素会“复制”舞者动作。

video.video_title: Starry Interpose - Will Pappenheimer & Sarah Slifer Swift

works.description_zh: 在 Manship 艺术家驻留地上演的一场舞蹈表演：现场编舞与 Pappenheimer 的 AR 作品以及 Paul Manship 雕塑中的姿态相互呼应。
works.idea_en: Dancers perform a mixed-reality dance together with AR artworks and sculpture poses.
works.technique_zh: 在演出场地放置手机 AR 内容，并通过设备拍摄，舞者则在虚拟物体周围演绎雕塑姿态。
works.exercise_en: Pick a sculpture on campus, choreograph a dance that imitates its pose, and film it with virtual elements placed beside it in phone AR. Twist: the virtual elements on the audience's phones copy the dancers' movements.

works.title: Stealth Updates
works.description: Visual content changes in front of the viewer without being noticed, by morphing images gradually and timing changes to exploit change blindness.
works.idea_zh: 利用“变化盲视”，让画面在你眼前改变却察觉不到。

video.video_title: Stealth Updates [SAP 2021]

works.technique: Computes a smooth image morph between old and new content and plays it slowly enough to stay below the threshold of noticed change.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机AR把一张海报上的元素用30秒慢慢变换成另一张图，让同学盯着看并报告是否发现变化；变化：在对方眨眼或转头时再快速切换。
works.description_zh: 通过逐渐变形图像，并利用变化盲视安排变化的时机，让视觉内容在观者眼前改变而不被察觉。
works.idea_en: Use change blindness to alter an image right before your eyes without you noticing.
works.technique_zh: 在旧内容与新内容之间计算平滑的图像变形，并以足够慢的速度播放，使其低于可察觉变化的阈值。
works.exercise_en: Use phone AR to slowly morph an element of a poster into another image over 30 seconds, have classmates stare at it and report whether they notice the change. Twist: switch quickly when the viewer blinks or turns their head.

works.title: Subway PONG
works.description: A playful AR glasses experiment: a game of Pong played across a real subway carriage with fellow passengers.
works.idea_zh: 在地铁车厢里用AR眼镜打乒乓

video.video_title: Subway PONG

works.technique: Likely Spectacles world tracking with a shared or co-located session places a Pong field across the carriage, with head or hand pose controlling the paddle.
works.exercise_zh: 用两台手机在同一 AR 空间中做一个跨越房间的 Pong 游戏，用手机位置当球拍；变体：把球场设在一个公共场所（电梯、走廊），规则要求不认识的人合作。
works.description_zh: 一个充满玩心的 AR 眼镜实验：和同车乘客在真实的地铁车厢里横跨车厢打一局 Pong。
works.idea_en: Play Pong with AR glasses in a subway car.
works.technique_zh: 大概率利用 Spectacles 的世界追踪，配合共享或同处一地的会话，在车厢里铺设一块横跨车厢的 Pong 场地，由头部或手部位姿控制球拍。
works.exercise_en: Use two phones in the same AR space to build a room-spanning Pong game, with each phone's position acting as the paddle. Twist: set the court in a public place such as an elevator or corridor, with rules that require strangers to cooperate.

works.title: The Looking Glass: Darren Bader
works.description: Darren Bader's surreal AR sculptures on The Shed's plaza use humour to question art and contemporary life, visible through the Acute Art app.
works.idea_zh: 把荒诞幽默的AR雕塑放进城市广场，追问“什么是艺术”
works.technique: Mobile AR anchors absurd 3D object combinations at fixed plaza locations via the Acute Art app.
works.exercise_zh: 把两件毫不相干的日常物体组合成一个AR“雕塑”放在校园里并起标题；变化：让观众投票选出最荒诞的组合，下周替换。

video.video_title: Darren Bader on Love and Freedom in AR | "The Looking Glass" exhibition now at The Shed

works.description_zh: Darren Bader 在 The Shed 广场上的超现实 AR 雕塑以幽默的方式追问艺术与当代生活，观众可通过 Acute Art 应用观看。
works.idea_en: Place absurd, funny AR sculptures in a city plaza to ask what counts as art.
works.technique_zh: 手机 AR 通过 Acute Art 应用，将荒诞的三维物体组合锚定在广场上的固定位置。
works.exercise_en: Combine two unrelated everyday objects into an AR sculpture, place it on campus and give it a title. Twist: let viewers vote for the most absurd combination and swap it in next week.

works.title: The Looking Glass: Precious Okoyomon
works.description: On The Shed's public plaza and the High Line, Precious Okoyomon's AR works — creatures and nature-based forms — appear through the Acute Art app as part of the group show The Looking Glass.
works.idea_zh: 在城市广场上用AR召唤出关于自然与身份的柔软生物
works.technique: Site-specific AR placement in the Acute Art app anchors animated 3D sculptures to geolocated spots on the plaza.
works.exercise_zh: 为校园广场设计一个表达“自然回归”的AR生物，并决定它只出现在哪一块具体的地面上；变化：它会随一天中的时间改变颜色。

video.video_title: Precious Okoyomon on Revealing a Whole New Reality | "The Looking Glass" exhibition now at The Shed

works.description_zh: 在 The Shed 的公共广场和高线公园（High Line）上，Precious Okoyomon 的 AR 作品——各种生物和取材自然的形态——通过 Acute Art 应用出现，作为群展 The Looking Glass 的一部分。
works.idea_en: Summon soft creatures about nature and identity into a city plaza with AR.
works.technique_zh: Acute Art 应用中针对场地的 AR 放置功能，把三维动画雕塑锚定在广场上带地理坐标的特定位置。
works.exercise_en: Design an AR creature for a campus plaza that expresses the return of nature, and decide the exact patch of ground where it alone appears. Twist: it changes color with the time of day.

works.title: The Looking Glass: Tomás Saraceno (spiders in AR)
works.description: Tomás Saraceno's AR spiders crawl across The Shed's plaza, part of his project to make spiders and their webs part of our lives and rethink our relationship with other species.
works.idea_zh: 让AR蜘蛛在城市里爬行，重新思考人与其他物种的关系
works.technique: Scanned/animated spider models are placed with plane detection in the Acute Art app so they crawl on real ground surfaces.
works.exercise_zh: 用Reality Composer或Adobe Aero放一只会沿地面爬行的AR昆虫，并写一句它的“视角”说明；变化：昆虫会避开观众的手机靠近。

video.video_title: Tomás Saraceno on Making Spiders Part of Our Lives  | "The Looking Glass" exhibition now at The Shed

works.description_zh: Tomás Saraceno 的 AR 蜘蛛在 The Shed 广场上爬行，这是他的一个项目的一部分：让蜘蛛和蛛网融入我们的生活，重新思考人与其他物种的关系。
works.idea_en: Let AR spiders crawl through the city to rethink how we relate to other species.
works.technique_zh: 在 Acute Art 应用中通过平面检测放置经扫描或制作动画的蜘蛛模型，使其在真实地面上爬行。
works.exercise_en: Use Reality Composer or Adobe Aero to place an AR insect that crawls along the ground, and write one line describing its point of view. Twist: the insect scurries away when a viewer's phone comes close.

works.title: Touch&Fold
works.description: A nail-mounted actuator unfolds a small pad onto the fingertip only when touching virtual objects, and folds away so the finger can feel real objects normally.
works.idea_zh: 指尖触觉器需要时展开、不需要时收起，虚实都能摸。

video.video_title: Touch&Fold: A Foldable Haptic Actuator for Rendering Touch in Mixed Reality

works.technique: Mounts a servo-driven folding tactor on the fingernail that rotates onto the pad for virtual contact and retracts for real-world touch.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个指套纸片装置：碰到手机AR中的虚拟物体时由同伴翻下纸片到指腹，碰真实物体时翻起；变化：纸片换成不同材质代表不同虚拟物。
works.description_zh: 一个装在指甲上的驱动器只在触碰虚拟物体时把小垫片展开到指尖，其余时候收起，让手指仍能正常感受真实物体。
works.idea_en: A fingertip haptic device folds out when needed and tucks away when not, so you can feel both virtual and real things.
works.technique_zh: 在指甲上安装一个由舵机驱动的折叠式触觉单元：接触虚拟物体时它转到指腹上，触摸真实物体时则收回。
works.exercise_en: Make a paper finger-flap device: when you touch a virtual object in phone AR, a partner flips the paper down onto your fingerpad, and flips it up when you touch a real object. Twist: swap the paper for different materials to stand for different virtual objects.

works.title: Urban Lasergame AR
works.description: A location-based AR laser tag game played in city streets.
works.idea_zh: 把城市街道变成AR激光枪战场

video.video_title: Urban Lasergame AR

works.technique: Likely GPS positioning plus camera-based person detection (or shared AR sessions) registers hits when a player aims the phone at another player.
works.exercise_zh: 用 WebAR + 人体检测做一个简化激光枪游戏：对准画面中的人并点击即算命中；变体：命中后不是“淘汰”，而是在对方身上留下一件 AR 装饰。
works.description_zh: 一款基于位置、在城市街道上进行的 AR 激光枪对战游戏。
works.idea_en: Turn city streets into an AR laser-tag battlefield.
works.technique_zh: 大概率结合 GPS 定位与基于摄像头的人体检测（或共享 AR 会话），当玩家把手机对准另一名玩家时判定命中。
