works.exercise_en: Build a simple laser-tag game with WebAR and person detection, where aiming at a person in the frame and tapping counts as a hit. Twist: a hit does not knock the other player out but leaves an AR decoration on them.

works.title: VarioLight 2: Rhythmic Gymnastics
works.description: Wide-range dynamic projection follows a rhythmic gymnast's ball and ribbon, painting light effects onto the apparatus during the routine.
works.idea_zh: 投影追着体操运动员的球和彩带，在表演中给它们'上色'。

video.video_title: VarioLight 2: Wide Dynamic Projection Mapping in Rhythmic Gymnastics

works.technique: High-speed vision tracks the gymnastics ball and ribbon, and galvanometer mirrors steer a projector to keep light effects registered on the fast-moving apparatus throughout the routine.
works.exercise_zh: 用摄像头颜色追踪一个抛接的彩色球，在投影仪或屏幕上让光效和粒子跟随球的轨迹，配合一段音乐完成 30 秒表演；变体：光效由球的速度或高度驱动音乐变化。
works.description_zh: 大范围动态投影跟随艺术体操运动员的球和彩带，在整套动作中把光效投射到器械上。
works.idea_en: Projection chases a gymnast's ball and ribbon and colors them during the routine.
works.technique_zh: 高速视觉追踪体操球和彩带，振镜引导投影仪的光路，在整套动作中让光效始终贴合在快速运动的器械上。
works.exercise_en: Use camera color tracking on a colored ball being tossed and caught, make light effects and particles follow its path on a projector or screen, and perform a 30-second routine to music. Twist: the ball's speed or height drives changes in the music.

works.title: Volumetric people with superpowers (Studio ANRK x Volograms)
works.description: Test Snapchat Lenses that drop volumetric captures of real people into the scene and give them superpowers, such as bursts of energy around their bodies.
works.description_zh: 一组 Snapchat 测试 Lens，把真人的体积视频捕捉放进场景里，并给他们加上“超能力”，比如环绕身体的能量爆发。
works.idea_en: Put a real, filmed human into social AR and then make them superhuman.
works.idea_zh: 把真实拍摄的人放进社交 AR，再让他们变成超人。
works.technique: Volograms turns single-camera video into volumetric 3D sequences that are imported into Lens Studio and combined with particle VFX.
works.technique_zh: Volograms 把单机位视频转换成体积 3D 序列，导入 Lens Studio 后与粒子特效结合。
works.exercise_en: Capture a classmate as a short volumetric clip (with a volumetric app or photogrammetry turntable) and place them in AR with one magical effect. Twist: the effect is triggered by the viewer's voice.
works.exercise_zh: 用体积捕捉应用或摄影测量转台把一位同学拍成一段体积视频，放进 AR 并加上一个魔法特效；变体：特效由观看者的声音触发。

video.video_title: Studio ANRK - playing around with Snap lenses with volograms and superpowers

works.title: Vuforia Spatial Toolbox – Remote Operator
works.description: PTC Reality Lab's open-source successor to the Reality Editor: a remote operator sees a live 3D scan of a factory and programs robots and machines by drawing spatial paths.
works.idea_zh: 远程在工厂的实时3D场景里画路径，直接给机器人编程。

video.video_title: Vuforia Spatial Toolbox - Remote Operator Interface

works.technique: A LiDAR scan of the space is streamed to a remote client as a 3D model, and paths drawn in that model are converted into waypoints in the shared coordinate frame and sent to the robot controller.
works.exercise_zh: 用 iPhone LiDAR 扫描应用（如 Polycam）扫描一个房间，在 three.js 里远程打开模型并点击画出一条路径，再把路径发送给另一部手机的 AR 视图显示为地面箭头；变体：让“机器人”由一位同学扮演，按照 AR 路径行走。
works.description_zh: PTC Reality Lab 推出的开源工具，是 Reality Editor 的后继者：远程操作员可以看到工厂的实时三维扫描，并通过绘制空间路径为机器人和机器编程。
works.idea_en: Draw paths remotely in a live 3D scene of a factory to program robots directly.
works.technique_zh: 空间的 LiDAR 扫描以三维模型形式传给远程客户端，在模型中绘制的路径被转换为共享坐标系中的路径点，再发送给机器人控制器。
works.exercise_en: Scan a room with an iPhone LiDAR app such as Polycam, open the model remotely in three.js and click to draw a path, then send the path to another phone's AR view to show as arrows on the floor. Twist: have a classmate play the robot and walk along the AR path.

works.title: Wand Duel
works.description: Players wearing Snap Spectacles face each other in a real room and cast spells by flicking a wand, duelling like wizards in a shared AR arena.
works.description_zh: 戴着 Snap Spectacles 的玩家在真实房间里面对面站立，挥动魔杖施放法术，在共享的 AR 竞技场里像巫师一样决斗。
works.idea_en: Turn AR glasses into a face-to-face magic duel where you can still see your opponent's real face.
works.idea_zh: 把 AR 眼镜变成面对面的魔法决斗，你依然能看到对手真实的脸。
works.technique: Co-located multiplayer on Spectacles syncs player positions and spell projectiles, with hand or controller gestures mapped to spells (likely).
works.technique_zh: 在 Spectacles 上做同空间多人联机，同步玩家位置和法术弹道，并把手势或控制器动作映射为不同法术（推测）。
works.exercise_en: Prototype a two-player phone AR duel where each player's phone position is their shield and a swipe fires a spell. Twist: spells bounce off real walls detected by the phone.
works.exercise_zh: 制作一个双人手机 AR 决斗原型：手机的位置就是盾牌，滑动屏幕即可发射法术；变体：法术会在手机识别出的真实墙面上反弹。

video.video_title: Building An AR Wizard Duelling Game

works.title: XRSpectator
works.description: Fans who cannot attend a match put on a VR headset and sit inside a 360 recording of the stadium, with the same AR stats and replays floating over the field as if they were there.
works.description_zh: 无法到场的球迷戴上 VR 头显，坐进体育场的 360 度录像里，同样的 AR 数据和回放漂浮在球场上方，仿佛身临其境。
works.idea_en: Recreate the in-stadium AR experience at home by augmenting a 360 video instead of reality.
works.idea_zh: 通过增强 360 度视频而不是现实，在家复现场内 AR 观赛体验。
works.technique: Wraps a 360 video of the live stadium around the user and registers the ARSpectator overlays to it, turning on-site AR into indirect AR on a VR HMD.
works.technique_zh: 把现场体育场的 360 度视频包裹在用户周围，并将 ARSpectator 的叠加内容配准到视频上，把现场 AR 变成 VR 头显中的间接 AR。
works.exercise_en: Film a school match with a 360 camera or phone panorama, then add floating labels to the panorama and watch it in a cardboard viewer. Twist: let viewers switch seats between two recording positions.
works.exercise_zh: 用 360 度相机或手机全景拍一场校内比赛，在全景画面中加入悬浮标签，然后用纸盒眼镜观看；变体：让观众在两个录制位置之间“换座位”。

video.video_title: XRSpectator: Immersive, Augmented Sports Spectating

works.title: XRStudio
works.description: A virtual production system for teaching in XR: the instructor's immersive session is mixed with real camera video and live-streamed so remote students can follow.
works.idea_zh: 把老师在XR里的讲课混合成直播画面给学生看。

video.video_title: XRStudio: A Virtual Production and Live Streaming System for Immersive Instructional Experiences

works.technique: Composites the instructor's tracked XR view with external camera footage and scene cameras into multiple switchable streams.
works.exercise_zh: 用OBS把一名同学手机AR画面和教室摄像头画面合成直播，让他用AR讲解一个3D模型；变化：观众通过弹幕控制AR中模型的颜色。
works.description_zh: 一个用于 XR 教学的虚拟制作系统：讲师的沉浸式课堂与真实摄像机画面混合后进行直播，让远程学生也能跟上。
works.idea_en: Mix a teacher's XR lecture into a live stream for students to watch.
works.technique_zh: 将讲师被追踪的 XR 视角与外部摄像机画面和场景相机画面合成为多路可切换的视频流。
works.exercise_en: Use OBS to combine a classmate's phone AR view with the classroom camera into a live stream while they explain a 3D model in AR. Twist: viewers change the model's color in AR through live chat comments.

works.title: border 2021
works.description: An update of the 2015 'border' for post-COVID audiences: seated viewers ride personal mobility devices and watch real and virtual dancers merge through mixed-reality headsets, with an online version too.
works.idea_zh: 观众坐在自动移动的座椅上，戴MR眼镜看真实与虚拟舞者融合
works.technique: Tracked mobility chairs move audience members through the stage while mixed-reality headsets render virtual dancers registered to the physical space.
works.exercise_zh: 让观众坐在带轮椅子上被同学推着走，用手机AR看到预先放置的虚拟舞者；变化：真人舞者与虚拟舞者在某一刻交换位置。

video.video_title: ELEVENPLAY x Rhizomatiks  “border 2021”

works.description_zh: 2015 年作品《border》面向疫情后观众的更新版：观众坐在个人移动设备上，通过混合现实头显观看真实舞者与虚拟舞者融为一体，同时还提供线上版本。
works.idea_en: Seated on self-driving chairs, the audience wears MR headsets and watches real and virtual dancers merge.
works.technique_zh: 被追踪的移动座椅载着观众穿过舞台，混合现实头显则渲染与实体空间对齐的虚拟舞者。
works.exercise_en: Seat audience members on wheeled chairs pushed by classmates while they watch pre-placed virtual dancers in phone AR. Twist: at one moment the live dancer and the virtual dancer swap places.

works.title: eyemR-Vis
works.description: Bi-directional gaze cues between remote collaborators, visualized in MR so each person knows where the other is looking and whether they are attending.
works.idea_zh: 把两个人的视线互相可视化，知道对方在看哪儿、有没有在专注。

video.video_title: eyemR-Vis:A MR System to Visualise Bi-Directional Gaze Behavioural Cues Between Remote Collaborators

works.technique: Eye trackers on both sides capture gaze direction, which is exchanged and visualized as shared gaze rays or highlights in MR, with visual states indicating when both people look at the same object.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe Face Mesh 的虹膜点或 WebGazer.js 近似估计两人在屏幕上的注视点，在共享画面中显示彼此的注视光标，两人同时看同一处时出现特效；变体：用“对视”来完成一个两人协作解谜。
works.description_zh: 远程协作者之间的双向视线提示，在 MR 中可视化呈现，让每个人都知道对方在看哪里、是否在专注。
works.idea_en: Show two people each other's gaze so they know where the other is looking and whether they are paying attention.
works.technique_zh: 双方的眼动追踪器捕捉视线方向，数据互相交换后在 MR 中以共享视线射线或高亮形式呈现，并用视觉状态提示两人何时在看同一个物体。
works.exercise_en: Use MediaPipe Face Mesh iris points or WebGazer.js to roughly estimate where two people are looking on screen, show each other's gaze cursor in a shared view, and trigger an effect when both look at the same spot. Twist: use mutual gaze to solve a two-person puzzle.

works.title: multiplex
works.description: Motion data from five dancers, projected images and five autonomously moving robot cubes share two exhibition spaces and an online version, hybridising real and virtual dancers.
works.idea_zh: 真实舞者数据、投影与自动移动的立方体共同组成混合现实舞台
works.technique: Recorded motion-capture data drives projection-mapped imagery on mobile robot cubes whose positions are tracked so the virtual dancers appear on their moving surfaces.
works.exercise_zh: 把纸箱放在遥控小车上移动，用投影跟随纸箱投出舞者剪影；变化：观众用手机扫码切换看到的“虚拟舞者”视角。

video.video_title: Rhizomatiks x ELEVENPLAY "multiplex" (2021)

works.description_zh: 五位舞者的动作数据、投影影像与五个自主移动的机器人立方体共享两处展览空间和一个线上版本，让真实舞者与虚拟舞者交融。
works.idea_en: Real dancer data, projection and self-moving cubes together form a mixed-reality stage.
works.technique_zh: 录制的动作捕捉数据驱动投影映射到移动机器人立方体上的影像，立方体的位置被实时追踪，使虚拟舞者出现在它们移动的表面上。
works.exercise_en: Put cardboard boxes on RC cars and have a projector follow the boxes to cast dancer silhouettes on them. Twist: viewers scan a QR code on their phones to switch which virtual dancer view they see.

works.title: $100 Wallpaper Using ARKit
works.description: Re-skins the walls of a real room with virtual wallpaper using LiDAR scene geometry.
works.idea_zh: 用 LiDAR 给真实房间换一张虚拟墙纸。

video.video_title: $100 wallpaper using ARKit

works.technique: Wall-classified LiDAR mesh faces receive a triplanar or world-space UV texture, with people occlusion so the wallpaper sits behind people in the room.
works.exercise_zh: 用竖直平面检测识别墙面并贴上重复图案的壁纸，开启人体遮挡；变体：壁纸图案随时间慢慢流动或变色。
works.description_zh: 利用 LiDAR 场景几何，为真实房间的墙面换上虚拟墙纸。
works.idea_en: Give a real room new virtual wallpaper with LiDAR.
works.technique_zh: 被分类为墙面的 LiDAR 网格面使用三平面映射或世界空间 UV 贴上纹理，并开启人体遮挡，让墙纸显示在房间中的人后方。
works.exercise_en: Use vertical plane detection to find walls, apply a repeating wallpaper pattern, and turn on people occlusion. Twist: the wallpaper pattern slowly flows or changes color over time.

works.title: 3D & AR on Shopify: Stroller Demo
works.description: A demo shown in Daniel Beauchamp's ShipIt! talk: a double stroller on a Shopify product page can be spun in 3D and then placed at real size on the street in AR.
works.description_zh: Daniel Beauchamp 在 ShipIt! 分享中展示的演示：Shopify 商品页上的双人婴儿车可以 3D 旋转查看，再以真实尺寸放到街道上进行 AR 预览。
works.idea_en: Let shoppers check a bulky product's real size in the place they will use it.
works.idea_zh: 让购物者在真正使用的地方确认大件商品的实际尺寸。
works.technique: Merchants upload a 3D model with the product; the storefront shows it in a web 3D viewer and hands a USDZ file to AR Quick Look on iPhone for true-scale placement.
works.technique_zh: 商家随商品上传 3D 模型，店铺用网页 3D 查看器展示，并在 iPhone 上把 USDZ 文件交给 AR Quick Look 进行真实比例放置。
works.exercise_en: Pick one bulky object (bike, stroller, instrument case), get or make its 3D model, and publish a page with a 3D viewer and an AR button; test it where the object would really be used. Twist: add a path animation showing it moving through a doorway.
works.exercise_zh: 选一件大件物品（自行车、婴儿车或琴盒），获取或制作 3D 模型，发布一个带 3D 查看器和 AR 按钮的页面，并在它真正的使用场所测试；变体：加一段它穿过门口的路径动画。

video.video_title: ShipIt! Presents: AR/VR at Shopify

works.title: 3D Scene Reconstruction with iPad Pro LiDAR
works.description: Scans a room live with the iPad Pro LiDAR and renders the growing mesh with shading and grid lines.
works.idea_zh: 用 iPad LiDAR 实时重建房间网格。

video.video_title: 3D Scene Reconstruction using ARKit and iPad Pro with LiDAR

works.technique: ARKit scene reconstruction mesh anchors are rendered in Metal with a normal-based shading and a world-space grid shader, updating as the mesh grows.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 网格管理器显示扫描出的房间网格，并用世界坐标网格线着色器渲染；变体：网格线按扫描先后时间渐变颜色。
works.description_zh: 用 iPad Pro 的 LiDAR 实时扫描房间，并以明暗着色和网格线渲染不断扩展的网格。
works.idea_en: Rebuild a room's mesh live with iPad LiDAR.
works.technique_zh: ARKit 场景重建得到的网格锚点在 Metal 中渲染，使用基于法线的着色和世界空间网格线着色器，并随网格扩展实时更新。
works.exercise_en: Show the scanned room mesh with the AR Foundation mesh manager and render it with a world-space grid-line shader. Twist: color the grid lines as a gradient by the order in which areas were scanned.

works.title: A Futuristic Portal to My Best Friend
works.description: A quarantine project: a mixed-reality 'portal' that opens a window from his apartment into his best friend's space so they can hang out as virtual roommates.
works.idea_zh: 疫情隔离期间，做一道连接好友家的混合现实传送门，当“虚拟室友”。

video.video_title: I Built a FUTURISTIC PORTAL To My Best Friend! (Quarantine Project)

works.technique: A wall-anchored portal renders a live volumetric or depth-video stream of the remote room behind the wall plane, using a stencil mask so the remote space appears to sit behind the real wall.
works.exercise_zh: 在墙上放一个 AR 窗口，窗口里播放朋友实时视频通话的画面（用深度或背景分离做出一点立体感）；变体：窗口只在两人同时站在墙前时打开。
works.description_zh: 一个隔离期间的项目：一道混合现实“传送门”从他的公寓打开一扇通往好友空间的窗户，让两人可以像虚拟室友一样一起消磨时光。
works.idea_en: During quarantine, build a mixed-reality portal into a friend's home and live as virtual roommates.
works.technique_zh: 锚定在墙上的传送门在墙面平面后方渲染远程房间的实时体积视频或深度视频流，并使用模板遮罩，让远程空间看起来就在真实墙壁后面。
works.exercise_en: Put an AR window on a wall that plays a live video call with a friend, using depth or background separation to add a bit of depth. Twist: the window opens only when both of you stand in front of your walls at the same time.

works.title: A Working Marauder's Map – Harry Potter AR
works.description: In a rented 'mini Hogwarts' castle in England, a physical parchment viewed through the phone shows everyone's live GPS position as walking footprints with name labels, like Harry Potter's Marauder's Map.
works.idea_zh: 做一张真能显示城堡里每个人实时位置的“活点地图”。

video.video_title: I Built a WORKING Marauder's Map! ⚡🗺️ - Harry Potter AR Special

works.technique: The parchment is tracked as an image target, and each participant's GPS coordinates are converted into map-space positions on it, where footprint animations and name labels are drawn.
works.exercise_zh: 用图像追踪识别一张校园手绘地图，把几位同学的 GPS 位置实时显示为走动的脚印；变体：地图上只显示“正在移动”的人。
works.description_zh: 在英格兰一座租来的“迷你霍格沃茨”城堡里，透过手机观看一张实体羊皮纸，就能看到每个人的实时 GPS 位置以带名字标签的行走脚印呈现，就像《哈利·波特》中的活点地图。
works.idea_en: Make a Marauder's Map that really shows where everyone in the castle is right now.
works.technique_zh: 羊皮纸作为图像目标被追踪，每位参与者的 GPS 坐标被转换为羊皮纸上的地图坐标，并在相应位置绘制脚印动画和名字标签。
works.exercise_en: Use image tracking to recognize a hand-drawn campus map and show the live GPS positions of a few classmates as walking footprints. Twist: the map shows only the people who are moving.

works.title: AR Boxing Game
works.description: He places virtual opponents in his real living room with AR Foundation and punches at them, turning a fitness routine into an AR boxing match.
works.idea_zh: 把陪练对手放进自家客厅，对着空气打拳也能健身。

video.video_title: Making an AR Boxing Game so I don't Get Fat

works.technique: AR Foundation plane detection places the opponent on the floor and the phone's pose (held or strapped) is used to detect punches and dodges.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 在地上放一个会出拳的沙袋人，玩家侧身躲避；加一个变化：心率越高对手越强。
works.description_zh: 他用 AR Foundation 把虚拟对手放进自家真实的客厅，并对着它们出拳，把日常健身变成一场 AR 拳击赛。
works.idea_en: Bring a sparring partner into your living room, so punching the air becomes a workout.
works.technique_zh: AR Foundation 平面检测把对手放在地面上，手机（手持或绑在身上）的位姿用于检测出拳和闪避。
works.exercise_en: Use AR Foundation to place a punching-bag opponent on the floor that throws punches while the player dodges sideways. Twist: the higher your heart rate, the stronger the opponent.

works.title: AR Drawing
works.description: Strokes drawn with the phone hang in space as stylised 3D lines.
works.idea_zh: 用手机在空中画出风格化的立体线条。

video.video_title: AR drawing

works.technique: Camera positions sampled while touching are converted into ribbon or tube meshes with stylized shading, anchored in world space.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 记录手机移动轨迹生成带状网格，并加卡通描边着色；变体：画完的线会慢慢被“风”吹动。
works.description_zh: 用手机画出的笔画以风格化的三维线条形式悬挂在空中。
works.idea_en: Draw stylized 3D lines in the air with your phone.
works.technique_zh: 在触摸屏幕期间采样的相机位置被转换为带风格化着色的带状或管状网格，并锚定在世界空间中。
works.exercise_en: Record the phone's movement path with AR Foundation to generate a ribbon mesh and add a cartoon outline shader. Twist: finished lines slowly sway in a virtual wind.

works.title: AR wallpaper lenses for Snap
works.description: Sketches for Zach's Snapchat lenses that wrap generative patterns across the walls and surfaces of a room like living wallpaper.
works.idea_zh: “AR就是新的墙纸”：把生成图案铺满房间的墙面和表面。

video.video_title: AR is the new wallpaper — excited to be working on some lenses for snap https://t.co/lFuM1oWbj8

works.technique: Lens Studio world mesh / plane detection supplies wall surfaces, and a generative shader with world-space UVs tiles animated patterns across them.
works.exercise_zh: 在 Lens Studio 或 AR Foundation 平面检测上给墙面铺一层会呼吸的程序化花纹（shader 用世界坐标做 UV）；变体：花纹随房间的环境光或声音改变，让宿舍墙变成“情绪壁纸”。
works.description_zh: Zach 为 Snapchat 滤镜做的草图：生成式图案像会呼吸的墙纸一样铺满房间的墙面和各个表面。
works.idea_en: AR is the new wallpaper: cover a room's walls and surfaces with generative patterns.
works.technique_zh: Lens Studio 的世界网格或平面检测提供墙面，使用世界空间 UV 的生成式着色器在墙面上平铺动态图案。
works.exercise_en: Lay a breathing procedural pattern over walls using plane detection in Lens Studio or AR Foundation, with a shader that uses world coordinates as UVs. Twist: the pattern changes with the room's ambient light or sound, turning a dorm wall into mood wallpaper.

works.title: ARHide
works.description: A LiDAR-era experiment that makes real objects in the scene disappear or turn translucent in AR.
works.idea_zh: LiDAR 时代的“隐身”实验：让真实物体从画面中消失。

video.video_title: ARHide

works.technique: The LiDAR scene mesh is used to cut out a real object's region, which is filled with background captured earlier or rendered with reduced alpha to make the object vanish or turn translucent.
works.exercise_zh: 用 LiDAR 网格选中一件家具，用事先拍好的背景贴图把它覆盖掉；变体：让物体按时间逐渐变透明，像在“褪色”。
works.description_zh: 一个 LiDAR 时代的实验，让场景中的真实物体在 AR 中消失或变得半透明。
works.idea_en: A LiDAR-era invisibility experiment that makes real objects vanish from view.
works.technique_zh: 利用 LiDAR 场景网格抠出真实物体所在区域，再用事先采集的背景填充，或降低透明度渲染，使物体消失或变得半透明。
works.exercise_en: Select a piece of furniture with the LiDAR mesh and cover it with a background texture you photographed in advance. Twist: make the object turn transparent gradually over time, as if fading away.

works.title: Anti-Gone
works.description: A live mixed-reality performance (Sundance 2020) where a motion-captured performer drives an ork-like avatar through a simulated swamp in real time.
works.idea_zh: 动捕表演者实时驱动虚拟生物的沼泽剧场

video.video_title: Anti-Gone | Performance Preview (Sundance 2020 Premiere)

works.technique: Real-time motion capture streams the performer's skeleton into Unity, retargeted to a game avatar in a simulated environment and projected for a live audience.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe Pose 或手机动捕 App 实时驱动 Unity 里的一个奇怪生物，投影在墙上现场演一段 3 分钟的独白；变体：让观众通过手机投票改变生物所处环境的天气。
works.description_zh: 一场现场混合现实表演（2020 年圣丹斯电影节）：经动作捕捉的表演者实时驱动一个类似兽人的化身，穿行在模拟的沼泽中。
works.idea_en: A swamp theater where a motion-captured performer drives a virtual creature in real time.
works.technique_zh: 实时动作捕捉把表演者的骨骼数据传入 Unity，重定向到模拟环境中的游戏化身上，并投影给现场观众观看。
works.exercise_en: Use MediaPipe Pose or a phone motion-capture app to drive a strange creature in Unity in real time, and project it on a wall to perform a 3-minute monologue live. Twist: let the audience vote on their phones to change the weather in the creature's environment.

works.title: Aquatic: an AR journey into the deep sea
works.description: Wearing an AR headset, a visitor sees glowing deep-sea creatures and sparks of bioluminescence bloom over the coffee table and drift through a sunny office lounge.
works.description_zh: 戴上 AR 头显后，参观者看到发光的深海生物和点点生物荧光在咖啡桌上绽放，并飘过阳光充足的办公室休息区。
works.idea_en: Flood an ordinary room with the mysterious life of the deep sea.
works.idea_zh: 让普通房间充满深海里神秘的生命。
works.technique: Likely a head-worn AR display anchoring particle-based creatures to a table surface, with VFX for bioluminescent trails.
works.technique_zh: 很可能是用头戴式 AR 显示把粒子构成的生物锚定在桌面上，并用视觉特效做出生物荧光的轨迹。
works.exercise_en: Anchor one bioluminescent creature to a real object in phone AR and let it swim around that object. Twist: it only glows when the room lights are off.
works.exercise_zh: 在手机 AR 里把一只发光生物锚定在一个真实物体上，让它绕着物体游动。变体：只有关掉房间灯时它才会发光。

video.video_title: Aquatic: An augmented reality journey into mysterious deep sea

works.title: Audio Augmented Reality with face-tracking
works.description: An audio-first AR prototype that uses face tracking to follow your head and render spatial sound anchored in the room around you.
works.idea_zh: 用人脸追踪获取头部朝向，做只靠声音的空间AR。

video.video_title: Audio Augmented Reality with face-tracking

works.technique: Front-camera face tracking gives the head pose, which updates the audio listener orientation so sound sources stay world-anchored while the user turns their head.
works.exercise_zh: 用 ARKit 人脸追踪获取头部转向，控制 Unity 中 AudioListener 的朝向，让一段声音固定在房间的某个方向；变体：做一个闭眼也能玩的“声音寻宝”。
works.description_zh: 一个以音频为核心的 AR 原型：利用人脸追踪跟随你的头部，渲染锚定在你周围房间中的空间声音。
works.idea_en: Use face tracking to get head direction and build spatial AR made only of sound.
works.technique_zh: 前置摄像头的人脸追踪提供头部位姿，并据此更新音频监听器的朝向，使用户转头时声源仍固定在世界空间中。
works.exercise_en: Use ARKit face tracking to get head rotation and drive the orientation of the AudioListener in Unity, so a sound stays fixed in one direction in the room. Twist: make a sound treasure hunt you can play with your eyes closed.

works.title: Augmented Reality Gestures
works.description: A prototype of multi-touch gestures for navigating 3D AR content on a touch screen, with 3D pan, pinch and zoom mapped to the scene.
works.idea_zh: 为手机AR设计的一套三维多点触控手势。

video.video_title: Augmented Reality Gestures - July 2020

works.technique: Multi-touch input is mapped to 3D transforms: one-finger drag pans along a plane, two-finger pinch scales, and twist rotates, with the mapping relative to the camera view.
works.exercise_zh: 在手机 AR 中为一个模型实现单指平移、双指缩放和旋转，并请同学测试哪种手势最难懂；变体：设计一个新的三指手势。
works.description_zh: 一个在触摸屏上浏览三维 AR 内容的多点触控手势原型，把三维平移、捏合与缩放映射到场景上。
works.idea_en: A set of 3D multi-touch gestures designed for phone AR.
works.technique_zh: 多点触控输入被映射为三维变换：单指拖动沿平面平移，双指捏合缩放，扭转则旋转，映射均相对于相机视角。
works.exercise_en: Implement one-finger panning and two-finger scaling and rotation for a model in phone AR, and ask classmates to test which gesture is hardest to understand. Twist: design a new three-finger gesture.

works.title: BBC Earth - Micro Kingdoms: Senses
works.description: A leafcutter ant colony and a wandering spider appear on your floor at giant scale; narrated by Stephen Fry, you switch into their senses to perceive vibrations and smells as they do.
works.description_zh: 巨大的切叶蚁群落和游走蛛出现在你家地板上；在 Stephen Fry 的旁白中，你切换到它们的感官，像它们一样感知震动和气味。
works.idea_en: Put tiny creatures in your room at your size, then let you borrow their senses.
works.idea_zh: 把微小的生物放大到与你同等尺寸放进房间，再让你借用它们的感官。
works.technique: Places high-detail animated creatures on the mapped room surfaces of Magic Leap 1 and switches rendering modes to visualise non-human senses.
works.technique_zh: 在 Magic Leap 1 扫描出的房间表面上放置高精度的动画生物，并切换渲染模式来可视化非人类的感官。
works.exercise_en: Make a phone AR scene where a scaled-up insect walks on the table, then add a 'sense mode' button that turns vibrations from a tapped table into visible ripples. Twist: design a mode for a bat's echolocation using the microphone.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个手机 AR 场景，让一只放大的昆虫在桌上行走，再加一个“感官模式”按钮，把敲桌子产生的震动显示成可见的涟漪；变体：用麦克风为蝙蝠的回声定位设计一种模式。

video.video_title: BBC Earth - Micro Kingdoms: Senses on Magic Leap

works.title: Bosch AR
works.description: An iOS app that lets you pick one of five strange creatures from Hieronymus Bosch's Garden of Earthly Delights and release it, animated, into the world around you.
works.description_zh: 一款 iOS 应用，让你从博斯《人间乐园》中挑选五个怪异生物之一，把它以动画形式放进身边的真实世界。
works.idea_en: Let 500-year-old painted monsters walk out of the canvas and into your street.
works.idea_zh: 让五百年前画中的怪物走出画布，走上你家门口的街道。
works.technique: Characters redesigned in 3D from the painting, rigged and animated, then placed with ARKit plane detection in a Unity app.
works.technique_zh: 根据原画用 3D 重新设计角色，完成绑定与动画，再在 Unity 应用中用 ARKit 平面检测放置到现实中。
works.exercise_en: Choose a painting in the public domain, model one small character from it, and animate it walking on a real table in AR. Twist: the character reacts when it reaches the table edge.
works.exercise_zh: 选一幅公有领域的画作，为其中一个小角色建模，让它在 AR 中走在真实的桌面上；变体：角色走到桌边时会作出反应。

video.video_title: Bosch AR // Studio ANRK

works.title: Copy and paste into AR
works.description: Images and art copied on the phone are pasted straight into the surrounding space as AR objects, with no editing step.
works.idea_zh: 复制一张图，直接'粘贴'到现实空间里。

video.video_title: you can now copy and paste directly into AR, coming in the next update! https://t.co/Ttz1u4rqVv

works.technique: Clipboard images are background-removed and spawned as textured quads at the AR raycast hit point.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个网页 AR（8th Wall/WebXR）：从相册选图后贴到墙上当'虚拟海报'；加一个变化：贴上的图会被其他同学看到并留言。
works.description_zh: 在手机上复制的图片和艺术作品会直接作为 AR 物体粘贴到周围空间中，无需任何编辑步骤。
works.idea_en: Copy an image and paste it straight into real space.
works.technique_zh: 剪贴板中的图片经去除背景后，作为带纹理的四边形面片生成在 AR 射线检测的命中点上。
works.exercise_en: Build web AR with 8th Wall or WebXR that lets you pick an image from the photo album and stick it on a wall as a virtual poster. Twist: posted images can be seen and commented on by other classmates.

works.title: Dynamicland (progress report)
works.description: A tour of the Oakland Dynamicland space: pages of code on paper, projected visualizations, tangible programming kits and collaborative projects.
works.idea_zh: 一座没有屏幕的计算机大楼：纸上的代码、桌上的投影、大家围在一起编程。

video.video_title: Dynamicland progress report, May 2020

works.technique: Every program is a printed page identified by dot codes, a room-wide camera-projector system (Realtalk) tracks pages and objects and runs their code, so programs communicate by statements about physical positions.
works.exercise_zh: 用投影仪 + 摄像头搭建一张“可编程桌子”：打印 5 张带标记的纸，每张对应一个函数（如“画圆”“变红”“向右移动”），把纸指向另一张纸时把效果作用在它上面；变体：设计一张能“读取”其他纸张内容的“元程序”纸。
works.description_zh: 带你参观奥克兰的 Dynamicland 空间：写在纸上的代码页、投影出的可视化、实体编程套件，以及各种协作项目。
works.idea_en: A computer the size of a building with no screens: code on paper, projections on tables, and people programming together around them.
works.technique_zh: 每个程序都是一张通过点阵码识别的打印纸页，覆盖整个房间的摄像头-投影仪系统（Realtalk）追踪纸页和物体并运行其中的代码，程序之间通过关于物理位置的陈述相互通信。
works.exercise_en: Build a programmable table with a projector and a camera: print 5 marker-tagged sheets, each standing for a function such as draw a circle, turn red or move right, and apply a sheet's effect to another sheet when you point it at that sheet. Twist: design a meta-program sheet that can read the contents of other sheets.

works.title: Earth Speakr
works.description: An AR app for children in which kids record their voice and facial expressions and 'lend' them to places and objects in the world — trees, rivers, buildings — to speak for the planet.
works.idea_zh: 孩子把自己的脸和声音借给树木、河流，让地球开口说话
works.technique: Face tracking captures the child's expressions and voice, which are mapped onto AR 'faces' placed on real objects detected through the phone camera.
works.exercise_zh: 用AR面部驱动（如Snap Lens或Reality Composer）把自己的表情贴到校园的一棵树上，录一句“树想说的话”；变化：全班的树组成一场对话。

video.video_title: Are you an Earth Speakr?

works.description_zh: 一款面向儿童的 AR 应用：孩子们录下自己的声音和面部表情，把它们“借给”世界上的地点和物体——树木、河流、建筑——让它们为地球发声。
works.idea_en: Children lend their faces and voices to trees and rivers so the Earth can speak.
works.technique_zh: 面部追踪捕捉孩子的表情和声音，并将其映射到手机摄像头检测到的真实物体上放置的 AR“脸”上。
works.exercise_en: Use AR face puppeteering, for example a Snap Lens or Reality Composer, to put your expressions on a tree on campus and record one line of what the tree wants to say. Twist: the whole class's trees form a conversation.

works.title: ElaMorph Projection
works.description: Projection alone makes a rigid 3D object appear to stretch and deform elastically as it moves, exploiting high-speed tracking and perception.
works.idea_zh: 只靠投影就让坚硬的物体看起来像橡皮一样弹性变形。

video.video_title: ElaMorph Projection: Deformation of 3D Shape by Dynamic Projection Mapping

works.technique: The rigid object's motion is tracked at high speed and projected shading and texture are warped according to a simulated elastic deformation driven by that motion, exploiting perception so the object looks as if it stretches.
works.exercise_zh: 追踪一个手持的白色纸盒，给投影在上面的图案加上随加速度拉伸和回弹的形变（可用弹簧模型），让观众觉得盒子是软的；变体：做一段“硬物变软”的短视频，并调查观众是否真的被骗。
works.description_zh: 仅凭投影，就让一个坚硬的三维物体在运动时看起来像被弹性拉伸和变形，利用的是高速追踪与人的感知机制。
works.idea_en: Projection alone makes a hard object look as stretchy as rubber.
works.technique_zh: 高速追踪刚性物体的运动，并根据由该运动驱动的弹性形变模拟来扭曲投影的明暗和纹理，借助感知错觉使物体看起来像在拉伸。
works.exercise_en: Track a hand-held white paper box and give the pattern projected onto it a stretch-and-rebound deformation driven by acceleration, for example with a spring model, so viewers feel the box is soft. Twist: make a short video of a hard object turning soft and survey whether viewers are actually fooled.

works.title: Face filter from a single photo
works.description: A face filter is generated from one photo of another person and mapped onto the user's live face so it follows expressions.
works.idea_zh: 只用一张照片，就能把别人的脸变成你的实时滤镜。

video.video_title: Face filter from a single photo

works.technique: Landmarks from a single photo are used to build a textured face mesh that is warped onto the live tracked face (likely a 2D morphable mapping).
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe FaceMesh 把一张名人或名画照片做成贴合自己脸的面具；加一个变化：面具只在你笑时出现。
works.description_zh: 根据另一个人的一张照片生成人脸滤镜，并映射到用户的实时面部上，跟随表情变化。
works.idea_en: From just one photo, turn someone else's face into your live filter.
works.technique_zh: 利用单张照片中的面部关键点构建带纹理的面部网格，并将其变形贴合到实时追踪的人脸上（大概率是一种二维可变形映射）。
works.exercise_en: Use MediaPipe FaceMesh to turn a photo of a celebrity or a famous painting into a mask that fits your own face. Twist: the mask appears only when you smile.

works.title: Fast Plane Detection and Classification with LiDAR
works.description: Visualises the LiDAR iPad Pro instantly classifying floor, walls, ceiling and furniture as coloured surfaces.
works.idea_zh: 可视化 LiDAR 瞬间识别出地板、墙、天花板和家具。

video.video_title: Fast plane detection and classification with ARKit3.5 + iPad pro

works.technique: ARKit scene reconstruction on LiDAR provides per-face semantic classification (floor, wall, ceiling, table, seat), which is visualized by coloring mesh faces by class.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation ARMeshManager 读取网格分类，给地板、墙、桌子不同颜色；变体：只在“座椅”类表面上放一只会坐下的角色。
works.description_zh: 可视化呈现 LiDAR 版 iPad Pro 如何瞬间把地板、墙面、天花板和家具分类为不同颜色的表面。
works.idea_en: Visualize LiDAR instantly recognizing floors, walls, ceilings and furniture.
works.technique_zh: 基于 LiDAR 的 ARKit 场景重建为每个网格面提供语义分类（地板、墙面、天花板、桌子、座椅），并按类别为网格面着色进行可视化。
works.exercise_en: Read mesh classifications with AR Foundation's ARMeshManager and give floors, walls and tables different colors. Twist: place a character that sits down only on seat-class surfaces.

works.title: Google Search EDU AR
works.description: Searching for a topic such as the muscular or skeletal system on a phone lets students place a life-size 3D anatomy model in their room; he helped launch the content and designed the auto-scale feature used by AR animals and dinosaurs in Search.
works.description_zh: 在手机上搜索“肌肉系统”“骨骼系统”等主题，学生就能把真实大小的 3D 解剖模型放进房间；他参与了这批内容的上线，并为搜索中的 AR 动物和恐龙设计了自动缩放功能。
works.idea_en: Every search result can become an object you can walk around in your own room.
works.idea_zh: 每一个搜索结果都可以变成一个能在自己房间里绕着看的物体。
works.technique: Search results open Scene Viewer, which places a glTF model on an ARCore plane and auto-scales it to fit the available space.
works.technique_zh: 搜索结果打开 Scene Viewer，把 glTF 模型放在 ARCore 平面上，并根据可用空间自动缩放。
works.exercise_en: Build a model-viewer web page that shows a school topic in AR at true scale. Twist: add a button that shrinks it to fit on the desk and label what changes.
works.exercise_zh: 用 model-viewer 做一个网页，以真实比例在 AR 中展示一个课程主题。变体：加一个按钮把它缩小到能放在桌上，并标注哪些内容发生了变化。

video.video_title: Just helped launch new EDU AR content on Google Search. I wish I could have this when I was learning drawings at high school, so I don’t need the plaster statue for anatomy anymore https://t.co/EpftWj

works.title: HERMITS
works.description: Small self-propelled robots dock into interchangeable mechanical shells - a lever, a crank, a vehicle - gaining new physical interactions like hermit crabs changing shells.
works.idea_zh: 像寄居蟹换壳一样，小机器人钻进不同外壳就获得新功能。

video.video_title: HERMITS: Mechanical Shells for Reconfigurable Robotic Tangible Interfaces

works.technique: Uses toio robots with position tracking to drive into passive 3D-printed shells whose gears and levers convert robot motion into new actuation or input.
works.exercise_zh: 给一个遥控小车设计三种纸板“外壳”（推土铲、旗帜、小屋），用手机AR标注每个外壳的功能；变化：让小车根据二维码自动识别换上的外壳。
works.description_zh: 小型自走机器人可以钻进可互换的机械外壳——杠杆、曲柄、载具——像寄居蟹换壳一样获得新的物理交互能力。
works.idea_en: Like hermit crabs changing shells, small robots gain new functions by crawling into different shells.
works.technique_zh: 使用带位置追踪的 toio 机器人驶入被动式 3D 打印外壳，外壳中的齿轮和杠杆把机器人的运动转换为新的驱动或输入方式。
works.exercise_en: Design three cardboard shells for an RC car (a bulldozer blade, a flag and a little house) and label each shell's function in phone AR. Twist: have the car automatically recognize which shell it is wearing from a QR code.

works.title: HandMorph
works.description: A passive exoskeleton puts a child-sized mechanical hand in front of the wearer's own; grasping real toys and tools through it makes everything feel bigger, with no headset involved.
works.description_zh: 一副被动外骨骼在佩戴者的手前面装了一只儿童尺寸的机械手；通过它去抓真实的玩具和工具，所有东西都显得更大，而且完全不需要头显。
works.idea_en: Change your body, not the picture: a mechanical small hand makes the real world feel oversized.
works.idea_zh: 改的不是画面而是身体：一只机械小手让真实世界显得巨大。
works.technique: Uses four-bar linkages to transmit each finger's motion and force to an anatomically scaled smaller hand, so haptic feedback stays congruent in the real environment.
works.technique_zh: 用四连杆机构把每根手指的动作和力量传到按比例缩小的仿生小手上，让触觉反馈在真实环境里保持一致。
works.exercise_en: Build a cardboard 'hand extender' with straws and string that mirrors finger bends onto a smaller cardboard hand, then try picking up objects of different sizes and rate how big they feel. Twist: make the hand larger instead and redesign a door handle for it.
works.exercise_zh: 用纸板、吸管和绳子做一个“手部延伸器”，把手指弯曲映射到一只更小的纸板手上，然后去拿不同大小的物体，给它们“感觉上的大小”打分；变体：把手做大，再为它重新设计一个门把手。

video.video_title: HandMorph: a Passive Exoskeleton that Miniaturizes Grasp (UIST 2020 Best Paper Award)

works.title: HoloBox with HoloLens 2
works.description: A physical box-shaped display and HoloLens 2 share synchronised objects that move seamlessly between the screen's 3D window and the air around it.
works.idea_zh: 虚拟物体在立体显示盒与 HoloLens 空间之间无缝穿梭。

video.video_title: HoloBox System That Works with HoloLens2

works.technique: The box display renders an off-axis perspective matched to the HoloLens user's head pose, and a shared coordinate frame lets objects hand over seamlessly between screen rendering and headset rendering.
works.exercise_zh: 用一台显示器做离轴透视窗口（用手机追踪头部位置），物体离开屏幕边缘时在 AR 手机中接着出现；变体：物体从屏幕“掉”到桌上会弹跳。
works.description_zh: 一个实体盒状显示器与 HoloLens 2 共享同步的物体，这些物体可以在屏幕的三维窗口与周围空气之间无缝穿梭。
works.idea_en: Virtual objects travel seamlessly between a 3D display box and the HoloLens space.
works.technique_zh: 盒状显示器按照 HoloLens 用户的头部位姿渲染匹配的离轴透视，共享坐标系则让物体在屏幕渲染与头显渲染之间无缝交接。
works.exercise_en: Use a monitor as an off-axis perspective window (tracking head position with a phone), and when an object leaves the edge of the screen, have it continue in an AR phone. Twist: objects that fall off the screen onto the desk bounce.

works.title: Instagram AR Filters (reel)
works.description: A reel of Anne Horel's face filters: pop, kitsch and surreal effects that stick pizza, glitter, emoji-like creatures and GIF-style loops onto the face and head.
works.description_zh: Anne Horel 的脸部滤镜合集：披萨、亮片、表情包般的小生物和 GIF 风格的循环动画被“粘”在脸和头上，波普、媚俗又超现实。
works.idea_en: Treat a face filter as a tiny wearable artwork in one consistent personal style.
works.idea_zh: 把脸部滤镜当成一件小小的可穿戴艺术品，并保持鲜明统一的个人风格。
works.technique: Spark AR face tracking attaches 2D sprite loops and 3D props to face landmarks, with segmentation and colour effects for the background.
works.technique_zh: 用 Spark AR 的人脸追踪把 2D 序列帧循环和 3D 道具绑定到面部关键点上，并用人像分割和调色处理背景。
works.exercise_en: Design three face filters that all share one invented visual style, using only hand-drawn 2D loops attached to face points. Twist: each filter must express a different mood without using text.
works.exercise_zh: 设计三个风格统一的脸部滤镜，只用手绘 2D 循环动画绑定在面部关键点上；变体：每个滤镜都要在不使用文字的情况下表达一种不同的情绪。

video.video_title: INSTAGRAM AR FILTERS🎭

works.title: KAWS: Expanded Holiday
works.description: KAWS's giant COMPANION figure released as AR sculptures placed simultaneously in cities worldwide and in users' homes, sold as limited AR editions.
works.idea_zh: 全球同时出现的巨型AR玩偶雕塑，也可买回家

video.video_title: Acute Art Presents EXPANDED HOLIDAY: KAWS LAUNCHES NEW ART FORM

works.technique: Geolocated AR placement plus user-side plane detection: the same large sculpture model is anchored at fixed city coordinates and can also be placed on any detected ground plane at home.
works.exercise_zh: 为你设计的一个角色做一个巨型 AR 雕塑，在校园的三个 GPS 地点同时出现（可用 AR.js location-based）；变体：让雕塑在不同地点做出不同姿态，暗示它在城市中移动。
works.description_zh: KAWS 的巨型 COMPANION 形象以 AR 雕塑的形式发布，同时出现在全球多座城市和用户家中，并作为限量 AR 版本出售。
works.idea_en: Giant AR toy sculptures appear worldwide at the same time, and you can buy one to take home.
works.technique_zh: 结合地理定位 AR 放置和用户端平面检测：同一个大型雕塑模型既锚定在城市中的固定坐标上，也可以放置在家中任何检测到的地面平面上。
works.exercise_en: Make a giant AR sculpture of a character you designed and have it appear at three GPS locations on campus at once, for example with location-based AR.js. Twist: give the sculpture a different pose at each location, hinting that it moves around the city.

works.title: Kinetic AR: robot motion programming in AR
works.description: Using a phone, you draw and edit a robot's motion path directly on the floor in AR and the physical robot follows it, making robot programming spatial and visual.
works.idea_zh: 直接在地上'画'出机器人的运动轨迹来编程。

video.video_title: Kinetic AR: Robotic Motion Planning and Programming using Augmented Reality Interfaces

works.technique: The AR interface tracks the robot and floor in a shared frame, and user-drawn spline paths are converted into motion commands sent to the robot.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机 AR 在地上放几个路径点，让扫地机器人/乐高小车按顺序经过；加一个变化：每个路径点可以设置'停下来跳舞'。
works.description_zh: 用手机直接在地面上以 AR 方式绘制和编辑机器人的运动路径，实体机器人会沿路径行进，让机器人编程变得空间化、可视化。
works.idea_en: Program a robot by drawing its path right on the floor.
works.technique_zh: AR 界面在共享坐标系中追踪机器人和地面，用户绘制的样条路径被转换为运动指令发送给机器人。
works.exercise_en: Place a few waypoints on the floor in phone AR and have a robot vacuum or LEGO car pass through them in order. Twist: each waypoint can be set to make the robot stop and dance.

works.title: Lenses for Emotional Oranges 'All That'
works.description: Colorful 3D lenses in Velvet Spectrum's signature style transform the performers and scenes of the Emotional Oranges music video.
works.idea_zh: 把工作室的招牌 3D 视觉语言做成音乐 MV 里的 AR 滤镜。

video.video_title: Letting the AR Move You with Velvet Spectrum

works.technique: Face and world lenses with stylized 3D assets are layered over the performers and shot directly through the camera for the video.
works.exercise_zh: 为一首歌做一个 AR 滤镜 MV：用同一套配色和材质做 3 个不同镜头的滤镜；加一个变化：滤镜随副歌自动切换。
works.description_zh: 带有 Velvet Spectrum 标志性风格的多彩三维滤镜，改造了 Emotional Oranges 音乐录影带中的表演者和场景。
works.idea_en: Turn the studio's signature 3D visual language into AR filters for a music video.
works.technique_zh: 带有风格化三维素材的面部滤镜和世界滤镜叠加在表演者身上，并直接通过摄像头拍摄成视频。
works.exercise_en: Make an AR filter music video for a song, with three filters for different shots that share one palette and set of materials. Twist: the filters switch automatically on the chorus.

works.title: LiDAR Point Cloud Streaming with Cartoon Effect
works.description: The iPad's live point cloud of a room and person is re-rendered on the receiving side as a hand-drawn cartoon.
works.idea_zh: 把实时点云渲染成卡通风格的远程空间。

video.video_title: Streaming Point Cloud of iPad's LiDAR & Visualization with a Cartoon Like Effect

works.technique: The received point cloud is rendered with a non-photorealistic shader (edge detection from depth discontinuities plus flat color quantization) to look hand-drawn.
works.exercise_zh: 对一段点云或深度视频加色阶量化和描边着色器，做出卡通风格；变体：让风格随说话人的情绪（音量高低）切换。
works.description_zh: iPad 实时采集的房间和人物点云，在接收端被重新渲染成手绘风格的卡通画面。
works.idea_en: Render a live point cloud as a cartoon-style remote space.
works.technique_zh: 接收到的点云使用非真实感着色器渲染（根据深度不连续处做边缘检测，再进行平涂色彩量化），呈现手绘效果。
works.exercise_en: Apply color quantization and an outline shader to a point cloud or depth video to create a cartoon style. Twist: switch styles with the speaker's mood, judged by how loud they are.

works.title: Liberty Bell
works.description: A giant AR Liberty Bell rings over historic US sites (Philadelphia, Selma, Washington) as a call to civic action.
works.idea_zh: 在美国历史地点上空敲响AR自由钟

video.video_title: View Historic Landmarks With This Augmented Reality Art App | Future Blink

works.technique: Geolocated AR places a large animated bell model with spatial audio at historic sites, so the sound source is positioned in the sky above the viewer.
works.exercise_zh: 为一个与公共议题相关的地点设计一个悬在空中的 AR 声音物体，用 Unity 空间音频让声音随距离变化；变体：物体只有在多人同时对准时才会响起。
works.description_zh: 一口巨大的 AR 自由钟在美国多个历史地点（费城、塞尔玛、华盛顿）上空敲响，呼吁公民行动。
works.idea_en: Ring an AR Liberty Bell in the sky over historic American sites.
works.technique_zh: 地理定位 AR 在历史地点放置带空间音频的大型钟体动画模型，使声源位于观众头顶的天空中。
works.exercise_en: Design an AR sound object hanging in the air for a place tied to a public issue, and use Unity spatial audio so the sound changes with distance. Twist: the object only rings when several people aim at it together.

works.title: Lines of Play
works.description: Build domino chains on real floors and furniture; with the ARCore Depth API the dominoes hide behind real obstacles, collide with real objects and topple with spatial audio.
works.idea_zh: 在真实地面摆AR多米诺骨牌，它们会被真实物体遮挡并撞到真实物体。

video.video_title: Lines of Play: An Experiment Using Depth API

works.technique: The ARCore Depth API supplies a depth map used for both occlusion and physics collision, so dominoes hide behind and bump into real objects.
works.exercise_zh: 开启环境深度，在桌面上摆一排 AR 多米诺骨牌，让它们撞到真实的书本后停下；变体：骨牌倒下时每块发出一个音阶，组成一段旋律。
works.description_zh: 在真实的地板和家具上搭建多米诺骨牌链；借助 ARCore Depth API，骨牌会隐藏在真实障碍物后面、与真实物体碰撞，并伴随空间音效依次倒下。
works.idea_en: Set up AR dominoes on a real floor, where real objects hide them and get in their way.
works.technique_zh: ARCore Depth API 提供的深度图同时用于遮挡和物理碰撞，使骨牌能藏在真实物体后面并撞上它们。
works.exercise_en: Turn on environment depth, line up AR dominoes on a tabletop and make them stop when they hit a real book. Twist: each domino plays a note of a scale as it falls, forming a melody.

works.title: Local Lenses
works.description: Persistent, shared AR that covers entire city blocks: multiple Snapchatters can paint and decorate real building facades together, and the changes stay in place for others.
works.idea_zh: 多人一起给整条街道的真实建筑涂装，AR内容会持久留在原地。

video.video_title: Introducing Local Lenses | Snap Partner Summit 2020

works.technique: A city-scale 3D map localizes users, and shared persistent state stores each paint stroke on building surfaces so later visitors see the accumulated changes.
works.exercise_zh: 用持久化锚点和一个简单后端（如 Firebase）做一面多人共享的 AR 涂鸦墙，涂鸦下次打开还在；变体：涂鸦会像真实油漆一样慢慢褪色。
works.description_zh: 覆盖整片城市街区的持久共享 AR：多位 Snapchat 用户可以一起给真实建筑立面上色和装饰，这些改动会保留在原处，供其他人看到。
works.idea_en: People paint real buildings along a whole street together, and the AR content stays where it was put.
works.technique_zh: 城市尺度的三维地图为用户定位，共享的持久化状态记录建筑表面上的每一笔涂装，后来的访客就能看到不断累积的改动。
works.exercise_en: Use persistent anchors and a simple backend such as Firebase to build a shared AR graffiti wall whose graffiti is still there the next time you open it. Twist: the graffiti slowly fades like real paint.

works.title: MEISAI – AR Filter App
works.description: An iOS AR effect app offering camouflage-like generative filters that reshape people and space in real time.
works.idea_zh: 像“迷彩”一样实时改写人和空间的生成式 AR 滤镜 App。

video.video_title: MEISAI - AR Filter App /  Kitasenju Design

works.technique: Person segmentation and depth masks drive full-screen shaders that re-texture people and space with generative camouflage patterns in real time.
works.exercise_zh: 用人体分割把人物区域替换成周围背景的采样纹理，做一个“迷彩隐身”滤镜；变体：只在人静止不动时隐身，一动就显形。
works.description_zh: 一款 iOS AR 特效应用，提供类似迷彩的生成式滤镜，实时重塑人与空间。
works.idea_en: A generative AR filter app that rewrites people and space in real time, like camouflage.
works.technique_zh: 人体分割和深度遮罩驱动全屏着色器，用生成式迷彩图案实时为人和空间重新贴图。
works.exercise_en: Use person segmentation to replace the person's area with texture sampled from the surrounding background, making a camouflage invisibility filter. Twist: you stay invisible only while standing still and reappear as soon as you move.

works.title: MRAT: Mixed Reality Analytics Toolkit
works.description: A toolkit that logs and visualises how users move, look and interact in mixed reality apps, replaying their paths and gaze as 3D traces in the room.
works.idea_zh: 把用户在MR里走过的路和看过的地方画成空间轨迹。

video.video_title: MRAT: The Mixed Reality Analytics Toolkit

works.technique: Instruments Unity MR apps to record head pose, gaze and input events and renders them as in-situ 3D heatmaps and trails.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机AR记录同学在教室里一次寻宝过程中手机的位置，事后在AR中回放为彩色轨迹线；变化：用颜色表示停留时间，讨论设计问题。
works.description_zh: 一个工具包，记录并可视化用户在混合现实应用中如何移动、观看和交互，以三维轨迹的形式在房间中回放他们的路径和视线。
works.idea_en: Draw where users walked and looked in MR as traces in space.
works.technique_zh: 对 Unity MR 应用进行埋点，记录头部位姿、视线和输入事件，并将其渲染为原位的三维热力图和轨迹。
works.exercise_en: Use phone AR to record where a classmate's phone moves during a treasure hunt in the classroom, then replay it in AR as colored trails. Twist: use color to show dwell time and discuss the design problems it reveals.

works.title: Mario Kart Live: Home Circuit
works.description: A real RC kart with a camera drives around cardboard gates in your home; on the Switch, the camera feed becomes a Mario Kart track with items, rivals and weather overlaid on your rooms.
works.idea_zh: 一辆带摄像头的实体遥控卡丁车，把你家变成马力欧赛道。

video.video_title: Mario Kart Live: Home Circuit - Announcement Trailer - Nintendo Switch

works.technique: Fiducial markers on cardboard gates localize the RC car's onboard camera, so the track, items and rivals are rendered from the kart's viewpoint over its live video.
works.exercise_zh: 把手机固定在玩具车上，在地上放几张图像标记当“关卡门”，经过时在 AR 中显示加速道具；变体：把门的顺序设计成一条只有 AR 里才看得见的赛道。
works.description_zh: 一辆装有摄像头的真实遥控卡丁车绕着你家里的纸板关卡门行驶；在 Switch 上，摄像头画面变成一条马力欧赛车赛道，道具、对手和天气都叠加在你的房间里。
works.idea_en: A real RC kart with a camera turns your home into a Mario Kart track.
works.technique_zh: 纸板关卡门上的基准标记为遥控车的车载摄像头提供定位，赛道、道具和对手便以卡丁车的视角渲染在其实时视频之上。
works.exercise_en: Mount a phone on a toy car, lay a few image markers on the floor as gates, and show speed-boost items in AR when the car passes them. Twist: arrange the gates into a track that is visible only in AR.

works.title: Mario Kart Live: Home Circuit — developer interview
works.description: Velan Studios explains how they built the kart, the gate-based track system and the latency-sensitive AR rendering that makes a living room feel like a race course.
works.idea_zh: 开发者讲述如何让真实车辆与虚拟赛道无缝融合。

video.video_title: Mario Kart Live: Home Circuit- Developer Interview

works.technique: The gates both define the track path and correct camera pose drift, and rendering is tuned to minimize latency between the car's video and its overlays.
works.exercise_zh: 测量自己 AR 原型中从相机画面到叠加内容的延迟（如用高速录像），并尝试一种降低延迟的方法；变体：故意加大延迟，观察用户开始不舒服的临界点。
works.description_zh: Velan Studios 讲解他们如何打造这辆卡丁车、基于关卡门的赛道系统，以及对延迟高度敏感的 AR 渲染，让客厅真正有了赛道的感觉。
works.idea_en: The developers explain how they fused a real car with a virtual track.
works.technique_zh: 关卡门既用来定义赛道路径，也用来校正相机位姿漂移；渲染经过专门调校，尽量缩短车辆视频与叠加内容之间的延迟。
works.exercise_en: Measure the latency from camera frame to overlay in your own AR prototype, for example with high-speed video, and try one way to reduce it. Twist: deliberately increase the latency and find the threshold where users start to feel uncomfortable.

works.title: Mergereality: multi-device gestural interaction in AR
works.description: His CMU thesis and CHI 2020 paper: a set of passthrough-AR prototypes where bare hands move content between tablets, monitors, smart lights and the room, each borrowing a physical affordance such as a drawer, a book page or a dropper.
works.description_zh: 他在 CMU 的毕业设计与 CHI 2020 论文：一组透视式 AR 原型，用徒手在平板、显示器、智能灯和房间之间搬运内容，每个交互都借用一种现实中的可供性，比如抽屉、书页或滴管。
works.idea_en: Screens and devices become physical containers that your hands can reach into and pull content out of.
works.idea_zh: 把屏幕和设备当成可以伸手进去、把内容拉出来的实体容器。
works.technique: A VR headset with a ZED Mini stereo camera provides video passthrough, Leap Motion tracks the hands, and each screen's pose is registered in Unity so that pinches near its edge hand content over between 2D and 3D.
works.technique_zh: 在 VR 头显上加装 ZED Mini 双目相机实现视频透视，Leap Motion 追踪双手，并在 Unity 中标定每块屏幕的位置，使手在屏幕边缘捏取时内容能在 2D 与 3D 之间交接。
works.exercise_en: Pick one everyday metaphor (drawer, pocket, envelope) and prototype a phone-AR gesture that moves a photo from a laptop screen into the room using an image marker on the screen. Twist: make the reverse gesture put it back.
works.exercise_zh: 选一个日常隐喻（抽屉、口袋、信封），用手机 AR 和贴在笔记本屏幕上的图像标记，做一个把照片从屏幕“拿”到房间里的手势原型。变体：再设计一个反向手势把它放回去。

video.video_title: Affordances for Multi-device Gestural Interaction in Augmented Reality

works.title: Metal Particles v2
works.description: Metal-driven particle systems that flow over the LiDAR-scanned geometry of a real room.
works.idea_zh: 让 Metal 粒子沿着 LiDAR 扫描出的房间表面流动。

video.video_title: Metal Particles v2

works.technique: GPU particles sample positions and normals from the LiDAR scene mesh (or depth map) so they flow and collide along the real room surfaces.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Unity VFX Graph 从 AR 网格表面发射粒子，让粒子沿重力流过家具；变体：让粒子流动方向跟随手机移动方向。
works.description_zh: 由 Metal 驱动的粒子系统，沿着 LiDAR 扫描出的真实房间几何表面流动。
works.idea_en: Let Metal particles flow along the room surfaces scanned by LiDAR.
works.technique_zh: GPU 粒子从 LiDAR 场景网格（或深度图）中采样位置和法线，从而沿真实房间表面流动并与之碰撞。
works.exercise_en: Emit particles from the AR mesh surface with Unity VFX Graph and let them flow over the furniture under gravity. Twist: make the particles flow in the direction the phone is moving.

works.title: MiXR: Hybrid AR Sheet Music
works.description: A performer sees virtual sheet music floating on the music stand through an AR headset, turns pages and annotates bars from a phone and tablet without taking hands off the instrument for long.
works.description_zh: 演奏者通过 AR 头显看到悬浮在谱架上的虚拟乐谱，可以用手机和平板翻页、在小节上做批注，而不必长时间离开乐器。
works.idea_en: Sheet music that floats where you need it and can be marked up by anyone in the ensemble.
works.idea_zh: 乐谱漂浮在需要的地方，乐团里的任何人都能在上面做标记。
works.technique: Combines an AR headset, a smartphone and a tablet in one networked system to place, page and annotate virtual scores in the physical environment.
works.technique_zh: 把 AR 头显、智能手机和平板组成一个联网系统，在实体环境中放置、翻页和批注虚拟乐谱。
works.exercise_en: Place a song's lyrics or chords as an AR panel beside a real instrument and let a second phone act as a page-turn pedal. Twist: let the 'conductor' phone highlight the bar everyone should be on.
works.exercise_zh: 把一首歌的歌词或和弦做成 AR 面板放在真实乐器旁，再用第二部手机当翻页踏板；变体：让“指挥”的手机高亮大家当前应该演奏的小节。

video.video_title: MiXR: A Hybrid AR Sheet Music Interface for Live Performance - Demo Video

works.title: Microsoft Mixed Reality Capture holograms in WebAR
works.description: Volumetric video of real performers captured in Microsoft's Mixed Reality Capture Studios plays as life-size holograms in the phone browser through 8th Wall.
works.idea_zh: 真人全息视频直接在手机浏览器里以真人大小出现在你面前。

video.video_title: Microsoft's Mixed Reality Capture Studios Integrated with 8th Wall WebAR

works.technique: Volumetric video (a sequence of textured meshes) is streamed and played in sync with audio, and anchored at life size on a detected ground plane in the browser.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机抠像（背景分离）录一段同学的视频，作为面向镜头的平面“全息人”放在 AR 地面上；变体：让这个全息人在你走近时转头看你。
works.description_zh: 在微软混合现实捕捉工作室（Mixed Reality Capture Studios）中拍摄的真人表演者体积视频，通过 8th Wall 在手机浏览器中以真人大小的全息影像播放。
works.idea_en: Life-size holographic video of real people appears right in front of you in the phone browser.
works.technique_zh: 体积视频（一系列带纹理的网格）以流式方式传输并与音频同步播放，在浏览器中以真人比例锚定在检测到的地面平面上。
works.exercise_en: Record a video of a classmate with phone background removal and place it on the AR floor as a camera-facing flat hologram person. Twist: make the hologram turn its head to look at you as you approach.

works.title: Minecraft Filter
works.description: A LiDAR filter that renders the surrounding room as blocky Minecraft-style geometry.
works.idea_zh: 把身边的真实房间渲染成《我的世界》方块风格。

video.video_title: Minecraft Filter

works.technique: Scene depth or mesh is voxelized and each voxel is textured by sampling the camera color at its projected position, giving a blocky Minecraft-like rendering.
works.exercise_zh: 把房间网格体素化，每个方块用摄像头画面对应颜色上色，做出方块风格的房间；变体：只让手机前方一个球形范围内变成方块。
works.description_zh: 一个 LiDAR 滤镜，把周围的房间渲染成《我的世界》风格的方块几何体。
works.idea_en: Render the real room around you in Minecraft-style blocks.
works.technique_zh: 对场景深度或网格进行体素化，每个体素按其投影位置从摄像头画面中采样颜色作为贴图，呈现出类似《我的世界》的方块效果。
works.exercise_en: Voxelize the room mesh and color each block with the matching color from the camera image to make a block-style room. Twist: only a spherical zone in front of the phone turns into blocks.

works.title: Mixed Reality Light Fields for Remote Assistance
works.description: A local worker captures a light field of a workspace with a phone; the remote expert explores it with free viewpoints and places annotations that appear in the worker's AR view.
works.idea_zh: 用手机拍下光场，远程专家自由看角度并把标注放回现场AR。

video.video_title: CHI2020: Mixed Reality Light Fields for Interactive Remote Assistance

works.technique: Captures many registered images to render novel views of the scene for the remote helper, then anchors their 3D annotations back in the local tracking space.
works.exercise_zh: 让学生甲用手机从多个角度拍一个桌面故障（如接线），学生乙在照片上标注步骤，甲再用AR标签还原到现场；变化：限定乙只能看3张照片。
works.description_zh: 现场工作人员用手机拍摄工作区域的光场；远程专家可以自由切换视角进行查看，并放置标注，这些标注会出现在工作人员的 AR 视图中。
works.idea_en: Capture a light field with a phone so a remote expert can view it from any angle and place notes back into the on-site AR.
works.technique_zh: 采集大量经过配准的图像，为远程协助者渲染场景的新视角，再把他们的三维标注锚定回现场的追踪空间中。
works.exercise_en: Have student A photograph a desktop fault, such as wiring, from several angles with a phone, have student B annotate the steps on the photos, and have A restore them on site as AR labels. Twist: limit B to looking at only 3 photos.

works.title: Olafur Eliasson: WUNDERKAMMER
works.description: A collection of AR objects by Olafur Eliasson (a sun, rain cloud, rainbow, puffin, compass) placed in the viewer's home during lockdown; the AR sun even charges a virtual Little Sun lamp.
works.idea_zh: 疫情期间把太阳、云、彩虹等自然现象用AR带进家里

video.video_title: Olafur Eliasson x Acute Art | WUNDERKAMMER

works.technique: Plane detection in the Acute Art app (ARKit/ARCore) places animated models of natural phenomena at real scale in the home, with simple interaction logic such as sun exposure charging a virtual lamp.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 做一个“家中自然现象”：在客厅放一朵会下雨的云或一个小太阳，并让它与另一个虚拟物体产生因果关系；变体：让现象只在现实天气相反时出现（外面下雨时室内出太阳）。
works.description_zh: Olafur Eliasson 创作的一组 AR 物件（太阳、雨云、彩虹、海鹦、指南针），在封城期间被放进观众家中；AR 太阳甚至能为一盏虚拟的 Little Sun 灯充电。
works.idea_en: During the pandemic, AR brought the sun, clouds, rainbows and other natural phenomena into people's homes.
works.technique_zh: Acute Art 应用中的平面检测（ARKit/ARCore）将自然现象的动画模型以真实尺度放置在家中，并配有简单的交互逻辑，例如晒太阳可以给虚拟灯充电。
works.exercise_en: Build a natural phenomenon at home with AR Foundation: put a raining cloud or a small sun in the living room and give it a cause-and-effect link with another virtual object. Twist: the phenomenon appears only when the real weather is the opposite, such as sunshine indoors while it rains outside.

works.title: Painted Mirror
works.description: A mirror installation for Springville Public Library that separates you from your surroundings with a depth camera and paints your portrait into an illustrated world, sharpening as you stand still.
works.idea_zh: 会画画的镜子：站得越久，你的肖像在插画世界里被描得越清楚。

video.video_title: Painted Mirror Timelapse

works.technique: A depth camera segments the person from the background, and a stroke-based painterly renderer draws the portrait with brush size shrinking the longer the person stands still.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe 分割加 p5.js 画笔粒子，把人画成油画风格，静止越久笔触越细越清楚，一动就变模糊；变体：背景换成你们学校的某个场景，做一面“毕业照镜子”。
works.description_zh: 为斯普林维尔公共图书馆（Springville Public Library）创作的一面镜子装置：它用深度相机把你从周围环境中分离出来，将你的肖像画进一个插画世界，你站得越久，画像就越清晰。
works.idea_en: A mirror that paints: the longer you stand still, the clearer your portrait becomes in an illustrated world.
works.technique_zh: 深度相机把人从背景中分割出来，基于笔触的绘画风格渲染器描绘肖像，人静止的时间越长，笔刷就越细。
works.exercise_en: Use MediaPipe segmentation and p5.js brush particles to paint a person in an oil-painting style, where strokes get finer and clearer the longer they stay still and blur as soon as they move. Twist: replace the background with a scene from your school to make a graduation-photo mirror.

works.title: Physics Simulation with ARKit 3.5
works.description: Virtual objects bounce and pile up on the LiDAR-scanned furniture and floor.
works.idea_zh: 虚拟物体在 LiDAR 扫描的家具上真实碰撞堆叠。

video.video_title: Physics simulation with ARKit3.5

works.technique: The LiDAR scene mesh is used as a MeshCollider, so rigidbodies spawned in Unity bounce off and pile up on real furniture.
works.exercise_zh: 给 AR 网格加 MeshCollider，点击屏幕从相机位置抛出小球，让它们落在真实沙发上；变体：只有打到某件家具才得分。
works.description_zh: 虚拟物体在 LiDAR 扫描出的家具和地面上弹跳、堆叠。
works.idea_en: Virtual objects collide and pile up realistically on LiDAR-scanned furniture.
works.technique_zh: 把 LiDAR 场景网格用作 MeshCollider，使 Unity 中生成的刚体能在真实家具上弹开并堆叠起来。
works.exercise_en: Add a MeshCollider to the AR mesh and tap the screen to throw balls from the camera position so they land on the real sofa. Twist: you score only when you hit a particular piece of furniture.

works.title: Pokémon GO Buddy Adventure
works.description: Buddy Pokémon follow the player and can be viewed in AR, where players feed them, play with them and take snapshots; the bond grows as you walk together.
works.idea_zh: 把宝可梦变成陪你散步的AR伙伴，可以喂食、互动、合影。

video.video_title: Pokemon GO - Official Buddy Adventures Feature Trailer

works.technique: An animated companion is placed on a detected plane, and touch interactions such as feeding and petting change a persistent affinity value that also grows with step count.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个 AR 小宠物，点击喂食、滑动抚摸会增加亲密度，亲密度达到阈值后解锁新动作；变体：亲密度也随你一天走的步数增长。
works.description_zh: 伙伴宝可梦会跟随玩家，并可在 AR 中查看；玩家可以喂食、陪它玩耍、给它拍照，一起走得越多，羁绊就越深。
works.idea_en: Turn a Pokémon into an AR companion that walks with you and that you can feed, play with and photograph.
works.technique_zh: 一个动画伙伴被放置在检测到的平面上，喂食、抚摸等触摸交互会改变一个持久保存的亲密度数值，该数值也会随步数增长。
works.exercise_en: Make a small AR pet whose affinity rises when you tap to feed it and swipe to pet it, unlocking a new move once affinity passes a threshold. Twist: affinity also grows with the number of steps you walk each day.

works.title: Pokémon GO Shared AR Experience
works.description: Nearby trainers join one shared AR session in which their buddy Pokémon appear together in the same real-world scene, so friends can play and take photos together.
works.idea_zh: 附近的玩家进入同一个AR场景，看到彼此的伙伴宝可梦一起玩耍。

video.video_title: Shared AR Experience Tutorial

works.technique: Nearby phones localize to a common anchor (via Lightship shared AR) so each player's companion is spawned at a shared pose and seen consistently by everyone.
works.exercise_zh: 两台手机通过共同图像标记对齐，各自放出一只宠物，让它们在对方屏幕里也出现并互相打招呼；变体：两只宠物靠近时一起做一个合体动作。
works.description_zh: 附近的训练家加入同一个共享 AR 会话，各自的伙伴宝可梦一同出现在同一个真实场景中，朋友们可以一起玩耍、合影。
works.idea_en: Nearby players enter the same AR scene and watch their buddy Pokémon play together.
works.technique_zh: 附近的手机定位到同一个共同锚点（通过 Lightship 共享 AR），使每位玩家的伙伴都在共享位姿处生成，所有人看到的效果一致。
works.exercise_en: Align two phones with a shared image marker, have each release a pet, and make each pet appear on the other screen too and greet the other pet. Twist: when the two pets come close, they perform a combined move together.

works.title: Potato Boss lens
works.description: A Snapchat/Snap Camera lens replaces you with a talking potato whose mouth and eyes are cut from your own face; it went viral when a manager got stuck with it in a video meeting.
works.idea_zh: 把你的脸变成会说话的土豆。

video.video_title: Why My Lens Blew with Phil Walton

works.technique: Face tracking crops the user's eyes and mouth textures and composites them onto a 3D potato model that follows head pose.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Lens Studio 把眼睛和嘴贴到一个水果/文具上做成'会说话的物品'；加一个变化：讲到关键词时物品会变色。
works.description_zh: 一个 Snapchat/Snap Camera 滤镜，把你替换成一颗会说话的土豆，土豆的嘴和眼睛取自你自己的脸；有位经理在视频会议中被这个滤镜卡住，让它一夜爆红。
works.idea_en: Turn your face into a talking potato.
works.technique_zh: 面部追踪裁剪出用户眼睛和嘴巴的纹理，并将其合成到一个跟随头部姿态的三维土豆模型上。
works.exercise_en: Use Lens Studio to paste your eyes and mouth onto a fruit or a piece of stationery to make a talking object. Twist: the object changes color when you say a keyword.

works.title: Pronto
works.description: Germán Leiva, Cuong Nguyen, Rubaiat Habib Kazi and Paul Asente let designers prototype AR by sketching on video and acting out interactions, with sketches anchored in 3D.
works.idea_zh: 在视频里随手画、自己演，几分钟就做出AR交互原型。

video.video_title: Pronto: Rapid Augmented Reality Video Prototyping Using Sketches and Enaction

works.technique: ARKit records a video with camera poses, and sketches drawn on video frames are lifted into 3D using the tracked camera and detected planes so they stay anchored as the recorded scene is replayed.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Reality Composer 或 Adobe Aero 录一段 AR 视频，在其中用手绘草图和“演一遍”的方式快速做出一个 AR 应用的交互原型，在 30 分钟内完成两轮迭代；变体：原型必须只用手绘线条，不允许任何 3D 模型。
works.description_zh: Germán Leiva、Cuong Nguyen、Rubaiat Habib Kazi 和 Paul Asente 让设计师通过在视频上画草图、亲自表演交互来制作 AR 原型，草图会锚定在三维空间中。
works.idea_en: Sketch on video and act it out yourself to build an AR interaction prototype in minutes.
works.technique_zh: ARKit 录制带相机位姿的视频，在视频帧上画出的草图借助追踪到的相机和检测到的平面被提升到三维空间，使其在回放录制场景时保持锚定。
works.exercise_en: Record an AR video with Reality Composer or Adobe Aero and quickly prototype an AR app's interaction in it with hand-drawn sketches and acting it out, completing two rounds of iteration in 30 minutes. Twist: the prototype may use only hand-drawn lines and no 3D models at all.

works.title: Rcam2: Volumetric AR camera rig
works.description: An iPad Pro LiDAR rig streams color, depth and camera pose to a PC, where Unity wraps the real scene in glowing particle and line effects that stay locked to the room.
works.idea_zh: 把 iPad 的 LiDAR 当成可移动的体积摄像机，让特效贴着真实房间长出来。

video.video_title: Rcam2: Volumetric AR camera rig with Unity

works.technique: ARKit on an iPad Pro captures LiDAR depth, color and camera pose, streams them over NDI to a PC, and Unity reprojects the depth into world space to spawn VFX Graph effects.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Reality Composer 或 Unity AR Foundation 的 mesh 扫描，让粒子沿着真实墙面和家具流动；加一个变化：只在你指过的物体表面发光。
works.description_zh: 一套基于 iPad Pro LiDAR 的拍摄装置，把彩色画面、深度和相机位姿实时传到 PC，由 Unity 在真实场景外包裹上发光的粒子和线条特效，并始终锁定在房间中。
works.idea_en: Use an iPad's LiDAR as a mobile volumetric camera so effects grow right on the real room.
works.technique_zh: iPad Pro 上的 ARKit 采集 LiDAR 深度、彩色画面和相机位姿，通过 NDI 传输到 PC，Unity 再把深度重投影到世界空间，生成 VFX Graph 特效。
works.exercise_en: Use mesh scanning in Reality Composer or Unity AR Foundation to make particles flow along real walls and furniture. Twist: only the surfaces of objects you have pointed at light up.

works.title: Real-Time LiDAR Point Cloud Streaming from iPad Pro
works.description: Streams the iPad Pro's live LiDAR point cloud to a remote PC and other XR devices, later with a cartoon-style rendering.
works.idea_zh: 把 iPad LiDAR 实时点云直播给远端设备。

video.video_title: Real-Time Point Cloud Streaming Application Working with LiDAR Sensor of iPad Pro

works.technique: Depth-map pixels are unprojected to world-space points using camera intrinsics and pose each frame, then compressed and streamed over the network for remote rendering.
works.exercise_zh: 从 iPhone 深度图中每 N 个像素取一个点反投影成点云，通过 WebSocket 发送到电脑上的 three.js 页面显示；变体：接收端把点渲染成不同风格（如方块或文字）。
works.description_zh: 把 iPad Pro 实时的 LiDAR 点云传输到远程 PC 和其他 XR 设备上，后来还加入了卡通风格的渲染。
works.idea_en: Stream an iPad's live LiDAR point cloud to remote devices.
works.technique_zh: 每一帧利用相机内参和位姿，把深度图像素反投影为世界空间中的点，然后压缩并通过网络传输，在远端渲染。
works.exercise_en: Take one point every N pixels from an iPhone depth map, unproject them into a point cloud, and send it over WebSocket to a three.js page on a computer for display. Twist: render the points on the receiving side in a different style, such as blocks or text.

works.title: RealitySketch
works.description: Sketch lines, angles and graphs on a phone's AR view of a moving object (a pendulum, a rolling ball) and the drawings bind to it, updating live to visualize physics.
works.idea_zh: 随手画的线和角度会'粘'在真实运动的物体上，实时变成物理可视化。

video.video_title: [UIST 2020] RealitySketch: Embedding Responsive Graphics and Visualizations in AR

works.technique: ARKit tracks the device and a detected plane, the moving object is tracked in the camera image by color, and sketched elements are bound to the object's projected 3D position so lines, angles and plots update each frame.
works.exercise_zh: 在手机 AR 中用颜色追踪标记一个摆动的吊坠或滚动的球，用户画一条线连接到它，线段长度和角度随运动实时更新并在旁边绘出曲线图；变体：用这个工具去测量你身边一个你好奇的周期运动。
works.description_zh: 在手机 AR 画面中，针对运动的物体（摆锤、滚动的球）画出线条、角度和图表，这些图形会与物体绑定并实时更新，把物理过程可视化。
works.idea_en: Lines and angles you sketch stick to real moving objects and become live physics visualizations.
works.technique_zh: ARKit 追踪设备和检测到的平面，运动物体通过颜色在摄像头画面中被追踪，绘制的元素绑定到物体投影后的三维位置上，使线条、角度和曲线图逐帧更新。
works.exercise_en: In phone AR, use color tracking to mark a swinging pendant or a rolling ball, let the user draw a line connected to it, and update the line's length and angle live while plotting a graph beside it. Twist: use the tool to measure some periodic motion around you that you are curious about.

works.title: Realtime Boxelization with ARKit4 and LiDAR
works.description: The whole room, including people, is converted in real time into a field of voxel boxes.
works.idea_zh: 把整个房间连同人实时体素化成方块。

video.video_title: Realtime Boxelization with ARKit4 and LiDAR

works.technique: The depth map is unprojected to world points each frame and quantized into a voxel grid, which is rendered as GPU-instanced cubes.
works.exercise_zh: 把 iPhone 深度图反投影成点并按 5cm 网格取整，用 GPU 实例化渲染成方块；变体：方块大小随音乐音量变化。
works.description_zh: 整个房间，连同其中的人，都被实时转换成一片体素方块。
works.idea_en: Voxelize the whole room, people included, into blocks in real time.
works.technique_zh: 每一帧将深度图反投影为世界空间中的点，并量化到体素网格中，再以 GPU 实例化的立方体进行渲染。
works.exercise_en: Unproject an iPhone depth map into points, snap them to a 5 cm grid, and render them as blocks with GPU instancing. Twist: make the block size change with the music volume.

works.title: Remnant
works.description: Visitors hold out their hands to gather matter into a star, pushing it through its lifecycle until it explodes into supernovae that leave nebulae, pulsars and black holes.
works.idea_zh: 伸手聚集物质造一颗星，直到它爆炸成超新星、留下黑洞。

video.video_title: Remnant

works.technique: Hand tracking (likely depth camera) detects open-hand gathering gestures, attracting particles to a point whose mass accumulates and triggers staged particle effects for each stellar lifecycle phase.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe Hands 做“聚拢”手势，把投影里的粒子吸成一颗星，吸满后爆炸成星云；变体：星的颜色和寿命由参与人数决定，一个人只能做出一颗小红矮星。
works.description_zh: 参观者伸出双手，把物质聚拢成一颗恒星，推动它走完整个生命周期，直到它爆发为超新星，留下星云、脉冲星和黑洞。
works.idea_en: Reach out to gather matter into a star until it explodes into a supernova and leaves a black hole.
works.technique_zh: 手部追踪（大概率使用深度相机）检测张开双手的聚拢手势，把粒子吸引到一个点上，该点的质量不断累积，并在恒星生命周期的每个阶段触发相应的粒子特效。
works.exercise_en: Use MediaPipe Hands to detect a gathering gesture that pulls projected particles into a star, which explodes into a nebula once it is full. Twist: the number of participants decides the star's color and lifespan, so one person alone can only make a small red dwarf.

works.title: Room Scan with iPad LiDAR and AR Visualization
works.description: A prototype room scanner that builds a coloured mesh of the room with the new iPad Pro LiDAR and overlays it back onto reality.
works.idea_zh: 用 iPad LiDAR 扫描房间，并把网格叠回现实中查看。

video.video_title: Room Scan by using iPad's LiDAR and AR Visualization

works.technique: ARKit scene reconstruction produces a LiDAR mesh, vertex colors are sampled by projecting camera frames onto it, and the colored mesh is overlaid back on the room.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation ARMeshManager 实时生成房间网格，用线框材质叠回真实空间；变体：按网格法线方向给墙、地、天花板上不同颜色。
works.description_zh: 一个房间扫描原型：用新款 iPad Pro 的 LiDAR 构建房间的彩色网格，再把它叠加回现实中。
works.idea_en: Scan a room with iPad LiDAR and overlay the mesh back onto reality to view it.
works.technique_zh: ARKit 场景重建生成 LiDAR 网格，把摄像头画面投影到网格上以采样顶点颜色，再将彩色网格叠加回房间。
works.exercise_en: Generate a live room mesh with AR Foundation's ARMeshManager and overlay it on the real space with a wireframe material. Twist: color walls, floor and ceiling differently based on the mesh normal direction.

works.title: S . P . A . C . E .
works.description: Made under social distancing, dancers are filmed by special camera rigs whose images are decomposed and rebuilt into geometric worlds that the body alone could not form.
works.idea_zh: 把舞者的身体信息拆解重组，生成身体本身做不到的几何世界
works.technique: Multi-camera capture and GPU image processing decompose each dancer's body data by rule sets and recompose it into real-time geometric visuals.
works.exercise_zh: 用MediaPipe Pose取得关节点，把关节点按规则复制、镜像、旋转成万花筒几何；变化：几位同学远程视频连线，各自的骨架拼成同一个图形。

video.video_title: ELEVENPLAY x Rhizomatiks "S . P . A . C . E ." (2020)

works.description_zh: 在保持社交距离的条件下创作：特殊的摄像装置拍摄舞者，影像被拆解并重建为身体本身无法构成的几何世界。
works.idea_en: Break down and reassemble dancers' body data to create geometric worlds the body itself cannot form.
works.technique_zh: 多机位拍摄和 GPU 图像处理按照规则集拆解每位舞者的身体数据，并将其实时重组为几何视觉效果。
works.exercise_en: Get joint points with MediaPipe Pose and copy, mirror and rotate them by rule into kaleidoscope geometry. Twist: several classmates join a remote video call and their skeletons combine into a single figure.

works.title: Sinclair Snake
works.description: A Wonderscope story centred on a snake character, told in AR scenes around the child's home and advanced by speaking aloud.
works.idea_zh: 和一条AR小蛇对话，用声音推动故事。

video.video_title: New on Wonderscope: Sinclair Snake

works.technique: An animated character rig is anchored in the room, and scene transitions are triggered by the child's spoken responses via speech recognition.
works.exercise_zh: 让一个 AR 角色向你提问，根据你的语音回答分出两条不同的剧情分支；变体：角色会记住你上次的回答。
works.description_zh: 一个以蛇为主角的 Wonderscope 故事，在孩子家中的各处 AR 场景里展开，并通过孩子大声说话来推进剧情。
works.idea_en: Talk with a little AR snake and move the story forward with your voice.
works.technique_zh: 带骨骼绑定的动画角色锚定在房间中，场景切换由孩子的口头回答通过语音识别触发。
works.exercise_en: Have an AR character ask you a question and branch into two different storylines based on your spoken answer. Twist: the character remembers what you answered last time.

works.title: Skatrix
works.description: Players scan a real curb, ledge, stair or table with their phone, and a small virtual skater grinds, flips and jumps across it under finger control; replays can be filmed from any angle.
works.description_zh: 玩家用手机扫描真实的路沿、台阶、楼梯或桌子，一个小小的虚拟滑手在手指操控下在上面滑杆、翻板、跳跃；还能从任意角度录制回放。
works.idea_en: Anything in the world can become a skate spot once the phone understands its edges.
works.idea_zh: 只要手机理解了物体的边缘，世界上任何东西都能变成滑板场地。
works.technique: Scene meshing and plane detection (later Niantic Lightship) convert real surfaces into colliders and grind rails for a physics-driven skater avatar.
works.technique_zh: 用场景网格化和平面检测（后来采用 Niantic Lightship）把真实表面转成碰撞体和可滑的杆，供物理驱动的滑手化身使用。
works.exercise_en: Build a small character that detects edges of real surfaces from the AR mesh and slides along them when it reaches one. Twist: record the run and replay it from a camera that orbits the real object.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个小角色，能从 AR 网格中识别真实表面的边缘，到达边缘时就沿着它滑行。变体：把这段滑行录下来，用一个绕着真实物体旋转的镜头回放。

video.video_title: Skatrix - AWE - teaser

works.title: Sounds in Space
works.description: An open-source toolkit for curating location-based audio in a room: sounds are placed in space and the phone plays a soundtrack that changes as the visitor walks.
works.idea_zh: 把声音放进空间里，随着你走动而变化的AR声景。

video.video_title: AR Experiment: Sounds in Space

works.technique: ARCore anchors store audio sources at positions in a room, and playback volume and panning follow the phone's tracked position.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 在房间里放置几个带 3D 音效的隐形声音源，走动时听到不同的音乐层；变体：让观众自己录一段声音并放进空间里。
works.description_zh: 一个开源工具包，用于在房间中策划基于位置的音频：把声音放置在空间中，手机播放的配乐会随参观者的走动而变化。
works.idea_en: Place sounds in space to make an AR soundscape that changes as you walk.
works.technique_zh: ARCore 锚点把音源存储在房间中的特定位置，播放音量和声像随手机被追踪的位置而变化。
works.exercise_en: Use AR Foundation to place several invisible sound sources with 3D audio in a room so you hear different music layers as you walk around. Twist: let visitors record their own sounds and place them in the space.

works.title: Spatial Copy and Paste Shared with ARCore
works.description: Selects a region of the real room on HoloLens 2, 'copies' it as a mesh, and pastes the captured space into another user's ARCore view.
works.idea_zh: 在 HoloLens 上“复制”一块真实空间，再“粘贴”到别人的手机 AR 里。

video.video_title: HoloLens Demo:Spatial Copy and Paste and Sharing with ARCore

works.technique: A bounding box selects part of the HoloLens 2 spatial mesh, the cropped mesh with colors is sent over the network, and the ARCore client places it at a chosen anchor.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Polycam 扫描桌面一角导出模型，在另一台手机的 AR 中把它“粘贴”到另一张桌子上；变体：粘贴时把尺寸缩小十倍，做成微缩景观。
works.description_zh: 在 HoloLens 2 上框选真实房间中的一块区域，把它作为网格“复制”下来，再把捕捉到的空间“粘贴”到另一位用户的 ARCore 视图中。
works.idea_en: Copy a piece of real space on HoloLens and paste it into someone else's phone AR.
works.technique_zh: 用包围盒选取 HoloLens 2 空间网格的一部分，把裁剪后的带颜色网格通过网络发送出去，ARCore 客户端再把它放置在选定的锚点处。
works.exercise_en: Scan a corner of a desk with Polycam, export the model, and paste it onto another table in a second phone's AR. Twist: shrink it tenfold when pasting to make a miniature landscape.

works.title: Squarepusher 'Terminal Slam' music video
works.description: Through mixed-reality glasses, Shibuya's billboards and ads are erased and replaced by glitching visuals synced to the music (diminished reality).
works.idea_zh: 戴上MR眼镜，涩谷的广告被抹去并替换成音乐视觉

video.video_title: Squarepusher - Terminal Slam (Official Video)

works.technique: Diminished reality: the camera feed is analysed to detect billboard regions, which are masked, inpainted and replaced with music-synced visuals, then re-rendered into the headset view.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机相机识别并遮住画面里的文字或 logo（颜色分割或图像追踪），用节奏驱动的故障图形填充；变体：把被遮掉的广告换成空白或天空，体验“没有广告的城市”。
works.description_zh: 透过混合现实眼镜，涩谷的广告牌和广告被抹去，替换成与音乐同步的故障风视觉（减弱现实）。
works.idea_en: Put on MR glasses and Shibuya's ads are erased and replaced with music visuals.
works.technique_zh: 减弱现实：分析摄像头画面以检测广告牌区域，对其进行遮罩和图像修补，再替换为与音乐同步的视觉内容，然后重新渲染到头显视野中。
works.exercise_en: Use the phone camera to detect and cover text or logos in the frame (with color segmentation or image tracking), and fill them with rhythm-driven glitch graphics. Twist: replace the covered ads with blank space or sky to experience a city without ads.

works.title: Super You (AR app)
works.description: An iPhone AR app that tracks your body and transforms you into a flowing digital being in real time.
works.idea_zh: 手机一扫，把自己变成流动的数字生命体

video.video_title: Super You  - AR app for iPhone 11 and above

works.technique: ARKit body tracking (or person segmentation) provides a skeleton and silhouette each frame, which drive particle or ribbon systems that replace the user's body in the camera view.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Lens Studio 或 ARKit 人体追踪，把全身替换成跟随关节流动的粒子或丝带；变体：给身体每个部位分配不同的“材料”（烟、水、文字），做一个表达自己性格的数字身体。
works.description_zh: 一款 iPhone AR 应用，追踪你的身体，把你实时变成一个流动的数字生命体。
works.idea_en: Point your phone at yourself and become a flowing digital being.
works.technique_zh: ARKit 身体追踪（或人体分割）每帧提供骨架和轮廓，驱动粒子或丝带系统，在摄像头画面中取代用户的身体。
works.exercise_en: Use Lens Studio or ARKit body tracking to replace your whole body with particles or ribbons that flow with your joints. Twist: assign each body part a different material, such as smoke, water or text, to make a digital body that expresses your personality.

works.title: TransceiVR
works.description: A person outside VR taps and draws on a tablet view of the virtual scene, and their annotations appear in the headset user's world, while they can also rewind or look around independently.
works.description_zh: VR 外的人在平板上的虚拟场景视图里点击和绘制，标注就出现在头显用户的世界中；外部用户还能独立回放或环顾场景。
works.idea_en: Give the people watching a headset user a real voice inside the virtual world.
works.idea_zh: 让旁观头显用户的人在虚拟世界里拥有真正的话语权。
works.technique: Hooks into VR platform APIs to capture scene views and poses for third-party apps without source code, streaming them to a tablet and projecting tablet annotations back into VR.
works.technique_zh: 借助 VR 平台接口，在无需源代码的情况下为第三方应用捕获场景画面与位姿，传到平板上，再把平板上的标注投射回 VR。
works.exercise_en: Pair a student wearing a phone VR viewer with a partner holding a second phone that mirrors the scene; the partner guides by drawing on their screen while the viewer finds objects. Twist: forbid speaking so all help must be drawn.
works.exercise_zh: 让一名戴手机 VR 眼镜的学生与拿着另一部镜像画面手机的同伴配对，同伴通过在屏幕上绘制来引导对方找东西；变体：禁止说话，所有帮助都只能画出来。

video.video_title: TransceiVR: Bridging Asymmetrical Communication Between VR Users and External Collaborators

works.title: Unity-chan and Occlusion
works.description: A dancing Unity-chan character is correctly hidden by real people and furniture using ARKit depth occlusion.
works.idea_zh: 虚拟角色会被真实的人和家具正确遮挡。

video.video_title: Unity-chan and Occulusion

works.technique: ARKit people occlusion and LiDAR environment depth are used in AR Foundation's AROcclusionManager, so the depth test hides the character behind real people and furniture.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR Foundation 中开启 AROcclusionManager，让一个跳舞角色在人和椅子后面被正确遮挡；变体：角色被挡住时会探头出来“偷看”。
works.description_zh: 借助 ARKit 深度遮挡，跳舞的 Unity-chan 角色能被真实的人和家具正确遮挡。
