works.idea_en: A virtual character is correctly hidden behind real people and furniture.
works.technique_zh: 在 AR Foundation 的 AROcclusionManager 中使用 ARKit 人体遮挡和 LiDAR 环境深度，通过深度测试把角色隐藏在真实的人和家具后面。
works.exercise_en: Turn on AROcclusionManager in AR Foundation so a dancing character is correctly hidden behind people and chairs. Twist: when the character is blocked, it pokes its head out to peek.

works.title: Unreal City
works.description: An AR public art walk along London's Thames with 36 works by artists such as Olafur Eliasson, Cao Fei and Tomás Saraceno, curated with Dazed.
works.idea_zh: 泰晤士河畔的AR雕塑步道

video.video_title: The Curator’s Tour | Unreal City

works.technique: GPS/geolocated anchors (refined with local plane detection) place a sequence of sculptures along a walking route, with the app acting as a map-guided exhibition.
works.exercise_zh: 全班每人做一件 AR 作品，沿校园一条步道按 GPS 位置布展，用 WebAR 链接串起来；变体：给展览设计一个只有走完全程才能看到的“终点作品”。
works.description_zh: 沿伦敦泰晤士河展开的 AR 公共艺术步道，汇集了 Olafur Eliasson、曹斐、Tomás Saraceno 等艺术家的 36 件作品，与 Dazed 联合策划。
works.idea_en: A trail of AR sculptures along the Thames.
works.technique_zh: 基于 GPS 地理定位的锚点（再辅以局部平面检测进行精调）沿步行路线放置一系列雕塑，应用本身则充当由地图引导的展览。
works.exercise_en: Have each student in the class make one AR work, install them by GPS position along a campus walkway, and link them together with WebAR. Twist: design a final work for the exhibition that can be seen only after walking the whole route.

works.title: Video-Annotated AR Assembly Tutorials
works.description: A normal 2D how-to video of assembling a toy is analysed automatically and turned into a 3D AR tutorial on the real object, with the original video clips pinned to each step.
works.description_zh: 一段组装玩具的普通二维教学视频被自动分析，变成叠加在真实物体上的三维 AR 教程，每一步还附上原视频片段。
works.idea_en: Convert any existing assembly video into step-by-step AR, keeping the video as backup.
works.idea_zh: 把任何现成的装配视频变成分步 AR 教程，同时保留视频作为参考。
works.technique: Tracks parts in the input video using a CAD model and an assembly graph of blocking relationships, then renders the detected steps in AR with the matching video snippets attached.
works.technique_zh: 借助 CAD 模型和记录部件遮挡关系的装配图在输入视频中追踪部件，再把识别出的步骤在 AR 中渲染出来，并附上对应的视频片段。
works.exercise_en: Pick a five-step LEGO model, film it, and build a phone AR guide that shows a 3D arrow and the matching video clip over each step on the real bricks. Twist: let the guide skip steps that the camera sees are already done.
works.exercise_zh: 选一个五步完成的乐高模型并拍下来，做一个手机 AR 指南，在真实积木上为每一步显示三维箭头和对应的视频片段；变体：当相机看到某步已完成时自动跳过。

video.video_title: Video-Annotated Augmented Reality Assembly Tutorials

works.title: Virtual Flowers Using ARKit
works.description: Generative flowers sprout and bloom across the scanned surfaces of a room.
works.idea_zh: 生成式花朵沿着房间表面生长绽放。

video.video_title: Virtual Flowers using ARKit3

works.technique: Points are sampled on the scanned mesh surface with their normals, and procedural flower instances grow along those normals with animated scale.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 网格或平面上随机采样点，沿法线生成逐渐长大的花；变体：花只长在手机镜头对准超过三秒的地方。
works.description_zh: 生成式花朵在房间的扫描表面上萌芽、绽放。
works.idea_en: Generative flowers grow and bloom along the room's surfaces.
works.technique_zh: 在扫描得到的网格表面上采样点及其法线，程序化的花朵实例沿法线方向生长，并带有尺寸变化的动画。
works.exercise_en: Randomly sample points on an AR mesh or plane and grow flowers along the normals that get bigger over time. Twist: flowers grow only where the phone camera has been aimed for more than three seconds.

works.title: Weird Type skate trails
works.description: Skateboarder Christopher Ledwig uses the Weird Type app to leave a trail of text following his skateboard's motion through space (shared by Zach).
works.idea_zh: 让一个 AR 文字工具被别人拿去玩出新花样：用文字画出滑板的轨迹。
works.technique: The app samples the phone's world-tracked pose each frame and emits typographic glyphs along that path, so moving the camera draws text in 3D.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个“移动手机就能在空中留下文字轨迹”的小工具，再请同学用运动（跑、跳、滑板）去用它；变体：让文字内容随速度变化。

video.video_title:
Using weird type to draw a trail of skate motion #Repost @christopherledwig (@get_repost)
・・・
augmented reality skateboard experiments #weirdtype #zachlieberman #northbrigade https://t.co/1MtstKHYDP

works.description_zh: 滑板手 Christopher Ledwig 用 Weird Type 应用让一串文字跟随滑板在空间中的运动留下轨迹（由 Zach 分享）。
works.idea_en: Someone else takes an AR text tool and finds a new trick: drawing a skateboard's path with words.
works.technique_zh: 应用每帧采样手机在世界追踪中的位姿，并沿这条路径发射文字字形，于是移动相机就能在三维空间中书写文字。
works.exercise_en: Make a small tool that leaves a trail of text in the air as you move your phone, then ask classmates to use it while running, jumping or skateboarding. Twist: make the text content change with speed.

works.title: Willowcrest Manor
works.description: A Wonderscope mystery set in a spooky mansion that unfolds around the child's room.
works.idea_zh: 一座神秘庄园在孩子的房间里展开推理故事。

video.video_title: New On Wonderscope: Willowcrest Manor

works.technique: Room-scale placement of set pieces and characters, likely with scripted triggers based on where the viewer looks, turns the child's room into a staged mystery.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个基于视线触发的 AR 悬疑场景：只有看向某个角落时才出现线索；变体：线索出现后如果你移开视线，它会换位置。
works.description_zh: 一个 Wonderscope 悬疑故事，发生在一座阴森的宅邸中，并在孩子的房间里徐徐展开。
works.idea_en: A mysterious manor unfolds a detective story in a child's bedroom.
works.technique_zh: 在房间尺度上放置场景道具和角色，大概率配合基于观看方向的脚本触发器，把孩子的房间变成一出悬疑剧的舞台。
works.exercise_en: Build a gaze-triggered AR mystery scene where a clue appears only when you look at a certain corner. Twist: once the clue appears, it moves somewhere else if you look away.

works.title: XRDirector
works.description: A role-based collaborative authoring tool where one person acts as director, others as actors or camera, puppeteering virtual characters in AR together like filming a scene.
works.idea_zh: 像拍电影一样分角色：导演、演员、摄影一起在AR中排演。

video.video_title: XRDirector: A Role-Based Collaborative Immersive Authoring System

works.technique: Synchronises a shared AR scene across devices and assigns each device a role with its own controls for moving characters, cameras and timelines.
works.exercise_zh: 分组用Reality Composer或共享AR App：一人做“导演”喊指令，两人各拿手机操控一个虚拟角色排演一个30秒短剧；变化：最后由“摄影师”手机录屏成片。
works.description_zh: 一个基于角色分工的协作创作工具：一人担任导演，其他人担任演员或摄影师，大家像拍摄一场戏一样在 AR 中共同操控虚拟角色。
works.idea_en: Split roles like on a film set: director, actors and camera rehearse together in AR.
works.technique_zh: 在多台设备之间同步共享的 AR 场景，并为每台设备分配角色，每个角色都有各自用于移动角色、相机和时间线的控制方式。
works.exercise_en: Work in groups with Reality Composer or a shared AR app: one person acts as director and calls out instructions while two others each control a virtual character with a phone to rehearse a 30-second skit. Twist: at the end, the camera operator screen-records the final cut on their phone.

works.title: You Are Strange
works.description: A short mixed-reality poem in which a dreamy painted figure and floating words appear around the artist in a real room, as if her imagination were leaking into the space.
works.description_zh: 一首简短的混合现实诗：一个梦幻的画中人和漂浮的文字出现在真实房间里艺术家的身边，仿佛她的想象力正渗进这个空间。
works.idea_en: Let a drawn daydream share the room with you.
works.idea_zh: 让画出来的白日梦与你共处一室。
works.technique: The 3D painting is created in VR and composited over footage of the real room from a tracked camera.
works.technique_zh: 三维绘画在 VR 中完成，再与被追踪摄像机拍到的真实房间画面合成。
works.exercise_en: Write a four-line poem and paint each line as a 3D element placed around a real person in a room using an AR drawing app. Twist: film it so the words are only readable from one camera position.
works.exercise_zh: 写一首四行小诗，用 AR 绘画应用把每一行画成一个三维元素，摆放在房间里真人的周围；变体：拍摄时让文字只有在某一个机位才能读懂。

video.video_title: You are strange... virtual reality painting - Mixed reality

works.title: iPad Pro LiDAR Matrix Simulation
works.description: The scanned room is texture-mapped with falling green Matrix code, turning his house into the digital rain.
works.idea_zh: 把扫描出的房间贴满《黑客帝国》的绿色代码雨。

video.video_title: iPad Pro LiDAR Matrix simulation

works.technique: The LiDAR mesh is shaded with a world-space projected shader that scrolls glyph textures downward over time, producing Matrix-style digital rain on every surface.
works.exercise_zh: 给 AR 网格写一个按世界坐标 Y 轴向下滚动字符贴图的着色器；变体：把字符换成你名字的字母或诗句。
works.description_zh: 扫描出的房间被贴满下落的《黑客帝国》绿色代码，把他的家变成一场数字雨。
works.idea_en: Cover the scanned room with the green code rain from The Matrix.
works.technique_zh: LiDAR 网格使用世界空间投影着色器进行着色，字符纹理随时间向下滚动，在每个表面上生成《黑客帝国》风格的数字雨。
works.exercise_en: Write a shader for the AR mesh that scrolls a glyph texture downward along the world-space Y axis. Twist: replace the glyphs with the letters of your name or lines of a poem.

works.title: 'Automaton' Instagram effect
works.description: A face effect that retextures and lights the face mesh to turn the user into a mechanical automaton with layered metal parts.
works.idea_zh: 把你的脸变成机械人偶。

video.video_title: Spark AR - Instagram Effect Breakdown ("Automaton")

works.technique: A custom texture and normal maps are applied to the tracked face mesh, with additional 3D parts attached to face anchors and lit in real time.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Lens Studio 面部网格贴图，把自己变成'文物'或'机器人'；加一个变化：张嘴时脸上的零件会弹开。
works.description_zh: 一个面部特效，为面部网格重新贴图并打光，把用户变成一个由层层金属部件构成的机械自动人偶。
works.idea_en: Turn your face into a mechanical automaton.
works.technique_zh: 在被追踪的面部网格上应用自定义纹理和法线贴图，并在面部锚点上附加额外的三维部件，进行实时打光。
works.exercise_en: Use face-mesh texturing in Lens Studio to turn yourself into a museum relic or a robot. Twist: the parts on your face spring open when you open your mouth.

works.title: 'Hole in the head' occlusion effect
works.description: A face-tracked effect cuts a convincing hole into the user's head where a tiny 3D scene sits inside.
works.idea_zh: 在脑袋上开个洞，里面藏着一个小世界。

video.video_title: Spark AR: Instagram Filters - “Hole in the head” with Occlusion

works.technique: An invisible occluder mesh around the head writes depth only, so a 3D model placed inside appears to sit in a cavity in the face.
works.exercise_zh: 用遮挡（occluder）材质在额头开一个洞，里面放一个旋转的小星球；加一个变化：眨眼时洞里的场景切换。
works.description_zh: 一个基于面部追踪的特效，在用户的头部切开一个以假乱真的洞，洞里藏着一个微缩的三维场景。
works.idea_en: Open a hole in your head with a tiny world hidden inside.
works.technique_zh: 头部周围一个不可见的遮挡网格只写入深度，使放在里面的三维模型看起来像是位于脸上的一个空腔中。
works.exercise_en: Use an occluder material to open a hole in your forehead and put a small spinning planet inside. Twist: the scene inside the hole switches when you blink.

works.title: 'Wichita' Instagram effect
works.description: An Instagram effect inspired by the White Stripes' 'Seven Nation Army' video splits your face and background into layered, animated kaleidoscopic tunnels.
works.idea_zh: 把自拍变成《Seven Nation Army》MV 那样无限延伸的三角隧道。

video.video_title: Spark AR: Instagram Effect Breakdown ("Wichita")

works.technique: Person segmentation separates the user from the background, and scripted layers of scaled, offset camera textures create the recursive tunnel.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Spark/Lens Studio 或 p5.js 把摄像头画面做成向中心无限递归的隧道；加一个变化：递归层数随音乐音量变化。
works.description_zh: 这款 Instagram 特效的灵感来自 The White Stripes《Seven Nation Army》的 MV，它把你的脸和背景拆成一层层动态的万花筒式隧道。
works.idea_en: Turn a selfie into the endless triangular tunnel from the 'Seven Nation Army' video.
works.technique_zh: 人像分割把用户从背景中分离出来，再用脚本叠加多层经过缩放和偏移的相机纹理，形成递归隧道。
works.exercise_en: Use Spark/Lens Studio or p5.js to turn the camera feed into a tunnel that recurses endlessly toward the center. Twist: make the number of recursion layers follow the music volume.

works.title: 360proto
works.description: Paper sketches drawn on equirectangular 360 grids are photographed and instantly viewed as immersive VR/AR scenes, with layers for interactive prototypes.
works.idea_zh: 在纸上画360度全景草图，拍一下就能在头显里走进去。

video.video_title: 360proto: Making Interactive Virtual Reality & Augmented Reality Prototypes from Paper

works.technique: Maps hand-drawn sketches on a distorted 360 grid template onto a sphere around the viewer, with layered sketches for AR overlays.
works.exercise_zh: 打印一张等距柱状投影网格纸让学生画一个房间，拍照后用手机全景查看器浏览；变化：在同一场景中叠加一层“AR标签”草图。
works.description_zh: 在等距柱状 360 度网格纸上画好的草图，拍照后即可作为沉浸式 VR/AR 场景直接浏览，还能叠加图层制作可交互的原型。
works.idea_en: Sketch a 360-degree scene on paper, snap a photo, and step inside it in a headset.
works.technique_zh: 把画在畸变 360 度网格模板上的手绘草图映射到环绕观者的球面上，并用分层草图制作 AR 叠加层。
works.exercise_en: Print an equirectangular grid sheet, have students draw a room on it, then photograph it and browse it in a phone panorama viewer. Twist: overlay a second sketch layer of 'AR labels' on the same scene.

works.title: AR Iron Man HUD
works.description: A phone-in-headset JARVIS HUD that tracks a real phone, listens to voice commands and wires in Alexa skills.
works.idea_zh: 用手机加廉价头盔自制钢铁侠 JARVIS 头显。

video.video_title: AR Iron Man HUD in Unity (tracking a phone)

works.technique: A phone-in-headset stereo view renders a HUD overlay, while Vuforia tracks a second physical phone as a target and voice commands are routed through Alexa skills.
works.exercise_zh: 用 HoloKit 双目模式做一个头部锁定的 HUD，显示时间和语音识别到的指令；变体：盯着桌上某个真实物体时 HUD 弹出它的“扫描信息”。
works.description_zh: 一套把手机插进头戴设备的 JARVIS 抬头显示：它能追踪一部真实的手机、听取语音指令，并接入 Alexa 技能。
works.idea_en: Build your own Iron Man JARVIS headset from a phone and a cheap helmet.
works.technique_zh: 手机插入头显形成双目立体视图并渲染 HUD 叠加层，同时用 Vuforia 把另一部实体手机当作追踪目标，语音指令则通过 Alexa 技能处理。
works.exercise_en: Build a head-locked HUD in HoloKit stereo mode that shows the time and the commands picked up by speech recognition. Twist: when you stare at a real object on the desk, the HUD pops up its 'scan info'.

works.title: AR eyedropper for smart lights
works.description: A virtual eyedropper sucks a color from any real object with a pinch and squirts it into a smart lamp, which changes to that color, accompanied by the Deluminator sound from Harry Potter.
works.description_zh: 一个虚拟滴管，捏一下就从任何真实物体上吸取颜色，再挤进智能灯里，灯立刻变成同样的颜色，还配上《哈利·波特》熄灯器的音效。
works.idea_en: Treat the whole visible world as a color palette you can sample and pour into connected devices.
works.idea_zh: 把整个看得见的世界当成调色盘，取色后倒进联网设备里。
works.technique: A ray from the fingertip hits the passthrough video texture to read the pixel color, and virtual colliders registered to the real lamps send that color to the smart bulbs over their API.
works.technique_zh: 从指尖发出的射线命中透视视频纹理并读取像素颜色，再通过与真实灯具对齐的虚拟碰撞体，把颜色经 API 发给智能灯泡。
works.exercise_en: Make a phone app that samples the color at the screen center and sends it to a smart bulb or a web page background. Twist: mix two sampled colors before pouring.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个手机应用：取屏幕中心的颜色，发送给智能灯泡或网页背景。变体：先吸两种颜色，混合后再倒出去。

video.video_title: A virtual eye dropper in AR that can pick up colors from real world and apply it to smart lights. It feels a bit magical so I used the deluminator sound effect in #HarryPotter movie. Prototyping with

works.title: ARKit3 Body Tracking Effects
works.description: Generative graphics attached to a tracked human skeleton follow a dancer's movements.
works.idea_zh: 给 ARKit3 追踪到的人体骨骼附上生成式图形。

video.video_title: ARKit3 Body Tracking Demo #1

works.technique: ARKit 3 body tracking provides a 3D skeleton, and generative meshes and trails are attached to joint transforms so they follow the dancer.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe Pose 追踪全身关节，在手腕和脚踝上挂彩色拖尾；变体：不同关节触发不同乐器的声音。
works.description_zh: 附着在被追踪人体骨骼上的生成式图形，随舞者的动作一起舞动。
works.idea_en: Hang generative graphics on the body skeleton that ARKit 3 tracks.
works.technique_zh: ARKit 3 人体追踪提供三维骨骼，生成式网格和拖尾挂在各关节的变换上，从而跟随舞者运动。
works.exercise_en: Track full-body joints with MediaPipe Pose and attach colorful trails to the wrists and ankles. Twist: each joint triggers the sound of a different instrument.

works.title: ARSpectator: MR Prototypes for Augmented Sports
works.description: Spectators in a rugby stadium hold up a phone and see player names, statistics and game information placed on the real pitch, prototyped first in the lab with a scale model.
works.description_zh: 橄榄球场的观众举起手机，就能看到球员姓名、统计数据和比赛信息摆放在真实的球场上；这些功能先在实验室里用缩比模型做了原型。
works.idea_en: Bring broadcast-style graphics to the fans actually sitting in the stadium.
works.idea_zh: 把转播画面里的图形信息带给真正坐在体育场里的观众。
works.technique: Localizes the phone against a prebuilt stadium model and overlays situated infographics, with lab prototypes simulating the field to test visualisations before live games.
works.technique_zh: 把手机定位到预先建好的体育场模型中并叠加情境化信息图，实验室原型会模拟球场，在正式比赛前测试可视化效果。
works.exercise_en: Print a mini football pitch, track it with a phone AR image target, and overlay live 'stats' for toy players moved by classmates. Twist: show different stats to home and away fans.
works.exercise_zh: 打印一个迷你足球场，用手机 AR 图像追踪识别它，为同学移动的玩具球员叠加实时“数据”；变体：给主队和客队球迷显示不同的数据。

video.video_title: Demonstrating Mixed Reality Prototypes for Augmented Sports Experiences

works.title: AR_Glitch
works.description: A generative glitch effect that tears and displaces the live camera image around the space.
works.idea_zh: 让现实画面在空间中产生生成式的故障撕裂。

video.video_title: AR_Glitch ver0.003

works.technique: A full-screen shader slices the camera image into blocks and offsets them with noise-driven displacement and RGB channel splitting, likely modulated by device motion.
works.exercise_zh: 在 Unity 或 three.js 里对摄像头画面写一个块状错位加 RGB 分离的故障着色器；变体：手机晃得越厉害故障越强。
works.description_zh: 一种生成式故障特效，把实时相机画面在空间中撕裂、错位。
works.idea_en: Make the real world tear apart in generative glitches across space.
works.technique_zh: 全屏着色器把相机画面切成方块，用噪声驱动的位移和 RGB 通道分离让它们错开，强度大概率随设备运动变化。
works.exercise_en: Write a glitch shader in Unity or three.js that offsets camera image blocks and splits RGB channels. Twist: the harder the phone shakes, the stronger the glitch.

works.title: ARt
works.description: A deadpan performance-demo (for TEDxTheWrong) launching 'the world's first platform for augmented reality art', satirising AR hype with face- and body-tracked artworks.
works.idea_zh: 一本正经地演示AR艺术的荒诞
works.technique: Face and body tracking attach artworks to the performer in real time, framed as a mock product launch; the technique is ordinary on purpose and the satire carries the piece.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Lens Studio 或 Effect House 做一个“艺术平台”滤镜，然后录一段 2 分钟一本正经的产品发布演示；变体：演示中必须有一个功能明显荒谬但被说得很重要。
works.description_zh: 一场为 TEDxTheWrong 创作的冷面表演式演示：艺术家郑重其事地发布“全球首个增强现实艺术平台”，借助人脸与身体追踪的作品，讽刺围绕 AR 的炒作。
works.idea_en: Demo the absurdity of AR art with a perfectly straight face.
works.technique_zh: 人脸和身体追踪把艺术作品实时附着在表演者身上，整体包装成一场假的产品发布会；技术刻意平平无奇，作品的力量来自讽刺。
works.exercise_en: Make an 'art platform' filter in Lens Studio or Effect House, then record a deadpan two-minute product launch demo. Twist: the demo must include one clearly absurd feature presented as crucial.

works.title: Acqua Alta – Crossing the Mirror (AR pop-up book)
works.description: A black-and-white ink pop-up book that, viewed through a phone or tablet, fills with animated rain, rising water and two dancing figures moving through its pages.
works.idea_zh: 透过手机看立体书，墨水画中的人物在页面间跳舞、被洪水淹没
works.technique: Marker-based AR recognises each pop-up spread and anchors motion-captured dance animation and water simulations to the paper geometry.
works.exercise_zh: 做一本3页的纸质立体书，用图像识别AR让每页出现一段动画；变化：翻页的顺序改变故事结局。

video.video_title: Augmented Reality Pop Up Book By Adrien M & Claire B

works.description_zh: 一本黑白水墨立体书。透过手机或平板观看时，书页间会落下动画雨水、涨起洪水，两个舞动的人物在页面之间穿行。
works.idea_en: Through a phone, ink-drawn figures dance between the pages of a pop-up book and get swept up by a flood.
works.technique_zh: 基于标记的 AR 识别每一个立体跨页，把动作捕捉的舞蹈动画和水体模拟锚定在纸张的几何结构上。
works.exercise_en: Make a three-page paper pop-up book and use image-recognition AR to play an animation on each page. Twist: the order in which pages are turned changes the ending.

works.title: All My Confusing Pets
works.description: A mixed-reality performance where the artist interacts with glitchy virtual pets composited into the real space.
works.idea_zh: 与一群混乱的虚拟宠物同台的混合现实表演

video.video_title: All My Confusing Pets : A Mixed Reality Performance

works.technique: Mixed-reality compositing of glitchy AI-driven creatures in Unity into the real space, with the performer's tracked pose used for interaction and collision.
works.exercise_zh: 用 HoloKit 或手机 AR 放几只行为规则互相冲突的虚拟宠物（追你、躲你、模仿你），录一段你试图照顾它们的表演；变体：让宠物的故障（抖动、穿模）成为它们性格的一部分。
works.description_zh: 一场混合现实表演：艺术家与一群合成进真实空间、不断出故障的虚拟宠物互动。
works.idea_en: A mixed-reality performance where the artist shares the stage with a pack of chaotic virtual pets.
works.technique_zh: 在 Unity 中把由 AI 驱动、带故障感的生物以混合现实方式合成进真实空间，并利用表演者被追踪的姿态进行交互和碰撞。
works.exercise_en: Place a few virtual pets with conflicting behavior rules (chase you, avoid you, copy you) in HoloKit or phone AR, and record a performance of you trying to look after them. Twist: make the pets' glitches (jitter, clipping) part of their personalities.

works.title: An Augmented Reality Web Browser
works.description: Floating, resizable web pages placed around physical space, an early take on spatial-computing windows on Android.
works.idea_zh: 把网页窗口漂浮在真实空间中，早期的空间计算浏览器。

video.video_title: Let's Make an Augmented Reality Web Browser (Unity AR)

works.technique: Web pages are rendered to textures by an embedded browser plugin and mapped onto world-anchored quads in ARCore, with raycast input translated into page coordinates for clicks and resizing.
works.exercise_zh: 在 WebXR 场景里放三块悬浮面板，每块显示一张网页截图或 iframe 纹理，可拖动和缩放；变体：面板离你越远内容越简化（只剩标题）。
works.description_zh: 可自由缩放的网页漂浮在真实空间各处，是 Android 上对空间计算窗口的一次早期尝试。
works.idea_en: Float web page windows in real space, an early spatial-computing browser.
works.technique_zh: 内嵌浏览器插件把网页渲染成纹理，贴到 ARCore 中锚定在世界坐标的四边形上；射线检测的输入被换算成页面坐标，用来点击和调整大小。
works.exercise_en: Place three floating panels in a WebXR scene, each showing a web page screenshot or iframe texture that can be dragged and scaled. Twist: the farther a panel is from you, the simpler its content gets (only the title remains).

works.title: Angry Birds AR: Isle of Pigs
works.description: Pig fortresses are built on the player's floor at room scale; players walk around them to find weak points and then launch birds from a slingshot.
works.idea_zh: 把愤怒的小鸟城堡搭在你家地板上，绕着走一圈寻找弱点。

video.video_title: Angry Birds AR: Isle of Pigs - Launch Trailer

works.technique: Destructible physics structures are built at room scale on the floor plane, and a slingshot is aimed from the camera position so the player walks to find angles.
works.exercise_zh: 在地面上放一座 AR 积木塔，从手机位置用弹弓发射小球，鼓励玩家走到侧面找弱点；变体：塔的形状由真实房间的空地大小自动决定。
works.description_zh: 猪堡垒以房间尺度搭建在玩家家里的地板上，玩家要绕着它走动寻找薄弱点，再用弹弓发射小鸟。
works.idea_en: Build Angry Birds fortresses on your living-room floor and walk around them to find the weak spots.
works.technique_zh: 在地面平面上以房间尺度搭建可破坏的物理结构，弹弓从相机位置瞄准，玩家需要走动寻找角度。
works.exercise_en: Place an AR block tower on the floor and launch balls from a slingshot at the phone's position, nudging players to walk to the side to find weak spots. Twist: the tower's shape is set automatically by the amount of open floor in the real room.

works.title: Angry Birds FPS: First Person Slingshot
works.description: Angry Birds rebuilt for Magic Leap One: pig fortresses are built on your real tables and floor, and you pull back a hand-held slingshot to knock them down.
works.idea_zh: 在真实桌面和地板上搭猪堡，亲手拉弹弓把它们打垮。

video.video_title: Angry Birds FPS: First Person Slingshot – Test Session

works.technique: Structures are spawned on detected tables and floors, and a slingshot mechanic maps the controller pull-back vector to launch velocity for physics projectiles.
works.exercise_zh: 在桌面上堆一座 AR 积木塔，用手机向后拉的距离决定发射力度把球打过去；变体：用真实物体当掩体，挡住部分积木。
works.description_zh: 为 Magic Leap One 重新打造的《愤怒的小鸟》：猪堡垒搭在你真实的桌面和地板上，你拉开手中的弹弓把它们击垮。
works.idea_en: Build pig forts on your real tables and floor, then pull back a slingshot by hand to knock them down.
works.technique_zh: 在检测到的桌面和地板上生成结构，弹弓机制把手柄向后拉的向量映射为物理弹丸的发射速度。
works.exercise_en: Stack an AR block tower on a table and fire a ball at it, with launch power set by how far you pull the phone back. Twist: use real objects as cover that hides some of the blocks.

works.title: Augmented Reality Language Learning
works.description: Walking through a room with a headset, the learner sees everyday objects automatically recognised and labelled with their foreign-language words, anchored in place.
works.description_zh: 戴着头显在房间里走动时，日常物品被自动识别，并在原地贴上对应的外语单词标签。
works.idea_en: Turn your own home into a vocabulary flashcard deck.
works.idea_zh: 把自己的家变成一套单词卡片。
works.technique: Runs object detection on camera frames and registers each detected label to 3D positions in the headset's spatial map so labels stay attached to objects.
works.technique_zh: 对摄像头画面做物体检测，并把每个检测结果配准到头显空间地图中的三维位置，让标签始终贴在物体上。
works.exercise_en: Use a phone object-detection or image-tracking AR tool to label ten classroom objects in a second language, then quiz a partner by hiding the labels. Twist: show only the first letter and reveal the word when the learner says it aloud.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机的物体识别或图像追踪 AR 工具，给教室里十件物品贴上第二语言的标签，然后隐藏标签考同伴；变体：只显示首字母，学生大声说出单词后再揭晓。

video.video_title: Augmented Reality Language Learning

works.title: AuthAR
works.description: While an expert assembles furniture, the system records video and 3D tracking to author an AR assembly tutorial at the same time, which learners then follow in a headset.
works.idea_zh: 边组装边自动生成AR教程。

video.video_title: AuthAR: Concurrent Authoring of Tutorials for AR Assembly Guidance

works.technique: Combines object tracking with synchronized video capture so each assembly step becomes a spatially anchored AR instruction with clips and annotations.
works.exercise_zh: 分成两人一组：一人组装乐高时用手机录制每一步，另一人用Reality Composer把每步视频/箭头放在对应零件位置上，给第三人使用；变化：教程不许用文字。
works.description_zh: 专家组装家具时，系统同步录制视频和三维追踪数据，顺手生成一份 AR 组装教程，学习者随后戴上头显照着操作即可。
works.idea_en: Generate an AR tutorial automatically while you assemble.
works.technique_zh: 把物体追踪与同步视频采集结合起来，让每个组装步骤都成为带视频片段和注释的空间锚定 AR 指引。
works.exercise_en: Work in pairs: one person records each step on a phone while building with LEGO, and the other uses Reality Composer to place each step's video or arrows at the matching part, for a third person to follow. Twist: the tutorial may not use any text.

works.title: Back to the Moon AR
works.description: An AR version of the Emmy-nominated Google Spotlight Story about Georges Méliès, letting the animated film play out on your table.
works.idea_zh: 梅里爱的月球奇遇在桌面上AR重演

video.video_title: Back to the Moon AR | Fx Goby | Nexus Studios

works.technique: ARCore plane detection places an animated diorama on a tabletop, with the viewer's phone movement acting as the camera for a pre-authored real-time story.
works.exercise_zh: 在桌面上用 AR 搭一个 30 秒的小剧场（如一段经典默片场景），观众移动手机当镜头；变体：只有从某个特定角度看，隐藏的情节才会显现。
works.description_zh: 曾获艾美奖提名的 Google Spotlight Story 讲述了 Georges Méliès 的故事，这是它的 AR 版本，让整部动画短片在你的桌面上上演。
works.idea_en: Méliès's trip to the moon plays out again on your tabletop in AR.
works.technique_zh: ARCore 平面检测把一个动画立体场景放到桌面上，观众移动手机就相当于操控摄影机，观看一段预先编排的实时故事。
works.exercise_en: Build a 30-second tabletop theater in AR (for example, a scene from a classic silent film) where the audience moves the phone as the camera. Twist: a hidden plot point is revealed only from one specific angle.

works.title: Bimba y Lola x Ines Alpha filter
works.description: An Instagram face filter for the Bimba y Lola Fall/Winter 2019 collection that covers the face in Alpha's glossy sculptural 3D makeup.
works.idea_zh: 把品牌时装季的视觉变成人人可戴的3D数字妆容滤镜。

video.video_title: Serve Face With the Bimba Y Lola X Ines Alpha Face Filter

works.technique: Spark AR face tracking attaches glossy 3D makeup meshes to the face, with materials art-directed to match a fashion collection's palette.
works.exercise_zh: 从一件服装或一张海报中提取配色，做一个与之呼应的人脸 AR 滤镜；变体：滤镜根据镜头中服装颜色自动改变。
works.description_zh: 为 Bimba y Lola 2019 秋冬系列打造的 Instagram 人脸滤镜，用 Alpha 标志性的光泽雕塑感 3D 妆容覆盖整张脸。
works.idea_en: Turn a fashion season's look into 3D digital makeup anyone can wear as a filter.
works.technique_zh: Spark AR 人脸追踪把有光泽的 3D 妆容网格附着在脸上，材质经过美术调校，与时装系列的色调相呼应。
works.exercise_en: Pull a color palette from a garment or poster and build a face AR filter that echoes it. Twist: the filter changes automatically to match the colors of clothing in the shot.

works.title: Bringing Tattoos to Life Using AR
works.description: Pointing the phone at people's tattoos animates them and plays the personal story behind each design.
works.idea_zh: 对准纹身，纹身图案动起来并讲出背后的故事。

video.video_title: Bringing Tattoos to Life Using AR

works.technique: Each tattoo is registered as an ARKit reference image, and when detected an animated overlay and audio clip are played on the tracked image anchor.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 图像追踪识别三张手绘贴纸，贴在手臂上时播放对应的动画和一段录音；变体：让每张贴纸讲述贴纸主人自己的一段故事。
works.description_zh: 把手机对准人们身上的纹身，纹身就会动起来，并讲出每个图案背后的个人故事。
works.idea_en: Point at a tattoo and it comes alive and tells the story behind it.
works.technique_zh: 每个纹身都注册为 ARKit 参考图像，检测到后在被追踪的图像锚点上播放动画叠加层和音频片段。
works.exercise_en: Use AR Foundation image tracking to recognize three hand-drawn stickers, playing the matching animation and a voice recording when they are stuck on an arm. Twist: each sticker tells a story from its owner's own life.

works.title: CarDrop-V
works.description: Phone viewers watch a highly detailed virtual car fall from the sky and smash into the real ground in slow motion.
works.idea_zh: 一辆虚拟汽车从天而降，慢动作砸在你面前的真实地面
works.technique: Mobile AR with ground-plane detection triggers a physics-driven slow-motion drop and impact animation of a car model.
works.exercise_zh: 用Reality Composer的物理功能让一个大物体从空中落到地面并慢放；变化：落地点由观众点击选定，并留下永久的“坑”。

video.video_title: CarDrop-V

works.description_zh: 观众透过手机，看着一辆细节极其丰富的虚拟汽车从天而降，以慢动作砸在真实地面上。
works.idea_en: A virtual car falls from the sky and smashes into the real ground in front of you in slow motion.
works.technique_zh: 基于地面平面检测的手机 AR 触发物理驱动的慢动作下落，并播放汽车模型的撞击动画。
works.exercise_en: Use Reality Composer's physics to drop a large object from the air onto the ground in slow motion. Twist: the viewer taps to choose the landing spot, and it leaves a permanent crater.

works.title: Changdeok ARirang
works.description: A location-based AR tour of Seoul's Changdeokgung palace with animated guides and historical stories anchored to the grounds.
works.idea_zh: 在昌德宫里由AR角色讲述历史

video.video_title: Changdeok ARirang | Nexus Studios

works.technique: Location-based AR with GPS plus local plane detection (and 5G streaming of heavy assets) anchors animated guides and scenes at specific palace locations.
works.exercise_zh: 在校园里选三个有故事的地点，用 WebAR 分别放一个讲述该地点过去的动画角色，串成一段导览；变体：导览角色之间互相矛盾，让观众自己判断哪个版本是真的。
works.description_zh: 在首尔昌德宫进行的基于位置的 AR 导览，动画向导和历史故事锚定在宫苑各处。
works.idea_en: AR characters tell the history of Changdeokgung Palace on site.
works.technique_zh: 结合 GPS 与局部平面检测的位置 AR（大体量素材通过 5G 串流），把动画向导和场景锚定在宫内的特定地点。
works.exercise_en: Pick three campus spots with a story and use WebAR to place an animated character at each one telling its past, linked into a guided tour. Twist: the guides contradict each other, and visitors must decide which version is true.

works.title: Clio's Cosmic Quest
works.description: A space-adventure story on Wonderscope staged life-size in the child's room; like all Wonderscope stories, the child advances it by reading characters' lines aloud.
works.idea_zh: 在自己房间里展开一场需要开口对话的太空冒险。

video.video_title: New on Wonderscope: Clio's Cosmic Quest

works.technique: Story scenes are staged in room-scale world coordinates, and voice-recognition gates plus walking prompts pace the narrative.
works.exercise_zh: 设计一个需要观众走到房间另一侧才能看到下一幕的 AR 故事；变体：观众必须说出某个星球的名字才能“起飞”。
works.description_zh: Wonderscope 上的一个太空冒险故事，以真人尺寸在孩子的房间里展开。和所有 Wonderscope 故事一样，孩子要大声念出角色的台词，才能推动剧情。
works.idea_en: A space adventure unfolds in your own room, and you have to speak up to move it along.
works.technique_zh: 故事场景布置在房间尺度的世界坐标中，由语音识别关卡和走动提示控制叙事节奏。
works.exercise_en: Design an AR story where viewers must walk to the other side of the room to see the next scene. Twist: viewers must say the name of a planet to 'take off'.

works.title: Context-Aware Online Adaptation of MR Interfaces
works.description: An optimizer continuously decides which virtual apps to show, where and how detailed, based on the user's current task and cognitive load.
works.idea_zh: MR界面像懂你一样，根据你正在做什么自动决定显示多少、放在哪。

video.video_title: Context-Aware Online Adaptation of Mixed Reality Interfaces

works.technique: An integer linear program decides for each app whether it is shown, where it is placed and at what level of detail, given estimated cognitive load from the task and a utility model, and re-solves as context changes.
works.exercise_zh: 在手机 AR 里放 5 个虚拟信息面板（时间、消息、天气、导航、音乐），写一个简单规则或打分函数，根据用户是否在走动、说话或打字自动隐藏或缩小面板；变体：让用户可以“贿赂”系统保留某个面板，讨论谁拥有控制权。
works.description_zh: 一个优化器根据用户当前的任务和认知负荷，持续决定显示哪些虚拟应用、放在哪里、展示多少细节。
works.idea_en: An MR interface that seems to read you, deciding how much to show and where based on what you are doing.
works.technique_zh: 整数线性规划根据由任务估算的认知负荷和效用模型，为每个应用决定是否显示、放在何处以及以何种细节层级呈现，并在情境变化时重新求解。
works.exercise_en: Place five virtual info panels (time, messages, weather, navigation, music) in phone AR and write a simple rule or scoring function that hides or shrinks them depending on whether the user is walking, talking or typing. Twist: let the user 'bribe' the system to keep a panel, and discuss who holds control.

works.title: D.I.S.P.L.A.Y.E.D + Audio AR
works.description: Heidi Latsky Dance and Google Creative Lab added position-based audio AR to a living-sculpture dance performance, so visitors hear dancers' voices and stories as they walk up to each performer.
works.idea_zh: 观众走近舞者时，耳中响起专属于该舞者的空间声音叙事。

video.video_title: DISPLAYED + Audio AR: an experiment from Google's Creative Lab

works.technique: Indoor positioning estimates the visitor's location, and distance to each performer's position controls the volume of their audio track.
works.exercise_zh: 在教室里布置 4 个“声音点”，根据手机与每个点的距离调整对应音频的音量，形成可走动的声音地图；变体：声音点对应的是同学讲述的一段个人故事。
works.description_zh: Heidi Latsky Dance 与 Google Creative Lab 为一场“活雕塑”舞蹈表演加入了基于位置的音频 AR：观众走近每位舞者时，会听到他们的声音和故事。
works.idea_en: As you approach a dancer, a spatial audio story belonging only to that dancer plays in your ears.
works.technique_zh: 室内定位估算观众所在的位置，再根据观众与每位表演者之间的距离控制其音轨的音量。
works.exercise_en: Set up four 'sound spots' in the classroom and adjust each spot's audio volume by the phone's distance to it, creating a walkable sound map. Twist: each sound spot plays a personal story told by a classmate.

works.title: Desk weather diorama
works.description: A small 3D mountain diorama showing Pittsburgh's temperature and a three-day forecast sits on his real desk; he flips through days with his bare hand in passthrough AR.
works.description_zh: 一个小小的 3D 山体沙盘放在他真实的书桌上，显示匹兹堡的气温和三天预报；他在透视 AR 里徒手翻看每天的天气。
works.idea_en: Turn a data widget into a tiny physical-feeling landscape on your desk.
works.idea_zh: 把数据小组件变成桌面上一块有实体感的小景观。
works.technique: ZED Mini stereo passthrough on an Oculus Rift gives depth-correct AR, with Leap Motion hands pressing the day buttons on a Unity diorama.
works.technique_zh: 在 Oculus Rift 上用 ZED Mini 双目透视获得深度正确的 AR，Leap Motion 的手去按 Unity 沙盘上的日期按钮。
works.exercise_en: Design a tabletop AR diorama that visualizes one live data feed (weather, bus times, air quality). Twist: the terrain itself must change shape with the data.
works.exercise_zh: 设计一个桌面 AR 沙盘，可视化一条实时数据（天气、公交时刻、空气质量）。变体：地形本身要随着数据改变形状。

video.video_title: Experiment with Zed mini + Leap Motion + Oculus Rift @LeapMotion @oculus @Stereolabs3D Please don’t judge on the messy cables 😂 https://t.co/WLcaoei71y

works.title: Digital Supernova
works.description: Generative geometric 'supernovae' are projected onto the Gothic vaults of Rodez Cathedral, turning the ceiling into a slowly exploding digital sky.
works.idea_zh: 把教堂穹顶变成不断爆发的数字超新星
works.technique: Real-time generative geometry is warped to the cathedral's vault surfaces using mapped projection and edge blending.
works.exercise_zh: 躺在地上向天花板投影旋转的生成几何，让大家仰望；变化：用同学的心跳（手机测）控制几何爆发的节奏。

video.video_title: Miguel CHEVALIER Supernova 2019 Notre Dame de Rodez

works.description_zh: 生成式几何“超新星”被投影到罗德兹大教堂的哥特式穹顶上，把天花板变成一片缓缓爆发的数字星空。
works.idea_en: Turn a cathedral vault into a sky of constantly exploding digital supernovae.
works.technique_zh: 通过映射投影和边缘融合，把实时生成的几何图形贴合到大教堂的穹顶表面。
works.exercise_en: Lie on the floor and project rotating generative geometry onto the ceiling for everyone to look up at. Twist: use a classmate's heartbeat (measured with a phone) to set the rhythm of the geometry's bursts.

works.title: Dissolving point-cloud face
works.description: A face captured as a depth image is rebuilt from a million real-time particles that dissolve and drift away.
works.description_zh: 用深度图捕捉的人脸由一百万个实时粒子重建，随后溶解飘散。
works.idea_en: Turn a depth scan of a person into living particles.
works.idea_zh: 把人的深度扫描变成会流动的粒子。
works.technique: The depth image is sampled into a point cache and fed to Unity's GPU Visual Effect Graph, where noise fields dissolve the particles.
works.technique_zh: 把深度图采样成点缓存，送入 Unity 基于 GPU 的 Visual Effect Graph，再用噪声场让粒子溶解。
works.exercise_en: Use a phone's depth or a TrueDepth face capture to spawn particles on a face and blow them away with a voice volume trigger. Twist: the face reforms only when you stay silent.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机深度或 TrueDepth 人脸捕捉在脸上生成粒子，用声音音量把它们吹散。变体：只有保持安静时脸才会重新聚合。

video.video_title: Using @unity3d Visual Effect Graph to dissolve a point-cloud face, and the face is generated from a depth image. #VisualEffectGraph is one of the most incredible tool I've ever used, it's also great f

works.title: DoodleLens
works.description: Point your phone at a doodle on paper and it is lifted off the page into AR, inspired by an old camcorder chroma feature; later updates animate doodles like flipbooks and turn them into 3D models.
works.idea_zh: 对着纸上的涂鸦一拍，它就'撕'下来变成 AR 贴纸活过来。

video.video_title: I made a little app that lets you bring your doodles into AR, inspired by that old camcorder feature! https://t.co/D7fVQxFry5

works.technique: The camera image is thresholded to extract dark ink strokes into a transparent texture, which is placed on a billboard anchored in AR space.
works.exercise_zh: 用 p5.js 或 Lens Studio 把白纸上的涂鸦抠成透明贴图并放到 AR 里；加一个变化：连续拍四张涂鸦就组成一段逐帧动画。
works.description_zh: 把手机对准纸上的涂鸦，它就会从纸面上被“揭”下来进入 AR。灵感来自老式摄像机的色键功能；后来的更新还能让涂鸦像翻页书一样动起来，或变成 3D 模型。
works.idea_en: Snap a doodle on paper and it peels off the page as a living AR sticker.
works.technique_zh: 对相机画面做阈值处理，把深色墨线提取成透明纹理，再放到锚定在 AR 空间中的公告板上。
works.exercise_en: Use p5.js or Lens Studio to cut a doodle on white paper into a transparent texture and place it in AR. Twist: four doodles captured in a row form a frame-by-frame animation.

works.title: DoodleLens flipbook animation
works.description: A series of doodles captured one after another plays back as a looping flipbook animation standing in the real world.
works.idea_zh: 把一叠涂鸦变成站在现实里的翻页动画。

video.video_title: you can now animate your doodles in AR just like an old flip book! https://t.co/5wdZQgASsj

works.technique: Each captured doodle becomes a frame in a sprite sequence that cycles on an AR-anchored quad.
works.exercise_zh: 让每位同学画一帧，拼成一段全班的逐帧动画放进 AR 教室；加一个变化：观众走近时播放速度变快。
works.description_zh: 一张接一张拍下的涂鸦，会作为循环播放的翻页动画立在真实世界里。
works.idea_en: Turn a stack of doodles into a flipbook animation standing in the real world.
works.technique_zh: 每张拍下的涂鸦都成为精灵序列中的一帧，在锚定于 AR 的四边形上循环播放。
works.exercise_en: Have each student draw one frame and combine them into a whole-class frame-by-frame animation placed in the AR classroom. Twist: playback speeds up as viewers get closer.

works.title: Doodles into 3D models
works.description: A flat drawing is extruded into a chunky 3D object that can be placed and walked around in AR.
works.idea_zh: 把平面涂鸦'挤出'成可以绕着看的 3D 物体。

video.video_title: you can now turn your doodles into 3D models, coming to the next doodlelens update! https://t.co/ll40OOUwHE

works.technique: The extracted doodle outline is triangulated and extruded into a mesh with the drawing as its front texture (likely contour extrusion).
works.exercise_zh: 在 Blender 或 three.js 里把一张手绘轮廓 SVG 挤出成 3D 并导入 AR；加一个变化：挤出厚度由画的颜色深浅决定。
works.description_zh: 一幅平面画被挤出成一个厚实的 3D 物体，可以放进 AR 并绕着它走动观看。
works.idea_en: Extrude a flat doodle into a 3D object you can walk around.
works.technique_zh: 对提取出的涂鸦轮廓进行三角剖分并挤出成网格，正面贴上原画作为纹理（大概率是轮廓挤出）。
works.exercise_en: Extrude a hand-drawn outline SVG into 3D in Blender or three.js and bring it into AR. Twist: the extrusion depth depends on how dark the drawing's colors are.

works.title: Drawalong AR
works.description: Turns a YouTube drawing tutorial into virtual tracing paper: the video floats over your real sketchbook so you can trace along. Made with YouTube artist AmandaRachLee.
works.idea_zh: 把YouTube绘画教程变成浮在真实画本上的描图纸。

video.video_title: AR Experiment: Drawalong AR

works.technique: A video plane is anchored to a detected paper surface with adjustable transparency, so the user can trace the tutorial through the overlay.
works.exercise_zh: 在桌面平面上放一个半透明的视频或图片层，对齐真实纸张后描画；变体：让叠加内容逐笔出现，像一位老师在示范。
works.description_zh: 把 YouTube 绘画教程变成一张虚拟描图纸：视频浮在你真实的速写本上方，让你跟着描画。与 YouTube 艺术家 AmandaRachLee 合作完成。
works.idea_en: Turn a YouTube drawing tutorial into tracing paper floating over your real sketchbook.
works.technique_zh: 把视频平面锚定在检测到的纸面上，并允许调节透明度，用户可以透过叠加层描摹教程。
works.exercise_en: Place a semi-transparent video or image layer on a tabletop plane, line it up with a real sheet of paper, and trace it. Twist: have the overlay appear stroke by stroke, like a teacher demonstrating.

works.title: Evolution of Fish
works.description: An AR artwork of fish evolving into plastic-bag creatures; here the artist plays with video feedback in the AR view.
works.idea_zh: 鱼在AR中进化成塑料袋生物

video.video_title: Evolution of Fish AR artwork - playing with video feedback

works.technique: An ARKit plane-anchored animated model shows fish morphing into plastic forms (blend shapes or model swaps), and screen recording of a screen within the AR view produces video feedback.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Unity AR 做一条鱼逐步变形成塑料袋的动画（blend shape 或模型切换），放在水槽或饮水机旁；变体：用手机对着另一台播放 AR 画面的屏幕拍摄，制造视频反馈循环。
works.description_zh: 一件关于鱼逐渐进化成塑料袋生物的 AR 作品；在这段记录中，艺术家在 AR 视图里玩起了视频反馈。
works.idea_en: Fish evolve into plastic-bag creatures in AR.
works.technique_zh: 基于 ARKit 平面锚定的动画模型呈现鱼逐渐变形为塑料形态的过程（通过 blend shape 或模型切换），在 AR 视图中翻拍另一块屏幕则产生视频反馈。
works.exercise_en: Use Unity AR to animate a fish gradually morphing into a plastic bag (via blend shapes or model swaps) and place it next to a fish tank or water cooler. Twist: point the phone at another screen showing the AR view to create a video feedback loop.

works.title: FIELD
works.description: An ever-changing ecosystem where visitors pollinate the environment with their bodies: movement spreads color, makes flowers bloom and attracts butterflies across the seasons.
works.idea_zh: 用身体给虚拟花田授粉，引来蝴蝶，季节随之变化。

video.video_title: FIELD

works.technique: Camera or depth-based body tracking deposits color into a persistent field texture as visitors move, which drives flower spawning and butterfly agents that follow color gradients.
works.exercise_zh: 用投影和人体追踪让人走过的地方留下颜色，颜色浓的地方长花、蝴蝶飞过去；变体：场景按真实时间慢慢换季，冬天时只有两个人靠在一起的地方才会开花。
works.description_zh: 一个不断变化的生态系统：观众用身体为环境授粉，他们的动作会播撒色彩、让花朵绽放，并随着季节更替引来蝴蝶。
works.idea_en: Pollinate a virtual flower field with your body, attract butterflies, and watch the seasons turn.
works.technique_zh: 基于相机或深度的人体追踪在观众移动时把颜色写入一张持续保存的场纹理，由它驱动花朵生成，蝴蝶智能体则沿颜色梯度飞行。
works.exercise_en: Use projection and body tracking so that people leave color where they walk, with flowers growing where color is dense and butterflies flying toward it. Twist: the scene slowly changes season in real time, and in winter flowers bloom only where two people stand close together.

works.title: Faire corps
works.description: An 'exhibition-experience' at Gaîté Lyrique where visitors enter projected, interactive environments that react to their bodies and invite them to move together.
works.idea_zh: 一个用身体集体进入、共同改变影像的展览空间
works.technique: Camera and depth sensing of visitors drives real-time projected particle and line environments on floors and walls.
works.exercise_zh: 设计一个需要3人以上一起动作才会变化的投影空间（如一起跳让画面变色）；变化：加入一条只有全员静止才出现的隐藏画面。

video.video_title: Faire corps - Adrien M & Claire B - Une exposition-expérience à la Gaîté Lyrique

works.description_zh: 在 Gaîté Lyrique 举办的一场“展览体验”：观众走进可交互的投影环境，影像会对他们的身体做出反应，并邀请大家一起行动。
works.idea_en: An exhibition space that people enter together and change with their bodies.
works.technique_zh: 通过相机和深度传感感知观众，驱动投射在地面和墙面上的实时粒子与线条环境。
works.exercise_en: Design a projected space that changes only when three or more people move together (for example, jumping together changes the colors). Twist: add a hidden image that appears only when everyone is completely still.

works.title: Fragment Shadow
works.description: Visitors' real shadows are split into several colored, offset shadows by precisely calibrated multiple projectors, so one body casts a fragmented, prismatic shadow.
works.idea_zh: 多台投影机让一个人的影子碎裂成好几个彩色影子。

video.video_title: Fragment Shadow :Exhibition Preview at SXSW2019

works.technique: Calibrates several projectors' geometry and color so their overlapping light sums to white, making each body occlusion reveal a different colored shadow.
works.exercise_zh: 用三盏红绿蓝LED灯（或三台手机手电加彩色玻璃纸）从不同角度照向白墙，让同学用身体做出彩色影子；变化：用编程让每盏灯随音乐轮流闪烁。
works.description_zh: 经过精确标定的多台投影机把观众真实的影子拆分成数个带颜色、彼此错开的影子，一个人的身体便投下碎裂的、棱镜般的影子。
works.idea_en: Several projectors split one person's shadow into multiple colored shadows.
works.technique_zh: 对多台投影机的几何和颜色进行标定，使重叠的光叠加为白色，这样身体的每一处遮挡都会显露出不同颜色的影子。
works.exercise_en: Shine three red, green and blue LED lights (or three phone flashlights with colored cellophane) at a white wall from different angles and let students make colored shadows with their bodies. Twist: program the lights to flash in turn with the music.

works.title: Future Gloss
works.description: Ines Alpha's first Snapchat lens: glossy, liquid 3D makeup that drips and flows over the user's face in real time.
works.idea_zh: 液态光泽的3D妆容在脸上实时流动，化妆不再受物理限制。

video.video_title: Future gloss by ines alpha

works.technique: A face mesh from face tracking drives 3D liquid geometry attached to facial landmarks, with glossy PBR materials and an environment map for reflections.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Lens Studio 或 Effect House 在脸上放一个跟随面部网格的 3D 液体造型，调出高光反射材质；变体：让液体随嘴巴张合流动。
works.description_zh: Ines Alpha 的第一个 Snapchat 镜头：光泽的液态 3D 妆容在用户脸上实时流淌。
works.idea_en: Glossy liquid 3D makeup flows over your face in real time, free from physical limits.
works.technique_zh: 人脸追踪得到的面部网格驱动附着在面部特征点上的 3D 液体几何体，配合有光泽的 PBR 材质和用于反射的环境贴图。
works.exercise_en: Use Lens Studio or Effect House to place a 3D liquid shape that follows the face mesh, and tune a glossy reflective material. Twist: make the liquid flow as the mouth opens and closes.

works.title: Future You
works.description: A motion-capture mirror that turns each viewer into a synthetic robotic figure; the harder you move, the stranger its 47,000 possible responses become.
works.idea_zh: 照见'未来的你'的动捕镜子，越动越奇异

video.video_title: Future You - Barbican, London

works.technique: A depth camera tracks the viewer's skeleton and a real-time engine retargets it to a generative robotic figure whose form parameters change with movement speed and energy.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe Pose 驱动一个由几何体拼成的“机器人分身”，动作越剧烈，分身的形态参数（尺寸、数量、颜色）越离谱；变体：让分身有一秒的“记忆”，逐渐把你过去的动作混进来。
works.description_zh: 一面动作捕捉镜子，把每位观众变成一个合成的机器人形象；你动得越用力，它在 47,000 种可能反应中呈现的样子就越怪异。
works.idea_en: A motion-capture mirror shows 'future you', and the more you move, the stranger it gets.
works.technique_zh: 深度相机追踪观众的骨骼，实时引擎把动作重定向到一个生成式机器人形象上，其形态参数随动作速度和能量变化。
works.exercise_en: Use MediaPipe Pose to drive a 'robot double' built from geometric shapes, whose form parameters (size, count, color) grow more outlandish the more intensely you move. Twist: give the double a one-second 'memory' that gradually mixes in your past movements.

works.title: GLADES
works.description: Visitors move in front of two displays: on one their body grows toxic blue algae on a virtual water surface, on the other an invasive python wraps around their silhouette, while a large projection shows an anhinga flying between them.
works.description_zh: 观众在两块屏幕前移动：一边他们的身体会在虚拟水面上长出有毒的蓝藻，另一边一条入侵的蟒蛇缠绕住他们的剪影，中间的大投影上一只蛇鹈在两者之间飞行、游动、降落。
works.idea_en: Your own silhouette becomes the source of ecological harm, so the message is felt, not read.
works.idea_zh: 你自己的剪影成了生态破坏的来源，信息不再是读到的，而是感受到的。
works.technique: Depth sensors track visitors' bodies without wearables, and openFrameworks (likely) simulates algae growth and a python rig that follows the silhouette.
works.technique_zh: 深度传感器在无需穿戴设备的情况下追踪观众身体，（很可能使用）openFrameworks 模拟蓝藻生长和一条跟随剪影的蟒蛇骨骼。
works.exercise_en: Use webcam body segmentation to make your silhouette leave a spreading 'pollution' trail on a projected pond, and a clean-up creature that follows others. Twist: the pond only recovers when everyone stands still.
works.exercise_zh: 用网络摄像头人体分割，让你的剪影在投影的池塘上留下不断扩散的“污染”痕迹，再加一只跟随其他人的清理生物；变体：只有所有人都静止不动时，池塘才会恢复。

video.video_title: GLADES

works.title: Grordbattle (multiplayer)
works.description: A co-located multiplayer Magic Leap duel from Weta Gameshop: players in the same real room see each other's avatars and trade ray-gun fire around the furniture.
works.idea_zh: 同一房间里多人戴Magic Leap用射线枪对战。

video.video_title: Hands-On with Magic Leap Multiplayer: Grordbattle!

works.technique: Co-located players share a common coordinate frame (shared spatial anchor or map), and each player's head and weapon poses are networked so avatars and shots line up with real bodies.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Unity Netcode 和图像标记对齐两台手机的坐标系，让两人在同一房间互射 AR 光球；变体：真实家具可以挡子弹。
works.description_zh: Weta Gameshop 打造的同空间多人 Magic Leap 对战：同一个真实房间里的玩家能看到彼此的虚拟形象，并绕着家具用射线枪互相开火。
works.idea_en: Several players in the same room wear Magic Leap and fight with ray guns.
works.technique_zh: 同处一室的玩家共享一个公共坐标系（共享空间锚点或地图），每位玩家的头部和武器姿态通过网络同步，使虚拟形象和射击与真实身体对齐。
works.exercise_en: Use Unity Netcode and an image marker to align two phones' coordinate systems so two people can shoot AR light balls at each other in the same room. Twist: real furniture blocks the shots.

works.title: Harry Potter: Wizards Unite
works.description: A location-based AR game with Warner Bros. where players trace spell glyphs on screen to free magical 'Foundables' that appear over the real world.
works.idea_zh: 在现实街道上画出咒语手势，解救散落在城市里的魔法物品。

video.video_title: Harry Potter: Wizards Unite | Gameplay Trailer

works.technique: Touch-path gesture recognition compares the traced stroke against template glyphs and scores accuracy and speed, with the encounter object overlaid on the camera view.
works.exercise_zh: 实现一个简单的手势路径识别（如 $1 Recognizer），画对符号时 AR 中的物体被释放；变体：让同学自己设计三种新符号及其效果。
works.description_zh: 与华纳兄弟合作的基于位置的 AR 游戏：玩家在屏幕上描画咒语符号，解救出现在现实世界中的魔法“Foundables”。
works.idea_en: Trace spell gestures on real streets to free magical objects scattered around the city.
works.technique_zh: 触摸路径手势识别把描画的笔迹与模板符号比对，给准确度和速度打分，遭遇到的物体叠加在相机画面上。
works.exercise_en: Implement simple gesture-path recognition (such as the $1 Recognizer) so that drawing the right symbol releases an object in AR. Twist: have students design three new symbols and their effects.

works.title: Hide yourself
works.description: An ARKit test with Molmol Kuo, made as ARKit 3 introduced people segmentation, playing with hiding a person inside the AR scene around them.
works.idea_zh: 用AR把人从画面里“藏起来”，让身体在真实场景中消失。

video.video_title: Hide yourself - arkit testing w @openMolmol_MPS https://t.co/8Xv2VdpD3h

works.technique: ARKit 3 people segmentation with depth produces a per-pixel human matte, which is used to occlude or replace the person with the reconstructed background behind them.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 的 Human Segmentation（或网页端 MediaPipe 分割）把画面里的人替换成先拍好的背景，做一个“隐身术”；变体：不是让人完全消失，而是只留下影子或衣服，讲一个关于存在感的短片。
works.description_zh: 与 Molmol Kuo 合作的一次 ARKit 实验，诞生于 ARKit 3 刚推出人像分割之时，尝试把人藏进周围的 AR 场景里。
works.idea_en: Use AR to hide a person from the frame, making the body vanish into the real scene.
works.technique_zh: ARKit 3 结合深度的人像分割生成逐像素的人体蒙版，用来遮挡人物，或用其身后重建的背景替换掉人物。
works.exercise_en: Use AR Foundation's Human Segmentation (or MediaPipe segmentation on the web) to replace people in the frame with a pre-shot background for an 'invisibility trick'. Twist: instead of making the person vanish completely, leave only their shadow or clothes, and tell a short story about presence.

works.title: Holoportation for ARCore with Multiple Azure Kinect
works.description: Several Azure Kinects capture a person as a live point cloud that is streamed into an ARCore phone as a life-size hologram.
works.idea_zh: 多台 Azure Kinect 实时捕捉真人点云，传送到手机 AR 里成为全息人。

video.video_title: Holoportation for ARCore with Multiple Azure Kinect

works.technique: Multiple calibrated Azure Kinect RGB-D streams are fused into a colored point cloud, streamed over the network, and rendered at life size at an ARCore anchor.
works.exercise_zh: 用 iPhone 的深度相机（Record3D 等）录一段人的 RGB-D 视频，转为点云在 AR 地面上以真人大小回放；变体：让点云随声音大小抖动或散开。
works.description_zh: 多台 Azure Kinect 把一个人捕捉成实时点云，串流到 ARCore 手机上，呈现为真人大小的全息影像。
works.idea_en: Several Azure Kinects capture a person's point cloud live and beam it into phone AR as a hologram.
works.technique_zh: 把多台经过标定的 Azure Kinect RGB-D 数据流融合成彩色点云，通过网络串流，并在 ARCore 锚点处以真人尺寸渲染。
works.exercise_en: Record an RGB-D video of a person with the iPhone depth camera (Record3D or similar), convert it to a point cloud, and replay it life-size on the floor in AR. Twist: make the point cloud shake or scatter with the loudness of sound.

works.title: Hybrid RTK GNSS and SLAM Outdoor AR
works.description: A wearable AR user walks a wide outdoor area and sees markers for assets given only by latitude and longitude, placed accurately over the real terrain.
works.description_zh: 佩戴 AR 设备的用户在大片户外区域行走，能看到仅以经纬度给出的目标标记精准地出现在真实地形上。
works.idea_en: Stitch small SLAM maps together with centimetre GPS to make city-scale AR.
works.idea_zh: 用厘米级 GPS 把一个个小 SLAM 地图缝合起来，实现城市尺度的 AR。
works.technique: Uses RTK GNSS positions to georegister and chain multiple local SLAM maps from the headset's tracker into one wide-area coordinate frame.
works.technique_zh: 利用 RTK GNSS 定位对头显追踪器生成的多个局部 SLAM 地图进行地理配准，并把它们串联成一个大范围坐标系。
works.exercise_en: Collect GPS coordinates of five spots around school with a phone, then place location-based AR markers at them and walk the route checking how far off each one appears. Twist: add a hidden treasure only visible within two metres.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机采集学校周围五个地点的 GPS 坐标，在这些位置放置基于位置的 AR 标记，沿路线走并检查每个标记偏差多少；变体：加一个只有走到两米内才看得见的隐藏宝物。

video.video_title: A Hybrid RTK GNSS and SLAM Outdoor Augmented Reality System

works.title: HyperCubes
works.description: Children arrange paper cubes printed with markers as coding blocks; the phone reads the sequence and an AR character executes it in space, teaching computational thinking.
works.idea_zh: 把纸方块排成一串就是'程序'，AR 角色按顺序执行。

video.video_title: HyperCubes: A Playful Introduction to Computational Thinking in Augmented Reality

works.technique: Paper cubes act as fiducial markers whose order and spatial arrangement are read as a sequence of instructions, and the result is animated in AR.
works.exercise_zh: 做一套纸质'代码积木'（前进/转弯/跳），用手机识别顺序并让 AR 机器人走迷宫；加一个变化：加入'循环'积木。
works.description_zh: 孩子们把印有标记的纸方块当作编程积木来排列，手机读取它们的顺序，AR 角色便在空间中执行这段程序，借此培养计算思维。
works.idea_en: Line up paper cubes to write a 'program', and an AR character carries it out in order.
works.technique_zh: 纸方块作为基准标记，其顺序和空间排列被读取为一串指令，执行结果以 AR 动画呈现。
works.exercise_en: Make a set of paper 'code blocks' (forward, turn, jump) and have a phone read their order so an AR robot walks through a maze. Twist: add a 'loop' block.

works.title: Interfaces by Morphosis AR app
works.description: The official AR app for Morphosis's Milan Design Week installation with Dassault Systèmes overlays animated architectural geometry and information on the physical installation.
works.idea_zh: 用 AR 给实体建筑装置叠加动态结构和设计信息。

video.video_title: Interfaces by Morphosis Demo Video

works.technique: Image or object tracking registers the phone to the installation so digital geometry and sound are aligned with the built structure (likely target-based).
works.exercise_zh: 给学校里一件雕塑或建筑模型做一个 AR 导览：扫一扫出现结构线和设计故事；加一个变化：可以'拆开'看内部结构。
works.description_zh: Morphosis 与 Dassault Systèmes 在米兰设计周装置的官方 AR 应用，在实体装置上叠加动态的建筑几何和信息。
works.idea_en: Overlay moving structure and design information on a physical architectural installation with AR.
works.technique_zh: 通过图像或物体追踪把手机与装置配准，使数字几何和声音与建成结构对齐（大概率基于目标识别）。
works.exercise_en: Make an AR guide for a sculpture or architectural model at school: scan it to reveal structural lines and the design story. Twist: let viewers 'take it apart' to see the inner structure.

works.title: Is that me? AR Mirror
works.description: People look into an AR mirror that shows a captured 3D version of their own body moving in real time, and researchers test whether they feel that reconstructed body is really theirs.
works.description_zh: 人们看向一面 AR 镜子，镜中显示的是自己身体实时捕捉的三维版本，研究者测试他们是否觉得这个重建的身体真的属于自己。
works.idea_en: An AR mirror can test how far your reflection can change before it stops being you.
works.idea_zh: AR 镜子可以测试：你的镜像改变到什么程度，就不再是“你”了。
works.technique: Captures the user with depth cameras into a live 3D representation and renders it in an AR mirror setup to measure ownership, agency and self-location.
works.technique_zh: 用深度相机把用户实时捕捉成三维形象，在 AR 镜子装置中渲染，以测量身体所有感、能动感和自我定位感。
works.exercise_en: Use a phone's front camera with a body-tracking effect as a mirror, gradually delaying or distorting the image, and ask classmates when it stops feeling like them. Twist: swap two students' bodies in the mirror.
works.exercise_zh: 把带人体追踪特效的手机前置摄像头当镜子，逐渐增加延迟或变形，问同学从什么时候开始觉得那不再是自己；变体：在镜子里交换两名学生的身体。

video.video_title: Is that me? - embodiment and body perception with an augmented reality mirror.

works.title: Journey of Colour
works.description: Visitors hold fabric and paint samples from the design center's showrooms up to a reader, and a long LED wall instantly washes into that exact color.
works.description_zh: 观众把设计中心各展厅的布料和油漆样品举到读取器前，一整面 LED 墙立即变成完全相同的颜色。
works.idea_en: Use a physical sample as a remote control for the color of a whole space.
works.idea_zh: 用一片实物样本，遥控整个空间的颜色。
works.technique: A camera reads the color of the held sample and maps it to the RGB output of the LEDs on the wall, with animated transitions.
works.technique_zh: 摄像头读取样本颜色，映射为墙上 LED 的 RGB 输出，并加入过渡动画。
works.exercise_en: Build a web page that samples the color of any object held in front of the phone camera and floods a projector or second screen with it. Twist: mix the colors of the last three objects into a gradient.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个网页，读取手机摄像头前任意物体的颜色，并让投影或第二块屏幕整个铺满这种颜色；变体：把最近三个物体的颜色混合成渐变。

video.video_title: Journey of Colour

works.title: LEGO Hidden Side
works.description: Physical LEGO sets such as a haunted school or graveyard are scanned by a phone app that reveals ghosts inside the model; players hunt them by moving around the build.
works.idea_zh: 拼好实体乐高，再用手机透视出藏在模型里的鬼魂。

video.video_title: LEGO Hidden Side Trailer | Comic-Con SD 2019

works.technique: The app recognizes the physical LEGO set (model or image-based tracking), and ghosts are rendered inside it with occlusion from a known digital model of the set.
works.exercise_zh: 用一个真实的纸盒模型和它的简化 3D 替身做遮挡，让 AR 幽灵躲在纸盒里的窗户后面；变体：打开真实盒子的某扇门会放出幽灵。
works.description_zh: 闹鬼的学校、墓地等实体乐高套装经手机应用扫描后，会显现出藏在模型里的鬼魂，玩家要绕着模型移动去搜寻它们。
works.idea_en: Build a physical LEGO set, then use a phone to see the ghosts hiding inside it.
works.technique_zh: 应用识别实体乐高套装（基于模型或图像追踪），并利用该套装已知的数字模型做遮挡，把鬼魂渲染在模型内部。
works.exercise_en: Use a real cardboard box model and a simplified 3D stand-in for occlusion so an AR ghost hides behind a window in the box. Twist: opening a door on the real box lets a ghost out.

works.title: Landmarkers
works.description: Lenses that recognise famous buildings such as the Eiffel Tower or Flatiron Building and transform their real facades with animation, e.g. making the structure melt or burst into rainbows.
works.idea_zh: 识别真实地标建筑，让整座埃菲尔铁塔在镜头里变形、融化、喷彩虹。

video.video_title: Introducing Landmarkers

works.technique: Landmark tracking matches the camera view to a prebuilt 3D model of a known building, so shaders and animations can be mapped precisely onto its real facade.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Lens Studio 的 Custom Landmarker 或图像追踪识别校园中一栋建筑立面，在它上面叠加融化或长草的动画；变体：让动画跟随真实时间变化。
works.description_zh: 这些镜头能识别埃菲尔铁塔、熨斗大厦等著名建筑，并用动画改造它们真实的立面，比如让建筑融化或迸发出彩虹。
works.idea_en: Recognize a real landmark and make the whole Eiffel Tower warp, melt or spray rainbows on camera.
works.technique_zh: 地标追踪把相机画面与已知建筑预先建好的 3D 模型匹配，从而把着色器和动画精确映射到其真实立面上。
works.exercise_en: Use Lens Studio's Custom Landmarker or image tracking to recognize a building facade on campus and overlay a melting or grass-growing animation on it. Twist: make the animation change with the real time of day.

works.title: LightAnchors
works.description: Blinking point lights on everyday devices broadcast data; a phone camera decodes them and anchors live AR labels on thermostats, routers and cars.
works.idea_zh: 让设备上的小指示灯'闪'出数据，手机一照就浮现实时标签。

video.video_title: LightAnchors: Appropriating Point Lights for Spatially-Anchored Augmented Reality Interfaces

works.technique: LEDs blink in a known preamble pattern at frequencies detectable by a phone camera, and the app finds bright points across frames, decodes the temporal pattern into data, and anchors labels at the light's image position.
works.exercise_zh: 让 Arduino 或另一部手机的屏幕闪烁编码（如 8 位 ID），用手机摄像头逐帧检测亮点并解码，在亮点位置显示对应的 AR 标签；变体：把闪烁的信息做成“秘密消息”，只有扫到的人才能看到。
works.description_zh: 日常设备上闪烁的点光源在广播数据；手机摄像头将其解码，并在恒温器、路由器和汽车上锚定实时 AR 标签。
works.idea_en: Let a device's tiny indicator light blink out data, and a live label pops up when a phone looks at it.
works.technique_zh: LED 以手机摄像头可检测的频率、按已知前导码模式闪烁；应用在多帧中寻找亮点，把时间上的闪烁模式解码为数据，并在光点的图像位置锚定标签。
works.exercise_en: Have an Arduino or another phone's screen blink an encoded signal (such as an 8-bit ID), detect and decode the bright spot frame by frame with the phone camera, and show the matching AR label at its position. Twist: turn the blinking data into a 'secret message' only those who scan it can see.

works.title: Lightform LF2 and Lightform Creator
works.description: The LF2 projector-camera and Creator software scan a scene of objects and let designers select surfaces and apply animated effects in minutes.
works.idea_zh: 扫描一下场景，就能给每个物体表面选特效。

video.video_title: Lightform LF2 and LFC | Design Tools for Projection

works.technique: Captures a high-resolution scan from the projector's viewpoint so every pixel of the scan corresponds to a projector pixel, removing manual calibration.
works.exercise_zh: 把几个白色纸盒堆在桌上，用投影仪+OBS/MapMap为每个面分配不同颜色动画；变化：挪动一个盒子后在1分钟内重新对齐。
works.description_zh: LF2 投影相机一体机配合 Creator 软件，可以扫描摆满物体的场景，让设计师在几分钟内选中表面并添加动画效果。
works.idea_en: Scan a scene once and pick an effect for every object surface.
works.technique_zh: 从投影机的视点采集高分辨率扫描，让扫描图的每个像素都对应一个投影像素，从而省去手动标定。
works.exercise_en: Stack a few white paper boxes on a table and use a projector with OBS/MapMap to give each face a different color animation. Twist: move one box and realign everything within one minute.

works.title: Loki
works.description: A bi-directional mixed-reality telepresence system where teacher and learner can each switch between video, 3D capture and virtual-replica views to demonstrate physical tasks.
works.idea_zh: 师生双向混合现实远程教学，可在视频、3D和虚拟复本间切换。

video.video_title: Loki: Facilitating Remote Instruction of Physical Tasks Using Two-way MixedReality Telepresence

works.technique: Streams RGB-D point clouds of both spaces and lets either user record, annotate and replay 3D demonstrations inside the other's environment.
works.exercise_zh: 搭建两间教室间的视频通话+手机AR远程折纸课：老师的手部动作录成短视频挂在学生AR桌面上；变化：学生也能回传自己的错误动作让老师标注。
works.description_zh: 一个双向的混合现实远程临场系统：老师和学习者都可以在视频、3D 捕捉和虚拟复本视图之间切换，用来演示实体操作任务。
works.idea_en: Two-way mixed-reality remote teaching that switches between video, 3D and virtual replicas.
works.technique_zh: 串流双方空间的 RGB-D 点云，任一用户都可以在对方的环境中录制、标注和回放 3D 演示。
works.exercise_en: Set up a remote origami class between two classrooms using a video call plus phone AR, where the teacher's hand movements are recorded as short clips pinned to the student's AR desk. Twist: students can send back their own mistakes for the teacher to annotate.

works.title: Manipulating 3D Anatomic Models in AR
works.description: A clinician whose hands are busy rotates and scales a 3D anatomy model in an AR headset using only head movement, compared with the usual hand-gesture approach.
works.description_zh: 双手正忙的临床医生仅靠头部动作，就能在 AR 头显中旋转和缩放三维解剖模型，研究将其与常规手势操作进行了比较。
works.idea_en: When your hands are busy, let your head drive the 3D model.
works.idea_zh: 双手没空的时候，就让头来操控三维模型。
works.technique: Maps head orientation and small head motions to rotation and scaling of a HoloLens hologram, with a hands-free mode switch.
works.technique_zh: 把头部朝向和细微的头部动作映射为 HoloLens 全息影像的旋转和缩放，并提供免手操作的模式切换。
works.exercise_en: Build a phone AR viewer where tilting the phone or your head rotates a 3D skull while you hold a pen in each hand, then time a labelling task. Twist: use voice to switch between rotate and zoom.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个手机 AR 查看器，双手各拿一支笔时，通过倾斜手机或头部来旋转一个三维头骨，并记录完成标注任务的时间；变体：用语音在旋转和缩放之间切换。

video.video_title: Manipulating 3D Anatomic Models in Augmented Reality

works.title: Minecraft Earth
works.description: Players collect blocks around their neighbourhood, build on tabletop 'build plates', then place builds at life size in the real world and play in them together.
works.idea_zh: 把我的世界的方块建筑以真实尺寸放在街头，大家一起进入。

video.video_title: Minecraft Earth: Apple WWDC Gameplay Reveal

works.technique: Build plates are authored at tabletop scale and rescaled to life size with the same anchor, while Azure Spatial Anchors let multiple players share the placement.
works.exercise_zh: 在桌上用 AR 方块搭一个小模型，一键放大到真实尺寸并走进去；变体：放大后另一位同学可以在同一位置看到它。
works.description_zh: 玩家在街区里收集方块，在桌面大小的“建造板”上搭建作品，再把它们以真实尺寸放到现实世界中，一起进去玩。
works.idea_en: Place Minecraft block builds life-size on the street and walk in together.
works.technique_zh: 建造板以桌面尺度制作，再沿用同一个锚点放大到真实尺寸；Azure Spatial Anchors 让多名玩家共享放置位置。
works.exercise_en: Build a small model from AR blocks on a table, then scale it to life size with one tap and walk inside. Twist: after scaling, another classmate can see it in the same spot.

works.title: Musical Chairs Against the Avengers in AR
works.description: A real game of musical chairs in which the other players are life-size virtual Avengers competing for real chairs.
works.idea_zh: 和真人尺寸的复仇者联盟一起抢真实的椅子。

video.video_title: I played musical chairs against the Avengers in AR

works.technique: Virtual characters are animated toward chair positions registered as anchors, with game logic comparing the player's camera position to those anchors when the music stops.
works.exercise_zh: 在房间里标记三把真椅子的位置，音乐停时让虚拟角色抢位，判断玩家（相机）是否先到达空椅；变体：把抢椅子改成抢一块真实的地毯或门口。
works.description_zh: 一场真实的抢椅子游戏，其他玩家是真人大小的虚拟复仇者，和你争抢真实的椅子。
works.idea_en: Fight life-size Avengers for real chairs.
works.technique_zh: 虚拟角色以动画方式跑向注册为锚点的椅子位置；音乐停止时，游戏逻辑比较玩家相机位置与这些锚点的关系。
works.exercise_en: Mark the positions of three real chairs in a room, have virtual characters race for seats when the music stops, and check whether the player (the camera) reaches an empty chair first. Twist: race for a real rug or doorway instead of chairs.

works.title: Night Terrors: Bloody Mary
works.description: A follow-up that brings the Bloody Mary legend into the player's home, with the ghost stalking them through the phone's AR view.
works.idea_zh: 把血腥玛丽传说带进你家，鬼魂在AR中跟踪你。

video.video_title: Night Terrors: Bloody Mary Mobile AR Horror Game Trailer

works.technique: ARKit or ARCore world tracking lets a ghost character move through room space relative to the player, with audio cues giving direction.
works.exercise_zh: 让一个 AR 角色在你背后移动，只能通过声音判断它的位置，转身时它躲到视野外；变体：用前置摄像头检测你是否在“镜子”前。
works.description_zh: 续作把“血腥玛丽”传说带进玩家家中，鬼魂通过手机的 AR 画面一路尾随玩家。
works.idea_en: Bring the Bloody Mary legend into your home, with a ghost stalking you in AR.
works.technique_zh: ARKit 或 ARCore 世界追踪让鬼魂角色在房间空间中相对玩家移动，并用声音提示指示方向。
works.exercise_en: Have an AR character move behind you so you can only locate it by sound, and make it hide out of view when you turn around. Twist: use the front camera to detect whether you are standing in front of a 'mirror'.

works.title: NightBloom at the Conservatory of Flowers
works.description: An immersive night event at San Francisco's Conservatory of Flowers where projections wash over living plants and glasshouse structures.
works.idea_zh: 把投影打在真实植物上，让温室在夜里“开花”。

video.video_title: NightBloom: Lightform at The Conservatory Of Flowers

works.technique: Uses scan-based alignment to project organic animated textures onto irregular foliage and architecture.
works.exercise_zh: 在教室里把投影打在一盆植物上，投射缓慢变化的色彩和光点；变化：用手机麦克风让植物上的光随说话声“呼吸”。
works.description_zh: 旧金山花卉温室举办的一场沉浸式夜间活动，投影光影流淌在活体植物和玻璃温室结构上。
works.idea_en: Project onto real plants so the greenhouse 'blooms' at night.
works.technique_zh: 利用基于扫描的对齐，把有机感的动画纹理投射到不规则的枝叶和建筑上。
works.exercise_en: Project slowly shifting colors and points of light onto a potted plant in the classroom. Twist: use the phone microphone so the light on the plant 'breathes' with people's voices.

works.title: Notable Women
works.description: With Google and former US Treasurer Rosie Rios, the app puts portraits of historic American women onto US banknotes in AR.
works.idea_zh: 用AR把杰出女性的头像印到美元上

video.video_title: Notable Women | Interactive AR | Nexus Studios

works.technique: ARCore augmented images detect banknote designs and replace the printed portrait region with a warped, lit portrait of a historic woman.
works.exercise_zh: 用图像追踪识别一张钞票或证件照，替换其中的头像为一位你认为值得纪念但被忽视的人；变体：配一段 15 秒语音讲述这个人为什么应该在这里。
works.description_zh: 这款应用由 Google 与前美国财政部司库 Rosie Rios 合作推出，用 AR 把美国历史上杰出女性的肖像放到美元钞票上。
works.idea_en: Use AR to print portraits of notable women onto US dollars.
works.technique_zh: ARCore 增强图像识别钞票图案，并用经过变形和打光处理的历史女性肖像替换原本印刷的肖像区域。
works.exercise_en: Use image tracking to recognize a banknote or ID photo and replace the portrait with someone you think deserves remembrance but has been overlooked. Twist: add a 15-second voice clip explaining why this person belongs there.

works.title: On the Shoulder of the Giant
works.description: The local AR user carries a miniature remote collaborator on their shoulder, who sees the world from that perspective and guides the work.
works.idea_zh: 把远方的同伴'放'在你肩膀上，和你同一视角一起干活。

video.video_title: On the Shoulder of the Giant: A Multi-Scale Mixed Reality Collaboration

works.technique: A miniature avatar of the remote collaborator is attached to the local user's tracked head or shoulder pose, and the remote viewpoint is rendered from that attached position so both share nearly the same perspective.
works.exercise_zh: 在 HoloKit 或手机 AR 中把一个小化身固定在屏幕左上方（模拟“肩膀上”），远端同学通过看你的摄像头画面给出指引，化身同步做出指向动作；变体：让肩膀上的化身是“过去的你”，播放你之前录下的提示。
works.description_zh: 本地 AR 用户的肩膀上“扛着”一个缩小版的远程协作者，对方从这个视角观察世界并指导工作。
works.idea_en: Put a distant partner on your shoulder so you work together from the same viewpoint.
works.technique_zh: 远程协作者的缩小化身附着在本地用户被追踪的头部或肩部姿态上，远端视角从这个附着位置渲染，使双方几乎共享同一视角。
works.exercise_en: Pin a small avatar to the top-left of the screen in HoloKit or phone AR (to mimic 'on the shoulder'), and have a remote classmate watch your camera feed and give directions while the avatar points along. Twist: make the shoulder avatar a 'past you' that plays back hints you recorded earlier.

works.title: Particles Face
works.description: The tracked face dissolves into a flowing compute-shader particle cloud.
works.idea_zh: 把追踪到的人脸分解成流动的粒子云。

video.video_title: Particles Face

works.technique: Face-mesh vertices are sampled as spawn points for a compute-shader particle system, and curl noise advects the particles away so the face appears to dissolve.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe Face Mesh 的顶点作为粒子发射点，在 three.js 中让粒子随噪声飘散；变体：张嘴时脸部整体消散，闭嘴时重新聚合。
works.description_zh: 被追踪的人脸消散成一团流动的计算着色器粒子云。
works.idea_en: Break a tracked face apart into a flowing cloud of particles.
works.technique_zh: 对人脸网格的顶点进行采样，作为计算着色器粒子系统的发射点，再用旋度噪声把粒子带走，让脸看起来在溶解。
works.exercise_en: Use MediaPipe Face Mesh vertices as particle emitters and let the particles drift away on noise in three.js. Twist: the whole face dissolves when the mouth opens and gathers again when it closes.

works.title: Pixelation with Human Segmentation
works.description: People are cut out of the scene with ARKit3 segmentation and re-rendered as moving pixel mosaics.
works.idea_zh: 把画面里的人抠出来，变成流动的像素马赛克。

video.video_title: Pixelation with Human Segmentation

works.technique: ARKit 3 person segmentation outputs a human stencil mask, and a shader pixelates only the masked region of the camera image.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe Selfie Segmentation 抠出人物，只对人物区域做马赛克像素化；变体：像素块大小随人离镜头的距离变化。
works.description_zh: 用 ARKit 3 的人像分割把人从场景中抠出来，再重新渲染成流动的像素马赛克。
works.idea_en: Cut people out of the frame and turn them into flowing pixel mosaics.
works.technique_zh: ARKit 3 人像分割输出人体模板蒙版，着色器只对相机画面中被蒙版覆盖的区域做像素化。
works.exercise_en: Cut out people with MediaPipe Selfie Segmentation and pixelate only the person region. Twist: the pixel block size changes with the person's distance from the camera.

works.title: Pokémon GO Snapshot
works.description: An AR photo mode where players place their Pokémon in the real world, approach and pose it, and take pictures; wild Pokémon sometimes photobomb the shot.
works.idea_zh: 在现实中给宝可梦拍写真，偶尔还会有野生宝可梦乱入。

video.video_title: Snap the perfect picture with Pokémon GO!

works.technique: A character is placed on a detected plane, and a photo mode lets the user move closer and frame the shot, with scripted random events adding a second character.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个 AR 拍照模式，拍照时有 20% 的概率冒出一个“乱入者”；变体：乱入者会根据画面中是否有人脸做出不同动作。
works.description_zh: 一个 AR 拍照模式：玩家把自己的宝可梦放到现实世界里，走近、摆好姿势再拍照，野生宝可梦有时还会突然乱入画面。
works.idea_en: Take photos of your Pokémon in the real world, with the odd wild Pokémon photobombing.
works.technique_zh: 角色被放置在检测到的平面上，拍照模式让用户靠近并构图，脚本化的随机事件会加入第二个角色。
works.exercise_en: Build an AR photo mode where a 'photobomber' has a 20% chance of popping up when a picture is taken. Twist: the photobomber acts differently depending on whether a face is in the frame.

works.title: Preemptive Action
works.description: Electrical muscle stimulation fires the user's arm a few milliseconds before they would react to a stimulus, speeding reaction time while the user still feels they moved by themselves.
works.idea_zh: 电刺激在你反应之前替你动手，但你仍觉得是自己动的。

video.video_title: Preemptive Action : Accelerating Human Reaction using Electrical Muscle Stimulation Without Compromising Agency

works.technique: Triggers EMS at a tuned latency just before the user's natural reaction, finding the window where the action is faster yet still judged as self-caused.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机做一个“看到信号就拍桌”的反应小游戏，并让同伴在你身后用轻拍肩膀提前提示；变化：比较提示和不提示时你是否觉得“是自己做的”。
works.description_zh: 肌肉电刺激在用户对刺激做出反应前几毫秒驱动其手臂，缩短反应时间，而用户仍觉得是自己在动。
works.idea_en: Electrical stimulation moves your hand before you react, yet you still feel you did it yourself.
works.technique_zh: 在用户自然反应之前以调校好的延迟触发 EMS，寻找一个动作更快、却仍被判定为自己发起的时间窗口。
works.exercise_en: Make a phone reaction game where you slap the table when a signal appears, and have a partner behind you give an early cue by tapping your shoulder. Twist: compare whether you feel 'I did it' with and without the cue.

works.title: Project Play (Magic Leap)
works.description: A throwback to his Magic Leap app where you could draw, animate and even program objects directly in mixed reality.
works.idea_zh: 在头显里直接画、做动画、甚至编程。

video.video_title: Throwback to my Magic Leap app “Project Play“ where you could draw, animate, and program anything! Eventually DoodleLens will include these concepts, just in a much easier way https://t.co/KCIDN7Q9I5

works.technique: Controller-driven 3D drawing strokes become objects that can be keyframed and given simple behaviors in Unity on Magic Leap.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Quest/手机 AR 画 3D 线条，再给线条加一个'跟随我'的行为；加一个变化：两条线相碰时发声。
works.description_zh: 回顾他当年的 Magic Leap 应用：你可以直接在混合现实中绘画、制作动画，甚至给物体编程。
works.idea_en: Draw, animate and even program directly inside a headset.
works.technique_zh: 在 Magic Leap 上的 Unity 中，用手柄画出的 3D 笔画变成物体，可以设置关键帧并赋予简单的行为。
works.exercise_en: Draw 3D lines in Quest or phone AR, then give a line a 'follow me' behavior. Twist: play a sound when two lines touch.

works.title: Pull a 3D model out of the monitor like a drawer
works.description: While modeling on a desktop editor, he reaches toward the monitor and slides the 3D model out as if opening a drawer, so it lands at full size on the real desk for review.
works.description_zh: 在桌面 3D 软件里建模时，他把手伸向显示器，像拉开抽屉一样把模型拉出来，模型以真实尺寸落在桌面上供查看。
works.idea_en: A monitor is a drawer: pull to take the 3D model out into the world, push to put it back.
works.idea_zh: 显示器就是抽屉：拉一下把 3D 模型拿到现实中，推一下再放回去。
works.technique: The monitor's position is calibrated in passthrough AR, the editor's current mesh is mirrored into Unity, and a hand-tracked pull along the screen normal drives the drawer motion (likely a constrained slider joint).
works.technique_zh: 在透视 AR 中标定显示器的位置，把编辑器里的当前网格同步到 Unity，手沿屏幕法线方向的拉动驱动抽屉式运动（可能用了受约束的滑动关节）。
works.exercise_en: Prototype a phone-AR 'drawer' on a laptop: detect the screen with an image marker and let a swipe toward the camera slide a 3D object out onto the table. Twist: the object keeps the scale it had on screen until you let go.
works.exercise_zh: 在笔记本电脑上做一个手机 AR“抽屉”：用图像标记识别屏幕，朝镜头方向滑动就把 3D 物体拉到桌面上。变体：松手前物体保持屏幕上的尺寸，松手后才变成真实大小。

video.video_title: Pulling a 3D model from an editor display(e.g. Maya, C4D) to a real-world environment, as if the screen is a drawer. Fun and useful for industrial designers, 3D artists, and architects to quickly view

works.title: Pull a sticky note out of an iPad
works.description: He sketches a sticky note on an iPad, then pinches its edge and pulls it out of the screen into the room, where it springs free like a note slipped out of a book; a six-year-old understood it at once.
works.description_zh: 他在 iPad 上画一张便签，然后捏住边缘把它从屏幕里拉出来放进房间，便签像从书页里抽出的纸条一样带着弹性脱离；一个六岁的孩子也一看就会。
works.idea_en: The tablet screen becomes a book you can pull pages out of, bridging 2D creation and 3D placement.
works.idea_zh: 把平板屏幕当成一本书，可以把画好的页面直接抽出来放进空间，连接 2D 创作和 3D 摆放。
works.technique: Passthrough AR (ZED Mini on a Rift) plus Leap Motion hand tracking; the iPad's drawing is streamed to Unity and a spring joint animates the note as it leaves the registered screen plane.
works.technique_zh: 用 ZED Mini 加 Rift 实现透视 AR，Leap Motion 追踪手势；iPad 上的画面同步到 Unity，便签离开已标定的屏幕平面时由弹簧关节驱动动画。
works.exercise_en: Build a WebAR page where a doodle drawn on the phone screen can be flicked up to become a note pinned in the room. Twist: notes stick only to vertical surfaces and fall off horizontal ones.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个 WebAR 页面：在手机屏幕上画的涂鸦，往上一划就变成钉在房间里的便签。变体：便签只能贴在竖直表面，放在水平面上会掉下来。

video.video_title: Draw a sticky note on an iPad and then pull it out into the AR world. I added little spring force and try to make the transition feel like pulling a physical note out of a book. Tested on a 6-year-old

works.title: Rcam at Channel #20 (live with umio)
works.description: A depth camera on stage streams a volumetric point cloud of the performer into Unity, where VFX Graph particles dissolve and rebuild her body in real time for a live concert.
works.idea_zh: 把舞台上的人实时扫成点云，再让粒子把人拆散、重组，成为现场演出的视觉。

video.video_title: Live performance with umio at Channel 20, Compilation of social media video posts

works.technique: A RealSense depth camera sends color+depth frames to Unity, which converts them into a point cloud that drives VFX Graph particles projected behind the performer.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Kinect/手机深度或 MediaPipe 人体分割把一位同学变成粒子剪影投影在墙上；加一个变化：音乐音量越大粒子越散。
works.description_zh: 舞台上的深度相机把表演者的体积点云串流进 Unity，VFX Graph 粒子在现场演唱会中实时将她的身体拆散又重建。
works.idea_en: Scan a performer into a live point cloud, then let particles tear the body apart and rebuild it as concert visuals.
