works.technique_zh: RealSense 深度相机把彩色和深度帧发送给 Unity，转换成点云，驱动投影在表演者身后的 VFX Graph 粒子。
works.exercise_en: Use Kinect, phone depth or MediaPipe body segmentation to turn a classmate into a particle silhouette projected on the wall. Twist: the louder the music, the more the particles scatter.

works.title: Real Life Doodles (Creator Cam)
works.description: An AR app built in a week-long devlog that turns flat doodles into objects living in the real world.
works.idea_zh: 把随手涂鸦变成真实空间里的 AR 物体。

video.video_title: Augmented Reality Devlog #2 | Real Life Doodles

works.technique: A photographed doodle is segmented from the white paper (thresholding or background removal) and applied as a cutout texture to a billboard or extruded mesh placed with plane detection.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机拍一张纸上涂鸦，去白底后作为贴图放到桌面上并让它轻轻弹跳；变体：给涂鸦加一个简单骨骼让它走路。
works.description_zh: 一个在为期一周的开发日志中做出来的 AR 应用，把平面涂鸦变成生活在真实世界里的物体。
works.idea_en: Turn quick doodles into AR objects in real space.
works.technique_zh: 把拍下的涂鸦从白纸背景中分割出来（阈值处理或去背景），作为镂空纹理贴到公告板或挤出网格上，再通过平面检测放置。
works.exercise_en: Photograph a doodle on paper with a phone, remove the white background, place it on a tabletop as a texture and make it bounce gently. Twist: give the doodle a simple skeleton so it can walk.

works.title: Revolutions / Margin of Error (Desert X)
works.description: Geolocated AR sculptures in the Coachella Valley desert for Desert X, including a writhing mass of drawn lines rising over a landfill site.
works.idea_zh: 沙漠中缠绕升起的巨型AR线条雕塑

video.video_title: Desert X Biennial 2019: Nancy Baker Cahill

works.technique: GPS-anchored animated line sculptures are placed at specific desert sites, with site choice (a landfill) carrying the meaning; local plane detection fixes the base on the ground.
works.exercise_zh: 找一个你认为“被忽视”的校园角落（垃圾站、配电房），用 AR 在上方放一团扭动升起的线条；变体：线条的颜色和扭动幅度由该地点的实时噪声或温度驱动。
works.description_zh: 为 Desert X 创作、放置在科切拉谷沙漠中的地理定位 AR 雕塑，其中包括一团在垃圾填埋场上空扭动升起的手绘线条。
works.idea_en: A giant AR sculpture of tangled lines rising over the desert.
works.technique_zh: 以 GPS 锚定的动画线条雕塑被放置在特定的沙漠地点，选址本身（一处垃圾填埋场）承载意义；局部平面检测把底座固定在地面上。
works.exercise_en: Find a campus corner you think is overlooked (a trash station, a power room) and use AR to place a writhing, rising mass of lines above it. Twist: drive the lines' color and motion with the spot's live noise level or temperature.

works.title: Scent Memo
works.description: Pointing a phone at a keepsake shows photos and memories linked to it, while a connected scent diffuser next to it releases a matching smell.
works.description_zh: 用手机对准一件纪念物，就会显示与它相关的照片和回忆，同时旁边联网的香氛机释放出相应的气味。
works.idea_en: Objects become keys that unlock memories through images and smell.
works.idea_zh: 物件变成钥匙，通过图像和气味打开回忆。
works.technique: Likely object or image recognition in a phone app that looks up linked media and signals a networked diffuser to release a stored scent.
works.technique_zh: 很可能是手机应用识别物体或图像，调出关联的媒体，并通知联网香氛机释放预设的气味。
works.exercise_en: Tag three personal objects with image markers and make each one open a photo memory in phone AR. Twist: add a sound or smell cue that plays before the image appears.
works.exercise_zh: 给三件个人物品贴上图像标记，让每件在手机 AR 中打开一段照片回忆。变体：在图像出现之前先播放一段声音或气味提示。

video.video_title: Scent Memo

works.title: Slurp in AR
works.description: Inspired by the MIT Media Lab's 'Slurp' eyedropper, a hand-held virtual dropper sucks up a distant piece of content and squeezes it out somewhere else; he later revisited the idea in the DIS 2022 paper '"Slurp" Revisited'.
works.description_zh: 受 MIT Media Lab 的“Slurp”滴管启发，手中的虚拟滴管可以把远处的内容吸进来，再挤到别处；之后他在 DIS 2022 论文《“Slurp” Revisited》中重新研究了这个想法。
works.idea_en: Move digital content between places with a single squeeze-and-release gesture, even when it is far away.
works.idea_zh: 用一次“挤压—松开”的手势在不同位置之间搬运数字内容，即使内容离得很远。
works.technique: Leap Motion hand tracking drives a virtual dropper; a pinch while pointing at an object 'slurps' it into the bulb, and releasing over a target plays the reverse animation.
works.technique_zh: Leap Motion 手势追踪驱动一个虚拟滴管；指向物体时捏合就把它“吸”进滴管，在目标上方松开则播放反向动画。
works.exercise_en: Build a two-step phone-AR interaction: tap to suck a virtual object into a cursor, walk elsewhere, tap to squirt it out. Twist: the dropper can only hold one thing, so picking up a second swaps them.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个两步的手机 AR 交互：点一下把虚拟物体吸进光标，走到别处再点一下挤出来。变体：滴管一次只能装一个东西，吸第二个时会和第一个交换。

video.video_title: This concept is inspired by an old project from MIT @medialab "Slurp", slurping virtual contents from place to place, even the contents that are far away. There would be many interesting possibilities

works.title: Spark AR world effects
works.description: Marc Wakefield turns his drawn and painted characters and worlds into Instagram world effects that place them into the user's surroundings, including effects for U2.
works.idea_zh: 把手绘角色和奇幻世界变成可以放进现实的Instagram AR效果。

video.video_title: Marc Wakefield uses Spark AR Studio to create new worlds

works.technique: Hand-drawn 2D artwork is placed as billboards or layered planes in world space via plane tracking, preserving the illustration style in 3D.
works.exercise_zh: 把自己的手绘角色分成前、中、后三层平面，放进 AR 形成有视差的纸片剧场；变体：绕着它走时，角色永远转身面对你。
works.description_zh: Marc Wakefield 把自己手绘和彩绘的角色与世界做成 Instagram 世界特效，放进用户的周围环境中，其中也包括为 U2 制作的特效。
works.idea_en: Turn hand-drawn characters and fantasy worlds into Instagram AR effects you can drop into reality.
works.technique_zh: 借助平面追踪，把手绘二维作品以公告板或分层平面的形式放进世界空间，在三维中保留插画风格。
works.exercise_en: Split your own hand-drawn character into front, middle and back layers and place them in AR as a paper theater with parallax. Twist: as you walk around it, the character always turns to face you.

works.title: Spy Car (AR object recognition demo)
works.description: Pointing an Android phone at a toy spy car recognizes the physical object and layers labels, gadget descriptions and animations onto its real body.
works.description_zh: 把 Android 手机对准一辆玩具特工车，应用识别出这件实物，并在车身上叠加标注、装备说明和动画。
works.idea_en: A toy becomes its own interactive manual once the camera recognizes its 3D shape.
works.idea_zh: 摄像头一旦认出玩具的立体形状，玩具就变成了自己的互动说明书。
works.technique: Vuforia or VisionLib model-target tracking matches the toy against its 3D model, so annotations stay registered to the object as it is turned.
works.technique_zh: 用 Vuforia 或 VisionLib 的模型目标追踪，把玩具与其 3D 模型匹配，使标注在物体转动时依然贴合。
works.exercise_en: Scan a small physical object as an object target and attach three tappable hotspots that explain its hidden parts. Twist: reveal an animated X-ray view of the inside when the object is turned upside down.
works.exercise_zh: 把一个小实物扫描成物体识别目标，给它加上三个可点击的热点，解释其内部的隐藏部件。变体：当物体被倒过来时，显示内部结构的动画透视图。

video.video_title: Unity: Spy car (AR mode demo)

works.title: Star Wars: Project Porg
works.description: Adopt porgs that waddle around your real home, recognise surfaces and play fetch with you on Magic Leap.
works.idea_zh: 把星战里的Porg当宠物养在家里。

video.video_title: Project Porg  Bring Porgs Home in ILMxLAB's Latest Experiment!

works.technique: Character behaviour trees query the room mesh for walkable surfaces and toys so the pets navigate and play in the real space.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机AR做一个会在桌面上跟随手机移动、捡球的小宠物（导航网格或简单跟随脚本）；变化：宠物会记住你上次放玩具的位置。
works.description_zh: 在 Magic Leap 上领养 Porg，它们会在你真实的家里摇摇摆摆地走来走去，认得各种表面，还会陪你玩捡球。
works.idea_en: Keep a Star Wars porg as a pet at home.
works.technique_zh: 角色行为树查询房间网格中可行走的表面和玩具，让宠物在真实空间中导航和玩耍。
works.exercise_en: Make a small phone AR pet that follows the phone across a tabletop and fetches a ball (using a navmesh or a simple follow script). Twist: the pet remembers where you last put a toy.

works.title: Streaming Holograms to ARCore via YouTube
works.description: Encodes RGB-D point clouds into an ordinary YouTube live stream so anyone's phone can decode and view them as AR holograms (the basis of HoloTuberKit).
works.idea_zh: 把全息点云编码进普通 YouTube 直播，用手机解码成 AR 全息影像。

video.video_title: Streaming Hologram to ARCore Device via YouTube

works.technique: Depth and color are packed side by side into a regular video frame, streamed via YouTube Live, and a client shader decodes depth per pixel to rebuild a point cloud in AR.
works.exercise_zh: 把一段 RGB 和深度拼接成左右并排的视频，在 three.js 中用着色器把深度还原成点云并放到 WebXR 场景中；变体：尝试不同深度编码方式，比较压缩后的噪点。
works.description_zh: 把 RGB-D 点云编码进普通的 YouTube 直播，任何人的手机都能解码并以 AR 全息影像观看（这是 HoloTuberKit 的基础）。
works.idea_en: Encode hologram point clouds into an ordinary YouTube live stream and decode them into AR holograms on a phone.
works.technique_zh: 深度和颜色左右并排打包进普通视频帧，通过 YouTube Live 串流，客户端着色器逐像素解码深度，在 AR 中重建点云。
works.exercise_en: Combine RGB and depth into a side-by-side video, use a shader in three.js to rebuild the depth as a point cloud, and place it in a WebXR scene. Twist: try different depth encodings and compare the noise after compression.

works.title: Superman vs Giant
works.description: A multi-scale MR telepresence interface where the remote user can fly like Superman through a reconstructed space or tower over it as a giant.
works.idea_zh: 远程协作者可以像超人一样飞行穿越空间，或以巨人身份俯视。

video.video_title: Superman vs Giant: A Multi-Scale Mixed Reality Flying Telepresence Interface

works.technique: The remote user can change their viewpoint scale and fly freely through a 3D reconstruction, and their avatar is rendered to the local AR user at the corresponding scale and position within the shared coordinate frame.
works.exercise_zh: 在 Unity 中给 VR/桌面一方做“巨人”和“飞行”两种视角模式，AR 一方看到对方以巨型头像或小飞人形式出现，双方合作完成一次摆放任务；变体：比较哪种尺度最适合给指令。
works.description_zh: 一个多尺度的 MR 远程临场界面：远程用户可以像超人一样在重建的空间中飞行，也可以化身巨人俯瞰整个空间。
works.idea_en: A remote collaborator can fly through the space like Superman or look down on it as a giant.
works.technique_zh: 远程用户可以改变视点尺度，在 3D 重建中自由飞行；其化身在共享坐标系中以对应的尺度和位置呈现给本地 AR 用户。
works.exercise_en: In Unity, give the VR/desktop side two view modes, 'giant' and 'flying', while the AR side sees the partner as a giant head or a tiny flyer, and have both sides complete a placement task together. Twist: compare which scale works best for giving instructions.

works.title: Tangible UI: hand tracking on flat surfaces
works.description: Using early Quest hand tracking, any real table becomes a giant touch screen: virtual buttons and sliders are laid flat on the desk and pressed with your fingers.
works.idea_zh: 用手部追踪把任意真实桌面变成巨大的触摸屏。

video.video_title: Tangible UI in Oculus Quest - Hand tracking on flat surfaces (with Music)

works.technique: A table plane is calibrated, and fingertip positions from hand tracking are tested against virtual buttons laid flat on it, with a small distance threshold standing in for a touch event.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe Hands 加桌面平面检测，把一组虚拟滑块贴在桌面上，用手指距离桌面的高度判断是否按下；变体：让不同手指控制不同功能。
works.description_zh: 借助早期 Quest 的手部追踪，任何一张真实的桌子都能变成巨大的触摸屏：虚拟按钮和滑块平铺在桌面上，用手指就能按。
works.idea_en: Use hand tracking to turn any real tabletop into a giant touch screen.
works.technique_zh: 先标定桌面平面，再用手部追踪得到的指尖位置与平铺在桌面上的虚拟按钮做检测，以一个很小的距离阈值代替触摸事件。
works.exercise_en: Combine MediaPipe Hands with tabletop plane detection to lay a set of virtual sliders on the desk, using the finger's height above the surface to decide whether it is pressed. Twist: let different fingers control different functions.

works.title: The Deep Listener
works.description: A location-based AR and sound walk through Kensington Gardens and Hyde Park in which five of London's species — plane trees, bats, parakeets, damselflies and reedbeds — appear as scanned, sonified creatures at their habitats.
works.idea_zh: 在公园里用AR“听见”五种城市物种的生命
works.technique: GPS-triggered AR places photogrammetry-scanned, game-engine-rendered species at specific park locations, paired with spatialised field recordings.
works.exercise_zh: 选校园里3种植物或动物，录下它们周边的声音并用AR在原地放置放大的模型；变化：只有安静站立10秒才会出现声音。

video.video_title: Jakob Kudsk Steensen: The Deep Listener | Serpentine Digital Commissions

works.description_zh: 一次穿行于肯辛顿花园和海德公园的基于位置的 AR 声音漫步：伦敦的五种物种——悬铃木、蝙蝠、长尾鹦鹉、豆娘和芦苇丛——以扫描建模、声音化的生物形态出现在各自的栖息地。
works.idea_en: Use AR in a park to 'hear' the lives of five urban species.
works.technique_zh: 由 GPS 触发的 AR 把经过摄影测量扫描、用游戏引擎渲染的物种放置在公园的特定位置，并搭配空间化的野外录音。
works.exercise_en: Pick three plants or animals on campus, record the sounds around them, and use AR to place enlarged models on the spot. Twist: the sound appears only after you stand still and quiet for 10 seconds.

works.title: The Life
works.description: The first mixed-reality performance artwork: a 19-minute volumetric capture of Abramović appears in the room through an MR headset, walking within a marked circle.
works.idea_zh: 通过MR头显，艺术家的全息分身在你面前表演

video.video_title: Marina Abramović’s 'The Life' — The World’s First Mixed Reality Performance Artwork | Christie's

works.technique: Volumetric capture of the performer (multi-camera studio) is played back as a 3D video mesh in a Magic Leap headset, anchored inside a physical circle so viewers walk around her.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机 LiDAR 扫描或多视角视频录一段同学的 1 分钟静默表演，在 AR 中放入地上画好的圆圈里供人绕行观看；变体：观众进入圆圈时表演者停下并“注视”他们。
works.description_zh: 首件混合现实表演艺术作品：一段 19 分钟的 Abramović 体积捕捉影像通过 MR 头显出现在房间里，她在一个标记好的圆圈内行走。
works.idea_en: Through an MR headset, the artist's holographic double performs in front of you.
works.technique_zh: 表演者的体积捕捉（多相机摄影棚）在 Magic Leap 头显中以 3D 视频网格回放，并锚定在一个实体圆圈内，观众可以绕着她走动。
works.exercise_en: Capture a classmate's one-minute silent performance with a phone LiDAR scan or multi-angle video, and place it in AR inside a circle drawn on the floor for people to walk around. Twist: when a viewer steps into the circle, the performer stops and 'looks' at them.

works.title: Tilt Five Holographic Game System
works.description: The Tilt Five Kickstarter: lightweight glasses and a retro-reflective game board plus a wand controller, so friends around a table share holographic board and video games.
works.idea_zh: 一块反光游戏板和一副眼镜，让朋友们围桌共享全息桌游。

video.video_title: Tilt Five Holographic Game System- Now on Kickstarter

works.technique: Glasses project stereo images onto a retro-reflective board and track head pose against it, while a tracked wand gives a ray for pointing at tabletop content.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中把一张图像标记当成游戏棋盘，用手机射线（从屏幕中心发出）选择棋子并移动；变体：棋子可以“站起来”超出棋盘高度。
works.description_zh: Tilt Five 的 Kickstarter 项目：一副轻便眼镜、一块回射式游戏板再加一根魔杖手柄，让围坐在桌边的朋友共享全息桌游和电子游戏。
works.idea_en: A reflective game board and a pair of glasses let friends share holographic board games around a table.
works.technique_zh: 眼镜把立体图像投射到回射式游戏板上，并以游戏板为参照追踪头部姿态；被追踪的魔杖则发出一条射线，用来指向桌面上的内容。
works.exercise_en: Use an image marker as a game board in AR and select and move pieces with a ray cast from the center of the phone screen. Twist: pieces can 'stand up' taller than the board.

works.title: TrackCap
works.description: A small cap with a marker on the headset lets an ordinary smartphone track itself relative to the head, turning the phone into a precise 6DoF controller and second screen for mobile headsets.
works.description_zh: 在头显上加一个带标记的小帽子，普通智能手机就能相对头部追踪自身位置，变成移动头显的高精度六自由度控制器和第二块屏幕。
works.idea_en: Flip the tracking: the phone watches the headset, not the other way round.
works.idea_zh: 反转追踪关系：由手机看头显，而不是头显看手机。
works.technique: The phone's camera tracks a marker cap mounted on the HMD, and the inverse pose gives the phone's 6DoF position in the headset's frame, even outside the headset's field of view.
works.technique_zh: 手机摄像头追踪装在头显上的标记帽，反算位姿即得到手机在头显坐标系中的六自由度位置，即使手机在头显视野外也能工作。
works.exercise_en: Tape a printed marker to a cardboard viewer and use a second phone's image tracking to follow it, then use that phone as a pointer in a shared scene. Twist: turn the second phone's screen into a paint palette.
works.exercise_zh: 把打印好的标记贴在纸盒眼镜上，用第二部手机的图像追踪跟随它，再把这部手机当作共享场景里的指针；变体：把第二部手机的屏幕变成调色板。

video.video_title: TrackCap: Enabling Smartphones for 3D Interaction on Mobile Head-Mounted Displays

works.title: TutoriVR
works.description: While painting in Tilt Brush, a learner opens a tutorial video that lives inside VR, with the teacher's controllers and brush strokes replayed in 3D next to their own canvas.
works.description_zh: 学习者在 Tilt Brush 里作画时，可以在 VR 中打开教程视频，老师的手柄动作和笔触会以三维形式在自己的画布旁回放。
works.idea_en: A tutorial should live in the same space as the work, not on a flat screen outside it.
works.idea_zh: 教程应该和作品待在同一个空间里，而不是在外面的平面屏幕上。
works.technique: Pairs a recorded 360 video tutorial with logged controller poses and tool states, so steps can be replayed as spatial ghosts and navigated by timeline.
works.technique_zh: 把录制好的 360 度视频教程与记录的手柄位姿和工具状态结合，让每一步都能以空间“幽灵”形式重放，并可按时间轴跳转。
works.exercise_en: Record a short origami or LEGO build with a phone, then place the video as a floating AR panel beside the real workspace and compare with watching on a laptop. Twist: add 3D arrows at the moments hands move out of frame.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机录一段折纸或拼乐高的过程，把视频作为悬浮 AR 面板放在真实工作台旁边，与在笔记本电脑上看教程作对比；变体：在手部移出画面的时刻加上三维箭头。

video.video_title: TutoriVR: A Video-Based Tutorial System for Design Applications in Virtual Reality

works.title: Undersea
works.description: A living coral reef appears in your room; fish swim around your furniture and respond as you reach toward them with your hands.
works.idea_zh: 把一片会回应你手的珊瑚礁搬进房间。

video.video_title: Undersea: An Underwater Deep Sea Magic Leap AR Experience

works.technique: Places a reef ecosystem on meshed surfaces and uses hand tracking to trigger flocking-avoidance behaviours in the fish.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机AR在地板放一片虚拟珊瑚和鱼群，鱼群会躲避手机靠近（距离检测）；变化：用手机手电筒光照吸引鱼群聚集。
works.description_zh: 一片活生生的珊瑚礁出现在你的房间里，鱼群绕着家具游动，你伸手靠近时它们会做出反应。
works.idea_en: Bring a coral reef that responds to your hands into your room.
works.technique_zh: 把珊瑚礁生态放置在经过网格化的表面上，并利用手部追踪触发鱼群的集群避让行为。
works.exercise_en: Place virtual coral and a school of fish on the floor in phone AR, with the fish swimming away as the phone approaches (distance check). Twist: use the phone flashlight to draw the fish together.

works.title: Varifocal Occlusion
works.description: An optical see-through HMD whose occlusion mask can be moved in focal depth, so real objects are blocked correctly whether they are near or far.
works.idea_zh: 遮挡层可以前后对焦，远近的现实都能被正确遮住。

video.video_title: Varifocal Occlusion for Optical See-Through Head-Mounted Displays  (IEEE VR 2019)

works.technique: Slides the occlusion SLM along the optical axis so the mask's focal plane matches the depth of the real object being blocked.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机相机拍摄近处与远处两个物体，分别在对焦于近/远时叠加虚拟遮挡片，讨论为何会模糊；变化：用手动对焦App演示焦平面变化。
works.description_zh: 一种光学透视式头显，其遮挡蒙版可以沿焦深前后移动，无论真实物体在近处还是远处，都能被正确遮住。
works.idea_en: An occlusion layer that refocuses near and far, so real objects at any distance are blocked correctly.
works.technique_zh: 沿光轴滑动用于遮挡的空间光调制器（SLM），使蒙版的焦平面与被遮挡真实物体的深度一致。
works.exercise_en: Photograph a near object and a far object with a phone camera, overlay a virtual occluder while focused on each, and discuss why it blurs. Twist: use a manual-focus app to show the focal plane shifting.

works.title: Virtual Drumpad on iOS
works.description: Tapping fingers in the air in front of the phone triggers drum pads that appear over the camera view.
works.idea_zh: 对着空气敲，手机里就响起鼓点。

video.video_title: Virtual Drumpad running on iOS

works.technique: Fingertip tracking detects downward strikes into on-screen pad regions and triggers low-latency audio samples.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe Hands + 网页音频做空气鼓：指尖进入某个方块就发声；加一个变化：鼓垫会跟着真实桌面边缘排布。
works.description_zh: 在手机前方的空中敲击手指，就能触发浮现在相机画面上的鼓垫。
works.idea_en: Tap on thin air and the phone plays a drum beat.
works.technique_zh: 指尖追踪检测手指向下击入屏幕上鼓垫区域的动作，并触发低延迟的音频采样。
works.exercise_en: Build air drums with MediaPipe Hands and Web Audio, where a fingertip entering a square plays a sound. Twist: lay out the drum pads along the edge of the real table.

works.title: Visual Noise Reduction HMD
works.description: Like noise-cancelling headphones for the eyes: a video see-through headset greys out and blurs moving distractions around your work area so you can concentrate.
works.description_zh: 就像给眼睛用的降噪耳机：视频透视头显把工作区域周围移动的干扰变灰、变模糊，让你更专注。
works.idea_en: Apply noise cancellation to vision instead of sound.
works.idea_zh: 把降噪用在视觉上，而不是声音上。
works.technique: Keeps a user-specified work area untouched and applies grayscale and blur in real time to the surrounding video to lower its visual saliency.
works.technique_zh: 保留用户指定的工作区域不变，对周围视频实时做灰度化和模糊处理，降低其视觉显著性。
works.exercise_en: Make a phone camera filter that keeps a central rectangle sharp and colourful while blurring and desaturating the rest, then read a page in a busy room with and without it. Twist: auto-detect motion and blur only moving regions.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个手机相机滤镜：中间的矩形保持清晰和彩色，其余部分模糊并去色，在热闹的房间里分别开关滤镜读一页书；变体：自动检测运动，只模糊移动的区域。

video.video_title: Concentration Improvement by Visual Noise Reduction with a Video See-Through HMD

works.title: Weird Cuts
works.description: An AR collage tool: you cut shapes out of the camera image and place the photographic cut-outs as floating layers in space to build assemblages.
works.idea_zh: 用相机拍下的“剪纸”在空间里拼贴，像在空气中做实体拼贴画。

video.video_title: Weird Cuts tutorial

works.technique: A user-drawn polygon masks the current camera frame into a textured cut-out, which is placed as a quad at the phone's pose (or a fixed distance in front of it) using ARKit/ARCore world tracking.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个 AR 剪刀：手指在屏幕上圈出一块相机画面，把它变成贴图薄片留在空中，拼一件 5 片以上的空间拼贴；变体：只能剪同一种颜色或材质，拼出一只“校园动物”。
works.description_zh: 一款 AR 拼贴工具：你从相机画面中剪下各种形状，把这些照片剪片作为漂浮的图层放进空间，拼成立体组合。
works.idea_en: Collage camera 'paper cutouts' in space, like making a physical collage in mid-air.
works.technique_zh: 用户绘制的多边形把当前相机帧遮罩成带纹理的剪片，再借助 ARKit/ARCore 世界追踪，以四边形的形式放置在手机所在姿态处（或手机前方固定距离处）。
works.exercise_en: Make AR scissors: circle a patch of the camera image on screen with your finger, turn it into a textured sliver that stays in mid-air, and build a spatial collage of at least five pieces. Twist: you may only cut one color or material, and must assemble a 'campus animal'.

works.title: Wonder's Land: Ringmaster Wanted!
works.description: A circus-themed Wonderscope story that plays out around the child, who takes part by speaking lines aloud to the performers.
works.idea_zh: 孩子加入一场AR马戏团演出，用声音参与表演。

video.video_title: New on Wonderscope: Wonder’s Land Ringmaster Wanted!

works.technique: Characters are arranged around the viewer in a circle, and speech input triggers performer animations, making the child a participant.
works.exercise_zh: 在观众周围一圈放几个 AR 表演者，观众说出口令时轮到对应的表演者登场；变体：观众说话声音越大，表演越夸张。
works.description_zh: 一个以马戏团为主题的 Wonderscope 故事，在孩子身边上演；孩子通过大声对表演者说台词参与其中。
works.idea_en: A child joins an AR circus show and takes part with their voice.
works.technique_zh: 角色围成一圈排布在观众四周，语音输入触发表演者的动画，让孩子成为参与者。
works.exercise_en: Place several AR performers in a circle around the viewer, and when the viewer says a cue word, the matching performer takes the stage. Twist: the louder the viewer speaks, the more exaggerated the performance.

works.title: YoPuppet
works.description: Hand tracking maps 22 points of your hand onto a cartoon puppet's face, so opening and closing your hand works the puppet's mouth in AR.
works.idea_zh: 把手变成 AR 手偶：张合手掌，木偶就开口说话。

video.video_title: YoPuppet Demo

works.technique: A deep-learning hand pose model tracks keypoints in real time and retargets them to a 2D/3D puppet rig anchored over the hand.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe Hands 做'手偶'：拇指和四指的张合控制角色的嘴，并加上变声；加一个变化：两只手的角色可以对话。
works.description_zh: 手部追踪把你手上的 22 个点映射到一个卡通木偶的脸上，手掌一张一合，AR 中的木偶就跟着张嘴闭嘴。
works.idea_en: Turn your hand into an AR puppet: open and close your hand and the puppet talks.
works.technique_zh: 深度学习手部姿态模型实时追踪关键点，并把它们重定向到锚定在手上方的 2D/3D 木偶绑定上。
works.exercise_en: Build a hand puppet with MediaPipe Hands, where the thumb and fingers opening and closing control a character's mouth, and add voice changing. Twist: characters on both hands can talk to each other.

works.title: iPhone AR in VR
works.description: A prototype that lets iOS users join and spectate a multiplayer VR space through ARKit, seeing the headset players' avatars in their own room.
works.idea_zh: 手机用户通过AR旁观并加入VR多人空间。

video.video_title: iPhone AR in VR - August 2019

works.technique: An ARKit phone joins a multiplayer VR room as a spectator client, rendering the synchronized avatar transforms relative to an origin placed on a detected floor.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个观众模式：一台设备玩游戏，另一台手机用 AR 把玩家的动作以小人偶形式放在桌面上观看；变体：观众可以在桌面上投放道具影响游戏。
works.description_zh: 一个原型：iOS 用户可以通过 ARKit 加入并旁观多人 VR 空间，在自己的房间里看到头显玩家的虚拟形象。
works.idea_en: Phone users join and watch a multiplayer VR space through AR.
works.technique_zh: ARKit 手机作为旁观客户端加入多人 VR 房间，以放置在检测到的地面上的原点为参照，渲染同步过来的虚拟形象变换。
works.exercise_en: Build a spectator mode: one device plays a game while another phone uses AR to show the player's moves as a small figure on the table. Twist: spectators can drop props on the table that affect the game.

works.title: 1600: White House AR (dollar bill)
works.description: Point a phone at a US one-dollar bill to see a 3D White House rise from it and experience a year in the life of 1600 Pennsylvania Avenue.
works.idea_zh: 一美元钞票上长出立体白宫

video.video_title: 1600 Whitehouse Dollar Bill | Augmented Reality | Nexus Studios

works.technique: Image tracking recognises the one-dollar bill's engraving as a target and anchors an animated 3D White House model with time-based storytelling.
works.exercise_zh: 用一张纸币或票据做图像目标，让上面的建筑或图案立体升起并讲一段短故事；变体：让故事讲的是这张纸币本身的“流通经历”。
works.description_zh: 把手机对准一张一美元钞票，就能看到一座立体的白宫从钞票上升起，体验宾夕法尼亚大道 1600 号一年中的日常。
works.idea_en: A 3D White House grows out of a one-dollar bill.
works.technique_zh: 图像追踪把一美元钞票上的雕版图案识别为目标，并锚定一个带有时间线叙事的白宫 3D 动画模型。
works.exercise_en: Use a banknote or ticket as an image target, make the building or pattern on it rise in 3D, and tell a short story. Twist: make the story about the banknote's own journey through circulation.

works.title: 3D hand interaction and physics on an iPhone
works.description: With only the built-in camera, a tracked 3D hand pushes and knocks over virtual objects that obey physics on a real table.
works.idea_zh: 只用手机摄像头，就能用真手推倒桌上的虚拟积木。

video.video_title: 3D hand interaction and physics on an iPhone

works.technique: A Keras-trained model estimates 3D hand pose, and colliders attached to the hand interact with physics bodies placed on ARKit planes.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Lens Studio 手部追踪或 AR Foundation + 手部碰撞体，让手推倒一排虚拟多米诺；加一个变化：只有竖起食指才能'戳'。
works.description_zh: 只靠手机自带的摄像头，被追踪的 3D 手就能推倒真实桌面上遵循物理规律的虚拟物体。
works.idea_en: With just a phone camera, knock over virtual blocks on a table with your real hand.
works.technique_zh: 用 Keras 训练的模型估计 3D 手部姿态，附着在手上的碰撞体与放在 ARKit 平面上的物理刚体相互作用。
works.exercise_en: Use Lens Studio hand tracking or AR Foundation with hand colliders so your hand can knock over a row of virtual dominoes. Twist: you can only 'poke' with your index finger raised.

works.title: 4th Wall (app and Contested Landscapes)
works.description: Monumental drawn sculptures by the artist appear in galleries and public sites through her free 4th Wall AR app.
works.idea_zh: 用免费App让巨型手绘雕塑出现在任何地方

video.video_title: Nancy Baker Cahill Revamps Galleries with Augmented Reality – Brought to you by Hyundai

works.technique: Hand drawings are converted into animated 3D line or ribbon geometry in Unity and placed at monumental scale via plane detection or geolocated anchors in the 4th Wall app.
works.exercise_zh: 把一张自己的手绘线稿扫描后在 Unity 或 three.js 中挤出成 3D 线条雕塑，以 10 米尺度放在操场上；变体：让线条缓慢地“画出”自己，观众看到的是绘制过程而非成品。
works.description_zh: 通过艺术家免费的 4th Wall AR 应用，她那些纪念碑尺度的手绘雕塑出现在画廊和公共场所中。
works.idea_en: Use a free app to make giant hand-drawn sculptures appear anywhere.
works.technique_zh: 在 Unity 中把手绘作品转换为动态的 3D 线条或丝带几何体，再通过 4th Wall 应用中的平面检测或地理定位锚点，以纪念碑般的尺度放置。
works.exercise_en: Scan one of your own line drawings, extrude it into a 3D line sculpture in Unity or three.js, and place it on the sports field at 10-meter scale. Twist: have the lines slowly 'draw' themselves so viewers see the process rather than the finished piece.

works.title: A Universal Remote Control Built Using AR
works.description: Tapping on real lamps, fans and TVs through the phone camera turns them on and off, using ARKit anchors wired to a Raspberry Pi.
works.idea_zh: 看见哪个家电就点哪个——用 AR 做的万能遥控器。

video.video_title: A universal remote control built using Augmented Reality

works.technique: Anchors placed on real appliances are raycast-tested on tap, and each hit sends an HTTP/MQTT request to a Raspberry Pi that switches the corresponding relay.
works.exercise_zh: 在台灯位置放一个 AR 锚点，点中时通过 HTTP 请求让 ESP32 或智能插座开关灯；变体：改成盯着灯看两秒（屏幕中心射线）就开灯。
works.description_zh: 通过手机摄像头点一下真实的台灯、风扇或电视，就能开关它们；背后是连接到 Raspberry Pi 的 ARKit 锚点。
works.idea_en: Tap whatever appliance you see: a universal remote built with AR.
works.technique_zh: 点击时对放置在真实电器上的锚点做射线检测，每次命中都会向 Raspberry Pi 发送 HTTP/MQTT 请求，切换对应的继电器。
works.exercise_en: Place an AR anchor on a desk lamp and, when it is tapped, send an HTTP request so an ESP32 or smart plug switches the light. Twist: switch it on by staring at the lamp for two seconds instead (a ray from the screen center).

works.title: AR Bocce Ball Measuring
works.description: AirMeasure detects bocce balls on the lawn and shows which one is closest to the jack.
works.idea_zh: 用 AR 判断地滚球谁离目标球更近。

video.video_title: AR Bocce Ball measuring with AirMeasure!

works.technique: Ball positions are detected (likely by color segmentation or tap-to-mark) and projected onto the ground plane, then distances to the jack are computed and ranked.
works.exercise_zh: 在地面上点击标记几个真实物体（如硬币）和一个目标点，显示离目标最近的是哪个；变体：做成在教室地面玩的弹瓶盖比赛裁判。
works.description_zh: AirMeasure 能检测草坪上的地滚球，并显示哪一颗离目标球最近。
works.idea_en: Use AR to judge which bocce ball is closest to the target.
works.technique_zh: 检测球的位置（大概率通过颜色分割或点击标记）并投影到地面平面上，再计算它们与目标球的距离并排序。
works.exercise_en: Tap to mark a few real objects (such as coins) and a target point on the floor, and show which one is closest to the target. Twist: turn it into a referee for a bottle-cap flicking contest on the classroom floor.

works.title: AR Business Card Concept
works.description: Pointing an iPhone at a printed business card makes a video, contact buttons and social links unfold around it in AR.
works.description_zh: 用 iPhone 对准一张纸质名片，名片周围就会在 AR 中展开视频、联系方式按钮和社交链接。
works.idea_en: A paper card that opens into a small interactive portfolio.
works.idea_zh: 一张会“打开”成小型互动作品集的纸名片。
works.technique: ARKit 2 image detection and tracking recognises the card and anchors video planes and tappable UI to its edges.
works.technique_zh: 用 ARKit 2 的图像检测与追踪识别名片，把视频平面和可点击界面锚定在名片边缘。
works.exercise_en: Design your own business card and build an image-tracked AR layer with three buttons that each show something about you. Twist: the layer looks different when the card is upside down.
works.exercise_zh: 设计一张自己的名片，做一个图像追踪的 AR 图层，上面有三个按钮分别展示关于你的一件事；变体：名片倒过来时图层会变成另一种样子。

video.video_title: AR Business Card Concept made with ARKit

works.title: AR Poser
works.description: A phone app detects your pose in a photo and inserts a Disney-style digital avatar that imitates it, posing alongside you.
works.idea_zh: 拍照时自动放一个模仿你姿势的虚拟角色站在你旁边。

video.video_title: AR Poser: Automatically Augmenting Mobile Pictures with Digital Avatars Imitating Poses

works.technique: 2D pose estimation extracts the user's skeleton from the photo, and the keypoints are retargeted onto a rigged character that is rendered and composited next to the user in a mirrored or complementary pose.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe Pose 读取合照中的人体关键点，把它们映射到 three.js 中的一个简单绑定角色（或 2D 纸片人），让角色摆出同样或对称的姿势；变体：让角色总是做出“捣乱”的反向动作。
works.description_zh: 一款手机应用，能识别照片中你的姿势，并加入一个迪士尼风格的数字角色模仿这个姿势，与你一起合影。
works.idea_en: When you take a photo, a virtual character that copies your pose appears next to you.
works.technique_zh: 二维姿态估计从照片中提取用户骨骼，关键点被重定向到一个已绑定的角色上，以镜像或互补的姿势渲染并合成在用户旁边。
works.exercise_en: Read body keypoints from a group photo with MediaPipe Pose and map them onto a simple rigged character in three.js (or a 2D paper doll) so it strikes the same or a mirrored pose. Twist: have the character always do the opposite, as a prankster.

works.title: AR Restaurant Menu Concept
works.description: Scanning a restaurant menu makes 3D models of the dishes appear on the table so diners can see each plate at real size before ordering.
works.description_zh: 扫描餐厅菜单，菜品的 3D 模型就会出现在餐桌上，食客点菜前就能看到每道菜的真实大小。
works.idea_en: Let diners preview the actual plate on their own table before ordering.
works.idea_zh: 点菜之前，就在自己的餐桌上预览真正端上来的那一盘。
works.technique: ARKit image tracking recognises the menu page, and tapping an item places a photogrammetry-style 3D dish on the detected table plane.
works.technique_zh: 用 ARKit 图像追踪识别菜单页面，点击某道菜就会在识别出的桌面上放置一个摄影测量风格的 3D 菜品。
works.exercise_en: Photoscan three foods from the cafeteria and build an AR menu that places them on a table. Twist: show each dish's calories or carbon footprint as a floating label.
works.exercise_zh: 用摄影测量扫描食堂的三种食物，做一个把它们放到桌上的 AR 菜单；变体：以悬浮标签显示每道菜的热量或碳足迹。

video.video_title: AR Restaurant Menu Concept made with ARKit

works.title: AR Roaches Crawling on Everything
works.description: Using 6D.ai real-time meshing, virtual cockroaches scurry over and behind the actual objects in a kitchen.
works.idea_zh: 借助实时网格，让虚拟蟑螂爬满厨房的每个表面。

video.video_title: AR Roaches crawling on everything

works.technique: 6D.ai real-time meshing provides a room mesh used both as an occlusion material and as a navigation surface, so agents crawl over and hide behind real objects.
works.exercise_zh: 在 LiDAR 设备上用 ARMeshManager 生成房间网格并设置遮挡材质，让小虫沿网格随机爬动；变体：让小虫躲避手机的光（屏幕中心射线）。
works.description_zh: 借助 6D.ai 的实时网格重建，虚拟蟑螂在厨房里的真实物体上面和后面四处乱窜。
works.idea_en: Use real-time meshing to let virtual cockroaches crawl over every surface in the kitchen.
works.technique_zh: 6D.ai 实时网格重建提供房间网格，既作为遮挡材质，也作为导航表面，让智能体在真实物体上爬行并躲到它们后面。
works.exercise_en: Generate a room mesh with ARMeshManager on a LiDAR device, apply an occlusion material, and let small bugs crawl randomly along the mesh. Twist: make the bugs flee the phone's light (a ray from the screen center).

works.title: AR dial on a physical puck
works.description: Rotating a blank physical puck on the desk turns it into a virtual dial: an AR ring and angle readout follow the real rotation.
works.description_zh: 在桌上转动一个空白的实体圆块，它就变成一个虚拟旋钮：AR 光环和角度读数跟着真实旋转变化。
works.idea_en: Give a dumb physical object a digital function by tracking how you turn it.
works.idea_zh: 通过追踪你如何转动一个普通物体，赋予它数字功能。
works.technique: Vuforia tracks a marker on the puck; its yaw angle relative to the base drives a ring UI and a numeric value in Unity.
works.technique_zh: Vuforia 追踪圆块上的标记，它相对底座的偏航角驱动 Unity 中的环形界面和数值。
works.exercise_en: Stick an image marker on a bottle cap and use its rotation in phone AR to control music volume or a light. Twist: map rotation to time and scrub through a day in the room.
works.exercise_zh: 在瓶盖上贴一个图像标记，用手机 AR 识别它的旋转来控制音量或灯光。变体：把旋转映射为时间，在房间里拖动一天的变化。

video.video_title: dial

works.title: ARCore procedural bridges
works.description: An internship prototype for Google Daydream: game levels are generated from the real room, with bridges built automatically between the detected surfaces of furniture and floor.
works.description_zh: 他在 Google Daydream 实习时的原型：游戏关卡根据真实房间生成，在家具和地面等检测到的平面之间自动搭起桥梁。
works.idea_en: Let the real room's furniture define the level layout of an AR game.
works.idea_zh: 让真实房间里的家具决定 AR 游戏的关卡布局。
works.technique: ARCore plane detection returns surfaces at different heights; a generator connects nearby plane edges with procedurally built bridge meshes.
works.technique_zh: ARCore 的平面检测返回不同高度的平面，生成器在相邻平面的边缘之间程序化地生成桥梁网格。
works.exercise_en: Write a small script that places a path between every pair of detected planes in AR Foundation. Twist: bridges collapse after the player crosses them once.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 写个小脚本，在每两个检测到的平面之间生成一条通路。变体：玩家走过一次后桥就会塌掉。

video.video_title: One of my internship project prototype @GoogleARVR Daydream, using ARCore to procedurally generate levels in AR. The bridge is totally generated based on physical environment, and the concept might be

works.title: ARKit + CoreML Foot Detection for AR Soccer
works.description: A foot-segmentation neural net lets the player kick a virtual soccer ball with their real foot.
works.idea_zh: 用神经网络识别真实的脚，去踢虚拟足球。

video.video_title: ARKit + CoreML foot detection for AR Soccer

works.technique: A foot-segmentation network produces a mask each frame, and the foot's estimated position is used as a kinematic collider that transfers velocity to a physics ball.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe Pose 追踪脚踝位置，在网页中用 three.js 生成一个虚拟球，脚靠近时把球踢飞；变体：做成颠球计数游戏。
works.description_zh: 一个脚部分割神经网络让玩家可以用真实的脚去踢虚拟足球。
works.idea_en: Use a neural network to find your real foot and kick a virtual soccer ball.
works.technique_zh: 脚部分割网络每帧输出一张蒙版，估算出的脚部位置被用作运动学碰撞体，把速度传递给物理球体。
works.exercise_en: Track ankle positions with MediaPipe Pose, create a virtual ball in three.js on a web page, and kick it away when the foot gets close. Twist: turn it into a keepy-uppy counting game.

works.title: ARKit 1.5 Vertical Planes and Meshes
works.description: Visualises ARKit 1.5's wall detection and irregular surface meshes as they grow over a room.
works.idea_zh: 实时可视化 ARKit 1.5 识别的墙面和不规则表面网格。

video.video_title: ARKit 1.5 Vertical Planes and Meshes

works.technique: ARKit 1.5 vertical plane detection and irregular plane-boundary polygons are rendered as semi-transparent meshes that update as the planes grow and merge.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 可视化水平和竖直平面，给不同朝向不同颜色并显示面积；变体：让平面面积变化时播放音调，让房间扫描变成一段音乐。
works.description_zh: 把 ARKit 1.5 的墙面检测和不规则表面网格可视化，看着它们在房间里逐渐生长。
works.idea_en: Visualize the walls and irregular surface meshes that ARKit 1.5 detects in real time.
works.technique_zh: 把 ARKit 1.5 的竖直平面检测结果和不规则平面边界多边形渲染成半透明网格，随着平面扩展与合并而更新。
works.exercise_en: Visualize horizontal and vertical planes with AR Foundation, giving each orientation its own color and showing the area. Twist: play a tone when a plane's area changes, turning the room scan into music.

works.title: ARKit 2 Eye Transform Test
works.description: A quick test of ARKit 2's per-eye transforms, drawing where each eye is looking as input for his face-controlled game Nose Zone.
works.idea_zh: 测试 ARKit 2 的双眼追踪，为用脸玩的游戏做新操控。

video.video_title:
Testing out the new ARKit 2 leftEyeTransform and rightEyeTransform features. Haven't played with lookAtPoint yet but hoping it'll let me fine-tune controls.

Maybe a new @playnosezone feature coming w

works.technique: ARKit 2 leftEyeTransform and rightEyeTransform are read each frame and rays are cast from each eye along its forward axis to visualize gaze direction.
works.exercise_zh: 用 ARKit 面部追踪从双眼位置发出两条射线显示你在看哪里；变体：用鼻尖朝向代替眼睛做控制，比较两者精度。
works.description_zh: 对 ARKit 2 单眼变换功能的一次快速测试：画出每只眼睛注视的方向，作为他那款用脸操控的游戏 Nose Zone 的输入。
works.idea_en: Test ARKit 2 eye tracking as a new control scheme for a game you play with your face.
works.technique_zh: 每帧读取 ARKit 2 的 leftEyeTransform 和 rightEyeTransform，并从每只眼睛沿其前向轴发出射线，可视化视线方向。
works.exercise_en: Use ARKit face tracking to cast two rays from the eye positions and show where you are looking. Twist: use the direction of your nose tip instead of your eyes as the control, and compare their accuracy.

works.title: ARKit Home Robot
works.description: A cheap home robot built from the discontinued Romo base and an iPhone, localised with ARKit and Placenote and driven from another phone.
works.idea_zh: 用停产的 Romo 底座加 iPhone，做一台靠 ARKit 定位的家用机器人。

video.video_title: ARKit Home Robot

works.technique: The robot's iPhone runs ARKit with a Placenote persistent map for relocalization, so its pose is known in a shared map and remote commands are expressed as map-space targets.
works.exercise_zh: 把手机固定在遥控小车上运行 AR 追踪，把小车位置实时发送到另一台手机上显示；变体：在另一台手机上点地面让小车自动开过去。
works.description_zh: 一台廉价的家用机器人，用已停产的 Romo 底座加一部 iPhone 搭成，通过 ARKit 和 Placenote 定位，并由另一部手机遥控。
works.idea_en: Build a home robot that finds its way with ARKit, from a discontinued Romo base and an iPhone.
works.technique_zh: 机器人上的 iPhone 运行 ARKit，并借助 Placenote 持久化地图进行重定位，这样它在共享地图中的位姿是已知的，远程指令则以地图空间中的目标点来表达。
works.exercise_en: Mount a phone on a remote-control car, run AR tracking, and send the car's position live to another phone for display. Twist: tap the floor on the other phone and have the car drive there on its own.

works.title: ARKit Portal to the Upside Down
works.description: A walk-through doorway in the living room that opens into the dark 'Upside Down' world from Stranger Things.
works.idea_zh: 在客厅开一道通往《怪奇物语》颠倒世界的传送门。

video.video_title: AUGMENTED REALITY Tutorial: ARKit Portal to the Upside Down

works.technique: A stencil-buffer portal renders the alternate world only through the door frame, and the stencil test flips when the camera crosses the portal plane so the user is inside the other world.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 放一扇门，门内用 Stencil 渲染一个暗色雾气世界，穿过门后切换为全屏渲染；变体：把门内世界做成你家乡的街道。
works.description_zh: 客厅里一扇可以走进去的门，通往《怪奇物语》中那个黑暗的“颠倒世界”。
works.idea_en: Open a portal in the living room to the Upside Down from Stranger Things.
works.technique_zh: 基于模板缓冲的传送门只在门框内渲染另一个世界；当相机穿过传送门平面时，模板测试随之翻转，用户便置身于另一个世界之中。
works.exercise_en: Place a door with AR Foundation, render a dark, foggy world inside it with a stencil, and switch to full-screen rendering once you walk through. Twist: make the world behind the door the streets of your hometown.

works.title: An Augmented Reality Rube Goldberg Machine
works.description: A chain-reaction machine that mixes real household objects with virtual dominoes, ramps and balls, playable as a physics puzzle with a reset button.
works.idea_zh: 一台横跨真实与虚拟物体的鲁布·戈德堡连锁机关。

video.video_title: An Augmented Reality Rube Goldberg Machine

works.technique: Detected planes and hand-placed invisible colliders stand in for real objects, so Unity rigidbody physics lets virtual balls and dominoes react to real furniture.
works.exercise_zh: 在桌面平面上摆放虚拟多米诺骨牌和斜坡，并给一本真书手动放一个隐形碰撞体，让小球滚下后撞倒整排骨牌；变体：让连锁反应最后触发一个真实声音或手机震动。
works.description_zh: 一台连锁反应机关，把真实的家居物品与虚拟的多米诺骨牌、斜坡和小球混在一起，可以当作带重置按钮的物理谜题来玩。
works.idea_en: A Rube Goldberg chain reaction that runs across real and virtual objects.
works.technique_zh: 用检测到的平面和手动放置的隐形碰撞体代替真实物体，使 Unity 刚体物理中的虚拟小球和多米诺能对真实家具做出反应。
works.exercise_en: Set up virtual dominoes and a ramp on a tabletop plane, add a hand-placed invisible collider to a real book, and let a ball roll down and knock over the whole row. Twist: have the chain reaction end by triggering a real sound or phone vibration.

works.title: Aquila: flying a drone with an AR eagle
works.description: A voice-controlled AR eagle, inspired by Assassin's Creed Origins, acts as the interface to launch and fly a real drone.
works.idea_zh: 用语音召唤一只 AR 老鹰，它带着真实的无人机起飞。

video.video_title: Aquila : A fun way to fly a drone using Augmented Reality

works.technique: Speech commands trigger an animated AR companion whose actions are mapped to drone SDK commands for takeoff and flight.
works.exercise_zh: 用语音识别 + AR 角色控制一个遥控玩具（或 Tello 无人机）：说'起飞'角色先飞、玩具再动；加一个变化：角色会模仿你的手势方向。
works.description_zh: 一只受《刺客信条：起源》启发的语音控制 AR 雄鹰，充当起飞和操控真实无人机的界面。
works.idea_en: Summon an AR eagle by voice, and it takes a real drone into the air.
works.technique_zh: 语音指令触发一个 AR 动画伙伴，它的动作被映射为无人机 SDK 中的起飞和飞行指令。
works.exercise_en: Use speech recognition and an AR character to control a remote-control toy (or a Tello drone): say 'take off' and the character flies first, then the toy moves. Twist: the character copies the direction of your hand gestures.

works.title: Augmented Reality Web Pages on Physical Books
works.description: A physical book is recognised and wrapped with its live web page—reviews and details float around the cover.
works.idea_zh: 认出实体书，把它的网页信息包裹在书的周围。

video.video_title: Augmented reality web pages on physical books

works.technique: The book cover is tracked as a reference image, and web content (reviews, details) is rendered as panels around the cover's tracked pose.
works.exercise_zh: 识别一本书的封面，在旁边显示评分和一句评论卡片；变体：显示的是你的同学给这本书写的一句话。
works.description_zh: 识别出一本实体书后，把它的实时网页信息包裹在书的周围，书评和详细信息环绕封面浮动。
works.idea_en: Recognize a physical book and wrap its web page information around it.
works.technique_zh: 书的封面作为参考图像被追踪，网页内容（书评、详情）以面板形式渲染在被追踪封面的姿态周围。
works.exercise_en: Recognize a book cover and show a card with its rating and a one-line review next to it. Twist: show a sentence a classmate wrote about the book instead.

works.title: BBC Civilisations AR
works.description: An AR app with BBC R&D that places over 30 museum artefacts in your room, which you can inspect, x-ray and hear narrated.
works.idea_zh: 把博物馆文物搬进客厅，还能透视观察

video.video_title: BBC Civilisations AR Preview | Nexus Studios

works.technique: Plane detection places photogrammetry scans of artefacts at real scale, with a clipping-plane or shader cross-section for x-ray views and attached audio narration.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机摄影测量（Polycam / RealityScan）扫描一件家里的老物件，在 AR 中放大展示并加上剖面或“透视”效果和语音讲解；变体：让讲解者是这件物品本身。
works.description_zh: 与 BBC R&D 合作的 AR 应用，把 30 多件博物馆文物放进你的房间，你可以仔细端详、用 X 光透视，还能听到讲解。
works.idea_en: Bring museum artifacts into your living room and see inside them.
works.technique_zh: 通过平面检测以真实尺寸放置文物的摄影测量扫描模型，用裁剪平面或着色器剖面实现 X 光视图，并附带语音讲解。
works.exercise_en: Scan an old object from home with phone photogrammetry (Polycam / RealityScan), display it enlarged in AR, and add a cross-section or 'x-ray' effect with voice narration. Twist: let the object itself be the narrator.

works.title: Beauty3000
works.description: An Instagram face effect that coats the face in a shiny, iridescent plastic-like skin that catches light as you move; it went viral in 2018 and helped start the AR filter-artist movement.
works.idea_zh: 把脸变成闪亮塑料般的未来皮肤，追问'什么是美'。

video.video_title: Johanna Jaskowska uses Spark AR Studio to re-imagine beauty

works.technique: The face mesh is re-textured with a glossy material that uses an iridescent or matcap environment reflection, so highlights shift as the head moves.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Effect House 或 Lens Studio 给脸部网格一个彩虹色的 Matcap 材质，观察转头时高光的变化；变体：把材质换成一种你身边真实物件的质感。
works.description_zh: 一款 Instagram 人脸特效，给脸覆上一层闪亮、带虹彩的塑料质感皮肤，随着你的动作折射光线；它在 2018 年走红，推动了 AR 滤镜艺术家这股潮流的兴起。
works.idea_en: Turn your face into shiny, plastic-like future skin and ask what beauty means.
works.technique_zh: 给人脸网格重新贴上有光泽的材质，使用虹彩或 matcap 环境反射，高光会随头部转动而移动。
works.exercise_en: Give the face mesh a rainbow matcap material in Effect House or Lens Studio and watch the highlights shift as you turn your head. Twist: swap the material for the texture of a real object around you.

works.title: Bringing Newspapers to Life with ARKit
works.description: Pointing the phone at a printed newspaper plays animated weather maps and sports highlights on top of the page.
works.idea_zh: 对准报纸，天气图和体育集锦就在纸面上动起来。

video.video_title:
Bringing newspapers to life with #ARKit. 📰📱

Animated weather maps and sports highlights are just the beginning! Built with #ARKit2 on #iOS12. https://t.co/JVth2FQCFw

works.technique: Newspaper photos are ARKit 2 reference images, and a video plane is placed exactly over each detected image so the printed picture appears to play.
works.exercise_zh: 用图像追踪识别报纸上的一张照片，在其上覆盖同尺寸视频让照片动起来；变体：视频内容是你们自己拍的“新闻后续”。
works.description_zh: 把手机对准印刷的报纸，版面上就会播放动态天气图和体育集锦。
works.idea_en: Point at a newspaper and the weather maps and sports highlights start moving on the page.
works.technique_zh: 报纸上的照片被设为 ARKit 2 参考图像，在每张检测到的图像上精确覆盖一个视频平面，让印刷图片看起来在播放。
works.exercise_en: Use image tracking to recognize a photo in a newspaper and cover it with a video of the same size so the photo comes alive. Twist: the video is a 'news follow-up' you shot yourselves.

works.title: Childish Gambino Playmoji (Google Pixel)
works.description: A dancing AR Childish Gambino character for Pixel's Playground that reacts to the user and dances alongside people in the camera view.
works.idea_zh: 会和你同框跳舞的AR明星

video.video_title: Childish Gambino AR | Google Pixel | Nexus Studios

works.technique: ARCore plane detection anchors an animated character, and person detection or pose estimation in the camera frame lets it react to and dance beside people.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Mixamo 动画角色在 AR 中放在同学身边，根据 MediaPipe 检测到的人是否举手来切换舞蹈；变体：让角色学习并模仿人的一个动作，再“教”回给下一个人。
works.description_zh: 为 Pixel 的 Playground 打造的会跳舞的 AR Childish Gambino 角色，它能对用户做出反应，并在相机画面中与人一起跳舞。
works.idea_en: An AR celebrity who dances in the frame with you.
works.technique_zh: ARCore 平面检测锚定一个动画角色，相机画面中的人体检测或姿态估计让它能对人做出反应，并在人身旁跳舞。
works.exercise_en: Place a Mixamo-animated character next to a classmate in AR and switch dances depending on whether MediaPipe detects a raised hand. Twist: have the character learn and copy one of a person's moves, then 'teach' it to the next person.

works.title: ChromaGlasses
works.description: Glasses with an optical see-through display analyse the scene and shift the colours of the world, pixel by pixel, so people with colour vision deficiency can tell apart colours they normally confuse.
works.description_zh: 配有光学透视显示的眼镜分析场景，逐像素地调整现实世界的颜色，让色觉障碍者能分辨平时容易混淆的颜色。
works.idea_en: Glasses that correct not focus but colour, by editing reality in real time.
works.idea_zh: 这副眼镜矫正的不是焦距而是颜色，方法是实时编辑现实。
works.technique: Captures the scene with a camera aligned to the eye, computes a compensation for the user's colour deficiency, and overlays it with pixel precision on an optical see-through HMD.
works.technique_zh: 用与眼睛对齐的摄像头拍摄场景，针对用户的色觉缺陷计算补偿，再在光学透视头显上以像素精度叠加。
works.exercise_en: Make a phone camera filter that pushes reds toward orange and greens toward blue, then test it on colour-blindness plates viewed through a colour-blindness simulator. Twist: design a filter that helps people spot ripe fruit.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个手机相机滤镜，把红色推向橙色、绿色推向蓝色，再透过色盲模拟器观看色盲测试图来验证效果；变体：设计一个帮助人辨认熟透水果的滤镜。

video.video_title: ChromaGlasses: Computational Glasses for Compensating Colour Blindness

works.title: Codename: Neon
works.description: A real-time multiplayer AR laser-tag prototype: players in the same park shoot energy at each other, collect pellets and dodge shots that all players see in the same space.
works.idea_zh: 多人在同一片草地上看到同一场AR激光枪战，低延迟共享现实。

video.video_title: Codename Neon (Niantic) - Real-Time Mobile AR Multiplayer Laser Tag Demo

works.technique: Players share a low-latency multiplayer session with a common anchor, so each phone's pose and fired projectiles are synchronized in the same world coordinates.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Unity Netcode 让两台手机在同一个图像标记坐标系下互相发射能量球，击中对方手机位置即得分；变体：地上散落的能量点被捡走后对双方都消失。
works.description_zh: 一个实时多人 AR 激光枪战原型：同一个公园里的玩家互相发射能量、收集能量点、躲避攻击，所有人在同一空间中看到的是同一场战斗。
works.idea_en: Several people on the same lawn see the same AR laser battle, sharing reality with low latency.
works.technique_zh: 玩家通过一个公共锚点共享低延迟的多人会话，使每部手机的位姿和发射的弹丸在同一世界坐标中同步。
works.exercise_en: Use Unity Netcode to let two phones fire energy balls at each other in the coordinate system of a shared image marker, scoring when a shot hits the other phone's position. Twist: energy pellets scattered on the ground disappear for both players once picked up.

works.title: Codename: Tonehenge
works.description: A cooperative AR puzzle prototype in which several players standing around the same spot manipulate a shared virtual stone circle together in real time.
works.idea_zh: 几个人围在一起，共同操作同一个AR石阵来解谜。

video.video_title: Codename Tonehenge (Niantic) Real-Time AR Multiplayer Puzzle Game Demo

works.technique: A shared anchor places one virtual structure for all players, and each player's input on a shared object state is replicated in real time so the puzzle needs coordinated action.
works.exercise_zh: 放一个多人共享的 AR 石阵，每人只能旋转其中一块石头，全部对齐才能打开；变体：石头只在所有人同时看着它时才能被转动。
works.description_zh: 一个合作式 AR 解谜原型：几名玩家站在同一处周围，实时共同操作一个共享的虚拟石阵。
works.idea_en: A few people gather around and work the same AR stone circle together to solve a puzzle.
works.technique_zh: 一个共享锚点为所有玩家放置同一个虚拟结构，每位玩家对共享物体状态的操作被实时同步，因此谜题需要协同行动才能解开。
works.exercise_en: Place a shared multiplayer AR stone circle where each person can rotate only one stone, and it opens only when all are aligned. Twist: a stone can be turned only when everyone is looking at it at the same time.

works.title: Collaborative Exploration of Urban Data in VR and AR
works.description: Several users gather around an immersive scale model of a city block and explore live datasets such as traffic or building information together, some in VR and some in AR.
works.description_zh: 几名用户围着一个沉浸式的城市街区缩比模型，一起探索交通、建筑信息等实时数据，有人在 VR 中，有人在 AR 中。
works.idea_en: Turn city data into a shared tabletop model people can walk around and point at.
works.idea_zh: 把城市数据变成可以绕着走、可以指指点点的共享桌面模型。
works.technique: Renders a scale model of the urban environment in shared VR and AR sessions and binds live datasets to its buildings and streets.
works.technique_zh: 在共享的 VR 与 AR 会话中渲染城市环境缩比模型，并把实时数据绑定到建筑和街道上。
works.exercise_en: Print a map of your neighbourhood, track it with phone AR and raise bars over each block for data the class collects, like number of trees. Twist: let two phones see the same bars and argue for one change to the street.
works.exercise_zh: 打印一张社区地图，用手机 AR 追踪，在每个街区上方升起柱状图表示全班收集的数据，比如树的数量；变体：让两部手机看到同样的柱状图，讨论出一项街道改造建议。

video.video_title: Collaborative exploration of urban data in virtual and augmented reality

works.title: Control Your iPhone with Your Eyes
works.description: Look at a button to select it and blink to press it: an ARKit 2 prototype that turns eye gaze into a pointer on iPhone X.
works.idea_zh: 看哪里就选中哪里，眨眼就点击——用眼睛操控 iPhone。

video.video_title: Control your iPhone with your eyes. Just look at a button to select it and blink to press. Powered by ARKit 2. #ARKit #ARKit2 #WWDC #iOS https://t.co/ow8TwEkC8J

works.technique: ARKit 2 face tracking provides a lookAtPoint and per-eye transforms, which are intersected with the screen plane to get a gaze cursor, and eyeBlink blend shapes act as clicks.
works.exercise_zh: 用 ARKit 面部追踪的 lookAtPoint（或 WebGazer.js）在屏幕上显示凝视光标，眨眼触发按钮；变体：做一个只能用眼睛玩的简单游戏。
works.description_zh: 看向按钮即可选中，眨眼即可按下：一个 ARKit 2 原型，把眼睛的注视变成 iPhone X 上的指针。
works.idea_en: Select whatever you look at and blink to click: control an iPhone with your eyes.
works.technique_zh: ARKit 2 人脸追踪提供 lookAtPoint 和单眼变换，将其与屏幕平面求交得到凝视光标，eyeBlink 混合形状则充当点击。
works.exercise_en: Show a gaze cursor on screen using ARKit face tracking's lookAtPoint (or WebGazer.js) and trigger buttons by blinking. Twist: make a simple game you can play only with your eyes.

works.title: Counting Foreign Currency in AR
works.description: Banknotes on a table are recognised and their converted value is shown on top of each note.
works.idea_zh: 识别桌上的外币纸币，并直接在纸币上显示换算金额。

video.video_title: Counting money

works.technique: Each banknote design is a reference image, so detected notes get an anchor with a label showing its value converted with an exchange rate.
works.exercise_zh: 用图像追踪识别几种钞票（或自制代币卡），在每张上显示换算后的金额并计算总和；变体：把金额换算成能买几杯奶茶。
works.description_zh: 识别桌上的纸币，并在每张钞票上方显示换算后的金额。
works.idea_en: Recognize foreign banknotes on a table and show the converted amount right on each note.
works.technique_zh: 每种钞票图案都是一张参考图像，检测到的纸币会获得一个锚点，并附上按汇率换算后的金额标签。
works.exercise_en: Use image tracking to recognize a few kinds of banknotes (or homemade token cards), show the converted amount on each, and add up the total. Twist: express the amount as how many cups of bubble tea it buys.

works.title: Dent Reality Indoor AR
works.description: An indoor AR wayfinding prototype that guides shoppers to products and locations inside buildings with overlays anchored to the space.
works.idea_zh: 在商场等室内空间里用 AR 指路找商品。

video.video_title:
Dent Reality has been busy (not-so quietly) building AR for indoor spaces. Now, we’re preparing to put it into people’s hands, and raising our first round of investment.

If you’re an accredited angel

works.technique: Indoor positioning likely relies on a pre-built visual map or image anchors for relocalization, with a pathfinding graph producing routes drawn as anchored AR overlays.
works.exercise_zh: 在教学楼走廊贴几张图像标记作为定位点，扫描后显示去某个教室的箭头；变体：导航到的目标是一件藏起来的“宝物”。
works.description_zh: 一个室内 AR 导航原型，借助锚定在空间中的叠加层，引导顾客在建筑内找到商品和地点。
works.idea_en: Use AR to find your way to products inside malls and other indoor spaces.
works.technique_zh: 室内定位大概率依靠预先构建的视觉地图或图像锚点进行重定位，由寻路图生成路线，再以锚定的 AR 叠加层绘制出来。
works.exercise_en: Stick a few image markers along a classroom-building corridor as positioning points, and after scanning show arrows leading to a given classroom. Twist: the destination is a hidden 'treasure'.

works.title: Design Camera 3D + AR
works.description: Places an infinitely scalable, photoreal iPhone showing your app design on any real surface for mockup photography.
works.idea_zh: 把展示你 App 设计的逼真 iPhone 模型放在任意真实桌面上拍摄。

video.video_title: Design camera 3D + AR

works.technique: A photoreal phone model with the app design as a screen texture is placed on a detected plane, using light estimation and contact shadows for realistic mockup shots.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Reality Composer 或 AR Foundation 把一个带自己设计截图的手机模型放到桌面并加阴影拍照；变体：可以把它放大到楼房那么大再拍一张。
works.description_zh: 把一部展示你 App 设计、可无限缩放的逼真 iPhone 放到任意真实表面上，用来拍摄样机效果图。
works.idea_en: Place a realistic iPhone showing your app design on any real table and photograph it.
works.technique_zh: 带有 App 设计屏幕纹理的逼真手机模型被放在检测到的平面上，借助光照估计和接触阴影拍出逼真的样机图。
works.exercise_en: Use Reality Composer or AR Foundation to place a phone model showing your own design screenshots on a table, add shadows and take a photo. Twist: scale it up to the size of a building and take another shot.

works.title: Dockyard 3D Projection Mapping / Yokohama Odyssey
works.description: Large-scale 3D projection mapping in the historic stone dry dock of Yokohama, turning the dock walls into an animated voyage.
works.idea_zh: 把百年石砌船坞变成航海史诗的投影舞台

video.video_title: DOCKYARD 3D PROJECTION MAPPING / YOKOHAMA ODYSSEY

works.technique: Large-scale architectural projection mapping: the dock is surveyed into a 3D model, multiple projectors are aligned and edge-blended, and content is rendered from the model's UV layout.
works.exercise_zh: 拿一个纸箱或积木搭成的“建筑”，在 TouchDesigner / MadMapper 里对齐投影，做一段讲述这个场所历史的 2 分钟动画；变体：只用建筑自身的轮廓线作为动画素材。
works.description_zh: 在横滨历史悠久的石砌干船坞中进行的大型 3D 投影映射，把船坞墙壁变成一段动态的航海之旅。
works.idea_en: Turn a century-old stone dock into a projection stage for a seafaring epic.
works.technique_zh: 大型建筑投影映射：先把船坞测绘成 3D 模型，再对齐多台投影机并做边缘融合，内容则按模型的 UV 布局渲染。
works.exercise_en: Build a 'building' from a cardboard box or blocks, align projection to it in TouchDesigner / MadMapper, and make a two-minute animation about the history of a place. Twist: use only the building's own outlines as animation material.

works.title: Dodge (developer sample)
works.description: Rock golems rise out of your real floor and hurl boulders that you physically dodge while swatting others away with hand gestures.
works.idea_zh: 石头怪从真实地板里钻出来扔石头，你要真的躲。

video.video_title: Magic Leap Reveals 'Dodge' AR Developer Sample

works.technique: Spawns characters on detected floor meshes and uses head position as the target so the player's real body movement is the core mechanic.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机AR做一个躲避游戏：虚拟球从地面某点向手机飞来，玩家需要移动身体躲开；变化：两名玩家互相为对方放置发射点。
works.description_zh: 石头巨人从你家真实的地板里钻出来，朝你扔巨石，你得真的闪身躲开，同时用手势把其他石头拍飞。
works.idea_en: Rock monsters burst out of your real floor and throw rocks, and you have to actually dodge.
works.technique_zh: 在检测到的地面网格上生成角色，并以头部位置为攻击目标，让玩家真实的身体移动成为核心玩法。
works.exercise_en: Make a phone AR dodging game where virtual balls fly from a point on the floor toward the phone and players must move their bodies to avoid them. Twist: two players place launch points for each other.

works.title: Dr. Grordbort's Invaders
works.description: A Magic Leap One launch game in which portals open in your real walls and robots from Dr. Grordbort's universe pour into your living room while you fight back with a ray gun.
works.idea_zh: 墙面打开传送门，复古科幻机器人闯入你的客厅。

video.video_title: 'Dr. Grordbort's Invaders' Magic Leap Trailer

works.technique: Wall surfaces from spatial mapping host portal decals with stencil masking, so robots appear to climb out of the real wall and then navigate the room mesh.
works.exercise_zh: 检测墙面并在上面“炸”出一个 Stencil 洞口，敌人从洞里爬出来；变体：让洞口越打越大，最后露出墙后的另一个世界。
works.description_zh: Magic Leap One 首发游戏之一：你家真实的墙上打开传送门，来自 Dr. Grordbort 宇宙的机器人涌入客厅，你则用射线枪反击。
works.idea_en: Portals open in your walls and retro sci-fi robots storm your living room.
works.technique_zh: 空间映射得到的墙面承载带模板遮罩的传送门贴花，让机器人看起来从真实墙壁里爬出，随后在房间网格上导航。
works.exercise_en: Detect a wall and 'blast' a stencil hole in it, with enemies crawling out of the hole. Twist: the hole grows bigger the more you shoot, finally revealing another world behind the wall.

works.title: DynaFlash v2 and Post Reality
works.description: The second-generation high-speed projector demonstrates 'post reality' effects: textures, wireframes and illusions projected onto fast-moving objects and people.
works.idea_zh: 高速投影让物体看起来像被'改写'了材质，现实本身成了屏幕。

video.video_title: DynaFlash v2 and Post Reality

works.technique: A high-speed projector with 8-bit grayscale at high frame rates, combined with millisecond vision-based tracking, projects textures and wireframes onto fast-moving objects without perceptible lag, making the augmentation appear physical.
works.exercise_zh: 在 TouchDesigner 中追踪一个手持的白色物体（纸板或球），把线框或纹理投影在上面，并通过缩小投影区域和预测运动来减少延迟；变体：让投影揭示物体“内部”看不见的结构。
works.description_zh: 第二代高速投影机展示了“后现实”效果：把纹理、线框和各种错觉投射到快速移动的物体和人身上。
works.idea_en: High-speed projection makes objects look as if their material has been rewritten, so reality itself becomes the screen.
works.technique_zh: 以高帧率输出 8 位灰度的高速投影机，配合毫秒级视觉追踪，把纹理和线框投射到快速移动的物体上而几乎察觉不到延迟，让增强效果看起来像是物体本身的一部分。
works.exercise_en: Track a handheld white object (cardboard or a ball) in TouchDesigner, project a wireframe or texture onto it, and reduce latency by shrinking the projection area and predicting motion. Twist: make the projection reveal the invisible structure 'inside' the object.

works.title: Exploring Paintings in AR
works.description: Looking at a painting identifies its key figures, which can be tapped to learn more about them.
works.idea_zh: 对准名画识别画中人物，点一下就能了解其故事。

video.video_title:
Exploring paintings in AR! 🖼📱

Look at artwork to identify key figures, and tap them to learn more. Built with #ARKit on #iOS12. #ARKit2 #AugmentedReality https://t.co/1pgSEr0iW4

works.technique: The painting is tracked as a reference image, and tappable hotspots are placed at known 2D coordinates on the image plane, opening info panels when hit.
works.exercise_zh: 识别一幅名画的打印件，在画中几个人物上放可点击热点，点开显示介绍；变体：点击人物时让他开口说一句台词。
works.description_zh: 看向一幅画时，系统会识别出画中的主要人物，点一下即可了解更多。
works.idea_en: Point at a famous painting to recognize its figures, and tap one to hear its story.
works.technique_zh: 把画作当作参考图像追踪，在图像平面上已知的二维坐标处放置可点击热点，点中时打开信息面板。
works.exercise_en: Recognize a printed copy of a famous painting and place tappable hotspots on several figures that open an introduction. Twist: when a figure is tapped, make it speak a line.

works.title: Finger ray for far interaction
works.description: Instead of only touching what is within arm's reach, a ray shoots from the index finger so that simple pinch gestures can select and move posters hanging far away.
works.description_zh: 不再只能触碰手臂范围内的东西，而是从食指射出一条射线，用简单的捏合手势选择并移动远处挂着的海报。
works.idea_en: Extend bare-hand input beyond arm's reach with a pointing ray plus a pinch.
works.idea_zh: 用指向射线加捏合，把徒手交互扩展到手够不着的距离。
works.technique: A raycast from the camera through the tracked index fingertip picks targets, and Leap Motion pinch state confirms selection and drag.
works.technique_zh: 从相机经过被追踪的食指指尖做射线检测来选中目标，再用 Leap Motion 的捏合状态确认选择和拖拽。
works.exercise_en: Using a webcam hand tracker (e.g. MediaPipe), build a pointer that selects items on a far wall projection when you pinch. Twist: the ray bends toward the nearest target like a magnet.
works.exercise_zh: 用网络摄像头手部追踪（如 MediaPipe）做一个指针：捏合时选中远处墙面投影上的物体。变体：射线像磁铁一样向最近的目标弯曲。

video.video_title: Leap motion hand is usually used for arm-reached distance interactions, but I tried to shoot a ray from the index finger, and combining with basic gestures, now we can interact with contents that are

works.title: Floating by shadow offset
works.description: A small study showing that a virtual object reads as floating above a real surface just by separating it from its shadow, an idea inspired by designer Dixon Lo.
works.description_zh: 一个小研究：只要让虚拟物体和它的影子分开，看起来就像悬浮在真实桌面上，这个想法受设计师 Dixon Lo 启发。
works.idea_en: Shadows are the cheapest depth cue: move the shadow and the object seems to lift off.
works.idea_zh: 影子是最便宜的深度线索：把影子挪开，物体就像飘了起来。
works.technique: A blob shadow stays on the detected plane while the object's height is animated, so the gap between them conveys elevation.
works.technique_zh: 一个圆形软阴影固定在检测到的平面上，而物体高度做动画，两者之间的距离传达出高度感。
works.exercise_en: Put one virtual ball on a table in phone AR and test three versions: no shadow, attached shadow, offset shadow; ask classmates which floats. Twist: make the shadow move in the opposite direction of the ball.
works.exercise_zh: 在手机 AR 里把一个虚拟球放在桌上，做三个版本：无影子、贴地影子、偏移影子，请同学判断哪个在飘。变体：让影子朝球的反方向移动。

video.video_title: Make an object floating in AR by overlapping shadow. The concept is inspired by Dixon Lo. https://t.co/6KGW8p2K9n

works.title: Floating islands between real surfaces
works.description: Another Google prototype: low-poly floating islands, towers and trees are generated to fill the gaps between detected surfaces, so the fantasy scene seems to grow out of the room.
works.description_zh: 另一个 Google 原型：在检测到的平面之间生成低多边形的浮岛、高塔和树木，让奇幻场景看起来像是从房间里长出来的。
works.idea_en: Fill the empty space between real surfaces with generated content so AR fits the room.
works.idea_zh: 用生成的内容填满真实平面之间的空隙，让 AR 与房间契合。
works.technique: Multiple ARCore planes are used as anchors; islands are spawned at heights between them with procedural decoration.
works.technique_zh: 以多个 ARCore 平面作为锚点，在它们之间的高度生成浮岛，并程序化地添加装饰。
works.exercise_en: Generate a floating object at the midpoint height between the floor and a table in AR Foundation. Twist: its species depends on the distance between the two surfaces.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR Foundation 中，在地面和桌面之间的中间高度生成一个漂浮物。变体：它的种类取决于两个平面之间的距离。

video.video_title: Another prototype I made @GoogleARVR using #ARCore to procedurally generate AR content based on physical space. The concept can leverage multiple detected surfaces and generates floating islands in be

works.title: Force Feedback for Mixed Reality via EMS
works.description: On HoloLens, virtual buttons, walls and heavy objects push back: EMS on the user's arm muscles creates resistance so the user feels them without holding any device.
works.idea_zh: 在HoloLens里按虚拟按钮、推虚拟墙，手臂真的感到阻力。

video.video_title: Adding Force Feedback to Mixed Reality Experiences and Games using Electrical Muscle Stimulation

works.technique: Detects hand contact with virtual objects and stimulates antagonist muscles to create counter-force while leaving the hands free to touch real objects.
works.exercise_zh: 在手机AR里放置一面虚拟墙，当手机穿过墙时让手机持续强振动并变红来表示“阻力”；变化：用弹力带绑住手臂模拟推墙的真实阻力。
works.description_zh: 在 HoloLens 上，虚拟按钮、墙壁和重物都会“顶回来”：通过对用户手臂肌肉施加 EMS 产生阻力，用户无需手持任何设备就能感受到它们。
works.idea_en: Press a virtual button or push a virtual wall in HoloLens and your arm really feels the resistance.
works.technique_zh: 检测手与虚拟物体的接触，并刺激拮抗肌产生反作用力，同时让双手保持空闲，可以触摸真实物体。
works.exercise_en: Place a virtual wall in phone AR, and when the phone passes through it, make the phone vibrate strongly and turn red to signal 'resistance'. Twist: tie a resistance band to your arm to simulate the real resistance of pushing a wall.

works.title: Games of Deletion
works.description: A world-scale multiplayer mixed-reality game in which players tag and 'delete' urban art and architecture through their phones, competing over real city spaces.
works.idea_zh: 把城市里的建筑与街头艺术变成多人 AR 游戏里可以'抹除'和争夺的领地。

video.video_title: Games of Deletion - Realtime Demo

works.technique: Geolocated AR content is anchored to real urban sites and synced across players so each tag or deletion changes a shared world state.
works.exercise_zh: 在校园选 5 个建筑点，用 AR 给它们'涂鸦'或'擦除'并记录到共享地图上，两队比赛占领；加一个变化：被擦除的建筑在 AR 里真的变透明。
works.description_zh: 一款世界尺度的多人混合现实游戏：玩家通过手机标记并“删除”城市中的街头艺术和建筑，争夺真实的城市空间。
works.idea_en: Turn city buildings and street art into territory to erase and fight over in a multiplayer AR game.
works.technique_zh: 地理定位的 AR 内容锚定在真实的城市地点上，并在玩家之间同步，每一次标记或删除都会改变共享的世界状态。
works.exercise_en: Pick five buildings on campus, use AR to 'tag' or 'erase' them and record this on a shared map, with two teams competing to take them over. Twist: erased buildings actually turn transparent in AR.

works.title: Garden Friends
works.description: An AR + voice experiment with animator Eran Hilleli: you grow personalized trees and flowers on real surfaces by chatting with a quirky character, speech driving the scene.
works.idea_zh: 对着AR小植物说好话，它们就按你的对话长成独特的花草。

video.video_title: Garden Friends

works.technique: ARCore plane detection places plants on real surfaces, while speech recognition and an intent-matching dialog system (Dialogflow) map what you say to parameters that grow and style the plants.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 平面检测放一个小角色，用语音识别加关键词或 LLM 解析你说的话，决定长出什么花草；变体：角色只对夸奖有反应，骂它会让花园枯萎，体会“对机器说话”的礼貌。
works.description_zh: 与动画师 Eran Hilleli 合作的 AR 加语音实验：你和一个古怪的角色聊天，在真实表面上种出专属于你的树木和花朵，由话语驱动整个场景。
works.idea_en: Say nice things to little AR plants and they grow into unique flowers shaped by your conversation.
works.technique_zh: ARCore 平面检测把植物放在真实表面上，语音识别和意图匹配对话系统（Dialogflow）把你说的话映射成控制植物生长和外观的参数。
works.exercise_en: Place a small character with AR Foundation plane detection and use speech recognition plus keywords or an LLM to interpret what you say and decide which plants grow. Twist: the character responds only to praise, and scolding makes the garden wither, so you feel what politeness toward machines means.

works.title: Hand-summoned UI panel
works.description: A floating control panel glides into arm's reach only when the hand reaches for it and drifts back into the world when done; he imagined it for controlling smart lights, with a slider inspired by Leap Motion's Cat Explorer.
works.description_zh: 一个悬浮的控制面板只在手伸过去时才滑到手边，用完又退回空间里；他设想用于控制智能灯，滑杆设计参考了 Leap Motion 的 Cat Explorer。
works.idea_en: UI lives in the world but comes to your hand only when you need it.
works.idea_zh: 界面留在空间里，只在需要时才来到你手边。
works.technique: A hand-proximity trigger lerps the panel between a world anchor and a hand-relative anchor, with Leap Motion pinch detection driving the slider.
works.technique_zh: 通过手部接近触发，让面板在世界锚点和跟随手部的锚点之间插值移动，Leap Motion 的捏合检测驱动滑杆。
works.exercise_en: Create a WebXR or phone-AR panel that stays on a wall but slides toward the camera when you walk closer than one meter. Twist: it retreats faster if you look away.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个 WebXR 或手机 AR 面板：平时挂在墙上，你走到一米以内时它会滑向镜头。变体：你把视线移开时它会更快地退回去。

video.video_title: Make UI panel moves to hand-reached space only when it's needed, and back away when it's done. I am imagining it's used for AR + IoT scenario (e.g. controlling smart light). The handle bar of the slid

works.title: Hawkeye Access
works.description: The shipped version of his prototype: browse any website hands-free on iOS by looking at links and blinking to open them.
works.idea_zh: 把眼控原型做成可上架的免手浏览器，服务无障碍需求。

video.video_title: Hawkeye Access | Control your iOS device with your eyes

works.technique: Calibrated gaze estimation from ARKit face tracking is smoothed and mapped to web page link targets, with dwell or blink detection triggering navigation.
works.exercise_zh: 用 WebGazer.js 做一个网页，盯着某个链接 1.5 秒自动打开；变体：为一位特定用户（如手部受伤的人）设计凝视界面。
works.description_zh: 他那个原型的正式上架版本：在 iOS 上无需动手即可浏览任意网站，看向链接、眨眼即可打开。
works.idea_en: Turn an eye-control prototype into a hands-free browser on the App Store for accessibility.
works.technique_zh: 对 ARKit 人脸追踪得到的、经过校准的视线估计做平滑处理，映射到网页上的链接目标，并用停留或眨眼检测触发跳转。
works.exercise_en: Build a web page with WebGazer.js that opens a link automatically after you stare at it for 1.5 seconds. Twist: design a gaze interface for one specific user (such as someone with an injured hand).

works.title: HeadLight
works.description: A head-mounted projector with a fish-eye lens throws a very wide image onto the surroundings in front of the wearer, augmenting whatever the wearer faces without glasses.
works.idea_zh: 把投影仪戴在头上，眼前的整个空间就是屏幕。

video.video_title: HeadLight : a wearable wide-angle projector system for Egocentric visual augmentation.

works.technique: Pre-distorts the image to compensate for the fish-eye conversion lens and aligns it with head orientation so graphics land on the walls the wearer looks at.
works.exercise_zh: 用胶带把手机投影仪（或手机+镜子）固定在头盔上，让投影内容跟随视线出现在墙上；变化：投影内容是只有你转头时才会显现的“隐藏标记”。
works.description_zh: 一台装有鱼眼镜头的头戴式投影仪，把极宽的画面投射到佩戴者前方的环境中，无需眼镜就能增强佩戴者面对的一切。
works.idea_en: Wear a projector on your head and the whole space in front of you becomes a screen.
works.technique_zh: 预先对图像做畸变处理以补偿鱼眼转换镜头，并与头部朝向对齐，让图形落在佩戴者注视的墙面上。
works.exercise_en: Tape a phone projector (or a phone plus a mirror) to a helmet so the projected content appears on the wall wherever you look. Twist: project 'hidden markers' that appear only when you turn your head.

works.title: HoloRoyale
works.description: Teams of players in HoloLens headsets battle across a large real space, with virtual robots and projectiles that hide behind, bounce off and collide with the actual walls and furniture.
works.description_zh: 戴着 HoloLens 的多支队伍在大片真实空间中对战，虚拟机器人和子弹会躲在真实墙壁和家具后面，也会从上面弹开或撞上它们。
works.idea_en: A multiplayer AR game at building scale where virtual action respects real architecture.
works.idea_zh: 一款建筑尺度的多人 AR 游戏，虚拟动作遵守真实的建筑结构。
works.technique: Maps a large venue in advance and shares a common coordinate frame across HoloLens devices so virtual elements get occlusion and physics against the real geometry.
works.technique_zh: 预先扫描大型场地，并在多台 HoloLens 之间共享坐标系，让虚拟元素相对真实几何体产生遮挡和物理效果。
works.exercise_en: Design a shared phone AR capture-the-flag game for the school hall where flags hide behind real pillars, using a common anchor on the floor. Twist: add a rule that you can only shoot what the other team cannot see.
works.exercise_zh: 为学校礼堂设计一款共享的手机 AR 夺旗游戏，把旗子藏在真实柱子后面，大家使用地面上的同一个锚点；变体：加一条规则，只能射击对方队伍看不到的目标。

video.video_title: HoloRoyale: A Large Scale High Fidelity Augmented Reality Game

works.title: Holograms That React to Music in Your Room
works.description: Paint audio-reactive holograms all over a room that pulse and morph with whatever music is playing (with Stephen Hodgson).
works.idea_zh: 在房间各处布置会随音乐跳动的全息图形。

video.video_title: Holograms that react to music in your room

works.technique: Painted stroke meshes have shader parameters (scale, emission, displacement) driven by real-time FFT bands of the playing music.
works.exercise_zh: 用空中画线生成 3D 笔画，再用音乐的 FFT 频段控制笔画粗细和亮度；变体：每条笔画绑定不同频段，低音粗高音亮。
works.description_zh: 在房间各处画满随音乐反应的全息图形，它们会跟着正在播放的音乐跳动、变形（与 Stephen Hodgson 合作）。
works.idea_en: Fill your room with holographic shapes that pulse to the music.
works.technique_zh: 绘制出的笔画网格的着色器参数（缩放、自发光、位移）由正在播放的音乐的实时 FFT 频段驱动。
works.exercise_en: Draw lines in the air to create 3D strokes, then use the music's FFT bands to control stroke thickness and brightness. Twist: bind each stroke to a different band, so bass makes strokes thicker and treble makes them brighter.

works.title: Hybrid UIs for Music Exploration in AR and VR
works.description: People browse an online music library together: some wear AR or VR headsets and grab genres and albums floating in 3D, others flick through the same collection on touch screens.
works.description_zh: 大家一起浏览在线音乐库：有人戴着 AR 或 VR 头显抓取悬浮在三维空间里的流派和专辑，有人在触摸屏上翻看同一个曲库。
works.idea_en: Let 2D touch screens and 3D headsets share one music collection in the same room.
works.idea_zh: 让二维触摸屏和三维头显在同一房间里共享同一个音乐库。
works.technique: Synchronises a 3D music-library visualisation across head-worn displays and multi-touch tablets, combining 3D hand tracking with 2D touch input.
works.technique_zh: 在头戴显示器和多点触控平板之间同步三维音乐库可视化，结合三维手部追踪和二维触控输入。
works.exercise_en: Lay out album covers as AR cards floating around the classroom and let students on laptops add songs to a shared playlist that phone users see appear in space. Twist: place songs by tempo from floor to ceiling.
works.exercise_zh: 把专辑封面做成漂浮在教室各处的 AR 卡片，让用笔记本电脑的学生往共享歌单里加歌，手机用户会看到新歌出现在空间中；变体：按节奏快慢把歌曲从地面排到天花板。

video.video_title: Hybrid UIs for Music Exploration in AR and VR

works.title: HydroRing
works.description: A thin ring pumps warm, cold or pulsing liquid through a latex tube on the fingertip to create pressure, vibration and temperature cues while leaving touch of real objects intact.
works.idea_zh: 用流动的液体在指尖产生冷热和压感，又不妨碍摸真实物体。

video.video_title: HydroRing: Supporting Mixed Reality Haptics using Liquid Flow

works.technique: Drives liquid through a thin tube over the fingerpad with pumps and heaters, modulating flow and temperature to render haptic effects.
works.exercise_zh: 让同学手指分别接触冷水袋和温水袋，同时在手机AR中看到“冰块/火焰”，讨论视觉与触觉一致时的真实感；变化：故意让视觉与温度相反。
works.description_zh: 一枚薄薄的指环，通过指尖上的乳胶管泵送温热、冰凉或脉动的液体，产生压力、振动和温度提示，同时不妨碍触摸真实物体。
works.idea_en: Use flowing liquid to create heat, cold and pressure at your fingertip without getting in the way of touching real things.
works.technique_zh: 用泵和加热器驱动液体流过贴在指腹上的细管，通过调节流量和温度呈现触觉效果。
works.exercise_en: Have classmates touch a cold water bag and a warm water bag with their fingers while seeing 'ice' or 'fire' in phone AR, and discuss how realistic it feels when sight and touch match. Twist: deliberately make the visuals contradict the temperature.

works.title: Indirect AR Browser for GIS Data
works.description: Pointing a phone at a street shows a pre-captured street-level panorama aligned to the view, with buildings and landmarks labelled perfectly because the labels live on the stored image.
works.description_zh: 把手机对准街道，屏幕显示与视角对齐的预采集街景全景图，建筑和地标的标签贴合得非常准确，因为标签是贴在存储图像上的。
works.idea_en: When live tracking is unreliable, augment a stored photo of the scene instead of the camera feed.
works.idea_zh: 实时追踪不可靠时，就去增强场景的存储照片，而不是摄像头画面。
works.technique: Replaces the live camera with crowd-sourced street-level imagery oriented by the phone's sensors and overlays geospatial data registered to that imagery.
works.technique_zh: 用手机传感器定向的众包街景图像替代实时摄像头画面，再把与图像配准的地理数据叠加上去。
works.exercise_en: Take a 360 photo of the school entrance, add labels on it in an editor, then show it on a phone that rotates with your gaze while standing at the same spot. Twist: switch between today's photo and an old photo of the same place.
works.exercise_zh: 在学校门口拍一张 360 度照片，在编辑器里加上标签，然后站在同一位置用会随视线转动的手机观看；变体：在今天的照片和同一地点的老照片之间切换。

video.video_title: Indirect Augmented Reality Browser for GIS Data

works.title: Instructions in AR
works.description: Hand-written technical instructions are attached to the real device they explain, using live image tracking.
works.idea_zh: 把手写的操作说明贴在它所说明的真实设备上。

video.video_title: Instructions in AR

works.technique: A photo of the device's panel is used as a reference image, and handwritten instruction images are attached as overlays at fixed offsets on the tracked image.
works.exercise_zh: 拍下打印机或咖啡机的面板作为识别图，在对应按钮旁贴上手写步骤说明；变体：步骤按顺序逐个出现，完成一步点一下再显示下一步。
works.description_zh: 借助实时图像追踪，把手写的技术说明贴在它所说明的真实设备上。
works.idea_en: Stick handwritten instructions onto the real device they explain.
works.technique_zh: 把设备面板的照片用作参考图像，手写说明图片以固定偏移作为叠加层附着在被追踪的图像上。
works.exercise_en: Photograph a printer or coffee machine panel as the recognition image and pin handwritten step instructions next to the matching buttons. Twist: steps appear one at a time, and each tap reveals the next.

works.title: It's Lit! Projected AR Murals
works.description: Lettering artist Gemma O'Brien and Craig Winslow hand-paint a mural, then Lightform projects animated light that traces, fills and reveals the painted letters.
works.idea_zh: 手绘壁画 + 投影动画，让静态字母“亮”起来。

video.video_title: It’s Lit! Make Projected AR Murals with Lightform

works.technique: Scans the painted mural to extract its line work, then uses those edges as masks and paths for projected animated effects.
works.exercise_zh: 让学生在白纸板上用黑色马克笔写大字，再用投影仪和免费投影映射软件（如MapMap）沿笔画投射流光；变化：用声音音量控制光的亮度。
works.description_zh: 字体艺术家 Gemma O'Brien 和 Craig Winslow 手绘了一幅壁画，随后 Lightform 投射动画光影，沿着笔画勾勒、填充并逐步显现出画上的字母。
