works.idea_en: A hand-painted mural plus projected animation makes still letters light up.
works.technique_zh: 扫描手绘壁画以提取线稿，再把这些边缘用作投影动画效果的遮罩和路径。
works.exercise_en: Have students write large letters with a black marker on white board, then use a projector and free projection-mapping software (such as MapMap) to send flowing light along the strokes. Twist: control the light's brightness with sound volume.

works.title: JIDO-RHYTHM Selfie Music Video
works.description: A selfie music-video app that deforms and animates your tracked face in time with the music.
works.idea_zh: 自拍音乐视频：脸部被追踪并随节奏变形。

video.video_title: Face Deformation / JIDO-RHYTHM

works.technique: ARKit face tracking provides a face mesh whose vertices are displaced by audio-analysis values (beat and amplitude), so the face deforms in time with music.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Lens Studio 或 MediaPipe Face Mesh 做一个随音乐节拍拉伸脸部的滤镜；变体：用你自己的哼唱而不是背景音乐驱动变形。
works.description_zh: 一款自拍音乐视频应用，让被追踪的脸随着音乐节奏变形、舞动。
works.idea_en: A selfie music video where your tracked face warps to the beat.
works.technique_zh: ARKit 人脸追踪提供面部网格，其顶点根据音频分析值（节拍和振幅）发生位移，让脸随音乐节奏变形。
works.exercise_en: Use Lens Studio or MediaPipe Face Mesh to build a filter that stretches the face to the music's beat. Twist: drive the deformation with your own humming instead of background music.

works.title: Jumping across real surfaces
works.description: A character controlled by an on-screen joystick jumps between several real surfaces detected by ARCore, turning a table and the floor into platforms.
works.description_zh: 用屏幕上的虚拟摇杆控制一个角色，在 ARCore 检测到的多个真实平面之间跳跃，把桌子和地面变成平台关卡。
works.idea_en: Real furniture becomes platforms in a platformer game.
works.idea_zh: 真实家具变成平台跳跃游戏的平台。
works.technique: ARCore planes get colliders so a physics-driven character controller can land on them.
works.technique_zh: 给 ARCore 平面加上碰撞体，让基于物理的角色控制器可以落在上面。
works.exercise_en: Build a one-button jumping game on AR Foundation planes. Twist: the character can only land on surfaces of a certain color.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR Foundation 平面上做一个单键跳跃游戏。变体：角色只能落在某种颜色的表面上。

video.video_title: Using virtual joystick to control a character jump on multiple physical surfaces with ARCore. https://t.co/11og8dDHQH

works.title: Just a Line
works.description: A minimal ARCore/ARKit app for drawing a single white line in the air; two people on Android and iPhone can draw together in the same space, and the result is a shareable video.
works.idea_zh: 只画一条线的AR涂鸦App，而且安卓和iPhone可以同场一起画。

video.video_title: Just a Line: The first cross-platform collaborative AR app (for doodling)

works.technique: The line is built from successive camera or touch-ray positions in world space extruded into a ribbon mesh, and Cloud Anchors share the anchor so two phones draw together.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 把手机移动时的位置连成一条 3D 线，再录屏导出；变体：线只能画一笔，中途松手就结束。
works.description_zh: 一款极简的 ARCore/ARKit 应用，只能在空中画一条白线；Android 和 iPhone 用户可以在同一空间里一起画，最终生成一段可分享的视频。
works.idea_en: An AR doodle app that draws just one line, and Android and iPhone users can draw together in the same space.
works.technique_zh: 把世界空间中连续的相机位置或触摸射线位置连起来，挤出成丝带状网格形成线条，再用 Cloud Anchors 共享锚点，让两部手机一起作画。
works.exercise_en: Use AR Foundation to connect the phone's positions as it moves into a 3D line, then record and export the screen. Twist: you get only one stroke, and lifting your finger ends it.

works.title: Just a Line with Shantell Martin
works.description: Artist Shantell Martin extends her signature continuous black-line drawings into the air around her using Just a Line.
works.idea_zh: 艺术家把标志性的连续线条从墙面画进空气里。

video.video_title: Shantell Martin: See the world as your canvas with AR

works.technique: The same world-space line drawing is used by an artist whose single continuous stroke becomes a spatial drawing around her body.
works.exercise_zh: 邀请一位同学在 AR 中用一笔画绕着自己的身体画一幅画，并从多角度录像；变体：把画出来的线导出为模型，再 3D 打印。
works.description_zh: 艺术家 Shantell Martin 借助 Just a Line，把她标志性的连续黑色线条画延伸到身边的空气里。
works.idea_en: An artist carries her signature continuous line off the wall and into the air.
works.technique_zh: 沿用同样的世界空间画线技术，艺术家一笔到底的连续笔画变成了环绕她身体的空间绘画。
works.exercise_en: Invite a classmate to draw a single-stroke picture around their own body in AR and film it from several angles. Twist: export the line as a model and 3D print it.

works.title: Kitchen Timers in Augmented Reality
works.description: Countdown timers float above real pots on the stove, rendered with motion blur, adaptive lighting and depth of field.
works.idea_zh: 让倒计时器悬浮在灶台上正在煮的锅上方。

video.video_title: Kitchen timers in augmented reality - iPhone ARKit demo

works.technique: Timers are placed as world anchors above detected pots, and renderer features (light estimation, motion blur, depth of field) make the overlay match the camera image.
works.exercise_zh: 点击锅的位置放一个悬浮倒计时，到时间变红并响铃；变体：多个计时器同时运行，按剩余时间自动排序高亮。
works.description_zh: 倒计时器悬浮在炉灶上真实的锅子上方，并带有运动模糊、自适应光照和景深效果。
works.idea_en: Float countdown timers above the pots cooking on the stove.
works.technique_zh: 计时器以世界锚点的形式放置在检测到的锅子上方，并借助渲染特性（光照估计、运动模糊、景深）使叠加层与相机画面融为一体。
works.exercise_en: Tap on a pot to place a floating countdown that turns red and rings when time is up. Twist: run several timers at once, automatically sorted and highlighted by time remaining.

works.title: La Tabla
works.description: A game table in Dynamicland where physical game pieces and paper cards drive projected gameplay, shown at GDC's Experimental Gameplay Workshop.
works.idea_zh: 用真实卡片和棋子在投影桌上玩的'可编程'游戏。

video.video_title: La Tabla at the Experimental Gameplay Workshop, Mar 2018

works.technique: Realtalk's camera recognizes game pieces and paper cards by printed dot codes, and projection renders gameplay whose rules are themselves printed programs lying on the table.
works.exercise_zh: 用俯视投影 + ArUco 标记做一个桌游：棋子移动后投影显示路径和效果，桌边一张“规则卡”换成另一张时游戏规则随之改变；变体：让玩家在游戏中途修改规则卡。
works.description_zh: Dynamicland 中的一张游戏桌，实体棋子和纸质卡片驱动投影出来的游戏过程，曾在 GDC 的 Experimental Gameplay Workshop 上展示。
works.idea_en: A 'programmable' game played on a projection table with real cards and pieces.
works.technique_zh: Realtalk 的相机通过印刷的点阵码识别棋子和纸卡，投影则渲染游戏过程，而游戏规则本身就是摆在桌上的打印程序。
works.exercise_en: Build a board game with top-down projection and ArUco markers: when a piece moves, the projection shows its path and effects, and swapping the 'rule card' at the table's edge changes the rules. Twist: let players change the rule cards mid-game.

works.title: Live VR Painting at the Louvre
works.description: In a live performance at the Louvre, the artist paints a three-dimensional interpretation of Delacroix's 'Liberty Leading the People' in VR while visitors watch the strokes appear on screens.
works.description_zh: 在卢浮宫的一场现场表演中，艺术家用 VR 画出德拉克洛瓦《自由引导人民》的三维诠释，观众通过屏幕看着笔触一笔笔出现。
works.idea_en: Step inside a famous painting and rebuild it as a space.
works.idea_zh: 走进一幅名画，把它重建成一个空间。
works.technique: A tracked VR headset with Tilt Brush is mirrored to large displays so the audience sees the 3D painting grow in real time.
works.technique_zh: 带追踪的 VR 头显运行 Tilt Brush，画面同步投到大屏上，观众可以实时看到三维画作逐渐生长。
works.exercise_en: Pick a classic painting and rebuild it as a 3D scene in an XR drawing tool, deciding what lies behind each figure. Twist: present it live while a partner narrates the history of the original.
works.exercise_zh: 选一幅经典名画，用 XR 绘画工具把它重建成三维场景，决定每个人物身后是什么；变体：现场作画，同时由搭档讲述原作的历史。

video.video_title: Live performance at the Louvre Museum Paris (virtual reality art)

works.title: LumiWatch
works.description: The first fully functional projection smartwatch: a laser projector and depth sensing put a touchscreen on your forearm.
works.idea_zh: 第一块真正能用的投影手表，把触控屏直接打在你的前臂上。

video.video_title: LumiWatch: On-Arm Projected Graphics and Touch Input

works.technique: A small laser-scanning projector in the watch body projects onto the forearm with keystone correction, and a row of time-of-flight sensors along the watch edge measures finger position along the arm for 1D/2D touch.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机当“手表”：通过手机前置摄像头 + MediaPipe 检测手指在手臂上的位置，映射为一条滑块控制音量，并用小投影或屏幕显示反馈；变体：设计一个只能在手臂上完成、无法在手机屏幕上做的交互。
works.description_zh: 第一款功能完备的投影智能手表：激光投影仪加上深度感知，把一块触摸屏投到你的前臂上。
works.idea_en: The first projection watch that really works, putting a touch screen right on your forearm.
works.technique_zh: 表身内的小型激光扫描投影仪经梯形校正后投射到前臂上，表壳边缘的一排飞行时间（ToF）传感器测量手指在手臂上的位置，实现一维/二维触控。
works.exercise_en: Use a phone as the 'watch': detect your finger's position on your arm with the front camera and MediaPipe, map it to a slider that controls volume, and show feedback with a small projector or the screen. Twist: design an interaction that only works on the arm and cannot be done on a phone screen.

works.title: MIDAS Projection
works.description: Markerless, model-less dynamic projection mapping that makes objects appear to be made of a different material (metal, wood) while they move.
works.idea_zh: 不需要标记和模型，让移动中的物体看起来换了一种材质。

video.video_title: MIDAS Projection: Markerless and Modelless Dynamic Projection Mapping for Material Representation

works.technique: High-speed depth sensing measures the moving object's surface normals each frame, and a material shading model (e.g. metal reflections, wood grain) is computed per frame and projected so the object appears to be made of that material.
works.exercise_zh: 用深度相机或已知形状（白色立方体）估计表面法线，在 TouchDesigner 中渲染金属或木纹材质并投影回物体，转动物体观察高光是否跟随；变体：让物体看起来是“液体”或“毛绒”材质。
works.description_zh: 无需标记、也无需模型的动态投影映射，让物体在移动时看起来像是由另一种材质（金属、木头）做成的。
works.idea_en: Without markers or models, make a moving object look like it is made of a different material.
works.technique_zh: 高速深度感知每帧测量移动物体的表面法线，逐帧计算材质着色模型（例如金属反射、木纹）并投射出去，让物体看起来就是由这种材质制成的。
works.exercise_en: Estimate surface normals with a depth camera or a known shape (a white cube), render a metal or wood material in TouchDesigner and project it back onto the object, then rotate the object to see whether the highlights follow. Twist: make the object look like 'liquid' or 'fur'.

works.title: MRTouch
works.description: Adds touch input on real walls and tables to HoloLens: users drag out virtual screens on any surface and tap them directly.
works.idea_zh: 让HoloLens的全息界面贴在真实墙面上，可以直接用手指点按。

video.video_title: MRTouch: Adding Touch Input to Head-Mounted Mixed Reality

works.technique: HoloLens depth frames are segmented into planar surfaces, fingertips are detected in depth, and a touch is registered when the fingertip is within a small distance of the plane, letting users drag out virtual screens on real surfaces.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR Foundation 中检测墙面平面，用 AR 手部追踪或 MediaPipe 指尖位置判断是否贴近平面，贴近时可拉出一个矩形屏幕并在上面点击；变体：在门、窗、黑板上各放一个与其功能相关的虚拟屏幕。
works.description_zh: 为 HoloLens 增加了在真实墙面和桌面上的触控输入：用户可以在任意表面上拉出虚拟屏幕，并直接点按。
works.idea_en: Stick HoloLens holographic interfaces onto real walls and tap them directly with a finger.
works.technique_zh: 把 HoloLens 的深度帧分割成若干平面，在深度图中检测指尖，当指尖与平面的距离小于一个很小的阈值时记为一次触摸，让用户在真实表面上拉出虚拟屏幕。
works.exercise_en: Detect a wall plane in AR Foundation and use AR hand tracking or MediaPipe fingertip positions to tell whether a finger is close to it; when it is, let the user drag out a rectangular screen and tap on it. Twist: place a virtual screen related to each object's function on a door, a window and a blackboard.

works.title: Magic Leap Create
works.description: A mixed-reality toy box: place dinosaurs, knights, dominoes and paint strokes in your room, and they fight, topple and bounce off real furniture.
works.idea_zh: 在客厅里摆放恐龙、骑士和多米诺，它们会与真实家具互动。

video.video_title: Project Create (Magic Leap Studios) - Magic Leap

works.technique: Uses the headset's world mesh as a physics collider so user-placed toys and strokes land on, bounce off and hide behind real surfaces.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机AR的平面检测+物理（Reality Composer或Unity AR Foundation）搭一条跨越桌子和地面的虚拟多米诺；变化：必须利用一个真实物体作为机关。
works.description_zh: 一个混合现实玩具箱：在房间里摆上恐龙、骑士、多米诺骨牌和彩绘笔画，它们会打斗、倒下，并在真实家具上弹来弹去。
works.idea_en: Set dinosaurs, knights and dominoes loose in your living room, where they interact with real furniture.
works.technique_zh: 把头显的世界网格用作物理碰撞体，让用户放置的玩具和笔画能落在真实表面上、从上面弹开，或躲到它们后面。
works.exercise_en: Use phone AR plane detection plus physics (Reality Composer or Unity AR Foundation) to build a virtual domino run that spans a table and the floor. Twist: it must use a real object as part of the contraption.

works.title: MathArt Lens
works.description: An early Snapchat world Lens that places a large, colourful parametric math sculpture in the room, which the user can walk around through the camera.
works.description_zh: 早期的 Snapchat 世界 Lens，在房间里放置一座大型、彩色的参数化数学雕塑，用户可以透过镜头绕着它走。
works.idea_en: Turn an equation into a sculpture you can stand next to.
works.idea_zh: 把一个方程变成可以站在旁边端详的雕塑。
works.technique: A parametric surface mesh (likely generated from a mathematical function) is placed with Lens Studio world tracking and ground detection.
works.technique_zh: 用 Lens Studio 的世界追踪和地面识别放置一个参数化曲面网格（很可能由数学函数生成）。
works.exercise_en: Generate a 3D surface from a math function in Python or Blender and place it at human scale in AR. Twist: let a slider change one parameter so the sculpture morphs live.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Python 或 Blender 根据一个数学函数生成 3D 曲面，并以人体尺度放进 AR；变体：加一个滑块改变某个参数，让雕塑实时变形。

video.video_title: Math Art Snapchat Lens

works.title: Mediate: A Spatial Tangible Interface for Mixed Reality
works.description: A shape-changing tangible interface that physically represents virtual content inside mixed reality, bridging headset holograms and touchable form.
works.idea_zh: 给混合现实里的虚拟物体配上可触摸、会变形的实体替身。

video.video_title: Mediate: A Spatial Tangible Interface for Mixed Reality

works.technique: A shape-changing tangible device is spatially registered to the MR headset so that its physical form is actuated to match the virtual object the user is reaching for, providing passive haptic proxy feedback.
works.exercise_zh: 在 HoloKit 或手机 AR 中把一个实体盒子注册为虚拟物体的“替身”，当虚拟物体变形时提示同学手动调整盒子（或用舵机撑开），让手摸到的形状与看到的一致；变体：故意让看到的和摸到的不一致，测试多大差别会被察觉。
works.description_zh: 一种可变形的实体交互界面，在混合现实中以物理形态呈现虚拟内容，连接起头显中的全息影像与可触摸的形体。
works.idea_en: Give virtual objects in mixed reality a touchable, shape-changing physical stand-in.
works.technique_zh: 可变形的实体装置在空间上与 MR 头显配准，其物理形态会被驱动变形，以匹配用户伸手去触碰的虚拟物体，从而提供被动的触觉代理反馈。
works.exercise_en: Register a physical box as the 'stand-in' for a virtual object in HoloKit or phone AR, and when the virtual object changes shape, prompt a classmate to adjust the box by hand (or push it open with a servo) so what the hand feels matches what the eye sees. Twist: deliberately mismatch what is seen and felt, and test how big a difference people notice.

works.title: Memes + AR with Watson
works.description: Say a phrase aloud and the matching meme image is searched and dropped into the room on a detected ground plane.
works.idea_zh: 说出一句话，对应的表情包就出现在房间里。

video.video_title: Let’s Make A Unity App (MEMES + AR)

works.technique: Speech-to-text (IBM Watson) extracts a phrase, an image search API returns a matching image, and the image is spawned as a textured quad on a detected ground plane.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Web Speech API 识别一句话，从本地图库中按关键词找图并在 WebXR 地面上生成一张图片卡片；变体：图片大小随说话音量变化。
works.description_zh: 大声说出一句话，系统就会搜索对应的表情包图片，并把它放到房间里检测到的地面上。
works.idea_en: Say a phrase and the matching meme appears in your room.
works.technique_zh: 语音转文字（IBM Watson）提取短语，图片搜索 API 返回匹配的图片，再把图片作为带纹理的四边形生成在检测到的地面平面上。
works.exercise_en: Recognize a spoken phrase with the Web Speech API, find a matching image in a local library by keyword, and spawn it as an image card on the floor in WebXR. Twist: the image size follows how loudly you speak.

works.title: Merger
works.description: A 360-degree film of an office worker whose entire workspace is a floating AR interface, controlled by hand and voice, as she fights to stay relevant against automation.
works.idea_zh: 未来白领被全息工作界面包围，用手势对抗AI取代的焦虑

video.video_title: Merger

works.technique: 360-degree rendered film of a head-centred UI sphere; a live equivalent uses a headset with hand tracking and floating panels arranged on a body-anchored cylinder.
works.exercise_zh: 用 HoloKit 或 WebXR 做一个环绕自己的多窗口工作界面，用手势或捏合切换任务；变体：让窗口数量随时间不断增加，直到用户必须“放弃”某些任务才能看清前方。
works.description_zh: 一部 360 度影片，讲述一位上班族的整个工作空间都是一个悬浮的 AR 界面，她用手势和语音操控它，拼命不让自己被自动化淘汰。
works.idea_en: A future office worker, surrounded by holographic work screens, fights off the fear of being replaced by AI with hand gestures.
works.technique_zh: 以头部为中心的 UI 球面被渲染成 360 度影片；若要实时实现，可以用带手部追踪的头显，把悬浮面板排布在以身体为锚点的圆柱面上。
works.exercise_en: Build a multi-window work interface that surrounds you in HoloKit or WebXR, switching tasks with gestures or pinches. Twist: keep adding windows over time until the user must 'give up' some tasks to see what is in front of them.

works.title: Mica
works.description: A photoreal digital human sits at your real table, makes eye contact, reacts to your gaze and shares small moments without speaking.
works.idea_zh: 一个会和你对视、坐在你真实桌旁的数字人。

video.video_title: Magic Leap's Mica Artificial Human From LeapCon

works.technique: Drives the character's gaze and expressions from the user's tracked eye direction and anchors her to detected table and chair surfaces.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机AR放置一个虚拟角色，使其头部始终转向手机镜头（LookAt），让同学体验被注视的感觉；变化：角色只在你不看它时移动。
works.description_zh: 一个照片级逼真的数字人坐在你真实的桌旁，与你目光交汇，对你的注视做出反应，不说一句话却与你分享一些小小的瞬间。
works.idea_en: A digital human who sits at your real table and meets your gaze.
works.technique_zh: 根据被追踪的用户视线方向驱动角色的目光和表情，并把她锚定在检测到的桌面和椅子表面上。
works.exercise_en: Place a virtual character with phone AR whose head always turns toward the phone camera (LookAt), so classmates feel what it is like to be watched. Twist: the character moves only when you are not looking at it.

works.title: Mini-Me
works.description: A remote VR collaborator appears as an adaptive miniature avatar that always stays in view of the AR user, with gaze and pointing redirected to stay accurate.
works.idea_zh: 远程伙伴变成始终在你视线里的'迷你小人'，指向和视线依旧准确。

video.video_title: Mini-Me: An Adaptive Avatar for Mixed Reality  Remote Collaboration

works.technique: The remote VR user's avatar is scaled down and repositioned to stay within the AR user's field of view, while their gaze and pointing directions are retargeted so they still point at the correct objects.
works.exercise_zh: 在手机 AR 中放一个小人化身，始终跟随在屏幕边缘可见位置，远端同学点击某个物体时，小人转身指向它；变体：给小人加上情绪表达（点头、疑惑），测试它能否替代语音。
works.description_zh: 远程 VR 协作者以一个可自适应的迷你化身出现，始终保持在 AR 用户的视野之内，其视线和指向经过重定向，依然保持准确。
works.idea_en: A remote partner becomes a 'mini-me' that always stays in your view, still pointing and looking accurately.
works.technique_zh: 远程 VR 用户的化身被缩小并重新定位，以保持在 AR 用户的视野范围内，同时对其视线和指向方向做重定向，使它们仍然指向正确的物体。
works.exercise_en: Place a small avatar in phone AR that always stays visible at the edge of the screen, and when a remote classmate taps an object, the avatar turns to point at it. Twist: give the avatar emotional gestures (nodding, looking puzzled) and test whether they can replace voice.

works.title: Mixed Reality Test
works.description: A small demo mixing VR and AR: an ARKit iPhone and a VR headset share the same Normcore session so the phone sees the VR player's world placed in the real room.
works.idea_zh: 让iPhone AR与VR头显共享同一个多人空间。

video.video_title: Mixed Reality Test - November 2018

works.technique: A networked session (Normcore) shares object and player transforms, and the AR phone aligns its world origin to the VR play space so VR content appears in the real room.
works.exercise_zh: 让一台电脑上的 Unity 场景和一台手机 AR 共享同一组物体位置，电脑上移动的物体在手机里实时出现在桌面上；变体：手机也可以反过来推动物体。
works.description_zh: 一个混合 VR 与 AR 的小演示：一部 ARKit iPhone 和一台 VR 头显共享同一个 Normcore 会话，手机便能看到 VR 玩家的世界被放置在真实房间里。
works.idea_en: Let iPhone AR and a VR headset share the same multiplayer space.
works.technique_zh: 联网会话（Normcore）共享物体和玩家的变换，AR 手机把自己的世界原点对齐到 VR 游玩空间，使 VR 内容出现在真实房间中。
works.exercise_en: Have a Unity scene on a computer and a phone AR app share the same set of object positions, so objects moved on the computer show up on the phone's tabletop in real time. Twist: the phone can push objects back the other way.

works.title: Move Mirror
works.description: A web experiment where you move in front of your webcam and, frame by frame, it finds a photo of someone else in the same pose, turning your dance into a flipbook of strangers.
works.description_zh: 一个网页实验：你在摄像头前动起来，它会逐帧找到姿势相同的另一个人的照片，把你的舞蹈变成一本由陌生人组成的翻页书。
works.idea_en: Your body becomes a search query that finds strangers striking the same pose.
works.idea_zh: 你的身体变成一个搜索词，去找到摆出同样姿势的陌生人。
works.technique: PoseNet in TensorFlow.js estimates body keypoints in the browser and matches them against a database of pose vectors from 80,000 images.
works.technique_zh: 在浏览器中用 TensorFlow.js 的 PoseNet 估计身体关键点，再与 8 万张图片的姿势向量数据库进行匹配。
works.exercise_en: Collect 50 pose photos from classmates, then build a webcam page that shows the closest-matching photo to your current pose. Twist: match poses between two live webcams instead of a database.
works.exercise_zh: 收集同学们的 50 张姿势照片，做一个网页，用摄像头实时显示与你当前姿势最接近的照片；变体：不用数据库，改为在两个实时摄像头之间匹配姿势。

video.video_title: AI Experiments: Move Mirror

works.title: NYU Holodeck
works.description: The NSF-funded Holodeck project combines motion capture, headsets and Chalktalk into shared mixed reality for teaching and collaboration.
works.idea_zh: 把共享混合现实做成可以一起上课、协作的'全息甲板'。

video.video_title: NYU Holodeck: The Future Reality Lab with Ken Perlin

works.technique: Room-scale optical motion capture, networked headsets and a shared scene-graph server let multiple users and Chalktalk content occupy one synchronized mixed-reality space.
works.exercise_zh: 设计并测试一节 10 分钟的“共享 AR 小课”：用共享锚点让全班手机看到同一个 3D 模型（如心脏或分子），讲者点击时所有人看到同一个高亮；变体：让学生可以举手（在 AR 里放标记）向讲者提问。
works.description_zh: 由美国国家科学基金会（NSF）资助的 Holodeck 项目，把动作捕捉、头显和 Chalktalk 结合成一个共享的混合现实空间，用于教学与协作。
works.idea_en: Turn shared mixed reality into a 'holodeck' where people take classes and collaborate together.
works.technique_zh: 房间尺度的光学动作捕捉、联网头显和共享场景图服务器，让多名用户与 Chalktalk 内容共处于同一个同步的混合现实空间。
works.exercise_en: Design and test a 10-minute 'shared AR mini-lesson': use a shared anchor so every phone in the class sees the same 3D model (such as a heart or a molecule), and when the speaker taps it, everyone sees the same highlight. Twist: let students raise a hand (by placing a marker in AR) to ask the speaker a question.

works.title: Outside the Wall
works.description: A mixed-reality installation of a table, chair and domestic objects viewed through an iPad, where virtual elements break out of the domestic wall into the space.
works.idea_zh: 透过平板，家里的墙被打破，外面的世界涌进来
works.technique: An iOS AR app registers virtual content to a physical arrangement of furniture and objects so the scene extends beyond the real wall.
works.exercise_zh: 摆一张桌子和几件日常物，用AR让墙面“破开”显示另一个世界；变化：物体被移动后，墙外的景象也随之改变。

video.video_title: Outside the Wall

works.description_zh: 一件混合现实装置，由一张桌子、一把椅子和一些家居物品组成；透过 iPad 观看时，虚拟元素冲破家中的墙壁，涌入空间。
works.idea_en: Through a tablet, the wall at home breaks open and the outside world pours in.
works.technique_zh: iOS AR 应用把虚拟内容与家具和物品的实体摆设配准，使场景延伸到真实墙面之外。
works.exercise_en: Arrange a table and a few everyday objects, and use AR to 'break open' the wall and show another world. Twist: when the objects are moved, the view beyond the wall changes too.

works.title: Practice Makes Perfect (North Star)
works.description: On the Project North Star headset a player uses a real table and paddle; a hand gesture summons a virtual ball, an AI opponent returns it, and predicted flight paths and light trails coach the player's form.
works.idea_zh: 真实球台和球拍，虚拟的球和AI对手，外加预测轨迹帮你练球。

video.video_title: Practice Makes Perfect

works.technique: Tracks the paddle and hands, simulates the virtual ball with parabolic equations of motion, and renders predicted trajectories with the headset's low latency and wide field of view.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机AR在桌面上标出一个“最佳落点”靶区，同学抛纸团命中时计分；变化：靶区随每次命中移动，并显示上一球的轨迹。
works.description_zh: 在 Project North Star 头显上，玩家使用真实的球桌和球拍：一个手势召唤出虚拟球，AI 对手把球打回来，预测飞行轨迹和光迹则帮助玩家纠正动作。
works.idea_en: A real table and paddle, a virtual ball and an AI opponent, plus predicted trajectories to help you practice.
works.technique_zh: 追踪球拍和双手，用抛物线运动方程模拟虚拟球，并借助头显的低延迟和宽视场渲染预测轨迹。
works.exercise_en: Mark a 'best landing spot' target zone on a table in phone AR and score when classmates hit it with a paper ball. Twist: the target moves after each hit and shows the path of the previous throw.

works.title: Project North Star: Desk UI
works.description: A North Star prototype that attaches holographic interfaces to a real desk, with virtual panels and widgets that you touch and manipulate as if they were physical desk objects.
works.idea_zh: 把全息界面贴附在真实书桌上，像实物一样触摸操作。

video.video_title: Project North Star: Desk UI

works.technique: UI panels are anchored to a calibrated desk surface and respond to fingertip proximity and press depth, so virtual widgets behave like physical objects on the desk.
works.exercise_zh: 在桌面上放一个 AR 小抽屉，用手指拉开后里面出现今天的待办事项；变体：把待办事项做成可以拿起丢进垃圾桶的纸团。
works.description_zh: 一个 North Star 原型，把全息界面附着在真实书桌上，虚拟面板和小部件可以像桌上的实物一样被触摸和操作。
works.idea_en: Attach holographic interfaces to a real desk and touch them like physical objects.
works.technique_zh: UI 面板锚定在经过标定的桌面上，并根据指尖的接近程度和按压深度做出响应，使虚拟小部件的表现如同桌上的实体物件。
works.exercise_en: Place a small AR drawer on the desk that reveals today's to-do list when pulled open with a finger. Twist: turn each to-do item into a paper ball you can pick up and throw into a trash can.

works.title: Project North Star: Exploring Augmented Reality
works.description: Footage shot through the North Star AR headset showing bare-hand interactions: virtual objects, menus and effects you grab, pinch and swipe with tracked hands.
works.idea_zh: 用开源宽视场AR头显探索裸手操作全息内容的交互语言。

video.video_title: Project North Star: Exploring Augmented Reality

works.technique: Leap Motion hand tracking provides articulated hand skeletons, and physics-based grab and pinch detection lets users manipulate virtual objects without controllers in an optical see-through display.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe Hands 或 HoloKit 手势识别做一个可以用捏合抓起、用挥手扔出的 AR 方块；变体：抓起的物体会随手的速度留下拖尾。
works.description_zh: 透过 North Star AR 头显拍摄的影像，展示裸手交互：用被追踪的双手抓取、捏合和滑动各种虚拟物体、菜单和效果。
works.idea_en: Use an open-source wide-field AR headset to explore an interaction language for handling holograms with bare hands.
works.technique_zh: Leap Motion 手部追踪提供带关节的手部骨骼，基于物理的抓取和捏合检测让用户在光学透视显示中无需手柄即可操作虚拟物体。
works.exercise_en: Use MediaPipe Hands or HoloKit gesture recognition to make an AR cube you can pick up with a pinch and throw with a wave. Twist: a grabbed object leaves a trail that follows the speed of your hand.

works.title: ProtoAR
works.description: Designers sketch on paper and shape Play-Doh, capture them with a phone, and immediately place the captured 2D/3D assets in a working mobile AR prototype.
works.idea_zh: 纸上画、橡皮泥捏，拍一下就变成可用的AR原型。

video.video_title: ProtoAR: Rapid Physical-Digital Prototyping of Mobile Augmented Reality Applications

works.technique: Captures sketches as image layers and clay models via multi-angle photos turned into 3D, then streams them into a marker/plane-based AR viewer.
works.exercise_zh: 让学生用纸笔画界面、用橡皮泥捏角色，用手机扫描（如Reality Composer/Polycam）后在AR中摆放演示；变化：限定30分钟做出一个AR导览原型。
works.description_zh: 设计师在纸上画草图、用橡皮泥捏造型，再用手机拍下来，采集到的二维/三维素材就能立即放进一个可运行的手机 AR 原型中。
works.idea_en: Draw on paper, sculpt with clay, snap a photo, and get a working AR prototype.
works.technique_zh: 把草图采集为图像图层，把黏土模型通过多角度拍照转换为 3D，再串流到基于标记或平面的 AR 查看器中。
works.exercise_en: Have students draw interfaces with pen and paper and sculpt characters from clay, scan them with a phone (such as Reality Composer or Polycam), and arrange them in AR for a demo. Twist: build an AR tour prototype in 30 minutes.

works.title: Pull a bookmark to trigger AR
works.description: Pulling a printed bookmark out of a book reveals an image target that makes AR information appear, using the book's own affordance as the trigger.
works.description_zh: 把一张印刷书签从书里抽出来，露出的图像标记会触发 AR 信息出现，用书本本身的可供性当作开关。
works.idea_en: Use a natural physical action (pulling, opening, sliding) as the switch for AR content.
works.idea_zh: 用自然的物理动作（抽出、打开、滑动）作为 AR 内容的开关。
works.technique: Vuforia image tracking only detects the target once it is exposed, so the physical reveal itself acts as the trigger.
works.technique_zh: Vuforia 图像追踪只有在标记露出来之后才能识别，所以“露出”这个物理动作本身就是触发器。
works.exercise_en: Hide an image marker inside an envelope, drawer or book and make AR content appear only when it is revealed. Twist: content changes depending on how far it is pulled out.
works.exercise_zh: 把图像标记藏进信封、抽屉或书里，只有被拉出来时才出现 AR 内容。变体：根据拉出的长度显示不同的内容。

video.video_title: Trigger AR information by leveraging the real world affordances @Vuforia https://t.co/1IQeLl5BwK

works.title: Real World Platform Occlusion Demo (Pikachu & Eevee)
works.description: A research demo by Niantic and Matrix Mill in which Pikachu and Eevee run around a plaza and correctly disappear behind real people, planters and benches using learned depth.
works.idea_zh: 用深度学习让虚拟宝可梦被真实行人和物体遮挡，真正融入现实。

video.video_title: Pokemon Go Occlusion Demo (NIantic) w/ Matrix Mill ft. Pikachu and Eevee

works.technique: A neural network estimates per-pixel depth from the camera image, and virtual characters are depth-tested against it so real people and objects occlude them.
works.exercise_zh: 开启 AR Foundation 的人物遮挡或环境深度遮挡，让一个角色绕着你的同学跑；变体：故意关闭遮挡再对比，拍一组前后对比截图。
works.description_zh: Niantic 与 Matrix Mill 的一项研究演示：皮卡丘和伊布在广场上跑来跑去，借助学习得到的深度，它们能正确地消失在真实的行人、花坛和长椅后面。
works.idea_en: Use deep learning so virtual Pokémon are hidden by real passers-by and objects and truly blend into reality.
works.technique_zh: 神经网络从相机图像中估计逐像素深度，虚拟角色与之进行深度测试，使真实的人和物体能够遮挡它们。
works.exercise_en: Turn on human occlusion or environment depth occlusion in AR Foundation and have a character run around your classmate. Twist: switch occlusion off on purpose and take a set of before-and-after screenshots.

works.title: Realtime Image Segmentation on iOS
works.description: A 2018 demo of a semantic segmentation network running live on an iPhone 6s camera feed, colouring people and objects pixel by pixel.
works.description_zh: 2018 年的演示：在 iPhone 6s 的摄像头画面上实时运行语义分割网络，逐像素地为人和物体上色。
works.idea_en: Let the phone know which pixels are people and which are things, the basis for occlusion and background effects.
works.idea_zh: 让手机知道哪些像素是人、哪些是物体，这正是遮挡和背景特效的基础。
works.technique: A MobileNet-based FCN-8s model trained in Keras on Pascal VOC is converted with coremltools and run on each camera frame (about 100-200 ms).
works.technique_zh: 在 Keras 中用 Pascal VOC 训练基于 MobileNet 的 FCN-8s 模型，用 coremltools 转换后逐帧运行（每帧约 100-200 毫秒）。
works.exercise_en: Run a pretrained person-segmentation model in the browser and use the mask to replace everything except people with a painting. Twist: invert it so only people become the painting.
works.exercise_zh: 在浏览器中运行一个预训练的人像分割模型，用蒙版把除人以外的一切替换成一幅画；变体：反过来，只让人变成画。

video.video_title: Realtime Image Segmentation on iOS, Keras + CoreML

works.title: Remixed Reality
works.description: A live 3D reconstruction of the room is shown in a VR headset and edited in real time: copy or erase objects and people, rewind time, or change geometry of the space.
works.idea_zh: 把现实当素材来'剪辑'：复制、擦除、倒带你身边的真实世界。

video.video_title: Remixed Reality: Manipulating Space and Time in Augmented Reality

works.technique: An array of calibrated Kinects produces a live 3D reconstruction of the room that is rendered in a VR headset, so any region of the point cloud can be copied, deleted, recolored, or buffered and replayed in time.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机 AR 的实时摄像头画面 + 分割模型（如 MediaPipe 或 SAM 的网页版）选中画面中的一个人或物体并“擦除”（用背景修补）或复制一份；变体：给画面加一个“时间滑块”，可以回看 10 秒前这个位置是什么样。
works.description_zh: 房间的实时 3D 重建显示在 VR 头显中，并可以实时编辑：复制或擦除物体和人、让时间倒流，或改变空间的几何形态。
works.idea_en: 'Edit' reality as raw footage: copy, erase and rewind the real world around you.
works.technique_zh: 一组经过标定的 Kinect 生成房间的实时 3D 重建并在 VR 头显中渲染，点云中的任意区域都可以被复制、删除、重新着色，或缓存下来按时间回放。
works.exercise_en: Use the live camera feed of phone AR with a segmentation model (such as MediaPipe or a web version of SAM) to select a person or object in the frame and 'erase' it (inpainting the background) or duplicate it. Twist: add a 'time slider' so you can look back at what this spot looked like 10 seconds ago.

works.title: Renegade Projected AR in Downtown Vegas
works.description: A Lightform projector on a cargo bike rides through downtown Las Vegas at night, scanning building facades and instantly mapping animated graphics onto them.
works.idea_zh: 骑着投影自行车，随走随扫描随投影，把城市墙面变成AR壁画。

video.video_title: Renegade Projected AR in Downtown Vegas ft. Lightform x Craig Winslow

works.technique: The projector-camera unit projects structured-light patterns to capture a depth/edge map of the facade, then auto-aligns effects to its edges.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机投影仪或小投影机在夜晚对着校园墙面投射预先做好的动画，并用手机拍下墙面照片在Keynote里描边对齐；变化：投影内容必须利用墙上的一个真实裂缝或窗户。
works.description_zh: 一台架在货运自行车上的 Lightform 投影仪在夜里穿行于拉斯维加斯市中心，扫描建筑立面并立即在上面映射动画图形。
works.idea_en: Ride a projector bike that scans and projects as it goes, turning city walls into AR murals.
works.technique_zh: 投影相机一体机投射结构光图案，采集立面的深度/边缘图，再把效果自动对齐到这些边缘上。
works.exercise_en: At night, use a phone projector or small projector to cast a pre-made animation onto a campus wall, then photograph the wall and trace its outlines in Keynote to align it. Twist: the projection must make use of a real crack or window in the wall.

works.title: Snow Dome
works.description: The remote VR user can shrink to miniature size inside a snow-globe-like copy of the space or grow into a giant, enabling multi-scale collaboration with the AR user.
works.idea_zh: 远程协作者可以缩小进雪花球里，也能变成巨人俯瞰全局。

video.video_title: Snow Dome: A Multi-Scale Interaction in Mixed Reality Remote Collaboration

works.technique: A scaled copy of the reconstructed space is rendered as a miniature (World-in-Miniature) inside a dome, and the VR user's position and scale are mapped between the miniature and full-scale coordinate frames so their avatar appears correctly to the AR user.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中把扫描好的房间模型缩小成桌上的“雪球”，点击雪球中的某点就把第一人称视角“传送”进去；变体：让雪球里的变化（放一件家具）同步到真实大小的 AR 场景中。
works.description_zh: 远程 VR 用户可以缩小到微缩尺寸，钻进一个雪花球般的空间复制品里，也可以变成巨人，从而与 AR 用户进行多尺度协作。
works.idea_en: A remote collaborator can shrink into a snow globe or grow into a giant looking down on everything.
works.technique_zh: 重建空间的缩小副本以微缩世界（World-in-Miniature）的形式渲染在一个穹顶内，VR 用户的位置和尺度在微缩坐标系与真实尺寸坐标系之间映射，使其化身能正确地呈现给 AR 用户。
works.exercise_en: Shrink a scanned room model into a 'snow globe' on the table in AR, and tap a point inside it to 'teleport' your first-person view there. Twist: sync changes made inside the snow globe (placing a piece of furniture) to the full-size AR scene.

works.title: Somen-to-Ramen Taste Modulation
works.description: Diners eating plain somen noodles see them rendered as rich ramen in their headset, and many report that the taste itself shifts toward ramen.
works.description_zh: 吃清淡素面的人在头显里看到的是浓郁的拉面，不少人反映连味道都变得更像拉面。
works.idea_en: Change what food looks like and you partly change what it tastes like.
works.idea_zh: 改变食物的样子，就能部分改变它的味道。
works.technique: Overlays a 3D model of a different dish onto the tracked bowl in video see-through AR, exploiting cross-modal interaction between vision and taste.
works.technique_zh: 在视频透视 AR 中把另一道菜的三维模型叠加到被追踪的碗上，利用视觉与味觉之间的跨感官作用。
works.exercise_en: Run a blind taste test: students taste plain crackers while looking through a phone AR filter that recolours them as chocolate or cheese, then rate flavour. Twist: add matching sound effects and see if crunch changes the rating.
works.exercise_zh: 做一次盲测：学生一边透过把饼干“染成”巧克力或奶酪的手机 AR 滤镜看，一边品尝原味饼干，再给味道打分；变体：加入相应的咀嚼音效，看脆感是否改变评分。

video.video_title: 麺類を対象とした視覚変調による 味覚操作インタフェースの有効性評価

works.title: SpeakingPuppy
works.description: An iOS app detects your dog's face, puts masks and filters on it and gives it a voice-changed talking mouth.
works.idea_zh: 给狗狗戴上面具，还让它开口说话。

video.video_title: SpeakingPuppy

works.technique: A custom pet-face landmark model tracks the dog's face so masks follow it, and the user's recorded voice is pitch-shifted and lip-synced to an animated mouth.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Lens Studio 宠物模板或 Teachable Machine 识别宠物/玩偶的脸，给它配上变声旁白；加一个变化：说话内容由观众打字决定。
works.description_zh: 一款 iOS 应用，能识别你家狗狗的脸，给它戴上面具和滤镜，还配上一张变声后会说话的嘴。
works.idea_en: Put a mask on your dog and make it talk.
works.technique_zh: 自定义的宠物面部特征点模型追踪狗的脸，让面具跟随移动；用户录制的声音经过变调，并与动画嘴巴口型同步。
works.exercise_en: Use the Lens Studio pet template or Teachable Machine to recognize the face of a pet or stuffed toy and give it a voice-changed narration. Twist: the audience types what it says.

works.title: Spiders with 6D.ai (Chip Sineni)
works.description: Chip Sineni's creepy-crawly test for the 6D.ai SDK: spiders crawl over and hide behind real furniture thanks to a live mesh of the room.
works.idea_zh: 让虚拟蜘蛛沿着真实家具爬行、躲到后面去。

video.video_title: Spiders - Chip Sineni bringing more creepy crawlies to life

works.technique: 6D.ai builds a real-time mesh of the environment on the phone, used for occlusion and as a navigation surface so creatures crawl over real geometry.
works.exercise_zh: 用 LiDAR 手机 + AR Foundation Meshing，让一群虚拟小虫沿桌面和椅子爬并被遮挡；加一个变化：开灯（环境光变亮）时它们四散逃跑。
works.description_zh: Chip Sineni 为 6D.ai SDK 做的一个令人发毛的测试：借助房间的实时网格，蜘蛛在真实家具上爬行，还会躲到家具后面。
works.idea_en: Let virtual spiders crawl along real furniture and hide behind it.
works.technique_zh: 6D.ai 在手机上实时构建环境网格，既用于遮挡，也作为导航表面，让生物在真实几何上爬行。
works.exercise_en: Use a LiDAR phone and AR Foundation Meshing to make a swarm of virtual bugs crawl over tables and chairs and get occluded. Twist: when the lights come on (ambient light gets brighter), they scatter and flee.

works.title: Stenciling in Augmented Reality
works.description: Projects a reference image onto paper through the phone so you can trace it by hand, giving instant drawing skills.
works.idea_zh: 把参考图“投”到纸上，让任何人都能照着描出好画。

video.video_title: Stenciling in augmented reality demo

works.technique: A semi-transparent reference image is anchored to the paper's plane (via plane detection or image tracking), so it stays registered while the user traces it by hand.
works.exercise_zh: 用平面检测把一张半透明线稿固定在桌面白纸上，照着描画；变体：线稿分步显示，先轮廓后细节。
works.description_zh: 通过手机把参考图“投”到纸上，让你用手照着描，立刻拥有画画的本事。
works.idea_en: Cast a reference image onto paper so anyone can trace a good drawing.
works.technique_zh: 把半透明的参考图锚定在纸张所在的平面上（通过平面检测或图像追踪），用户手绘描摹时它始终保持对齐。
works.exercise_en: Use plane detection to fix a semi-transparent line drawing onto a sheet of white paper on the desk, and trace it. Twist: show the line drawing in steps, outline first, then details.

works.title: Street Fighter II: Real World Warrior Edition
works.description: A multiplayer AR remake of Street Fighter II in which two players on phones control full-size fighters battling on real streets.
works.idea_zh: 把街头霸王变成两人同屏的真人尺寸 AR 对战，真正打上街头。

video.video_title: Street Fighter II in the real world

works.technique: Two phones share one AR coordinate space (likely via ARKit collaborative sessions or a shared anchor plus network sync) so both players see the same full-size fighters, whose inputs are replicated over the network.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Unity Netcode + AR Foundation 做两台手机共享同一锚点，各自控制一个方块角色互相推挤出圈；变体：用真实身体动作（手机晃动）代替按键出招。
works.description_zh: 《街头霸王 II》的多人 AR 重制版：两名玩家用手机操控真人大小的格斗家，在真实的街道上对战。
works.idea_en: Turn Street Fighter into a two-player, life-size AR fight that actually takes to the streets.
works.technique_zh: 两部手机共享同一个 AR 坐标空间（大概率通过 ARKit 协作会话，或共享锚点加网络同步），双方看到同样的真人大小格斗家，其操作输入通过网络同步。
works.exercise_en: Use Unity Netcode and AR Foundation so two phones share one anchor and each controls a block character trying to push the other out of a ring. Twist: attack with real body movements (shaking the phone) instead of buttons.

works.title: Studio Visit (mobile portal)
works.description: A site-specific mixed-reality installation: a mobile AR portal opens from the gallery into a surreal virtual version of the artist's studio.
works.idea_zh: 手机AR传送门通往艺术家的怪诞工作室

video.video_title: Studio Visit, 2018 - Mobile Portal Interaction

works.technique: An AR portal uses a stencil-buffer mask on a doorway plane so the virtual studio is only visible through the opening, and the scene is registered to the gallery wall.
works.exercise_zh: 在 Unity AR 中用 stencil shader 做一扇传送门，门后是你书桌的夸张虚构版本；变体：让门后的世界能“漏”出几个物体到现实这一侧。
works.description_zh: 一件因地制宜的混合现实装置：一扇手机 AR 传送门从画廊通往艺术家工作室的一个超现实虚拟版本。
works.idea_en: A phone AR portal leads into the artist's bizarre studio.
works.technique_zh: AR 传送门在门洞平面上使用模板缓冲遮罩，使虚拟工作室只能透过门洞看到，整个场景与画廊墙面配准。
works.exercise_en: Use a stencil shader in Unity AR to build a portal that leads to an exaggerated fictional version of your desk. Twist: let a few objects 'leak' out of the world behind the door onto the real side.

works.title: SwiftShot
works.description: A WWDC multiplayer ARKit 2 game: players on several iPhones/iPads see the same tabletop battlefield and fling slingshot projectiles at each other's wooden blocks.
works.idea_zh: 多人在同一张桌子上的共享AR弹弓大战。

video.video_title: Apple SwiftShot Demo: First multi-player game created with ARKit 2

works.technique: Shares an ARWorldMap between devices so all players relocalize to the same anchors, then syncs physics state over peer-to-peer networking.
works.exercise_zh: 用Reality Composer或AR Foundation共享锚点做两人对战：在同一张桌面上用手机轻扫发射小球撞倒对方积木；变化：桌面上的真实杯子作为不可穿透的障碍。
works.description_zh: WWDC 上发布的一款 ARKit 2 多人游戏：玩家用多部 iPhone/iPad 看到同一个桌面战场，互相用弹弓发射弹丸，攻击对方的木块。
works.idea_en: A shared AR slingshot battle between several players at the same table.
works.technique_zh: 在设备之间共享 ARWorldMap，让所有玩家重定位到相同的锚点，再通过点对点网络同步物理状态。
works.exercise_en: Build a two-player battle with shared anchors in Reality Composer or AR Foundation: on the same tabletop, flick the phone to launch balls and knock down the opponent's blocks. Twist: a real cup on the table acts as a solid obstacle.

works.title: TendAR
works.description: An ARCore pet game where a talking guppy fish lives in the camera view and feeds on the player's emotions, read from their facial expressions, and asks them to show objects around them.
works.idea_zh: 一条以你的表情和情绪为食的AR小鱼。

video.video_title: Tendar

works.technique: Front-camera facial expression classification feeds the pet's emotional state, while rear-camera object recognition checks whether the player shows the requested item.
works.exercise_zh: 用表情识别（MediaPipe 或 ARKit blendshape）判断你是否在笑，AR 小鱼以你的情绪为食；变体：小鱼会请你拍一个指定物体，并用物体识别验证。
works.description_zh: 一款 ARCore 宠物游戏：一条会说话的孔雀鱼住在相机画面里，靠读取玩家面部表情得到的情绪为食，还会让玩家把周围的物品拿给它看。
works.idea_en: A small AR fish that feeds on your expressions and emotions.
works.technique_zh: 前置摄像头的面部表情分类决定宠物的情绪状态，后置摄像头的物体识别则检查玩家是否展示了它要求的物品。
works.exercise_en: Use expression recognition (MediaPipe or ARKit blend shapes) to tell whether you are smiling, and have an AR fish feed on your emotions. Twist: the fish asks you to photograph a specific object and checks it with object recognition.

works.title: The Other Way
works.description: An interactive VR story built in two weeks at CMU's Entertainment Technology Center: players sit on a real bicycle fitted with a Vive Tracker, so riding it carries them through the story; it was later shown at IEEE VR 2020.
works.description_zh: 在卡内基梅隆大学 ETC 两周内完成的互动 VR 故事：玩家骑上一辆装有 Vive Tracker 的真实自行车，骑行动作带着他们穿过故事；作品后来在 IEEE VR 2020 展示。
works.idea_en: Use a real bicycle as the controller so the body feels the journey.
works.idea_zh: 用一辆真实的自行车当控制器，让身体感受到旅程。
works.technique: A Vive Tracker on the bike mimics steering and motion in VR, so the physical prop and the virtual path stay in sync.
works.technique_zh: 在自行车上安装 Vive Tracker，在 VR 中模拟转向和前进，使实体道具与虚拟路线保持同步。
works.exercise_en: Turn a chair, bike or scooter into a controller by taping a phone to it and reading its motion in a WebXR scene. Twist: the story branches depending on which way you lean.
works.exercise_zh: 把手机绑在椅子、自行车或滑板车上，在 WebXR 场景中读取它的运动，把它变成控制器。变体：故事根据你身体倾斜的方向分支。

video.video_title: The Other Way

works.title: The Ring Brought to Life in AR
works.description: Re-enacts the famous horror scene in which Samara crawls out of the TV and into the living room, anchored to a real television.
works.idea_zh: 让《午夜凶铃》贞子真的从家里电视机里爬出来。

video.video_title: The Ring brought to life in AR

works.technique: A rigged character animation is aligned to a real TV (likely by manual placement or image tracking of the screen), with an occlusion mask on the TV frame so the figure appears to emerge from inside the screen.
works.exercise_zh: 用图像追踪识别笔记本屏幕上的一张图片，让一个角色从屏幕里“爬出”落到桌面上，屏幕边框用遮挡材质挡住未出来的部分；变体：换成从冰箱门或抽屉里钻出来的东西。
works.description_zh: 重现那个著名的恐怖场景：贞子从电视里爬出来进入客厅，而这一切锚定在一台真实的电视上。
works.idea_en: Make Sadako from The Ring really crawl out of the TV at home.
works.technique_zh: 把绑定好骨骼的角色动画与真实电视对齐（大概率通过手动放置或对屏幕做图像追踪），并在电视边框上加遮挡蒙版，使人物看起来是从屏幕里钻出来的。
works.exercise_en: Use image tracking to recognize a picture on a laptop screen and have a character 'crawl out' of the screen onto the desk, with an occlusion material on the screen bezel hiding the part still inside. Twist: make something emerge from a fridge door or a drawer instead.

works.title: TickTock AR-controlled home robot
works.description: A phone running TickTock's software rides on a small mobile robot as its brain; in the AR app, users tap a spot on the floor and the real robot plans a path and drives there, also responding to Google Assistant voice commands.
works.description_zh: 一部运行 TickTock 软件的手机装在小型移动机器人上充当大脑；在 AR 应用里点一下地面上的某个位置，真实机器人就规划路径开过去，还能响应 Google Assistant 的语音指令。
works.idea_en: Tap a point in AR and a real robot goes there.
works.idea_zh: 在 AR 里点一个位置，真实机器人就开过去。
works.technique: Project Tango SLAM on an Asus Zenfone AR localizes the robot and maps the room, and taps on the AR view are raycast to floor coordinates for the path planner.
works.technique_zh: Asus Zenfone AR 上的 Project Tango SLAM 负责机器人定位和房间建图，在 AR 画面上的点击通过射线投射转换为地面坐标，交给路径规划器。
works.exercise_en: Mount a phone on a Bluetooth toy car, raycast taps in AR to floor points, and drive the car toward the tapped point. Twist: let a second phone see the car's planned path as a glowing line in AR.
works.exercise_zh: 把手机装在蓝牙玩具车上，在 AR 中通过射线投射把点击转换为地面坐标，让小车开向被点中的位置。变体：让第二部手机在 AR 中以发光线条看到小车规划的路线。

video.video_title: TickTock's Augmented Reality Powered Robot Platform Highlights

works.title: Time Travel in AR
works.description: In a public graffiti park whose walls change daily, the phone shows earlier versions of the artwork in place, letting you see into the past.
works.idea_zh: 在每天都被覆盖的涂鸦墙前，用 AR 看到它过去的样子。

video.video_title:
Time travel in AR! ⏳✈️

The artwork in this public graffiti park changes daily. With the power of #ARKit, it's possible to see into the past. Built with #ARKit2 on #iOS12. https://t.co/APa2Nj8jdC

works.technique: Wall sections are tracked with image recognition (likely against earlier photos), and archived photos of past graffiti are overlaid at the detected image pose.
works.exercise_zh: 拍下校园某面墙今天的样子作为识别图，以后扫描时把旧照片叠回去，用滑块在不同日期间切换；变体：让同学在墙上留下只能在 AR 中看到的涂鸦。
works.description_zh: 在一座墙面每天都在变化的公共涂鸦公园里，手机会在原位显示作品早先的版本，让你看见过去。
works.idea_en: In front of a graffiti wall painted over every day, use AR to see what it used to look like.
works.technique_zh: 通过图像识别追踪各段墙面（大概率以早先的照片为比对基准），再把过去涂鸦的存档照片叠加在检测到的图像位姿上。
works.exercise_en: Photograph a campus wall as it looks today to use as the recognition image, then overlay old photos when it is scanned later, with a slider to switch between dates. Twist: let classmates leave graffiti on the wall that can only be seen in AR.

works.title: Tónandi
works.description: An interactive Magic Leap soundscape in which glowing sound creatures spread across your real room; touching, gathering and waving at them with your hands layers and shapes Sigur Rós's music.
works.idea_zh: 伸手触碰房间里的发光生物来演奏和生成音乐。

video.video_title: sigur rós & magic leap

works.technique: Room-anchored creature agents each carry a music stem or sample, and hand-tracking contact or proximity triggers, layers and modulates those audio sources.
works.exercise_zh: 在房间里散布 5 个会发光的 AR 生物，每个对应一段音乐分轨，靠近时该分轨淡入；变体：把它们聚到一起时音乐合成一首完整的曲子。
works.description_zh: 一个可交互的 Magic Leap 声音景观：发光的声音生物遍布你真实的房间，用手触碰、聚拢它们或朝它们挥手，就能叠加并塑造 Sigur Rós 的音乐。
works.idea_en: Reach out and touch glowing creatures in your room to play and shape the music.
works.technique_zh: 锚定在房间中的生物智能体各自携带一段音乐分轨或采样，手部追踪检测到的接触或接近会触发、叠加并调制这些音源。
works.exercise_en: Scatter five glowing AR creatures around a room, each tied to a music stem that fades in as you approach. Twist: when they are gathered together, the stems combine into a complete piece.

works.title: Valve's Portal in Unity with ARKit
works.description: Uses ARKit 1.5 vertical-plane detection to shoot linked blue and orange portals onto real walls and see through them.
works.idea_zh: 在真实墙面上打出《传送门》里的蓝橙传送门。

video.video_title: Valve's Portal in Unity (with ARkit)

works.technique: Portals placed on detected vertical planes use render textures from paired virtual cameras whose pose mirrors the viewer's relative pose to the other portal.
works.exercise_zh: 在两面墙上各放一个传送门，每个门显示另一个门后方虚拟相机的 RenderTexture，让一个虚拟球从一个门进另一个门出；变体：门两侧的时间不同（一侧是白天一侧是夜晚）。
works.description_zh: 利用 ARKit 1.5 的竖直平面检测，在真实墙面上发射一对相连的蓝色和橙色传送门，并能透过它们看到另一侧。
works.idea_en: Shoot the blue and orange portals from Portal onto real walls.
works.technique_zh: 放置在检测到的竖直平面上的传送门使用来自成对虚拟相机的渲染纹理，每台相机的位姿复刻观者相对于另一扇传送门的位姿。
works.exercise_en: Place a portal on each of two walls, each showing the RenderTexture of a virtual camera behind the other portal, and send a virtual ball in one portal and out the other. Twist: each side of the portal has a different time of day (day on one side, night on the other).

works.title: VarioLight
works.description: A mirror-steered high-speed projection system tracks a dancer across a whole stage and projects imagery onto them with no drift.
works.idea_zh: 高速转镜追着舞者满场跑，把影像精确投在移动的人身上。

video.video_title: VarioLight: Dynamic Projection Mapping for a Wide Range Performance

works.technique: Two galvanometer mirrors steer the projection beam at high speed, driven by a high-speed vision tracker, so a small projection field follows a moving performer across a large stage.
works.exercise_zh: 把投影仪装在舵机云台上（或只在画面中移动一个投影光斑），用摄像头追踪跑动的同学，让一个图案始终落在其身上；变体：光斑追踪的目标由舞者的动作切换（举手时转向另一人）。
works.description_zh: 一套由反射镜导向的高速投影系统，能在整个舞台上追踪舞者，并把影像投射到他们身上而不发生漂移。
works.idea_en: High-speed steering mirrors chase a dancer across the stage, landing images precisely on a moving body.
works.technique_zh: 两面振镜在高速视觉追踪器的驱动下高速引导投影光束，使一个小投影区域能在大舞台上跟随移动的表演者。
works.exercise_en: Mount a projector on a servo pan-tilt head (or just move a projected spot within the frame), track a running classmate with a camera, and keep a pattern on them at all times. Twist: the dancer's movement switches the spot's target (raising a hand sends it to another person).

works.title: WDCH Dreams
works.description: For the LA Phil's centenary, 45 terabytes of the orchestra's archives are processed by machine learning and projected onto the exterior of the Walt Disney Concert Hall as the building's 'dreams'.
works.idea_zh: 让音乐厅用AI“梦见”自己一百年的记忆，并投在外墙上
works.technique: Machine-learning models cluster and morph archival images and audio, and the results are projection-mapped with 42 projectors onto Gehry's curved stainless-steel façade.
works.exercise_zh: 收集学校老照片，用简单的图像聚类或风格混合生成序列，投影到校园一面墙上；变化：让路过的人用手机投票决定下一段“梦”的主题。

video.video_title: WDCH Dreams by REFIK ANADOL | Google Arts & Culture

works.description_zh: 为庆祝洛杉矶爱乐乐团百年，这件作品用机器学习处理了乐团 45 TB 的档案，并将其作为这座建筑的“梦境”投影在华特·迪士尼音乐厅的外墙上。
works.idea_en: Let a concert hall use AI to 'dream' its hundred years of memories and project them onto its facade.
works.technique_zh: 机器学习模型对档案图像和音频进行聚类与形变，结果通过 42 台投影机映射到 Gehry 设计的弧形不锈钢立面上。
works.exercise_en: Collect old school photos, generate a sequence with simple image clustering or style blending, and project it onto a campus wall. Twist: let passers-by vote on their phones for the theme of the next 'dream'.

works.title: We Live in an Ocean of Air
works.description: Groups of visitors wear headsets and backpacks in a room with a giant sequoia; they see each other as glowing bodies and watch their own breath flow into the tree as it breathes back.
works.description_zh: 一组组观众戴着头显、背着背包走进放置巨型红杉的房间，他们看到彼此是发光的身体，并看到自己的呼吸流进树里，而树也在向他们回呼吸。
works.idea_en: Visualize the breath exchange between people and trees in a shared space.
works.idea_zh: 在共享空间里把人与树之间的呼吸交换可视化。
works.technique: Multi-user tracked VR with breath sensors and heart-rate input drives particle visuals, combined with scent, wind and a physical tree set.
works.technique_zh: 多人追踪 VR 结合呼吸传感器与心率输入驱动粒子画面，并配合气味、风和实体树布景。
works.exercise_en: Use a phone microphone to detect breathing and draw each breath as a particle cloud drifting toward a virtual plant in a shared web AR scene. Twist: the plant only grows when two people breathe in sync.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机麦克风检测呼吸，在一个共享的网页 AR 场景中，把每次呼吸画成飘向虚拟植物的粒子云；变体：只有两个人呼吸同步时，植物才会生长。

video.video_title: We Live in an Ocean of Air

works.title: WebXR Studio on Augmented Website
works.description: A browser authoring tool that lets anyone compose AR scenes and publish them on an 'augmented website' viewable on any phone.
works.idea_zh: 在浏览器里拼装 AR 场景，并直接发布成“增强网站”。

video.video_title: WebXR Studio on Augmented Website

works.technique: A browser editor serializes a scene graph of 3D assets and anchor settings to a URL, and a WebXR/AR.js viewer loads that description on any phone.
works.exercise_zh: 用 A-Frame 做一个简单编辑页面，拖拽三个物体后生成分享链接，别人打开链接在 AR 中看到同样布局；变体：让访问者也能添加一个物体，场景越积越多。
works.description_zh: 一款浏览器端创作工具，让任何人都能拼装 AR 场景，并发布成可在任意手机上观看的“增强网站”。
works.idea_en: Assemble AR scenes in the browser and publish them straight to an 'augmented website'.
works.technique_zh: 浏览器编辑器把由 3D 素材和锚点设置组成的场景图序列化为一个 URL，WebXR/AR.js 查看器在任意手机上加载这份描述。
works.exercise_en: Build a simple editor page with A-Frame that generates a share link after you drag three objects into place, so anyone opening the link sees the same layout in AR. Twist: let visitors add an object too, so the scene keeps growing.

works.title: Weird Type
works.description: An iOS AR app for writing and painting with animated typography in 3D space; type can follow your path, react to sound, explode, and be walked around.
works.idea_zh: 把文字当作画笔，在真实空间里书写、绕着走、用声音让它变形。

video.video_title: weird type

works.technique: ARKit camera pose supplies a 3D path that glyph outlines are laid along, and the glyph vertices are animated by per-frame noise, time, and microphone amplitude.
works.exercise_zh: 在 three.js WebXR 或 Unity 里把一句话的字母沿着手机移动轨迹逐个放进空间，并让字母随麦克风音量抖动或炸开；变体：选一句只有在特定位置倒着走才能读通的话。
works.description_zh: 一款 iOS AR 应用，用动态字体在 3D 空间中书写和绘画；文字可以沿着你走过的路径排布、对声音做出反应、炸开，还可以绕着它走动观看。
works.idea_en: Use letters as a brush to write in real space, walk around them and warp them with sound.
works.technique_zh: ARKit 相机位姿提供一条 3D 路径，字形轮廓沿路径排布，字形顶点则由逐帧噪声、时间和麦克风音量驱动动画。
works.exercise_en: In three.js WebXR or Unity, place the letters of a sentence one by one in space along the phone's path, and make them shake or burst with microphone volume. Twist: choose a sentence that only reads correctly if you walk backward from a particular spot.

works.title: Wile E. Coyote vs the Roadrunner in AR
works.description: Looney Tunes characters chase each other around a real room, with Wile E. Coyote's cartoon traps set against actual furniture.
works.idea_zh: 让威利狼和哔哔鸟的卡通追逐在真实房间里上演。

video.video_title: Wile E. Coyote vs the Roadrunner in AR

works.technique: Characters follow scripted paths laid out on detected floor planes, with occlusion geometry roughly matched to real furniture so they can run behind it.
works.exercise_zh: 在地面平面上画一条路径，让两个卡通角色沿路径追逐，并在沙发位置放一块遮挡体让它们消失在后面；变体：让路径由学生用手机在房间里走一圈录下来。
works.description_zh: Looney Tunes 的角色在真实房间里互相追逐，威利狼的卡通陷阱就设在真实的家具旁边。
works.idea_en: Stage the cartoon chase between Wile E. Coyote and the Road Runner in a real room.
works.technique_zh: 角色沿着布置在检测到的地面平面上的脚本路径移动，遮挡几何体大致与真实家具吻合，让角色可以从家具后面跑过。
works.exercise_en: Draw a path on the floor plane, have two cartoon characters chase each other along it, and place an occluder at the sofa so they disappear behind it. Twist: have students record the path by walking a loop around the room with a phone.

works.title: Wonderscope
works.description: An iOS app of AR stories for children: characters appear life-size in the room and the child moves the story along by walking around and reading lines out loud to them.
works.idea_zh: 孩子朗读台词推动故事，AR角色就在客厅里回应。

video.video_title: Introducing Wonderscope: an augmented reality iOS app for kids

works.technique: Life-size characters are placed on the floor via plane detection, and speech recognition checks the child's spoken line against the script to advance the story.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个三句对白的 AR 小故事，角色站在地上，孩子读出正确台词后剧情才继续；变体：读错时角色会用幽默方式提示。
works.description_zh: 一款面向儿童的 iOS AR 故事应用：角色以真人大小出现在房间里，孩子通过四处走动、大声对角色念出台词来推动故事发展。
works.idea_en: A child reads lines aloud to move the story along, and AR characters answer right in the living room.
works.technique_zh: 通过平面检测把真人大小的角色放在地面上，语音识别将孩子念出的台词与剧本比对，以推进故事。
works.exercise_en: Make a three-line AR mini story with a character standing on the floor, where the plot continues only after the child reads the right line. Twist: when the line is wrong, the character gives a funny hint.

works.title: discrete figures (with Kyle McDonald)
works.description: A dance performance mixing dancers, drones, projection and machine-learning 'generated dancers' that appear alongside and on the performers.
works.idea_zh: 机器学习生成的虚拟舞者与真人同台

video.video_title: discrete figures at Spiral Hall Tokyo

works.technique: Motion capture of dancers trains or drives ML-generated virtual dancers, which are rendered into projection mapped onto stage elements and drones whose positions are tracked in the same space.
works.exercise_zh: 录下一位同学的舞蹈骨骼数据，在投影里生成一个会“模仿”并逐渐走样的虚拟舞伴，与真人同台；变体：虚拟舞伴每一轮都用上一轮的偏差继续生成，看它离人多远。
works.description_zh: 一场融合舞者、无人机、投影和机器学习“生成舞者”的舞蹈演出，这些生成舞者出现在表演者身旁，也出现在他们身上。
works.idea_en: Machine-learning-generated virtual dancers share the stage with real ones.
works.technique_zh: 舞者的动作捕捉数据用于训练或驱动机器学习生成的虚拟舞者，这些舞者被渲染进投影，映射到舞台元素和无人机上，而无人机的位置在同一空间中被追踪。
works.exercise_en: Record a classmate's dance skeleton data and generate a virtual partner in the projection that 'copies' them and gradually drifts off, sharing the stage with the real dancer. Twist: each round, the virtual partner generates from the previous round's deviations, and see how far it strays from the human.

works.title: ines alpha x Katsu
works.description: A face-tracked 3D makeup look made with artist Katsu: iridescent sculptural forms grow from and cling to the face as it moves.
works.idea_zh: 为艺术家量身打造的三维数字妆容，贴合面部动态生长。

video.video_title: ines alpha x katsu

works.technique: Sculptural meshes modeled in Cinema 4D are parented to face-tracking anchors, with iridescent shader effects that change with view angle.
works.exercise_zh: 用任意 3D 软件做一个雕塑感的小物件，挂在人脸追踪的某个锚点（如额头或颧骨）上；变体：物件随面部表情展开或收起。
works.description_zh: 与艺术家 Katsu 合作的人脸追踪 3D 妆容：带虹彩的雕塑形态随着面部动作从脸上生长出来，并紧贴面部。
works.idea_en: A 3D digital makeup look tailored to an artist, growing along with the face as it moves.
works.technique_zh: 在 Cinema 4D 中建模的雕塑网格被挂接到人脸追踪锚点上，并配有随视角变化的虹彩着色效果。
works.exercise_en: Make a small sculptural object in any 3D software and attach it to a face-tracking anchor (such as the forehead or a cheekbone). Twist: the object unfolds or folds up with facial expressions.

works.title: ines alpha x The Bulletproof Cat
works.description: Another face-tracked 3D makeup collaboration in which translucent, organic 3D shapes sit on and move with a performer's face.
works.idea_zh: 半透明的有机形态附着在脸上，随表情一起运动。

video.video_title: ines alpha x the bulletproof cat

works.technique: Translucent organic meshes are bound to the face mesh and deform with blendshape-driven expressions, using refraction or transparency shaders.
works.exercise_zh: 用 ARKit blendshape 读取表情系数，驱动脸上一个半透明形体的大小或形状；变体：只在微笑时让形体发光。
works.description_zh: 又一件基于面部追踪的 3D 妆容合作作品：半透明的有机形体贴合在表演者脸上，随面部一同运动。
works.idea_en: Translucent organic shapes cling to the face and move with every expression.
works.technique_zh: 半透明的有机网格绑定在面部网格上，随 blendshape 驱动的表情一起变形，并使用折射或透明着色器渲染。
works.exercise_en: Read expression coefficients from ARKit blendshapes and use them to drive the size or shape of a translucent form on the face. Twist: make the form glow only when the person smiles.

works.title: 1000 Michael Scotts Screaming at You in AR
works.description: An absurdist phone AR piece that fills the room with a crowd of screaming Michael Scotts.
works.idea_zh: 让一千个《办公室》里的 Michael Scott 在房间里对你尖叫。

video.video_title: 1000 Michael Scotts Screaming At You in AR

works.technique: A large number of animated character instances (GPU instancing or LOD) are scattered on detected planes with randomized timing, and spatialized audio fills the room.
works.exercise_zh: 在地面平面上批量生成 100 个同一角色，随机播放动作和空间音效；变体：角色都会转头盯着手机。
works.description_zh: 一件荒诞风格的手机 AR 作品：一大群尖叫的 Michael Scott 挤满整个房间。
works.idea_en: A thousand Michael Scotts from The Office fill your room and scream at you.
works.technique_zh: 大量带动画的角色实例（借助 GPU instancing 或 LOD）以随机的时间偏移散布在检测到的平面上，空间化音频充满整个房间。
works.exercise_en: Spawn 100 copies of the same character on the floor plane, each playing animations and spatial sounds at random. Twist: have every character turn its head to stare at the phone.

works.title: 57° North
works.description: A choose-your-own-adventure story played on the Merge Cube: each chapter appears as a small diorama in the palm that the player turns and chooses within.
works.idea_zh: 把分支叙事故事装进手掌中的立方体小剧场。

video.video_title: 57° North for Merge Cube - Trailer

works.technique: The Merge Cube's patterned faces are tracked as a multi-face image target, so a diorama follows the cube's rotation and choices are made by turning it.
works.exercise_zh: 用纸盒六面贴图像标记做一个自制 Merge Cube，在盒子上显示一个小故事场景，转到不同面时做出不同选择；变体：摇晃盒子会让场景里下雨。
works.description_zh: 一部在 Merge Cube 上游玩的互动分支故事：每一章都以小型立体场景的形式出现在掌心，玩家转动方块并在其中做出选择。
works.idea_en: A branching story packed into a tiny cube theater that sits in your palm.
works.technique_zh: Merge Cube 各面的图案被当作多面图像目标进行追踪，立体场景跟随方块旋转，玩家通过转动方块来做出选择。
works.exercise_en: Make your own Merge Cube by putting image markers on all six faces of a paper box, show a small story scene on it, and let each face you turn to trigger a different choice. Twist: shaking the box makes it rain in the scene.

works.title: A Colossal Wave
works.description: Visitors stand under VR umbrellas and watch a surreal flood, while a real dropper tower, bowling ball and gong in the gallery make physical impacts and sounds synced to the virtual wave.
works.description_zh: 观众站在“VR 雨伞”下观看一场超现实的洪水，同时展厅里真实的落锤塔、保龄球和锣发出与虚拟巨浪同步的撞击和声响。
works.idea_en: Mix a headset vision with real physical impacts so the whole room shakes with the virtual event.
works.idea_zh: 把头显中的画面与真实的物理冲击结合，让整个房间随虚拟事件一起震动。
works.technique: Umbrella-mounted displays show the virtual scene while a show-control system triggers the physical mechanisms and sound-reactive gallery lighting in sync.
works.technique_zh: 伞形头显展示虚拟场景，演出控制系统同步触发实体机械装置和声音响应的展厅灯光。
works.exercise_en: Build a short phone VR scene of a wave and time three real-world cues in the room (a drum hit, a fan, a dropped object) to match it. Twist: let the person outside the headset perform the cues live.
works.exercise_zh: 做一段关于海浪的手机 VR 短场景，并在房间里安排三个与之同步的现实提示（一声鼓、一阵风扇、一个落下的物体）；变体：让头显外的人现场手动制造这些提示。

video.video_title: A Colossal Wave!

works.title: AR Airplanes
works.description: An iPhone app that lets you fly an RC-style airplane anywhere in augmented reality, taking off from the floor and banking around the room or a park.
works.description_zh: 一款 iPhone 应用，让你在任何地方用 AR 驾驶遥控风格的飞机：从地面起飞，在房间或公园里盘旋。
works.idea_en: A pocket RC plane that needs no field, no batteries and never crashes for real.
works.idea_zh: 一架装在口袋里的遥控飞机：不需要场地、不需要电池，也不会真的坠毁。
works.technique: ARKit world tracking provides a stable origin and ground plane while on-screen joysticks drive a simple flight model in world space.
works.technique_zh: ARKit 世界追踪提供稳定的原点和地面，屏幕上的摇杆在世界坐标中驱动一个简单的飞行模型。
works.exercise_en: Build an AR flying toy with two on-screen sticks and place three rings to fly through in the classroom. Twist: the rings are placed by a second player on another phone.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个带两个屏幕摇杆的 AR 飞行玩具，在教室里放三个圆环让飞机穿过；变体：圆环由另一部手机上的第二位玩家摆放。

video.video_title: ARKit AR Airplanes iOS iPhone app

works.title: AR Cartoon Prototype
works.description: An ARKit prototype that stands Gumball and Darwin from The Amazing World of Gumball in a real living room as flat, hand-drawn characters that keep their 2D cartoon look. Video: Made With ARKit.
works.description_zh: 一个 ARKit 原型：让《阿甘妙世界》（The Amazing World of Gumball）里的 Gumball 和 Darwin 以平面手绘形象站在真实客厅里，保留原汁原味的 2D 卡通风格。（视频来自 Made With ARKit）
works.idea_en: AR does not have to look real: a cartoon style can sit convincingly in a real room.
works.idea_zh: AR 不必追求逼真，卡通风格同样能令人信服地待在真实房间里。
works.technique: Animated 2D character sprites are likely rendered as camera-facing billboards with drop shadows, anchored to the floor via ARKit plane detection.
works.technique_zh: 角色很可能以始终面向镜头的 2D 动画贴片（billboard）加投影的方式渲染，并通过 ARKit 平面检测固定在地板上。
works.exercise_en: Animate a 2D character you have drawn as a sprite sheet and stand it on a real desk in AR as a camera-facing card with a shadow. Twist: when viewers walk behind it, reveal a hand-drawn back side.
works.exercise_zh: 把你画的 2D 角色做成序列帧动画，在 AR 中以始终面向镜头、带阴影的卡片形式立在真实书桌上；变体：观众绕到背后时，显示一张手绘的背面。

video.video_title: AR Cartoon Prototype by @JonathanForder

works.title: AR Experiments (ARCore launch collection)
works.description: A collection of small open-source ARCore prototypes released at launch, from drawing and physics toys to portals, showing creative uses of the new platform.
works.idea_zh: ARCore发布时的一组开源小实验，展示AR的各种创意可能。

video.video_title: AR Experiments: Expanding creative possibilities with ARCore

works.technique: Small experiments each isolate one ARCore capability such as plane detection, hit testing, light estimation or anchors, showing how a single technique can carry a toy.
works.exercise_zh: 每组选一个 AR 基础能力（平面检测、光照估计、锚点等），在一小时内做一个只依赖该能力的小玩具；变体：互相交换能力再做一个。
works.description_zh: ARCore 发布时推出的一组开源小原型，从绘画、物理小玩具到传送门，展示了这个新平台的各种创意用法。
works.idea_en: A set of small open-source experiments released with ARCore that show how many creative directions AR can take.
works.technique_zh: 每个小实验只突出 ARCore 的一项能力，如平面检测、命中测试、光照估计或锚点，展示单一技术就足以撑起一个小玩具。
works.exercise_en: Have each group pick one basic AR capability (plane detection, light estimation, anchors, etc.) and build, within one hour, a small toy that relies on that capability alone. Twist: swap capabilities between groups and build another one.

works.title: AR Swimming Pool
works.description: A tiny pool with a rubber duck and fish lives inside a marker on the desk, seen through a cut-out in the table.
works.idea_zh: 桌面上嵌进去一个有小黄鸭和鱼的迷你泳池。

video.video_title: AR Swimming Pool

works.technique: A pool geometry sunk below the marker plane is framed by a depth-only occluder around the opening, creating the illusion of a cavity cut into the table.
works.exercise_zh: 在标记下方做一个小水池模型，用遮挡面让它看起来像桌子里挖出的洞，里面放会游动的鱼；变体：把水池换成一个地下蚁穴。
works.description_zh: 桌上的一个标记里藏着一座迷你泳池，里面有小黄鸭和鱼，看上去就像透过桌面上挖开的洞口往下看。
works.idea_en: A mini swimming pool with a rubber duck and fish sunk into the tabletop.
works.technique_zh: 泳池几何体沉在标记平面以下，开口四周用只写深度的遮挡体框住，营造出桌面被挖出一个空洞的错觉。
works.exercise_en: Build a small pool model below a marker, use occluder faces to make it look like a hole dug into the table, and fill it with swimming fish. Twist: replace the pool with an underground ant nest.

works.title: AR Wormhole
works.description: A thought experiment about stepping into the past: a live 360 camera streams to the phone with a 10-second delay, and walking through a portal lets you look around the moment that just happened.
works.idea_zh: 穿过一个虫洞，回到10秒前的现实并环顾四周。

video.video_title: AR Experiments: AR Wormhole

works.technique: A fixed 360 camera streams equirectangular video with a 10-second buffer, and an AR portal renders that delayed sphere so that looking through it shows the same place in the past from the phone's orientation.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Unity AR Foundation 做一扇传送门，门里贴一段在同一位置提前拍好的 360 视频，走进去看到“过去的这里”；变体：门里的时间差可以调，比如“一年前的这里”，讲这个地方的变化。
works.description_zh: 一个关于走进过去的思想实验：一台 360 相机把实时画面以 10 秒延迟传到手机上，穿过传送门后，你就能环顾刚刚发生过的那一刻。
works.idea_en: Step through a wormhole and look around the world as it was ten seconds ago.
works.technique_zh: 固定位置的 360 相机传输等距柱状投影视频，并缓存 10 秒；AR 传送门渲染这段延迟的球面画面，透过门看出去，就是按手机朝向呈现的同一地点的过去。
works.exercise_en: Build a portal in Unity AR Foundation and map onto it a 360 video shot earlier at the same spot, so walking in shows you "this place in the past." Twist: make the time gap adjustable, such as "this place one year ago," to tell how the place has changed.

works.title: AR Yōkai
works.description: Visitors wearing HoloLens walk through Shunkoin, an old Kyoto temple, and meet nine yōkai spirits from classical Japanese paintings, placed into the scanned rooms as part of a shared ghost story.
works.description_zh: 访客戴着 HoloLens 走进京都古寺春光院，遇见来自日本古画的九种妖怪；它们被安置在扫描过的房间里，构成一段共享的怪谈故事。
works.idea_en: Let historical paintings haunt the very building they belong to.
works.idea_zh: 让古画里的妖怪回到它们所属的建筑中“作祟”。
works.technique: 3D scans the temple interior to situate animated yōkai models with occlusion and shared placement across multiple HoloLens users.
works.technique_zh: 对寺庙内部进行三维扫描，使多台 HoloLens 用户看到的动画妖怪模型具备遮挡效果并处在共享位置上。
works.exercise_en: Pick a local legend, model or collect one creature, and hide it with phone AR in the part of school where the story would happen; guide a small group through it. Twist: make the creature appear only when the lights are dimmed.
works.exercise_zh: 挑一个本地传说，制作或收集一个相关生物模型，用手机 AR 把它藏在学校中最适合故事发生的地方，并带一小组人走一遍；变体：只有灯光调暗时生物才会出现。

video.video_title: AR Yōkai: A Situated Augmented Reality Ghost Story

works.title: AR-Code: QR Code to AR in Under 5 Seconds
works.description: Scanning a QR code opens a web page that immediately shows AR content on the same marker, measuring cold-start time to AR.
works.idea_zh: 扫一个二维码，5 秒内进入网页 AR。

video.video_title: AR-Code : qrcode to augmented reality in less than 5sec!

works.technique: A QR code encodes the URL of a web AR page and doubles as the tracking marker (or sits beside one), so scanning it launches AR content aligned to the same printed code.
works.exercise_zh: 生成一个包含 AR 网页地址的二维码并在旁边印上 AR.js 标记，扫码后内容直接出现在标记上；变体：把它做成课程作业的“会说话的名片”。
works.description_zh: 扫描二维码即可打开网页，并立刻在同一个标记上显示 AR 内容；作品测量的是从冷启动到进入 AR 所需的时间。
works.idea_en: Scan a QR code and land in web AR in under five seconds.
works.technique_zh: 二维码中编码了网页 AR 的地址，同时兼作追踪标记（或放在标记旁边），扫码后启动的 AR 内容会与同一张印刷码对齐。
works.exercise_en: Generate a QR code that holds the address of an AR web page and print an AR.js marker next to it, so scanning it makes the content appear right on the marker. Twist: turn it into a "talking business card" for a course assignment.

works.title: AR.js on Tango with WebAR Playground
works.description: Markerless web AR on a Google Tango phone, placing A-Frame objects directly on real surfaces.
works.idea_zh: 在 Tango 手机上跑无需标记的网页 AR。

video.video_title: AR.js on Tango with WebAR Playground

works.technique: Tango's depth camera and motion tracking provide 6DoF pose and surface hits in the browser, letting A-Frame entities be placed on real surfaces without markers.
works.exercise_zh: 用 WebXR Hit Test API（Chrome Android）在地面放一个 A-Frame 物体，对比 AR.js 标记方式的差别；变体：每点一次地面就种下一棵会长大的树。
works.description_zh: 在 Google Tango 手机上运行的无标记网页 AR，可以把 A-Frame 物体直接放到真实表面上。
works.idea_en: Markerless web AR running on a Tango phone.
works.technique_zh: Tango 的深度相机和运动追踪在浏览器中提供 6DoF 位姿和表面命中点，使 A-Frame 实体无需标记即可放置在真实表面上。
works.exercise_en: Use the WebXR Hit Test API (Chrome on Android) to place an A-Frame object on the floor, and compare it with the AR.js marker approach. Twist: every tap on the floor plants a tree that grows.

works.title: AR.js – Efficient Augmented Reality for the Web
works.description: Launch demo of AR.js: pure-JavaScript marker AR running at 60fps on an old phone, with no app install.
works.idea_zh: 纯网页、无需安装、老手机也能 60 帧运行的 AR。

video.video_title: AR.js - Efficient Augmented Reality for the Web

works.technique: An Emscripten-compiled ARToolKit runs marker pose estimation in the browser and feeds the pose to a three.js camera, giving marker AR with no app install.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR.js + A-Frame 写不超过 10 行 HTML 的标记 AR 网页，部署到 GitHub Pages 用手机打开；变体：设计自己的图案标记替换默认 Hiro。
works.description_zh: AR.js 的发布演示：纯 JavaScript 实现的标记 AR，在旧手机上也能跑到 60fps，而且无需安装任何应用。
works.idea_en: Pure web AR with no install that runs at 60 fps even on an old phone.
works.technique_zh: 用 Emscripten 编译的 ARToolKit 在浏览器中完成标记位姿估计，并把位姿传给 three.js 相机，实现无需安装应用的标记 AR。
works.exercise_en: Write a marker AR web page in no more than 10 lines of HTML using AR.js and A-Frame, deploy it to GitHub Pages, and open it on a phone. Twist: design your own pattern marker to replace the default Hiro.

works.title: ARCore Drawing (ofxARCore)
works.description: A simple demo for drawing 3D lines in space on an Android phone, made to show how openFrameworks and ARCore combine; the code became the ofxARCore addon.
works.idea_zh: 用openFrameworks和ARCore在空中画三维线条的开源示例。

video.video_title: AR Experiments: ARCore Drawing

works.technique: Camera pose from ARCore is exposed to openFrameworks, and positions sampled while touching are connected into 3D polylines rendered in world space.
works.exercise_zh: 不用 Unity，改用 three.js + WebXR 实现一个空中画线工具，比较两种工具链的开发体验；变体：线条颜色随画线速度变化。
works.description_zh: 一个在 Android 手机上于空间中绘制 3D 线条的简单演示，用来说明 openFrameworks 如何与 ARCore 结合；这段代码后来发展成了 ofxARCore 插件。
works.idea_en: An open-source example of drawing 3D lines in the air with openFrameworks and ARCore.
works.technique_zh: ARCore 的相机位姿被开放给 openFrameworks，触摸屏幕期间采样到的位置被连成 3D 折线，并在世界空间中渲染。
works.exercise_en: Skip Unity and build an air-drawing tool with three.js and WebXR instead, then compare the development experience of the two toolchains. Twist: make the line color change with drawing speed.

works.title: ARKit + CoreLocation
works.description: Floating labels pinned to real-world landmarks by GPS stay locked in place as he walks through London, combining ARKit tracking with CoreLocation.
works.idea_zh: 把 GPS 地标标签稳稳钉在真实街景上。

video.video_title: ARKit + CoreLocation https://t.co/nTdKyGrBmv

works.technique: GPS coordinates of landmarks are converted to bearings and distances from the device's location and heading, then placed as labels in ARKit's gravity-and-heading aligned world frame.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR + GPS 在校园几栋楼的经纬度上放悬浮文字标签，走动时标签固定在建筑方向；变体：标签显示这栋楼里你的一段个人记忆。
works.description_zh: 他在伦敦街头行走时，按 GPS 钉在真实地标上的悬浮标签始终稳稳停在原处；这个演示把 ARKit 追踪与 CoreLocation 结合在一起。
works.idea_en: GPS landmark labels pinned firmly onto the real street view.
works.technique_zh: 根据设备的位置和朝向，把地标的 GPS 坐标换算成方位角和距离，再以标签形式放入 ARKit 按重力和方向对齐的世界坐标系中。
works.exercise_en: Use AR plus GPS to place floating text labels at the coordinates of several campus buildings, so the labels stay fixed toward each building as you walk. Twist: have each label show a personal memory of yours from inside that building.

works.title: ARKit + CoreLocation Part 2: AR Turn-by-Turn Navigation
works.description: AR arrows and route lines are drawn on the actual street, leading the walker turn by turn to the destination.
works.idea_zh: 第一次把导航箭头直接画在真实街道上。

video.video_title: ARKit + CoreLocation, part 2 https://t.co/AyQiFyzlj3

works.technique: Route waypoints from a directions API are converted from GPS to local AR coordinates and drawn as arrows and lines on the ground plane, re-aligned as location updates arrive.
works.exercise_zh: 从地图 API 获取一条步行路线的几个点，用 AR 在地面上画出箭头引导到下一个路口；变体：路线不是最短路，而是经过校园里最安静的地方。
works.description_zh: AR 箭头和路线直接画在真实街道上，一步一步引导行人抵达目的地。
works.idea_en: Navigation arrows drawn straight onto the real street for the first time.
works.technique_zh: 把路线规划 API 返回的途经点从 GPS 坐标转换为本地 AR 坐标，在地面平面上绘制成箭头和线条，并在收到新的定位数据时重新对齐。
works.exercise_en: Get a few points of a walking route from a map API and use AR to draw arrows on the ground that lead to the next intersection. Twist: make the route pass through the quietest places on campus instead of taking the shortest path.

works.title: ARKit + Unity + Motion Capture: robot dancing
works.description: A robot character performs motion-captured dance moves in his living room, showing how real mocap data makes an AR character feel alive.
works.idea_zh: 用动捕数据让机器人在客厅里跳舞。

video.video_title: ARkit + Unity + Motion Capture Data

works.technique: A humanoid rig driven by recorded motion-capture clips is placed on an ARKit floor plane so the dance happens at human scale.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Mixamo 下载一段舞蹈动作绑到角色上，放进 AR 教室里；加一个变化：用手机麦克风的节拍控制播放速度。
works.description_zh: 一个机器人角色在他的客厅里跳着动作捕捉来的舞蹈，说明真实的动捕数据能让 AR 角色显得生动鲜活。
works.idea_en: Motion-capture data makes a robot dance in your living room.
works.technique_zh: 由录制的动作捕捉片段驱动的人形骨骼被放在 ARKit 检测到的地面平面上，让舞蹈以真人比例呈现。
works.exercise_en: Download a dance clip from Mixamo, bind it to a character, and place the character in your classroom in AR. Twist: use the beat picked up by the phone microphone to control playback speed.

works.title: ARKit 3D Point Cloud House Walk-through
works.description: Logs every raw ARKit feature point while walking through a house, revealing the building as a sparse point cloud with the camera path drawn in green.
works.idea_zh: 把 ARKit 看到的特征点全部记录下来，走一圈房子就长出点云。

video.video_title: ARKit 3d point cloud - House walk through

works.technique: Every frame's ARKit raw feature points and camera pose are accumulated into a persistent point buffer, then rendered as a point cloud with the camera trajectory as a line.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 的 ARPointCloudManager 累积所有特征点并记录相机路径，走完一圈后把点云缩小放到桌上查看；变体：按采集时间给点着色，看出行走顺序。
works.description_zh: 在房子里走一圈，记录下 ARKit 的每一个原始特征点，建筑便以稀疏点云的形式显现出来，相机路径用绿线标出。
works.idea_en: Record every feature point ARKit sees, and a walk around the house grows into a point cloud.
works.technique_zh: 把每一帧 ARKit 的原始特征点和相机位姿累积到一个持久的点缓冲区中，再渲染成点云，并把相机轨迹画成一条线。
works.exercise_en: Accumulate all feature points with AR Foundation's ARPointCloudManager while recording the camera path, then shrink the point cloud onto a table to inspect it after one lap. Twist: color the points by capture time to reveal the walking order.

works.title: ARKit Light Estimation Demo
works.description: A virtual cube brightens and dims as he switches real room lights on and off, showing ARKit light estimation.
works.idea_zh: 虚拟物体的明暗随房间真实灯光变化。

video.video_title: ARKit by Example - Light Estimation demo

works.technique: ARKit light estimation returns ambient intensity and color temperature each frame, which are applied to the scene's lights so virtual objects match the room lighting.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR Foundation 中开启光照估计，把估计值赋给场景灯光，开关房间灯观察虚拟物体明暗变化；变体：房间越暗，虚拟物体自己越亮，像夜灯。
works.description_zh: 他开关房间里的真实灯光时，虚拟立方体也随之变亮变暗，以此展示 ARKit 的光照估计。
works.idea_en: Virtual objects brighten and dim with the real lights in the room.
works.technique_zh: ARKit 光照估计每帧返回环境光强度和色温，将其应用到场景灯光上，使虚拟物体与房间光照保持一致。
works.exercise_en: Turn on light estimation in AR Foundation, feed the estimated values into the scene lights, and switch the room lights on and off to watch the virtual object change. Twist: the darker the room, the brighter the virtual object glows, like a night light.

works.title: ARKit Pokémon Go with Unity GPS and Mapbox
works.description: A Pokémon Go-style demo that combines ARKit tracking with Mapbox GPS so creatures stand at real-world locations.
works.idea_zh: 把 ARKit 和 GPS 地图结合，做真正落在街道上的宝可梦。

video.video_title: Apple ARkit Pokemon Go with Unity GPS and Mapbox

works.technique: Mapbox converts creature GPS coordinates into positions relative to the device's GPS location and compass heading, which are then placed in the ARKit world frame.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR + GPS 把一个虚拟生物放在校园某个经纬度上，走到附近才能看见并点击捕捉；变体：生物只在特定时间段或天气出现。
works.description_zh: 一个类似 Pokémon Go 的演示，把 ARKit 追踪与 Mapbox 的 GPS 结合起来，让小精灵站在真实世界的具体位置上。
works.idea_en: ARKit plus GPS maps put Pokémon that actually stand on the street.
