works.technique: Predicts the defocus blur of the occlusion mask and adds compensating light from the display so the combined image has crisp opaque edges.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机视频透视AR对比“半透明叠加”和“完全遮挡”两种虚拟物体渲染，观察哪种更像真的；变化：给虚拟物体加阴影后再比较。
works.description_zh: 一种透视式显示器，能通过阻挡真实光线让虚拟物体真正不透明，并补偿遮罩周围模糊的“漏光”，使边缘看起来清晰锐利。
works.idea_en: Make virtual objects in see-through AR truly block the reality behind them.
works.technique_zh: 预测遮挡遮罩的离焦模糊，并由显示器补上相应的补偿光线，使合成后的图像具有清晰、不透明的边缘。
works.exercise_en: In phone video pass-through AR, compare rendering a virtual object as a semi-transparent overlay versus fully occluding, and observe which looks more real. Twist: add shadows to the virtual object and compare again.

works.title: Paper Cubes
works.description: Printable paper cubes become physical controllers for a crowd of AR stick figures: show a cube and the figures jump, turn or stop, and an 'AI cube' makes them smarter.
works.idea_zh: 用剪纸做的方块当遥控器，指挥 AR 小人跳、转、停。

video.video_title: AR Experiments: Paper Cubes

works.technique: Each cube face is a Vuforia image target; the recognized face and cube pose trigger behaviors for AR characters walking over the table.
works.exercise_zh: 打印几个带图案的纸方块，用 8th Wall/Vuforia 识别，每个图案对应一种角色动作；加一个变化：两个方块靠近时组合成新指令。
works.description_zh: 可打印的纸方块成为一群 AR 火柴人的实体控制器：亮出一个方块，小人们就会跳跃、转身或停下，而一个“AI 方块”能让它们变得更聪明。
works.idea_en: Paper cubes become remote controls that make AR stick figures jump, turn and stop.
works.technique_zh: 方块的每个面都是一个 Vuforia 图像目标，识别出的面和方块位姿会触发桌面上行走的 AR 角色做出相应行为。
works.exercise_en: Print a few patterned paper cubes and recognize them with 8th Wall or Vuforia, with each pattern mapped to a character action. Twist: two cubes placed close together combine into a new command.

works.title: Parallel Parking with AR
works.description: A prototype AR guide that measures a parking spot from the sidewalk and shows whether and how the car will fit.
works.idea_zh: 先在路边量出车位，再用 AR 指引侧方停车。

video.video_title: Parallel Parking with Augmented Reality - by AirMeasure

works.technique: The user marks the corners of the parking gap by raycasting to the ground plane, and the measured length is compared to a car-sized bounding box shown in place.
works.exercise_zh: 在地面上点两点测出一段空位长度，放入一个指定大小的虚拟盒子并用红绿颜色提示是否放得下；变体：用它判断家具能否放进宿舍某个角落。
works.description_zh: 一个 AR 引导原型：在人行道上测量停车位，并显示车能否停进去以及该怎么停。
works.idea_en: Measure the parking space from the curb first, then let AR guide your parallel parking.
works.technique_zh: 用户通过向地面平面发射射线标出停车空位的各个角点，测得的长度与现场显示的车辆大小包围盒进行比较。
works.exercise_en: Tap two points on the ground to measure the length of a gap, drop in a virtual box of a given size, and use red or green to show whether it fits. Twist: use it to check whether a piece of furniture fits into a corner of your dorm room.

works.title: Pokémon GO AR+
works.description: An ARKit mode where Pokémon are anchored on the ground at real scale; walking closer can startle them, so players sneak up before throwing.
works.idea_zh: 宝可梦真实站在地面上，玩家要悄悄靠近才能捕捉。

video.video_title: Pokemon GO's new AR+ Mode for iOS

works.technique: ARKit plane detection anchors the creature at real scale on the ground, and the camera's distance and approach speed to the anchor drive a flee behavior.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 在地面放一只小动物，手机移动太快靠近时它会逃开，慢慢靠近才能摸到它；变体：蹲低身体时它会变得更信任你。
works.description_zh: 一种 ARKit 模式，宝可梦以真实比例锚定在地面上；走得太近可能会惊动它们，因此玩家要先悄悄靠近再投球。
works.idea_en: Pokémon stand on the real ground, and you have to sneak up to catch them.
works.technique_zh: ARKit 平面检测把小精灵以真实比例锚定在地面上，相机与锚点之间的距离和接近速度驱动其逃跑行为。
works.exercise_en: Place a small animal on the ground with AR Foundation that runs away if the phone approaches too fast, so you can only touch it by moving in slowly. Twist: it trusts you more when you crouch down low.

works.title: Rainbrow – Eyebrow-Controlled Game
works.description: An iPhone X game controlled with your face: raise your eyebrows to fly up, lower them to go down, using TrueDepth face tracking.
works.idea_zh: 用挑眉毛来控制角色上下的 iPhone X 游戏。

video.video_title: Rainbrow — iPhone X Eyebrow-Controlled Game

works.technique: ARKit face tracking on the TrueDepth camera exposes the browInnerUp/browDown blend-shape coefficients, which are mapped directly to the character's vertical position.
works.exercise_zh: 用 ARKit 面部 blendshape（或 MediaPipe Face Landmarker）读取眉毛高度，控制一个小鸟上下飞过障碍；变体：改用张嘴程度或挑一边眉毛控制。
works.description_zh: 一款用脸控制的 iPhone X 游戏：借助 TrueDepth 面部追踪，挑起眉毛就往上飞，压低眉毛就往下落。
works.idea_en: An iPhone X game where raising your eyebrows moves the character up and down.
works.technique_zh: 基于 TrueDepth 相机的 ARKit 面部追踪提供 browInnerUp/browDown 等 blendshape 系数，直接映射为角色的垂直位置。
works.exercise_en: Read eyebrow height from ARKit face blendshapes (or MediaPipe Face Landmarker) to steer a little bird up and down past obstacles. Twist: control it with how wide your mouth opens or by raising one eyebrow instead.

works.title: Realistic AR Brush Texture with Deep Learning
works.description: A neural network turns photos into painterly textures that are hung on real walls as AR paintings.
works.idea_zh: 用神经网络把照片变成油画笔触，挂到真实墙上。

video.video_title: Realistic AR brush texture with deep learning

works.technique: A style-transfer network (CoreML) converts a photo into a painted texture, which is applied to a framed quad placed on a detected vertical plane.
works.exercise_zh: 用在线风格迁移工具生成一张画作，用竖直平面检测把它挂在墙上并加画框；变体：拍下墙本身，风格化后贴回原处，让墙变成画。
works.description_zh: 神经网络把照片转换成具有绘画感的纹理，作为 AR 画作挂在真实墙面上。
works.idea_en: A neural network turns photos into oil-paint brushwork and hangs them on real walls.
works.technique_zh: 风格迁移网络（CoreML）把照片转换为绘画纹理，再贴到一个带画框的四边形上，放置在检测到的竖直平面上。
works.exercise_en: Generate a painting with an online style-transfer tool, hang it on a wall using vertical plane detection, and add a frame. Twist: photograph the wall itself, stylize it, and paste it back in place so the wall becomes a painting.

works.title: Reality Editor 2.0: A Web Browser for the Physical World
works.description: The second-generation Reality Editor treats every physical object as a web page: anchored AR UIs, logic crafting and spatial search for objects in the room.
works.idea_zh: 把现实世界当成网页来浏览，每个物体都是一个可交互的页面。

video.video_title: Reality Editor 2: A Web-Browser for the Physical World

works.technique: Objects are identified by image targets and each hosts HTML/JavaScript UIs served from a local node server, which the AR browser renders as anchored web views and connects through a visual logic editor.
works.exercise_zh: 用 WebXR 或 8th Wall 为教室里 3 个物体各做一个锚定的小网页面板（显示状态、可点击），并提供一个“搜索”按钮高亮指定物体；变体：让每个物体的网页可以被其他同学编辑，看看一小时后变成什么样。
works.description_zh: 第二代 Reality Editor 把每一个实体物体都当作一张网页：提供锚定的 AR 界面、逻辑编排，以及对房间中物体的空间搜索。
works.idea_en: Browse the physical world like the web, where every object is an interactive page.
works.technique_zh: 物体通过图像目标识别，每个物体承载由本地节点服务器提供的 HTML/JavaScript 界面，AR 浏览器把它们渲染为锚定的网页视图，并通过可视化逻辑编辑器相互连接。
works.exercise_en: Use WebXR or 8th Wall to make an anchored mini web panel for each of three objects in the classroom (showing status and clickable), plus a "search" button that highlights a chosen object. Twist: let classmates edit each object's page and see what it has become after an hour.

works.title: Refraction in AR.js
works.description: Glass-like virtual objects refract the live camera feed so they blend into the real desk; a larger glass torus fills his apartment.
works.idea_zh: 虚拟玻璃物体折射真实画面，与现实融为一体。

video.video_title: Refraction in AR js

works.technique: The live camera frame is used as an environment texture, and a refraction shader offsets its lookup by the surface normal so glass objects bend the real scene behind them.
works.exercise_zh: 在 three.js + WebXR 中把摄像头画面作为环境贴图，给一个玻璃球加折射材质放在桌上；变体：让玻璃物体的形状是你自己的名字 3D 字。
works.description_zh: 玻璃质感的虚拟物体折射实时相机画面，从而与真实桌面融为一体；一个更大的玻璃圆环则填满了他的公寓。
works.idea_en: Virtual glass objects refract the real scene and blend into reality.
works.technique_zh: 把实时相机画面用作环境纹理，折射着色器根据表面法线偏移采样位置，使玻璃物体弯折其后方的真实场景。
works.exercise_en: In three.js with WebXR, use the camera image as an environment map and put a glass sphere with a refractive material on the table. Twist: shape the glass object as 3D letters of your own name.

works.title: Rendez-vous in Mixed Reality
works.description: In a mixed-reality video, the artist paints a glowing cat in the air of her living room while her real cat Mimi watches and tries to catch the virtual one.
works.description_zh: 在一段混合现实视频中，艺术家在客厅的空中画出一只发光的猫，她家真实的猫 Mimi 盯着看，还试图去抓那只虚拟的猫。
works.idea_en: A real pet meeting a painted one reveals the magic and absurdity of mixed reality.
works.idea_zh: 真实的宠物遇见画出来的宠物，揭示了混合现实的魔力和荒诞。
works.technique: The painting is made in Tilt Brush on a tracked VR headset, and a separately tracked external camera composites the 3D strokes over real room footage.
works.technique_zh: 画作在带追踪的 VR 头显中用 Tilt Brush 完成，另一台被追踪的外部摄像机把三维笔触合成到真实房间的画面上。
works.exercise_en: Use Open Brush or an AR drawing app to paint a character that interacts with a real object or person in the frame, and film it from a second camera. Twist: have a real person or pet 'respond' to the drawing on cue.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Open Brush 或 AR 绘画应用画一个角色，让它与画面里真实的物体或人互动，并用第二台摄像机拍下来；变体：让一个真人或宠物按提示对这幅画“做出回应”。

video.video_title: Rendez-vous in Mixed Reality (Tilt Brush)

works.title: Retargeting Video Tutorials to AR
works.description: Tool paths in video tutorials (e.g. painting or sanding strokes on a surface) are extracted and replayed as 3D AR guides on the user's own object.
works.idea_zh: 把视频教程里的工具动作抽出来，变成叠在自己物体上的AR轨迹。

video.video_title: Retargeting Video Tutorials Showing Tools with Surface Contact to Augmented Reality

works.technique: Tracks the tool and its surface contact in the source video, reconstructs the 3D path, and renders it as animated guides registered to the target surface.
works.exercise_zh: 选一段书法或描线教学视频，手动描出其中的笔画路径，用手机AR叠加在学生自己的纸上跟写；变化：路径速度随学生书写速度自适应。
works.description_zh: 从视频教程中提取工具路径（例如在表面上涂刷或打磨的笔触），并在用户自己的物体上以 3D AR 引导的形式重放。
works.idea_en: Pull the tool motions out of a video tutorial and turn them into AR paths laid over your own object.
works.technique_zh: 在原始视频中追踪工具及其与表面的接触，重建 3D 路径，并将其渲染为配准到目标表面上的动画引导。
works.exercise_en: Pick a calligraphy or line-tracing tutorial video, trace its stroke paths by hand, and overlay them in phone AR on students' own paper so they can write along. Twist: have the path speed adapt to each student's writing speed.

works.title: SharedSphere
works.description: A local worker streams a live 360 panorama; the remote expert, immersed in it, sees and points with hands and gaze shown back to the local worker in AR.
works.idea_zh: 远程专家'钻进'现场的360全景里，手势和视线实时回到现场AR中。

video.video_title: SharedSphere: MR collaboration through shared live panorama

works.technique: A 360 camera on the local worker streams a live panorama to the remote expert's VR view, and the expert's head gaze and Leap Motion hand gestures are sent back and rendered in the local worker's AR display.
works.exercise_zh: 用一部 360 相机（或手机全景直播）把现场画面传给远程同学，远程同学在画面上点击标注，本地同学在手机 AR 中看到对应方向的箭头；变体：只允许远程同学用手势，不允许说话，完成一次找物任务。
works.description_zh: 现场工作人员实时传输 360 全景画面；沉浸其中的远程专家可以观察并用手势指点，其手势和视线会以 AR 形式回传给现场人员。
works.idea_en: A remote expert steps into a live 360 view of the site, and their hands and gaze appear back on site in AR.
works.technique_zh: 现场人员身上的 360 相机把实时全景传到远程专家的 VR 视图中，专家的头部注视方向和 Leap Motion 手势被回传，并在现场人员的 AR 显示中渲染出来。
works.exercise_en: Stream the scene to a remote classmate with a 360 camera (or a phone panorama livestream), let the remote classmate tap to annotate the view, and have the local classmate see an arrow in that direction in phone AR. Twist: the remote classmate may only use gestures and cannot speak while completing a find-the-object task.

works.title: Snapchat World Lenses
works.description: Snapchat's rear-camera lenses place animated 3D objects, such as a rainbow-puking cloud or the Dancing Hot Dog, on the ground in the real scene that users can walk around and record.
works.idea_zh: 把动画3D角色放进后置镜头的真实世界，让AR成为全民表情包。

video.video_title: Introducing New World Lenses

works.technique: Rear-camera SLAM with ground detection anchors an animated character to the floor, and video recording captures the composited result for sharing.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Lens Studio 做一个地面上的动画角色 World Lens，录一段 10 秒短视频；变体：角色会模仿镜头前真人的动作（用身体追踪）。
works.description_zh: Snapchat 的后置摄像头滤镜把带动画的 3D 物体放在真实场景的地面上，比如吐彩虹的云朵或跳舞热狗，用户可以绕着它们走动并录制视频。
works.idea_en: Animated 3D characters dropped into the real world through the rear camera turned AR into everyone's meme.
works.technique_zh: 后置摄像头 SLAM 结合地面检测，把动画角色锚定在地面上，并通过视频录制捕捉合成后的画面用于分享。
works.exercise_en: Make a World Lens with an animated character on the ground in Lens Studio and record a 10-second clip. Twist: the character imitates the movements of a real person in front of the camera, using body tracking.

works.title: Studio Play
works.description: A gallery of installations at the Cleveland Museum of Art where families use movement to explore the collection, including a 4K wall that reveals and zooms artworks by body position.
works.idea_zh: 在美术馆里用身体动作去“揭开”和放大馆藏作品。

video.video_title: Studio Play

works.technique: Depth cameras estimate each visitor's position and distance from the wall, mapping it to pan and zoom within a high-resolution image of artworks.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe 估计人离屏幕多远、站在左还是右，据此放大一幅高清名画的对应区域；变体：画作里的人物会转头看向你所站的位置。
works.description_zh: 克利夫兰艺术博物馆中的一组互动装置，家庭观众用身体动作探索馆藏，其中一面 4K 墙会根据人的身体位置揭示并放大艺术作品。
works.idea_en: Use your body to uncover and zoom into museum artworks.
works.technique_zh: 深度相机估计每位观众的位置及其与墙面的距离，并映射为在一幅高分辨率艺术作品图像中的平移和缩放。
works.exercise_en: Use MediaPipe to estimate how far a person is from the screen and whether they stand left or right, and zoom into the matching region of a high-resolution famous painting. Twist: the figures in the painting turn their heads to look at where you stand.

works.title: Super Mario AR
works.description: A Super Mario World level is bent into a ring around the player; you turn in place to follow Mario and reach out to grab power-ups floating in real space and drop them onto him.
works.idea_zh: 把横版马里奥关卡卷成一圈围着你，你转身跟着跑，还能伸手抓道具丢给马里奥。

video.video_title: Super Mario AR

works.technique: The level geometry is wrapped onto a cylinder centered on the ARKit world origin so rotating the phone scrolls the game, and a raycast pick lets you move items.
works.exercise_zh: 把一个 2D 小游戏的关卡'卷'成围着玩家的一圈（在 Unity 或 Reality Composer 里），玩家原地转身来推进；加一个变化：玩家必须蹲下才能看到隐藏关。
works.description_zh: 一个《Super Mario World》关卡被弯成一圈环绕着玩家；你原地转身跟着马里奥前进，还能伸手抓住漂浮在真实空间中的道具，再把它们丢给马里奥。
works.idea_en: A side-scrolling Mario level wraps around you; you turn to follow him and reach out to grab power-ups for him.
works.technique_zh: 关卡几何被包裹到以 ARKit 世界原点为中心的圆柱面上，转动手机即可卷动游戏画面，通过射线拾取可以移动道具。
works.exercise_en: Wrap the level of a small 2D game into a ring around the player (in Unity or Reality Composer) so the player advances by turning in place. Twist: players must crouch to see a hidden level.

works.title: Super Mario Bros Recreated as Life-Size AR Game
works.description: He rebuilt World 1-1 of Super Mario Bros at life size and played it in first person in Central Park, hitting blocks and stomping Goombas through a HoloLens.
works.idea_zh: 把超级马里奥第一关按真人尺寸搬进中央公园，自己扮成马里奥去玩。

video.video_title: Super Mario Bros Recreated as Life Size Augmented Reality Game

works.technique: A life-size level built in Unity is anchored to a world origin on HoloLens so inside-out SLAM tracking lets the player walk through it, with collisions between the head position and block colliders triggering hits.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 在地面上放一排 1:1 大小的问号方块，头（相机）碰到方块时弹出金币并计分；变体：把关卡换成你们校园里某条走廊的专属地图。
works.description_zh: 他按真人尺寸重建了《Super Mario Bros》的 1-1 关，戴着 HoloLens 在中央公园以第一人称游玩，顶砖块、踩栗子怪。
works.idea_en: The first level of Super Mario, rebuilt life-size in Central Park, with the player as Mario.
works.technique_zh: 在 Unity 中搭建的真人尺寸关卡锚定在 HoloLens 的世界原点上，借助 inside-out SLAM 追踪让玩家在其中行走，头部位置与方块碰撞体之间的碰撞会触发顶砖效果。
works.exercise_en: Place a row of life-size question blocks on the ground with AR Foundation, and pop out a coin and add to the score when the head (camera) hits a block. Twist: replace the level with a custom map of a hallway on your campus.

works.title: Tangible Mixed Reality 01: Oculus Touch & haptics
works.description: First of a series in which Oculus Touch controllers track real objects so they can be mirrored inside VR; here real surfaces give passive haptic feedback to a virtual interface.
works.idea_zh: 用真实物体给虚拟界面提供被动触觉反馈。

video.video_title: Tangible Mixed Reality 01 : Oculus Touch & haptics

works.technique: A tracked controller is mounted on a real object to provide its 6DoF pose, and a virtual panel is registered to the object's surface so touching the virtual UI hits real material (passive haptics).
works.exercise_zh: 在一块纸板上贴图像标记，用 AR 在纸板表面叠加一组虚拟按钮，手指点纸板时按钮高亮；变体：用不同材质（毛毡、铝箔）做表面，比较哪种按起来最像按钮。
works.description_zh: 系列作品的第一部，用 Oculus Touch 控制器追踪真实物体，使其能在 VR 中被同步映射；在这件作品里，真实表面为虚拟界面提供了被动触觉反馈。
works.idea_en: Real objects give virtual interfaces passive touch feedback.
works.technique_zh: 把被追踪的控制器安装在真实物体上以获取其 6DoF 位姿，并把虚拟面板配准到物体表面，使触碰虚拟界面时手指碰到的是真实材料（被动触觉）。
works.exercise_en: Stick an image marker on a piece of cardboard, overlay a set of virtual buttons on its surface in AR, and highlight a button when a finger taps the cardboard. Twist: make the surface from different materials (felt, foil) and compare which feels most like a button.

works.title: Tangible Mixed Reality 02: Oculus Touch & launchpad
works.description: A physical launchpad controller is tracked and mirrored in VR so its real pads can be pressed while wearing a headset, with virtual feedback attached.
works.idea_zh: 把真实MIDI打击垫变成混合现实中的空间视觉控制器。

video.video_title: Tangible Mixed Reality 02 : Oculus Touch & launchpad

works.technique: The physical launchpad is registered in the virtual scene by a rigidly attached tracker, and incoming MIDI note events trigger visual effects at each pad's virtual position.
works.exercise_zh: 把一个 MIDI 键盘或手机上的虚拟鼓垫连接到 Unity，每次按键在 AR 中对应位置冒出粒子；变体：让粒子飞向房间里的某个固定目标并留下痕迹。
works.description_zh: 一个实体 Launchpad 控制器被追踪并映射到 VR 中，戴着头显时也能按到真实的打击垫，同时附带虚拟反馈。
works.idea_en: A real MIDI pad controller becomes a spatial visual instrument in mixed reality.
works.technique_zh: 通过刚性固定的追踪器把实体 Launchpad 配准到虚拟场景中，传入的 MIDI 音符事件会在每个打击垫的虚拟位置上触发视觉效果。
works.exercise_en: Connect a MIDI keyboard or a virtual drum pad on a phone to Unity, so each key press bursts particles at the matching spot in AR. Twist: make the particles fly toward a fixed target in the room and leave traces.

works.title: Tangible Mixed Reality 03: Oculus Touch & synthesizer
works.description: A real hardware synthesizer is registered in the virtual scene so you can play and tweak it while immersed, with virtual visuals attached to the instrument.
works.idea_zh: 转动真实合成器的旋钮，在空间中塑造声音可视化。

video.video_title: Tangible Mixed Reality 03 : Oculus Touch & synthesizer

works.technique: A hardware synth is aligned to a virtual replica through a tracked offset, so knob and key positions match and virtual visualizations stay attached to the physical instrument.
works.exercise_zh: 为一个真实乐器（如尤克里里）做图像标记，在琴身周围叠加随声音振动的 AR 波形；变体：用麦克风识别音高，不同音高显示不同颜色。
works.description_zh: 一台真实的硬件合成器被配准到虚拟场景中，沉浸其中时也能演奏和调节它，乐器上还附有虚拟视觉效果。
works.idea_en: Turn the knobs of a real synthesizer to shape sound visuals in space.
works.technique_zh: 通过追踪得到的偏移量把硬件合成器与其虚拟复制品对齐，使旋钮和琴键位置一一对应，虚拟可视化效果始终附着在实体乐器上。
works.exercise_en: Make an image marker for a real instrument (such as a ukulele) and overlay AR waveforms around its body that vibrate with the sound. Twist: detect pitch with the microphone and show a different color for each pitch.

works.title: Tangible Mixed Reality 04: Oculus Touch & keyboard
works.description: A physical computer keyboard is tracked so you can type for real inside VR, with virtual labels and panels attached to the real keys.
works.idea_zh: 在VR中用真实键盘打字，并给实体按键叠加虚拟标签。

video.video_title: Tangible Mixed Reality 04 : Oculus Touch & keyboard

works.technique: A tracker fixed to the keyboard gives its pose, and a matching virtual keyboard model with per-key labels is overlaid so the user can type on real keys while immersed.
works.exercise_zh: 在真实键盘上用图像标记定位，给常用快捷键叠加 AR 标签；变体：按下某个键时在键盘上方浮现一句该键的“内心独白”。
works.description_zh: 一个实体电脑键盘被追踪，让你能在 VR 中真正打字，真实按键上还附着虚拟标签和面板。
works.idea_en: Type on a real keyboard in VR, with virtual labels laid over the physical keys.
works.technique_zh: 固定在键盘上的追踪器提供其位姿，再叠加一个与之匹配、每个键都带标签的虚拟键盘模型，让用户在沉浸状态下也能在真实按键上打字。
works.exercise_en: Locate a real keyboard with an image marker and overlay AR labels on commonly used shortcuts. Twist: when a key is pressed, a line of that key's "inner monologue" floats above the keyboard.

works.title: Tangible Mixed Reality 05: Oculus Touch & board game
works.description: A real board game is tracked and augmented with a virtual layer, pitching mixed reality as a way to 'uberize' ordinary physical objects the way MP3 did music.
works.idea_zh: 给真实桌游叠加虚拟棋子和动画，让普通物件被数字层重新定义。

video.video_title: Tangible Mixed Reality 05 : Oculus Touch & board game

works.technique: The board's pose is tracked with a controller or marker, and a virtual layer (animations, rules, scores) is rendered in board-local coordinates so it moves with the physical board.
works.exercise_zh: 选一个简单的棋盘游戏（如井字棋），用图像追踪识别棋盘并在格子上叠加动画和得分；变体：加入一条只有 AR 才能看到的隐藏规则。
works.description_zh: 一套真实的桌游被追踪并叠加上一层虚拟内容，借此提出混合现实可以像 MP3 之于音乐那样，把普通实体物品“优步化”。
works.idea_en: Virtual pieces and animations on a real board game let a digital layer redefine an ordinary object.
works.technique_zh: 用控制器或标记追踪棋盘位姿，并在棋盘局部坐标系中渲染一层虚拟内容（动画、规则、分数），使其随实体棋盘一起移动。
works.exercise_en: Pick a simple board game (such as tic-tac-toe), recognize the board with image tracking, and overlay animations and scores on the squares. Twist: add a hidden rule that only AR can reveal.

works.title: Tangible Mixed Reality 06: Oculus Touch & ROBOT
works.description: A small physical robot is tracked with an Oculus Touch controller and mirrored in the virtual scene, blending a real moving machine with a virtual character.
works.idea_zh: 给真实的小机器人套上虚拟外形和界面，实体与虚拟角色合一。

video.video_title: Tangible Mixed Reality 06 : Oculus Touch & ROBOT

works.technique: A tracker rides on a small robot so its live pose drives a virtual character or effect overlay, blending the physical motion with a digital skin.
works.exercise_zh: 给一辆遥控小车贴图像标记，在 AR 中把它换成一只动物角色；变体：小车撞到东西时，AR 角色做出夸张的表情。
works.description_zh: 一个小型实体机器人由 Oculus Touch 控制器追踪并映射到虚拟场景中，把一台真实运动的机器与一个虚拟角色融合在一起。
works.idea_en: A real little robot wears a virtual body and interface, merging machine and character.
works.technique_zh: 追踪器搭载在小机器人上，其实时位姿驱动一个虚拟角色或叠加特效，把实体运动与数字外皮融为一体。
works.exercise_en: Stick an image marker on a remote-controlled car and replace it with an animal character in AR. Twist: when the car bumps into something, the AR character makes an exaggerated face.

works.title: The Armada Arrives
works.description: A fleet of enormous spaceships hovers above his house, testing how very large virtual objects feel in ARKit.
works.idea_zh: 一支巨型舰队悬停在自家房子上空。

video.video_title: ARKit Unity Demo - The Armada Arrives!

works.technique: Very large models are placed far from the camera in world space with correct scale, atmospheric fog and shadows, so world tracking conveys their size above the house.
works.exercise_zh: 在户外放一个几百米大小的飞船悬在空中，加雾和阴影让它看起来够远够大；变体：飞船投下的阴影会随时间在地面上移动。
works.description_zh: 一支由巨型宇宙飞船组成的舰队悬停在他家房子上空，用来测试超大型虚拟物体在 ARKit 中给人的感受。
works.idea_en: A giant fleet hovers in the sky above your house.
works.technique_zh: 在世界空间中把超大模型以正确比例放置在远离相机的位置，配合大气雾效和阴影，使世界追踪能够传达出它们悬在房屋上方的巨大尺度。
works.exercise_en: Place a spaceship hundreds of meters long hovering in the air outdoors, and add fog and shadows so it looks far and big enough. Twist: the ship's shadow moves across the ground over time.

works.title: The Machines
works.description: The released game: 1v1 real-time multiplayer battles on a real table, where each phone is a moving camera over a shared miniature battlefield.
works.idea_zh: 两台手机在同一张桌上共享微缩战场，实时对战。

video.video_title: The Machines Launch Trailer

works.technique: Two phones share one tabletop anchor and a synchronized game state, with each phone acting as a free-moving camera over the miniature battlefield.
works.exercise_zh: 用网络同步做一个两人桌面 AR 对战，每人从自己的角度看同一张地图；变体：每个人只能看到自己单位附近的区域（战争迷雾）。
works.description_zh: 正式发布的游戏版本：在真实桌面上进行 1 对 1 实时多人对战，每部手机都是一台在共享微缩战场上方移动的摄像机。
works.idea_en: Two phones share a miniature battlefield on one table for a real-time battle.
works.technique_zh: 两部手机共享同一个桌面锚点和同步的游戏状态，每部手机都作为一台在微缩战场上方自由移动的摄像机。
works.exercise_en: Use network sync to build a two-player tabletop AR battle where each player sees the same map from their own angle. Twist: each player can only see the area near their own units (fog of war).

works.title: The Machines (Apple keynote reveal)
works.description: Shown at Apple's iPhone 8 event: a tabletop strategy battle in which players walk around the table to change the view and find openings in the enemy base.
works.idea_zh: 绕着桌子走动去观察战场，身体移动本身就是战术。

video.video_title: Directive Games Reveals The Machines | Apple Special Event 2017 | Unreal Engine

works.technique: ARKit world tracking places a detailed battlefield on the table, and the player's physical movement around it becomes the camera control, revealing new sightlines.
works.exercise_zh: 在桌上放一个 AR 迷宫城堡，只有走到某个角度才能看到隐藏的入口；变体：入口在两个人分别站在两侧时才会同时出现。
works.description_zh: 在 Apple 的 iPhone 8 发布会上亮相：一场桌面策略对战，玩家绕着桌子走动来改变视角，寻找敌方基地的破绽。
works.idea_en: Walk around the table to survey the battlefield, where moving your body is itself a tactic.
works.technique_zh: ARKit 世界追踪把一个细节丰富的战场放在桌上，玩家绕桌的身体移动成为相机控制，从而揭示新的视线。
works.exercise_en: Put an AR maze castle on a table whose hidden entrance is visible only from a certain angle. Twist: the entrance appears only when two people stand on opposite sides at the same time.

works.title: The New Yorker Innovators Issue AR Cover (with Christoph Niemann)
works.description: Christoph Niemann's New Yorker cover of a subway platform opens in AR into a 3D Manhattan that rises out of the magazine.
works.idea_zh: 杂志封面上的地铁站升起整座立体曼哈顿

video.video_title: The New Yorker - Innovators Issue AR Cover | Nexus Studios

works.technique: Image tracking on the printed cover anchors an animated 3D city model in Unity/ARKit that rises out of the page with depth-consistent perspective.
works.exercise_zh: 给一张自己城市的明信片或海报做 AR：让画中的城市从纸面立体地升起；变体：让升起的城市是 50 年前或 50 年后的样子。
works.description_zh: Christoph Niemann 为《纽约客》绘制的地铁站台封面，在 AR 中展开成一座从杂志中升起的立体曼哈顿。
works.idea_en: A subway station on a magazine cover raises a whole 3D Manhattan.
works.technique_zh: 对印刷封面进行图像追踪，锚定一个在 Unity/ARKit 中制作的动画 3D 城市模型，让它以深度一致的透视从纸面上升起。
works.exercise_en: Make AR for a postcard or poster of your own city so the pictured city rises in 3D from the paper. Twist: the risen city shows what it looked like 50 years ago or will look like 50 years from now.

works.title: Titanic AR Demo
works.description: At a real lake, a full-size Titanic appears on the water and sails off into the distance.
works.idea_zh: 在真实湖面上，一艘等大的泰坦尼克号缓缓驶远。

video.video_title: Titanic AR Demo - ARKit augmented reality in Unity

works.technique: A full-scale ship model is placed at a distance on the water with a horizon-aligned anchor, and animated motion makes it sail away while tracking holds the world frame.
works.exercise_zh: 在操场或湖边放一艘真实尺寸的大船并让它缓慢驶远；变体：船只在你背对它时移动，转身才发现位置变了。
works.description_zh: 在一片真实的湖上，一艘原尺寸的泰坦尼克号出现在水面，并缓缓驶向远方。
works.idea_en: A full-size Titanic slowly sails away across a real lake.
works.technique_zh: 借助与地平线对齐的锚点，把原尺寸的船模放在远处水面上，通过动画让它驶离，同时追踪维持世界坐标系稳定。
works.exercise_en: Place a life-size ship on a sports field or by a lake and let it slowly sail away. Twist: the ship moves only when your back is turned, so you notice its new position when you turn around.

works.title: Towers for Tango
works.description: A tower-defence game for Google's Tango depth-sensing phones in which the battlefield and towers are placed on real floors and furniture.
works.idea_zh: 在深度感知手机上，把塔防战场放在真实的地板和家具上。

video.video_title: Towers for Tango Trailer - AR game for Tango

works.technique: Tango's depth sensor builds a room mesh, and towers and enemy paths are placed on real floors and furniture surfaces from that mesh.
works.exercise_zh: 用带 LiDAR 的 iPhone 做网格重建，把敌人的行进路线放在真实地面上并绕开家具；变体：玩家可以挪动真实椅子来改变路线。
works.description_zh: 一款为 Google Tango 深度感知手机开发的塔防游戏，战场和防御塔都放在真实的地板和家具上。
works.idea_en: On a depth-sensing phone, a tower-defense battlefield is laid across real floors and furniture.
works.technique_zh: Tango 的深度传感器构建房间网格，再依据该网格把防御塔和敌人路径放置在真实地板和家具表面上。
works.exercise_en: Reconstruct a mesh with a LiDAR iPhone and lay the enemies' route on the real floor so it steers around furniture. Twist: players can move real chairs to change the route.

works.title: TweetReality
works.description: The first augmented-reality Twitter client: your timeline appears as floating cards arranged around you in space, which you browse by moving the phone.
works.description_zh: 第一个增强现实版 Twitter 客户端：你的时间线化作漂浮的卡片环绕在身边，移动手机即可浏览。
works.idea_en: Unroll a social feed into the room so scrolling becomes turning your body.
works.idea_zh: 把社交信息流铺满房间，让“滑动”变成“转身”。
works.technique: ARKit world tracking lays out Twitter API content as floating 3D cards around the user, with tap-to-open, like and retweet buttons in space.
works.technique_zh: 用 ARKit 世界追踪把 Twitter API 内容排布成环绕用户的漂浮 3D 卡片，并在空间中提供点击展开、点赞和转发按钮。
works.exercise_en: Lay out ten messages from a class chat as cards in a circle around the viewer in AR. Twist: older messages drift farther away and fade.
works.exercise_zh: 把班级群的十条消息以卡片形式在 AR 中围成一圈排列在观者周围；变体：越早的消息离得越远、越模糊。

video.video_title: TweetReality - The First AR Client for Twitter

works.title: Two-Way AR Portal with A-Frame 360
works.description: A walk-through portal door that shows a 360 world from outside and the real room from inside.
works.idea_zh: 一扇双向传送门：外面看是 360 世界，进去回看是现实房间。

video.video_title: Portal door with A-Frame 360 using AR.js

works.technique: A stencil-masked door shows a 360 panorama from outside, and when the camera crosses the door plane the rendering inverts so the panorama surrounds the viewer and the real room is seen through the door.
works.exercise_zh: 用 three.js + WebXR 放一扇门，门里显示一张 360 全景照片，走进门后全景包围你、门外看到真实房间；变体：用你自己拍的全景照片。
works.description_zh: 一扇可以走进去的传送门：从外面看是 360 度的世界，从里面看则是真实的房间。
works.idea_en: A two-way portal: from outside you see a 360 world, and from inside you look back at the real room.
works.technique_zh: 带模板遮罩的门从外面显示 360 全景，当相机穿过门所在的平面时渲染反转，全景包围观众，而真实房间则透过门框可见。
works.exercise_en: Place a door with three.js and WebXR that shows a 360 panorama inside; after you walk through, the panorama surrounds you and the real room is visible through the door. Twist: use a panorama you shot yourself.

works.title: Walking in VR Using AR.js Tracking
works.description: Uses AR.js positional tracking to physically walk into the A-Frame logo in virtual reality.
works.idea_zh: 借用 AR.js 的定位，在 VR 里真正走进 A-Frame 标志。

video.video_title: Walking in Virtual Reality using AR.js on A-Frame

works.technique: AR positional tracking drives the VR camera, so physical walking translates 1:1 into movement through a fully virtual A-Frame scene.
works.exercise_zh: 用 WebXR 追踪手机位置，把画面替换成全虚拟场景，让学生在教室里走进一个巨大 logo；变体：虚拟场景的墙壁与真实教室墙对齐，防止撞墙。
works.description_zh: 利用 AR.js 的位置追踪，在虚拟现实中亲身走进 A-Frame 的标志。
works.idea_en: Borrow AR.js positioning to actually walk into the A-Frame logo in VR.
works.technique_zh: AR 位置追踪驱动 VR 相机，使现实中的行走 1:1 转化为在纯虚拟 A-Frame 场景中的移动。
works.exercise_en: Track the phone's position with WebXR, replace the view with a fully virtual scene, and have students walk into a giant logo in the classroom. Twist: align the walls of the virtual scene with the real classroom walls so no one bumps into them.

works.title: Wingnut AR WWDC 2017 ARKit demo
works.description: On the WWDC 2017 stage, an iPad placed a desolate outpost on a real table; as the presenter walked around it, airships arrived, bombed the base and exploded into debris, all in Unreal Engine.
works.description_zh: 在 2017 年 WWDC 舞台上，一台 iPad 把一个荒凉的前哨基地放在真实桌面上；演示者绕着桌子走动时，飞艇飞来轰炸基地并炸出满地碎片，全部由 Unreal Engine 渲染。
works.idea_en: A tabletop becomes a cinematic miniature battlefield you can walk around like a film set.
works.idea_zh: 一张桌面变成可以绕着走的电影级微缩战场，像在片场里看戏。
works.technique: ARKit world tracking and horizontal plane detection anchor an Unreal Engine 4 scene to the table, with real-time lighting estimation and particle effects.
works.technique_zh: ARKit 的世界追踪和水平面检测把 Unreal Engine 4 场景锚定到桌面上，并配合实时光照估计和粒子特效。
works.exercise_en: Place a miniature diorama on a detected table plane and script a 30-second cinematic event (arrival, conflict, aftermath) that plays when the viewer walks to a marked viewpoint. Twist: let the viewer's distance to the table control the time scale.
works.exercise_zh: 在检测到的桌面平面上放置一个微缩场景，编排一段 30 秒的电影式事件（到来、冲突、余波），当观众走到指定观察点时触发播放。变体：让观众与桌子的距离控制时间流速。

video.video_title: Wingnut AR Unreal Engine Demo on iOS | WWDC 2017

works.title: ZapBox
works.description: A $30 cardboard headset turns a phone into a room-scale mixed-reality device: printed pointcode markers scattered on the floor map the room, and two cardboard controllers with codes act as tracked hands.
works.description_zh: 一个 30 美元的纸板头显把手机变成房间级混合现实设备：散放在地上的打印点码标记用于给房间建图，两个贴着码的纸板手柄充当被追踪的双手。
works.idea_en: Room-scale MR with tracked controllers, built from paper, cardboard and a phone camera.
works.idea_zh: 用纸、纸板和手机摄像头搭出带追踪手柄的房间级混合现实。
works.technique: The phone camera detects printed circular pointcodes to build a map of the room and track handheld cardboard controllers in 6DoF, with a fisheye lens widening the view.
works.technique_zh: 手机摄像头识别打印的圆形点码，建立房间地图并以六自由度追踪手持纸板手柄，同时用鱼眼镜头扩大视野。
works.exercise_en: Print six ArUco markers, tape two onto cardboard paddles, and build a phone AR scene where the paddles become tools that hit a floating ball. Twist: use a marker taped to the floor as a portal that swaps the ball into another world.
works.exercise_zh: 打印六个 ArUco 标记，把其中两个贴在纸板球拍上，做一个手机 AR 场景，让球拍变成击打漂浮小球的工具。变体：把一个贴在地上的标记当作传送门，让小球穿越到另一个世界。

video.video_title: ZapBox: Mixed Reality for Everyone

works.title: bioSync
works.description: Two people wear paired EMG/EMS armbands: when one tenses or relaxes a muscle, the other person's arm stiffens or loosens in sync, so a teacher can literally pass on a movement or a tremor.
works.description_zh: 两个人戴上成对的肌电感应/电刺激臂带：一个人绷紧或放松肌肉，另一个人的手臂就同步变硬或变软，老师可以把动作甚至手抖“传”给学生。
works.idea_en: Share muscle tension between two bodies as if it were a live video stream.
works.idea_zh: 像直播视频一样，在两具身体之间实时共享肌肉张力。
works.technique: Measures muscle activity with electromyography on one wearer and replays it as electrical muscle stimulation on the partner through the same electrodes, in both directions.
works.technique_zh: 在一位佩戴者身上用肌电图测量肌肉活动，再通过同一组电极以电刺激的形式在搭档身上回放，而且是双向的。
works.exercise_en: Pair students and have one guide the other's wrist with a light string and a phone vibration cue whenever the leader's phone accelerometer detects a flick; practise a drum pattern this way. Twist: swap roles mid-rhythm without stopping and see who is really leading.
works.exercise_zh: 让学生两两一组，一人手机的加速度计检测到甩腕时，就通过细绳牵引和另一部手机的震动提示带动搭档的手腕，用这种方式练一段鼓点；变体：节奏不停，中途交换角色，看看到底是谁在带谁。

video.video_title: bioSync: Synchronous Kinesthetic Experience among People

works.title: phosphere
works.description: A dance installation homage to Schlemmer's Triadic Ballet: dancers wearing wrist markers trigger light from 24 projectors mounted overhead, turning gestures into three-dimensional light geometry.
works.idea_zh: 舞者手腕上的标记点控制24台投影仪，把手势变成空间里的光之几何
works.technique: Wrist-marker motion tracking feeds a real-time system that aims light from 24 truss-mounted projectors at computed 3D positions around the dancers.
works.exercise_zh: 给同学手腕贴反光贴或彩色标记，用摄像头追踪后让投影仪在对应位置打出光圈；变化：两只手之间自动连成一条光线。

video.video_title: Rhizomatiks Research × ELEVENPLAY Dance Installation at Gallery AaMo “phosphere”

works.description_zh: 一件向 Schlemmer《三元芭蕾》致敬的舞蹈装置：舞者手腕佩戴标记，触发架设在头顶的 24 台投影仪发光，把手势化为三维的光之几何。
works.idea_en: Markers on dancers' wrists steer 24 projectors, turning gestures into geometry of light in space.
works.technique_zh: 手腕标记的动作追踪数据输入实时系统，控制架设在桁架上的 24 台投影仪，把光投向舞者周围计算出的 3D 位置。
works.exercise_en: Put reflective stickers or colored markers on a classmate's wrists, track them with a camera, and have a projector cast rings of light at the matching positions. Twist: automatically connect the two hands with a beam of light.

works.title: shapeShift
works.description: A compact pin-based shape display rides on a small robot across the table, rendering moving shapes you can feel and, paired with a headset, standing in physically for virtual objects.
works.description_zh: 一个紧凑的针阵形状显示器装在小机器人上在桌面移动，渲染出可以触摸的动态形状；配合头显使用时，它能充当虚拟物体的实体替身。
works.idea_en: Put a shape display on wheels so physical pixels can follow virtual objects around.
works.idea_zh: 给形状显示器装上轮子，让实体像素跟着虚拟物体走。
works.technique: Moves a 7 mm pitch actuated pin array on an omnidirectional robot base and synchronises its position and height map with tracked virtual content in a head-mounted display.
works.technique_zh: 把 7 毫米间距的驱动针阵装在全向机器人底座上，并将其位置和高度图与头显中被追踪的虚拟内容同步。
works.exercise_en: Stick a printed marker on a toy car or robot and anchor a virtual object to it in phone AR, so touching the real toy lets you 'touch' the virtual one. Twist: swap the virtual object while keeping the same physical proxy and discuss which feels right.
works.exercise_zh: 在玩具车或机器人上贴一个打印标记，在手机 AR 中把一个虚拟物体锚定在上面，这样触摸真实玩具就像“摸到”了虚拟物体；变体：保持同一个实体替身，更换虚拟物体，讨论哪种感觉最对。

video.video_title: shapeShift: A Mobile Tabletop Shape Display for Tangible and Haptic Interaction

works.title: AnimaStage
works.description: A tabletop stage with a hidden grid of actuators animates paper crafts and 3D-printed figures placed on it, turning hand-made props into puppets.
works.idea_zh: 在一个会动的舞台上，把纸片和手工道具变成会动的木偶。

video.video_title: Animastage

works.technique: Drives an array of linear actuators under a flexible stage surface so objects attached to it are pushed, tilted and bounced to perform scripted motions.
works.exercise_zh: 用纸板和手机振动（或小电机）做一个会抖动的纸偶舞台，并用手机AR叠加表情与台词；变化：让观众拍手的节奏驱动舞台动作。
works.description_zh: 一个桌面舞台，下方隐藏着一组执行器阵列，能让放在上面的纸艺和 3D 打印小人动起来，把手工道具变成木偶。
works.idea_en: A moving stage turns paper cutouts and handmade props into puppets.
works.technique_zh: 驱动柔性舞台表面下方的线性执行器阵列，推动、倾斜和弹跳附着在表面上的物体，让它们按脚本表演动作。
works.exercise_en: Build a shaking paper-puppet stage with cardboard and phone vibration (or a small motor), and overlay facial expressions and lines with phone AR. Twist: let the rhythm of the audience's clapping drive the stage's motion.

works.title: Augmented Reality Linoleum Prints
works.description: Hand-carved linoleum prints that come alive with animation when scanned, joining traditional printmaking with AR.
works.idea_zh: 传统版画与AR结合，手刻版画在镜头里活过来。

video.video_title: Augmented Reality Linoleum Prints by Zenka

works.technique: High-contrast hand-carved prints serve as image targets with strong feature points, and animations are aligned to the printed forms.
works.exercise_zh: 用橡皮章或手绘做一张高对比度图案，测试它作为图像标记的识别效果，并加上对应动画；变体：印出多张有细微差异的版画，每张触发不同动画。
works.description_zh: 手工雕刻的麻胶版画在扫描时会随着动画活起来，把传统版画与 AR 结合在一起。
works.idea_en: Traditional printmaking meets AR, and hand-carved prints come alive through the lens.
works.technique_zh: 高对比度的手刻版画具有丰富的特征点，可作为图像目标，动画与印刷图形精确对齐。
works.exercise_en: Make a high-contrast pattern with a rubber stamp or by hand, test how well it is recognized as an image marker, and add a matching animation. Twist: print several slightly different copies, each triggering a different animation.

works.title: ChainFORM
works.description: Modular chains with built-in touch sensing, angle sensing and LEDs that can be snapped together into shape-changing strips, wearables or creatures.
works.idea_zh: 可拼接的智能链条，能感触、显示和变形。

video.video_title: ChainFORM: A Linear Integrated Modular Hardware System for Shape Changing Interfaces

works.technique: Each module carries a servo, angle sensor, capacitive touch pad and LED on a shared bus, so a chain can both record and replay its own shape.
works.exercise_zh: 用积木或纸链条做一个“会记录形状”的原型，同时用手机AR给每一节标上颜色和数值；变化：把链条缠在手腕上变成可穿戴提醒器。
works.description_zh: 内置触摸感应、角度感应和 LED 的模块化链条，可以拼接成能变形的条带、可穿戴设备或小生物。
works.idea_en: Snap-together smart chains that can sense touch, display light and change shape.
works.technique_zh: 每个模块都在共享总线上集成了舵机、角度传感器、电容式触摸板和 LED，因此整条链既能记录也能重放自身的形状。
works.exercise_en: Build a prototype chain that "records its shape" from building blocks or paper links, and use phone AR to label each link with a color and value. Twist: wrap the chain around a wrist to make a wearable reminder.

works.title: Combining Shape-Changing Interfaces and Spatial AR
works.description: Projection and shape-changing objects work together so a physical object's appearance can extend and move beyond its real shape.
works.idea_zh: 投影+会变形的实物，让物体看上去能伸出自己本来的边界。

video.video_title: Combining Shape-Changing Interfaces and Spatial Augmented Reality Enables Extended Object Appearance

works.technique: Actuated objects are tracked and calibrated to a projector so that projected imagery extends the object's visible form beyond its physical shape and stays registered while it moves.
works.exercise_zh: 用一个舵机转动的纸盒和投影仪做投影映射，让投影把纸盒“延长”成一个动物，盒子动时投影的四肢跟着动；变体：让投影和实物运动故意错位，制造一个诡异的效果。
works.description_zh: 投影与可变形物体协同工作，使实体物体的外观能够延伸并运动到其真实形状之外。
works.idea_en: Projection plus a shape-changing object makes the object seem to reach past its own edges.
works.technique_zh: 对受驱动的物体进行追踪，并与投影仪标定，使投影图像把物体的可见形态延伸到其实体形状之外，且在运动中保持配准。
works.exercise_en: Do projection mapping on a servo-rotated paper box so the projection "extends" the box into an animal whose projected legs move when the box moves. Twist: deliberately misalign the projection and the physical motion to create an uncanny effect.

works.title: Crystal Cloud (Fête des Lumières)
works.description: The Coop Himmelb(l)au Musée des Confluences in Lyon is staged as a play between 'crystal' and 'cloud' — solid facets and soft vapour projected across its deconstructivist shell.
works.idea_zh: 在解构主义建筑上表演“水晶”与“云”的对话
works.technique: A precise 3D model of the irregular façade lets projected content switch between hard faceted lighting and soft volumetric effects.
works.exercise_zh: 用锡纸和棉花分别包两个纸盒，投影同一段动画，比较不同材质上的效果；变化：设计一段在两种材质间“迁移”的影像。

video.video_title: CRYSTAL CLOUD | Fête des Lumières 2016

works.description_zh: Coop Himmelb(l)au 设计的里昂汇流博物馆被演绎为“水晶”与“云”之间的一场对话——坚硬的切面与柔软的雾气交替投映在其解构主义外壳上。
works.idea_en: A dialogue between crystal and cloud performed on a deconstructivist building.
works.technique_zh: 依据不规则立面的精确 3D 模型，让投影内容在硬朗的切面光效与柔和的体积效果之间切换。
works.exercise_en: Wrap two paper boxes, one in foil and one in cotton, project the same animation onto both, and compare the effect on each material. Twist: design a piece of imagery that "migrates" from one material to the other.

works.title: Dead Mall Chunks
works.description: Point clouds reconstructed from found videos of abandoned shopping malls float as ghostly fragments of storefronts, escalators and arcades.
works.description_zh: 从网上找到的废弃购物中心视频中重建出的点云，像幽灵一样漂浮着店面、扶梯和游戏厅的碎片。
works.idea_en: Use other people's videos to archive places that are disappearing.
works.idea_zh: 用别人拍下的视频，为正在消失的地方建档。
works.technique: Frames from walk-through videos on YouTube are processed with photogrammetry into point clouds that are then collected and rendered in 3D.
works.technique_zh: 把 YouTube 上的漫游视频逐帧提取，用摄影测量处理为点云，再收集起来在三维中渲染。
works.exercise_en: Find a public walk-through video of a place that no longer exists, reconstruct a fragment of it as a point cloud and place it in AR on your desk. Twist: add sound from the original video that plays only when you lean in.
works.exercise_zh: 找一段已不复存在的地方的公开漫游视频，把其中一段重建为点云，再以 AR 方式放到桌面上；变体：加入原视频的声音，只有靠近时才会播放。

video.video_title: Dead Mall Chunks // Front Entrance

works.title: Demonz (INITI Playground)
works.description: Kids and adults throw real balls at animated monsters projected on a large floor or wall, playing a digital version of dodgeball in the real space.
works.description_zh: 孩子和大人把真实的球扔向投在大面积地面或墙面上的动画怪物，在真实空间里玩数字版躲避球。
works.idea_en: Turn any flat surface into a giant touch screen for physical ball games.
works.idea_zh: 把任何平面变成一块巨大的触摸屏，玩真实的投球游戏。
works.technique: Motion tracking detects where balls and bodies hit the surface and the projection-mapped game responds, so the play area can scale to any size and number of players.
works.technique_zh: 运动追踪检测球和身体击中表面的位置，投影游戏随之响应，因此场地大小和玩家人数都可以任意扩展。
works.exercise_en: Project a target game on a wall and detect soft-ball hits with a webcam by frame differencing; each hit pops a creature. Twist: make creatures dodge when players aim too long.
works.exercise_zh: 在墙上投一个打靶游戏，用摄像头帧差法检测软球击中的位置，每次击中就让一只小怪物爆开；变体：玩家瞄准太久时，怪物会躲开。

video.video_title: Demonz - INITI Playground

works.title: Down the Rabbit Hole
works.description: At Blackpool's Lightpool festival, the Tower Ballroom façade becomes a portal into weightless space inspired by astronaut Tim Peake and Alice in Wonderland.
works.description_zh: 在布莱克浦灯光节上，塔楼舞厅的立面变成一个通往失重太空的入口，灵感来自宇航员 Tim Peake 和《爱丽丝梦游仙境》。
works.idea_en: A façade as a rabbit hole: the building opens onto another world.
works.idea_zh: 把立面当成兔子洞：建筑打开，通向另一个世界。
works.technique: A projection-mapped narrative renders false perspective 'openings' into the wall so the audience seems to look through it into space.
works.technique_zh: 投影叙事在墙面上渲染出假透视的“开口”，让观众仿佛透过墙面看进太空。
works.exercise_en: Create a projected 'hole' in a flat wall using forced perspective, and animate something falling into it. Twist: make the hole follow the position of the nearest viewer using a webcam.
works.exercise_zh: 用强制透视在一面平墙上投影出一个“洞”，再做一个物体掉进去的动画；变体：用摄像头让这个洞跟随最近观众的位置变化。

video.video_title: Down The Rabbit Hole

works.title: Dynamic Projection Mapping onto Deforming Non-Rigid Surfaces
works.description: Images are projected onto cloth and paper as they fold and stretch, tracked at high speed so textures appear printed on the moving material.
works.idea_zh: 布料怎么揉捏折叠，投影的图案就怎么跟着变形，像印上去一样。

video.video_title: Dynamic projection mapping onto deforming non-rigid surface

works.technique: Invisible IR ink markers on the deformable surface are tracked by a high-speed camera, the surface mesh is reconstructed from the dot grid each frame, and the texture is warped onto it and projected by a high-speed projector.
works.exercise_zh: 在一块布或 T 恤上画一个点阵网格，用摄像头检测网格点（OpenCV 斑点检测），把图案按网格变形后投影回去，让投影随布料褶皱弯曲；变体：投影一件“会动的印花”，比如游动的鱼。
works.description_zh: 在布料和纸张折叠、拉伸的同时向其投射图像，借助高速追踪，纹理看起来就像印在运动的材料上一样。
works.idea_en: However the cloth is crumpled or folded, the projected pattern bends with it as if printed on.
works.technique_zh: 高速相机追踪可变形表面上肉眼不可见的红外墨水标记，每帧根据点阵重建表面网格，把纹理变形贴合上去，再由高速投影仪投射出来。
works.exercise_en: Draw a dot grid on a piece of cloth or a T-shirt, detect the grid points with a camera (OpenCV blob detection), warp a pattern to the grid, and project it back so it bends with the folds of the fabric. Twist: project a "moving print," such as swimming fish.

works.title: Dynamic VR Display
works.description: A head-tracked display setup in which 3D graphics are re-rendered from the viewer's eye position in real time, so flat screens combined with physical objects read as a continuous 3D space.
works.idea_zh: 跟踪观看者头部位置实时重绘画面，让平面屏幕与实物融成立体空间。

video.video_title: Dynamic VR Display (Rhizomatiks Research)

works.technique: Head tracking feeds an off-axis (asymmetric frustum) projection so each display renders the scene from the viewer's eye position, making flat screens behave like windows into a consistent 3D space.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe Face Mesh 估计头部位置，在 three.js 里做离轴投影，让笔记本屏幕变成一个有深度的“窗口盒子”；变体：盒子里放一个只有从特定角度看才能拼完整的物体或文字。
works.description_zh: 一套头部追踪显示装置，根据观看者眼睛的位置实时重新渲染 3D 图形，让平面屏幕与实体物体组合在一起时，看起来像一个连续的立体空间。
works.idea_en: Tracking the viewer's head and redrawing the image in real time merges flat screens and real objects into one 3D space.
works.technique_zh: 头部追踪数据输入离轴（非对称视锥）投影，使每块显示屏都从观看者眼睛的位置渲染场景，让平面屏幕像是通往同一个一致 3D 空间的窗口。
works.exercise_en: Estimate head position with MediaPipe Face Mesh and build an off-axis projection in three.js so a laptop screen becomes a "window box" with depth. Twist: put an object or text in the box that only comes together from one particular angle.

works.title: ExoSkin
works.description: A hybrid fabrication system for designing and 3D-printing wearables directly on the body, combining on-body modelling with printing onto a body-shaped surface.
works.idea_zh: 直接在身体上设计并打印可穿戴物。

video.video_title: ExoSkin by Madeline Gannon, Tovi Grossman, and George Fitzmaurice :: Supported by FRFAF

works.technique: Scans the body part, lets the designer model around it in 3D, and prints the wearable in place on a body-shaped form.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机扫描同学的手腕（Polycam等），在3D软件里围绕模型画一条饰带并用纸条按比例还原；变化：在AR中先试戴再制作。
works.description_zh: 一套混合式制造系统，可以直接在身体上设计并 3D 打印可穿戴物，把贴身建模与在人体形状表面上打印结合起来。
works.idea_en: Design and print wearables directly on the body.
works.technique_zh: 扫描身体部位，让设计者围绕它进行 3D 建模，再在人体形状的模具上原位打印可穿戴物。
works.exercise_en: Scan a classmate's wrist with a phone (Polycam or similar), draw a band around the model in 3D software, and recreate it to scale with paper strips. Twist: try it on in AR before making it.

works.title: Fencing Visualized
works.description: An AR sports-broadcast system that tracks the tips of fencing swords and draws their trajectories over live footage so audiences can follow the fast bouts.
works.idea_zh: 把剑尖轨迹实时叠加在直播画面上，让看不清的击剑变得可见

video.video_title: Yuki Ota Fencing Visualized Project - MORE ENJOY FENCING（English Ver.）

works.technique: Computer vision (likely multi-camera marker-less tracking with deep learning) localises the sword tips in each frame, and their 3D trajectories are rendered as trails over the broadcast camera image.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe Hands 或颜色追踪记录挥动一支彩色笔的轨迹，在视频上叠加渐隐的光带；变体：选一项你熟悉的快速动作（拍球、打字、翻书）做“可视化转播”。
works.description_zh: 一套 AR 体育转播系统，追踪击剑剑尖并把其运动轨迹绘制在直播画面上，让观众能够看清快速的交锋。
works.idea_en: Blade-tip trails drawn live over the broadcast make hard-to-see fencing visible.
works.technique_zh: 计算机视觉（可能是基于深度学习的多相机无标记追踪）在每一帧中定位剑尖，并把其 3D 轨迹渲染为叠加在转播画面上的拖尾。
works.exercise_en: Record the trajectory of a waving colored pen with MediaPipe Hands or color tracking, and overlay a fading band of light on the video. Twist: pick a fast motion you know well (bouncing a ball, typing, flipping pages) and make a "visualized broadcast" of it.

works.title: Flock: A Holojam Experience
works.description: David Lobser's co-located Holojam piece where participants become birds and create a flock together in shared space.
works.idea_zh: 一群人在共享空间里一起变成鸟群。

video.video_title: Flock: A Holojam Experience at FoST FEST

works.technique: Each participant's tracked position drives a bird avatar, and boids-style flocking rules (separation, alignment, cohesion) generate additional birds that respond to the participants' movements.
works.exercise_zh: 在 three.js 中实现 boids 鸟群，用摄像头检测到的人的位置作为“领头鸟”，投影到墙上或在 AR 中显示；变体：让鸟群对不同人的动作速度做出吸引或逃离的反应。
works.description_zh: David Lobser 创作的一件同场 Holojam 作品，参与者化身为鸟，在共享空间中一起组成鸟群。
works.idea_en: A group of people become a flock of birds together in a shared space.
works.technique_zh: 每位参与者被追踪的位置驱动一个鸟形化身，boids 式集群规则（分离、对齐、聚合）生成更多鸟，并对参与者的动作做出反应。
works.exercise_en: Implement a boids flock in three.js, use people's positions detected by a camera as "lead birds," and project it on a wall or show it in AR. Twist: make the flock be drawn to or flee from each person depending on how fast they move.

works.title: Fragments
works.description: A HoloLens crime thriller that maps your home and stages the investigation inside it: life-size characters sit on your real furniture and clues and memory reconstructions appear in your room.
works.idea_zh: 把真实家里变成犯罪调查现场，虚拟角色坐在你的沙发上。

video.video_title: Microsoft HoloLens: Fragments

works.technique: Spatial mapping classifies seats, tables and floors in the home, and the story system places characters and clues on matching surfaces, so each room produces a different staging.
works.exercise_zh: 检测房间里的水平面，把一个“案发现场”的线索分别放在最高和最低的平面上；变体：让一个 AR 角色坐在真实椅子上讲述案情。
works.description_zh: 一款 HoloLens 犯罪惊悚游戏，会扫描你的家并把调查过程搬进其中：真人大小的角色坐在你真实的家具上，线索和记忆重现场景出现在你的房间里。
works.idea_en: Your real home becomes a crime scene, with virtual characters sitting on your sofa.
works.technique_zh: 空间映射对家中的座位、桌子和地面进行分类，故事系统把角色和线索放到相匹配的表面上，因此每个房间都会产生不同的场景布置。
works.exercise_en: Detect the horizontal surfaces in a room and place the clues of a "crime scene" on the highest and lowest ones. Twist: have an AR character sit on a real chair and describe the case.

works.title: Gardens of the Anthropocene
works.description: AR plants mutated by climate change (such as giant red algae) grow over real harbours and gardens.
works.idea_zh: 气候变化下变异的植物在真实港湾里生长

video.video_title: Garden of the Anthropocene - Giant Red Algae in Salem Harbor

works.technique: Geolocated and plane-anchored 3D plant models (built in Unity, shown via Layar) are placed over real harbours and gardens at plausible scale.
works.exercise_zh: 为校园里的一种真实植物设计它在 2100 年气候下的“变异版”，用 AR 放在原植物旁边；变体：加一个时间滑块，让植物从现在逐渐变异到未来。
works.description_zh: 因气候变化而变异的 AR 植物（如巨型红藻）生长在真实的港湾和花园之上。
works.idea_en: Plants mutated by climate change grow in a real harbor.
works.technique_zh: 基于地理位置和平面锚定的 3D 植物模型（用 Unity 制作，通过 Layar 展示）以合理的比例放置在真实的港湾和花园上。
works.exercise_en: Design a "mutated version" of a real plant on campus as it might look under the climate of 2100, and place it next to the original in AR. Twist: add a time slider so the plant gradually mutates from now into the future.

works.title: Graffiti Nature
works.description: Drawn animals and plants are scanned into a projected room-sized ecosystem where they eat each other and flee when visitors step on them.
works.idea_zh: 画出的动物进入会被踩、会捕食的投影生态

video.video_title: Graffiti Nature

works.technique: Scanned drawings become agents in a projected ecosystem simulation (predator-prey rules), and floor-facing depth sensors detect footsteps that make creatures flee or die.
works.exercise_zh: 用 p5.js 做一个简单的捕食模拟，每个同学画的生物扫描后成为其中一个个体，投影到地面并用摄像头检测脚步；变体：被踩“死”的生物会变成养分，长出新的植物。
works.description_zh: 手绘的动物和植物被扫描进一个投影在整个房间里的生态系统，它们彼此捕食，被观众踩到时会逃开。
works.idea_en: Drawn animals enter a projected ecosystem where they hunt and can be stepped on.
works.technique_zh: 扫描后的绘画成为投影生态模拟（捕食者与猎物规则）中的个体，朝向地面的深度传感器检测脚步，使生物逃跑或死亡。
works.exercise_en: Build a simple predator-prey simulation in p5.js where each creature a classmate draws is scanned in as one individual, project it on the floor, and detect footsteps with a camera. Twist: creatures stepped "to death" become nutrients that grow new plants.

works.title: HYPER-REALITY
works.description: A POV short in Medellín where a woman's view is saturated with AR ads, game points and assistant UI; when her identity is hacked the overlay collapses.
works.idea_zh: 当AR完全接管视野，现实被游戏化与广告化后的眩晕与脆弱

video.video_title: HYPER-REALITY

works.technique: POV footage camera-tracked and composited with dense 3D UI layers; can be approximated live with phone world tracking plus a large number of world- and screen-space UI elements that collapse on an event.
works.exercise_zh: 在手机 AR 里把一条走廊塞满广告、游戏积分和助手提示，拍一段第一人称视频；变体：设计一个“身份被盗”的瞬间，让所有界面同时崩溃或变成陌生人的界面。
works.description_zh: 一部以麦德林为背景的第一人称短片：一位女性的视野被 AR 广告、游戏积分和助手界面塞满；当她的身份被黑客盗取时，叠加层随之崩塌。
works.idea_en: The dizziness and fragility of a reality turned into games and ads once AR takes over your whole view.
works.technique_zh: 对第一人称视角的实拍素材进行摄像机追踪，并合成密集的 3D 界面层；可以用手机世界追踪加上大量世界空间和屏幕空间的界面元素实时近似，并在某个事件发生时让它们一起崩溃。
works.exercise_en: Fill a hallway in phone AR with ads, game points and assistant prompts, and shoot a first-person video. Twist: design a moment of "identity theft" when every interface crashes at once or turns into a stranger's interface.

works.title: Hag-Seed interactive
works.description: An installation with Margaret Atwood for the London Literature Festival: text from her novel Hag-Seed becomes projected scenes that visitors play with using their bodies.
works.idea_zh: 把小说文字变成可以用身体玩的投影场景。

video.video_title: Hag-seed interactive

works.technique: Camera or depth-based body segmentation gives silhouettes and motion, which are used as collision shapes and forces for animated text particles in a projected scene.
works.exercise_zh: 选一首诗，把每个词变成投影墙上的物理粒子，用 MediaPipe Selfie Segmentation 的人体轮廓把词推散或接住；变体：只有两个人合作用身体搭出“容器”时，诗句才会按顺序排好。
works.description_zh: 与 Margaret Atwood 为伦敦文学节合作的装置：她的小说《Hag-Seed》中的文字化为投影场景，观众可以用身体与之互动。
works.idea_en: Turn the words of a novel into a projected scene you play with your body.
works.technique_zh: 基于相机或深度的人体分割提供轮廓和运动信息，用作投影场景中动画文字粒子的碰撞形状和作用力。
works.exercise_en: Choose a poem, turn each word into a physics particle on a projection wall, and use the body outline from MediaPipe Selfie Segmentation to push the words apart or catch them. Twist: the lines fall into order only when two people work together to form a "container" with their bodies.

works.title: HoloARt: Painting with Holograms
works.description: Judith Amores and Pattie Maes let users paint with hand gestures in HoloLens, splashing holographic paint that sticks to and drips on real surfaces.
works.idea_zh: 在真实房间里用手甩出全息颜料，颜料会粘在真实墙面上。

video.video_title: HoloARt: Painting with Holograms in Mixed Reality

works.technique: HoloLens spatial mapping provides a mesh of the room, and hand gestures spawn paint particles whose collisions with the mesh leave decals and drip simulations on real surfaces.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 的 Meshing（LiDAR iPhone）或平面检测，让手机点击屏幕发射颜料球，碰到真实表面后留下贴花并缓慢下流；变体：颜料的颜色或粘稠度由声音大小或手机倾斜角度控制。
works.description_zh: Judith Amores 和 Pattie Maes 让用户在 HoloLens 中用手势作画，泼出的全息颜料会粘在真实表面上并往下滴。
works.idea_en: Fling holographic paint with your hands in a real room, and it sticks to the real walls.
works.technique_zh: HoloLens 空间映射提供房间网格，手势生成颜料粒子，粒子与网格碰撞后在真实表面上留下贴花并进行滴落模拟。
works.exercise_en: Use AR Foundation Meshing (on a LiDAR iPhone) or plane detection so tapping the screen fires paint balls that leave decals on real surfaces and slowly drip down. Twist: control the paint's color or thickness with sound volume or the phone's tilt.

works.title: HoloStudio
works.description: Build 3D models in 3D with holographic tools modelled on real ones, then send them to a 3D printer to become physical objects.
works.idea_zh: 用手势在空中搭建3D模型，再打印成实物。

video.video_title: Microsoft HoloLens:  HoloStudio

works.technique: Provides a toolbelt of primitive shapes and holographic tools manipulated with gaze and air-tap, exporting printable meshes.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机AR（如Reality Composer）拼搭一个桌面雕塑，截图导出后用纸板/黏土做实体版本；变化：规定只能使用三种基本形状。
works.description_zh: 借助仿照真实工具设计的全息工具，在三维空间中直接搭建 3D 模型，再发送到 3D 打印机，变成实体物品。
works.idea_en: Build 3D models in the air with gestures, then print them as real objects.
works.technique_zh: 提供一套由基本形体和全息工具组成的工具带，通过注视和空中点击操作，并可导出可打印的网格。
works.exercise_en: Assemble a tabletop sculpture in phone AR (e.g., Reality Composer), export screenshots, and make a physical version from cardboard or clay. Twist: allow only three basic shapes.

works.title: Holographic ribbons for VRDG+H
works.description: A floating statue and ribbons appear as virtual images in mid-air using a holographic optical setup, animated to DUB-Russell's music at the VRDG+H show.
works.idea_zh: 用光学'虚像'让 Unity 做的雕像和缎带悬浮在空中随音乐舞动。

video.video_title:
像とリボンは虚像。ホログラフィーの使い方が分かってきて楽しくなってきました！3/26 VRDG+H ではこれが DUB-Russell の音に乗って暴れます💥💥💥
https://t.co/o5MyM7fKGw https://t.co/NLB81mzBO1

works.technique: Unity renders are shown through a holographic / Pepper's-ghost-style optical element so the image is perceived as a virtual image floating in space (likely a half-mirror or holographic screen).
works.exercise_zh: 用一块斜放的透明亚克力和手机屏幕做佩珀尔幻象，让一个 3D 小雕像悬浮；加一个变化：拍手时缎带绕着它旋转。
works.description_zh: 在 VRDG+H 演出中，借助全息光学装置，一座雕像和几条缎带以虚像的形式悬浮在半空，随 DUB-Russell 的音乐舞动。
works.idea_en: An optical virtual image makes a Unity statue and ribbons float in the air and dance to music.
works.technique_zh: Unity 渲染的画面经由全息或佩珀尔幻象类光学元件呈现，使图像被感知为悬浮在空间中的虚像（可能是半透镜或全息屏幕）。
works.exercise_en: Make a Pepper's ghost with a tilted sheet of clear acrylic and a phone screen so a small 3D statue appears to float. Twist: ribbons spin around it when you clap.

works.title: Holoportation
works.description: Rings of depth cameras capture people in full 3D and stream them live into HoloLens, so a remote person appears life-size in your room; conversations can be recorded and replayed at miniature scale.
works.idea_zh: 把远方的人实时'传送'成真人大小的全息影像站在你面前。

video.video_title: Holoportation: Virtual 3D Teleportation in Real-Time

works.technique: Multiple RGB-D camera pods capture a person from all sides, the Fusion4D pipeline fuses them into a temporally consistent textured mesh in real time, and it is compressed and streamed to a HoloLens where it is rendered anchored in the room.
works.exercise_zh: 用 iPhone 录一段 Record3D 或 Polycam 的体积视频（或深度点云），导入 Unity 放到 HoloKit/手机 AR 的桌面上以缩小比例回放，像是“迷你版的你”在讲话；变体：让回放可以被暂停和绕到背后看，记录一段你想留给未来自己的话。
works.description_zh: 环形排布的深度相机对人进行完整的 3D 捕捉，并实时传输到 HoloLens 中，让远方的人以真人大小出现在你的房间里；对话还可以被录制下来，以微缩比例回放。
works.idea_en: Teleport a faraway person live as a life-size hologram standing in front of you.
works.technique_zh: 多组 RGB-D 相机从各个方向捕捉人物，Fusion4D 流程实时将其融合为时间上一致的带纹理网格，经压缩后传输到 HoloLens，并锚定在房间中渲染。
works.exercise_en: Record a volumetric video (or depth point cloud) with Record3D or Polycam on an iPhone, import it into Unity, and play it back at reduced scale on a tabletop in HoloKit or phone AR, like a "mini you" talking. Twist: make the playback pausable and viewable from behind, and record a message you want to leave for your future self.

works.title: Hypercard in the World
works.description: The precursor to Dynamicland at HARC/CDG: paper cards on tables and walls become live programs through projection and cameras, and people program the room together.
works.idea_zh: 把一张张纸卡变成程序，让整个房间成为可以一起编程的电脑。

video.video_title: Hypercard in the World, May 2016

works.technique: Ceiling-mounted cameras identify paper cards by printed color-dot codes, and projectors render each card's program output onto and around it, with programs reacting to the positions and adjacency of other cards.
works.exercise_zh: 给几张卡片印上 ArUco 码，用俯视摄像头 + OpenCV 识别，在投影仪上给每张卡片显示对应的输出（一个颜色、一段文字），当两张卡片靠近时触发组合效果；变体：让同学把卡片当作“程序语句”拼出一个小动画。
works.description_zh: Dynamicland 在 HARC/CDG 时期的前身：通过投影和相机，桌面和墙上的纸卡变成实时运行的程序，人们一起为整个房间编程。
works.idea_en: Turn paper cards into programs so the whole room becomes a computer people program together.
works.technique_zh: 安装在天花板上的相机通过印刷的彩色圆点编码识别纸卡，投影仪把每张卡片的程序输出渲染在卡片上及其周围，程序会对其他卡片的位置和相邻关系做出反应。
works.exercise_en: Print ArUco codes on a few cards, recognize them with an overhead camera and OpenCV, and use a projector to show each card's output (a color, a line of text), triggering a combined effect when two cards come close. Twist: have classmates use the cards as "program statements" to assemble a small animation.

works.title: LONELY GHOUSTS
works.description: An early Project Tango AR game in which friendly creatures appear along your real walks and wait to be met and collected.
works.idea_zh: 在日常散步的路上遇见孤单的小幽灵。

video.video_title: LONELY GHOUSTS

works.technique: Tango motion tracking places animated creatures in world space so they stay put as you walk around them.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 在校园路线上随机放置 5 个'孤单小怪'，走近时它们会跟你打招呼；加一个变化：收集后它们会跟在你身后排队。
works.description_zh: 一款早期的 Project Tango AR 游戏，友善的小生物会出现在你真实的散步路线上，等着你去遇见并收集它们。
works.idea_en: Meet lonely little ghosts along your everyday walks.
works.technique_zh: Tango 运动追踪把带动画的生物放在世界空间中，你绕着它们走动时它们会保持在原地。
works.exercise_en: Use AR Foundation to scatter five "lonely little monsters" along a campus route that greet you when you get close. Twist: once collected, they line up and follow behind you.

works.title: Laplacian Vision
works.description: AR glasses or a projector show the predicted future trajectory of a thrown ball as a line in the air, helping people anticipate and catch it.
works.idea_zh: 让你看到飞行物体未来的轨迹。

video.video_title: Laplacian Vision: Augmenting Motion Prediction via HMDs (AH2016)

works.technique: Tracks the object with cameras, fits a ballistic model and renders the extrapolated path in the user's view with latency compensation.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机AR检测一个滚动的球并用抛物线/直线外推画出它未来1秒的位置；变化：故意显示“错误的未来”看同学是否被误导。
works.description_zh: AR 眼镜或投影仪把一个被抛出的球预测的未来轨迹以空中的线条形式显示出来，帮助人们预判并接住它。
works.idea_en: See where a flying object is going to be.
works.technique_zh: 用相机追踪物体，拟合弹道模型，并在补偿延迟后把外推出的路径渲染到用户视野中。
works.exercise_en: Detect a rolling ball in phone AR and draw its position one second ahead by parabolic or linear extrapolation. Twist: deliberately show a "wrong future" and see whether classmates are misled.

works.title: Light Barrier Third Edition
works.description: A larger edition at the Asian Culture Center in Gwangju: concave mirrors and projection materialize volumetric light objects and scenes in fog.
works.idea_zh: 更大尺度的光之屏障：光在雾中凝成体积感的影像与物体。

video.video_title: Light Barrier Third Edition [2016] (4K)

works.technique: Concave mirror arrays focus calibrated projector rays into haze, and mapping each pixel's reflected ray lets the system draw volumetric light objects at chosen positions in the room.
works.exercise_zh: 用一面凹面化妆镜反射投影进雾中，试着把光线汇聚成一个悬浮的光点并让它移动；变体：用这个光点讲一个“萤火虫”的小故事，光点会因观众靠近而逃走。
works.description_zh: 在光州亚洲文化殿堂展出的更大版本：凹面镜与投影在雾中凝结出具有体积感的光之物体和场景。
works.idea_en: A larger Light Barrier where light condenses in fog into volumetric images and objects.
works.technique_zh: 凹面镜阵列把经过标定的投影光线汇聚到雾气中，通过映射每个像素的反射光线，系统能在房间中的指定位置绘制出体积光物体。
works.exercise_en: Reflect a projection into fog with a concave makeup mirror and try to focus the light into a floating point of light that moves. Twist: use the point of light to tell a small "firefly" story in which it flees when viewers come close.

works.title: Light Capsule 004 — Astoria, Oregon
works.description: A faded hand-painted advertisement on an old building in Astoria is brought back to life at night: projection redraws the missing letters and colors exactly on top of the ghost sign.
works.description_zh: 阿斯托里亚一栋老建筑上褪色的手绘广告在夜晚复活：投影把缺失的字母和颜色精准地重画在“幽灵招牌”上。
works.idea_en: Use light to temporarily restore a city's forgotten layer of history.
works.idea_zh: 用光暂时修复城市被遗忘的历史图层。
works.technique: Archival photos and on-site research are used to redraw the sign as vector artwork, which is then projection-mapped and animated over the remaining paint.
works.technique_zh: 借助档案照片和实地考察，把招牌重绘为矢量图形，再投影映射到残存的油漆上并加入动画。
works.exercise_en: Find an old sign, faded poster or worn floor marking, photograph it, redraw what it once looked like, and project it back on site. Twist: animate the moment the sign was first painted.
works.exercise_zh: 找一块旧招牌、褪色海报或磨损的地面标识，拍照、重绘它原本的样子，再在现场投回去；变体：做一段动画，重现它当年被画出来的那一刻。

video.video_title: Light Capsule 004 — Astoria, Oregon

works.title: Light Capsule 013 — Detroit x Miss Van
works.description: In Detroit, a painted mural by street artist Miss Van and a neighboring ghost sign are augmented together with animated light that makes the painted figures glow and move.
works.description_zh: 在底特律，街头艺术家 Miss Van 的壁画与旁边的一块幽灵招牌一起被动态光影增强，画中的人物仿佛开始发光、移动。
works.idea_en: Add a time layer to a mural: light animates what paint can only freeze.
works.idea_zh: 给壁画加上时间维度：颜料只能定格的东西，光可以让它动起来。
works.technique: The mural is photographed straight-on, animation is drawn on top of the photo and projection-mapped back so light hits exactly the painted shapes.
works.technique_zh: 正面拍摄壁画，在照片上绘制动画，再投影映射回墙面，使光线精准地落在画中的形状上。
works.exercise_en: Choose a poster or drawing on the classroom wall, trace its shapes and animate one element (hair, water, eyes) with projected light. Twist: make the animation start only when someone stands in front of it.
works.exercise_zh: 挑一张教室墙上的海报或画，描出其中的形状，用投影让其中一个元素（头发、水、眼睛）动起来；变体：只有当有人站到它面前时动画才开始。

video.video_title: Light Capsule 013 — Detroit x Miss Van

works.title: Light Capsules — London Design Festival
works.description: During the London Design Festival, five ghost signs across the city are revived with projection, drawing crowds to walls they had walked past for years.
works.description_zh: 伦敦设计节期间，全城五处幽灵招牌被投影复活，吸引人们停下来注视这些多年来经过却从未留意的墙面。
works.idea_en: A tour of the city's ghost signs, each lit up for one night.
works.idea_zh: 一条城市幽灵招牌之旅，每一块都只亮一个晚上。
works.technique: Each sign is matched with historical sources, redrawn and projection-mapped, with animations that reveal the lettering stroke by stroke.
works.technique_zh: 每块招牌都与历史资料比对、重绘并做投影映射，动画一笔一画地揭示字母。
works.exercise_en: Map three locations on a campus walking route and design a projected reveal for each that connects into one story. Twist: publish a map so visitors can find them only at a set time.
works.exercise_zh: 在一条校园步行路线上选三个地点，为每个地点设计一段投影揭示，并把它们串成一个故事；变体：发布一张地图，访客只有在指定时间到达才能看到。

video.video_title: Light Capsules — LDF16: Part 1

works.title: Living Library
works.description: A giant projected book with real pages: a depth camera tracks hands so touching and turning pages triggers animated illustrations on the paper.
works.idea_zh: 巨大的实体书，翻页和触摸会让纸上的插画动起来。

video.video_title: Living Library

works.technique: A depth camera over a blank physical book detects hand touches and page turns, and a projector calibrated to the book surface projects illustrations aligned to the pages.
works.exercise_zh: 做一本白页手工书，用摄像头检测翻到第几页（可在页角贴色块），投影仪把对应动画投到书页上，手指点哪里哪里动；变体：写一个只有翻回上一页才会改变结局的故事。
works.description_zh: 一本配有真实书页的巨型投影书：深度相机追踪双手，触摸和翻动书页会让纸上的插画动起来。
works.idea_en: A giant real book whose illustrations move when you turn and touch the pages.
works.technique_zh: 安装在空白实体书上方的深度相机检测手的触摸和翻页，与书面标定好的投影仪把插画对齐投射到书页上。
works.exercise_en: Make a handmade book with blank pages, use a camera to detect which page is open (colored patches on the page corners help), and project the matching animation onto the page so whatever a finger touches moves. Twist: write a story whose ending changes only when you flip back to the previous page.

works.title: Lost Droids (MR test)
works.description: Shot through Magic Leap optics: R2-D2 and C-3PO appear in a real office, R2 projects a hologram message and the droids react to the viewer.
works.idea_zh: 星战机器人出现在真实办公室里并向你投射全息信息。

video.video_title: ILMxLAB and Magic Leap “Lost Droids” Mixed Reality Test

works.technique: Real-time rendered characters anchored to the physical room and filmed directly through the prototype's optics.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机AR让一个角色在教室里“投射”一段录好的视频留言（在角色上方播放视频平面）；变化：留言只在两人同时观看时播放。
works.description_zh: 透过 Magic Leap 光学系统拍摄：R2-D2 和 C-3PO 出现在一间真实的办公室里，R2 投射出一段全息消息，两个机器人还会对观看者做出反应。
works.idea_en: Star Wars droids show up in a real office and project a hologram message for you.
works.technique_zh: 实时渲染的角色锚定在实体房间中，并直接透过原型机的光学系统拍摄。
works.exercise_en: Use phone AR to have a character in the classroom "project" a recorded video message by playing a video plane above it. Twist: the message plays only when two people watch at the same time.

works.title: Materiable
works.description: A shape display renders material properties such as elasticity, viscosity and flexibility, so touching the pins feels like pressing jelly, sand or rubber.
works.idea_zh: 让同一块针阵表面按你的手感'变成'果冻、沙子或橡胶。

video.video_title: Materiable

works.technique: Force sensing through the pins' motor current detects how hard a pin is pressed, and a per-pin physics model (spring, damper, fluid coupling) sets the pin response to simulate elasticity or viscosity, with projection showing the material.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机触屏压力或按压时长作为输入，在 AR 平面上渲染一块虚拟材料（果冻、沙子、橡胶），分别用弹簧、阻尼、扩散模型让它对按压作出不同反应并配合震动反馈；变体：发明一种现实中不存在的材料。
works.description_zh: 一台形状显示器能呈现弹性、黏性和柔韧性等材料属性，触摸针阵时的手感就像在按压果冻、沙子或橡胶。
works.idea_en: The same pin surface turns into jelly, sand or rubber under your hand.
works.technique_zh: 通过针脚电机电流进行力感知，检测每根针被按压的力度，再由逐针的物理模型（弹簧、阻尼、流体耦合）设定针的响应，模拟弹性或黏性，并用投影显示材料外观。
works.exercise_en: Use touchscreen pressure or press duration as input to render a block of virtual material (jelly, sand, rubber) on an AR plane, and make it respond differently to presses using spring, damping and diffusion models, with vibration feedback. Twist: invent a material that does not exist in reality.

works.title: Más Que la Cara
works.description: A public installation in downtown Houston that tracks passers-by's faces and overlays dozens of generative, illustrated masks that move with their eyebrows, lips and head.
works.idea_zh: “不只是脸”：公共空间的魔镜，把路人的脸实时变成会随表情变化的生成式面具。

video.video_title: Más Que la Cara installation

works.technique: A 2D facial landmark tracker (FaceTracker-style) fits dozens of points to each face on a live camera, and vector-illustrated mask parts are skinned to eyebrow, lip and head landmarks so they deform with expression.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe Face Mesh 加 p5.js 画一个只由几何线条组成的面具，眉毛和嘴巴的关键点驱动图形形变；变体：每个人一靠近就随机换一张面具，做 10 种风格给路人“换脸”。
works.description_zh: 休斯敦市中心的一件公共装置，追踪路人的面孔，并叠加数十种生成式插画面具，面具会随眉毛、嘴唇和头部的动作而变化。
works.idea_en: "More than a face": a magic mirror in public space that turns passers-by's faces into generative masks that follow their expressions.
works.technique_zh: 2D 面部特征点追踪器（FaceTracker 类）在实时相机画面中为每张脸拟合数十个点，矢量插画的面具部件蒙皮到眉毛、嘴唇和头部特征点上，随表情一起变形。
works.exercise_en: Draw a mask made only of geometric lines with MediaPipe Face Mesh and p5.js, with eyebrow and mouth landmarks driving the shapes. Twist: give each person a random new mask as soon as they come close, with 10 styles to "swap faces" for passers-by.

works.title: Night Terrors
works.description: A survival horror game played at home in the dark with headphones: the phone becomes the only way to see the monsters and apparitions that move through your own rooms.
works.idea_zh: 关灯戴耳机，自己家变成怪物出没的恐怖游戏场景。

video.video_title: Night Terrors Trailer - Augmented Reality Horror Game

works.technique: The phone camera feed is darkened and lit by a virtual flashlight, and apparitions are overlaid with jump-scare timing and spatial audio through headphones.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个只在手机“手电筒”光圈里才显示 AR 内容的场景，配合耳机中的方位声音；变体：光圈越小，恐怖元素越近。
works.description_zh: 一款戴着耳机在漆黑的家中游玩的生存恐怖游戏：手机成为看见那些在你自己房间里游荡的怪物和幽灵的唯一途径。
works.idea_en: Lights off, headphones on, and your own home becomes a horror game full of monsters.
works.technique_zh: 手机相机画面被调暗，并由一支虚拟手电筒照亮；幽灵以精心设计的惊吓时机叠加出现，并通过耳机播放空间音频。
works.exercise_en: Build a scene where AR content appears only inside the phone's "flashlight" circle, paired with directional sound in headphones. Twist: the smaller the circle, the closer the horror gets.

works.title: OST Rift
works.description: A consumer VR headset converted into an optical see-through AR display with careful timing so virtual objects stay locked to the real world during head motion.
works.idea_zh: 把VR头显改装成光学透视AR，让虚拟物体稳稳“钉”在现实中。

video.video_title: OST Rift: Temporally Consistent Augmented Reality with a Consumer HMD (IEEE VR 2016, poster)

works.technique: Adds beam-splitter optics to a Rift and predicts head pose to compensate display latency, keeping overlays temporally consistent with the real scene.
works.exercise_zh: 用HoloKit或手机+半透镜做一个简易透视AR眼镜，比较快速转头时虚拟方块的漂移；变化：人为加入200ms延迟，让同学描述感受。
works.description_zh: 把一台消费级 VR 头显改装成光学透视式 AR 显示器，并精细处理时序，使虚拟物体在头部运动时仍然牢牢锁定在现实世界中。
works.idea_en: A VR headset converted to optical see-through AR, with virtual objects pinned firmly to reality.
works.technique_zh: 为 Rift 加装分光镜光学组件，并预测头部位姿以补偿显示延迟，使叠加内容与真实场景在时间上保持一致。
works.exercise_en: Build simple see-through AR glasses from HoloKit or a phone plus a half-mirror, and compare how a virtual cube drifts during fast head turns. Twist: add an artificial 200 ms delay and have classmates describe how it feels.

works.title: PHANTOGEIST
works.description: A first-person shooter on a Project Tango phone spawns ghostly enemies and environments around you anywhere, from a small room to a football field, with no markers.
works.idea_zh: 在任何真实场地里打第一人称幽灵射击，场地大小游戏自己适配。

video.video_title: PHANTOGEIST Demo Mode, SF Alley

works.technique: Tango's inside-out motion tracking gives 6DoF pose so enemies can be placed in world coordinates and the play area scales to the available physical space.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 做一个在操场上刷怪的小游戏，敌人从远处走来；加一个变化：只有把手机举高才能看到飞在空中的敌人。
works.description_zh: 一款运行在 Project Tango 手机上的第一人称射击游戏，无需任何标记，就能在任何地方——从小房间到足球场——在你周围生成幽灵敌人和环境。
works.idea_en: A first-person ghost shooter for any real space, with the game adapting to the size of the site.
works.technique_zh: Tango 的 inside-out 运动追踪提供 6DoF 位姿，使敌人可以放置在世界坐标中，游戏区域也会根据可用的实际空间自动缩放。
works.exercise_en: Build a small game with AR Foundation that spawns monsters on a sports field, with enemies walking in from the distance. Twist: enemies flying in the air can only be seen when you hold the phone up high.

works.title: PHANTOGEIST Co-op 'Automatic Mixed Reality'
works.description: Two Tango devices share the same ghost battle, so one player can film the other fighting virtual enemies, producing mixed-reality footage automatically.
works.idea_zh: 两台设备共享同一场战斗，一人玩、一人当'摄影师'，自动产出混合现实视频。

video.video_title: PHANTOGEIST: Co-Op "Automatic Mixed Reality"

works.technique: Both devices localize into a shared coordinate frame (likely via Tango area learning) so enemies appear in the same physical place for each player.
works.exercise_zh: 用 8th Wall/Lens Studio 的多人共享或 ARKit 协作会话做一个双人游戏：一个人打怪，另一个人拍摄；加一个变化：摄影者的镜头可以'冻结'怪物。
works.description_zh: 两台 Tango 设备共享同一场幽灵战斗，一名玩家可以拍摄另一名玩家与虚拟敌人战斗的画面，自动生成混合现实视频。
works.idea_en: Two devices share one battle: one person plays, the other films, and mixed-reality video comes out automatically.
works.technique_zh: 两台设备都定位到同一个共享坐标系中（大概率通过 Tango 区域学习），使敌人对每位玩家都出现在同一个物理位置。
works.exercise_en: Build a two-player game with 8th Wall or Lens Studio shared sessions, or an ARKit collaborative session, where one person fights monsters and the other films. Twist: the camera operator's lens can "freeze" the monsters.

works.title: PanoVC
works.description: A video call where the caller's phone continuously builds a panorama of their surroundings, so the remote person can look around the other place freely instead of seeing a single camera frame.
works.description_zh: 在视频通话中，呼叫方的手机持续拼接周围环境的全景，远程用户可以自由环顾对方所在的地方，而不是只看到单个摄像头画面。
works.idea_en: Share your whole surroundings on a call, not just where your camera points.
works.idea_zh: 通话时分享你的整个周遭环境，而不只是摄像头对着的地方。
works.technique: Incrementally stitches and streams a panoramic map from the sender's phone camera while live frames update the part currently in view.
works.technique_zh: 从发送方的手机摄像头逐步拼接并传输全景图，同时用实时帧更新当前视野中的那部分。
works.exercise_en: Take a phone panorama of the classroom, send it to a partner in another room, and keep sending live photos of the spot they ask to see; let them guide you to find an object. Twist: mark where the remote person is looking with a sticky note.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机拍一张教室全景发给另一个房间的同伴，再根据对方的要求不断发送所指位置的实时照片，让对方引导你找到一件物品；变体：用便利贴标出远程者正在看的位置。

video.video_title: PanoVC: Pervasive Telepresence using Mobile Phones

works.title: Parallel Eyes
works.description: Four people wear HMDs showing a split screen of everyone's first-person views at once, then try to play hide-and-seek and coordinate while seeing through all bodies simultaneously.
works.idea_zh: 四个人同时看到彼此的第一人称视角，在“共享眼睛”里玩捉迷藏。

video.video_title: Parallel Eyes : Exploring Human Capability and Behaviors with Paralleled First Person View Sharing

works.technique: Streams each participant's head-mounted camera into a shared tiled video layout shown in every HMD, a collaboration with YCAM.
works.exercise_zh: 让四名同学各用手机前摄/后摄开视频会议并把画面并排显示，戴着手机眼镜玩找人游戏；变化：随机把你的画面和别人的画面互换位置。
works.description_zh: 四个人戴着头显，同时看到所有人的第一人称视角分屏画面，然后在同时透过所有人的身体观看的状态下，尝试玩捉迷藏并相互配合。
works.idea_en: Four people see through each other's eyes at once and play hide-and-seek with shared vision.
works.technique_zh: 把每位参与者头戴相机的画面实时传输到一个共享的平铺视频布局中，并显示在每台头显里；这是与 YCAM 的合作作品。
works.exercise_en: Have four classmates join a video call with their phones' front or rear cameras, show all feeds side by side, and play a find-the-person game wearing phone viewers. Twist: randomly swap the position of your feed with someone else's.

works.title: Pokémon GO
