works.description: Players walk their neighbourhood to find Pokémon that appear on the camera view over the real street, then throw Poké Balls to catch them; gyms and raids gather players at landmarks.
works.idea_zh: 让宝可梦出现在你家街角，用行走和相机去收集它们。

video.video_title: Discover Pokémon in the Real World with Pokémon GO!

works.technique: GPS and spawn tables place creatures near map locations, and the encounter screen overlays the creature on the camera feed using gyroscope orientation rather than full SLAM.
works.exercise_zh: 用陀螺仪控制一个叠加在摄像头画面上的角色，只有转向正确方向时才看得到它，滑动屏幕扔球捕捉；变体：角色只在特定天气或时段出现。
works.description_zh: 玩家在自己的街区里走动寻找宝可梦，它们会出现在相机画面中的真实街道上，玩家投出精灵球来捕捉；道馆和团体战则把玩家聚集到地标处。
works.idea_en: Pokémon show up on your street corner, and you collect them by walking and using the camera.
works.technique_zh: GPS 与刷新表把小精灵放在地图位置附近，遭遇界面借助陀螺仪朝向（而非完整的 SLAM）把小精灵叠加在相机画面上。
works.exercise_en: Use the gyroscope to control a character overlaid on the camera image that can be seen only when you face the right direction, and swipe to throw a ball and catch it. Twist: the character appears only in certain weather or at certain times.

works.title: Remote Memories (with Laurent Delforge / Before Tigers)
works.description: A panoramic polyptych of projection-mapped panels and sound that slowly assembles a pictorial landscape of memories, also performed live.
works.idea_zh: 把记忆碎片拼成一幅需要慢慢看的全景投影画
works.technique: Video is mapped across several physical panels of different sizes and depths so a single composition spans the polyptych.
works.exercise_zh: 用5块不同大小的白板组成多联画，投影一段老照片动画跨越所有面板；变化：每块面板代表一个人讲述的记忆片段。

video.video_title: Remote Memories - Yannick Jacquet & Before Tigers

works.description_zh: 一件由投影映射面板和声音构成的全景多联画，缓缓拼合出一幅由记忆组成的画面风景，也曾以现场演出的形式呈现。
works.idea_en: Fragments of memory pieced into a panoramic projection you have to take in slowly.
works.technique_zh: 视频被映射到多块大小和深度各不相同的实体面板上，使单一画面构图横跨整幅多联画。
works.exercise_en: Arrange five whiteboards of different sizes into a polyptych and project an animation of old photos across all the panels. Twist: each panel stands for a fragment of memory told by a different person.

works.title: RoboRaid
works.description: Alien robots burst through your actual walls, leaving cracks, and you shoot them with gaze and air-tap while physically dodging projectiles.
works.idea_zh: 外星机器人从你家真实墙壁破墙而入。

video.video_title: Microsoft HoloLens: RoboRaid

works.technique: Uses the spatial-mapping mesh to pick wall spawn points and render crack decals, with spatial audio signalling enemies behind the player.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机AR检测竖直墙面并在墙上生成“破洞”贴图和钻出的敌人，玩家用准星点击射击；变化：只用声音提示敌人方位。
works.description_zh: 外星机器人冲破你家真实的墙壁闯进来，留下裂痕；你用注视和空中点击射击它们，同时还要真实地闪躲飞来的弹丸。
works.idea_en: Alien robots break in through the real walls of your home.
works.technique_zh: 利用空间映射网格选取墙面上的生成点并渲染裂痕贴花，同时用空间音频提示玩家身后的敌人。
works.exercise_en: Detect vertical walls in phone AR and generate "broken hole" decals with enemies crawling out of them, which players shoot by tapping a crosshair. Twist: signal enemy positions with sound alone.

works.title: Room2Room
works.description: Life-size telepresence: a remote person is captured in 3D and projected into your room, sitting on your real couch at the correct scale.
works.idea_zh: 把远方的人按真人大小投影到你家沙发上，不用戴任何设备。

video.video_title: Room2Room: Life-Size Telepresence in a Projected Augmented Reality Environment

works.technique: A Kinect captures the remote person as a colored depth mesh, and projector-camera calibration plus the local user's head tracking renders them life-size with perspective correction onto a real piece of furniture.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe Selfie Segmentation 把远端同学的视频抠像，投影成真人大小坐在本地真实椅子上，并通过视频通话交谈；变体：让远端的人只在你看向椅子时出现。
works.description_zh: 真人大小的远程临场：远方的人被 3D 捕捉后投影到你的房间里，以正确的比例坐在你真实的沙发上。
works.idea_en: Project a faraway person at life size onto your sofa, with no headset required.
works.technique_zh: Kinect 把远端的人捕捉为带颜色的深度网格，借助投影仪—相机标定以及本地用户的头部追踪，把其以真人大小、经透视校正后渲染到一件真实家具上。
works.exercise_en: Cut out a remote classmate from their video with MediaPipe Selfie Segmentation, project them at life size sitting on a real local chair, and talk over a video call. Twist: the remote person appears only when you look at the chair.

works.title: Shining360
works.description: A 30-minute 360-degree film that reconstructs the spaces of Kubrick's The Shining as fragmented 3D models, letting viewers look around the hotel while the camera follows the original shots.
works.description_zh: 一部 30 分钟的 360 度影片，把库布里克《闪灵》中的空间重建为破碎的三维模型，观众可以环顾酒店，镜头则沿着原片的机位运动。
works.idea_en: Every film shot hides a 3D space that can be reconstructed and walked through.
works.idea_zh: 每一个电影镜头里都藏着一个可以被重建、可以走进去的三维空间。
works.technique: The film was split into frames, photogrammetry computed depth and 3D fragments from each scene, and the fragments were stitched along the original camera path for VR.
works.technique_zh: 把影片拆成逐帧画面，用摄影测量为每个场景计算深度和三维碎片，再沿原始摄像机路径拼接，供 VR 观看。
works.exercise_en: Take a 10-second tracking shot from a film or your own phone, extract frames and run them through a photogrammetry tool, then fly a virtual camera through the result. Twist: look at what the original camera never showed.
works.exercise_zh: 取一段 10 秒的电影跟拍镜头或自己用手机拍的视频，抽帧后用摄影测量工具处理，再让虚拟摄像机在结果中飞行；变体：去看看原来的镜头从未拍到的地方。

video.video_title: Shining360°

works.title: SnapToReality
works.description: Virtual objects in AR automatically snap to real-world edges and planes, making precise alignment of holograms with furniture effortless.
works.idea_zh: 让全息物体像PPT吸附对齐一样'吸'到真实桌边和墙面上。

video.video_title: SnapToReality: Aligning Augmented Reality to the Real World

works.technique: Planes and dominant edges are extracted from the depth data in real time, and virtual objects being manipulated are snapped to the nearest aligned constraint when within a distance and angle threshold.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR Foundation 中实现拖动虚拟相框时自动吸附到最近的检测平面和平面边缘（距离小于 5cm 时吸附）；变体：设计一种“反吸附”，让某些物体总是躲开真实表面漂浮。
works.description_zh: AR 中的虚拟物体会自动吸附到真实世界的边缘和平面上，让全息影像与家具的精确对齐变得毫不费力。
works.idea_en: Holograms snap onto real table edges and walls, like the snap-to-align guides in slide software.
works.technique_zh: 从深度数据中实时提取平面和主要边缘，当被操作的虚拟物体进入距离和角度阈值范围内时，便吸附到最近的对齐约束上。
works.exercise_en: In AR Foundation, make a virtual picture frame snap to the nearest detected plane and plane edge while being dragged, when it is within 5 cm. Twist: design an "anti-snap" so some objects always float away from real surfaces.

works.title: Treehugger: Wawona
works.description: Participants hug a physical sculpture of a giant sequoia and put their head into its knot; in the headset, they see water and nutrients flowing inside the tree, and the longer they hug, the deeper they drift into tree time.
works.description_zh: 参与者拥抱一棵巨型红杉的实体雕塑，把头伸进树洞；在头显里，他们看到水分和养分在树体内流动，拥抱得越久，就越深地沉入“树的时间”。
works.idea_en: A physical hug is the interface to the invisible life inside a tree.
works.idea_zh: 一个真实的拥抱，就是进入树内部隐秘生命的接口。
works.technique: A headset experience is aligned with a physical tree sculpture so touch matches the virtual trunk, with particle visuals and spatial audio driven by dwell time.
works.technique_zh: 头显体验与实体树雕塑对齐，触摸与虚拟树干一致，粒子画面和空间音频随停留时间推进。
works.exercise_en: Wrap a pillar or tree with a cardboard 'bark' and build a phone-in-headset scene that shows flowing particles inside it, advancing only while the user keeps both hands on it. Twist: add a fan or smell cue that appears at the deepest level.
works.exercise_zh: 用纸板“树皮”包住一根柱子或一棵树，做一个手机头显场景，显示其内部流动的粒子，只有用户双手一直扶着它时才会推进；变体：在最深的阶段加入风扇或气味提示。

video.video_title: Treehugger Trailer

works.title: Unifield | Projection on Lasercut Sculpture
works.description: A laser-cut sculpture based on Coxeter's higher-dimensional geometry is projection-mapped so light seems to reveal a 4D object rotating through it.
works.idea_zh: 在激光切割雕塑上做投影映射，像一个四维物体在其中穿行。

video.video_title: Unifield | Projection on Lasercut Sculpture

works.technique: Projection mapping aligns rendered animation to the fabricated sculpture's facets so virtual light and motion appear to live on the physical form.
works.exercise_zh: 用纸板折一个多面体，投影映射让每个面依次亮起形成'旋转'错觉；加一个变化：观众走动时（用摄像头检测）光的旋转方向改变。
works.description_zh: 一件基于 Coxeter 高维几何的激光切割雕塑，经过投影映射后，光线仿佛揭示出一个在其中旋转穿行的四维物体。
works.idea_en: Projection mapping on a laser-cut sculpture makes it look like a 4D object is passing through it.
works.technique_zh: 投影映射把渲染的动画与制作完成的雕塑切面精确对齐，使虚拟的光与运动看起来就存在于实体形态之上。
works.exercise_en: Fold a polyhedron from cardboard and use projection mapping to light up its faces in sequence, creating the illusion of rotation. Twist: change the direction of the rotating light when viewers walk by, detected with a camera.

works.title: Wilderness Wiggle
works.description: A body-controlled Alaskan wilderness play wall for children at the Alaska Native Medical Center, where movement makes animals and landscape respond.
works.idea_zh: 阿拉斯加医院里的体感荒野游戏墙，动作让动物与风景回应孩子。

video.video_title: Wilderness Wiggle

works.technique: A depth camera tracks body silhouettes and movement, which are mapped to responsive animal and landscape animations on a play wall.
works.exercise_zh: 选一个你家乡的自然景观，用摄像头和 p5.js 做一面体感墙，动作让当地动物出现或躲起来；变体：请一位来自不同地方的同学提供动物和声音素材，让墙讲述他的地方。
works.description_zh: 为阿拉斯加原住民医疗中心的孩子们打造的一面体感阿拉斯加荒野游戏墙，孩子们的动作会让动物和风景做出回应。
works.idea_en: A motion-sensing wilderness play wall in an Alaskan hospital where animals and landscape answer children's movements.
works.technique_zh: 深度相机追踪身体轮廓和动作，并将其映射为游戏墙上会做出回应的动物和风景动画。
works.exercise_en: Pick a natural landscape from your hometown and build a motion-sensing wall with a camera and p5.js where movement makes local animals appear or hide. Twist: ask a classmate from a different place to supply animals and sounds so the wall tells the story of their place.

works.title: Young Conker
works.description: A HoloLens platformer that scans your room and procedurally turns furniture and floors into levels for the squirrel Conker to run across.
works.idea_zh: 扫描房间，把家具和地面自动变成平台游戏关卡。

video.video_title: Microsoft HoloLens ~ Young Conker

works.technique: The room mesh is analyzed for walkable horizontal surfaces, and a procedural level generator places platforms, collectibles and paths across real furniture.
works.exercise_zh: 用平面检测找出房间里所有水平面，在它们之间自动生成跳跃路径和金币；变体：让角色在真实物体边缘会滑落。
works.description_zh: 一款 HoloLens 平台游戏，会扫描你的房间，并以程序化方式把家具和地面变成关卡，让松鼠 Conker 在上面奔跑。
works.idea_en: Scan the room and automatically turn furniture and floors into platformer levels.
works.technique_zh: 分析房间网格中可行走的水平表面，由程序化关卡生成器在真实家具上布置平台、收集品和路径。
works.exercise_en: Find all horizontal surfaces in a room with plane detection and automatically generate jump paths and coins between them. Twist: make the character slip off the edges of real objects.

works.title: Zooids
works.description: Dozens of small tabletop robots act like physical pixels, arranging themselves into charts, shapes and handles that users can push, drag and grab.
works.description_zh: 几十个桌面小机器人像实体像素一样，排列成图表、形状和把手，用户可以推、拖、抓。
works.idea_en: A display made of many tiny robots that you can touch, rearrange and hold.
works.idea_zh: 由许多小机器人组成、可以触摸、重新排列和握住的显示器。
works.technique: Tracks each robot with a projector-based optical system and drives them with collision-free motion planning so the swarm forms target layouts and responds to touch.
works.technique_zh: 用基于投影仪的光学系统追踪每个机器人，并通过无碰撞运动规划驱动它们，使群体排出目标布局并对触摸作出反应。
works.exercise_en: Have ten students act as 'pixels' on a gridded floor and follow phone instructions to form a bar chart of class data, then let a volunteer push one to change the data. Twist: use projection to show each pixel's target spot.
works.exercise_zh: 让十名学生在画好格子的地板上充当“像素”，按手机上的指令排成反映班级数据的柱状图，再让一位志愿者推动其中一个来改变数据；变体：用投影显示每个“像素”的目标位置。

video.video_title: Zooids: Building Block for Swarm User Interface

works.title: connected colors
works.description: Face-tracked projection mapping blooms plants, birds and patterns across a performer's face in sync with her movement.
works.idea_zh: 花鸟纹样在追踪的面孔上实时绽放

video.video_title: connected colors / real-time face tracking and 3d projection mapping

works.technique: Real-time face tracking feeds a projector-camera system that renders animated patterns in the face's UV space, so plants and birds appear to grow on the skin as the head turns.
works.exercise_zh: 在 TouchDesigner 里用 MediaPipe 人脸关键点驱动一段花纹生长动画，投影到戴白色面具的同学脸上；变体：让花纹的生长速度随音乐或呼吸声变化。
works.description_zh: 基于面部追踪的投影映射，让植物、鸟和纹样随表演者的动作在她的脸上同步绽放。
works.idea_en: Flower and bird patterns bloom live on a tracked face.
works.technique_zh: 实时面部追踪数据输入投影仪—相机系统，在面部 UV 空间中渲染动画纹样，使头部转动时植物和鸟仿佛从皮肤上生长出来。
works.exercise_en: In TouchDesigner, drive a pattern-growing animation with MediaPipe face landmarks and project it onto the face of a classmate wearing a white mask. Twist: make the growth speed follow the music or the sound of breathing.

works.title: live AR system test
works.description: A test of a live AR system for stage shows, with virtual graphics anchored to the physical stage as the broadcast camera moves.
works.idea_zh: 舞台直播中虚拟图形与真实舞台锁定的实时AR系统

video.video_title: live ar system test

works.technique: A broadcast camera with tracking (encoders or optical) streams its pose and lens data to a real-time engine that renders stage-anchored graphics matched to the camera's view.
works.exercise_zh: 用一台手机做“转播机位”，在 Unity AR 中给桌面小舞台加上固定位置的虚拟灯光和布景，另一名同学在舞台上表演；变体：让虚拟布景随表演者的声音大小变化。
works.description_zh: 一次面向舞台演出的实时 AR 系统测试，在转播摄像机移动时，虚拟图形始终锚定在实体舞台上。
works.idea_en: A live AR system that locks virtual graphics to the real stage during a live broadcast.
works.technique_zh: 带追踪功能（编码器或光学方式）的转播摄像机把位姿和镜头数据传给实时引擎，引擎渲染出锚定在舞台上、与摄像机视角匹配的图形。
works.exercise_en: Use a phone as the "broadcast camera" and add fixed virtual lights and scenery to a small tabletop stage in Unity AR while another classmate performs on it. Twist: make the virtual scenery change with the performer's voice volume.

works.title: 24 drones
works.description: Three dancers and 24 light-drones perform together; the drones form moving constellations of light that respond to and frame the choreography.
works.idea_zh: 24架发光无人机组成会跳舞的光点星座
works.technique: An indoor motion-capture system localises 24 custom light drones (designed by Motoi Ishibashi) whose light and position are programmed against the choreography.
works.exercise_zh: 让24位同学各拿一个手机闪光灯，在黑暗中按投影给出的坐标走位组成图形；变化：图形由舞者的姿势实时生成。

video.video_title: ELEVENPLAY x RZM "24 drones"

works.description_zh: 三位舞者与 24 架发光无人机同台演出；无人机组成流动的光之星座，回应并框定舞蹈编排。
works.idea_en: Twenty-four glowing drones form a dancing constellation of light.
works.technique_zh: 室内动作捕捉系统对 24 架定制发光无人机（由 Motoi Ishibashi 设计）进行定位，其灯光和位置均根据编舞进行编程。
works.exercise_en: Have 24 classmates each hold a phone flashlight and walk in the dark to coordinates given by a projection, forming shapes. Twist: generate the shapes in real time from a dancer's pose.

works.title: Affordance++
works.description: Objects 'tell' the user how to use them by actuating the user's own hand with EMS: grabbing a spray can makes you shake it, touching a hot mug makes your hand pull back.
works.idea_zh: 物体通过电刺激直接“教”你的手怎么用它。

video.video_title: Affordance++: allowing objects to communicate dynamic use (CHI 2015, Best Paper Award)

works.technique: Detects which object the hand approaches and plays a pre-recorded EMS pattern on forearm muscles that enacts the object's intended movement.
works.exercise_zh: 给教室里的几个物品贴二维码，用手机AR识别后在手上叠加“动态使用提示”（如抖动、旋转箭头）；变化：提示用手机振动节奏而非图像表示。
works.description_zh: 物体借助 EMS 驱动用户自己的手，“告诉”用户该如何使用它们：抓起喷漆罐时手会自动摇晃它，碰到烫手的杯子时手会自动缩回。
works.idea_en: Objects use electrical stimulation to teach your hand directly how to use them.
works.technique_zh: 检测手正在接近哪个物体，并在前臂肌肉上施加预先录制的 EMS 模式，让手做出该物体预期的使用动作。
works.exercise_en: Stick QR codes on a few objects in the classroom, recognize them in phone AR, and overlay "animated usage hints" (shaking, rotating arrows) on the hand. Twist: express the hints as phone vibration rhythms instead of images.

works.title: AfterMath: Seeing the Future through AR
works.description: Point a tablet at a physical scene and AR predicts and shows what will happen next, e.g. where objects will fall or roll after a physical action.
works.idea_zh: 用AR提前预演物理世界的'下一秒'，看见即将发生的后果。

video.video_title: AfterMath: Seeing the Future through Augmented Reality

works.technique: The tablet tracks the scene with AR, reconstructs or fits the physical objects as rigid bodies, and runs a physics simulation forward in time to render predicted trajectories as ghost overlays.
works.exercise_zh: 在 Unity + AR Foundation 中检测桌面平面，放一个虚拟球并用物理引擎预演它被推出后的轨迹，以半透明残影显示“未来 2 秒”；变体：显示多个可能的未来分支，让用户选择想要的那一个。
works.description_zh: 把平板对准一处真实场景，AR 会预测并显示接下来将发生的事情，比如某个物理动作之后，物体会往哪里掉落、朝哪里滚动。
works.idea_en: Use AR to rehearse the physical world's next second, so you see the consequences before they happen.
works.technique_zh: 平板借助 AR 追踪场景，把其中的实体物体重建或拟合为刚体，再将物理模拟向前推演，把预测出的运动轨迹以半透明“残影”叠加渲染出来。
works.exercise_en: Detect a tabletop plane in Unity + AR Foundation, place a virtual ball, and use the physics engine to preview its path after a push, showing "the next 2 seconds" as semi-transparent ghost trails. Twist: show several possible future branches and let the user pick the one they want.

works.title: Augmented Creativity
works.description: A collection of AR experiences that bridge real and virtual creative play: coloring, building and storytelling with physical toys brought to life.
works.idea_zh: 用AR把孩子的涂色、搭建和讲故事变成活的。

video.video_title: Augmented Creativity: Bridging the real and virtual worlds to enhance creative play

works.technique: A set of AR applications that track physical creative artifacts (colored drawings, built toys) with image and model-based tracking, then extract color and shape from them to drive animated virtual counterparts.
works.exercise_zh: 让学生用纸、黏土或乐高做一件实体作品，拍照后用 Lens Studio 或 Reality Composer 让它“活”起来（加动画、声音或会说话的脸）；变体：作品在 AR 中的行为必须由它的某个实体特征决定。
works.description_zh: 一组连接真实与虚拟创意游戏的 AR 体验：涂色、搭建和讲故事，让实体玩具活起来。
works.idea_en: AR turns children's coloring, building and storytelling into something alive.
works.technique_zh: 一系列 AR 应用通过图像追踪和基于模型的追踪来识别实体创作物（涂好色的画、搭好的玩具），从中提取颜色与形状，驱动对应的虚拟角色动起来。
works.exercise_en: Have students make a physical piece from paper, clay or LEGO, photograph it, and bring it to life in Lens Studio or Reality Composer with animation, sound or a talking face. Twist: the piece's behavior in AR must be driven by one of its physical features.

works.title: Blueprint
works.description: A 15-minute audiovisual installation of projected light on a technical line drawing, exploring the blueprint as the origin of structures.
works.idea_zh: 光在蓝图线稿上建构与解构

video.video_title: blueprint

works.technique: Projection mapped onto a technical line drawing builds and deconstructs structures with animated line work aligned to the printed lines.
works.exercise_zh: 打印一张建筑或机器的线稿，投影一段让它逐步“建造”再“拆解”的线条动画；变体：让建造过程在某一步出错，并从错误中长出另一种结构。
works.description_zh: 一件时长 15 分钟的视听装置：光投射在一幅技术线稿上，探讨蓝图作为一切结构起点的意义。
works.idea_en: Light builds and unbuilds structures on a blueprint's line drawing.
works.technique_zh: 将投影映射到一幅技术线稿上，与印刷线条精确对齐的线条动画不断搭建又拆解出各种结构。
works.exercise_en: Print a line drawing of a building or machine and project a line animation that gradually "builds" it and then "takes it apart". Twist: make the construction go wrong at one step, and let a different structure grow out of the mistake.

works.title: CHILDHOOD: Egocentric Smaller-person Experience
works.description: An adult wears a head-mounted display fed by a camera at child eye height plus passive hand exoskeletons, and suddenly sees furniture, doors and people from a small child's point of view while grasping with small hands.
works.description_zh: 成年人戴上头显，画面来自装在孩子眼睛高度的摄像头，手上再套一副被动外骨骼，于是家具、门和身边的人都变成了小孩子视角里的样子，连抓东西的手也变小了。
works.idea_en: Lower the camera and shrink the hands, and an adult can briefly live inside a child's body.
works.idea_zh: 把摄像头放低、把手“缩小”，成年人就能短暂地住进孩子的身体里。
works.technique: Streams a waist-mounted stereo camera to a video see-through HMD so eye height drops by about half, while linkage exoskeletons map the wearer's finger motion onto smaller hands.
works.technique_zh: 腰部的双目摄像头把画面实时送进视频透视头显，使视线高度下降约一半，同时连杆外骨骼把佩戴者的手指动作映射到更小的“手”上。
works.exercise_en: Strap a phone at waist height, stream its camera to a second phone in a cardboard viewer, and walk around the classroom for ten minutes; list what feels dangerous, huge or unreachable. Twist: mount the camera at a dog's or a giant's height and redesign one object for that body.
works.exercise_zh: 把一部手机绑在腰部高度，把它的摄像头画面实时传到另一部装在纸盒眼镜里的手机上，在教室里走十分钟，记录哪些东西显得危险、巨大或够不着；变体：把摄像头装到狗或巨人的视线高度，再为那个身体重新设计一件物品。

video.video_title: Wearable Device for Shaping Experience into that of a Smaller-person

works.title: Connected Worlds
works.description: A large-scale ecosystem at the New York Hall of Science: six projected habitats linked by a 3000 sq ft interactive floor and 45 ft waterfall; children move physical logs to route water and plant seeds with gestures.
works.idea_zh: 整个大厅就是一个生态系统：孩子搬动实物木头引水、用手播种，影响六个栖息地。

video.video_title: Connected Worlds

works.technique: Many Kinect depth cameras track the floor to detect physical logs and people, which redirect a projected 2D fluid simulation of water flowing between networked habitat simulations.
works.exercise_zh: 在地面投影一条水流，用俯拍摄像头识别几块彩色木板改变水流方向，把水分给墙上两个不同的小生态（沙漠/雨林）；变体：让两个生态之间有资源冲突，全班需要协商水怎么分。
works.description_zh: 位于纽约科学馆的大型生态系统装置：六个投影栖息地由一块 3000 平方英尺的互动地面和一道 45 英尺高的瀑布相连；孩子们搬动实物木头引导水流，用手势播撒种子。
works.idea_en: The whole hall is one ecosystem: children move real logs to steer water and plant seeds by hand, shaping six habitats.
works.technique_zh: 多台 Kinect 深度相机追踪地面，识别实物木头和人的位置，据此改变投影出的二维流体模拟，让水在彼此联网的各个栖息地模拟之间流动。
works.exercise_en: Project a stream of water onto the floor, use an overhead camera to detect a few colored boards that redirect the flow, and split the water between two small ecosystems on the wall (desert and rainforest). Twist: create a resource conflict between the two ecosystems so the class has to negotiate how the water is shared.

works.title: Dancing Light / D.O.PE.
works.description: A performer dances with computer-controlled projector light that shapes, cuts and follows her body in a dark space.
works.idea_zh: 让投影光本身成为与舞者对舞的伙伴
works.technique: A projector is used as a programmable spotlight whose masks are sequenced (and likely tracked) to sculpt the performer's silhouette in darkness.
works.exercise_zh: 在黑暗中用投影仪投出会移动的光形，让同学即兴与光“对舞”；变化：用摄像头让光形在人靠近时逃开。

video.video_title: Dancing Light – Klaus Obermaier feat. Tegest Pecht-Guido

works.description_zh: 黑暗空间中，一位舞者与计算机控制的投影光共舞，光不断塑造、切割并追随她的身体。
works.idea_en: Make projected light itself a dance partner for the performer.
works.technique_zh: 把投影仪当作可编程的追光灯，按序列切换遮罩（可能还结合了追踪），在黑暗中雕刻出舞者的轮廓。
works.exercise_en: Project moving shapes of light in a dark room and have a classmate improvise a "duet" with them. Twist: use a camera so the light shapes flee when a person gets close.

works.title: Dropping an Ai Weiwei Urn in AR
works.description: The artist re-enacts Ai Weiwei's famous urn-dropping photo with a virtual urn in AR.
works.idea_zh: 用AR重演艾未未摔瓮

video.video_title: Dropping an Ai Wei Wei Urn in AR

works.technique: A virtual urn is anchored to the tracked hands or a plane and animated with physics to fall and shatter, re-staging a famous photographic sequence in AR.
works.exercise_zh: 选一张著名的行为艺术照片，用手机 AR 和物理引擎重演其中的关键物体动作并拍成三联照；变体：把被摔的物体换成一个你自己的“神圣物件”的虚拟版本。
works.description_zh: 艺术家在 AR 中用一只虚拟陶瓮，重演艾未未那组著名的摔瓮照片。
works.idea_en: Re-enact Ai Weiwei dropping the urn, in AR.
works.technique_zh: 把虚拟陶瓮锚定在被追踪的双手或某个平面上，用物理动画让它坠落、摔碎，在 AR 中重新上演一组著名的摄影序列。
works.exercise_en: Pick a famous performance-art photograph, re-enact the key object's action with phone AR and a physics engine, and shoot it as a triptych. Twist: replace the dropped object with a virtual version of your own "sacred object".

works.title: DynaFlash
works.description: A 1,000 fps, 3 ms latency projector keeps imagery locked to a sheet of paper as it is waved, bent and moved quickly in the hand.
works.idea_zh: 千帧投影仪让图像紧紧贴在你手中挥动的纸上。

video.video_title: DynaFlash: High-speed 8-bit image projector at 1,000fps with 3ms delay

works.technique: A 1,000 fps projector using a DLP chip with binary frames, paired with high-speed vision tracking of the paper's markers, closes the loop in about 3 ms so the projected image stays locked to a moving, bending surface.
works.exercise_zh: 用普通投影仪 + 摄像头追踪一张移动的纸（用四角标记或颜色检测），把图像实时投影到纸上，测量并记录挥动时的错位；变体：利用延迟本身设计一种“拖尾”美学效果。
works.description_zh: 一台每秒 1000 帧、延迟仅 3 毫秒的投影仪，即使手中的纸被快速挥动、弯折和移动，投出的图像也始终牢牢贴在纸面上。
works.idea_en: A thousand-frame projector keeps the image stuck to the paper waving in your hand.
works.technique_zh: 采用 DLP 芯片输出二值帧的 1000 fps 投影仪，配合对纸面标记的高速视觉追踪，整个闭环延迟约 3 毫秒，使投影图像始终锁定在移动、弯曲的表面上。
works.exercise_en: Use an ordinary projector and a camera to track a moving sheet of paper (with corner markers or color detection), project an image onto it in real time, and measure and record the misalignment as it is waved. Twist: use the latency itself to design a "motion trail" aesthetic.

works.title: EGO (with Stefano D'Alessio & Martina Menegon)
works.description: A large projection shows the viewer's mirror image, but their movements stretch, fragment and deform it into an abstract self that still feels like 'me'.
works.idea_zh: 镜像被你的动作扭曲成抽象形体，却依然像“你自己”
works.technique: A depth/video camera captures the viewer and a real-time mesh of their image is distorted by motion-driven parameters before projection.
works.exercise_zh: 用摄像头+网格变形做“哈哈镜”，挥手越快镜像越被拉扯；变化：加入声音，每种变形都有对应的音色。

video.video_title: EGO – Interactive Audiovisual Installation

works.description_zh: 一幅巨大的投影映出观众的镜像，而观众的动作会把镜像拉伸、打碎、扭曲，变成一个抽象却依然让人觉得“这就是我”的自我形象。
works.idea_en: Your movements warp your mirror image into an abstract shape that still looks like you.
works.technique_zh: 用深度相机或普通摄像头捕捉观众，把其影像实时生成网格，并由动作驱动的参数对网格进行变形后再投影出来。
works.exercise_en: Build a "funhouse mirror" with a camera and mesh deformation, so the faster you wave, the more your reflection gets stretched. Twist: add sound, giving each kind of deformation its own timbre.

works.title: Elements
works.description: Visitors embody Earth, Wind, Fire or Water and sculpt a projected environment with their movements.
works.idea_zh: 每个人化身一种元素，用身体塑造投影世界。

video.video_title: Elements

works.technique: Depth cameras track each visitor's body and gesture velocity, which are mapped to element-specific particle and fluid systems (fire, wind, water, earth) in a projected environment.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe Pose 给四位同学各分配一种元素，手臂的速度生成火、风、水、土的粒子并投影；变体：两种元素相遇时会产生新东西，比如水加火起雾。
works.description_zh: 观众化身为土、风、火、水四种元素之一，用身体动作塑造一个投影出来的环境。
works.idea_en: Each person becomes an element and shapes the projected world with their body.
works.technique_zh: 深度相机追踪每位观众的身体和手势速度，并将其映射到投影环境中各元素对应的粒子与流体系统（火、风、水、土）。
works.exercise_en: Use MediaPipe Pose to assign one element to each of four classmates, so their arm speed spawns fire, wind, water or earth particles that are projected on the wall. Twist: when two elements meet they create something new, such as water plus fire making mist.

works.title: Entangled
works.description: Two layered projections on translucent scrims respond to visitors from both sides, so people on opposite sides tangle each other's painterly traces.
works.idea_zh: 半透明幕两侧的人互相“缠绕”对方留下的影像痕迹
works.technique: Two cameras track people on each side of stacked scrims and generative drawing layers are projected through the semi-transparent fabric, mixing both groups' traces.
works.exercise_zh: 挂一块薄纱，前后各放一台投影和摄像头，让两侧同学的动作轨迹叠在同一块纱上；变化：只有两侧的人对齐站位时图案才会连通。

video.video_title: Camille Utterback – Entangled

works.description_zh: 两层投影落在半透明纱幕上，同时回应幕布两侧的观众，站在两边的人会让彼此留下的绘画般的痕迹交织在一起。
works.idea_en: People on either side of a sheer screen tangle up each other's traces.
works.technique_zh: 两台摄像头分别追踪叠放纱幕两侧的人，生成式绘画图层透过半透明织物投射出来，把两侧人群留下的痕迹混合在一起。
works.exercise_en: Hang a piece of sheer fabric with a projector and a camera on each side, so the movement trails of classmates on both sides overlap on the same cloth. Twist: the pattern only connects when people on the two sides line up with each other.

works.title: Flowers and People, Cannot be Controlled but Live Together
works.description: Projected flowers bloom and wither across the walls through the seasons; when visitors touch or stand still, petals scatter or grow around them.
works.idea_zh: 投影花朵因观众的触碰与停留而绽放或凋落

video.video_title: Flowers and People, Cannot be Controlled but Live Together @ PACE Art + Technology, California, USA

works.technique: A real-time generative flower simulation runs continuously, and depth or proximity sensors detect visitors' position and stillness to trigger blooming or scattering locally.
works.exercise_zh: 在 TouchDesigner 中用摄像头检测人的位置，投影花朵在人静止时生长、移动时凋落；变体：让花的种类随一天中的时间或季节改变。
works.description_zh: 投影出来的花朵在墙面上随四季开放又凋零；当观众触碰或静止不动时，身边的花瓣会散落或生长。
works.idea_en: Projected flowers bloom or fall as visitors touch them or stand still.
works.technique_zh: 实时生成的花朵模拟持续运行，深度或距离传感器检测观众的位置以及是否静止，在局部触发花开或花散。
works.exercise_en: In TouchDesigner, use a camera to detect where people are, so projected flowers grow while someone stands still and wither when they move. Twist: make the flower species change with the time of day or the season.

works.title: FoveAR
works.description: Combines an optical see-through headset for the central field of view with room projection for the periphery, giving AR a very wide field of view.
works.idea_zh: 眼镜负责视野中心，投影负责四周余光，拼出超大视场的AR。

video.video_title: FoveAR: Combining an Optically See-Through Near-Eye Display with Projector-Based Spatial ...

works.technique: An optical see-through HMD renders the central view while calibrated room projectors render the same scene in the periphery, with head tracking keeping both views registered.
works.exercise_zh: 让一位同学戴 HoloKit 看中心的虚拟物体，同时用投影仪在其周围墙面渲染同一场景的外围部分（如雨、星空），比较有无投影时的沉浸感；变体：故意让外围画面和中心画面讲不同的故事。
works.description_zh: 它把光学透视头显（负责中央视野）与房间投影（负责周边视野）结合起来，让 AR 获得极宽的视场。
works.idea_en: The glasses handle the center of your view and projection fills the edges, stitching together a very wide AR field of view.
works.technique_zh: 光学透视 HMD 渲染中央视野，经过标定的房间投影仪在周边渲染同一场景，头部追踪让两部分画面保持对齐。
works.exercise_en: Have one student wear HoloKit to look at a virtual object in the center while a projector renders the outer part of the same scene on the surrounding walls (rain, a starry sky), and compare how immersive it feels with and without the projection. Twist: deliberately make the peripheral and central imagery tell different stories.

works.title: Future Ruins
works.description: An installation for La Nuit des Images at the Musée de l'Elysée in which built structures and light imagine architecture as ruins seen from the future.
works.idea_zh: 用光和结构想象未来的人如何看待今天的建筑废墟
works.technique: Custom software (Hand Coded) drives projection or light onto purpose-built physical structures, likely using mapped geometry to animate their surfaces.
works.exercise_zh: 用纸板搭一座“废墟”，拍照后做对齐投影让它时而完整、时而崩塌；变化：由观众选择“一百年后”还是“一千年后”的状态。

video.video_title: Future Ruins

works.description_zh: 为爱丽舍博物馆（Musée de l'Elysée）的 La Nuit des Images 创作的装置，用搭建的结构和光线，把建筑想象成从未来回望的废墟。
works.idea_en: Use light and structure to imagine how future people will see today's buildings as ruins.
works.technique_zh: 定制软件（Hand Coded）驱动投影或灯光打在专门搭建的实体结构上，可能利用映射好的几何形体为结构表面制作动画。
works.exercise_en: Build a "ruin" out of cardboard, photograph it, and make an aligned projection that shows it sometimes whole and sometimes collapsing. Twist: let the audience choose between its state "100 years later" and "1,000 years later".

works.title: Halo Content
works.description: Emails, messages and notifications in a head-worn display drift out of the way whenever a person walks into view, forming a halo around their face instead of covering it.
works.description_zh: 头戴显示中的邮件、消息和通知在有人走进视野时自动让开，在对方脸部周围形成一圈“光环”，而不是挡住它。
works.idea_en: AR notifications should politely step aside when a real person appears.
works.idea_zh: 当真实的人出现时，AR 通知应该礼貌地让开。
works.technique: Detects faces and bodies in the camera feed and moves overlay elements with a simple force-directed layout so they orbit around, rather than occlude, the conversation partner.
works.technique_zh: 在摄像头画面中检测人脸和人体，用简单的力导向布局移动叠加元素，让它们绕着对话对象排布而不是遮挡。
works.exercise_en: Use a phone face-tracking AR app to attach three floating notification cards that orbit a detected face without covering it, then hold a two-minute conversation through the phone. Twist: make urgent cards come closer and quiet ones fade out.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机的人脸追踪 AR 做三张悬浮通知卡片，让它们绕着识别到的人脸转而不遮挡，然后透过手机进行两分钟对话；变体：让紧急的卡片靠得更近，不重要的逐渐淡出。

video.video_title: Halo Content: Non-invasive Augmented Reality (IUI 2015)

works.title: Highsight
works.description: A 'virtual bungee jump through a real space': harnessed visitors wear an Oculus Rift showing a live camera on a wire as it drops through a diorama and into the crowd around them.
works.idea_zh: 戴上头显，视角来自一根线上的真实摄像头，从模型里一路坠落到人群中。

video.video_title: Highsight

works.technique: A live camera on a cable-guided rig streams low-latency video into a head-mounted display, so the viewer's vision is displaced into a moving remote viewpoint within the same physical space.
works.exercise_zh: 把一部手机绑在绳子或杆子上做“飞行摄像头”，用 WebRTC 把画面实时传到戴 HoloKit 的同学眼前，让他从天花板视角看自己；变体：让观看者只能通过这个视角找回房间里某件藏起来的东西。
works.description_zh: 一次“穿越真实空间的虚拟蹦极”：系好安全带的观众戴上 Oculus Rift，看到的是一根钢丝上摄像头的实时画面，镜头一路坠过微缩模型，落进他们身边的人群。
works.idea_en: Put on a headset and see through a real camera on a wire as it plunges through a model and into the crowd.
works.technique_zh: 安装在缆索导轨上的实时摄像头把低延迟视频传进头戴显示器，观众的视觉被转移到同一物理空间中一个不断移动的远程视点。
works.exercise_en: Tie a phone to a rope or pole as a "flying camera", stream its video over WebRTC to a classmate wearing HoloKit, and let them watch themselves from the ceiling. Twist: the viewer can only use this viewpoint to find an object hidden somewhere in the room.

works.title: Holojam
works.description: Untethered mobile headsets and optical motion capture let a group walk around one room as avatars, drawing 3D ribbons in the air together.
works.idea_zh: 一群人戴着无线头显在同一空间里变成卡通化身，一起在空中画画。

video.video_title: Holojam

works.technique: OptiTrack cameras track reflective markers on each untethered mobile headset and on the hands, and positions are streamed over Wi-Fi so every headset renders all users' avatars and 3D ribbons in the shared room.
works.exercise_zh: 用 HoloKit 或手机 AR 的共享坐标（图像目标作为共同原点），让多人在同一空间用手机位置画出 3D 彩带并看到彼此的化身；变体：彩带只能在两个人合作（同时按下）时才会画出。
works.description_zh: 借助无线移动头显和光学动作捕捉，一群人以化身形象在同一个房间里走动，一起在空中画出三维彩带。
works.idea_en: A group in wireless headsets becomes cartoon avatars in one room and draws in the air together.
works.technique_zh: OptiTrack 相机追踪每台无线移动头显和双手上的反光标记点，位置数据通过 Wi-Fi 实时传输，使每台头显都能渲染出共享房间里所有用户的化身和三维彩带。
works.exercise_en: Use a shared coordinate system in HoloKit or phone AR (an image target as the common origin) so several people draw 3D ribbons in the same space with their phone positions and see each other's avatars. Twist: ribbons only appear when two people cooperate by pressing at the same time.

works.title: Impacto
works.description: A wearable combining a tactile solenoid tap with EMS muscle contraction so virtual boxing punches and soccer headers feel like real impacts.
works.idea_zh: 让VR里的一拳真的打到你身上。

video.video_title: impacto: a wearable that simulates physical impact in VR

works.technique: Pairs a solenoid for the skin-level tap with EMS that jerks the limb backwards, together simulating the momentum of an impact.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个手机AR拳击游戏，被打中时同伴用泡沫棒轻拍你手臂（“人肉触觉”）；变化：比较有/无触觉时玩家的躲闪反应。
works.description_zh: 一款可穿戴设备，把螺线管的触觉敲击与 EMS 肌肉电刺激结合起来，让虚拟拳击的出拳和足球头球都有真实的冲击感。
works.idea_en: Make a punch in VR actually land on you.
works.technique_zh: 用螺线管在皮肤表层产生敲击感，同时用 EMS 让肢体向后抽动，两者配合模拟出撞击的冲量。
works.exercise_en: Make a phone AR boxing game where, whenever you get hit, a partner taps your arm with a foam stick as "human haptics". Twist: compare how players dodge with and without the touch feedback.

works.title: In the Eyes of the Animal
works.description: Visitors in a real forest wear headsets and see the same forest as a mosquito, dragonfly, frog or owl might, rendered from LiDAR and CT scans as flowing particles and sound.
works.description_zh: 观众置身真实森林，戴上头显，以蚊子、蜻蜓、青蛙或猫头鹰的视角看同一片森林，画面由激光雷达和 CT 扫描数据生成的流动粒子与声音构成。
works.idea_en: Swap human senses for animal senses inside the very place you are standing.
works.idea_zh: 就在你站立的地方，把人类的感官换成动物的感官。
works.technique: LiDAR scans of Grizedale Forest and CT scans of animals are turned into point-cloud worlds with spatial binaural audio, experienced in headsets on site.
works.technique_zh: Grizedale 森林的激光雷达扫描与动物 CT 扫描被转化为点云世界，配合空间双耳音频，在现场用头显体验。
works.exercise_en: Scan a corner of the school garden with a phone LiDAR app, import it as a point cloud and render it the way a bee might see it (only moving things and UV-like colors). Twist: shrink the camera to insect height and speed.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机激光雷达应用扫描校园花园的一角，以点云导入，并按蜜蜂的视角渲染（只看得见运动的东西和类似紫外线的颜色）；变体：把相机缩小到昆虫的高度和速度。

video.video_title: ITEOTA TEASER

works.title: Infinity Room
works.description: A mirrored room whose walls are flooded with projected generative patterns, creating the sensation of floating in an infinite, shifting space.
works.idea_zh: 用投影和镜子让一个小房间看起来无限延伸
works.technique: Projectors cover the walls and floor while mirrored surfaces multiply the generative, sound-driven imagery to dissolve the room's boundaries.
works.exercise_zh: 在纸箱里贴镜面纸，用手机或小投影投入图案，观察无限反射；变化：让图案随背景音乐频谱变化。

video.video_title: INFINITY ROOM -Temporary Immersive Environment Experiment by Refik Anadol | Exploratorium

works.description_zh: 一个四壁为镜面的房间，墙面被投影的生成式图案铺满，让人仿佛漂浮在一个无限延伸、不断变幻的空间中。
works.idea_en: Projection and mirrors make a small room look endless.
works.technique_zh: 投影仪覆盖墙面和地面，镜面把由声音驱动的生成式影像不断复制，消解了房间的边界。
works.exercise_en: Line a cardboard box with mirror paper, project patterns into it with a phone or small projector, and watch the infinite reflections. Twist: make the patterns change with the spectrum of the background music.

works.title: Invisibilia: Revealing Invisible Data
works.description: An AR view that visualizes the invisible signals around connected devices, such as Wi-Fi fields and data flows, as overlays in the room.
works.idea_zh: 把看不见的无线信号和数据流可视化在空间里。

video.video_title: Invisibilia: Revealing Invisible Data Using Augmented Reality and Internet Connected Devices.

works.technique: Device positions are registered in AR (markers or known anchors) and network data such as Wi-Fi signal strength or packet activity is sampled and rendered as volumetric fields or particle flows around each device.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 或 WebXR 在路由器、手机、音箱位置放置锚点，读取手机测到的 Wi-Fi 信号强度（或用模拟数据）渲染成粒子云和数据流线；变体：可视化另一种看不见的东西，比如噪声、温度或二氧化碳浓度。
works.description_zh: 一种 AR 视图，把联网设备周围看不见的信号（如 Wi-Fi 信号场和数据流）以叠加图层的形式呈现在房间中。
works.idea_en: Make invisible wireless signals and data flows visible in the room.
works.technique_zh: 通过 AR（标记或已知锚点）注册各设备的位置，采集 Wi-Fi 信号强度、数据包活动等网络数据，并在每台设备周围渲染成体积场或粒子流。
works.exercise_en: Place anchors at the router, phone and speaker with AR Foundation or WebXR, read the Wi-Fi signal strength measured by the phone (or use simulated data), and render it as particle clouds and data streamlines. Twist: visualize another invisible thing, such as noise, temperature or CO2 concentration.

works.title: JackIn Head
works.description: A head-worn omnidirectional camera streams stabilized 360-degree video so remote viewers can look anywhere around the wearer, independent of where the wearer turns their head.
works.idea_zh: 把别人头上的全景相机当作自己的眼睛，远程的人可以独立转头看四周。

video.video_title: JackIn Head: 1st person omnidirectional video for immersive experience

works.technique: Estimates head rotation from the spherical video and counter-rotates each frame so the 360 stream stays world-stable for remote HMD viewers.
works.exercise_zh: 把一台360相机绑在帽子上直播到另一位同学的手机VR眼镜中，观看者用手势指挥佩戴者走路；变化：让三个人同时“附身”同一个人，投票决定方向。
works.description_zh: 佩戴在头上的全景相机传出经过稳像的 360 度视频，远程观众可以自由环顾佩戴者四周，不受佩戴者转头方向的影响。
works.idea_en: Borrow the panoramic camera on someone else's head as your own eyes, and look around independently from afar.
works.technique_zh: 从球面视频中估算头部旋转，再对每一帧做反向旋转，让 360 度视频流对远程 HMD 观众保持与世界坐标稳定。
works.exercise_en: Strap a 360 camera to a hat and livestream it to a classmate's phone VR viewer, who then directs the wearer's walking with hand signals. Twist: let three people "possess" the same person at once and vote on which way to go.

works.title: Just another day in the office at Magic Leap
works.description: Early Magic Leap concept footage made with Weta: a worker checks email on a holographic screen, then a robot invasion breaks out and he fights it with a ray gun around the real office.
works.idea_zh: 办公室里的日常突然被穿墙而来的机器人入侵打断。

video.video_title: Just another day in the office at Magic Leap 2015

works.technique: Spatial meshing of the office lets robots occlude behind and collide with real desks and walls, and a tracked controller acts as the ray gun for raycast hits.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机 AR 做一个小机器人从桌子后面探出头的场景，利用遮挡让它藏在真实物体后面；变体：点击机器人后它会逃到另一个真实物体后面。
works.description_zh: Magic Leap 与 Weta 合作制作的早期概念影片：一名员工在全息屏幕上查看邮件，随后机器人大举入侵，他拿起射线枪在真实办公室里四处迎战。
works.idea_en: An ordinary office day is interrupted by robots bursting through the walls.
works.technique_zh: 对办公室做空间网格化，让机器人能被真实的桌子和墙壁遮挡并与之碰撞；一个被追踪的控制器充当射线枪，通过射线检测判定命中。
works.exercise_en: Build a phone AR scene where a small robot peeks out from behind a table, using occlusion to hide it behind real objects. Twist: when tapped, the robot flees behind a different real object.

works.title: Kinetic Blocks
works.description: A shape display that stacks, sorts and assembles passive blocks by itself, and can replay a user's remote block-building gestures.
works.idea_zh: 桌面自己动手搭积木，把数字指令变成物理组装。

video.video_title: Kinetic Blocks

works.technique: The shape display lifts, tilts and pushes passive blocks with sequenced pin motions (like a programmable conveyor), with tracked block positions and recorded gestures driving the manipulation plans.
works.exercise_zh: 用投影在桌面上画出“移动箭头”，让同学扮演执行器按箭头推动积木，程序根据摄像头检测到的积木位置计算下一步；变体：录下一位同学的搭建过程，再让系统“回放”指挥另一个人复刻。
works.description_zh: 一台形状显示器可以自己堆叠、分拣和组装被动积木，还能复现远程用户搭积木的手势。
works.idea_en: The tabletop builds with blocks by itself, turning digital commands into physical assembly.
works.technique_zh: 形状显示器通过按序列运动的针脚来抬起、倾斜和推动被动积木（类似可编程传送带），由追踪到的积木位置和录制的手势生成操作方案。
works.exercise_en: Project "move arrows" onto a table and have a classmate act as the actuator, pushing blocks as the arrows show, while a program computes the next step from the block positions detected by a camera. Twist: record one classmate's building process, then have the system "play it back" to guide another person in copying it.

works.title: Le mouvement de l'air
works.description: Three dancers move through projected wind, water and particle landscapes that swirl around their bodies as if air had become visible.
works.idea_zh: 把看不见的空气流动变成围绕舞者的可见影像
works.technique: Real-time fluid and particle simulations in eMotion are projected on floor and backdrop and steered live with the dancers' movement.
works.exercise_zh: 用网页流体模拟（WebGL fluid）投影，用摄像头光流让同学的动作搅动“空气”；变化：用风扇吹的真实风与投影同步。

video.video_title: LE MOUVEMENT DE L’AIR / ADRIEN M & CLAIRE B

works.description_zh: 三位舞者穿行在投影出的风、水与粒子景观之中，这些影像在他们身体周围回旋，仿佛空气变得可见。
works.idea_en: Turn invisible air currents into visible imagery swirling around the dancers.
works.technique_zh: 用 eMotion 进行实时流体与粒子模拟，投影到地面和背景幕上，并随舞者的动作实时操控。
works.exercise_en: Project a web fluid simulation (WebGL fluid) and use camera optical flow so classmates' movements stir up the "air". Twist: sync real wind from a fan with the projection.

works.title: Level of Confidence
works.description: A face-recognition camera trained on the faces of the 43 disappeared Ayotzinapa students looks for them in each visitor's face and shows which student they most resemble and how confident the match is.
works.idea_zh: 用人脸识别在每位观众脸上寻找43位失踪学生，把监控技术变成纪念
works.technique: Eigenface/Fisherface and LBP face-recognition algorithms compare the live face against the students' portraits and display the best match with its confidence score.
works.exercise_zh: 用网页人脸特征库（face-api.js）把观众与一组历史人物照片比对并显示相似度；变化：由同学讨论选择一个值得被“寻找”的群体作为数据集。

video.video_title: Level of Confidence by Rafael Lozano-Hemmer, Mexico City, 2015

works.description_zh: 一台人脸识别摄像头以阿约齐纳帕（Ayotzinapa）43 名失踪学生的面孔为训练数据，在每位观众的脸上寻找他们，并显示观众最像哪一位学生以及匹配的置信度。
works.idea_en: Face recognition searches every visitor's face for the 43 missing students, turning surveillance into a memorial.
works.technique_zh: 采用 Eigenface/Fisherface 与 LBP 人脸识别算法，把实时人脸与学生肖像逐一比对，显示最佳匹配及其置信度分数。
works.exercise_en: Use a web face-recognition library (face-api.js) to compare visitors with a set of photos of historical figures and display the similarity scores. Twist: have the class discuss and choose a group worth "searching for" as the dataset.

works.title: LineFORM
works.description: A snake-like chain of servo modules that can bend into shapes, wrap the wrist, act as a physical graph line, or constrain the user's hand motion.
works.idea_zh: 一条会自己弯曲的“线”，既能显示信息又能约束你的手。

video.video_title: UIST 2015 - LineFORM: Actuated Curve Interfaces for Display, Interaction, and Constraint

works.technique: Chains serially linked servo segments and computes joint angles by inverse kinematics so the line can take on target curves or respond to touch.
works.exercise_zh: 用吸管和扭扭棒做一条可弯曲的实体线，再用手机AR沿着线显示流动的数据或音乐波形；变化：同学改变线的形状时AR内容同步变化。
works.description_zh: 一条由舵机模块串成的蛇形链，能弯成各种形状、缠绕手腕、充当实体的曲线图，还能约束用户手部的动作。
works.idea_en: A line that bends itself, both displaying information and constraining your hand.
works.technique_zh: 把舵机单元串联成链，用逆运动学计算各关节角度，使这条线能摆出目标曲线或对触碰作出反应。
works.exercise_en: Make a bendable physical line from straws and pipe cleaners, then use phone AR to show flowing data or a music waveform along it. Twist: when a classmate reshapes the line, the AR content changes with it.

works.title: Live Texturing of AR Characters from Colored Drawings
works.description: Children color a page in a coloring book and a tablet instantly shows the drawn character as a 3D animated figure with their own coloring, even on hidden sides.
works.idea_zh: 孩子涂色的画一拿起平板就变成立体会动的角色，颜色完全是自己涂的。

video.video_title: Live Texturing of Augmented Reality Characters from Colored Drawings

works.technique: The coloring page is tracked and rectified, the drawn colors are sampled into the 3D character's UV texture through a precomputed mapping, and occluded parts are filled by a texture synthesis lookup from visible regions.
works.exercise_zh: 设计一张涂色线稿并在 Unity 中做一个对应的 3D 模型，用 AR 图像追踪拍到页面后把页面图像通过 UV 贴到模型上（可直接用平面映射近似）；变体：让涂色影响角色的行为，比如红色越多越暴躁。
works.description_zh: 孩子在涂色书上涂好一页，平板立刻把画中的角色变成带着他们自己配色的三维动画形象，就连看不到的背面也有颜色。
works.idea_en: Hold up a tablet and a child's coloring page becomes a moving 3D character wearing the child's own colors.
works.technique_zh: 追踪并校正涂色页面，通过预先计算的映射把画上的颜色采样到三维角色的 UV 贴图中，被遮挡的部分则从可见区域做纹理合成查找来填补。
works.exercise_en: Design a coloring line drawing and a matching 3D model in Unity, then use AR image tracking to capture the page and map its image onto the model through the UVs (a planar projection is a fine approximation). Twist: let the coloring affect the character's behavior, for example the more red, the grumpier it gets.

works.title: Minecraft for HoloLens (E3 demo)
works.description: On stage at E3, a player sees a Minecraft world built on a real coffee table, zooms into it, opens it like a dollhouse and commands it by voice.
works.idea_zh: 把整个Minecraft世界放在真实茶几上，用语音和手势操控。

video.video_title: HoloLens Minecraft Demo  - E3 2015 Microsoft Press Conference

works.technique: Anchors a scaled game world to a detected table surface and combines gaze, air-tap and voice for world manipulation.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机AR把一个方块小世界放在桌面上，并用语音指令（如iOS快捷指令或Web Speech）“爆炸/下雨”；变化：让观众在另一部手机上看到同一世界。
works.description_zh: 在 E3 舞台上，一位玩家看到一个搭建在真实茶几上的 Minecraft 世界，他可以放大进入其中，像打开玩偶屋一样把它掀开，还能用语音指挥它。
works.idea_en: Put an entire Minecraft world on a real coffee table and control it by voice and gesture.
works.technique_zh: 把缩小的游戏世界锚定在检测到的桌面上，并结合注视、空中点击（air-tap）和语音来操控这个世界。
works.exercise_en: Place a small block world on a table with phone AR and trigger "explode" or "rain" with voice commands (such as iOS Shortcuts or Web Speech). Twist: let the audience see the same world on another phone.

works.title: ModulAR
works.description: A video see-through headset with swappable camera-lens modules lets the wearer switch between telescopic zoom and wide-angle vision just by where they look, using built-in eye tracking.
works.description_zh: 一款视频透视头显配有可更换的摄像头镜头模块，佩戴者只需通过注视方式，就能在望远变焦和广角视野之间切换，靠的是内置眼动追踪。
works.idea_en: Vision superpowers as plug-in lenses you switch on with your eyes.
works.idea_zh: 把视觉超能力做成可插拔的镜头，用眼睛来开启。
works.technique: Combines interchangeable camera-lens modules on an HMD with eye tracking, so gaze gestures trigger on-demand zoom or field-of-view expansion in the video feed.
works.technique_zh: 在头显上组合可互换的摄像头镜头模块与眼动追踪，用注视手势按需触发视频画面的变焦或视野扩展。
works.exercise_en: Build a phone 'binocular' mode in a cardboard viewer that zooms the camera when you tilt your head up and returns to normal when you tilt down; test it on a board at the back of the room. Twist: trigger the zoom by blinking twice using front-camera face tracking.
works.exercise_zh: 在纸盒眼镜中的手机上做一个“望远镜”模式：抬头时相机放大，低头时恢复正常，用教室后面的黑板测试；变体：借助前置摄像头的人脸追踪，眨两下眼触发放大。

video.video_title: ISMAR 2015 - ModulAR: The Augmented Reality Vision Augmentation Display

works.title: Penguins Mirror
works.description: 450 stuffed toy penguins on turntables rotate between their white bellies and black backs to form a silhouette of whoever stands before them.
works.idea_zh: 450只玩具企鹅转身，黑背白肚拼出你的剪影
works.technique: A camera extracts the viewer's silhouette and motorised turntables turn each penguin to show its white or black side as a binary pixel.
works.exercise_zh: 用几个双面黑白的小物件（纸杯、玩具）装在转盘上，用摄像头剪影控制正反面；变化：加入延迟，让“像素”像人浪一样依次翻转。

video.video_title: Daniel Rozin: Penguins Mirror

works.description_zh: 450 只毛绒玩具企鹅站在转盘上，在白肚皮和黑后背之间来回转动，拼出站在它们面前的人的剪影。
works.idea_en: 450 toy penguins turn around, their black backs and white bellies forming your silhouette.
works.technique_zh: 摄像头提取观众的剪影，电动转盘让每只企鹅露出白色或黑色的一面，充当一个二值像素。
works.exercise_en: Mount a few small objects that are black on one side and white on the other (paper cups, toys) on turntables, and flip them with a camera silhouette. Twist: add a delay so the "pixels" flip one after another like a stadium wave.

works.title: Pixel Waves
works.description: Waves of pixel-like light roll across the floor and respond to people walking through them like a digital sea.
works.idea_zh: 在像素组成的光之海浪中行走，浪花会随你而动
works.technique: Floor projection of a height-field wave simulation, perturbed at the positions of people detected by an overhead tracking system (Voxels track).
works.exercise_zh: 用网页做二维波动方程模拟并投到地面，摄像头检测到人就在该点“投石子”；变化：让声音大小改变海浪的颜色。

video.video_title: Pixel Waves - Miguel Chevalier - Illuminate Adelaide

works.description_zh: 像素般的光浪在地面上翻滚，就像一片数字海洋，会对从中走过的人作出回应。
works.idea_en: Walk through a sea of pixel light whose waves move with you.
works.technique_zh: 在地面投影一个高度场波浪模拟，由俯视追踪系统（Voxels track）检测到的人所在位置对波面施加扰动。
works.exercise_en: Build a 2D wave-equation simulation on the web and project it onto the floor, dropping a "pebble" wherever the camera detects a person. Twist: let the volume of sound change the color of the waves.

works.title: Project Jacquard
works.description: Conductive yarns woven into ordinary fabric turn a jacket sleeve into a touch surface: swipe or tap the cuff to control your phone.
works.idea_zh: 把衣袖织成触摸板。

video.video_title: Welcome to Project Jacquard

works.technique: Weaves a grid of conductive threads into the textile and reads capacitive changes from a snap-on tag that classifies swipes and taps.
works.exercise_zh: 用导电胶带或导电线缝在旧手套/袖子上，接Makey Makey控制手机AR里的场景切换；变化：不同的衣服部位代表不同的AR“魔法”。
works.description_zh: 把导电纱线织进普通面料，夹克袖子就变成了触控面板：在袖口上滑动或轻点，即可操控手机。
works.idea_en: Weave a jacket sleeve into a touchpad.
works.technique_zh: 在织物中织入导电纱线网格，由一枚扣在衣服上的标签读取电容变化，并识别滑动和轻点手势。
works.exercise_en: Sew conductive tape or conductive thread onto an old glove or sleeve and connect it to a Makey Makey to switch scenes in a phone AR app. Twist: let different parts of the clothing trigger different AR "spells".

works.title: Project Soli
works.description: A tiny radar chip senses sub-millimetre finger motions in the air, so rubbing fingers turns a virtual dial and tapping presses an invisible button.
works.idea_zh: 用手指在空中搓一搓就能转动看不见的旋钮。

video.video_title: Welcome to Project Soli

works.technique: Emits a broad radar beam and classifies the Doppler and range signature of micro-finger movements into 'virtual tool' gestures.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机AR手部追踪或MediaPipe实现“捏合转旋钮、双指点按钮”的空中微手势控制一个虚拟收音机；变化：只允许眼睛不看手完成操作。
works.description_zh: 一枚微型雷达芯片能感知手指在空中亚毫米级的动作：搓动手指可以转动虚拟旋钮，轻点则能按下一个看不见的按钮。
works.idea_en: Rub your fingers in the air to turn an invisible dial.
works.technique_zh: 发射宽波束雷达，根据手指微动作的多普勒与距离特征，把它们分类为“虚拟工具”手势。
works.exercise_en: Use phone AR hand tracking or MediaPipe to build mid-air micro-gestures (pinch to turn a knob, two-finger tap to press a button) that control a virtual radio. Twist: the task must be done without looking at your hands.

works.title: Projecting West
works.description: On a 15-day road trip from Portland, Oregon to Portland, Maine, the team makes impulsive projection installations each night on barns, motels, rocks and roadside signs.
works.description_zh: 在从俄勒冈州波特兰到缅因州波特兰的 15 天公路旅行中，团队每晚在谷仓、汽车旅馆、岩石和路边招牌上即兴创作投影装置。
works.idea_en: A road trip where each stop gets its own site-specific story in light.
works.idea_zh: 一场公路旅行，每一站都获得一个属于它自己的光之故事。
works.technique: A portable projector and generator are set up quickly and content is mapped on site to whatever surface each town offers.
works.technique_zh: 便携投影机和发电机快速架设，现场把内容映射到每个小镇能提供的任意表面上。
works.exercise_en: In teams, walk around campus for 30 minutes, pick an overlooked surface and make a 20-second projection about it using a laptop and pico projector. Twist: the content must use only what you learned from someone passing by.
works.exercise_zh: 分组在校园里走 30 分钟，挑一个被忽视的表面，用笔记本和微型投影仪为它做一段 20 秒的投影；变体：内容只能来自你从路人那里听到的信息。

video.video_title: Projecting West — Launch Trailer

works.title: Reality Editor
works.description: The public Reality Editor app: connected objects carry visual markers; point your phone at them to see their capabilities and wire a light switch to a lamp or a chair to a car seat by drawing connections.
works.idea_zh: AR版'数字螺丝刀'：看一眼就能重新布线家里所有智能设备。

video.video_title: REALITY EDITOR

works.technique: Each object carries a visual marker recognized by Vuforia, its Open Hybrid server publishes I/O nodes over Wi-Fi, and drawn AR connections become routing rules between the objects' Arduino-driven inputs and outputs.
works.exercise_zh: 用两块 ESP32 各接一个按钮和一个灯，手机 WebAR 识别它们的贴纸标记后可以画线把按钮连到灯上（后端用 WebSocket 转发）；变体：把连接对象换成非电子物品（如椅子被坐下），想出一个有意思的“物体间对话”。
works.description_zh: 公开发布的 Reality Editor 应用：联网物体上贴有视觉标记，用手机对准它们就能看到各自的功能，并通过画线把电灯开关连到台灯，或把椅子连到汽车座椅。
works.idea_en: An AR "digital screwdriver": glance at your smart devices and rewire them all.
works.technique_zh: 每个物体都带有可被 Vuforia 识别的视觉标记，其 Open Hybrid 服务器通过 Wi-Fi 发布输入/输出节点；在 AR 中画出的连线会变成物体之间的路由规则，连接由 Arduino 驱动的输入与输出。
works.exercise_en: Connect a button and a light to each of two ESP32 boards, and have a phone WebAR app recognize their sticker markers so you can draw a line from the button to the light (with a WebSocket backend relaying messages). Twist: swap in non-electronic things, such as a chair being sat on, and invent an interesting "conversation between objects".

works.title: Reality Masher: multi-person AR
works.description: A Microsoft Research prototype with Jaron Lanier in which several people wearing early HoloLens headsets share and play with the same holograms in one room.
works.idea_zh: 多人戴头显，在同一个房间里共享同一批全息物体。

video.video_title: Reality Masher: Multi-Person Augmented Reality

works.technique: Multiple HoloLens devices share a common spatial anchor so holograms occupy the same physical location for every participant.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Lens Studio Connected Lens 或 8th Wall 共享会话，让两台手机看到同一只虚拟宠物并轮流喂它；加一个变化：一人只能看到、另一人只能听到。
works.description_zh: 微软研究院与 Jaron Lanier 合作的原型：几个人戴着早期的 HoloLens 头显，在同一个房间里共享并把玩同一批全息影像。
works.idea_en: Several people in headsets share the same set of holograms in one room.
works.technique_zh: 多台 HoloLens 设备共享同一个空间锚点，使全息影像对每位参与者来说都位于同一物理位置。
works.exercise_en: Use Lens Studio Connected Lens or an 8th Wall shared session so two phones see the same virtual pet and take turns feeding it. Twist: one person can only see it and the other can only hear it.

works.title: Reflection Study (interactive edition)
works.description: A light table where visitors move laser-cut acrylic pieces; the software simulates 2D light bouncing off the physical shapes to create typography and graphic forms.
works.idea_zh: 在灯箱上摆动亚克力块，软件模拟光线在实物间反射，生成图形与字体。

video.video_title: reflection study / Interactive edition

works.technique: A camera under or over the light table extracts the contours of acrylic pieces, and a 2D ray-tracing simulation bounces light rays off those polygon edges, projected back onto the table.
works.exercise_zh: 在桌面上俯拍几张彩色卡纸，用 p5.js 提取轮廓后从一个光源发射射线在卡纸边缘反射，投影回桌面；变体：设计一组卡片形状，让光线最终能拼出你的名字首字母。
works.description_zh: 一张灯箱桌，观众可以挪动上面激光切割的亚克力块；软件模拟二维光线在这些实物形状上的反射，生成字体与图形。
works.idea_en: Move acrylic pieces on a light table and the software bounces simulated light off them to draw shapes and letters.
works.technique_zh: 位于灯箱桌下方或上方的摄像头提取亚克力块的轮廓，二维光线追踪模拟让光线在这些多边形边缘反射，再投影回桌面。
works.exercise_en: Shoot a few pieces of colored card from above, extract their outlines in p5.js, cast rays from a light source that bounce off the card edges, and project the result back onto the table. Twist: design a set of card shapes so the light rays end up spelling your initials.

works.title: Retargeting Technical Documentation to AR
works.description: Printed instruction manuals are automatically converted into 3D AR instructions: the arrows and steps from paper diagrams are mapped onto the real device.
works.idea_zh: 把纸质说明书自动变成叠在实物上的AR步骤。

video.video_title: Retargeting Technical Documentation to Augmented Reality

works.technique: Parses manual illustrations, registers them to a 3D model of the device, and re-renders arrows and motion cues in AR on the tracked real object.
works.exercise_zh: 挑一份宜家说明书的一页，学生用Reality Composer把其中的箭头和零件动画放到真实物件上；变化：比较纸质与AR版本谁装得更快。
works.description_zh: 把纸质说明书自动转换成三维 AR 说明：纸面示意图中的箭头和步骤会被映射到真实设备上。
works.idea_en: Automatically turn a paper manual into AR steps overlaid on the real object.
works.technique_zh: 解析说明书插图，把它们配准到设备的三维模型上，再在被追踪的真实物体上以 AR 重新渲染箭头和运动提示。
works.exercise_en: Pick one page of an IKEA manual and have students use Reality Composer to place its arrows and part animations on the real object. Twist: compare whether the paper or the AR version gets things assembled faster.

works.title: SIM/NEBULA
works.description: Inside Prague's Rudolfinum concert hall, the Czech Philharmonic plays while the ornate hall itself is mapped with 45 minutes of futuristic visuals about a cybernetic organism being born.
works.description_zh: 在布拉格鲁道夫音乐厅里，捷克爱乐乐团现场演奏，华丽的音乐厅内部被 45 分钟的未来感影像覆盖，讲述一个控制论生命体的诞生。
works.idea_en: Map the inside of a concert hall so the architecture performs alongside the orchestra.
works.idea_zh: 给音乐厅内部做投影，让建筑与乐团同台演出。
works.technique: Multiple artists created chapters rendered to a 3D model of the hall interior, and projectors covered walls, balconies and organ in sync with the live score.
works.technique_zh: 多位艺术家分章节创作，依据音乐厅内部 3D 模型渲染，投影覆盖墙面、包厢和管风琴，并与现场乐谱同步。
works.exercise_en: Pick a piece of classical music and map a classroom corner so that each instrument group 'lives' on a different surface. Twist: let the visuals react to a live microphone instead of a timeline.
works.exercise_zh: 选一首古典乐，给教室的一个角落做投影，让不同乐器组“住”在不同的表面上；变体：让画面对现场麦克风做出反应，而不是按时间轴播放。

video.video_title: SIM / NEBULA

works.title: SemanticPaint
works.description: While scanning a room, the user touches objects and names them by voice; the system learns and labels chairs, tables and walls in the live 3D map.
works.idea_zh: 边扫描房间边用手点、用嘴说，系统就学会认识每件家具。

video.video_title: SemanticPaint: Interactive 3D Labelling and Learning at your Fingertips

works.technique: A KinectFusion-style reconstruction is labeled online: user touch plus a spoken label seeds voxels, and a streaming random-forest classifier with CRF smoothing propagates labels across the 3D map.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation Meshing 扫描房间，用户点击某块网格并说出名字（语音转文字），给这片区域着色并存标签，同时展示检测到的平面分类（桌、墙、地面）；变体：给物体打上情绪或记忆标签，而不是名称。
works.description_zh: 在扫描房间的同时，用户触碰物体并用语音说出名字，系统便在实时三维地图中学会识别并标注椅子、桌子和墙面。
works.idea_en: Point and speak while scanning a room, and the system learns to recognize every piece of furniture.
works.technique_zh: 对 KinectFusion 式的三维重建进行在线标注：用户的触碰加上语音标签为体素提供初始标注，流式随机森林分类器配合 CRF 平滑把标签扩散到整张三维地图。
works.exercise_en: Scan a room with AR Foundation Meshing, let the user tap a patch of mesh and say its name (speech to text), color that region and store the label, and also show the detected plane classifications (table, wall, floor). Twist: tag objects with emotions or memories instead of names.

works.title: Star Wars Mixed Reality Test
works.description: Recorded live on a Project Tango tablet, Star Wars ships and droids appear in a real room and hold their place as the camera walks around them.
works.idea_zh: 在真实房间里让星战机器人和飞船停在原地，你绕着它们走。

video.video_title: Star Wars Mixed Reality Test

works.technique: Tango motion tracking plus depth sensing anchors 3D models to the room so they keep position and scale while the device moves.
works.exercise_zh: 把一个你喜欢的电影道具模型放进教室，绕着它录一段'纪录片'；加一个变化：靠近时模型会转头看你。
works.description_zh: 用 Project Tango 平板实拍录制：星球大战的飞船和机器人出现在真实房间里，镜头绕着它们走动时，它们始终稳稳停在原处。
works.idea_en: Star Wars droids and ships stay put in a real room while you walk around them.
works.technique_zh: Tango 运动追踪结合深度感知把三维模型锚定在房间里，设备移动时模型的位置和比例保持不变。
works.exercise_en: Put a model of your favorite movie prop into the classroom and walk around it to shoot a short "documentary". Twist: the model turns its head to look at you when you get close.

works.title: Tactum
works.description: Touch and pinch gestures on your own forearm are tracked and a projector shows a live 3D-printable wearable form growing on your skin as you design it.
works.idea_zh: 在自己的手臂上用手势“捏”出一件可3D打印的饰品。

video.video_title: Tactum: Skin-Centric Design by Madeline Gannon

works.technique: Tracks the arm with a depth camera, interprets skin touches as modelling gestures and projection-maps the resulting geometry back onto the arm.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机AR手部追踪在手臂上放置可拉伸的虚拟手镯，并用手势调整形状后导出截图做纸模；变化：投影仪从上方把设计投在真实手臂上。
works.description_zh: 系统追踪用户在自己前臂上的触摸与捏合手势，投影仪把正在设计的、可直接 3D 打印的可穿戴形体实时投在皮肤上，看着它随设计过程逐渐生长。
works.idea_en: Pinch a 3D-printable piece of jewelry into shape right on your own arm.
works.technique_zh: 用深度相机追踪手臂，把对皮肤的触碰解读为建模手势，再把生成的几何形体投影映射回手臂上。
works.exercise_en: Use phone AR hand tracking to place a stretchable virtual bracelet on your arm, adjust its shape with gestures, then export a screenshot and make a paper model from it. Twist: have a projector above cast the design onto a real arm.

works.title: Unfold 01 | Projection on Print
works.description: A morphogenesis-inspired form printed on a large canvas is overlaid with an exactly aligned projection, so the flat print seems to fold and breathe.
works.idea_zh: 投影精确叠在印刷画上，让平面图像像生物一样折叠、呼吸。

video.video_title: Unfold 01 | Projection on Print

works.technique: A projector is calibrated to the printed canvas so animated light and shadow are registered on top of the matching printed geometry.
works.exercise_zh: 打印一张黑白几何图，用投影仪 + MadMapper/TouchDesigner 精确对位投上动画光影；加一个变化：动画跟随环境音乐节奏。
works.description_zh: 一幅受形态发生启发的形体印在大幅画布上，再叠加一层精确对齐的投影，让平面的印刷画仿佛在折叠、呼吸。
works.idea_en: A projection laid exactly over a print makes the flat image fold and breathe like a living thing.
works.technique_zh: 将投影仪与印刷画布进行标定，使动态的光影精确叠合在对应的印刷几何图形之上。
works.exercise_en: Print a black-and-white geometric image and use a projector with MadMapper or TouchDesigner to align animated light and shadow precisely onto it. Twist: make the animation follow the rhythm of the ambient music.

works.title: Virtual Replicas for Remote Assistance
works.description: A remote expert grabs a virtual copy of a part in the local worker's room and shows exactly where and how it should go; the local worker sees the ghost replica move into place through their AR headset.
works.description_zh: 远程专家抓起本地工人房间里某个部件的虚拟复制品，演示它应该放在哪里、怎样放；本地工人通过 AR 头显看到这个“幽灵”复制品移动到位。
works.idea_en: Point and demonstrate with a copy of the real object instead of with words or arrows.
works.idea_zh: 用真实物体的复制品来指示和示范，而不是靠语言或箭头。
works.technique: Tracks the physical objects and gives the remote VR or AR expert manipulable 3D replicas whose poses are mirrored as guidance in the local user's stereo head-worn display.
works.technique_zh: 追踪实体物体，为身处 VR 或 AR 的远程专家提供可操作的三维复制品，其位姿会作为指导同步显示在本地用户的立体头戴显示器中。
works.exercise_en: Put a printed marker on a toy part; a remote partner moves a virtual copy of it in a shared phone AR scene to show where it goes, and the local student assembles it. Twist: allow the expert only one gesture and no voice.
works.exercise_zh: 在玩具零件上贴一个打印标记，远程同伴在共享的手机 AR 场景中移动它的虚拟复制品来示范位置，本地学生照着组装；变体：专家只能用一个手势，不能说话。

video.video_title: Virtual Replicas for Remote Assistance in Virtual and Augmented Reality

works.title: Whale in the Gym (concept)
works.description: A humpback whale bursts out of a school gym floor in front of students and splashes back down, a concept film for shared, room-scale mixed reality.
works.idea_zh: 一头鲸鱼从学校体育馆地板里跃出。

video.video_title: Whale Surprise Jumps into a Gym in Mixed Reality (Exciting) by Magic Leap

works.technique: Concept visualization (likely VFX compositing rather than live headset capture) of a large creature breaking through a real floor plane.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机AR（如Reality Composer）让一个巨大动物从教室地板“冲出”，并设计一个遮挡的洞口效果；变化：全班同时用多部手机看到同一只动物。
works.description_zh: 一头座头鲸在学生面前从学校体育馆的地板中破地而出，又溅起水花落回去。这是一支展示多人共享、房间尺度混合现实的概念影片。
works.idea_en: A whale leaps out of a school gym floor.
works.technique_zh: 概念可视化（大概率是 VFX 后期合成，而非头显实拍），表现一只巨大生物冲破真实地面的场景。
works.exercise_en: Use phone AR (for example Reality Composer) to make a giant animal burst out of the classroom floor, and design an occluded hole effect. Twist: let the whole class see the same animal on several phones at once.

works.title: Zoom Pavilion (with Krzysztof Wodiczko)
works.description: An immersive room of projections from 12 computerized surveillance cameras that detect visitors' faces and zoom in on them and on the spatial relationships between strangers.
works.idea_zh: 监控摄像头自动放大你与陌生人的关系，并投满整个房间
works.technique: Face-detection and tracking algorithms steer robotic zoom cameras and project their live feeds, recording distances between detected people.
works.exercise_zh: 用网页摄像头做人脸检测并自动“数码变焦”到每张脸，投影到墙上；变化：计算两人间距离并在画面中画线标出。

video.video_title: Rafael Lozano-Hemmer & Krzysztof Wodiczko 'Zoom Pavilion' 2015

works.description_zh: 一个沉浸式投影空间，影像来自 12 台由计算机控制的监控摄像头，它们检测观众的面孔并放大，也放大陌生人之间的空间关系。
works.idea_en: Surveillance cameras zoom in on how you relate to strangers and fill the whole room with it.
works.technique_zh: 人脸检测与追踪算法控制机械变焦摄像头，把它们的实时画面投影出来，同时记录被检测到的人之间的距离。
works.exercise_en: Use a webcam to detect faces, automatically "digitally zoom" in on each one, and project the result onto a wall. Twist: compute the distance between two people and draw a line marking it in the image.

works.title: border (Rhizomatiks Research x ELEVENPLAY)
works.description: Audience members ride automated wheelchairs wearing headsets whose view mixes live dancers with virtual ones, so they cannot tell which bodies are real.
works.idea_zh: 坐着自动轮椅戴头显，真假舞者在眼前交错

video.video_title: Border at Spiral

works.technique: Motion capture tracks both the audience wheelchairs and real dancers in a shared coordinate system, so HMD-rendered virtual dancers and scenery are registered precisely to the physical stage.
works.exercise_zh: 用 HoloKit 或手机 AR 在教室里放一个虚拟舞者，让观看者坐在带轮椅子上被同学推着走固定路线，真人舞者和虚拟舞者交替出现；变体：观看者看不到真人舞者什么时候替换了虚拟的，事后让他猜。
works.description_zh: 观众坐在自动轮椅上、戴着头显，眼前的画面把真人舞者和虚拟舞者混在一起，让人分不清哪些身体是真实的。
works.idea_en: Ride an automated wheelchair in a headset while real and virtual dancers weave past you.
works.technique_zh: 动作捕捉系统在同一坐标系中同时追踪观众的轮椅和真人舞者，使 HMD 渲染的虚拟舞者和场景与实体舞台精确对齐。
works.exercise_en: Place a virtual dancer in the classroom with HoloKit or phone AR, seat the viewer on a wheeled chair and have classmates push them along a fixed route while real and virtual dancers take turns appearing. Twist: the viewer cannot tell when a real dancer has replaced a virtual one, and has to guess afterward.

works.title: castAR SmartGlasses at AWE 2015
works.description: A later castAR prototype shown at AWE 2015 with tabletop games that several players see at once around the retro-reflective surface.
works.idea_zh: 多人围坐反光桌面，共同玩全息桌游。

video.video_title: Jeri Ellsworth (Cofounder, CastAR) - CastAR SmartGlasses at AWE 2015

works.technique: Because each wearer's projector image returns only to their own eyes, multiple players can share one surface with individually correct perspective views.
works.exercise_zh: 设计一个多人桌面游戏，每个玩家看到的信息不同（比如手牌只有自己能看），用多台手机 AR 围绕同一张图像标记实现；变体：加入一张所有人都能看到的公共牌。
works.description_zh: castAR 在 AWE 2015 上展示的后期原型，配有桌面游戏，多位玩家可以围着回射反光表面同时看到游戏画面。
works.idea_en: Several players sit around a reflective table and play a holographic board game together.
works.technique_zh: 由于每位佩戴者的投影仪画面只会反射回他自己的眼睛，多名玩家可以共享同一块表面，并各自看到透视正确的画面。
works.exercise_en: Design a multiplayer tabletop game where each player sees different information (for example, only you can see your own hand of cards), built with several phones running AR around the same image marker. Twist: add one public card that everyone can see.

works.title: drone + AR test
works.description: Tests where flying drones are tracked and AR graphics are composited onto them in real time, previewing AR for live drone performances.
works.idea_zh: 给飞行中的无人机实时叠加AR图形

video.video_title: drone + AR test 01 (Rhizomatiks Research)

works.technique: Optical motion capture (e.g. retroreflective markers on drones) gives each drone's 6DoF pose, which drives CG attached to it and composited into the tracked camera view.
works.exercise_zh: 在一个遥控小车或手持物体上贴图像标记，用 AR 图像追踪给它叠加翅膀、尾迹等图形；变体：让尾迹记录它移动的完整路径，最后形成一幅“运动绘画”。
works.description_zh: 一系列测试：追踪飞行中的无人机，并实时把 AR 图形合成到它们身上，为无人机现场表演中的 AR 效果做预演。
works.idea_en: Overlay AR graphics on drones in flight, in real time.
works.technique_zh: 光学动作捕捉（例如贴在无人机上的回射标记点）获取每架无人机的 6DoF 位姿，驱动附着在其上的 CG，并合成进被追踪的摄像机画面。
works.exercise_en: Stick an image marker on a remote-control car or a handheld object and use AR image tracking to overlay wings, trails and other graphics on it. Twist: have the trail record its complete path, ending up as a "motion painting".

works.title: shadow (drone with a spotlight)
works.description: A single dancer is lit only by spotlights carried by drones; as the drones move, her shadows multiply, stretch and rotate on the walls.
works.idea_zh: 用无人机携带的聚光灯让影子成为舞蹈的一部分
works.technique: Light-carrying drones follow programmed paths so the light source position is choreographed, controlling the size and direction of the dancer's shadows.
works.exercise_zh: 关灯，用手机手电筒绑在长杆或小车上移动，让同学跳舞时影子在墙上变化；变化：用两个不同颜色的光源做出双色影子。

video.video_title: ELEVENPLAY x Rhizomatiks "shadow" (2015) drone with a spot light

works.description_zh: 一位舞者只被无人机携带的聚光灯照亮；随着无人机移动，她投在墙上的影子不断增多、拉长、旋转。
works.idea_en: Spotlights carried by drones make the dancer's shadows part of the dance.
works.technique_zh: 携带光源的无人机按编程路径飞行，从而编排光源的位置，控制舞者影子的大小和方向。
works.exercise_en: Turn off the lights, tie a phone flashlight to a long pole or a small cart, and move it while a classmate dances so their shadow shifts across the wall. Twist: use two light sources of different colors to make two-toned shadows.

works.title: 3D Video Capture With Three Kinects
works.description: Three calibrated Kinects capture a person in full 3D and merge them with virtual environments for immersive tele-collaboration.
works.idea_zh: 三台Kinect合成完整3D真人，放进虚拟环境里远程协作。

video.video_title: 3D Video Capture With Three Kinects

works.technique: Three Kinects are extrinsically calibrated to one coordinate frame (e.g. by a shared calibration target), and their point clouds are merged into a single 3D representation rendered in a VR environment.
works.exercise_zh: 用两部手机从不同角度拍同一人的深度数据（或用 Polycam 分别扫描），在 CloudCompare 或 three.js 中通过共同标记点手动对齐合并；变体：比较只用一个视角与两个视角时，观众感受到的“在场感”有何不同。
works.description_zh: 三台经过标定的 Kinect 对人进行完整的三维捕捉，并与虚拟环境融合，实现沉浸式远程协作。
works.idea_en: Three Kinects combine into a full 3D person placed in a virtual space for remote collaboration.
works.technique_zh: 对三台 Kinect 做外参标定，统一到同一坐标系（例如借助共享的标定板），把各自的点云合并成一个三维表示，在 VR 环境中渲染。
works.exercise_en: Capture depth data of the same person from two angles with two phones (or scan separately with Polycam), then align and merge them by hand in CloudCompare or three.js using shared reference points. Twist: compare how much "presence" viewers feel with one viewpoint versus two.

works.title: Augmented Hand Series
works.description: Visitors insert a hand into a box and see it transformed in real time on screen: extra or missing fingers, lengthened digits, wobbling knuckles and other uncanny variations.
works.idea_zh: 把手伸进盒子，屏幕里的手多长一根手指、手指变长——实时而诡异的“手的变形”。

video.video_title: Augmented Hand Series (Demonstration, 2014)

works.technique: A Leap Motion (or camera) tracks hand joints, and an image-warping mesh is deformed per joint to add, remove, or stretch fingers on the live hand video.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe Hands 拿到 21 个关键点，在 p5.js 里对手部视频做网格变形，让手指变长或多出一根；变体：设计一只“会自己动”的手，让某根手指在你不动时悄悄乱跑。
works.description_zh: 观众把手伸进一个盒子，屏幕上随即实时显示被改造过的手：多出或少了手指、手指被拉长、指节晃动，还有其他令人不安的变化。
works.idea_en: Put your hand in a box and watch it on screen grow an extra finger or longer fingers, live and uncanny.
works.technique_zh: 用 Leap Motion（或摄像头）追踪手部关节，按关节对图像变形网格进行形变，在实时手部视频中增加、删除或拉长手指。
works.exercise_en: Get the 21 keypoints from MediaPipe Hands and apply mesh warping to the hand video in p5.js to lengthen fingers or add one more. Twist: design a hand that "moves on its own", with one finger quietly wandering off while you hold still.

works.title: Augmented Menu
works.description: A virtual AR waiter with automatic gestures, facial expressions and lip-sync appears at the table to present the daily menu and talk with diners.
works.idea_zh: 一个虚拟服务员出现在餐桌上，为你介绍今日菜单。

video.video_title: Augmented Menu

works.technique: An avatar anchored on a table marker is animated procedurally with gesture, head-look and lip-sync generated from the audio input.
works.exercise_zh: 做一张 AR 菜单卡：扫一下出现一个会说话的 3D 角色介绍菜品（Reality Composer + TTS）；加一个变化：角色会看向离它最近的人。
works.description_zh: 一位虚拟 AR 服务员出现在餐桌上，带着自动生成的手势、面部表情和口型同步，为食客介绍今日菜单并与他们交谈。
works.idea_en: A virtual waiter appears on your table to walk you through today's menu.
works.technique_zh: 锚定在桌面标记上的虚拟角色通过程序化方式生成动画，手势、头部朝向和口型同步都由音频输入驱动。
works.exercise_en: Make an AR menu card that, when scanned, brings up a talking 3D character who introduces the dishes (Reality Composer + TTS). Twist: the character looks at whoever is closest to it.

works.title: Augmented Reality Street Art
works.description: Wheat-pasted street art by Zenka that, seen through an AR app, animates on the wall.
works.idea_zh: 街头贴画在手机里动起来。

video.video_title: Augmented Reality Street Art

works.technique: The printed artwork is registered as an image target, and a video or animation layer is aligned to it so the static piece appears to move.
works.exercise_zh: 用 8th Wall 或 Lens Studio 把一张自己的海报设为图像目标，扫描后播放它的动画版本；变体：动画只在有人站在海报前时继续。
works.description_zh: Zenka 用浆糊张贴的街头艺术作品，透过 AR 应用观看时会在墙上动起来。
works.idea_en: Street paste-ups start moving inside your phone.
works.technique_zh: 把印刷好的作品注册为图像目标，再将视频或动画图层与之对齐，让静态作品看起来在动。
works.exercise_en: Set one of your own posters as an image target in 8th Wall or Lens Studio, so scanning it plays an animated version. Twist: the animation only keeps going while someone stands in front of the poster.

works.title: FUJI
works.description: A 14-minute installation where projection over a large drawing of Mount Fuji creates shifting light, weather and geometric illusions.
works.idea_zh: 投影在富士山素描上营造光影与天气

video.video_title: FUJI (不死)

works.technique: Projection over a large pencil drawing uses precisely registered light to add clouds, sunrise and geometric overlays, with the drawing serving as a static luminance base.
works.exercise_zh: 画一幅简单的铅笔风景，在投影中模拟一天中光线、云影和天气的变化；变体：让天气变化由当天真实的天气 API 数据驱动。
works.description_zh: 一件时长 14 分钟的装置，投影覆盖在一幅巨大的富士山素描上，营造出变幻的光影、天气和几何错觉。
works.idea_en: Projection brings light and weather to a pencil drawing of Mount Fuji.
works.technique_zh: 在一幅大尺寸铅笔画上投影，用精确对位的光添加云层、日出和几何叠加效果，画作本身则作为静态的亮度底图。
works.exercise_en: Draw a simple pencil landscape and use projection to simulate how light, cloud shadows and weather change over a day. Twist: drive the weather changes with real data from that day's weather API.

works.title: Fisheye Vision
works.description: A modified Oculus Rift with a fisheye camera gives the wearer about 180 degrees of vision while keeping the center undistorted, plus a 'Matrix mode' that shows the world in green code.
works.description_zh: 改装的 Oculus Rift 配上鱼眼摄像头，让佩戴者拥有约 180 度的视野，同时中央区域不变形；还有一个把世界显示成绿色代码的“Matrix 模式”。
works.idea_en: Give people a wider-than-human field of view and let them keep a normal center.
works.idea_zh: 给人超过人类极限的视野，同时保留正常的中央视觉。
works.technique: Warps a fisheye video feed so the central region keeps natural magnification while the periphery is compressed into the display edges of a video see-through Rift.
works.technique_zh: 对鱼眼视频做变形：中央区域保持自然放大率，周边被压缩到视频透视 Rift 的显示边缘。
works.exercise_en: Clip a cheap fisheye lens onto a phone in a cardboard viewer and play catch or navigate a hallway for five minutes. Twist: compress only the left and right edges and test whether people notice someone approaching from the side sooner.
works.exercise_zh: 把廉价鱼眼镜头夹在放进纸盒眼镜的手机上，玩五分钟接球或走走廊；变体：只压缩左右边缘，测试大家能否更早发现从侧面走来的人。

video.video_title: UIST Fisheye Vision ARrift (Augmented Reality Oculus Rift)

works.title: FlyAR
works.description: A drone operator plans and watches a flight path on a tablet held up to the sky: planned waypoints and the live drone position appear directly over the real landscape and buildings.
works.description_zh: 无人机操作员把平板举向天空规划和监控航线：计划的航点和无人机的实时位置直接叠加在真实的地形和建筑上。
works.idea_en: Plan where a drone will fly by drawing in the actual sky, not on a 2D map.
works.idea_zh: 在真实的天空中画出无人机的航线，而不是在二维地图上。
works.technique: Registers the planned flight path and live telemetry of a micro aerial vehicle to the environment using GPS/INS plus a 3D model, rendered with depth cues on a handheld AR device.
works.technique_zh: 借助 GPS/惯导和三维模型，把微型飞行器的计划航线和实时遥测配准到环境中，并在手持 AR 设备上以深度线索渲染。
works.exercise_en: Use a phone AR app to place a chain of floating waypoints around the schoolyard, then have a classmate walk the path as the 'drone' while you check for collisions. Twist: add a no-fly zone that turns red when crossed.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机 AR 在校园里放一串悬浮航点，让同学扮演“无人机”沿路线行走，你来检查是否会撞上东西；变体：加一个禁飞区，被穿越时变红。

video.video_title: FlyAR: Augmented Reality Supported Micro Aerial Vehicle Navigation

works.title: Foresta Lumina
works.description: An illuminated night walk through a forest in Coaticook, Quebec, with projection, light and sound that tell a story along the trail.
works.idea_zh: 夜晚森林步道上的光影叙事

video.video_title: Foresta Lumina | An Enchanted Night Walk From Park to Illuminated Forest

works.technique: A network of projectors, lights and speakers distributed along a trail is triggered in sequence (likely show control with sensors), so a narrative unfolds as visitors walk.
works.exercise_zh: 在校园一段夜间小路上设置三个“光影节点”（手机投影、灯带、蓝牙音箱），串成一个完整的小故事；变体：让某个节点只有在观众安静时才触发。
works.description_zh: 在魁北克科阿蒂库克（Coaticook）的一片森林里，一段被点亮的夜游步道，投影、灯光和声音沿途讲述一个故事。
works.idea_en: A story told in light along a forest trail at night.
