works.technique_zh: 沿步道分布的投影仪、灯光和扬声器网络依次触发（大概率借助传感器和演出控制系统），故事随观众的脚步逐步展开。
works.exercise_en: Set up three "light nodes" (a phone projector, an LED strip, a Bluetooth speaker) along a campus path at night and link them into one complete short story. Twist: one node only triggers when the audience is quiet.

works.title: Hedgehog Labeling
works.description: Markus Tatzgern, Denis Kalkofen, Raphael Grasset and Dieter Schmalstieg arrange external AR labels in 3D like hedgehog spines so they stay readable and stable as you move.
works.idea_zh: 让AR标签像刺猬的刺一样在3D中排布，移动视角也不打架。

video.video_title: Hedgehog labeling: View management techniques for external labels in 3D space

works.technique: Labels are placed along 3D poles radiating from their anchors and their positions are optimized in 3D space (not per frame in screen space), which reduces overlap and avoids label jumping as the viewpoint changes.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中为一个物体（如自行车模型）的 10 个部件加标签，分别实现“屏幕空间避让”和“固定 3D 刺猬式放射”两种布局，绕物体走一圈比较稳定性；变体：让标签数量随用户距离自动增减。
works.description_zh: Markus Tatzgern、Denis Kalkofen、Raphael Grasset 和 Dieter Schmalstieg 把外部 AR 标签在三维空间中像刺猬的刺一样排布，让人在移动时标签依然清晰易读、位置稳定。
works.idea_en: Arrange AR labels in 3D like hedgehog spines so they don't collide when you change viewpoint.
works.technique_zh: 标签沿着从锚点向外放射的三维支杆放置，并在三维空间中（而不是逐帧在屏幕空间中）优化其位置，从而减少重叠，避免视角变化时标签跳动。
works.exercise_en: Label 10 parts of an object (such as a bicycle model) in AR, implement both a "screen-space avoidance" layout and a "fixed 3D hedgehog" radial layout, and walk around the object to compare their stability. Twist: make the number of labels grow or shrink with the user's distance.

works.title: JackIn Eye
works.description: A remote viewer 'jacks into' a walking person's head-mounted camera; the system stitches past frames into an out-of-body third-person view so the viewer can look around beyond the wearer's gaze.
works.idea_zh: 远程的人“钻进”别人的第一人称视角，还能跳出身体从背后看他。

video.video_title: JackIn: Integrating First-Person View with Out-of-Body Vision Generation for Human-Human Augmentation (AH2014)

works.technique: Uses SLAM on the first-person video to register frames into a growing 3D panorama, then renders a virtual camera placed behind and above the wearer.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机直播一个同学的第一人称视角给另一位戴Cardboard的同学看，由观看者口头指挥他完成找物任务；变化：观看者只能看到5秒前的延迟画面。
works.description_zh: 远程观众“接入”一位行走者的头戴摄像头；系统把过去的画面拼接成一个“灵魂出窍”式的第三人称视角，让观众能看到佩戴者视线之外的四周。
works.idea_en: A remote person slips into someone's first-person view and can even step out of the body to watch from behind.
works.technique_zh: 对第一人称视频做 SLAM，把各帧配准进一幅不断扩展的三维全景，再从放在佩戴者后上方的虚拟相机进行渲染。
works.exercise_en: Livestream one classmate's first-person view from a phone to another classmate wearing Cardboard, who gives spoken directions to complete a find-the-object task. Twist: the viewer can only see a feed delayed by 5 seconds.

works.title: Light Barrier
works.description: Projected light is reflected by 200 curved mirrors into haze, forming floating volumetric shapes that seem to exist in mid-air.
works.idea_zh: 镜面阵列把投影光折射进雾中，形成悬浮光体

video.video_title: LIGHT BARRIER by Kimchi & Chips

works.technique: Structured-light scanning calibrates each projector pixel's ray after reflection by convex mirrors, and those rays are rendered as volumetric beams that intersect in haze to draw 3D shapes.
works.exercise_zh: 在烟雾机或加湿器的雾里打一台投影，用黑底白线图形做出光束扫过的“光膜”，编一段 1 分钟的光雕动画；变体：光束形状由现场音乐的频谱决定。
works.description_zh: 投影光经 200 面曲面镜反射进雾气之中，形成仿佛悬浮在半空的体积光形。
works.idea_en: A mirror array bends projected light into haze to form floating shapes of light.
works.technique_zh: 用结构光扫描标定每个投影像素经凸面镜反射后的光线路径，再把这些光线渲染成体积光束，在雾中交汇，勾勒出三维形体。
works.exercise_en: Shine a projector into the mist from a fog machine or humidifier, use white-line-on-black graphics to create sweeping "light sheets", and compose a one-minute light sculpture animation. Twist: let the spectrum of live music determine the shape of the beams.

works.title: MIRAGE
works.description: An architecture-scale painted mural in LA's Fashion District that becomes an interactive animated artwork when viewed through a companion AR app.
works.idea_zh: 一面巨型壁画只有透过手机才会“动起来”
works.technique: Image-recognition AR (developed with The Heavy Projects) tracks the painted façade and overlays animated layers aligned to the mural.
works.exercise_zh: 在大白纸上画一幅壁画，用图像识别AR给其中几个元素加动画；变化：同一壁画在白天和夜晚显示不同的AR层。

video.video_title: MIRAGE : RSH

works.description_zh: 洛杉矶时装区的一幅建筑尺度手绘壁画，透过配套的 AR 应用观看时，就会变成一件互动的动画作品。
works.idea_en: A giant mural only comes alive when you look through your phone.
works.technique_zh: 基于图像识别的 AR（与 The Heavy Projects 合作开发）追踪绘有壁画的外墙，叠加与壁画对齐的动画图层。
works.exercise_en: Paint a mural on a large sheet of white paper and use image-recognition AR to animate several of its elements. Twist: show different AR layers on the same mural by day and by night.

works.title: Magic Carpets
works.description: Generative carpets of light are projected across the floor of a historic courtyard; patterns ripple and reorganise wherever visitors walk.
works.idea_zh: 让古建筑地面变成一块会随脚步变化的魔毯
works.technique: Overhead cameras track visitors (Voxels tracking software) and generative pattern software reacts locally to their positions on the floor projection.
works.exercise_zh: 在地面投一块几何图案“地毯”，俯拍摄像头检测脚步位置产生涟漪；变化：两个人之间的连线会生成新的图案花纹。

video.video_title: Miguel CHEVALIER Magic Carpets 2014, Castel del Monte, Italy

works.description_zh: 生成式的光之地毯投射在一座历史庭院的地面上，观众走到哪里，图案就在哪里泛起涟漪、重新组合。
works.idea_en: Turn the floor of an old building into a magic carpet that changes with every step.
works.technique_zh: 俯视摄像头（配合 Voxels 追踪软件）追踪观众，生成式图案软件根据他们在地面投影上的位置作出局部响应。
works.exercise_en: Project a geometric-pattern "carpet" onto the floor and use an overhead camera to detect footsteps and spawn ripples. Twist: the line between two people generates new pattern motifs.

works.title: Mano-a-Mano (Dyadic Projected SAR)
works.description: Two people face each other in a projected room and each sees correct perspective 3D objects between them: throwing fireballs, passing a ball, playing catch with virtual objects.
works.idea_zh: 两个人面对面，都能在投影出的立体空间里看到对的透视，互相扔火球。

video.video_title: Dyadic Projected Spatial Augmented Reality

works.technique: Kinect tracks both users' heads, and each projected object is rendered with view-dependent perspective for one user so that, on the surfaces behind the opposite person, it appears to float in 3D between them.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe Face 追踪一位同学的头部位置，在投影墙上按其视角渲染一个“悬浮在空中”的球，另一人用手势把球“扔”过去；变体：两人轮流获得正确视角，讨论第三个旁观者看到了什么。
works.description_zh: 两个人在投影房间中面对面，各自都能看到两人之间透视正确的三维物体：互扔火球、传球，或者用虚拟物体玩接抛游戏。
works.idea_en: Two people face each other, both see correct 3D perspective in the projected space, and throw fireballs at each other.
works.technique_zh: Kinect 追踪两位用户的头部，每个投影物体都按其中一位用户的视角进行视点相关渲染，于是投在对方身后表面上的物体，看起来就像悬浮在两人之间的三维空间里。
works.exercise_en: Use MediaPipe Face to track one classmate's head position and render a ball "floating in mid-air" on the projection wall from their viewpoint, while another person "throws" it over with a gesture. Twist: the two take turns getting the correct viewpoint, then discuss what a third bystander saw.

works.title: Modern Polaxis
works.description: A printed comic about a paranoid time-traveller; pointing a phone at each page brings panels to life with animation, sound and 3D depth.
works.idea_zh: 用手机扫描实体漫画，每一页都活了起来

video.video_title: Modern Polaxis Augmented Reality Comic - Trailer

works.technique: Vuforia image targets recognise each printed comic page, and Unity renders animated layers, 3D depth and sound anchored to the page.
works.exercise_zh: 画一页四格漫画并打印，用 MindAR 或 AR Foundation 图像追踪让其中一格动起来并加声音；变体：让 AR 层讲述与纸面相矛盾的“真相”。
works.description_zh: 一本讲述偏执时间旅行者的实体漫画；用手机对准每一页，画格就会动起来，还带有声音和三维纵深。
works.idea_en: Scan a printed comic with your phone and every page comes to life.
works.technique_zh: 用 Vuforia 图像目标识别每一页印刷漫画，由 Unity 渲染锚定在页面上的动画图层、三维纵深和声音。
works.exercise_en: Draw and print a four-panel comic, then use MindAR or AR Foundation image tracking to animate one panel and add sound. Twist: have the AR layer tell a "truth" that contradicts the page.

works.title: Nail Art Museum
works.description: An AR 'museum' that places tiny artworks and gallery spaces on the artist's fingernails, parodying the art market.
works.idea_zh: 把美术馆缩小搬到指甲上

video.video_title: Nail Art Museum (2014)

works.technique: Small printed markers on the fingernails are tracked by the camera, and miniature gallery models are rendered on each nail's pose.
works.exercise_zh: 在指甲或指尖贴小图像标记（或用 MediaPipe Hands 指尖位置），在上面放一个迷你美术馆和作品；变体：给这座美术馆写一段夸张的开幕致辞并录成视频。
works.description_zh: 一座 AR“美术馆”，把微型艺术品和展厅空间放在艺术家的指甲上，以此戏仿艺术市场。
works.idea_en: Shrink a museum and move it onto your fingernails.
works.technique_zh: 摄像头追踪贴在指甲上的小型印刷标记，在每片指甲的位姿上渲染迷你展厅模型。
works.exercise_en: Stick small image markers on your nails or fingertips (or use fingertip positions from MediaPipe Hands) and place a mini museum with artworks on them. Twist: write an over-the-top opening speech for this museum and record it as a video.

works.title: OMOTE
works.description: Real-time face tracking and projection mapping paint shifting digital makeup, cracks and masks onto a model's moving face.
works.idea_zh: 把人脸变成实时追踪的投影画布，数字妆容随表情移动

video.video_title: OMOTE / REAL-TIME FACE TRACKING & PROJECTION MAPPING

works.technique: Face tracking with markers or landmarks drives a 3D face mesh whose texture is projected by a calibrated projector, with latency kept low so makeup stays registered to the moving face.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe Face Mesh 生成人脸网格，把一种“数字妆容”投影到白色面具或同学脸上（先用静止面具校准）；变体：让妆容随表情变化，比如张嘴时出现裂纹。
works.description_zh: 实时面部追踪与投影映射在模特活动的脸上绘出不断变化的数字妆容、裂纹和面具。
works.idea_en: Turn a face into a tracked projection canvas where digital makeup moves with every expression.
works.technique_zh: 借助标记点或面部特征点进行面部追踪，驱动三维人脸网格，其纹理由经过标定的投影仪投出；系统将延迟压到很低，使妆容始终贴合运动中的脸。
works.exercise_en: Generate a face mesh with MediaPipe Face Mesh and project a "digital makeup" onto a white mask or a classmate's face (calibrate on a still mask first). Twist: make the makeup change with expression, for example cracks appear when the mouth opens.

works.title: Physical Telepresence
works.description: Remote participants' hands and objects are captured in 3D and rendered physically on a shape display, so someone far away can push and manipulate objects on your table.
works.idea_zh: 远程协作时，对方的手以实体形状出现在你桌上，能真的拨动物体。

video.video_title: Physical Telepresence

works.technique: A Kinect depth stream of the remote space is converted to a height map that drives the local shape display in real time, so remote hands physically push objects on the pins.
works.exercise_zh: 用两台电脑的摄像头 + MediaPipe Hands 实现远程“推”：A 端的手部位置控制 B 端投影在桌上的虚拟推板，推动 B 端桌面上被识别的纸片方块（或虚拟物体）；变体：只传递手的“影子”，讨论匿名的远程触碰是什么感觉。
works.description_zh: 远程参与者的手和物体被三维捕捉，并在形状显示器上以实体形式再现，让远方的人也能推动、摆弄你桌上的物体。
works.idea_en: In remote collaboration, the other person's hands appear as physical shapes on your table and can actually push things.
works.technique_zh: 把远端空间的 Kinect 深度流转换为高度图，实时驱动本地的形状显示器，让远程的手通过针脚真实地推动物体。
works.exercise_en: Build a remote "push" with two computers' cameras and MediaPipe Hands: the hand position on side A controls a virtual pusher projected on side B's table, which shoves detected paper squares (or virtual objects) there. Twist: transmit only the hand's "shadow", and discuss what anonymous remote touch feels like.

works.title: Pixel (with Mourad Merzouki / Compagnie Käfig)
works.description: Eleven hip-hop and circus dancers perform with projected points of light on the floor and backdrop that move, ripple and cascade with their bodies.
works.idea_zh: 街舞舞者与地面上的“光点像素”一起舞动
works.technique: Floor and back projections of particle fields are generated live with eMotion and synchronised with the choreography by a digital performer.
works.exercise_zh: 在地面投影一片光点，让同学跳街舞，光点随脚步涟漪扩散；变化：光点形成一条只有两人配合才能通过的“河”。

video.video_title: PIXEL | Création 2014 | Compagnie Käfig

works.description_zh: 十一位街舞与马戏舞者在地面和背景幕上的投影光点中表演，光点随着他们的身体移动、泛起涟漪、倾泻而下。
works.idea_en: Hip-hop dancers move together with pixels of light on the floor.
works.technique_zh: 地面投影和背景投影中的粒子场由 eMotion 实时生成，并由一位数字表演者现场操控，与编舞同步。
works.exercise_en: Project a field of light dots on the floor and have classmates breakdance while the dots ripple outward from their steps. Twist: make the dots form a "river" that can only be crossed when two people work together.

works.title: PolyFauna
works.description: A free app in which you look around a dark, evolving landscape of Stanley Donwood's drawings and creatures by moving your phone, follow a red dot, and hear Radiohead's 'Bloom' fragmented into the space.
works.description_zh: 一款免费应用：移动手机就能环顾一片由 Stanley Donwood 的绘画与生物构成、不断演化的黑暗风景，跟随一个红点前进，并听到被拆散到空间中的 Radiohead《Bloom》片段。
works.idea_en: Your phone is a window into a living world built from an album's sketchbook.
works.idea_zh: 手机是一扇窗，通向由专辑草图本长出来的活世界。
works.technique: The phone's gyroscope drives a 360-degree camera in a generative 3D environment, and touch spawns creatures whose shapes evolve over time (built by Universal Everything).
works.technique_zh: 手机陀螺仪驱动生成式 3D 环境中的 360 度相机，触摸会生成随时间演化形态的生物（由 Universal Everything 开发）。
works.exercise_en: Scan ten of your own sketches, turn them into textured 3D shapes and place them in a gyroscope-controlled web scene that people explore by turning their phones. Twist: let each visitor's touch leave a creature that later visitors meet.
works.exercise_zh: 扫描自己的十张草图，把它们变成带纹理的 3D 形体，放进一个由陀螺仪控制的网页场景，让人转动手机来探索；变体：每位访客的触摸会留下一只小生物，后来的访客都能遇见它。

video.video_title: Radiohead Polyfauna

works.title: Qbox: AR Magic Toy
works.description: Put a small toy inside a box and, through an AR interface, it comes to life, interacting with the box, the child and the world around it.
works.idea_zh: 把玩具放进魔法盒，透过屏幕它就活了。

video.video_title: Qbox - AR Magic Toy

works.technique: Marker tracking on the box registers an animated virtual version of the inserted toy on top of the physical one (likely marker/toy recognition).
works.exercise_zh: 做一个贴有识别图的纸盒，放入不同玩具时（换不同卡片）AR 里出现不同动画；加一个变化：摇晃盒子会让角色晕倒。
works.description_zh: 把一个小玩具放进盒子，透过 AR 界面，它就活了过来，能与盒子、孩子以及周围的世界互动。
works.idea_en: Put a toy into a magic box and it comes alive on the screen.
works.technique_zh: 通过追踪盒子上的标记，把放入的玩具对应的动画虚拟版本叠加在实体玩具之上（大概率结合了标记或玩具识别）。
works.exercise_en: Make a cardboard box with a recognition image, so different animations appear in AR when different toys go in (by swapping cards). Twist: shaking the box makes the character faint.

works.title: Queen Victoria
works.description: The statue of Queen Victoria in a Kitchener park takes on the face and hands of seven local residents, including refugees, who tell their life stories through her.
works.description_zh: 基奇纳市公园里的维多利亚女王雕像换上了七位当地居民（包括难民）的脸和手，由“女王”替他们讲述自己的人生故事。
works.idea_en: A colonial monument becomes a microphone for the community living around it.
works.idea_zh: 一座殖民时代的纪念像，变成周围社区居民的扩音器。
works.technique: Two cameras recorded each speaker, one head-mounted for the face and one for the torso, and the merged video was aligned to the statue's face and hands in projection.
works.technique_zh: 每位讲述者由两台摄像机拍摄，一台头戴拍脸，一台拍躯干和手，合成后的视频在投影时对齐到雕像的脸和手上。
works.exercise_en: Choose a local statue or portrait, collect three short voice stories from people who live nearby and map their faces onto a printed or 3D-printed copy. Twist: switch stories when someone steps closer.
works.exercise_zh: 选一座本地雕像或肖像，收集三位附近居民的简短口述，把他们的脸投影到打印或 3D 打印的复制品上；变体：有人走近时就切换到下一个故事。

video.video_title: Krzysztof Wodizcko and Gary Kirkham: Queen Victoria, Lamees #1

works.title: Re+Public AR mural
works.description: Re+Public's AR app animates large street murals: pointing a phone at the wall makes the painted characters and shapes come alive.
works.idea_zh: 对准街头壁画，画中形象立刻动起来

video.video_title: Re+Public Augmented Reality Mural

works.technique: Image tracking recognises each mural as a target and overlays animated layers registered to the painting in the phone's camera view.
works.exercise_zh: 选校园里的一幅壁画或自己画一张海报，用 8th Wall / MindAR 图像追踪让画中元素动起来；变体：让动画只在特定时间段出现，比如只在傍晚“醒来”。
works.description_zh: Re+Public 的 AR 应用让大型街头壁画动起来：用手机对准墙面，画中的角色和形状就会活起来。
works.idea_en: Point at a street mural and the figures in it start to move.
works.technique_zh: 图像追踪把每幅壁画识别为目标，在手机摄像头画面中叠加与画作对齐的动画图层。
works.exercise_en: Pick a mural on campus or paint your own poster, and use 8th Wall or MindAR image tracking to animate elements in it. Twist: the animation only appears at certain times, for example it only "wakes up" at dusk.

works.title: RoomAlive
works.description: Multiple auto-calibrating projector-camera units cover an entire living room so games can happen on every surface: whack-a-mole creatures crawl out of the couch, and you dodge traps with your body.
works.idea_zh: 整个客厅每一面墙、每件家具都成了游戏场，怪物从沙发里爬出来。

video.video_title: RoomAlive: Magical Experiences Enabled by Scalable, Adaptive Projector-Camera Units

works.technique: Each projector-camera unit auto-calibrates by projecting Gray-code structured light that its Kinect observes, yielding a unified 3D room model onto which games are rendered with per-surface projection mapping and depth-based body tracking.
works.exercise_zh: 用一台投影仪 + 摄像头做 Gray code 结构光标定（或手动四角映射），把房间一角变成打地鼠游戏：小怪物从沙发边缘钻出，用 MediaPipe 检测手拍到它的位置；变体：让怪物躲避你而不是等你打。
works.description_zh: 多台可自动标定的投影仪-相机单元覆盖整个客厅，让游戏可以发生在每一个表面上：打地鼠式的小怪物从沙发里爬出来，你还得用身体躲避陷阱。
works.idea_en: Every wall and piece of furniture in the living room becomes a game board, with monsters crawling out of the couch.
works.technique_zh: 每个投影仪-相机单元投射格雷码（Gray code）结构光并由 Kinect 观测，从而完成自动标定，得到统一的房间三维模型；游戏通过逐表面投影映射渲染到房间里，并用基于深度的身体追踪进行交互。
works.exercise_en: Calibrate a projector and camera with Gray-code structured light (or manual four-corner mapping) and turn a corner of the room into whack-a-mole: little monsters pop out from the edge of the couch, and MediaPipe detects where your hand slaps them. Twist: make the monsters dodge you instead of waiting to be hit.

works.title: RoomAlive: The Other Resident
works.description: A spooky narrative game built with the RoomAlive projection system, where a ghostly presence haunts the real room around the player.
works.idea_zh: 用房间级投影在自家客厅里上演一出闹鬼剧。

video.video_title: RoomAlive: The Other Resident

works.technique: Built on the RoomAlive Toolkit's calibrated projector-camera units, the game uses the scanned room model to place projected effects (shadows, apparitions, stains) on specific furniture, triggered by the player's tracked position.
works.exercise_zh: 用一台投影仪在宿舍或教室角落做一段 3 分钟的恐怖叙事：摄像头检测观众走到某个位置时，墙上出现影子、门框渗出污迹；变体：让“幽灵”只在观众背对它时移动。
works.description_zh: 一款基于 RoomAlive 投影系统制作的惊悚叙事游戏，一个幽灵般的存在在玩家身处的真实房间里作祟。
works.idea_en: Use room-scale projection to stage a haunting in your own living room.
works.technique_zh: 游戏基于 RoomAlive Toolkit 中经过标定的投影仪-相机单元，利用扫描得到的房间模型把投影效果（阴影、幽灵、污渍）放在特定家具上，并由玩家被追踪的位置触发。
works.exercise_en: Use one projector to create a 3-minute horror story in a corner of a dorm or classroom: when a camera detects the viewer reaching a certain spot, a shadow appears on the wall and a stain seeps from the door frame. Twist: the "ghost" only moves when the viewer has their back to it.

works.title: SOLANUM (Augmented Sculpture)
works.description: A site-specific augmented sculpture in the JW Marriott Houston lounge: layered physical forms and a custom-fit virtual skin melt together into one evolving object.
works.idea_zh: 实体层叠雕塑和贴合的虚拟外衣融为一体
works.technique: Layered physical slices are fabricated from the same 3D design as the projection content, enabling pixel-accurate mapping on every layer edge.
works.exercise_zh: 用多层泡沫板叠出一个形体，投影随层级变化的颜色扫描线；变化：让扫描线的速度由现场人数（摄像头计数）决定。

video.video_title: SOLANUM ǀ Augmented Sculpture

works.description_zh: 为休斯敦 JW Marriott 酒店大堂酒廊创作的一件场域特定增强雕塑：层层叠叠的实体形态与量身贴合的虚拟外皮融为一体，成为一个不断演变的物体。
works.idea_en: A layered physical sculpture and a close-fitting virtual skin merge into one.
works.technique_zh: 层叠的实体切片与投影内容出自同一个三维设计，从而能在每一层的边缘实现像素级精准的映射。
works.exercise_en: Stack several layers of foam board into a form and project scan lines whose color changes from layer to layer. Twist: let the number of people present (counted by a camera) set the speed of the scan lines.

works.title: Seamless MR (hanacam test)
works.description: A test of seamless mixed-reality video where a tracked camera composites CG into a live scene in real time.
works.idea_zh: 追踪摄像机把CG无缝合成进实景的MR实验

video.video_title: Seamless MR a.k.a. hanacam test -01

works.technique: A tracked camera (encoder or optical tracking) supplies real-time pose to a render engine whose virtual camera matches it, so CG is keyed and composited into the live feed without drift.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机 ARKit 位姿作为虚拟摄像机，在 Unity 中把一个 CG 物体合成到实景视频里，并对比加与不加阴影、遮挡的真实感差异；变体：让 CG 物体只在画面边缘“偷看”，制造若隐若现的存在感。
works.description_zh: 一次无缝混合现实影像测试：被追踪的摄像机把 CG 实时合成进实景画面。
works.idea_en: An MR test where a tracked camera blends CG seamlessly into a live scene.
works.technique_zh: 被追踪的摄像机（通过编码器或光学追踪）向渲染引擎实时提供位姿，引擎中的虚拟摄像机与之同步，使 CG 能无漂移地抠像并合成进实时画面。
works.exercise_en: Use the phone's ARKit pose as a virtual camera in Unity to composite a CG object into live-action video, and compare how real it looks with and without shadows and occlusion. Twist: have the CG object only "peek" in from the edge of the frame, creating a presence that is there one moment and gone the next.

works.title: Sketch Town
works.description: Hand-drawn cars, buildings and UFOs are scanned into a shared 3D projected town where they drive and fly, and can be touched.
works.idea_zh: 手绘的车与房子进入共享的投影城市

video.video_title: Sketch Town / FUTURE WORLD: WHERE ART MEETS SCIENCE

works.technique: Scanned template drawings are UV-mapped onto 3D vehicle and building models and inserted into a shared projected city, with sensors detecting touch on the projection.
works.exercise_zh: 让同学在模板上画房子和车辆，扫描后贴图到简单模型上并放进投影城市；变体：规定每件作品都必须和别人的作品发生一次互动（碰撞、接送、连接）。
works.description_zh: 手绘的汽车、房屋和 UFO 被扫描进一座共享的三维投影小镇，在那里行驶、飞翔，还能被触摸。
works.idea_en: Hand-drawn cars and houses move into a shared projected city.
works.technique_zh: 扫描后的模板画作通过 UV 映射贴到三维车辆和建筑模型上，放入共享的投影城市中，传感器负责检测对投影的触摸。
works.exercise_en: Have classmates draw houses and vehicles on templates, then scan them, texture them onto simple models and put them into a projected city. Twist: every piece must interact with someone else's piece at least once (collide, pick up, connect).

works.title: TRANSFORM
works.description: Three large shape displays form dynamic furniture shown at Milan Design Week: the surface flows like water, reacts to bodies and carries objects around.
works.idea_zh: 一张会像海浪一样起伏、能自己搬运物品的'活'桌子。

video.video_title: TRANSFORM: Nature and Machine by MIT Media Lab | Tangible Media Group

works.technique: Three shape displays run choreographed height-map animations and physics-style wave simulations, with Kinect tracking of visitors' bodies modulating the motion.
works.exercise_zh: 在 TouchDesigner 或 three.js 中做一张由上百根柱子组成的“流体桌面”，用摄像头检测人的位置让波纹从人身边荡开，投影到真实桌面上；变体：让桌面把一个虚拟物体“运送”到站在桌边的某个人面前。
works.description_zh: 在米兰设计周展出的动态家具，由三块大型形状显示器组成：表面像水一样流动，会对人的身体作出反应，还能把物品搬来搬去。
works.idea_en: A living table that heaves like ocean waves and carries objects around by itself.
works.technique_zh: 三块形状显示器运行编排好的高度图动画和物理风格的波浪模拟，并通过 Kinect 追踪观众身体来调制运动。
works.exercise_en: Build a "fluid tabletop" of hundreds of pillars in TouchDesigner or three.js, use a camera to detect people so ripples spread from wherever they stand, and project it onto a real table. Twist: have the table "deliver" a virtual object to one particular person standing beside it.

works.title: The Numberlys IMAG-N-O-TRON
works.description: A companion app for the printed picture book The Numberlys: pointing an iPad at the pages makes the art-deco number characters and the letters they invent spring off the paper as animated 3D scenes with sound.
works.description_zh: 印刷绘本 The Numberlys 的配套应用：把 iPad 对准书页，装饰艺术风格的数字角色和它们发明的字母就从纸上跃出，变成带声音的 3D 动画场景。
works.idea_en: The printed book stays the main object; the tablet is a lens that animates what is already on the page.
works.idea_zh: 纸书始终是主角，平板只是一片让书页内容动起来的镜片。
works.technique: Likely natural-feature image tracking of each illustrated spread, with pre-authored 3D animation anchored to the page.
works.technique_zh: 很可能是对每一跨页插图做自然特征图像追踪，再把预先制作的 3D 动画锚定到书页上。
works.exercise_en: Pick a favorite children's book page, scan it as an image target, and animate one character stepping out of the illustration with a sound effect. Twist: the character should only appear when a second reader covers a specific word with a finger.
works.exercise_zh: 挑一页喜欢的儿童绘本，把它设为图像标记，让其中一个角色伴随音效从插画里走出来。变体：只有当另一位读者用手指盖住某个特定单词时，角色才会出现。

video.video_title: THE NUMBERLYS IMAG•N•O•TRON™

works.title: Thermal Touch
works.description: A prototype for smart glasses in which any surface, such as a poster, wall or car, becomes a touchscreen: an infrared camera sees the warm spot a finger leaves and triggers the AR content there.
works.description_zh: 一个为智能眼镜设计的原型：海报、墙面或汽车等任何表面都能变成触摸屏——红外摄像头看到手指留下的余温点，就在那里触发 AR 内容。
works.idea_en: The heat your fingertip leaves behind is the click.
works.idea_zh: 指尖留下的余温，就是一次点击。
works.technique: A thermal camera and a standard camera are calibrated together; residual heat from a touch is detected in the infrared image and mapped onto the tracked surface's AR coordinates.
works.technique_zh: 把热成像摄像头与普通摄像头联合标定；从红外图像中检测触摸后残留的热量，再映射到被追踪表面的 AR 坐标上。
works.exercise_en: Fake Thermal Touch with a normal camera: track a printed poster, detect a finger dwell on it via hand tracking, and leave a slowly fading glow at each touch point. Twist: make the glow fade at a rate based on how long the finger stayed.
works.exercise_zh: 用普通摄像头模拟 Thermal Touch：追踪一张打印海报，通过手部追踪检测手指在上面的停留，并在每个触点留下慢慢消退的光晕。变体：让光晕的消退速度取决于手指停留的时长。

video.video_title: Thermal Touch from Metaio  - A New Augmented Reality Interface for Wearables

works.title: Towards AR User Interfaces in 3D Media Production
works.description: A 3D artist models and animates with virtual objects floating over the real desk, using hand gestures in a headset instead of mouse and keyboard.
works.description_zh: 三维艺术家在头显中用手势对漂浮在真实桌面上方的虚拟物体进行建模和动画制作，而不是用鼠标和键盘。
works.idea_en: Bring professional 3D modelling off the monitor and into the space above your desk.
works.idea_zh: 把专业三维建模从显示器上搬到桌面上方的空间里。
works.technique: Likely combines a stereo HMD with 3D hand tracking to map familiar content-creation commands onto direct spatial manipulation.
works.technique_zh: 很可能把立体头显与三维手部追踪结合，把熟悉的内容创作命令映射为直接的空间操作。
works.exercise_en: Use a phone AR sculpting or drawing app to model a simple object above your desk, then time the same task in a desktop 3D tool. Twist: work in pairs where one person only moves the camera.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机 AR 雕刻或绘画 App 在桌面上方建一个简单模型，再用桌面三维软件完成同样任务并计时对比；变体：两人合作，其中一人只负责移动相机。

video.video_title: ISMAR 2014Demo Video:"Towards Augmented Reality user interfaces in 3D media production"

works.title: Visions of America: Amériques
works.description: Inside Walt Disney Concert Hall, projections explode across the hall in response to the gestures and body language of conductor Esa-Pekka Salonen performing Varèse's Amériques.
works.idea_zh: 让指挥家的手势实时“指挥”整座音乐厅的投影
works.technique: A depth camera (Kinect) tracks the conductor's gestures and maps them to real-time generative visuals projected onto the hall's interior surfaces.
works.exercise_zh: 用MediaPipe Pose追踪一位同学“指挥”的手臂动作，控制投影粒子的爆发和方向；变化：让全班演奏简单节奏，指挥手势决定哪一组的画面亮起。

video.video_title: Projecting a new immersive experience inside L.A.'s Disney Hall

works.description_zh: 在华特·迪士尼音乐厅内，指挥家 Esa-Pekka Salonen 演绎瓦雷兹（Varèse）的《美洲》（Amériques）时，投影随着他的手势和肢体语言在整个音乐厅中迸发。
works.idea_en: Let a conductor's gestures conduct the projections across an entire concert hall in real time.
works.technique_zh: 深度相机（Kinect）追踪指挥的手势，并将其映射为实时生成的视觉影像，投射到音乐厅的内部表面上。
works.exercise_en: Use MediaPipe Pose to track a classmate's "conducting" arm movements and control the bursts and direction of projected particles. Twist: have the class play a simple rhythm, with the conductor's gestures deciding which group's visuals light up.

works.title: fly (dance with drones)
works.description: Dancers perform a duet with small drones that fly precise trajectories around their bodies, as if the objects were partners.
works.idea_zh: 让无人机成为舞伴，与舞者同步飞行
works.technique: Motion-capture tracking positions both dancers and drones in 3D space, and pre-programmed flight paths are synchronised to the choreography and music.
works.exercise_zh: 用一台小型可编程无人机（如Tello）或遥控小车，编好与音乐同步的路径让同学围绕它编舞；变化：让物体的路径由舞者手部的录制轨迹生成。

video.video_title: ELEVENPLAY x RZM "fly"  (dance with drones)

works.description_zh: 舞者与小型无人机合跳双人舞，无人机沿着精确的轨迹绕着他们的身体飞行，仿佛这些物体也是舞伴。
works.idea_en: Make drones dance partners that fly in sync with the dancers.
works.technique_zh: 动作捕捉在三维空间中同时定位舞者和无人机，预先编好的飞行路径与编舞和音乐保持同步。
works.exercise_en: Program a small drone (such as a Tello) or a remote-control car to follow a path synced to music, and have classmates choreograph around it. Twist: generate the object's path from a recorded trajectory of a dancer's hand.

works.title: iMapp Bucharest 555
works.description: The vast Palace of the Parliament in Bucharest is mapped for the city's 555th anniversary, with the façade dissolving into particles, mechanisms and flying fragments at enormous scale.
works.description_zh: 为庆祝布加勒斯特建城 555 周年，巨大的议会宫整面被投影覆盖，立面在超大尺度上溶解成粒子、机械和飞散的碎片。
works.idea_en: At building scale, a single illusion can make thousands of people feel the ground move.
works.idea_zh: 在建筑尺度上，一个错觉就能让成千上万人觉得脚下的地面在动。
works.technique: A large array of projectors covers one of the world's biggest façades, with content rendered to a 3D scan of the building (third-party footage of the show).
works.technique_zh: 大量投影机阵列覆盖这座世界上最大的建筑立面之一，内容依据建筑三维扫描渲染（视频为观众拍摄的现场记录）。
works.exercise_en: Design a mapping storyboard for the largest wall you can find, then prototype it at 1:100 on a printed photo with a pico projector. Twist: design one moment that only works from a single viewing spot.
works.exercise_zh: 为你能找到的最大一面墙设计投影分镜，再用微型投影仪在 1:100 的打印照片上做原型；变体：设计一个只有站在某个特定位置才能看懂的瞬间。

video.video_title: Bucuresti 555 ani - The Macula Czech Republic

works.title: 1000 Hands
works.description: Visitors contribute line drawings through a mobile app; each drawing is grown into a 3D form that joins a collective, evolving projected landscape in the gallery.
works.idea_zh: 上千名观众的手绘被生长成立体形态，汇入共同的投影风景

video.video_title: 1000 Hands interactive

works.technique: Line drawings from a mobile app are sent to a server, converted into procedurally extruded or grown 3D geometry, and added to a shared real-time scene that is projected in the gallery.
works.exercise_zh: 用网页表单收集全班的手绘线条，在 three.js 中把每条线挤出成会慢慢生长的 3D 形体并放进同一片投影风景；变体：让每个形体的生长方向由绘制者当时的心情选项决定。
works.description_zh: 观众通过手机应用提交线条画，每幅画都会生长成一个三维形体，汇入展厅中一片共同的、不断演变的投影风景。
works.idea_en: Drawings by a thousand visitors grow into 3D forms and join one shared projected landscape.
works.technique_zh: 手机应用中的线条画被发送到服务器，转换成程序化挤出或生长的三维几何体，并加入一个共享的实时场景，在展厅中投影出来。
works.exercise_en: Collect the whole class's hand-drawn lines with a web form, extrude each line in three.js into a slowly growing 3D form, and place them all in one projected landscape. Twist: let each form's growth direction depend on the mood option its drawer picked at the time.

works.title: 26th Floor (Augmented Sculpture)
works.description: An 'augmented sculpture' for the Four Seasons Hotel Beirut, where a white faceted object and its projected light skin were designed together.
works.idea_zh: 雕塑与投影一起设计，白色形体被光赋予流动的皮肤
works.technique: A faceted physical sculpture is built from the same digital model used to author the projection, so every face receives perfectly aligned content.
works.exercise_zh: 用白卡纸折一个多面体，在电脑里做同一模型并按面投影不同颜色的流动；变化：让一束“光”在各面之间传递，形成连续动画。

video.video_title: 26th Floor | Augmented Sculpture | INTERN VERSION

works.description_zh: 为贝鲁特四季酒店创作的一件“增强雕塑”，白色多面体与投射其上的光之外皮是一同设计的。
works.idea_en: Sculpture and projection are designed together, giving a white form a flowing skin of light.
works.technique_zh: 多面体实体雕塑与制作投影内容所用的是同一个数字模型，因此每个面都能获得完美对齐的内容。
works.exercise_en: Fold a polyhedron from white card, build the same model on the computer, and project different flowing colors face by face. Twist: pass a beam of "light" from face to face to form a continuous animation.

works.title: 320° Licht
works.description: Inside the 100-metre-high Gasometer Oberhausen, graphic patterns grow and change across 320 degrees of wall, turning the industrial cylinder into an immersive light space.
works.idea_zh: 把巨大的储气罐内壁变成不断变化的光之空间
works.technique: An array of projectors is blended across the cylindrical interior, with generative patterns designed to exploit the surface's extreme height.
works.exercise_zh: 在楼梯间或走廊用投影做纵向延伸的图案，让人仰头观看；变化：图案随观众站立的位置向上“生长”。

video.video_title: 320° LICHT | SPATIAL EXPERIENCE

works.description_zh: 在高达 100 米的奥伯豪森储气罐（Gasometer Oberhausen）内部，图形图案在 320 度的墙面上生长、变化，把这座工业圆筒变成沉浸式的光之空间。
works.idea_en: Turn the inside of a giant gas holder into an ever-changing space of light.
works.technique_zh: 多台投影仪在圆柱形内壁上进行边缘融合，生成式图案专门针对这一表面的超高尺度而设计。
works.exercise_en: Project vertically stretching patterns in a stairwell or corridor so people have to look up. Twist: make the patterns "grow" upward from wherever a viewer is standing.

works.title: AIREAL
works.description: Rajinder Sodhi, Ivan Poupyrev, Matthew Glisson and Ali Israr use a 3D-printed vortex cannon to fire rings of air so you can feel virtual butterflies and balls in free air.
works.idea_zh: 用空气涡环炮让你在空中'摸到'虚拟的蝴蝶和皮球。

video.video_title: AIREAL: Interactive Tactile Experiences in Free Air

works.technique: A flexible nozzle on a pan-tilt mount aims a speaker-driven air vortex ring at the tracked user's hand (via a depth camera), delivering localized tactile pulses in free air.
works.exercise_zh: 用纸杯或塑料瓶加气球膜做一个简易空气炮，配合手机 AR 中出现的虚拟蝴蝶，由一位同学在蝴蝶“碰到”手时手动发射空气环；变体：设计一个只有触感、没有视觉的“隐形”AR 生物。
works.description_zh: Rajinder Sodhi、Ivan Poupyrev、Matthew Glisson 和 Ali Israr 用一台 3D 打印的涡环炮发射空气环，让你能在空中感受到虚拟的蝴蝶和皮球。
works.idea_en: An air-vortex cannon lets you "touch" virtual butterflies and balls in mid-air.
works.technique_zh: 安装在云台上的柔性喷嘴由扬声器驱动产生空气涡环，并对准由深度相机追踪到的用户手部，在自由空间中提供局部的触觉脉冲。
works.exercise_en: Make a simple air cannon from a paper cup or plastic bottle and a balloon membrane, pair it with a virtual butterfly in phone AR, and have a classmate fire an air ring by hand whenever the butterfly "touches" someone's hand. Twist: design an "invisible" AR creature that you can only feel, not see.

works.title: Adaptive Ghosted Views for AR
works.description: Ghosted X-ray views that adapt which real-world features to keep visible, so hidden pipes or rooms behind a wall stay readable without losing the wall.
works.idea_zh: 自适应的“幽灵透视”：墙后管线可见，墙本身也不消失。

video.video_title: Adaptive ghosted views for Augmented Reality

works.technique: Computes importance from real-world image features and adapts the transparency of the occluder per pixel before revealing the hidden virtual layer.
works.exercise_zh: 给一面贴有海报的墙做AR“看穿墙”效果：把海报的主要线条保留为半透明，后面显示虚拟管道；变化：让同学评估保留多少细节最好。
works.description_zh: 自适应的“幽灵式”X 光透视视图，会自动决定保留哪些真实世界特征，让墙后隐藏的管道或房间清晰可辨，同时墙本身也不会消失。
works.idea_en: An adaptive ghosted see-through view: the pipes behind the wall show up and the wall stays.
works.technique_zh: 根据真实世界的图像特征计算重要度，逐像素调整遮挡物的透明度，再显示被遮挡的虚拟图层。
works.exercise_en: Build an AR "see through the wall" effect on a wall with a poster: keep the poster's main lines semi-transparent and show virtual pipes behind it. Twist: have classmates judge how much detail is best to keep.

works.title: BeThere
works.description: A mobile 3D collaboration system where a remote user sees a reconstructed 3D copy of the local space and reaches in with tracked hands to point and manipulate.
works.idea_zh: 远程的人把手“伸进”你的空间指指点点。

video.video_title: BeThere: 3D Mobile Collaboration with Spatial Input

works.technique: Attaches a depth sensor to a mobile device to capture the scene and the user's hand, sharing both as 3D data so remote hands appear in the local AR view.
works.exercise_zh: 组织两人视频通话：远程者在截图上画圈画箭头，本地者用手机AR把这些标记放到真实物体上完成组装任务；变化：只允许用手势不许说话。
works.description_zh: 一套移动式三维协作系统：远程用户能看到本地空间重建出的三维副本，并用被追踪的双手“伸进”其中进行指点和操作。
works.idea_en: A remote person reaches their hands into your space to point things out.
works.technique_zh: 在移动设备上加装深度传感器，捕捉场景和用户的手，并将两者作为三维数据共享，使远程的手出现在本地的 AR 视图中。
works.exercise_en: Set up a two-person video call: the remote person draws circles and arrows on a screenshot, and the local person uses phone AR to place those marks on real objects to complete an assembly task. Twist: only gestures are allowed, no talking.

works.title: Box
works.description: Two industrial robots move large panels while projection-mapped imagery on them stays locked to a robot-moved camera, creating illusions shot entirely in-camera.
works.idea_zh: 机械臂移动画布与摄像机，投影与运动精确同步的现场魔术

video.video_title: Box

works.technique: Motion-control industrial robots move both the screens and the camera on programmed paths, and projection is rendered from the known poses so the anamorphic imagery stays correct from the camera's viewpoint.
works.exercise_zh: 用手动移动的纸板屏幕和固定手机摄像头，在 TouchDesigner 中根据纸板上的 ArUco 标记实时调整投影，使画面始终“贴”在纸板上；变体：设计一个只有从摄像机视角才成立的错觉，现场观众看到的是乱码。
works.description_zh: 两台工业机器人移动大型面板，面板上的投影映射画面始终与一台由机器人移动的摄像机锁定，创造出完全在镜头内实拍完成的视觉错觉。
works.idea_en: Robot arms move the canvases and the camera, a live magic trick where projection and motion stay perfectly in sync.
works.technique_zh: 运动控制工业机器人按编程路径同时移动屏幕和摄像机，投影则依据已知位姿进行渲染，使变形透视影像从摄像机视角看始终正确。
works.exercise_en: Using a hand-moved cardboard screen and a fixed phone camera, adjust the projection in real time in TouchDesigner based on ArUco markers on the cardboard so the image always "sticks" to it. Twist: design an illusion that only works from the camera's viewpoint, while the live audience sees gibberish.

works.title: Dynamic Compact Visualizations for AR
works.description: AR annotations and exploded views of a real object are laid out compactly and reorganise dynamically as the viewpoint changes, avoiding clutter.
works.idea_zh: AR标注和爆炸图随视角自动重新排布，永不杂乱。

video.video_title: Dynamic Compact Visualizations for Augmented Reality

works.technique: Uses view-management optimisation to cluster and position labels and explosion diagrams in screen space each frame.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机AR为一台拆开的旧电器零件加标签，让同学设计标签在转动视角时如何避免重叠；变化：只允许显示3个标签，其余折叠。
works.description_zh: 真实物体的 AR 标注和爆炸图以紧凑的方式排布，并随视角变化动态重组，避免画面杂乱。
works.idea_en: AR labels and exploded views rearrange themselves with the viewpoint and never get cluttered.
works.technique_zh: 采用视图管理优化，逐帧在屏幕空间中对标签和爆炸图进行聚类与定位。
works.exercise_en: Use phone AR to label the parts of a disassembled old appliance, and have classmates design how the labels avoid overlapping as the view rotates. Twist: only 3 labels may be shown, and the rest fold away.

works.title: Face substitution tests
works.description: Early openFrameworks tests swap faces in live video, pasting another face onto the tracked face with matching position and expression.
works.idea_zh: 实时把另一张脸'贴'到你的脸上。

video.video_title: Face Substitution tests

works.technique: A face tracker fits a mesh to the live face and texture-maps a second face onto it with color blending (likely based on Kyle McDonald and Arturo Castro's openFrameworks FaceSubstitution code).
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe FaceMesh 把一幅名画的脸贴到自己脸上并跟随表情；加一个变化：两个同学互换脸。
works.description_zh: 早期的 openFrameworks 实验，在实时视频中换脸：把另一张脸贴到被追踪的脸上，位置和表情都同步匹配。
works.idea_en: Paste another face onto yours in real time.
works.technique_zh: 人脸追踪器把网格拟合到实时人脸上，再通过颜色融合把另一张脸作为纹理映射上去（大概率基于 Kyle McDonald 和 Arturo Castro 的 openFrameworks FaceSubstitution 代码）。
works.exercise_en: Use MediaPipe FaceMesh to paste the face from a famous painting onto your own so it follows your expressions. Twist: two classmates swap faces.

works.title: Flying Head
works.description: A person wearing a head-mounted display walks, crouches and turns their head, and a small drone copies the same motion in another space, so flying feels like moving your own head.
works.description_zh: 戴着头戴显示器的人走动、蹲下、转头，另一处的小型无人机就同步做出同样的动作，操控飞行就像移动自己的头一样。
works.idea_en: Your head becomes the joystick: body motion drives a flying camera.
works.idea_zh: 头就是摇杆：用身体动作驾驶一台会飞的摄像机。
works.technique: Motion capture tracks the user's head position and orientation and maps it one-to-one to the drone's pose, while the drone's camera feed is shown in the HMD.
works.technique_zh: 动作捕捉系统追踪用户头部的位置和朝向，一比一映射为无人机的姿态，同时把无人机摄像头画面显示在头显中。
works.exercise_en: Map a phone's head-tracked orientation (in a cardboard viewer) to a webcam on a pan-tilt servo or a virtual camera in another room scene. Twist: scale your movements by 10x and discuss how it changes your sense of body size.
works.exercise_zh: 把戴在纸板眼镜里的手机的头部朝向，映射到舵机云台上的摄像头或另一个虚拟房间里的摄像机；变体：把动作放大十倍，讨论这如何改变你对自身尺度的感觉。

video.video_title: Flying Head: A Head Motion Synchronization Mechanism for Unmanned Aerial Vehicle Control

works.title: Hakanaï
works.description: A dancer inside a cube of tulle interacts with projected lines, grids and letters that are performed live around her; afterwards the audience can enter the cube.
works.idea_zh: 舞者在纱幕立方体中与实时投影的线条“对话”，像一首短诗
works.technique: Four-sided projection on tulle scrims is 'played' live by a digital performer using eMotion, with motion sensing linking the images to the dancer.
works.exercise_zh: 用4块纱或白布围成小立方体，投影线条动画，同学在里面随线条即兴；变化：让观众用手机遥控线条，与里面的人互动。

video.video_title: Adrien M & Claire B : Hakanaï

works.description_zh: 一位舞者置身于纱幕围成的立方体中，与四周现场演奏出的投影线条、网格和字母互动；演出结束后，观众可以走进这个立方体。
works.idea_en: A dancer in a cube of gauze converses with live projected lines, like a short poem.
works.technique_zh: 在四面纱幕上投影，由一位数字表演者用 eMotion 现场“演奏”影像，并通过动作感应把画面与舞者联系起来。
works.exercise_en: Enclose a small cube with four pieces of gauze or white cloth, project line animations onto it, and have a classmate improvise with the lines inside. Twist: let the audience control the lines from their phones to interact with the person inside.

works.title: IllumiRoom
works.description: A projector around the TV extends Xbox games onto the living-room walls and furniture: snow falls in the room, the room shakes on explosions, the field of view grows beyond the screen.
works.idea_zh: 游戏画面冲出电视，雪花飘落在客厅墙上，爆炸时整个房间都在抖。

video.video_title: IllumiRoom by Microsoft Research: Peripheral Projected Illusions for Interactive Experiences

works.technique: A Kinect scans the geometry around the TV, the projector is calibrated to it, and game-driven effects (peripheral extension, edge highlighting, radial distortion) are rendered with depth-aware projection mapping around the screen.
works.exercise_zh: 把投影仪对准显示器周围的墙面，在 TouchDesigner 中实时抓取屏幕边缘颜色并向外扩展，同时在屏幕内出现爆炸时让投影画面震动；变体：让房间效果与剧情反着来，比如游戏越激烈，房间越安静。
works.description_zh: 电视周围的一台投影仪把 Xbox 游戏延伸到客厅的墙面和家具上：雪花在房间里飘落，爆炸时整个房间都在震动，视野也超出了屏幕的边界。
works.idea_en: The game bursts out of the TV: snow drifts down the living-room walls and the whole room shakes when things explode.
works.technique_zh: Kinect 扫描电视周围的几何形状，投影仪据此完成标定，再用具备深度感知的投影映射在屏幕四周渲染由游戏驱动的效果（外围视野延伸、边缘高亮、径向畸变）。
works.exercise_en: Aim a projector at the wall around a monitor, grab the colors at the screen's edges in real time in TouchDesigner and extend them outward, and shake the projected image whenever an explosion happens on screen. Twist: make the room effects run against the story, for example the more intense the game, the quieter the room.

works.title: Invizimals: The Alliance / The Lost Kingdom
works.description: PS Vita AR capture game (The Alliance) paired with a PS3 adventure (The Lost Kingdom) where creatures captured in AR travel between the handheld and the console world.
works.idea_zh: 在掌机上用AR捕获怪兽，再带着它们进入主机冒险世界。

video.video_title: Invizimals: The Alliance and Invizimals: The Lost Kingdom Trailer | PS Vita - PS3

works.technique: Creatures captured in the handheld AR mode are saved to a shared profile and loaded as playable characters in a separate console game, linking two devices through data.
works.exercise_zh: 在手机 AR 中“捕捉”一个角色并保存为 JSON，再在电脑上的 Unity 场景中读取它作为可控角色；变体：在电脑上升级后，手机 AR 里的角色外观也改变。
works.description_zh: PS Vita 上的 AR 捕捉游戏（The Alliance）与 PS3 上的冒险游戏（The Lost Kingdom）互相搭配，在 AR 中捕获的生物可以在掌机与主机世界之间来回穿梭。
works.idea_en: Catch monsters in AR on a handheld, then take them along into an adventure on the console.
works.technique_zh: 在掌机 AR 模式中捕获的生物被保存到共享的玩家档案中，并在另一款主机游戏里作为可操控角色载入，通过数据把两台设备连接起来。
works.exercise_en: "Catch" a character in phone AR and save it as JSON, then load it as a controllable character in a Unity scene on a computer. Twist: after leveling it up on the computer, the character's look in phone AR changes too.

works.title: Ishin-Den-Shin
works.description: A person speaks into a microphone and then touches someone's ear with a finger; the recorded message is heard only by the person being touched, transmitted through the body.
works.idea_zh: 用手指触碰对方耳朵，悄悄话通过身体传过去。

video.video_title: Ishin-Den-Shin

works.technique: Converts recorded speech into a modulated inaudible high-voltage signal on the speaker's body, and the touched earlobe vibrates as a tiny speaker.
works.exercise_zh: 用骨传导耳机或手机录音，设计“只有被触碰的人才能听到”的传声游戏（碰肩触发播放）；变化：信息沿一条人链逐个传递并逐渐变形。
works.description_zh: 一个人对着麦克风说话，然后用手指触碰另一个人的耳朵；录下的话语通过身体传递，只有被触碰的人才能听到。
works.idea_en: Touch someone's ear with your finger and a whisper travels through your body to them.
works.technique_zh: 把录下的语音转换成调制过的、人耳听不到的高压信号加载到说话者身上，被触碰的耳垂便像一个微型扬声器那样振动发声。
works.exercise_en: Use bone-conduction headphones or phone recordings to design a message-passing game where "only the person being touched can hear" (a tap on the shoulder triggers playback). Twist: pass the message along a human chain, letting it gradually change on the way.

works.title: Laser Forest
works.description: Visitors walk through a forest of 150 tall rods; tapping or shaking a rod plays a note and fires laser light across the dark hall, so the whole crowd becomes an orchestra.
works.description_zh: 观众穿行于由 150 根高杆组成的“森林”中，敲击或摇动一根杆就会发出一个音符并在黑暗大厅中射出激光，整个人群成了一支乐队。
works.idea_en: A walk-through instrument where every touch becomes sound and light in space.
works.idea_zh: 一件可以走进去的乐器，每一次触碰都变成空间中的声音和光。
works.technique: Each rod has a motion sensor that triggers synthesized sounds and laser patterns, with lasers and haze making beams visible between the rods.
works.technique_zh: 每根杆内都有运动传感器，触发合成声音和激光图案，激光与雾气让光束在杆之间清晰可见。
works.exercise_en: Make three 'trees' from cardboard tubes with a phone or micro:bit accelerometer inside; shaking each one plays a note and flashes a projected beam on the ceiling. Twist: make trees that only sound when shaken together.
works.exercise_zh: 用纸筒做三棵“树”，里面放手机或 micro:bit 加速度计，摇动一棵就发出一个音并在天花板上投出一道光；变体：有些树只有同时被摇动时才会发声。

video.video_title: Laser Forest by Marshmallow Laser Feast

works.title: Layar for Google Glass
works.description: Layar's image-recognition AR ported to Google Glass, so printed pages and posters trigger interactive content in the wearer's view.
works.idea_zh: 把印刷品识别AR带到Google眼镜上。

video.video_title: Layar Augmented Reality for Google Glass

works.technique: Image recognition matches printed pages against a database, triggering linked content in a head-worn display without needing a touch screen.
works.exercise_zh: 为一张课程海报做图像识别触发，扫描后播放一段 15 秒的介绍视频；变体：同一张海报在不同时间扫描显示不同内容。
works.description_zh: Layar 将其基于图像识别的 AR 移植到 Google Glass 上，印刷页面和海报可以直接在佩戴者的视野中触发互动内容。
works.idea_en: Bring print-recognition AR to Google Glass.
works.technique_zh: 图像识别把印刷页面与数据库进行匹配，在头戴显示器中触发关联内容，无需触摸屏。
works.exercise_en: Make a course poster into an image-recognition trigger that plays a 15-second introduction video when scanned. Twist: scanning the same poster at different times shows different content.

works.title: Light Leaks
works.description: With Jonas Jongejan: dozens of mirror balls reflect light from projectors calibrated with computer vision, filling a whole room with moving points of light.
works.idea_zh: 几十个迪斯科球反射投影光，整间屋子变成流动的光点空间。

video.video_title: Light Leaks

works.technique: Structured-light (Gray code) scanning maps each projector pixel to where its reflection lands in the room via the mirror balls, and the content is authored in that reflected space so light points move coherently.
works.exercise_zh: 把投影仪对准一个迪斯科球或几片镜子，在 TouchDesigner 里逐区域点亮，记录每块区域的光斑落在房间哪里，再编一段光点游走的动画；变体：让光点按一首歌的节奏在墙上“跳舞”。
works.description_zh: 与 Jonas Jongejan 合作：几十个镜面球反射由计算机视觉标定过的投影仪发出的光，让整个房间充满流动的光点。
works.idea_en: Dozens of disco balls reflect projector light and turn a whole room into a space of drifting light points.
works.technique_zh: 用结构光（格雷码）扫描，把每个投影像素经镜面球反射后落在房间里的位置对应起来，再在这个“反射空间”中制作内容，使光点能连贯地运动。
works.exercise_en: Aim a projector at a disco ball or a few mirror pieces, light it region by region in TouchDesigner, note where each region's light spot lands in the room, and then compose an animation of wandering light points. Twist: make the light points "dance" on the wall to the rhythm of a song.

works.title: Line Segments Space
works.description: A web of nylon threads spans a dark gallery; calibrated projection lights the strings to articulate dynamic imaginary forms in the physical volume.
works.idea_zh: 黑暗中一张尼龙线网，被精准投影点亮成流动的三维图形。

video.video_title: Line Segments Space 2014

works.technique: Calibrated projection (projector pose solved against the known string geometry) lights only the pixels that fall on each nylon thread, drawing shapes along lines in physical space.
works.exercise_zh: 在暗箱里拉几十根白线，投影仪用遮罩只照亮线上的像素，在 TouchDesigner 里让光沿线流动出一个立体轮廓；变体：线的排布由一段文字的笔画决定，让光把字“写”在空中。
works.description_zh: 一张尼龙线网横跨黑暗的展厅，经过标定的投影点亮这些细线，在实体空间中勾勒出不断变化的虚构形体。
works.idea_en: A web of nylon threads in the dark, lit by precise projection into flowing 3D shapes.
works.technique_zh: 经过标定的投影（根据已知的线网几何求解投影仪位姿）只点亮落在每根尼龙线上的像素，沿着实体空间中的线条绘出形体。
works.exercise_en: String a few dozen white threads inside a dark box, have the projector light only the pixels that fall on the threads using a mask, and make light flow along them in TouchDesigner to trace a 3D outline. Twist: arrange the threads by the strokes of a piece of text, so the light "writes" the characters in the air.

works.title: Memory of Form and Matter
works.description: Digitally fabricated sculptures are overlaid with projection-mapped simulations, so static printed structures appear to breathe and move with light.
works.idea_zh: 给3D打印雕塑投上模拟动画，让静止的实物像活物一样“呼吸”。

video.video_title: Memory of Form and Matter

works.technique: Projection mapping registers the projector to the 3D-printed sculpture's CAD model, and simulations (flow, displacement) are rendered in model space so light follows the physical geometry.
works.exercise_zh: 用 3D 打印或纸雕做一个小结构，用 TouchDesigner 的 Kantan Mapper 或投影映射把呼吸般的明暗动画投上去；变体：让它“呼吸”的节奏跟房间里的噪音同步。
works.description_zh: 数字制造的雕塑上叠加了投影映射的模拟动画，让静止的打印结构仿佛随着光在呼吸、在运动。
works.idea_en: Project simulations onto a 3D-printed sculpture so the still object seems to breathe like a living thing.
works.technique_zh: 投影映射把投影仪与 3D 打印雕塑的 CAD 模型对齐，模拟效果（流动、位移）在模型空间中渲染，使光线贴合实体几何。
works.exercise_en: Make a small structure by 3D printing or paper sculpture and project a breathing light-and-dark animation onto it using TouchDesigner's Kantan Mapper or projection mapping. Twist: sync its "breathing" to the noise in the room.

works.title: Netykavka
works.description: A cone of projected light in a hazy dark room, inspired by Anthony McCall's solid-light films, reacts when visitors put their hands into the beam.
works.description_zh: 在弥漫薄雾的暗室里，一束受 Anthony McCall“实体光”作品启发的投影光锥，会对观众伸进光束的手做出反应。
works.idea_en: Make a beam of light feel like a solid object you can touch.
works.idea_zh: 让一束光感觉像一个可以触摸的实体。
works.technique: Haze makes the projector's beam visible as a 3D volume, and a sensor (likely a depth camera) detects hands intersecting the beam to change the projected line drawing.
works.technique_zh: 雾气让投影光束显现为三维体积，传感器（很可能是深度摄像头）检测伸入光束的手，从而改变投影的线条图形。
works.exercise_en: In a dark room with a fog machine or hair spray, project a slowly growing circle outline and use a webcam to detect a hand in the beam so the circle breaks where it is 'touched'. Twist: make two beams that can only be merged by two people.
works.exercise_zh: 在暗室里用烟雾机营造雾气，投出一个缓慢生长的圆形轮廓，用摄像头检测伸入光束的手，让圆在被“摸到”的地方断开；变体：做两束光，只有两个人合作才能让它们融合。

video.video_title: Netykavka

works.title: Nosaj Thing 'Eclipse/Blue' music video
works.description: A dancer performs inside real-time projected graphics driven by motion capture, so the visuals wrap her body and the space live.
works.idea_zh: 动作捕捉驱动的投影随舞者身体实时变形

video.video_title: Nosaj Thing "Eclipse/Blue" [Official Video]

works.technique: Motion capture of the dancer drives real-time openFrameworks graphics that are projected onto the stage and her body, with the projector calibrated to the capture volume.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Kinect 或 MediaPipe Pose 追踪一个人，把线条和粒子投影到他身后的墙上并随动作变形；变体：让图形只在人静止时出现，动作越快画面越消散。
works.description_zh: 一位舞者在由动作捕捉驱动的实时投影图形中起舞，影像实时包裹着她的身体和整个空间。
works.idea_en: Motion-captured projections reshape themselves around the dancer's body in real time.
works.technique_zh: 对舞者进行动作捕捉，驱动 openFrameworks 实时生成图形，投影到舞台和她的身体上；投影仪已与动作捕捉空间完成标定。
works.exercise_en: Track a person with Kinect or MediaPipe Pose and project lines and particles onto the wall behind them that deform with their movement. Twist: the graphics only appear when the person is still, and dissolve faster the faster they move.

works.title: Perfume at Cannes Lions
works.description: Perfume performs with semi-translucent screens they move on stage; motion capture and a 3D-scanned venue let projections map onto the screens and dancers in real time, blending stage and virtual space.
works.idea_zh: 偶像团体在舞台上推动半透明幕布，实时投影与她们的动作融为一体。

video.video_title: Perfume Performance Cannes Lions

works.technique: Optical motion capture tracks the moving screens and dancers, and a 3D scan of the venue defines a virtual stage in which projector renders are updated per frame to stay mapped onto moving surfaces.
works.exercise_zh: 给一块手持白板贴上 ArUco 或 AR 标记，用摄像头追踪它的位置，投影仪把画面始终投在移动的白板上，编一段 1 分钟的舞；变体：两块板靠近时画面会从一块“流”到另一块。
works.description_zh: Perfume 在舞台上一边表演一边推动半透明屏幕；借助动作捕捉和对场馆的三维扫描，投影实时映射到屏幕和舞者身上，舞台与虚拟空间融为一体。
works.idea_en: A pop group pushes translucent screens around the stage while live projection merges with their moves.
works.technique_zh: 光学动作捕捉追踪移动的屏幕和舞者，场馆的三维扫描定义出一个虚拟舞台，投影仪的渲染在其中逐帧更新，确保画面始终映射在移动的表面上。
works.exercise_en: Put an ArUco or AR marker on a handheld whiteboard, track its position with a camera so the projector always casts the image onto the moving board, and choreograph a one-minute dance. Twist: when two boards come close, the image "flows" from one to the other.

works.title: Reality Editor: Programming Smarter Objects
works.description: Early Reality Editor demo: drag virtual lines between physical objects seen through a phone to connect their inputs and outputs, like patching cables in thin air.
works.idea_zh: 在手机画面里从一个物体拖线到另一个物体，就把它们'连'在一起了。

video.video_title: Reality Editor: Programming Smarter Objects

works.technique: Marker-based AR recognition overlays each object's inputs and outputs as nodes, and dragging a line between nodes on the touchscreen writes a data-flow link that the networked objects then execute.
works.exercise_zh: 在手机 AR 中识别两张图卡（代表“开关”和“灯”），用手指从一个节点拖线到另一个节点建立连接，连接后按虚拟开关就能点亮虚拟灯；变体：在连线中间插入一个“逻辑盒”（延时、反转或计数）。
works.description_zh: Reality Editor 的早期演示：在手机画面中，在实体物体之间拖出虚拟连线，把它们的输入和输出连接起来，就像在空中接插线缆。
works.idea_en: Drag a line from one object to another on your phone screen and they are wired together.
works.technique_zh: 基于标记的 AR 识别把每个物体的输入和输出以节点形式叠加显示，在触摸屏上从一个节点拖线到另一个节点，就会写入一条数据流连接，再由联网的物体执行。
works.exercise_en: Recognize two image cards in phone AR (one standing for a "switch" and one for a "light"), drag a line with your finger from one node to the other to connect them, and then pressing the virtual switch lights the virtual lamp. Twist: insert a "logic box" (delay, invert or count) in the middle of the connection.

works.title: Sharing Faces
works.description: Linked mirror installations in Anyang, Korea and Yamaguchi, Japan: your expression and pose are matched in real time with photos of someone who once stood at the other site.
works.idea_zh: 跨国“镜子”：你看到的是另一国家某个人以相同表情和姿势的脸。

video.video_title: Sharing Faces

works.technique: Face tracking extracts head pose and expression parameters, which are used as a nearest-neighbour query into a growing database of photos captured at the remote site.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe 提取头部朝向和嘴巴张开程度，从另一组同学提前拍好的照片库里找出姿势最像的一张实时显示；变体：两个教室互相连线，你只能用对方过去的照片“回应”对方。
works.description_zh: 分别位于韩国安养和日本山口的两面互相连通的“镜子”装置：你的表情和姿态会被实时匹配到曾经站在另一端的某个人的照片上。
works.idea_en: A cross-border mirror: you see the face of someone in another country with your same expression and pose.
works.technique_zh: 面部追踪提取头部姿态和表情参数，并以此作为最近邻查询条件，在另一端不断积累的照片数据库中检索。
works.exercise_en: Use MediaPipe to extract head orientation and how wide the mouth is open, then find and display in real time the most similar pose from a photo library another group of classmates shot in advance. Twist: link two classrooms so you can only "reply" to the other side with their past photos.

works.title: Sketch Aquarium
works.description: Children colour paper fish that are scanned and immediately swim in a giant projected aquarium, where they react when touched.
works.idea_zh: 孩子画的鱼被扫描进投影水族馆里游动

video.video_title: Sketch Aquarium / お絵かき水族館

works.technique: Coloured template sheets are scanned, the drawing is texture-mapped onto a pre-made 3D fish model via the template's known layout, and the fish joins a projected real-time scene with touch or depth-sensor interaction.
works.exercise_zh: 设计一张生物涂色模板，用手机拍照后把纹理贴到 three.js 模型上，让它进入投影的共享水族箱；变体：让每个生物的行为（快慢、群游或独游）由涂色中的主色决定。
works.description_zh: 孩子们给纸上的鱼涂色，扫描后这些鱼立刻就在巨大的投影水族馆里游动，被触碰时还会作出反应。
works.idea_en: Fish drawn by children are scanned in and swim in a projected aquarium.
works.technique_zh: 扫描涂好色的模板纸，依据模板的已知版式把画作作为纹理映射到预先做好的三维鱼模型上，让鱼加入实时投影场景，并通过触摸或深度传感器进行交互。
works.exercise_en: Design a creature coloring template, photograph it with a phone, texture it onto a three.js model, and send it into a shared projected aquarium. Twist: let each creature's behavior (fast or slow, schooling or solitary) be decided by the dominant color in its coloring.

works.title: Smarter Objects
works.description: Point an iPad at a radio or lamp and a virtual control interface appears attached to it; you can reprogram what its physical knobs do and link objects together.
works.idea_zh: 用平板对准实物，就能看见并改写它'隐藏的界面'和行为逻辑。

video.video_title: Smarter Objects

works.technique: Vuforia image targets recognize each physical object and anchor a virtual UI to it, while an Arduino inside the object exchanges knob and actuator states with the iPad over the network so the virtual UI can remap physical controls.
works.exercise_zh: 用 8th Wall 图像识别或 AR Foundation Image Tracking 识别一个台灯或音箱上的贴图，弹出虚拟控制面板，并通过 ESP32/Arduino 控制一个 LED 的亮度；变体：让一个实体旋钮控制的东西可以在 AR 界面里被“重新指派”。
works.description_zh: 用 iPad 对准收音机或台灯，就会出现一个附着在物体上的虚拟控制界面；你可以重新定义它的实体旋钮的功能，还能把多个物体连接在一起。
works.idea_en: Point a tablet at an object to see and rewrite its hidden interface and behavior.
works.technique_zh: Vuforia 图像目标识别每个实体物体，并把虚拟 UI 锚定在其上；物体内部的 Arduino 通过网络与 iPad 交换旋钮和执行器的状态，使虚拟 UI 能够重新映射实体控件。
works.exercise_en: Use 8th Wall image recognition or AR Foundation Image Tracking to recognize a sticker on a lamp or speaker, pop up a virtual control panel, and control an LED's brightness through an ESP32/Arduino. Twist: let what a physical knob controls be "reassigned" in the AR interface.

works.title: Space Mural (Aurasma)
works.description: A painted space-themed mural that triggers animated AR content through Aurasma when viewed with a phone.
works.idea_zh: 一幅太空壁画在手机镜头下变成动态影像。

video.video_title: Augmented Reality Art - Aurasma - Space Mural by Zenka #mocatvupload

works.technique: An image recognition service matches the mural and triggers an overlay animation registered to the painted surface.
works.exercise_zh: 在白板上画一幅简单壁画，用图像追踪让其中的元素飞出来；变体：邀请同学在壁画上添加一笔，观察识别是否仍然有效。
works.description_zh: 一幅以太空为主题的手绘壁画，用手机观看时会通过 Aurasma 触发 AR 动画内容。
works.idea_en: A space mural turns into moving images through a phone camera.
works.technique_zh: 图像识别服务匹配壁画，并触发与绘画表面对齐的叠加动画。
works.exercise_en: Draw a simple mural on a whiteboard and use image tracking to make its elements fly out. Twist: invite classmates to add one stroke to the mural and see whether recognition still works.

works.title: Sublimate
works.description: Combines a shape display with see-through stereoscopic AR so data can switch between physical form (pins) and virtual 'gas' form floating above the table.
works.idea_zh: 让数据像物质一样在'固态'实体和'气态'全息之间相变。

video.video_title: Sublimate 2013

works.technique: A shape display is registered with a head-tracked stereoscopic see-through display (half-silvered mirror or tracked tablet), so virtual geometry is rendered in the same coordinate space as the pins and can transition between physical and virtual.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中把一组实体方块（或乐高）当作“固态”数据，其余部分用半透明虚拟粒子显示在其上方，点击某一数据点时让它从虚拟“凝固”为需要用实体块摆出的形状；变体：反过来，让实体被拿走时化为虚拟的气体飘走。
works.description_zh: 将形状显示器与透视式立体 AR 结合，让数据可以在实体形态（针脚）和悬浮在桌面上方的虚拟“气态”之间切换。
works.idea_en: Let data change phase like matter, between solid physical form and gaseous hologram.
works.technique_zh: 形状显示器与带头部追踪的立体透视显示（半透半反镜或被追踪的平板）进行配准，使虚拟几何体与针脚在同一坐标空间中渲染，并能在实体与虚拟之间转换。
works.exercise_en: In AR, treat a set of physical blocks (or LEGO) as "solid" data and show the rest as semi-transparent virtual particles above them; when a data point is tapped, it "solidifies" from virtual into a shape you must build with physical blocks. Twist: do the reverse, so a physical piece evaporates into virtual gas when taken away.

works.title: TESSERACT (HyperCube)
works.description: A scaffolding cube in a public square is covered with projection and light so that, seen from the front, it appears to fold, rotate and unfold like a four-dimensional hypercube.
works.description_zh: 广场上的一座脚手架立方体被投影和灯光覆盖，从正面看，它仿佛像四维超立方体一样折叠、旋转、展开。
works.idea_en: Use a real 3D frame to make a fourth dimension feel visible.
works.idea_zh: 用真实的三维框架，让第四维度仿佛可见。
works.technique: Projection surfaces stretched inside a scaffold frame receive content rendered for the main viewing angle so layered surfaces create a volumetric illusion.
works.technique_zh: 绷在脚手架框架内的多层投影面接收按主要观看角度渲染的内容，层层叠加的表面形成体积错觉。
works.exercise_en: Build a cube frame from sticks and stretch two layers of tulle inside, then project content that seems to rotate a cube inside a cube. Twist: find the one viewing spot where the illusion is perfect and mark it on the floor.
works.exercise_zh: 用木条搭一个立方体框架，在里面绷两层薄纱，投影出“立方体套立方体”旋转的画面；变体：找到错觉最完美的那个观看位置，并在地上标出来。

video.video_title: TESSERACT aka HyperCube - 1024 architecture

works.title: The Ark (with Squeaky Lobster)
works.description: At night in the Oaxaca ethnobotanical garden, projections and sound make a grove of giant cacti appear to hold and transmit a luminous archive of the plants' history.
works.idea_zh: 把投影打在真实的仙人掌林上，让植物成为发光的档案
works.technique: Projectors are aligned to the silhouettes of real cacti so scanned outlines and patterns wrap organic, non-planar surfaces.
works.exercise_zh: 用投影仪照射盆栽或树枝，按植物轮廓做遮罩动画；变化：用麦克风让植物“听到”声音后亮起纹理。

video.video_title: The Ark - Romain Tardy x Squeaky Lobster

works.description_zh: 夜晚的瓦哈卡民族植物园中，投影与声音让一片巨型仙人掌林仿佛承载并传递着一份关于植物历史的发光档案。
works.idea_en: Project onto a real grove of cacti and turn the plants into a glowing archive.
works.technique_zh: 投影仪与真实仙人掌的轮廓对齐，使扫描得到的外形线条和图案能包裹在这些有机的非平面表面上。
works.exercise_en: Shine a projector on a potted plant or branches and make a mask animation that follows the plant's outline. Twist: use a microphone so the plant lights up with patterns when it "hears" sound.

works.title: The Radar
works.description: Passers-by connect their own smartphones to a local Wi-Fi network and use them as controllers to solve a projected puzzle on a building façade together.
works.description_zh: 路人用自己的智能手机连上现场 Wi-Fi，把手机当手柄，一起解开投在建筑立面上的谜题。
works.idea_en: The crowd's phones become game controllers for a building-sized screen.
works.idea_zh: 人群手里的手机，变成一面建筑大屏的游戏手柄。
works.technique: A local web server hands each connected phone a control page and relays its inputs to the real-time mapping software, supporting several players at once.
works.technique_zh: 本地 Web 服务器给每台连接的手机下发控制页面，并把输入实时转发给投影软件，可同时支持多名玩家。
works.exercise_en: Build a WebSocket page that lets up to five phones steer dots on a projected wall, and design a puzzle that needs all five to cooperate. Twist: give each phone a different, secret ability.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个 WebSocket 网页，让最多五部手机操控投影墙上的光点，并设计一个必须五人合作才能完成的谜题；变体：给每部手机一个不同的秘密能力。

video.video_title: The Radar - Interactive mapping installation for public controlled by mobile devices

works.title: Towards Intelligent View Management
works.description: While walking through streets with a video see-through display, users drag text panels where they prefer them; the recordings reveal clusters of 'safe' places that an automatic system can learn.
works.description_zh: 用户戴着视频透视显示器走在街上，把文字面板拖到自己喜欢的位置；记录显示出一些“安全区域”的聚集规律，可供自动系统学习。
works.idea_en: Learn where people want text to sit in their view before letting software place it.
works.idea_zh: 先弄清人们希望文字待在视野哪里，再让软件去自动摆放。
works.technique: Records manual placements of text overlays in mobile video see-through AR and clusters them against image features such as dark, uniform regions to derive placement rules.
works.technique_zh: 记录移动视频透视 AR 中用户手动放置文字的位置，并结合图像特征（如较暗、均匀的区域）做聚类，归纳出摆放规则。
works.exercise_en: Walk a route with a phone camera app and a sticky note on the screen; at ten stops move the note to where it bothers you least and screenshot it, then map the patterns as a class. Twist: repeat while talking to a partner and see where the note moves.
works.exercise_zh: 拿着开着相机的手机沿一条路线走，屏幕上贴一张便利贴；在十个停留点把便利贴移到最不碍事的位置并截图，全班一起总结规律；变体：边和同伴聊天边做一遍，看便利贴会被移到哪里。

video.video_title: ISMAR 2013 - Towards Intelligent View Management

works.title: Weather Worlds
works.description: Real-time green-screening places children inside a dynamic weather world where body gestures conjure storms, tornadoes and lightning.
works.idea_zh: 孩子站进画面获得操控天气的超能力：挥手召唤风暴和闪电。

video.video_title: Weather Worlds

works.technique: Green-screen chroma keying composites children into a 3D weather scene, and gesture detection from the silhouette (arm raise, spin) triggers particle weather systems.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe 分割把人抠进一个天气场景，举手下雨、转圈起风，投在墙上；变体：天气由情绪触发，比如大笑放晴、捂脸起雾。
works.description_zh: 实时绿幕抠像把孩子们放进一个动态的天气世界，他们用身体手势召唤风暴、龙卷风和闪电。
works.idea_en: Children step into the picture and gain the power to control weather, waving up storms and lightning.
works.technique_zh: 绿幕色度抠像把孩子合成进三维天气场景，再根据剪影识别手势（举臂、转圈），触发粒子天气系统。
works.exercise_en: Use MediaPipe segmentation to cut people into a weather scene projected on the wall, where raising a hand brings rain and spinning brings wind. Twist: trigger weather with emotions, for example laughing clears the sky and covering your face brings fog.

works.title: Wonderbook: Book of Potions
works.description: A second Harry Potter Wonderbook where players brew potions in a virtual cauldron sitting on the book, grinding and pouring ingredients with the Move controller.
works.idea_zh: 在实体书上用手柄碾磨、倒入材料，调配AR魔药。

video.video_title: Wonderbook: Book of Potions - E3 Announce

works.technique: The book marker anchors a virtual cauldron, and controller motion patterns such as grinding and pouring are recognized from IMU data to add ingredients.
works.exercise_zh: 在图像标记上放一口 AR 锅，用手机的摇晃、倾倒动作（加速度计）添加不同原料，配方正确时冒出彩色烟雾；变体：配方需要按正确顺序加入。
works.description_zh: 哈利·波特系列的第二本 Wonderbook：玩家在放在书上的虚拟坩埚里熬制魔药，用 Move 手柄研磨、倾倒各种材料。
works.idea_en: Grind and pour ingredients with a controller over a real book to brew AR potions.
works.technique_zh: 书本标记用于锚定虚拟坩埚，系统根据 IMU 数据识别研磨、倾倒等手柄动作模式，从而加入相应材料。
works.exercise_en: Put an AR cauldron on an image marker and add different ingredients by shaking or tilting the phone (accelerometer), with colored smoke rising when the recipe is right. Twist: the ingredients must be added in the correct order.

works.title: Wonderbook: Diggs Nightcrawler
works.description: A film-noir detective story for Wonderbook: turning the pages of the physical book opens pop-up scenes of Library City, where players help bookworm detective Diggs investigate Humpty Dumpty's fall.
works.description_zh: 一部为 Wonderbook 打造的黑色电影风格侦探故事：翻动实体书页，Library City 的立体场景就从书中弹出，玩家帮助书虫侦探 Diggs 调查 Humpty Dumpty 摔落之谜。
works.idea_en: Turning a real page works like a camera cut in a detective movie.
works.idea_zh: 翻动真实的书页，就像侦探电影里的一次镜头切换。
works.technique: Page patterns printed in the Wonderbook are tracked by the PlayStation Eye so pop-up dioramas and characters stay glued to the open spread as it moves.
works.technique_zh: PlayStation Eye 追踪 Wonderbook 书页上印刷的图案，让立体布景和角色在书本移动时仍牢牢贴在翻开的书页上。
works.exercise_en: Write a three-page mystery and make each page an AR image target that shows one pop-up diorama with a hidden clue; readers must tilt the phone around the book to spot it. Twist: make the final page show a different culprit depending on which clues were tapped.
works.exercise_zh: 写一个三页的小悬疑故事，把每页做成 AR 图像标记，各呈现一个藏有线索的立体场景，读者必须绕着书移动手机才能发现线索。变体：根据读者点中了哪些线索，让最后一页揭示不同的凶手。

video.video_title: Wonderbook™: Diggs Nightcrawler™

works.title: Wonderbook: Walking with Dinosaurs
works.description: A BBC-licensed Wonderbook title: players dig fossils out of the pages of a physical marker book, then rebuild and feed dinosaurs that stomp out of the book into the living-room camera image.
works.description_zh: BBC 授权的 Wonderbook 游戏：玩家从实体标记书的书页里挖出化石，再把恐龙拼装复原、喂养，看着它们从书中走进电视画面里的客厅。
works.idea_en: A paper book becomes an excavation site, and each page turn advances a natural-history lesson.
works.idea_zh: 一本纸书变成考古挖掘现场，每翻一页，自然史课程就往前推进一步。
works.technique: The PlayStation Eye tracks printed patterns on each Wonderbook page to anchor 3D scenes to the book, while the Move controller acts as brush, hand or food.
works.technique_zh: PlayStation Eye 识别 Wonderbook 每页上的印刷图案，把 3D 场景锚定在书上；Move 手柄则充当刷子、手或食物。
works.exercise_en: Print four image-target pages and staple them into a booklet; in Unity with Vuforia or AR Foundation image tracking, make each page reveal one stage of a fossil dig (buried, brushed, assembled, alive). Twist: require the reader to tilt or shake the book to uncover the next layer.
works.exercise_zh: 打印四页图像识别标记并装订成小册子；在 Unity 中用 Vuforia 或 AR Foundation 图像追踪，让每一页依次呈现化石挖掘的一个阶段（掩埋、清理、拼装、复活）。变体：要求读者倾斜或摇晃书本才能露出下一层。

video.video_title: Wonderbook: Walking with Dinosaurs

works.title: Woodland Wiggle
works.description: A room-sized interactive TV at the Royal London Hospital where children step into a storybook woodland to paint, play music and summon weather with animated animals.
works.idea_zh: 医院里整面墙的互动童话森林，孩子用身体画画、奏乐、召唤天气。

video.video_title: Woodland Wiggle

works.technique: Kinect body tracking maps children's positions and gestures to triggers in a 2D animated scene (painting, playing instruments, calling weather), with large-scale display for full-body play.
works.exercise_zh: 为一个儿童候诊区设计一面体感墙：用 MediaPipe Pose 让伸手、跳跃、蹲下分别触发画画、敲鼓、下雪；变体：所有动作都要能在坐着或躺着时完成，适合行动不便的孩子。
works.description_zh: 伦敦皇家医院里一台房间大小的互动电视，孩子们走进童话般的林地，与动画动物一起画画、奏乐、召唤天气。
works.idea_en: A wall-sized interactive fairy-tale forest in a hospital, where children paint, make music and call up weather with their bodies.
works.technique_zh: Kinect 身体追踪把孩子的位置和手势映射为二维动画场景中的触发事件（画画、演奏乐器、召唤天气），配合大尺寸显示实现全身互动。
works.exercise_en: Design a motion-sensing wall for a children's waiting area: use MediaPipe Pose so reaching out, jumping and crouching trigger painting, drumming and snow. Twist: every action must be possible while sitting or lying down, for children with limited mobility.

works.title: Word Lens for Glass
works.description: Word Lens on Google Glass: the wearer looks at a sign and sees it translated in their view hands-free.
works.idea_zh: 戴上眼镜看招牌，翻译直接出现在视野里。

video.video_title: Introducing Word Lens for Glass

works.technique: The OCR and in-place replacement pipeline runs on head-worn camera frames, so translation appears in view without holding a device.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机前后摄像头模拟眼镜视角做“免手持”文字翻译，并讨论眼镜上需要如何简化界面；变体：只用语音朗读翻译结果，不显示文字。
works.description_zh: 运行在 Google Glass 上的 Word Lens：佩戴者看向一块招牌，无需动手，视野中就会出现翻译后的文字。
works.idea_en: Look at a sign through the glasses and the translation appears right in your view.
works.technique_zh: OCR 与原位替换流程直接处理头戴摄像头拍到的画面，无需手持设备就能在视野中看到翻译。
works.exercise_en: Simulate a glasses view with a phone's cameras to build hands-free text translation, and discuss how the interface would need to be simplified for glasses. Twist: only read the translation aloud by voice, with no text shown.

works.title: WorldKit
works.description: Paint an interface onto any surface with a sweep of the hand: buttons, sliders and displays are projected where you draw them and become touch-enabled.
works.idea_zh: 用手在任意桌面墙面上'刷'一下，就长出一个可触控的按钮或滑杆。

video.video_title: WorldKit

works.technique: A calibrated Kinect and projector let the user paint a region with a hand; the depth map within that region is used as a touch-sensing surface and the painted region becomes a projected widget.
works.exercise_zh: 用投影仪 + 摄像头实现：用手在墙上画一个矩形区域，系统在这里生成一个投影按钮或滑块，碰到时切换灯光或音乐；变体：让同学在教室里“布置”出一个只用投影的工作台。
works.description_zh: 只需挥手一扫，就能把界面“刷”到任何表面上：按钮、滑块和显示区域会被投影到你画出的位置，并且可以触控。
works.idea_en: Swipe your hand over any table or wall and a touchable button or slider appears there.
works.technique_zh: 经过标定的 Kinect 和投影仪让用户用手“涂”出一块区域；该区域内的深度图被用作触摸感应表面，涂出的区域则成为一个投影控件。
works.exercise_en: With a projector and a camera, draw a rectangle on the wall with your hand, and have the system generate a projected button or slider there that switches the lights or music when touched. Twist: have classmates "set up" a projection-only workstation in the classroom.

works.title: YouMove
works.description: An AR mirror records an expert's movement and then trains learners by overlaying skeleton guides and feedback on their mirror reflection, gradually removing guidance.
works.idea_zh: AR魔镜把老师的动作叠在你的镜像上，一步步教你跳。

video.video_title: YouMove: Enhancing Movement Training with an Augmented Reality Mirror

works.technique: Uses Kinect skeleton tracking behind a large half-silvered mirror to draw recorded motion guides aligned with the user's reflection and score their accuracy.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机前摄+人体姿态识别（如MediaPipe/Effect House）叠加一个“老师骨架”，学生跟着做一套广播操并获得评分；变化：逐步淡化骨架直到完全隐藏。
works.description_zh: 一面 AR 镜子先录下专家的动作，再在学习者的镜像上叠加骨架引导和反馈来训练他们，并逐步撤去引导。
works.idea_en: An AR mirror overlays the teacher's moves on your reflection and teaches you the dance step by step.
works.technique_zh: 在大面积半透半反镜后方用 Kinect 进行骨架追踪，绘制与用户镜像对齐的录制动作引导，并为动作的准确度打分。
works.exercise_en: Use a phone's front camera and body pose recognition (such as MediaPipe or Effect House) to overlay a "teacher skeleton", and have students follow a set of calisthenics and get a score. Twist: gradually fade the skeleton until it is completely hidden.

works.title: castAR Kickstarter
works.description: Glasses with tiny projectors that bounce light off a retro-reflective mat, so each wearer sees their own correct-perspective 3D holograms, such as board games, on the table.
works.idea_zh: 眼镜里的微型投影仪打到反光板上，让每个人看到桌面上的立体全息游戏。

video.video_title: CastAR Kickstarter

works.technique: Head-mounted projectors cast a stereo image onto a retro-reflective mat that returns light mainly to its source, so each wearer sees only their own head-tracked perspective.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机前置人脸追踪实现头部耦合透视，把桌面上的平板变成一个有纵深的“全息桌面”；变体：两人从不同角度看同一个平板，讨论为什么只有一人看到正确透视。
works.description_zh: 一副装有微型投影仪的眼镜，光线打到回射反光垫上再反射回来，让每位佩戴者都能在桌面上看到属于自己、透视正确的三维全息影像，比如桌游。
works.idea_en: Tiny projectors in the glasses bounce off a reflective board so everyone sees 3D holographic games on the table.
works.technique_zh: 头戴投影仪把立体影像投射到回射反光垫上，反光垫主要把光送回光源方向，因此每位佩戴者只能看到自己经头部追踪校正的透视画面。
works.exercise_en: Use front-camera face tracking on a phone to create head-coupled perspective, turning a tablet lying on the table into a "holographic tabletop" with depth. Twist: have two people look at the same tablet from different angles and discuss why only one sees the correct perspective.

works.title: castAR at Maker Faire 2013
works.description: Jeri Ellsworth demonstrates the castAR glasses and wand, explaining how the technology she started at Valve tracks the head and projects stereo images onto the mat.
works.idea_zh: 展示从Valve带出来的AR眼镜和魔杖原型。

video.video_title: Cast AR 3D augmented-reality glasses interview w/ Jeri Ellsworth | Maker Faire 2013 | Engadget

works.technique: Head tracking relative to the mat, likely via camera-tracked markers, updates the off-axis stereo projection so holograms stay locked to the table.
works.exercise_zh: 用一个低成本材料（反光胶带或手电筒）做一个小实验，观察回射材料如何把光送回光源；变体：据此画出一个你设想的桌面 AR 设备草图。
works.description_zh: Jeri Ellsworth 演示 castAR 眼镜和魔杖，讲解这项她在 Valve 开始研发的技术如何追踪头部，并把立体影像投射到反光垫上。
works.idea_en: A demo of the AR glasses and wand prototype that came out of Valve.
works.technique_zh: 通过相对反光垫进行头部追踪（大概率借助摄像头追踪标记点），实时更新离轴立体投影，使全息影像牢牢固定在桌面上。
works.exercise_en: Run a small experiment with cheap materials (reflective tape and a flashlight) to see how retroreflective material sends light back to its source. Twist: based on this, sketch a tabletop AR device of your own design.

works.title: cube (Sónar Tokyo)
works.description: ELEVENPLAY dancers perform inside and around cube frames while computer-vision tracking turns their movement into live graphics and LED light cues.
works.idea_zh: 舞者在立方体框架中舞动，动作被实时转成光与图形
works.technique: Computer-vision tracking (by Satoru Higa) of dancers drives real-time visuals and LED 'jockeying', likely projected onto and around the cube frames.
works.exercise_zh: 用摄像头追踪同学在纸箱框架里的手部位置，实时控制投影到框架上的线条；变化：每个框架只响应一个人，形成“光的合奏”。

video.video_title: ELEVENPLAY x Rhizomatiks "cube" (2013)

works.description_zh: ELEVENPLAY 的舞者在立方体框架内外起舞，计算机视觉追踪把她们的动作实时转化为图形和 LED 灯光效果。
works.idea_en: Dancers move inside cube frames as their motion turns into live light and graphics.
works.technique_zh: 由 Satoru Higa 负责的计算机视觉追踪捕捉舞者，驱动实时影像和 LED 灯光操控，影像可能投射在立方体框架上及其周围。
works.exercise_en: Use a camera to track the hand positions of classmates inside cardboard frames and control lines projected onto the frames in real time. Twist: each frame responds to only one person, forming an "ensemble of light".

works.title: exTouch
works.description: Point a tablet at a small robot and drag its on-screen AR image with your finger; the real robot drives and rotates to match the gesture in physical space.
works.idea_zh: 在手机AR画面里拖动物体，现实中的机器人就跟着动：AR画面变成实体遥控器。

video.video_title: exTouch

works.technique: Tracks the robot's pose with the tablet camera and converts touch-drag gestures on its AR image into motor commands in the robot's own coordinate frame.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机AR识别一个遥控小车上的图片标记，在屏幕上拖动虚拟箭头来驱动实体小车（可用Arduino/蓝牙车）；变化：让两位同学各用一部手机从不同角度同时操控同一辆车。
works.description_zh: 把平板对准一台小机器人，用手指拖动屏幕上它的 AR 影像，真实的机器人就会在物理空间中移动、转向，与手势保持一致。
works.idea_en: Drag an object in the phone's AR view and the real robot follows, turning the AR screen into a physical remote control.
works.technique_zh: 用平板摄像头追踪机器人的位姿，把在其 AR 影像上的触摸拖动手势转换为机器人自身坐标系中的电机指令。
works.exercise_en: Use phone AR to recognize an image marker on a remote-control car, and drag a virtual arrow on screen to drive the real car (an Arduino or Bluetooth car works). Twist: let two classmates control the same car at once, each with a phone from a different angle.

works.title: inFORM
works.description: Daniel Leithinger and Sean Follmer's 30x30 motorized pin display renders 3D content and remote users' hands physically; objects on the table can be moved by the surface itself.
works.idea_zh: 让屏幕上的像素变成能升降的实体'像素'，远方的手可以真的推动桌上的球。

video.video_title: inFORM - Interacting With a Dynamic Shape Display

works.technique: An array of 900 motorized pins is actuated to render a height map, a Kinect captures remote hands and objects as depth images that are downsampled to pin heights, and a projector colors the pin tops.
works.exercise_zh: 用摄像头或深度相机（或 MediaPipe 手部关键点）把手的形状转换成 10x10 的高度图，在 three.js 里用柱子阵列实时渲染，并把颜色投影到桌面；变体：做一个 3x3 的实体版本（舵机推动木棍）只显示最关键的一个信息。
