works.description_zh: Daniel Leithinger 和 Sean Follmer 打造的 30×30 电动针脚显示器，能以实体形式呈现三维内容和远程用户的手；桌上的物体可以被表面本身推动。
works.idea_en: Turn screen pixels into physical pixels that rise and fall, so a faraway hand can really push a ball on your table.
works.technique_zh: 由 900 根电动针脚组成的阵列通过升降呈现高度图；Kinect 把远程的手和物体捕捉为深度图像，降采样为针脚高度；投影仪为针脚顶端上色。
works.exercise_en: Convert the shape of a hand into a 10x10 height map with a camera or depth camera (or MediaPipe hand keypoints), render it live as an array of pillars in three.js, and project the colors onto a table. Twist: build a 3x3 physical version (servos pushing wooden sticks) that shows only the single most important piece of information.

works.title: us+
works.description: A Google Hangout app that analyzes speech and facial expressions during a video call and overlays live feedback and automatic interventions to 'improve' the conversation.
works.idea_zh: 视频通话里的AI“社交教练”：实时分析你的表情和话语并在画面上提醒你。

video.video_title: us+

works.technique: Webcam face tracking and speech-to-text with sentiment/word-count analysis run during the video call, and rule-based triggers overlay text prompts and auto-mute when thresholds are crossed.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Web Speech API 和 MediaPipe 做一个视频聊天“教练”网页，统计谁说话多、谁在笑，并弹出提示；变体：加入一条过分的自动干预规则（比如你说“我”太多就被静音），体验被算法管理的对话。
works.description_zh: 一款 Google Hangout 应用，在视频通话中分析说话内容和面部表情，并叠加实时反馈和自动干预，以“改善”对话。
works.idea_en: An AI "social coach" in video calls that reads your face and words and nudges you on screen in real time.
works.technique_zh: 视频通话过程中运行网络摄像头面部追踪和语音转文字，并进行情感和词频分析；一旦超过阈值，基于规则的触发器就会叠加文字提示或自动静音。
works.exercise_en: Build a video-chat "coach" web page with the Web Speech API and MediaPipe that tracks who talks most and who is smiling, and pops up prompts. Twist: add one excessive automatic intervention rule (for example, you get muted if you say "I" too often) and experience a conversation managed by an algorithm.

works.title: Abraham Lincoln: War Veteran Projection
works.description: For a month, the bronze Abraham Lincoln statue in New York's Union Square speaks with the faces, gestures and voices of veterans of the Vietnam, Iraq and Afghanistan wars, projected precisely onto the statue.
works.description_zh: 整整一个月，纽约联合广场上的林肯铜像借用越战、伊拉克和阿富汗战争退伍军人的脸、手势和声音开口说话，影像被精准地投在雕像上。
works.idea_en: Let living people borrow a monument's body to tell the stories it never told.
works.idea_zh: 让普通人借用纪念碑的身体，讲出它从未讲过的故事。
works.technique: Veterans were filmed with a camera fixed to their head so the face stays still, then the footage was warped to match the statue's face and hands and projected at night.
works.technique_zh: 拍摄时摄像头固定在退伍军人头上，使脸部在画面中保持不动；之后把画面变形对齐到雕像的脸和手上，在夜间投影。
works.exercise_en: Film a classmate's face with a phone rigidly attached to their head, then use MadMapper or a projection-mapping web tool to fit the video onto a bust, mask or plaster head. Twist: let the object answer questions from the audience.
works.exercise_zh: 用固定在同学头上的手机拍摄他的脸，再用 MadMapper 或网页投影映射工具把视频贴合到一座胸像、面具或石膏头像上；变体：让这个物体回答观众的提问。

video.video_title: Abraham Lincoln: War Veteran Projection, 2012

works.title: All the Universe is Full of the Lives of Perfect Creatures
works.description: Looking into a mirror, the viewer sees an animal's head overlaid exactly on their own reflection, mimicking their head movement and facial expressions.
works.idea_zh: 照镜子时你的脸变成一只动物，并同步你的表情
works.technique: A camera behind a half-silvered mirror runs FaceTracker (ofxFaceTracker) and drives a 3D animal head rendered on a display so it aligns with the viewer's reflection.
works.exercise_zh: 用MediaPipe Face Mesh驱动一个动物头像，叠在镜像画面上同步眨眼张嘴；变化：用半透镜+显示器做成真正的“魔镜”，并让动物有时不听话。

video.video_title: All the Universe is Full of the Lives of Perfect Creatures

works.description_zh: 观众照镜子时，会看到一个动物头像精确地叠在自己的镜像上，模仿自己的头部动作和面部表情。
works.idea_en: Your face turns into an animal in the mirror and copies your expressions.
works.technique_zh: 半透半反镜后方的摄像头运行 FaceTracker（ofxFaceTracker），驱动显示器上渲染的三维动物头部，使其与观众的镜像对齐。
works.exercise_en: Drive an animal head with MediaPipe Face Mesh, overlaid on the mirrored video so it blinks and opens its mouth in sync. Twist: build a real "magic mirror" with a half-silvered mirror and a monitor, and have the animal sometimes disobey.

works.title: Archifon
works.description: Up to ten visitors aim laser pointers at the columns, arches and statues of a deconsecrated Baroque chapel, and each architectural element they hit lights up with projection and plays a sound, turning the chapel into a giant instrument.
works.description_zh: 最多十位观众拿着激光笔对准一座已废弃巴洛克礼拜堂的柱子、拱券和雕像，被照到的建筑构件就会亮起投影并发出声音，整座礼拜堂变成一件巨大的乐器。
works.idea_en: Play architecture like an instrument by pointing at it.
works.idea_zh: 用手指（激光笔）点一点，就能把建筑当乐器来演奏。
works.technique: A camera tracks the laser dots on the mapped interior, and each surface of the 3D-mapped chapel is linked to visuals and Max/MSP sound triggers.
works.technique_zh: 摄像头追踪投影内部的激光光点，礼拜堂三维映射后的每个表面都与相应的画面和 Max/MSP 声音触发绑定。
works.exercise_en: Point a webcam at a projected wall, detect a red laser dot with OpenCV or p5.js, and divide the wall into six zones that each play a note and flash. Twist: make zones need two lasers at once to sound a chord.
works.exercise_zh: 把摄像头对准投影墙面，用 OpenCV 或 p5.js 检测红色激光点，把墙面分成六个区域，每个区域被照到时闪亮并发出一个音；变体：某些区域需要两支激光同时照射才能奏出和弦。

video.video_title: Archifon I. - Interactive Installation

works.title: Assembly
works.description: A hemisphere of 5,500 suspended white blocks is scanned and coated with pixels from external projectors, forming a habitat for digital forms inside physical space.
works.idea_zh: 5500块悬挂的方块被投影“涂上”像素，数字形体住进真实空间。

video.video_title: Assembly

works.technique: Projector-camera structured-light scanning locates each suspended block in 3D, so multiple projectors can address the blocks as volumetric pixels for animated forms.
works.exercise_zh: 在纸箱里吊 30 个白色小方块，投影仪逐块点亮并记录位置，做一个“体素屏幕”显示一个会游动的形状；变体：用全班每人做的一块方块组成，每块亮起时显示主人的名字。
works.description_zh: 由 5500 块悬挂白色方块组成的半球体，经过扫描后由外部投影仪为其“涂上”像素，在实体空间中为数字形体营造出一个栖息地。
works.idea_en: 5,500 hanging blocks are painted with projected pixels, letting digital forms live in real space.
works.technique_zh: 投影仪-相机结构光扫描确定每个悬挂方块在三维空间中的位置，使多台投影仪能把这些方块当作体素像素来寻址，呈现动态形体。
works.exercise_en: Hang 30 small white cubes in a cardboard box, light them one by one with a projector and record their positions, and build a "voxel screen" that shows a swimming shape. Twist: make it from one cube per student, each showing its owner's name when it lights up.

works.title: Augmented City
works.description: A vision video in which a phone and glasses recognize buildings, shop fronts and objects in a city block and layer navigation, offers and interactive content directly onto them.
works.description_zh: 一段愿景视频：手机和眼镜识别街区里的建筑、店面和物体，并直接在它们上面叠加导航、优惠和互动内容。
works.idea_en: Every surface of a city is a potential screen once the camera recognizes it.
works.idea_zh: 只要摄像头能认出来，城市里的每个表面都可能成为屏幕。
works.technique: Metaio's markerless 3D tracking and junaio channels recognize building facades and objects from edge and feature models to anchor content without GPS drift.
works.technique_zh: Metaio 的无标记 3D 追踪和 junaio 频道，通过边缘和特征模型识别建筑立面与物体，在不受 GPS 漂移影响的情况下锚定内容。
works.exercise_en: Photograph three storefronts or building entrances near campus, turn them into image targets, and attach one useful piece of information to each. Twist: make the information change with the time of day.
works.exercise_zh: 拍下校园附近的三个店面或建筑入口，把它们设为图像标记，给每个附上一条有用信息。变体：让信息随一天中的时间变化。

video.video_title: Metaio's Augmented City Demo

works.title: Augmented Gesture with Post-its
works.description: Cheap coloured Post-it notes on the fingers become gesture trackers for controlling a web 3D scene.
works.idea_zh: 把便利贴贴在手指上，就成了网页手势追踪器。

video.video_title: postit works so well for augmented gesture!

works.technique: Color thresholding on the webcam image finds the centroids of brightly colored Post-its on the fingers, which serve as low-cost gesture input points.
works.exercise_zh: 在网页中用颜色阈值追踪手指上的彩色便利贴，用它们的位置旋转一个 three.js 物体；变体：两种颜色距离变小时判定为“捏合”。
works.description_zh: 贴在手指上的廉价彩色便利贴变成手势追踪器，用来控制网页中的三维场景。
works.idea_en: Stick Post-its on your fingers and they become a web gesture tracker.
works.technique_zh: 对摄像头画面做颜色阈值分割，找出手指上鲜艳便利贴的质心，把它们作为低成本的手势输入点。
works.exercise_en: Track colored Post-its on your fingers with color thresholding in a web page and use their positions to rotate a three.js object. Twist: detect a "pinch" when the two colors get close to each other.

works.title: Augmented Pong in 3D
works.description: A 3D Pong game in which the paddles are driven by physical markers held in front of the webcam.
works.idea_zh: 拿着实体标记当球拍，在浏览器里打 3D 乒乓。

video.video_title: Augmented Pong in 3D

works.technique: Two fiducial markers are tracked from the webcam, and their screen positions are mapped to paddle positions in a three.js Pong game.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR.js 追踪两张标记卡作为球拍，在它们之间用 three.js 做一个来回弹的球；变体：球速随两张卡的距离变化。
works.description_zh: 一款三维乒乓（Pong）游戏，球拍由举在网络摄像头前的实体标记来控制。
works.idea_en: Hold physical markers as paddles and play 3D Pong in the browser.
works.technique_zh: 通过网络摄像头追踪两个基准标记，并把它们在屏幕上的位置映射为 three.js 乒乓游戏中的球拍位置。
works.exercise_en: Track two marker cards with AR.js as paddles and use three.js to make a ball bounce back and forth between them. Twist: the ball speed changes with the distance between the two cards.

works.title: Augmented Reality Sandbox
works.description: Shape real sand with your hands; a Kinect reads the terrain and a projector paints elevation colors and contour lines onto it, and holding out a hand makes virtual rain that flows downhill.
works.idea_zh: 用手堆沙子，投影实时画出等高线；伸手就能'下雨'，水顺着沙丘流下。

video.video_title: Augmented Reality Sandbox with Real-Time Water Flow Simulation

works.technique: A Kinect above the sandbox measures the sand's height map, which is filtered and used to color an elevation map with contour lines projected back onto the sand, while a shallow-water simulation runs rain across the terrain.
works.exercise_zh: 用深度相机（或用一盘彩色黏土加 RGB 摄像头近似）测量高度，在 TouchDesigner 中生成等高线和海拔配色，投影回沙盘或黏土上；变体：把“雨水”换成另一种东西，比如人群、火或声音的传播。
works.description_zh: 用双手塑造真实的沙子，Kinect 读取地形，投影仪在沙面上绘出海拔配色和等高线；伸出一只手，就会降下虚拟的雨，雨水顺着地势向下流淌。
works.idea_en: Pile up sand by hand while projection draws contour lines live; hold out a hand to make it rain down the dunes.
works.technique_zh: 沙盘上方的 Kinect 测量沙面高度图，经过滤波后用于生成带等高线的海拔配色图并投影回沙面；同时运行浅水模拟，让雨水在地形上流动。
works.exercise_en: Measure height with a depth camera (or approximate it with a tray of colored clay and an RGB camera), generate contour lines and elevation colors in TouchDesigner, and project them back onto the sand or clay. Twist: replace the "rain" with something else that spreads, such as crowds, fire or sound.

works.title: Augmented Reality in Your Browser
works.description: A 2012 screencast showing marker-based AR running in a desktop web browser via WebRTC webcam access and JSARToolKit.
works.idea_zh: 2012 年就在浏览器里跑起来的网页 AR。

video.video_title: Augmented Reality in your Browser

works.technique: WebRTC getUserMedia streams the webcam into a canvas, JSARToolKit detects square fiducial markers and estimates their pose, and three.js renders 3D content with that pose over the video.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR.js（或 MindAR）在网页中识别打印的 Hiro 标记并显示一个旋转的 3D 模型；变体：让模型根据标记倾斜的角度改变颜色。
works.description_zh: 一段 2012 年的录屏，展示借助 WebRTC 调用网络摄像头和 JSARToolKit，在桌面网页浏览器中运行基于标记的 AR。
works.idea_en: Web AR already running in the browser back in 2012.
works.technique_zh: WebRTC 的 getUserMedia 把摄像头画面传入 canvas，JSARToolKit 检测方形基准标记并估算其位姿，three.js 再按该位姿把三维内容渲染在视频之上。
works.exercise_en: Use AR.js (or MindAR) to recognize a printed Hiro marker in a web page and display a spinning 3D model. Twist: make the model change color according to how far the marker is tilted.

works.title: Beamatron
works.description: A steerable projector and Kinect on a pan-tilt head follow people around a room, projecting a virtual car that drives over real furniture and floors.
works.idea_zh: 会转头的投影机器人，让虚拟遥控车在真实房间的家具上开来开去。

video.video_title: Beamatron

works.technique: A projector and Kinect sit on a motorized pan-tilt head; the room is pre-scanned into a 3D model, and imagery is pre-distorted per surface as the head steers so content stays correct while moving across furniture.
works.exercise_zh: 把小投影仪放在可手动或舵机转动的云台上，用 TouchDesigner 根据角度切换画面，让一辆投影的小车沿墙和地板“开”过去；变体：让小车追着房间里的某个人（用摄像头检测）跑。
works.description_zh: 装在云台上的可转向投影仪和 Kinect 跟随房间里的人移动，投射出一辆虚拟小车，在真实的家具和地板上行驶。
works.idea_en: A head-turning projector robot lets a virtual RC car drive over the real furniture in a room.
works.technique_zh: 投影仪和 Kinect 安装在电动云台上；房间事先被扫描成三维模型，云台转动时按表面对画面进行预畸变，使内容在跨越家具移动时仍保持正确。
works.exercise_en: Put a small projector on a pan-tilt mount turned by hand or servo, switch the image in TouchDesigner based on the angle, and make a projected little car "drive" along the wall and floor. Twist: have the car chase a particular person in the room (detected by a camera).

works.title: Border Memorial: Frontera de los Muertos
works.description: Geolocated AR skeletal effigies (inspired by Día de los Muertos) mark the exact places where migrants died crossing the US-Mexico border.
works.idea_zh: 在移民死亡的确切地点放置AR亡灵纪念碑

video.video_title: Border Memorial: Frontera de los Muertos

works.technique: GPS-anchored Layar objects place skeletal effigies at the coordinates of recorded migrant deaths, turning a dataset into a geolocated memorial.
works.exercise_zh: 用一份与地点相关的公开数据（交通事故点、消失的小店），在 WebAR 中每个数据点放一个小纪念物；变体：让纪念物的形态由该数据点的具体信息生成。
works.description_zh: 基于地理位置的 AR 骷髅塑像（灵感来自亡灵节）标记出移民在穿越美墨边境时丧生的确切地点。
works.idea_en: Place AR memorials of the dead at the exact spots where migrants died.
works.technique_zh: 以 GPS 锚定的 Layar 对象把骷髅塑像放在有记录的移民死亡地点坐标上，把一份数据集变成一座基于地理位置的纪念碑。
works.exercise_en: Take a public place-based dataset (traffic accident sites, shops that have disappeared) and put a small memorial at each data point in WebAR. Twist: generate each memorial's form from the specific details of its data point.

works.title: Botanicus Interacticus
works.description: Living plants become interactive: stroking, pinching or sliding along a stem is sensed through the plant itself and triggers projected visuals and sound.
works.idea_zh: 抚摸一株真植物，它会发出声音和光影。

video.video_title: "BOTANICUS INTERACTICUS" SIGGRAPH 2012 installation

works.technique: Places a single electrode in the plant's soil and applies Touché-style swept-frequency sensing to locate and classify touches on the plant.
works.exercise_zh: 把盆栽接到Makey Makey或触摸传感器上，触摸叶片时在手机或投影上长出虚拟花朵并发声；变化：两人同时触摸时才会开花。
works.description_zh: 让活的植物变得可以互动：抚摸、捏住或沿着茎滑动，都能通过植物本身被感知，并触发投影影像和声音。
works.idea_en: Stroke a real plant and it answers with sound, light and shadow.
works.technique_zh: 在植物的土壤中插入一个电极，采用 Touché 式的扫频感应技术，对植物上的触摸进行定位和分类。
works.exercise_en: Connect a potted plant to a Makey Makey or touch sensor so touching a leaf grows virtual flowers with sound on a phone or projection. Twist: the flowers only bloom when two people touch the plant at the same time.

works.title: BubbleWhere
works.description: A proof of concept in which the phone finds any round object in view, such as a plate, coaster or logo, grabs its texture on the fly, and turns it into a trackable AR bubble.
works.description_zh: 一个概念验证：手机在画面里找到任何圆形物体，比如盘子、杯垫或标志，即时截取它的纹理，把它变成可追踪的 AR 气泡。
works.idea_en: Any circle in the world can become an instant AR marker.
works.idea_zh: 世界上的任何圆形都能瞬间变成 AR 标记。
works.technique: Real-time ellipse detection finds circles, rectifies and captures their texture, and then tracks the circle's pose as a new target without prior training.
works.technique_zh: 实时椭圆检测找出圆形，校正并截取其纹理，然后在无需事先训练的情况下把该圆作为新目标追踪其位姿。
works.exercise_en: Use OpenCV Hough circles on a phone camera feed to find round objects and pin a small animated creature onto each one. Twist: creatures jump between circles when two are close together.
works.exercise_zh: 在手机摄像头画面上用 OpenCV 霍夫圆检测找出圆形物体，在每个圆上放一只小动画生物。变体：当两个圆靠得很近时，小生物会在它们之间跳来跳去。

video.video_title: BubbleWhere - Augmented Reality Proof of Concept

works.title: BurnAR
works.description: Looking at their own hands through a headset, users see flames and smoke rising from their skin; some report an involuntary feeling of heat although nothing is warm.
works.description_zh: 用户通过头显看自己的手，会看到火焰和烟从皮肤上冒出；尽管没有任何东西是热的，有些人仍会不由自主地感到发热。
works.idea_en: Convincing AR on your own body can trigger real bodily sensations.
works.idea_zh: 在自己身体上足够逼真的 AR，能引发真实的身体感受。
works.technique: Segments the user's hands in a video see-through HMD and overlays real-time volumetric fire and smoke that follow the hand motion.
works.technique_zh: 在视频透视头显中分割出用户的双手，并叠加随手部运动的实时体积火焰和烟雾。
works.exercise_en: Apply a phone hand-tracking AR effect that puts fire or ice on the hands, then ask classmates to rate warmth or cold on a scale while blindfolded partners compare. Twist: add a matching crackling sound and see if ratings rise.
works.exercise_zh: 使用手机手部追踪 AR 特效，在手上加火焰或冰霜，请同学按量表评估冷热感，再与蒙眼的对照组比较；变体：加上相应的噼啪声，看评分是否上升。

video.video_title: BurnAR: Feel the Heat (ISMAR 2012)

works.title: ClonAR
works.description: A real object is scanned with a Kinect, and its clone appears in AR where the user can feel and sculpt it with a haptic pen before sending it off to be printed.
works.description_zh: 用 Kinect 扫描一个真实物体，它的克隆体出现在 AR 中，用户可以用触觉笔触摸并雕刻它，再拿去打印。
works.idea_en: Scan, touch and remix a real object in AR in one continuous loop.
works.idea_zh: 在 AR 中扫描、触摸并改造真实物体，一气呵成。
works.technique: Uses KinectFusion signed distance fields directly for both haptic rendering and GPU raymarched visuals, skipping mesh conversion.
works.technique_zh: 把 KinectFusion 生成的有符号距离场直接用于触觉渲染和 GPU 光线步进渲染，省去网格转换。
works.exercise_en: Scan a small object with a phone 3D-scan app, place the copy next to the original in AR, and use a sculpting app to redesign it. Twist: print or build the redesigned version from clay and compare.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机三维扫描 App 扫描一个小物件，在 AR 中把复制品放在原物旁边，再用雕刻 App 重新设计它；变体：用黏土把新设计做出来并与原物比较。

video.video_title: ClonAR: Rapid Redesign of Real-World Objects (ISMAR 2012)

works.title: Future Self (with Wayne McGregor)
works.description: A three-dimensional sculpture of hanging LED rods renders a light-figure that mirrors and responds to the dancers or visitors moving in front of it.
works.idea_zh: 用LED杆阵组成会映出你动作的“光之分身”
works.technique: Depth cameras capture the body and drive a volumetric LED matrix so the silhouette is rendered as points of light in 3D.
works.exercise_zh: 用Kinect或手机深度相机把身体变成3D点云，在屏幕上用发光点显示；变化：让光之分身比真人慢半拍，成为“未来的你”的反面。

video.video_title: rAndom international: future self

works.description_zh: 一件由悬挂 LED 灯杆构成的三维雕塑，呈现出一个光之人形，映照并回应在它面前移动的舞者或观众。
works.idea_en: An array of LED rods forms a "light double" that mirrors your movements.
works.technique_zh: 深度相机捕捉人体，驱动一个体积式 LED 矩阵，把身体剪影以三维光点的形式呈现出来。
works.exercise_en: Turn your body into a 3D point cloud with a Kinect or a phone depth camera and display it as glowing dots on screen. Twist: make the light double lag half a beat behind you, the opposite of a "future you".

works.title: HoloDesk
works.description: A see-through display over a desk lets you reach under it and juggle, grasp and share virtual 3D objects with your real hands, with correct occlusion.
works.idea_zh: 把手伸到半透明镜面下，直接用真手托起、抛接虚拟小球。

video.video_title: HoloDesk - Direct 3D Interactions with a Situated See-Through Display

works.technique: A beam splitter shows a display's image in the volume under it, a head-tracking camera provides view-dependent rendering, and a Kinect's depth of the hands is converted into particle proxies that physically interact with and occlude virtual objects.
works.exercise_zh: 用平板加 45° 斜放的亚克力板做一个“佩珀尔幻象”盒子，把 MediaPipe 检测到的手部关键点接到物理引擎里，让手能在盒子里拨动虚拟方块；变体：在盒子里放一个真实物体，让虚拟物体绕开它。
works.description_zh: 桌面上方的一块透视显示屏让你可以把手伸到它下面，用真实的双手抛接、抓握并分享虚拟三维物体，遮挡关系也完全正确。
works.idea_en: Reach under a half-mirror and catch and toss virtual balls with your real hands.
works.technique_zh: 分光镜把显示器的画面呈现在其下方的空间里，头部追踪摄像头提供视点相关渲染，Kinect 获取的手部深度被转换为粒子代理，与虚拟物体发生物理交互并正确遮挡它们。
works.exercise_en: Build a "Pepper's ghost" box from a tablet and a sheet of acrylic tilted at 45 degrees, and feed the hand keypoints detected by MediaPipe into a physics engine so your hand can nudge virtual cubes inside the box. Twist: put a real object in the box and make the virtual objects move around it.

works.title: Holoflector
works.description: A large half-silvered mirror with a display behind it and Kinect body tracking: virtual objects appear in your reflection and react to your real body.
works.idea_zh: 一面魔镜：镜中的你能接住虚拟的球，镜像与虚拟物体完美对位。

video.video_title: Holoflector

works.technique: A half-silvered mirror in front of an LCD combines the real reflection with rendered graphics, and Kinect skeleton tracking places virtual objects so they align with the user's reflected body.
works.exercise_zh: 用一台平板加一块亚克力半透镜（或用镜像的摄像头画面）做一面“魔镜”，用 MediaPipe Pose 让虚拟小球落在你反射的肩膀上并可被拍掉；变体：镜子里的你做出和你不一样的动作。
works.description_zh: 一面大尺寸半透半反镜，背后装有显示屏并配合 Kinect 身体追踪：虚拟物体会出现在你的镜像中，并对你真实的身体作出反应。
works.idea_en: A magic mirror where your reflection can catch a virtual ball, with the image and the virtual objects lined up exactly.
works.technique_zh: LCD 前方的半透半反镜把真实的镜像与渲染出的图形合在一起，Kinect 骨架追踪确定虚拟物体的位置，使其与用户镜像中的身体对齐。
works.exercise_en: Build a "magic mirror" from a tablet and an acrylic half-mirror (or a mirrored camera feed), and use MediaPipe Pose so a virtual ball lands on your reflected shoulder and can be brushed off. Twist: your reflection makes a different move from the one you make.

works.title: Ingress
works.description: A location-based sci-fi game where two factions capture real-world landmarks as 'portals' by walking to them with a phone and link them into territory control fields.
works.idea_zh: 把真实城市地标变成两大阵营争夺的传送门，走路就是玩法。

video.video_title: Ingress - It's time to Move.

works.technique: GPS location is matched against a database of geotagged landmarks, and a proximity radius decides when a player can interact with a portal, making the map itself the AR layer.
works.exercise_zh: 在校园地图上标出 5 个“据点”，用浏览器定位 API 判断玩家是否在 30 米内，到达即可占领；变体：两个相邻据点都被同一方占领时自动连线成领地。
works.description_zh: 一款基于位置的科幻游戏：两大阵营的玩家拿着手机走到真实世界的地标处，把它们作为“传送门”占领，再把传送门连接起来形成控制领地。
works.idea_en: Real city landmarks become portals fought over by two factions, and walking is the gameplay.
works.technique_zh: 把 GPS 位置与带地理标签的地标数据库进行匹配，用一个邻近半径判定玩家何时可以与传送门互动，让地图本身成为 AR 图层。
works.exercise_en: Mark 5 "strongholds" on a campus map and use the browser Geolocation API to check whether a player is within 30 meters, capturing a stronghold on arrival. Twist: when two neighboring strongholds belong to the same side, they automatically link into territory.

works.title: It's You
works.description: Projected figures crowd around something hidden; when a pedestrian stands behind them as if to look over their shoulders, they step aside to reveal part of the scene, blocking it for others.
works.idea_zh: 投影人群挡住了秘密，只有你凑近时他们才让开给你看
works.technique: A camera detects a pedestrian's position in the interaction zone and triggers animation branches of the projected crowd that open a view at that spot.
works.exercise_zh: 投一群背对观众的剪影人，用摄像头检测谁站到后面，就让对应位置的人让开露出隐藏图像；变化：隐藏的内容由上一位观众留下的一句话组成。

video.video_title: It's You

works.description_zh: 投影出的人群围在某个隐藏的东西周围；当路人站到他们身后，像是要越过他们肩膀张望时，这些人就会让开，露出场景的一部分，同时又挡住了其他人的视线。
works.idea_en: A projected crowd hides a secret, and only steps aside when you lean in.
works.technique_zh: 摄像头检测路人在互动区域中的位置，触发投影人群的不同动画分支，在该位置让出一个观看的缺口。
works.exercise_en: Project a crowd of silhouettes with their backs to the audience, and use a camera to detect who steps behind them so the figures at that spot move aside and reveal a hidden image. Twist: the hidden content is a sentence left by the previous visitor.

works.title: Kid Icarus: Uprising AR Cards
works.description: Collectible AR cards for Kid Icarus: Uprising; placing two cards in front of the 3DS makes the characters appear and battle each other on the table.
works.idea_zh: 两张实体卡放在桌上，卡上的角色就跳出来对战。

video.video_title: Nintendo 3DS - Kid Icarus: Uprising How to Play Video 3

works.technique: Two cards are detected at once as image targets, and the relative pose between them determines the characters' facing and battle stats.
works.exercise_zh: 用两张图像标记卡各召唤一个角色，卡片距离越近两者越激动，对面朝向时开始战斗；变体：卡片叠放时两个角色合体。
works.description_zh: 《新光神话：帕尔提娜之镜》（Kid Icarus: Uprising）的收藏型 AR 卡片；把两张卡片放在 3DS 前面，卡上的角色就会出现在桌面上互相对战。
works.idea_en: Put two physical cards on the table and the characters jump out to fight.
works.technique_zh: 同时把两张卡片识别为图像目标，由两者之间的相对位姿决定角色的朝向和战斗数值。
works.exercise_en: Summon one character from each of two image marker cards, so the closer the cards the more excited the characters get, and they start fighting when facing each other. Twist: stacking the cards merges the two characters into one.

works.title: LightGuide
works.description: A ceiling projector draws arrows, color gradients and 3D cues directly on the user's hand to guide it along a precise movement path.
works.idea_zh: 把动作提示直接投影在你的手上，手跟着光走。

video.video_title: LightGuide: Projected Visualizations for Hand Movement Guidance

works.technique: Tracks the hand with a depth camera and renders movement-guidance visualizations warped onto the hand surface in real time.
works.exercise_zh: 用投影仪在桌面/手上投射一条动画路径，让同学用手跟随画出一个字母；变化：用手机AR改为在屏幕上把箭头贴在手上，比较两种引导的准确度。
works.description_zh: 天花板上的投影仪把箭头、颜色渐变和三维提示直接画在用户手上，引导手沿着精确的运动路径移动。
works.idea_en: Project movement cues straight onto your hand and let the hand follow the light.
works.technique_zh: 用深度相机追踪手部，实时把运动引导可视化内容经形变后渲染到手的表面上。
works.exercise_en: Project an animated path onto the table or a hand and have a classmate follow it with their hand to draw a letter. Twist: switch to phone AR that pins the arrows to the hand on screen, and compare the accuracy of the two kinds of guidance.

works.title: Lighting the Sails (Sydney Opera House)
works.description: A projected homage to Jørn Utzon in which the Opera House sails appear to be unfolded, rebuilt and given a human, breathing expression.
works.idea_zh: 让悉尼歌剧院的“帆”在投影中被拆解、重建并呼吸
works.technique: Laser-scanned geometry of the curved shells guides multi-projector content that exaggerates their construction logic with simulated depth and light.
works.exercise_zh: 用一张弯曲的纸或灯罩当“帆”，投影线框在上面拆分重组；变化：用呼吸声的大小控制“帆”的鼓起程度。

video.video_title: SYDNEY OPERA HOUSE | Facade projection

works.description_zh: 一场向约恩·伍重（Jørn Utzon）致敬的投影作品，悉尼歌剧院的“风帆”仿佛被展开、重建，并被赋予了人性化的、会呼吸的表情。
works.idea_en: The sails of the Sydney Opera House are taken apart, rebuilt and made to breathe in projection.
works.technique_zh: 以激光扫描得到的曲面壳体几何为依据制作多投影仪内容，用模拟的纵深和光影夸张地展现其建造逻辑。
works.exercise_en: Use a curved sheet of paper or a lampshade as a "sail" and project a wireframe onto it that splits apart and reassembles. Twist: let the loudness of breathing control how much the "sail" billows.

works.title: Meet Your Creator
works.description: Sixteen quadrotor drones carrying LEDs and motorized mirrors fly in formation over a theater stage, bouncing beams of light and building glowing sculptures in the air above the audience.
works.description_zh: 十六架携带 LED 和电动镜子的四旋翼无人机在剧场舞台上空编队飞行，反射光束，在观众头顶构建出发光的空中雕塑。
works.idea_en: Flying robots as moving light pixels that draw in the air of a theater.
works.idea_zh: 让会飞的机器人成为移动的光像素，在剧场空中作画。
works.technique: A motion-capture system tracks each drone and choreography software sends synchronized flight paths, LED colors and mirror angles to bounce stage lights.
works.technique_zh: 动作捕捉系统追踪每架无人机，编排软件同步下发飞行路径、LED 颜色和镜面角度，用来反射舞台灯光。
works.exercise_en: Choreograph a 60-second light show for five virtual drones in a 3D web scene (three.js), timing positions and colors to a song. Twist: add one real flashlight and a mirror in the classroom and aim the beam to hit a marked target.
works.exercise_zh: 在三维网页场景（three.js）里为五架虚拟无人机编排一段 60 秒的灯光秀，让位置和颜色与一首歌的节拍对应；变体：在教室里加一支真实手电筒和一面镜子，把光束反射到指定目标上。

video.video_title: MEET YOUR CREATOR   QUADROTOR SHOW

works.title: MirageTable
works.description: A curved projected tabletop with stereo glasses and Kinect: users grab virtual 3D objects with bare hands and meet a remote partner rendered as if sitting across the table.
works.idea_zh: 弯曲桌面+立体投影，徒手抓取虚拟物体，并与远方的人'隔桌相对'。

video.video_title: MirageTable: Freehand Interaction on a Projected Augmented Reality Tabletop.

works.technique: A Kinect captures the user and the remote partner as depth meshes, head-tracked stereo projection onto a curved screen renders view-dependent 3D, and a physics engine lets hand geometry push virtual objects.
works.exercise_zh: 用 three.js 做一个基于人脸追踪（MediaPipe Face）的视差桌面：摄像头追踪头部，屏幕或投影上的 3D 物体随视角变化产生“离屏”错觉；变体：把另一台电脑传来的对方视频放进这个 3D 空间里，做一个“隔桌对坐”的小游戏。
works.description_zh: 一张配合立体眼镜和 Kinect 的弧形投影桌面：用户可以徒手抓取虚拟三维物体，还能与远程伙伴见面，对方看起来就像坐在桌子对面。
works.idea_en: A curved desk with stereo projection lets you grab virtual objects by hand and sit "across the table" from someone far away.
works.technique_zh: Kinect 把用户和远程伙伴采集为深度网格，带头部追踪的立体投影在弧形屏幕上渲染视点相关的三维画面，物理引擎让手部几何能推动虚拟物体。
works.exercise_en: Build a parallax tabletop in three.js driven by face tracking (MediaPipe Face): a camera tracks your head, and 3D objects on the screen or projection shift with your viewpoint to create an "off-screen" illusion. Twist: put the other person's video from another computer into this 3D space and make a small "sitting across the table" game.

works.title: NerdHerder
works.description: A commercial tabletop AR game built with Qualcomm: herd panicking office nerds back to their cubicles by dangling donuts on a printed game board.
works.idea_zh: 在桌面上用甜甜圈引诱慌乱的书呆子回到工位。

video.video_title: NerdHerder Promo

works.technique: Vuforia image tracking of the printed board anchors a Unity game scene, and the phone's pose relative to the board is itself the controller, since the dangled donut follows where the camera points.
works.exercise_zh: 在 Unity + AR Foundation 中做一个“用手机位置当手柄”的小游戏：手机在图像目标上方的位置决定虚拟诱饵落点，引导虚拟小人走到目标区域；变体：诱饵换成声音或光，比较哪种引导更有趣。
works.description_zh: 与高通合作开发的商业桌面 AR 游戏：在一张印刷游戏板上晃动甜甜圈，把惊慌失措的办公室书呆子们赶回各自的工位。
works.idea_en: Lure panicking nerds back to their desks with a donut on your tabletop.
works.technique_zh: Vuforia 对印刷游戏板进行图像追踪，锚定 Unity 游戏场景；手机相对游戏板的位姿本身就是控制器，因为吊着的甜甜圈会跟随摄像头所指的位置移动。
works.exercise_en: Make a small game in Unity + AR Foundation that uses the phone's position as the controller: where the phone hovers above an image target decides where a virtual lure lands, guiding virtual little people to a goal area. Twist: swap the lure for sound or light, and compare which kind of guidance is more fun.

works.title: O (Omicron) (with Thomas Vaquié)
works.description: A permanent 360° projection on the concrete dome of Wrocław's Centennial Hall that reveals and reinterprets the ribbed structure of the 1913 building.
works.idea_zh: 用投影揭示一座百年混凝土穹顶的结构之美
works.technique: Multiple calibrated projectors cover the interior dome; content is authored on a 3D model of the rib structure so lines trace the real architecture.
works.exercise_zh: 把一把雨伞或纸圆顶当“穹顶”，用投影沿伞骨画出发光线条动画；变化：让线条沿结构“生长”，模拟建筑建造的过程。

video.video_title: O (Omicron)

works.description_zh: 弗罗茨瓦夫百年厅混凝土穹顶上的一件永久性 360° 投影作品，揭示并重新诠释了这座 1913 年建筑的肋拱结构。
works.idea_en: Use projection to reveal the structural beauty of a century-old concrete dome.
works.technique_zh: 多台经过标定的投影仪覆盖穹顶内侧，内容在肋拱结构的三维模型上制作，使线条能沿着真实建筑的走向描绘。
works.exercise_en: Use an umbrella or a paper dome as the "dome" and project glowing line animations along its ribs. Twist: make the lines "grow" along the structure to simulate the building being constructed.

works.title: Punch a Doom Character in AR
works.description: A browser mini-game in which you punch a Doom monster that appears in your webcam view.
works.idea_zh: 对着摄像头挥拳，打浏览器里的 Doom 怪物。

video.video_title: Punch a Doom Character in Augmented Reality

works.technique: Frame differencing (motion detection) in regions of the webcam image registers punches at the monster's screen position, rendered in three.js over the video.
works.exercise_zh: 用 p5.js 做摄像头帧差检测，在画面某区域检测到大幅运动时让怪物被击飞；变体：怪物会躲闪，需要从不同方向出拳。
works.description_zh: 一款浏览器小游戏，你要挥拳击打出现在网络摄像头画面中的 Doom 怪物。
works.idea_en: Throw punches at the camera to hit a Doom monster in the browser.
works.technique_zh: 在网络摄像头画面的若干区域中进行帧差（运动检测），在怪物所在的屏幕位置判定出拳，并用 three.js 把怪物渲染在视频之上。
works.exercise_en: Build camera frame differencing in p5.js so the monster gets knocked flying when a big motion is detected in a certain region of the frame. Twist: the monster dodges, so you have to punch from different directions.

works.title: REVEL
works.description: Olivier Bau and Ivan Poupyrev's reverse electrovibration injects a tiny signal into the user's body so that projected or AR virtual objects on real surfaces gain touchable textures.
works.idea_zh: 往人体里注入微弱信号，让投影出的虚拟物体摸起来有纹理。

video.video_title: Revel: Programming the Sense of Touch

works.technique: Reverse electrovibration injects a weak time-varying electrical signal into the user's body, creating an oscillating electrostatic attraction between the sliding finger and any grounded conductive surface, which is perceived as texture and can be modulated per virtual object.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机震动（Vibration API 或 Unity Handheld.Vibrate）在 AR 中模拟触感纹理：手指划过不同虚拟物体时播放不同频率和节奏的震动（REVEL 的电刺激不适合课堂复现）；变体：让同学闭眼仅凭震动猜出是哪种材质。
works.description_zh: Olivier Bau 和 Ivan Poupyrev 提出的反向电振动技术，向用户身体注入一个微弱信号，让真实表面上投影或 AR 呈现的虚拟物体拥有可以触摸到的纹理。
works.idea_en: Send a faint signal through the body so projected virtual objects have texture you can feel.
works.technique_zh: 反向电振动向用户身体注入微弱的时变电信号，在滑动的手指与任意接地的导电表面之间产生振荡的静电吸引力，被感知为纹理，并可针对每个虚拟物体分别调制。
works.exercise_en: Simulate tactile textures in AR with phone vibration (the Vibration API or Unity Handheld.Vibrate): play vibrations of different frequencies and rhythms as a finger slides over different virtual objects (REVEL's electrical stimulation is not suitable to reproduce in class). Twist: have classmates close their eyes and guess the material from the vibration alone.

works.title: Rain Room
works.description: A 100 m² field of continuously falling water pauses wherever a person walks, so visitors move through rain without getting wet.
works.idea_zh: 在一场只为你停下的雨中行走
works.technique: 3D cameras track visitors from above and a grid of solenoid valves shuts off the water tiles directly around each person in real time.
works.exercise_zh: 用摄像头俯拍+地面投影做“虚拟雨”，雨点在人周围自动避开；变化：用电磁阀或小水泵做一个1米见方的实体原型。

video.video_title: Random International: Rain Room

works.description_zh: 一片 100 平方米、持续降落的水幕，人走到哪里，哪里的雨就会停下，观众得以在雨中穿行而不被淋湿。
works.idea_en: Walk through rain that stops just for you.
works.technique_zh: 3D 相机从上方追踪观众，由电磁阀组成的网格实时关闭每个人周围那几块区域的水流。
works.exercise_en: Make "virtual rain" with an overhead camera and floor projection, so raindrops automatically avoid the area around each person. Twist: build a one-meter-square physical prototype with solenoid valves or a small water pump.

works.title: Reality Fighters
works.description: A PS Vita launch title in which players put their own photographed face on a fighter and brawl in AR on their real surroundings, filmed by the Vita's rear camera.
works.idea_zh: 把自己的脸贴到格斗角色上，在真实街道或客厅里AR对打。

video.video_title: Reality Fighters™ PS Vita Trailer

works.technique: A photographed face is mapped onto a fighter's head, and the characters are rendered over the rear camera feed anchored by an AR card.
works.exercise_zh: 用前置摄像头拍脸贴到 AR 格斗小人头上，在桌面上和同学的小人对打；变体：打输的一方脸部贴图会出现“伤痕”。
works.description_zh: PS Vita 的首发游戏之一：玩家把自己拍下的脸贴到格斗角色身上，在 Vita 后置摄像头拍到的真实环境中进行 AR 对打。
works.idea_en: Put your own face on a fighter and brawl in AR in a real street or living room.
works.technique_zh: 把拍下的人脸映射到格斗角色的头部，角色以 AR 卡片为锚点，渲染在后置摄像头的画面之上。
works.exercise_en: Take a photo of your face with the front camera, paste it onto the head of a tiny AR fighter, and fight a classmate's fighter on the table. Twist: the loser's face texture shows "scars".

works.title: SLAM Computer Vision Tank: See Through Walls
works.description: At Augmented Reality Event 2012, an iPhone mapped a real wall and street with markerless SLAM, and a virtual tank blasted holes through it that revealed a virtual world behind.
works.description_zh: 在 2012 年 Augmented Reality Event 上，一部 iPhone 用无标记 SLAM 建立了真实墙面和街道的地图，一辆虚拟坦克在墙上炸出洞，露出墙后的虚拟世界。
works.idea_en: Blast a hole in a real wall and peek into the world behind it.
works.idea_zh: 在真实墙上炸出一个洞，窥看墙后的世界。
works.technique: Markerless monocular SLAM (credited to Robert Castle's PTAM-style work) estimates the wall plane, and depth-masked holes render the virtual scene behind it.
works.technique_zh: 无标记单目 SLAM（致谢 Robert Castle 的 PTAM 类工作）估计墙面平面，再用深度遮罩的洞口渲染墙后的虚拟场景。
works.exercise_en: Detect a vertical plane and let each tap punch a circular hole that reveals a different virtual room behind the wall. Twist: holes slowly heal over unless the player keeps looking at them.
works.exercise_zh: 检测一个竖直平面，每次点击就打出一个圆洞，露出墙后不同的虚拟房间。变体：除非玩家一直盯着看，否则洞会慢慢愈合。

video.video_title: SLAM Computer Vision Tank: See Through Walls

works.title: Sagrada Familia - Ode à la Vie
works.description: A monumental projection-mapping show on Gaudí's Sagrada Família façade for La Mercè festival, making the stone appear to grow, flood and bloom.
works.idea_zh: 让圣家堂石墙生长、涌流、开花的投影秀

video.video_title: Sagrada Familia, Barcelona | Ode à la Vie Light & Sound Show

works.technique: Large-scale multi-projector architectural mapping with edge blending, using a detailed 3D model of the facade to render growth and flooding effects that respect its relief.
works.exercise_zh: 用一件有浮雕或复杂表面的物体（石膏像、雕花盒）做投影，让表面看起来在生长、被水淹没或开花；变体：表达这个物体“内心”的一段情绪。
works.description_zh: 在梅尔塞节（La Mercè）期间，于高迪的圣家堂立面上上演的一场宏大投影映射秀，让石墙看起来在生长、涌流、开花。
works.idea_en: A projection show that makes the stone walls of the Sagrada Família grow, flood and bloom.
works.technique_zh: 采用多投影仪边缘融合的大型建筑投影映射，借助精细的立面三维模型渲染生长与水流效果，并与其浮雕起伏精确贴合。
works.exercise_en: Project onto an object with relief or a complex surface (a plaster bust, a carved box) so its surface seems to grow, flood or bloom. Twist: express an emotion from the object's "inner life".

works.title: Second Surface
works.description: Shunichi Kasahara, Valentin Heun and Austin Lee let several people draw and leave notes on real surfaces around them through tablets; the drawings stay anchored in space for others to see.
works.idea_zh: 多人在真实物体表面上共同涂鸦留言，内容留在原地供他人发现。

video.video_title: SECOND SURFACE: MULTI-USER SPATIAL COLLABORATION SYSTEM BASED ON AUGMENTED REALITY (IN COLLABORATION WITH TANGIBLE MEDIA GROUP)

works.technique: Natural feature tracking of the surface texture gives each tablet a 6DOF pose relative to the same physical surface, so strokes stored in surface coordinates are shared over the network and rendered from every viewpoint.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 的共享锚点（或同一张图像目标）让两部手机看到同一块墙面，在上面画画留言并实时同步；变体：留言只有在特定时间或特定人靠近时才会出现。
works.description_zh: Shunichi Kasahara、Valentin Heun 和 Austin Lee 让多人通过平板在身边的真实表面上画画、留言，这些涂鸦会固定在空间中，供其他人看到。
works.idea_en: Several people doodle and leave notes on real surfaces, and the notes stay put for others to find.
works.technique_zh: 对表面纹理进行自然特征追踪，为每台平板计算相对于同一实体表面的 6DOF 位姿；笔画以表面坐标存储并通过网络共享，从每个视角都能正确渲染。
works.exercise_en: Use AR Foundation shared anchors (or the same image target) so two phones see the same wall, then draw and leave messages on it that sync in real time. Twist: messages only appear at a certain time or when a certain person comes near.

works.title: Skataviz
works.description: An iPhone attached to a skateboard records its motion and visualizes the board's rotation and tricks as 3D data augmented over live video of the run.
works.idea_zh: 滑板上绑手机，把翻板动作变成叠加在视频上的三维数据轨迹。

video.video_title: Skataviz - Prototype

works.technique: The phone's gyroscope and accelerometer are fused (IMU sensor fusion) into an orientation stream that animates a 3D board model and data traces overlaid on synchronized video.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机网页的 DeviceOrientation 接口把手机绑在滑板、自行车或者篮球上，记录转动并在视频上叠加一个 3D 轨迹；变体：把数据可视化成一只动物，让它在做动作时“叫”出来。
works.description_zh: 把一部 iPhone 固定在滑板上记录运动，并把滑板的旋转和花式动作以三维数据的形式可视化，叠加在滑行过程的实拍视频上。
works.idea_en: Strap a phone to a skateboard and turn board flips into 3D data trails over the video.
works.technique_zh: 对手机的陀螺仪和加速度计进行融合（IMU 传感器融合），得到姿态数据流，驱动三维滑板模型和数据轨迹，并叠加在同步的视频上。
works.exercise_en: Strap a phone to a skateboard, bicycle or basketball, use the DeviceOrientation API in a web page to record its rotation, and overlay a 3D trail on the video. Twist: visualize the data as an animal that "calls out" when a trick happens.

works.title: SnapAR
works.description: Take virtual snapshots of a scene from different viewpoints on a handheld AR device and switch between them instantly instead of walking around.
works.idea_zh: 给场景拍几张'AR快照'，之后瞬间切换视角而不用来回走动。

video.video_title: SnapAR: Quick Viewpoint Switching for Hand-Held Augmented Reality Using Virtual Snapshots

works.technique: The handheld stores tracked camera images with their poses as snapshots, and the user switches the displayed view to a stored snapshot (with live AR overlays re-rendered for that pose) instead of physically walking to it.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR Foundation 中实现“存视角”按钮：保存当前相机截图和位姿，之后点击缩略图即可切换到该视角查看虚拟物体；变体：用这些快照做一个多视角“AR 对比图”说明作品。
works.description_zh: 在手持 AR 设备上从不同视角为场景拍下虚拟快照，之后无需来回走动，就能在这些视角之间即时切换。
works.idea_en: Take a few AR snapshots of a scene, then jump between viewpoints without walking around.
works.technique_zh: 手持设备把追踪到的相机图像连同位姿保存为快照，用户可以把显示画面切换到某张已存快照（并针对该位姿重新渲染实时 AR 叠加），而不必亲自走到那个位置。
works.exercise_en: Implement a "save viewpoint" button in AR Foundation that stores the current camera image and pose, so tapping a thumbnail later switches to that viewpoint to view the virtual objects. Twist: use these snapshots to make a multi-view "AR comparison sheet" that explains a piece of work.

works.title: Spirit Camera: The Cursed Memoir
works.description: A Fatal Frame spin-off co-developed with Koei Tecmo: the 3DS becomes the haunted Camera Obscura, and a bundled cursed diary reveals ghosts that appear in your real room.
works.idea_zh: 3DS变成一台能拍到鬼的相机，随附的日记本在AR中显出幽灵。

video.video_title: Nintendo 3DS - Spirit Camera: The Cursed Memoir Launch Trailer

works.technique: Pages in a printed booklet act as image targets that trigger story events, while gyroscope-based aiming lets ghosts appear around the player in the camera view.
works.exercise_zh: 制作一本几页的纸质“诅咒日记”，每页扫描后触发一段 AR 鬼影或声音；变体：只能在熄灯时（摄像头亮度低时）看到鬼影。
works.description_zh: 与光荣特库摩（Koei Tecmo）共同开发的《零》系列外传：3DS 变成闹鬼的射影机，随游戏附赠的诅咒日记会让幽灵出现在你真实的房间里。
works.idea_en: The 3DS becomes a camera that can photograph ghosts, and the bundled diary reveals them in AR.
works.technique_zh: 印刷小册子的各页作为图像目标触发剧情事件，同时基于陀螺仪的瞄准让幽灵出现在摄像头画面中玩家的四周。
works.exercise_en: Make a paper "cursed diary" of a few pages, where scanning each page triggers an AR ghost or a sound. Twist: the ghosts can only be seen with the lights off (when camera brightness is low).

works.title: T(ether)
works.description: Spatially-aware tablets act as windows into a shared 3D scene above a table; several users sculpt and animate virtual objects with gestures behind the screens.
works.idea_zh: 多人把平板当作窗口，在桌上方的共享空间里用手捏塑和动画3D物体。

video.video_title: T(ether) – Spatially-Aware Handhelds, Gestures and Proprioception for Multi-User 3D Modeling and Animation

works.technique: Vicon motion capture tracks each iPad and the users' gloved hands, so each tablet renders a correct perspective view into a shared 3D scene and hand positions behind the screen manipulate virtual objects.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 的共享锚点让两三部手机看同一个虚拟雕塑，每部手机当作“窗口”从不同角度观看，并用点击拖动来捏合顶点；变体：每部手机只能看到或编辑雕塑的一部分，必须合作才能完成。
works.description_zh: 具备空间感知能力的平板充当观看桌面上方共享三维场景的窗口；多位用户在屏幕后方用手势雕塑虚拟物体并制作动画。
works.idea_en: Several people use tablets as windows and shape and animate 3D objects by hand in a shared space above a table.
works.technique_zh: Vicon 动作捕捉追踪每台 iPad 和用户戴手套的手，使每台平板都能渲染出进入共享三维场景的正确透视画面，屏幕后方的手部位置则用来操控虚拟物体。
works.exercise_en: Use AR Foundation shared anchors so two or three phones see the same virtual sculpture, each acting as a "window" from a different angle, and pinch vertices by tapping and dragging. Twist: each phone can only see or edit part of the sculpture, so finishing it takes teamwork.

works.title: The Treachery of Sanctuary
works.description: A triptych of white screens: in the first a visitor's shadow disintegrates into flying birds, in the second birds peck the shadow apart, in the third the shadow grows giant wings and takes flight.
works.idea_zh: 你的影子在三块屏幕上经历“解体—被吞噬—长出翅膀飞翔”
works.technique: Kinect depth cameras capture each visitor's silhouette and skeleton, and openFrameworks/Unity-style real-time graphics replace parts of the shadow with animated birds and wings projected on the screens.
works.exercise_zh: 用MediaPipe Pose拿到手臂骨骼，在剪影上长出一对随手臂扇动的翅膀；变化：设计你自己的“三幕”，每一幕影子有不同命运。

video.video_title: Amazing Art Installation Turns You Into A Bird | Chris Milk "The Treachery of Sanctuary"

works.description_zh: 由三块白色屏幕组成的三联作品：在第一块屏幕上，观众的影子碎裂成四散飞走的鸟；在第二块上，群鸟把影子啄食殆尽；在第三块上，影子长出巨大的翅膀，腾空而起。
works.idea_en: Across three screens your shadow falls apart, is devoured, then grows wings and flies.
works.technique_zh: Kinect 深度相机捕捉每位观众的剪影和骨架，采用类似 openFrameworks/Unity 的实时图形，把影子的局部替换成动画飞鸟和翅膀，投影在屏幕上。
works.exercise_en: Get the arm skeleton from MediaPipe Pose and grow a pair of wings on the silhouette that flap with the arms. Twist: design your own "three acts", giving the shadow a different fate in each.

works.title: Touché
works.description: Swept-frequency capacitive sensing that recognises how you touch a doorknob, a table, water or your own body - one pinch versus full grasp - with a single electrode.
works.idea_zh: 一根电极就能分辨你是捏、握还是整只手浸在水里。

video.video_title: Touché: Enhancing Touch Interaction on Humans, Screens, Liquids, and Everyday Objects

works.technique: Sweeps the excitation frequency across a range and classifies the resulting capacitive profile, because different grips change the body's impedance at different frequencies.
works.exercise_zh: 用Makey Makey或Arduino的电容触摸引脚连接水杯、水果或门把手，训练一个简单分类器识别“摸一下/握住”；变化：把不同握法映射成手机AR里不同的特效。
works.description_zh: 一种扫频电容感应技术，只用一个电极就能识别你触碰门把手、桌子、水或自己身体的方式，比如是用两指一捏还是整只手握住。
works.idea_en: A single electrode can tell whether you pinch, grasp, or plunge your whole hand into water.
works.technique_zh: 在一段频率范围内扫描激励频率，并对得到的电容曲线进行分类，因为不同的握法会在不同频率下改变人体阻抗。
works.exercise_en: Connect a water glass, a piece of fruit or a doorknob to a Makey Makey or an Arduino's capacitive touch pin, and train a simple classifier to tell "a touch" from "a grip". Twist: map the different grips to different effects in phone AR.

works.title: Wonderbook: Book of Spells
works.description: Written with J.K. Rowling's Pottermore, a blank marker book becomes a pop-up spell book on screen; players wave the Move controller as a wand to cast spells that affect the pages and room.
works.idea_zh: 一本空白的实体书在屏幕里变成立体魔法书，用手柄当魔杖施咒。

video.video_title: Wonderbook: Book of Spells Trailer

works.technique: Each page of the book carries a distinct marker, so page identity and pose drive which pop-up scene is rendered, while the tracked Move wand gestures cast spells into it.
works.exercise_zh: 用一本小册子，每页贴一个不同的图像标记，翻页时在 AR 中弹出对应的立体场景；变体：用手机当魔杖，在页面上方挥动触发变化。
works.description_zh: 与 J.K. 罗琳的 Pottermore 合作撰写：一本印有标记的空白书在屏幕上变成立体弹出式咒语书，玩家把 Move 手柄当作魔杖挥动施咒，影响书页和房间。
works.idea_en: A blank physical book turns into a pop-up spellbook on screen, with the controller as your wand.
works.technique_zh: 书的每一页都印有不同的标记，页面的身份和位姿决定渲染哪个弹出式场景，被追踪的 Move 魔杖手势则向场景中施放咒语。
works.exercise_en: Put a different image marker on each page of a small booklet so turning the page pops up a matching 3D scene in AR. Twist: use the phone as a wand, waving it above the page to trigger changes.

works.title: re-flex (Z33)
works.description: A projected light installation for Z33 that reveals and distorts the geometry of the room, discussed by the artist.
works.idea_zh: 光线揭示并扭曲房间几何的装置

video.video_title: Pablo Valbuena - re-flex - Mind the System, Find the Gap | Z33

works.technique: Projected light lines calibrated to the room's geometry reveal or contradict its perspective, relying on anamorphic alignment from chosen viewpoints.
works.exercise_zh: 在一个小房间里投出一组只有从某个位置看才连成完整图形的线（变形透视），其他位置看是碎片；变体：给观众在地上标一个错误的观看点，让他们自己找到正确位置。
works.description_zh: 为 Z33 创作的投影光装置，揭示并扭曲了房间的几何结构，片中由艺术家本人讲解。
works.idea_en: An installation where light reveals and warps the geometry of a room.
works.technique_zh: 与房间几何结构标定对齐的投影光线，通过从选定视点出发的变形透视对位，揭示或颠覆房间原有的透视关系。
works.exercise_en: Project a set of lines in a small room that only join into a complete figure from one position (anamorphic perspective) and look like fragments from anywhere else. Twist: mark a wrong viewing spot on the floor and let the audience find the right one themselves.

works.title: AR Games (Nintendo 3DS)
works.description: Preinstalled on every 3DS: placing a '?' AR card on a table makes a dragon burst out of it or lets you fish in a lake that opens in the table, shoot archery targets and draw graffiti.
works.idea_zh: 把一张AR卡片放在桌上，桌面就裂开成湖泊、跳出巨龙。

video.video_title: Nintendo 3DS - New Owner's Guide: AR Games

works.technique: A known printed card provides a fiducial for camera pose, and the stereo 3D display renders content emerging from the table plane around the card.
works.exercise_zh: 用一张打印的图像标记做一个从桌面“裂开”钻出来的 AR 巨龙，可以用 Stencil 做出桌面洞口；变体：把标记放在不同表面上，巨龙的反应不同。
works.description_zh: 每台 3DS 都预装的游戏：把一张“?”AR 卡片放在桌上，就会有巨龙从中破出，你还可以在桌面裂开的湖里钓鱼、射箭打靶、随手涂鸦。
works.idea_en: Put an AR card on the table and the tabletop cracks open into a lake or a dragon bursts out.
works.technique_zh: 一张已知图案的印刷卡片作为基准标记提供相机位姿，裸眼立体 3D 屏幕则渲染从卡片周围桌面平面中冒出的内容。
works.exercise_en: Use a printed image marker to make an AR dragon that bursts "cracking" out of the tabletop, using a stencil to cut the hole in the table. Twist: put the marker on different surfaces and have the dragon react differently.

works.title: AR Games: Fishing
works.description: One of the 3DS AR Games modes: the table surface around the AR card turns into a pond, and the player fishes by moving and tilting the console.
works.idea_zh: 桌面在AR中化为池塘，移动掌机就能在自家桌上钓鱼。

video.video_title: Fishing in AR Games on the Nintendo 3DS (Complete)

works.technique: The card marks the table as a water plane using a stencil or depth mask, and tilting and moving the console are mapped to the fishing line and reel.
works.exercise_zh: 在桌面上用 Shader 做一个“水面”，倾斜手机抛竿，快速上抬手机收线；变体：鱼只在你保持安静时才会上钩（用麦克风判断）。
works.description_zh: 3DS 的 AR Games 模式之一：AR 卡片周围的桌面变成一片池塘，玩家通过移动和倾斜掌机来钓鱼。
works.idea_en: The tabletop turns into a pond in AR, and moving the handheld lets you fish at your own desk.
works.technique_zh: 卡片借助模板（stencil）或深度遮罩把桌面标记为水面，掌机的倾斜和移动被映射为鱼线和收线动作。
works.exercise_en: Make a "water surface" on the table with a shader, tilt the phone to cast, and lift it quickly to reel in. Twist: fish only bite when you stay quiet (judged by the microphone).

works.title: AR Pop-up Book
works.description: Opening an ordinary picture book in front of a camera makes 3D characters and scenes pop out of its pages, tracked from the printed illustrations themselves rather than black markers.
works.description_zh: 在摄像头前打开一本普通图画书，三维角色和场景就从书页里“弹”出来；追踪依据的是印刷插图本身，而不是黑色标记。
works.idea_en: Any printed page can become a pop-up book when the picture itself is the tracker.
works.idea_zh: 只要图片本身就是追踪目标，任何印刷页面都能变成立体书。
works.technique: Uses natural-feature texture tracking on the page images to estimate camera pose and render 3D content registered to each page.
works.technique_zh: 对页面图像做自然特征纹理追踪来估计相机位姿，并渲染与每一页配准的三维内容。
works.exercise_en: Pick a children's book page, set it as an image target in a phone AR tool, and make one character jump out when the page is opened. Twist: make characters from two pages talk to each other when both are visible.
works.exercise_zh: 选一页儿童读物，把它设为手机 AR 工具中的图像目标，让一个角色在翻开这页时跳出来；变体：当两页同时可见时，让两页的角色互相对话。

video.video_title: AR popup book based on texture tracking

works.title: AR in the Psychomotor Phase of a Procedural Task
works.description: Head-worn AR shows animated guidance for the hands-on part of an assembly task (aligning and inserting parts) directly on the physical engine combustor.
works.idea_zh: AR动画直接在真实零件上示范'手该怎么动'。

video.video_title: Augmented reality in the psychomotor phase of a procedural task

works.technique: The combustor parts are tracked in 6DOF, and animated overlays compare the current part pose with the target pose, showing alignment cues (arrows, rotation hints) until the part is correctly inserted.
works.exercise_zh: 用图像追踪一块乐高底板和一个带贴纸的零件，在 AR 中显示目标位置的虚影，零件越接近目标，虚影颜色越绿；变体：去掉数字提示，只用声音引导对准。
works.description_zh: 头戴式 AR 直接在真实的发动机燃烧室上显示动画引导，指导装配任务中需要动手操作的环节（对准和插入零件）。
works.idea_en: AR animation demonstrates how your hands should move, right on the real part.
works.technique_zh: 对燃烧室零件进行 6DOF 追踪，动画叠加层比较零件当前位姿与目标位姿，持续显示对准提示（箭头、旋转提示），直到零件被正确插入。
works.exercise_en: Use image tracking on a LEGO baseplate and a part with a sticker, and show a ghost of the target position in AR that turns greener as the part gets closer. Twist: remove the visual hints and guide the alignment with sound alone.

works.title: Body Swap
works.description: Two people stand side by side and each controls the other's body on screen like a puppet, making each other dance, jump and look silly.
works.idea_zh: 和旁边的人交换身体：你控制他的画面形象，他也在操控你。

video.video_title: Body Swap

works.technique: Kinect skeleton tracking of two players drives two on-screen puppets, with each player's joint data mapped to the other player's avatar.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe Pose 同时追踪两个人，把 A 的动作渲染在 B 的剪影人偶上，反之亦然；变体：只交换一半身体，比如你控制对方的腿、对方控制你的手，完成一个共同任务。
works.description_zh: 两个人并排站立，各自像操纵木偶一样控制屏幕上对方的身体，让对方跳舞、蹦跳、出洋相。
works.idea_en: Swap bodies with the person beside you: you control their on-screen figure while they control yours.
works.technique_zh: Kinect 骨架追踪两名玩家，驱动屏幕上的两个木偶，每位玩家的关节数据都被映射到对方的化身上。
works.exercise_en: Track two people at once with MediaPipe Pose and render A's movements on B's silhouette puppet and vice versa. Twist: swap only half the body, for example you control the other person's legs and they control your arms, to complete a shared task.

works.title: CELL (with James Alliban)
works.description: An interactive installation where a depth camera tracks visitors and attaches floating identity tags drawn from social media to their bodies on a large mirror-screen.
works.idea_zh: 摄像头追踪人体，给每个路人实时贴上网络身份标签的数字镜子

video.video_title: CELL | 1 | Showreel

works.technique: A Kinect depth camera segments and tracks each visitor's skeleton, and openFrameworks renders text tags that follow the tracked head/torso positions on a mirror-like screen.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe Pose 在网页摄像头画面里追踪多人，把随机抓取的网络标签（话题、昵称、广告词）贴在每个人头顶；变体：让标签根据人的站姿或停留时长而改变，讨论“算法如何给你贴标签”。
works.description_zh: 一件互动装置：深度相机追踪观众，在一面大型镜面屏幕上把取自社交媒体的身份标签附着在他们身上，随人漂浮。
works.idea_en: A digital mirror that tracks bodies and slaps online identity tags on every passerby in real time.
works.technique_zh: Kinect 深度相机对每位观众进行分割并追踪其骨架，openFrameworks 渲染文字标签，使其在镜面般的屏幕上跟随被追踪的头部或躯干位置。
works.exercise_en: Track several people in a webcam feed with MediaPipe Pose on a web page and stick randomly scraped online tags (hashtags, nicknames, ad slogans) above each person's head. Twist: make the tags change with a person's stance or how long they stay, and discuss "how algorithms label you".

works.title: Carnation Rain (Largo do Carmo)
works.description: An AR rain of red carnations over Lisbon's Largo do Carmo, where the 1974 Carnation Revolution ended.
works.idea_zh: 在革命发生的广场上空下起AR康乃馨雨

video.video_title: Carnation Rain (Largo do Carmo), by Tamiko Thiel, 2011

works.technique: A GPS-anchored particle-like object (animated falling flowers) is placed over the historic square, using location as the carrier of historical meaning.
works.exercise_zh: 选一个有历史事件的校园或城市地点，用 Unity AR 让与事件相关的物体从天而降；变体：用粒子系统让落下的物体在地面上慢慢堆积成一个符号。
works.description_zh: 在里斯本卡尔穆广场（Largo do Carmo）上空降下一场红色康乃馨的 AR 花雨，1974 年的康乃馨革命正是在这里落幕。
works.idea_en: An AR rain of carnations falls over the square where the revolution took place.
works.technique_zh: 把一个以 GPS 锚定、类似粒子效果的对象（下落的花朵动画）放置在这座历史广场上空，以地理位置作为历史意义的载体。
works.exercise_en: Pick a campus or city location tied to a historical event and use Unity AR to make objects related to that event fall from the sky. Twist: use a particle system so the fallen objects slowly pile up on the ground into a symbol.

works.title: Chase No Face / BELL
works.description: A music video in which graphics are projected onto singer BELL's face in real time with a hacked Kinect, face tracker and LED projector, with no post-production.
works.idea_zh: 音乐录影带里所有脸上的图形都是实时投影上去的，没有后期。

video.video_title: Chase No Face / BELL

works.technique: A Kinect provides depth for head pose while a 2D FaceTracker fits landmarks, and a calibrated projector renders textures onto the singer's face in real time; the camera-projector pair is registered so no post-production is needed.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe Face Mesh 和投影仪给一段 30 秒的歌曲做现场投脸 MV，一镜到底拍下来；变体：每一句歌词换一种脸部“皮肤”，风格由组员抽签决定。
works.description_zh: 一支音乐录影带：利用破解的 Kinect、面部追踪器和 LED 投影仪，把图形实时投射到歌手 BELL 的脸上，全程没有后期制作。
works.idea_en: Every graphic on the faces in this music video was projected live, with no post-production.
works.technique_zh: Kinect 提供深度数据用于估计头部姿态，二维 FaceTracker 拟合面部特征点，经过标定的投影仪实时把纹理渲染到歌手脸上；相机与投影仪已完成配准，因此无需后期。
works.exercise_en: Use MediaPipe Face Mesh and a projector to make a live face-projection music video for a 30-second song, shot in one continuous take. Twist: switch to a different face "skin" for each line of lyrics, with the style decided by team members drawing lots.

works.title: Dancing House
works.description: Interactive projection mapping on historic façades: the building bends, sways and 'dances' in response to the movements of people standing in front of it.
works.idea_zh: 你一动，整栋老建筑就跟着你扭动起舞
works.technique: A camera tracks the audience's body movement and maps it onto deformation parameters of a 3D model of the façade that is projection-mapped onto the building.
works.exercise_zh: 给一面墙或纸盒建筑拍照建模，用身体姿态（如MediaPipe Pose）控制投影贴图的弯曲；变化：两个人同时做相反动作时建筑会“撕裂”。

video.video_title: Dancing House – Klaus Obermaier

works.description_zh: 在历史建筑立面上进行的互动投影映射：建筑会随着站在它面前的人的动作弯曲、摇摆、“跳舞”。
works.idea_en: When you move, the whole old building twists and dances with you.
works.technique_zh: 摄像头追踪观众的身体动作，将其映射为立面三维模型的形变参数，再把该模型投影映射到建筑上。
works.exercise_en: Photograph and model a wall or a cardboard building, and use body pose (such as MediaPipe Pose) to bend the projected texture. Twist: when two people make opposite moves at the same time, the building "tears".

works.title: Dash Dodge Dive
works.description: Crowd games for the London 2012 Olympics big screens: people in public squares across the UK compete against each other using body movements seen by the screens' cameras.
works.idea_zh: 全英多个广场的大屏联网，人群用身体动作跨城对战小游戏。

video.video_title: Dash Dodge Dive

works.technique: Big-screen cameras use motion detection (frame differencing or blob tracking) to measure crowd movement per zone, and scores are synchronised over a network between sites.
works.exercise_zh: 用 p5.js 把摄像头画面分成左右两区，统计每区的运动量作为两队的“力气”，玩一场投影拔河；变体：两个教室通过网络对战，赢的一方可以在对方屏幕上留下一句话。
works.description_zh: 为 2012 年伦敦奥运会大屏幕设计的群体游戏：英国各地公共广场上的人们，通过大屏幕摄像头捕捉的身体动作彼此比拼。
works.idea_en: Big screens in squares across the UK are linked so crowds battle other cities with their bodies.
works.technique_zh: 大屏幕上的摄像头通过运动检测（帧差或斑点追踪）按区域测量人群的运动量，分数通过网络在各个地点之间同步。
works.exercise_en: Split the camera image into left and right zones in p5.js, measure the amount of motion in each as the two teams' "strength", and play a projected tug-of-war. Twist: two classrooms compete over the network, and the winners get to leave a message on the other side's screen.

works.title: Divide By Zero
works.description: A dance film in which a performer's movements, guided by a hypnotherapist, drive interactive graphics that connect unconscious content with digital interfaces.
works.idea_zh: 在催眠引导下的舞蹈，把潜意识动作变成可见的界面
works.technique: Camera tracking of the dancer drives real-time generative graphics composited around her body (likely openFrameworks).
works.exercise_zh: 让同学闭眼听一段引导语即兴动作，摄像头把动作轨迹画成线条；变化：结束后让本人看回放，写下对“潜意识图形”的解读。

video.video_title: Divide By Zero

works.description_zh: 一部舞蹈影片：表演者在催眠师的引导下起舞，她的动作驱动互动图形，把潜意识内容与数字界面联系在一起。
works.idea_en: A dance under hypnotic guidance turns unconscious movement into a visible interface.
works.technique_zh: 通过摄像头追踪舞者，驱动围绕她身体合成的实时生成图形（大概率使用 openFrameworks）。
works.exercise_en: Have a classmate close their eyes and improvise movement while listening to a guided script, as a camera draws their motion trail as lines. Twist: afterward, let them watch the playback and write down their reading of the "subconscious graphics".

works.title: EyePet & Friends
works.description: Two players can each raise a pet that play together in the living room, with new costume, drawing and mini-game modes.
works.idea_zh: 两只AR宠物在你的客厅里一起玩耍。

video.video_title: EyePet & Friends Trailer

works.technique: Two tracked controllers and pet instances share the camera-based floor frame, letting two players' pets interact in the same augmented video.
works.exercise_zh: 在同一个 AR 画面里放两只宠物，分别由两名玩家控制，让它们根据距离做出互动；变体：两只宠物有各自的性格，会产生冲突。
works.description_zh: 两位玩家可以各养一只宠物，让它们在客厅里一起玩耍，还加入了新的服装、绘画和小游戏模式。
works.idea_en: Two AR pets play together in your living room.
works.technique_zh: 两个被追踪的手柄和两只宠物实例共享基于摄像头的地面坐标系，让两位玩家的宠物能在同一段增强视频中互动。
works.exercise_en: Put two pets in the same AR view, each controlled by a different player, and have them interact based on their distance. Twist: give each pet its own personality so the two come into conflict.

works.title: Eyeshine
works.description: An installation that captures, records and replays the red-eye retroreflections from observers' eyes, revealing a normally invisible property of the human retina.
works.idea_zh: 捕捉观众眼睛的“红眼”反光，让人看到自己像夜行动物一样发光的眼睛。

video.video_title: Eyeshine (Interactive Installation, 2011)

works.technique: An infrared light source placed coaxially with an IR camera produces retroreflection from the retina (the red-eye effect), which is detected as bright pupil blobs and recorded and replayed.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机闪光灯贴近镜头在暗处拍人眼，或用红外摄像头，找出瞳孔反光并在 p5.js 里单独保存，排成一面“眼光墙”；变体：只收集对视超过 3 秒的人的眼光，讨论“被看见”的伦理。
works.description_zh: 这件装置捕捉、记录并回放观众眼中的“红眼”逆反射，让人类视网膜一种平时看不见的特性显现出来。
works.idea_en: Catch the red-eye glint in visitors' eyes so they see their own eyes glowing like a night animal's.
works.technique_zh: 红外光源与红外摄像头同轴放置，使视网膜产生逆反射（即红眼效应），系统把它检测为明亮的瞳孔光斑，再加以记录和回放。
works.exercise_en: In a dark room, photograph people's eyes with the phone flash held right next to the lens (or use an IR camera), isolate the pupil glints in p5.js and save them, then arrange them into a 'wall of eyeshine'. Twist: collect glints only from people who hold eye contact for more than 3 seconds, and discuss the ethics of 'being seen'.

works.title: Eyjafjallajökull
works.description: Light is projected onto a hand-drawn wireframe mountain so the drawing appears to erupt, shift and transform into a volcano.
works.idea_zh: 投影让手绘线稿山体仿佛火山喷发

video.video_title: EYJAFJALLAJÖKULL

works.technique: A projector is aligned to a large hand-drawn wireframe on paper, and projected light and animation reveal, erase and extend the lines to create the illusion of an erupting 3D mountain.
works.exercise_zh: 用黑笔在白纸上画一座山的线框，再把投影对齐到线稿上，让光在线条之间流动模拟火山喷发；变体：换成自己家乡的一处地形，并加入一种当地的自然现象。
works.description_zh: 光被投射到一座手绘线框山体上，画面仿佛开始喷发、移动，最终化作一座火山。
works.idea_en: Projection makes a hand-drawn line mountain look like an erupting volcano.
works.technique_zh: 投影仪与纸上的大幅手绘线框图精确对齐，投射的光和动画对线条进行显现、擦除和延伸，营造出一座三维山体正在喷发的错觉。
works.exercise_en: Draw the wireframe of a mountain in black pen on white paper, align a projector to the drawing, and make light flow between the lines to simulate an eruption. Twist: use a landform from your hometown instead and add one local natural phenomenon.

works.title: Face Raiders
works.description: The 3DS takes a photo of your face (or a friend's) and turns it into flying enemy heads that attack through holes in your real room; you turn your body to aim and shoot.
works.idea_zh: 把你自己的脸变成敌人，从真实房间墙面破洞中飞出来攻击你。

video.video_title: Nintendo 3DS - New Owner's Guide: Face Raiders

works.technique: A captured face photo is texture-mapped onto enemy meshes, and the gyroscope rotates the virtual camera so enemies surround the player in a 360-degree space overlaid on the camera feed.
works.exercise_zh: 用前置摄像头拍一张脸，贴到 AR 中飞来飞去的球体上，转身用陀螺仪瞄准射击；变体：被击中的脸会做出不同表情。
works.description_zh: 3DS 给你（或朋友）拍一张脸部照片，再把它变成会飞的敌人头像，从真实房间墙上的破洞里冲出来攻击你；你需要转动身体来瞄准射击。
works.idea_en: Your own face becomes the enemy, bursting out of holes in your real room's walls to attack you.
works.technique_zh: 拍下的人脸照片被作为纹理贴到敌人网格上，陀螺仪驱动虚拟相机旋转，让敌人在叠加于摄像头画面的 360 度空间中包围玩家。
works.exercise_en: Take a face photo with the front camera, map it onto spheres flying around in AR, and turn your body to aim and shoot using the gyroscope. Twist: faces pull different expressions when they are hit.

works.title: Face Substitution
works.description: Widely cited as the first realistic real-time face swap: another person's face is fitted and blended onto yours live from a webcam.
works.idea_zh: 最早的实时换脸：摄像头里你的脸被无缝替换成别人的脸。

video.video_title: Face Substitution

works.technique: FaceTracker fits a deformable landmark mesh to both the source and live face, the source texture is warped onto the live mesh, and color-transfer plus Poisson-style blending hides the seam.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe Face Mesh 的三角网格把一张名画人物的脸贴到自己脸上，做简单的颜色匹配后实时换脸；变体：只换半张脸，做一面“一半是你一半是祖先”的镜子。
works.description_zh: 这件作品常被视为第一个逼真的实时换脸：通过网络摄像头，另一个人的脸被实时贴合并融合到你的脸上。
works.idea_en: The earliest live face swap: your face on the webcam is seamlessly replaced with someone else's.
works.technique_zh: FaceTracker 分别在源人脸和实时人脸上拟合可变形的特征点网格，把源人脸纹理扭曲贴到实时网格上，再用颜色迁移加类泊松融合来消除接缝。
works.exercise_en: Use the triangle mesh from MediaPipe Face Mesh to map the face of a figure from a famous painting onto your own, apply simple color matching, and swap faces in real time. Twist: swap only half the face to make a mirror that is 'half you, half your ancestor'.

works.title: Fruit Ninja Kinect
works.description: Players stand in front of the TV and see their own silhouette among flying fruit; any fast sweep of an arm or leg slices the fruit, so whole-body flailing becomes the controller.
works.description_zh: 玩家站在电视前，看到自己的身体剪影混在飞舞的水果中；手臂或腿的任何快速挥动都能切开水果，全身乱舞就是控制器。
works.idea_en: Your full-body silhouette is the blade.
works.idea_zh: 你的全身剪影就是刀刃。
works.technique: Kinect depth sensing segments the player's silhouette and skeleton; fast-moving limb joints generate slicing trails that hit fruit.
works.technique_zh: Kinect 深度感应分割出玩家的剪影和骨架，快速移动的肢体关节生成切割轨迹去击中水果。
works.exercise_en: Use a webcam with MediaPipe Pose to draw the player's silhouette and make wrists and ankles leave slicing trails that cut falling shapes. Twist: allow two players and give points only when both slice the same object at once.
works.exercise_zh: 用摄像头加 MediaPipe Pose 绘制玩家剪影，让手腕和脚踝留下切割轨迹，切开下落的图形。变体：允许两名玩家同时参与，只有两人同时切中同一个物体才得分。

video.video_title: E3 2011: Fruit Ninja Kinect

works.title: In-Place AR 3D Sketching of Mechanical Systems
works.description: Students sketch simple physics setups such as springs, masses and slopes on paper; the camera recognizes the diagram and runs a 3D simulation on top of it, which changes as the sketch is edited.
works.description_zh: 学生在纸上画出弹簧、质量块和斜面等简单物理装置；摄像头识别出示意图，并在上面运行 3D 模拟，修改草图时模拟也随之改变。
works.idea_en: A physics textbook diagram you draw yourself becomes a live experiment.
works.idea_zh: 自己画的物理课本示意图变成一场实时实验。
works.technique: Sketch parsing turns diagram symbols into rigid bodies and constraints for a physics engine, rendered in 3D over the tracked paper.
works.technique_zh: 草图解析把示意图符号转成物理引擎中的刚体和约束，并在被追踪的纸面上以 3D 渲染。
works.exercise_en: Let students draw a slope and a circle on paper, detect them, and simulate a ball rolling down in AR with adjustable gravity. Twist: add a spring symbol that bounces the ball back.
works.exercise_zh: 让学生在纸上画一个斜面和一个圆，识别后在 AR 中模拟小球沿斜面滚下，并可调节重力。变体：加入一个弹簧符号，把小球弹回去。

video.video_title: In-Place Augmented Reality 3D Sketching of Mechanical Systems

works.title: Inside - Out
works.description: A shop installation where cameras and projectors transport the activity of one space into another, creating surprising feedback loops between viewers and participants.
works.idea_zh: 把一个空间里的人实时投进另一个空间，形成互相观看的回路
works.technique: Live camera feeds from one room are processed and projected into the other (and back), forming a two-way video feedback loop.
works.exercise_zh: 用两台笔记本在走廊两端互相视频并投影到墙上，让两边的人玩“隔墙互动”；变化：只显示对方的剪影，并交换左右。

video.video_title: Inside - Out

works.description_zh: 一件店铺装置：摄像头和投影仪把一个空间里的活动传送到另一个空间，在观看者与参与者之间形成出人意料的反馈回路。
works.idea_en: Project people from one space live into another so both sides end up watching each other.
works.technique_zh: 一个房间的实时摄像画面经处理后投影到另一个房间（反之亦然），形成双向的视频反馈回路。
works.exercise_en: Set up two laptops at opposite ends of a hallway, video-call between them and project each feed onto the wall so people on both sides can play across the wall. Twist: show only the other side's silhouettes, mirrored left to right.

works.title: Interactive Surface with Projection-based Wearable System
works.description: A wearable projector and camera turn nearby surfaces into touch interfaces: menus are projected onto a wall or table and the user taps them with a finger.
works.description_zh: 可穿戴的投影仪和摄像头把附近的表面变成触控界面：菜单被投射到墙面或桌面上，用户用手指点击即可操作。
works.idea_en: Carry your interface with you and project it onto whatever surface is nearby.
works.idea_zh: 把界面随身带着，投射到身边任何表面上。
works.technique: Likely calibrates a body-worn projector-camera pair so the camera detects fingertip contact on the projected image.
works.technique_zh: 很可能对佩戴在身上的投影仪与摄像头进行标定，让摄像头检测指尖在投影画面上的触碰。
works.exercise_en: Mount a pico projector or a phone projector on a strap, project three buttons on a desk, and use a second phone's camera to detect which one a finger covers. Twist: project on your own forearm.
works.exercise_zh: 把微型投影仪或手机投影绑在带子上，在桌面上投出三个按钮，用第二部手机的摄像头检测手指遮住了哪个；变体：投射到自己的前臂上。

video.video_title: Interactive surface with projection-based wearable system

works.title: Invizimals: The Lost Tribes
works.description: Third PSP entry with new tribes of Invizimals to hunt through the camera and battle on the marker trap card.
works.idea_zh: 用摄像头寻找新部族怪兽，并在卡片上对战。

video.video_title: Invizimals The Lost Tribes Gamescom 2011 Trailer PSP

works.technique: The marker card defines the arena origin, and creatures from different sets are rendered in the card's frame with turn-based battle animations.
works.exercise_zh: 用两张不同的图像标记卡分别召唤两个阵营的角色，让它们在桌上回合制对战；变体：把两张卡的距离作为攻击范围的一个参数。
works.description_zh: PSP 上的第三部作品，加入了新的 Invizimals 部族，玩家要通过摄像头搜寻它们，并在标记陷阱卡上展开对战。
works.idea_en: Hunt new tribes of monsters through the camera and battle them on a card.
works.technique_zh: 标记卡定义了竞技场的原点，不同系列的生物被渲染在卡片的坐标系中，并配有回合制战斗动画。
works.exercise_en: Use two different image-marker cards to summon characters from two factions and have them fight turn-based battles on the table. Twist: use the distance between the two cards as a parameter for attack range.

works.title: KinectFusion
works.description: Sweep a Kinect around a room and a dense 3D model is built in real time; virtual particles then bounce off and splash onto real surfaces.
works.idea_zh: 拿着Kinect扫一圈，实时重建整个房间，虚拟粒子能撞到真实桌面上。

video.video_title: KinectFusion HQ

works.technique: Depth frames are aligned with ICP to estimate camera pose and fused into a GPU truncated signed distance function (TSDF) volume, whose ray-cast surface serves as a collision mesh for virtual particles.
works.exercise_zh: 用 LiDAR iPhone 的 AR Foundation Meshing 实时生成房间网格，然后撒下上千个虚拟粒子，让它们在真实桌面、沙发上弹跳堆积；变体：把粒子换成会“生长”的东西（苔藓、藤蔓）沿网格蔓延。
works.description_zh: 拿着 Kinect 在房间里扫一圈，就能实时构建出稠密的三维模型；随后虚拟粒子会在真实表面上弹跳、飞溅。
works.idea_en: Sweep a Kinect around once to rebuild the whole room live, and virtual particles can hit the real table.
works.technique_zh: 用 ICP 对齐深度帧来估计相机位姿，并把深度数据融合进 GPU 上的截断符号距离函数（TSDF）体素中；对该体素进行光线投射得到的表面，被用作虚拟粒子的碰撞网格。
works.exercise_en: Use AR Foundation Meshing on a LiDAR iPhone to generate a live room mesh, then scatter thousands of virtual particles and let them bounce and pile up on the real table and sofa. Twist: replace the particles with something that 'grows' (moss, vines) and spreads along the mesh.

works.title: Lit Tree
works.description: A small potted tree is scanned and projected onto so its leaves act as 3D pixels; visitors' hands are scanned over a plinth and reflected as volumes of light inside the tree.
works.idea_zh: 把一棵真树的叶子当作三维像素投影，人的手势在树里“亮”起来。

video.video_title: Lit Tree

works.technique: Structured-light scanning with a projector and Kinect maps every projector pixel to a 3D point on the leaves, turning the tree into a sparse volumetric display that lights voxels inside a scanned hand volume.
works.exercise_zh: 把投影仪对着一盆植物，用 TouchDesigner 逐行扫描记录哪些像素打到叶子上，再只点亮叶子画出上下移动的光平面；变体：用 MediaPipe 手的高度控制光平面，像用手抚摸这棵树。
works.description_zh: 一棵小盆栽树被扫描并投影，树叶因此成为三维像素；观众的手在底座上方被扫描，化作一团光出现在树冠之中。
works.idea_en: Use the leaves of a real tree as 3D pixels, so a visitor's hand gesture lights up inside the tree.
works.technique_zh: 利用投影仪和 Kinect 做结构光扫描，把每个投影像素对应到树叶上的一个三维点，从而把树变成一个稀疏的体积显示器，点亮位于扫描所得手部体积之内的体素。
works.exercise_en: Aim a projector at a potted plant, scan line by line in TouchDesigner to record which pixels land on leaves, then light only the leaves to draw a plane of light moving up and down. Twist: use hand height from MediaPipe to control the light plane, as if stroking the tree.

works.title: Little Magic Stories
works.description: Children perform stories on a small stage with drawn props and costumes; Kinect tracking and projection bring their imagined characters and scenery to life in front of an audience.
works.idea_zh: 孩子在小舞台上表演，自己画的角色和布景被投影实时“变活”。

video.video_title: Little Magic Stories

works.technique: Kinect skeleton and depth tracking follow the children on stage, and colored props are recognised to trigger projected characters and scenery tied to their positions.
works.exercise_zh: 给小组发几张画好的纸道具，用颜色识别触发投影背景和角色，用 MediaPipe Pose 让角色跟着表演者走，表演 3 分钟的小故事；变体：观众鼓掌的音量决定下一幕的场景。
works.description_zh: 孩子们用自己画的道具和服装在小舞台上表演故事；借助 Kinect 追踪和投影，他们想象中的角色与布景在观众面前活了起来。
works.idea_en: Children act on a small stage while the characters and sets they drew come alive through projection.
works.technique_zh: Kinect 的骨骼与深度追踪跟随舞台上的孩子，系统识别彩色道具来触发投影角色和布景，并将其与孩子的位置绑定。
works.exercise_en: Give each group a few drawn paper props, use color detection to trigger projected backgrounds and characters, use MediaPipe Pose to make characters follow the performers, and stage a 3-minute story. Twist: the loudness of the audience's applause picks the scene for the next act.

works.title: Luminous Flux
works.description: For the Liver Building's 100th anniversary, Liverpool's waterfront landmark is covered in moving light that makes its clock towers ripple, fold and open up above the crowd.
works.description_zh: 为庆祝利物浦皇家利物大厦百年诞辰，这座海滨地标被流动的光覆盖，钟楼在人群头顶起伏、折叠、打开。
works.idea_en: A city celebrates a building by letting light rewrite its stone.
works.idea_zh: 一座城市用光改写石头，来为一栋建筑庆生。
works.technique: Animations are rendered against a surveyed model of the façade and played through edge-blended projectors so the illusions of depth line up with real ornaments.
works.technique_zh: 动画依据测绘得到的立面模型渲染，经边缘融合的投影机播放，使虚假的纵深感与真实的装饰构件对齐。
works.exercise_en: Map a staircase or doorway on campus and create one illusion that makes the real structure look soft, flexible or hollow. Twist: sync the illusion to a clock so it happens exactly on the hour.
works.exercise_zh: 在校园里选一段楼梯或一个门洞做投影，创造一种让真实结构看起来变软、变弯或变空的错觉；变体：把错觉与时钟同步，每到整点准时出现。

video.video_title: Luminous Flux

works.title: MOTIV
works.description: Russ's SVA MFA thesis: a hacked Kinect follows a performer's body so that gestures shape the velocity and tempo of a playing song, while on-screen graphics mirror and guide the moves.
works.description_zh: Russ 在 SVA 的硕士毕业设计：破解的 Kinect 追踪表演者的身体，用手势实时控制正在播放的乐曲的力度和速度，屏幕上的图形同步反馈并引导动作。
works.idea_en: Let the body, not an instrument, control the emotion of music.
works.idea_zh: 不用学乐器，用身体动作直接控制音乐的情绪。
works.technique: A Kinect depth camera tracks the performer's movement and maps it in real time to expression parameters such as note velocity and tempo of a multi-track MIDI sequence.
works.technique_zh: Kinect 深度相机追踪表演者的动作，实时映射到多轨 MIDI 序列的表情参数上，例如音符力度和速度。
works.exercise_en: Map one tracked body feature (hand height or arm spread) to the volume and tempo of a looping track with a webcam pose tracker, then perform a 30-second piece. Twist: map two performers to different instruments so they must play together.
works.exercise_zh: 用摄像头姿态识别，把一个身体特征（手的高度或双臂张开程度）映射到循环音轨的音量和速度上，然后表演 30 秒；变体：让两位表演者各控制一种乐器，必须配合演奏。

video.video_title: Russ Maschmeyer presenting MOTIV at SVA's Open IXD

works.title: Make the Line Dance
works.description: A dancer moves in front of a projector and a Kinect, and lines of light are mapped onto their moving body, sticking to limbs as they turn and bend.
works.description_zh: 舞者在投影仪和 Kinect 前舞动，光线被投影映射到他们移动的身体上，转身、弯腰时依然贴合在四肢上。
works.idea_en: Projection mapping onto a moving body instead of a static building.
works.idea_zh: 把投影映射的对象从静止的建筑换成运动的身体。
works.technique: A Kinect tracks the dancer's skeleton, Quartz Composer draws graphics along the bones, and MadMapper aligns the projector view with the camera view.
works.technique_zh: Kinect 追踪舞者骨架，Quartz Composer 沿骨骼绘制图形，MadMapper 将投影视角与摄像头视角对齐。
works.exercise_en: Calibrate a projector to a webcam, run MediaPipe pose tracking and project a glowing line along one arm of a volunteer. Twist: make the line leave a trail that the dancer can 'dance with' a second later.
works.exercise_zh: 把投影仪与摄像头标定对齐，运行 MediaPipe 姿态追踪，把一条发光线条投到志愿者的一只手臂上；变体：让线条留下拖影，舞者可以在一秒后与自己的“残影”共舞。

video.video_title: Make the Line Dance - 1024 architecture

works.title: Mécaniques Discursives (with Fred Penelle)
works.description: A wall of woodcut prints depicting a strange machine is brought to life by precise projection: gears turn, creatures move and light flows through the printed mechanism.
works.idea_zh: 用投影让墙上的版画机器真的转动起来
works.technique: Video is drawn to match the exact contours of hand-printed woodcuts on the wall and projected in registration so animation appears to live inside the paper.
works.exercise_zh: 先手绘一张黑白“机器”图贴在墙上，再拍照在电脑中逐个零件做旋转动画并投影对齐；变化：观众拍手时机器运转速度改变。

video.video_title: Mécaniques Discursives, short documentary by fred penelle & yannick jacquet

works.description_zh: 一整面墙的木刻版画描绘了一台奇异的机器，精确的投影让它活了过来：齿轮转动，生物游走，光在印出来的机械结构中流淌。
works.idea_en: Projection makes the printed machine on the wall actually turn.
works.technique_zh: 影像按照墙上手工木刻版画的精确轮廓绘制，并与之对位投影，让动画看起来就生长在纸面之中。
works.exercise_en: Hand-draw a black-and-white 'machine' and pin it to the wall, photograph it, animate each part rotating on the computer, and project it back in alignment. Twist: the machine changes speed when the audience claps.

works.title: Newtown Creek (oil spill)
works.description: Geolocated AR on Brooklyn's Newtown Creek visualising the huge hidden oil spill beneath it.
works.idea_zh: 让地下看不见的石油泄漏浮现在河面上

video.video_title: "Newtown Creek (oil spill)" documentary of AR art by Tamiko Thiel

works.technique: Geolocated AR places a large semi-transparent model of the underground oil plume at its real coordinates, making hidden environmental data spatially visible.
works.exercise_zh: 找一份本地环境数据（地下水、噪声、排水管网），用 AR 把它按真实位置可视化在地面上；变体：让可视化的规模与数据真实数值 1:1 对应，体验“看不见的量”。
works.description_zh: 在布鲁克林 Newtown Creek 上的地理定位 AR 作品，把河底下隐藏的巨大石油泄漏可视化。
works.idea_en: Bring an invisible underground oil spill up to the surface of the river.
works.technique_zh: 地理定位 AR 把地下油污羽流的大型半透明模型放在其真实坐标上，让隐藏的环境数据在空间中变得可见。
works.exercise_en: Find a local environmental dataset (groundwater, noise, drainage network) and use AR to visualize it on the ground at its real location. Twist: scale the visualization 1:1 with the real data values to feel the size of 'invisible quantities'.

works.title: Night Bright
works.description: Children use their bodies as flashlights to light up a projected nighttime forest and play hide-and-seek with nocturnal creatures they locate by sound.
works.idea_zh: 用身体当手电筒照亮夜晚森林，循声寻找藏着的动物。
