video.video_title: Night Bright

works.technique: Depth or camera-based body tracking positions a light mask on each child, and a projected night scene is revealed only inside those regions, with spatial audio cues pointing to hidden creatures.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个全黑的投影场景，用 MediaPipe 追踪人的手或身体，只有被“身体手电筒”照到的地方才显示画面，并用左右声道提示动物位置；变体：找到所有动物后反过来它们会来“照”你。
works.description_zh: 孩子们把身体当作手电筒，照亮投影出的夜间森林，并循着声音与藏在林中的夜行动物玩捉迷藏。
works.idea_en: Use your body as a flashlight to light up a night forest and follow sounds to find hidden animals.
works.technique_zh: 基于深度相机或普通摄像头的人体追踪在每个孩子身上定位一块光照遮罩，投影的夜景只在这些区域内显现，同时用空间音频提示隐藏生物的位置。
works.exercise_en: Build an all-black projected scene, track people's hands or bodies with MediaPipe so imagery appears only where the 'body flashlight' shines, and use left/right audio channels to hint where animals are. Twist: once all the animals are found, they turn around and 'shine' on you.

works.title: OmniTouch
works.description: A shoulder-worn depth camera and projector turn hands, walls, notebooks and tables into multitouch surfaces on the fly.
works.idea_zh: 肩上的深度相机+投影，把手掌、墙面、笔记本随时变成多点触控屏。

video.video_title: OmniTouch - Demo Video - ACM UIST 2011

works.technique: A shoulder-mounted depth camera finds finger-like cylinders in the depth image and determines touch by checking whether the fingertip is within a few millimeters of the surface below it, while a calibrated pico projector renders onto the detected surfaces.
works.exercise_zh: 用深度相机（RealSense、Kinect 或 LiDAR iPhone）检测手指与桌面的深度差来判断触摸，把一个投影键盘放在笔记本或手掌上；变体：让界面自动选择最大的可用平面出现。
works.description_zh: 一套戴在肩上的深度相机和投影仪，能随时把手掌、墙面、笔记本和桌面变成多点触控表面。
works.idea_en: A shoulder-mounted depth camera and projector turn your palm, a wall or a notebook into a multitouch screen on the spot.
works.technique_zh: 肩戴式深度相机在深度图像中寻找类似手指的圆柱体，并通过判断指尖是否距其下方表面仅几毫米来确定触摸；同时经过标定的微型投影仪把界面投射到检测到的表面上。
works.exercise_en: Use a depth camera (RealSense, Kinect or a LiDAR iPhone) to detect touch from the depth difference between finger and table, and place a projected keyboard on a notebook or your palm. Twist: make the interface automatically appear on the largest available surface.

works.title: Orators, Rostrums and Propaganda Stands
works.description: Virtual orators' podiums, inspired by early Soviet agitprop, are placed in public squares via AR for anyone to 'speak' from.
works.idea_zh: 在公共广场放置可发声的AR演讲台

video.video_title: Orators Rostrums and Propaganda Stands HSLU

works.technique: Geolocated AR podium models are placed in public squares, with the user physically stepping into the virtual rostrum; likely GPS positioning with compass-based orientation.
works.exercise_zh: 在校园广场放一个 AR 演讲台，站上去就触发录音，把每个人的发言留在台上供后来者听；变体：演讲台只播放与当前发言相反立场的上一条录音。
works.description_zh: 受早期苏联鼓动宣传艺术启发，作品通过 AR 在公共广场上放置虚拟演讲台，任何人都可以站上去“发言”。
works.idea_en: Place AR podiums in public squares that anyone can speak from.
works.technique_zh: 地理定位的 AR 演讲台模型被放置在公共广场上，用户可以亲身走进虚拟讲台；大概率采用 GPS 定位加指南针朝向。
works.exercise_en: Place an AR podium in a campus square: stepping onto it starts a recording, and each speech stays on the podium for later visitors to hear. Twist: the podium only plays back the previous recording that took the opposite position to the current speaker.

works.title: Para-Site (Mattress Factory)
works.description: Site-specific video projection on the architecture of the Mattress Factory, with light that seems to crawl along corners and surfaces.
works.idea_zh: 寄生在建筑角落上的光线投影

video.video_title: Pablo Valbuena - Para-Site [mattress factory]

works.technique: Site-specific projection mapping onto corners and edges of a room, with a keystone- or mesh-warped projection so thin light lines crawl precisely along architectural edges.
works.exercise_zh: 在教室的一个墙角用投影画出沿边缘缓慢爬行的细光线，用 mesh warp 精确贴合；变体：让光线像一只“寄生生物”一样对观众的靠近做出躲避反应（用摄像头检测）。
works.description_zh: 在 Mattress Factory 建筑上进行的在地视频投影，光线仿佛沿着墙角和表面缓缓爬行。
works.idea_en: Light projections that live like parasites on the corners of a building.
works.technique_zh: 针对房间墙角和边缘做在地投影映射，借助梯形校正或网格变形，让细细的光线精确地沿建筑边缘爬行。
works.exercise_en: Project thin lines of light that slowly crawl along the edges of one corner of your classroom, fitted precisely with mesh warp. Twist: make the light behave like a 'parasite' that shies away when viewers approach (detected with a camera).

works.title: Paranormal Activity: Sanctuary
works.description: A location-based multiplayer horror game tied to the film franchise: players see demons in the camera view around real places, exorcise them, and build safe-haven sanctuaries on the city map, while risking possession that turns them against allies.
works.description_zh: 一款与同名电影系列联动的基于地理位置的多人恐怖游戏：玩家在真实地点的摄像头画面中看到恶灵，驱除它们，并在城市地图上建立避难所，同时冒着被附身、反过来对付盟友的风险。
works.idea_en: A haunting that spreads across real city blocks, with players as exorcists or the possessed.
works.idea_zh: 闹鬼事件在真实街区蔓延，玩家要么是驱魔人，要么被附身。
works.technique: GPS and compass place spirits and sanctuaries at real locations and overlay them on the camera view, with shared server state for territory and possession.
works.technique_zh: 用 GPS 和指南针把灵体和避难所放在真实位置并叠加到摄像头画面上，服务器共享领地与附身状态。
works.exercise_en: Place five geolocated 'haunted' points around campus and make a phone AR view that shows a ghost when a player is within 20 m. Twist: players who fail to banish a ghost become visible as ghosts to other players.
works.exercise_zh: 在校园里放置五个带地理坐标的“闹鬼”点，做一个手机 AR 视图：玩家走到 20 米以内时显示幽灵。变体：没能驱走幽灵的玩家，会在其他玩家眼中变成幽灵。

video.video_title: Paranormal Activity: Sanctuary Official Trailer

works.title: Puppet Parade
works.description: Children puppeteer giant projected creatures with their arms via Kinect skeleton tracking, while others step into the scene to pet and feed them.
works.idea_zh: 用手臂操纵巨型投影木偶，其他孩子走进画面去喂它们。

video.video_title: Puppet Parade - Interactive Kinect Puppets

works.technique: Kinect skeleton tracking maps the shoulder-elbow-wrist chain to the joints of a projected puppet, with separate body detection for others who walk in to interact.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe Pose 把手臂的三个关节映射到一个大型投影提线木偶，另一人走进画面可以喂它；变体：两个人各控制木偶的一半身体，必须配合才能让它走路。
works.description_zh: 孩子们借助 Kinect 骨骼追踪，用手臂操纵巨大的投影生物，其他孩子则走进画面去抚摸和喂养它们。
works.idea_en: Work giant projected puppets with your arms while other kids walk into the scene to feed them.
works.technique_zh: Kinect 骨骼追踪把肩-肘-腕关节链映射到投影木偶的关节上，并单独检测走进画面参与互动的其他人。
works.exercise_en: Use MediaPipe Pose to map three arm joints onto a large projected marionette, and let a second person walk into the frame to feed it. Twist: two people each control half of the puppet's body and must cooperate to make it walk.

works.title: Scramble Suit
works.description: Inspired by Philip K. Dick's A Scanner Darkly: the live face is continuously re-substituted with many different faces so the wearer becomes impossible to describe.
works.idea_zh: 《黑暗扫描仪》式的“乱码衣”：你的脸不断被换成不同的人。

video.video_title: Scramble Suit

works.technique: The same FaceTracker mesh-warp-and-blend pipeline as Face Substitution, cycling through a large database of source faces every few frames so identity never stabilises.
works.exercise_zh: 收集全班 20 张正脸照，用 MediaPipe Face Mesh 每隔半秒给摄像头里的人换一张，做一件“无法被描述的面具”；变体：让换脸速度随周围人数增加而加快，讨论监控与匿名。
works.description_zh: 灵感来自菲利普·K·迪克的《A Scanner Darkly》（《黑暗扫描仪》）：画面中的脸不断被替换成许多不同的面孔，佩戴者因此变得无法被描述。
works.idea_en: A 'scramble suit' from A Scanner Darkly: your face keeps being swapped for different people.
works.technique_zh: 沿用 Face Substitution 中同一套 FaceTracker 网格变形与融合流程，每隔几帧就在一个大型源人脸库中切换一次，使身份始终无法稳定下来。
works.exercise_en: Collect 20 front-facing photos from the class and use MediaPipe Face Mesh to give the person on camera a new face every half second, making an 'indescribable mask'. Twist: speed up the swapping as more people gather nearby, and discuss surveillance and anonymity.

works.title: Shades of Absence: Public Voids
works.description: Geolocated AR at the Venice Biennale placing golden silhouettes of censored artists in public squares.
works.idea_zh: 在威尼斯公共空间放置被审查艺术家的金色剪影

video.video_title: "Shades of Absence: Public Voids" @ Venice Biennial 2011

works.technique: GPS-anchored Layar content places flat golden silhouette billboards in public squares, relying on coarse geolocation and compass heading.
works.exercise_zh: 选一个与“缺席”有关的主题（被遗忘的人、拆掉的建筑），用 WebAR 在对应地点放置金色剪影；变体：剪影只在没有人站在那个位置时才可见。
works.description_zh: 威尼斯双年展期间的地理定位 AR 作品，在公共广场上放置遭审查艺术家的金色剪影。
works.idea_en: Place golden silhouettes of censored artists in Venice's public spaces.
works.technique_zh: 基于 GPS 锚定的 Layar 内容在公共广场上放置平面金色剪影广告牌，依赖粗略的地理定位和指南针朝向。
works.exercise_en: Pick a theme about absence (forgotten people, demolished buildings) and use WebAR to place golden silhouettes at the matching locations. Twist: a silhouette is visible only when nobody is standing in that spot.

works.title: Sketch-a-race
works.description: Draw any line on paper, point an iPad at it, and the sketch becomes a race track with cars driving along it; players race using only stop-and-go controls and can switch to a first-person view.
works.description_zh: 在纸上随手画一条线，用 iPad 对准它，草图就变成一条赛道，小车沿着它行驶；玩家只用“走/停”控制比赛，还能切换到第一人称视角。
works.idea_en: Your own doodle is the level design.
works.idea_zh: 你自己的涂鸦就是关卡设计。
works.technique: The camera extracts the drawn stroke from the paper, converts it into a path spline and tracks the page so the 3D track stays registered in real time.
works.technique_zh: 摄像头从纸上提取手绘笔画，转换成路径样条，并追踪纸张，使 3D 赛道实时贴合。
works.exercise_en: Use OpenCV or an AR image tracker to detect a dark hand-drawn line on white paper and send a small car along it in AR. Twist: let line thickness control speed.
works.exercise_zh: 用 OpenCV 或 AR 图像追踪器检测白纸上的深色手绘线条，让一辆小车在 AR 中沿线行驶。变体：让线条粗细控制车速。

video.video_title: Sketch-a-race iPad2 Augmented Reality demo by Ogmento

works.title: Sketching up the World
works.description: On an early smartphone, a user sketches and places 3D content directly onto buildings in an unprepared outdoor scene, leaving annotations that others can find later.
works.description_zh: 在早期智能手机上，用户直接在未经预处理的户外场景中给建筑绘制草图、放置三维内容，留下可供他人日后查看的注释。
works.idea_en: Anyone should be able to author AR content on the spot, with just a phone.
works.idea_zh: 任何人都应该能拿着手机，当场创作 AR 内容。
works.technique: Uses panoramic tracking with sensor fusion on the phone to register sketched and extruded content to the surroundings without a prior model.
works.technique_zh: 在手机上结合全景追踪与传感器融合，把绘制和挤出的内容配准到周围环境，无需预先建模。
works.exercise_en: Walk around campus with a phone AR drawing app and leave three spatial doodles that explain something about each place, then swap phones and hunt for each other's notes. Twist: allow only arrows and one word.
works.exercise_zh: 拿着手机 AR 绘画 App 在校园里走，给三个地点各留下一幅解释该地的空间涂鸦，然后交换手机寻找彼此的留言；变体：只允许画箭头并写一个词。

video.video_title: Sketching up the world: In situ authoring for mobile Augmented Reality

works.title: Snowflake Sculpture, Time Square Seoul
works.description: A huge constellation of suspended snowflake shapes fills a shopping mall atrium; from most balconies it looks abstract, but from one hidden vantage point the pieces line up into a secret image.
works.description_zh: 巨大的悬挂雪花形体群填满购物中心中庭；从大多数楼层看它是抽象的，但在一个隐藏的观看点，这些碎片会对齐成一幅秘密图像。
works.idea_en: An anamorphic sculpture rewards the one person who finds the right spot.
works.idea_zh: 一座变形透视雕塑，只奖励找到正确位置的那个人。
works.technique: Each element is placed in 3D along lines of sight from a chosen viewpoint so that their projections align into one picture only from there (anamorphosis).
works.technique_zh: 每个构件都沿着从某个选定观看点出发的视线放置在三维空间中，只有在那一点看时它们的投影才对齐成一幅画（变形透视）。
works.exercise_en: Hang ten paper shapes at different depths in a room so that from one marked spot they form a letter or face, then build the same illusion in an AR scene. Twist: make two different images visible from two different spots.
works.exercise_zh: 在房间里把十个纸片形状挂在不同深度，使它们从一个标记点看过去拼成一个字母或一张脸，再在 AR 场景中实现同样的错觉；变体：从两个不同位置分别能看到两幅不同的图像。

video.video_title: Snowflake sculpture at Time Square Seoul 2011

works.title: Sony PlayStation Realtime Projection Mapping
works.description: A living room is transformed live, in camera, into three famous film scenes: projections track moving furniture and puppets, while pyrotechnics and real objects blend with the projected worlds.
works.description_zh: 一间客厅在镜头前被实时改造成三个著名电影场景：投影追踪移动的家具和木偶，烟火和真实物件与投影世界融为一体。
works.idea_en: Projection mapping that follows moving objects turns an ordinary room into a film set.
works.idea_zh: 能追踪移动物体的投影映射，把普通房间变成电影片场。
works.technique: Objects and puppets are tracked in 3D in real time and the projection content is re-rendered from the projector's viewpoint every frame, so the mapping stays locked to moving surfaces.
works.technique_zh: 物体和木偶被实时三维追踪，投影内容每一帧都从投影机视角重新渲染，从而让映射始终锁定在移动的表面上。
works.exercise_en: Track a white box with an ArUco marker from the projector's camera and keep a texture projected on it while a classmate moves it around. Twist: turn the box into a 'window' onto a movie scene that stays fixed in world space.
works.exercise_zh: 用贴了 ArUco 标记的白色纸盒，从投影机旁的摄像头追踪它，同学移动纸盒时让贴图始终投在盒子上；变体：把纸盒变成一扇“窗”，透过它看到一个固定在空间中的电影场景。

video.video_title: Sony Realtime Projection Mapping 1

works.title: The Walking Cube
works.description: A large cube frame is shaken and tilted by mechanical actuators, and synchronized light and video make it look like a living creature walking, breathing and stumbling.
works.description_zh: 一个大型立方体框架被机械装置摇晃和倾斜，同步的灯光与影像让它看起来像一只正在行走、呼吸、踉跄的生物。
works.idea_en: Combine small physical motion with light to give a simple shape a personality.
works.idea_zh: 把微小的实体运动和光结合起来，让一个简单几何体拥有性格。
works.technique: Pneumatic or motorized actuators under the legs are sequenced with lighting and video cues from the same timeline.
works.technique_zh: 腿部下方的气动或电机执行器与灯光、影像提示在同一条时间轴上编排。
works.exercise_en: Put a cardboard cube on four servo 'legs' controlled by an Arduino and sync LED strips to its movement to make it look scared, happy or tired. Twist: let it react to a clap.
works.exercise_zh: 把一个纸板立方体放在四个由 Arduino 控制的舵机“腿”上，用 LED 灯带配合动作，让它看起来害怕、开心或疲惫；变体：让它对拍手声做出反应。

video.video_title: The Walking Cube - 1024 architecture

works.title: Traces
works.description: An interactive artwork using a Kinect camera that reflects visitors as trails of light, turning movement into drawings.
works.idea_zh: Kinect把观众的动作变成光的轨迹

video.video_title: Traces - by James Alliban

works.technique: A Kinect depth image is thresholded into a body silhouette, and its contour or motion is accumulated over time in openFrameworks to draw fading light trails.
works.exercise_zh: 用 TouchDesigner 的 Kinect 或摄像头人体分割，把人的轮廓做成缓慢消退的光轨投到墙上；变体：让轨迹只记录两个人之间的“空隙”而不是身体本身。
works.description_zh: 一件使用 Kinect 相机的互动作品，把观众映照成一道道光的轨迹，让动作变成绘画。
works.idea_en: A Kinect turns visitors' movements into trails of light.
works.technique_zh: 对 Kinect 深度图像做阈值处理得到人体剪影，再在 openFrameworks 中随时间累积其轮廓或运动，绘制出逐渐消退的光轨。
works.exercise_en: Use Kinect or camera body segmentation in TouchDesigner to turn people's outlines into slowly fading light trails projected on a wall. Twist: make the trails record only the 'gap' between two people rather than their bodies.

works.title: XYZT, Abstract Landscapes
works.description: An exhibition of ten interactive installations where visitors touch, blow on and walk through projected typographic and particle landscapes.
works.idea_zh: 用触摸、吹气、行走去改变由字母和粒子组成的风景
works.technique: Floor and wall projections use camera, depth and touch sensing to feed eMotion physics systems, so visuals respond like material.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个地面投影粒子池，用俯拍摄像头让走过的人“划开”粒子；变化：用麦克风吹气强度控制粒子飞散的方向。

video.video_title: Adrien M & Claire B : XYZT / 1min trailer

works.description_zh: 一个由十件互动装置组成的展览，观众可以触摸、吹气，或从投影出的文字与粒子风景中穿行而过。
works.idea_en: Touch, blow and walk to reshape landscapes made of letters and particles.
works.technique_zh: 地面和墙面投影利用摄像头、深度和触摸传感为 eMotion 物理系统提供输入，让画面像真实材料一样作出反应。
works.exercise_en: Build a floor-projected particle pool and use an overhead camera so people walking through 'part' the particles. Twist: use a microphone to let the strength of a breath control which way the particles scatter.

works.title: 3D Video Capture with Kinect
works.description: Days after Kinect's release, Kreylos showed live 3D video of himself captured by a Kinect and viewed from any angle, an early step toward volumetric telepresence.
works.idea_zh: Kinect刚发售几天，就把人实时捕捉成可以任意角度观看的3D视频。

video.video_title: 3D Video Capture with Kinect

works.technique: The Kinect's depth image is back-projected into a 3D point cloud using its camera intrinsics and textured with the calibrated RGB image, so the capture can be rendered from any virtual viewpoint.
works.exercise_zh: 用 LiDAR iPhone 或 Record3D 采集自己的实时点云，在 three.js 中从任意角度旋转观看，并在其旁边放一个虚拟物体；变体：把点云风格化（体素、线框或粒子）拍一个 30 秒短片。
works.description_zh: Kinect 发售仅几天后，Kreylos 就展示了用 Kinect 实时捕捉、可从任意角度观看的自己的 3D 影像，这是迈向体积式远程临场的早期一步。
works.idea_en: Days after the Kinect came out, he captured a person as live 3D video you could view from any angle.
works.technique_zh: 利用 Kinect 相机内参把深度图像反投影成三维点云，再用标定后的 RGB 图像为其着色，使捕捉结果可以从任意虚拟视角渲染。
works.exercise_en: Capture a live point cloud of yourself with a LiDAR iPhone or Record3D, orbit it from any angle in three.js, and place a virtual object beside it. Twist: stylize the point cloud (voxels, wireframe or particles) and shoot a 30-second short.

works.title: AR X-Ray Vision Based on Visual Saliency
works.description: A user looks at a building and sees through its wall into the hidden room behind, while the most noticeable parts of the wall, like edges and signs, stay visible for context.
works.description_zh: 用户看向一栋建筑，就能透过墙看到后面隐藏的房间，同时墙面上最显眼的部分（如边缘和标识）仍然保留，提供上下文。
works.idea_en: See through walls, but keep just enough of the wall so your brain believes the depth.
works.idea_zh: 透视墙壁，但保留恰好足够的墙面，让大脑相信深度关系。
works.technique: Computes a visual saliency map of the occluding surface and uses it to decide which occluder pixels to keep over the rendered hidden content.
works.technique_zh: 计算遮挡表面的视觉显著性图，据此决定在渲染出的隐藏内容上方保留哪些遮挡物像素。
works.exercise_en: Photograph a door and the room behind it, then build a phone AR peephole that blends the hidden room over the live door while keeping the door's edges. Twist: let the hole follow a flashlight app's beam.
works.exercise_zh: 拍下一扇门和门后的房间，做一个手机 AR 窥视孔，把隐藏房间融合到实时的门上，同时保留门的边缘；变体：让窥视孔跟随手电筒 App 的光束移动。

video.video_title: An Augmented Reality X-Ray System Based on Visual Saliency (ISMAR 2010)

works.title: ARmonica
works.description: A collaborative sonic AR environment where users place and bounce virtual objects off physical bars to trigger musical notes together.
works.idea_zh: 多人在空间里摆放虚拟物体，让它们弹跳碰撞奏出音乐。

video.video_title: ARmonica: A Collaborative Sonic Environment

works.technique: Physical bars are tracked and modeled as colliders in a physics simulation, and virtual objects bouncing off them trigger pitched sound events rendered with spatial audio for all participants.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中检测桌面，把几根实体铅笔或尺子标记为“琴键”（手动放置对应虚拟碰撞体），让虚拟小球弹跳碰到时发出不同音高；变体：两人各控制一个发球点，合作弹出一段旋律。
works.description_zh: 一个协作式的声音 AR 环境：用户放置虚拟物体，让它们在实体横杆上弹跳，共同触发音符。
works.idea_en: Several people place virtual objects in space and let them bounce and collide to make music.
works.technique_zh: 实体横杆被追踪并在物理模拟中建模为碰撞体，虚拟物体弹到上面时触发带音高的声音事件，并以空间音频的形式呈现给所有参与者。
works.exercise_en: Detect a tabletop in AR, mark a few real pencils or rulers as 'keys' (placing matching virtual colliders by hand), and make virtual balls play different pitches when they bounce off them. Twist: two people each control a launch point and cooperate to play a melody.

works.title: Argon AR Browser
works.description: Argon, the first AR web browser, renders standards-based web content (KHARMA/KML, later HTML/JavaScript) anchored to places and images, so anyone can author AR like a web page.
works.idea_zh: 用网页技术写AR，让现实世界可以像网页一样被发布和浏览。

video.video_title: Argon: Augmented Reality Browser

works.technique: Argon exposed AR as a web platform: pages written in KML/KHARMA and later HTML/JavaScript declared content anchored to geolocation or image targets, and the browser supplied the tracked camera pose to render it.
works.exercise_zh: 用 WebXR（three.js）或 8th Wall 写一个完全用网页技术制作的 AR 页面，把 HTML 卡片锚定在一个平面或图像上，并分享链接给同学直接打开；变体：让同学通过编辑一个 JSON 文件就能往你的 AR 页面里添加内容。
works.description_zh: Argon 是第一款 AR 网页浏览器，它把基于标准的网页内容（KHARMA/KML，后来是 HTML/JavaScript）锚定在地点和图像上，让任何人都能像做网页一样创作 AR。
works.idea_en: Write AR with web technology so the real world can be published and browsed like a web page.
works.technique_zh: Argon 把 AR 做成一个网页平台：用 KML/KHARMA（后来是 HTML/JavaScript）编写的页面声明锚定于地理位置或图像目标的内容，浏览器则提供被追踪的相机位姿来渲染这些内容。
works.exercise_en: Build an AR page made entirely with web technology using WebXR (three.js) or 8th Wall, anchor an HTML card to a plane or image, and share the link so classmates can open it directly. Twist: let classmates add content to your AR page just by editing a JSON file.

works.title: Art Critic Face Matrix (We AR in MoMA)
works.description: Part of the uninvited AR show in MoMA: a matrix of critics' faces floats in the galleries, visible only through the Layar browser.
works.idea_zh: 在MoMA内部未经许可放置批评家面孔矩阵

video.video_title: Art Critic Face Matrix in MoMA (face detail)

works.technique: Layar geolocated POIs position billboarded 2D/3D content by GPS coordinates inside the museum, so anyone with the app sees it without the institution's permission.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR.js location-based 或 8th Wall 在学校某个“权威”空间（校长室门口、图书馆）放一组未经许可的虚拟面孔或评论；变体：让面孔的内容来自同学对这个空间的真实评价。
works.description_zh: 这是在 MoMA 举办的“不请自来”AR 展览的一部分：一组艺术评论家的面孔矩阵漂浮在展厅中，只有通过 Layar 浏览器才能看见。
works.idea_en: Put a matrix of critics' faces inside MoMA without permission.
works.technique_zh: Layar 的地理定位兴趣点按 GPS 坐标在博物馆内放置始终朝向观者的 2D/3D 内容，任何装了该应用的人都能看到，而无需机构许可。
works.exercise_en: Use location-based AR.js or 8th Wall to place a set of unauthorized virtual faces or comments in an 'authority' space at school (the principal's door, the library). Twist: draw the faces' content from classmates' real opinions of that space.

works.title: Augmented (hyper)Reality: Domestic Robocop
works.description: A first-person walk through a kitchen where every surface is covered in AR labels, recipes, ads and reward points; the film imagines how an 'augmented' home would be monetised.
works.idea_zh: 把家里每个平面都变成广告与界面，预演被信息淹没的增强生活

video.video_title: Augmented (hyper)Reality: Domestic Robocop

works.technique: Design-fiction compositing: a handheld first-person shot is camera-tracked in post (After Effects / 3D tracker) so UI labels are pinned to kitchen surfaces; a live version can be approximated with AR plane and image anchors.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 平面检测或 8th Wall 在厨房/宿舍的桌面、冰箱门上贴满标签、广告和积分弹窗，拍一段 30 秒第一人称视频；变体：让每个标签都要求用户“付费”或“看广告”才能关闭。
works.description_zh: 以第一人称视角走过一间厨房，每个表面都覆盖着 AR 标签、菜谱、广告和积分奖励；影片设想了一个被“增强”的家会如何被商业化。
works.idea_en: Turn every surface at home into ads and interfaces to rehearse a life drowning in information.
works.technique_zh: 设计虚构式的合成：手持第一人称镜头在后期中做摄像机追踪（After Effects / 3D 追踪器），把 UI 标签钉在厨房表面上；实时版本可以用 AR 平面锚点和图像锚点来近似实现。
works.exercise_en: Use AR Foundation plane detection or 8th Wall to cover the tables and fridge door of a kitchen or dorm with labels, ads and points pop-ups, and shoot a 30-second first-person video. Twist: every label demands that the user 'pay' or 'watch an ad' before it can be closed.

works.title: Augmented City 3D
works.description: A stereoscopic film of a walk through a city whose AR layers can be customised, shared and hijacked, questioning who designs the augmented urban space.
works.idea_zh: 城市空间变成可订阅、可定制的AR图层，每个人看到不同的城市

video.video_title: Augmented City 3D [OFFICIAL]

works.technique: Stereoscopic 3D film with camera-tracked CG layers composited onto street footage; in a live build this maps to geolocated or VPS anchors with per-user layer sets.
works.exercise_zh: 选一段校园路线，在 WebXR 或 Unity 里做两套不同的 AR 图层（如“商业版”和“社群版”）并用按钮切换；变体：加入一个“被劫持”的图层，由另一名同学远程往你的城市里塞内容。
works.description_zh: 一部立体影片，带观众走过一座城市，城市中的 AR 图层可以被定制、分享和劫持，由此追问：增强后的城市空间由谁来设计？
works.idea_en: The city becomes subscribable, customizable AR layers, so everyone sees a different city.
works.technique_zh: 立体 3D 影片，把经过摄像机追踪的 CG 图层合成到街景素材上；若做成实时版本，则对应于地理定位或 VPS 锚点，加上按用户区分的图层集合。
works.exercise_en: Choose a campus route and build two different sets of AR layers in WebXR or Unity (say a 'commercial' version and a 'community' version), switched with a button. Twist: add a 'hijacked' layer that another classmate remotely stuffs with content in your city.

works.title: Cinématique
works.description: A dancer and a juggler-programmer perform inside projected letters, lines and particles that behave with physics and react to their gestures in real time.
works.idea_zh: 让投影里的文字和线条像有重量的物体一样被舞者推动
works.technique: Adrien Mondot's eMotion software runs physics-based particle and line systems, driven live by a digital performer and by motion sensing of the dancers.
works.exercise_zh: 用p5.js或Processing做有重力的文字粒子，投到墙上让同学用手势（摄像头）推开它们；变化：文字被推散后会慢慢组合成新的句子。

video.video_title: Adrien M & Claire B : Cinématique

works.description_zh: 一位舞者和一位兼任程序员的杂耍艺人在投影出的文字、线条和粒子中表演，这些元素遵循物理规律，并对他们的动作作出实时反应。
works.idea_en: Let a dancer push projected letters and lines as if they were objects with weight.
works.technique_zh: Adrien Mondot 的 eMotion 软件运行基于物理的粒子与线条系统，由一位数字表演者现场操控，同时接收舞者的动作感应数据。
works.exercise_en: Make text particles with gravity in p5.js or Processing, project them on a wall, and let classmates push them away with hand gestures (via camera). Twist: once scattered, the letters slowly reassemble into a new sentence.

works.title: EyePet (PlayStation Move edition)
works.description: EyePet updated for the PlayStation Move controller, which becomes tracked tools such as a hairdryer, shower head or paint brush in the pet's AR world.
works.idea_zh: 手里的Move手柄变成吹风机、画笔等AR工具，照顾宠物。

video.video_title: EyePet Move E3 Trailer

works.technique: The Move controller's glowing ball is tracked by the camera for position and its IMU for orientation, so it can be rendered as swappable virtual tools in the pet's space.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机当道具控制器，把它的姿态映射成 AR 中的吹风机、刷子等工具，给宠物梳洗；变体：每种工具有独特的声音反馈。
works.description_zh: 为 PlayStation Move 手柄推出的 EyePet 升级版，手柄在宠物的 AR 世界里变成可被追踪的工具，比如吹风机、花洒或画笔。
works.idea_en: The Move controller in your hand becomes an AR hairdryer or paintbrush for looking after your pet.
works.technique_zh: 摄像头追踪 Move 手柄上发光球的位置，IMU 提供其朝向，因此手柄可以在宠物空间中渲染为可切换的虚拟工具。
works.exercise_en: Use a phone as a prop controller, map its orientation to AR tools such as a hairdryer or brush, and groom a pet. Twist: give each tool its own distinctive sound feedback.

works.title: Face projection test
works.description: Real-time projection mapping onto a moving face: a face tracker drives graphics projected directly onto the performer's skin.
works.idea_zh: 把图形直接投影到会动的人脸上，脸成为实时屏幕。

video.video_title: face projection test

works.technique: A face tracker on a camera co-located with the projector detects landmarks, and a camera-projector homography (calibrated once) warps the rendered graphics so they land on the moving face.
works.exercise_zh: 把投影仪和摄像头并排放置，用 MediaPipe Face Mesh 检测脸，再通过四点标定把图形投到同学脸上（注意亮度和眼睛安全）；变体：只投射在脸上会“流下来”的动态纹理，讲一个关于情绪的小片段。
works.description_zh: 在移动的人脸上做实时投影映射：人脸追踪器驱动图形，直接投射到表演者的皮肤上。
works.idea_en: Project graphics straight onto a moving face so the face becomes a live screen.
works.technique_zh: 与投影仪放在一起的摄像头上运行人脸追踪器来检测特征点，再通过（只需标定一次的）相机-投影仪单应矩阵对渲染图形做变形，使其准确落在移动的脸上。
works.exercise_en: Place a projector and camera side by side, detect a face with MediaPipe Face Mesh, and use four-point calibration to project graphics onto a classmate's face (mind the brightness and eye safety). Twist: project only dynamic textures that 'run down' the face, telling a short piece about emotion.

works.title: Fat Tag, Meet Projector
works.description: The Fat Tag iPhone graffiti app wired straight into a pocket projector, turning finger-drawn tags into instant projection bombing on city walls.
works.idea_zh: 手机上手指画的涂鸦直接投到街头墙面，最简“投影轰炸”。

video.video_title: Fat Tag, Meet Projector

works.technique: Touch strokes from a phone drawing app are streamed (likely over OSC or network) to a laptop that renders them to a pico projector aimed at a wall.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个手机网页画板，用 WebSocket 把笔画实时传到连投影仪的电脑并投到墙上；变体：限定只能画一种符号，全班在同一面墙上合作完成一幅“标签地图”。
works.description_zh: 把 iPhone 涂鸦应用 Fat Tag 直接接到口袋投影仪上，手指画出的涂鸦标签立刻就能“投影轰炸”到城市墙面上。
works.idea_en: Finger graffiti on a phone goes straight onto a street wall: the simplest projection bombing.
works.technique_zh: 手机绘画应用中的触摸笔画被实时传送（大概率通过 OSC 或网络）到一台笔记本电脑，由它渲染并输出到对准墙面的微型投影仪。
works.exercise_en: Make a phone web drawing pad, stream strokes over WebSocket to a computer connected to a projector, and project them onto a wall. Twist: allow only one kind of symbol, and have the whole class build a 'tag map' together on the same wall.

works.title: Feedback (with Todd Vanderlin)
works.description: A large interactive wall for Roundhouse CircusFest that turns performers' and visitors' movements into layered visual feedback; a later version used Kinect for 3D interaction.
works.idea_zh: 把人的动作不断回授成层层叠叠的视觉回声
works.technique: Camera (later Kinect depth) input is composited with its own previous frames to create a video-feedback trail driven by the body.
works.exercise_zh: 用摄像头画面叠加上一帧并略微缩放旋转，做出“视觉回声”投影；变化：用手的高度控制回声的旋转角度。

video.video_title: Feedback

works.description_zh: 为 Roundhouse CircusFest 制作的大型互动墙，把表演者和观众的动作变成层层叠叠的视觉反馈；后来的版本使用 Kinect 实现三维互动。
works.idea_en: Feed people's movements back into themselves as layer upon layer of visual echoes.
works.technique_zh: 摄像头（后来改为 Kinect 深度）输入与自身之前的帧进行合成，形成由身体驱动的视频反馈拖尾。
works.exercise_en: Overlay the camera image on the previous frame with a slight scale and rotation to project a 'visual echo'. Twist: use hand height to control the echo's rotation angle.

works.title: Ghost Projection for Richard III
works.description: Stage media for a Carnegie Mellon production of Richard III: computer vision tracks actors playing ghosts and projects static noise only onto their moving bodies.
works.idea_zh: 舞台上只在“鬼魂”演员身上投影雪花噪点，让他们变成幽灵。

video.video_title: Ghost Projection (Test) for Richard III

works.technique: Stage cameras (likely IR with background subtraction) segment the actors' bodies, and the resulting matte, warped through a camera-projector calibration, restricts projected video noise to their silhouettes.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe 人体分割加投影仪，只在同学身上投电视雪花噪点，背景保持全黑；变体：写一段 1 分钟的“鬼魂独白”，让噪点随台词音量变强变弱。
works.description_zh: 为卡内基梅隆大学《理查三世》制作的舞台影像：计算机视觉追踪扮演鬼魂的演员，只在他们移动的身体上投射静电雪花噪点。
works.idea_en: Project static noise only onto the 'ghost' actors on stage, turning them into phantoms.
works.technique_zh: 舞台摄像头（可能是红外摄像头配合背景减除）把演员的身体分割出来，得到的遮罩经过相机-投影仪标定变换后，把投影的视频噪点限制在他们的剪影之内。
works.exercise_en: Use MediaPipe body segmentation and a projector to cast TV static only onto a classmate, keeping the background completely black. Twist: write a one-minute 'ghost monologue' and let the static grow and fade with the loudness of the lines.

works.title: Growth (Virtual Public Art Project)
works.description: Visitors to Prospect Park in Brooklyn point an iPhone or Android phone at a spot in the park and see a 30-foot fractal polygon sculpture standing among the trees.
works.description_zh: 来到布鲁克林展望公园的游客把 iPhone 或安卓手机对准公园里某个位置，就能看到一座 9 米高的分形多边形雕塑矗立在树木之间。
works.idea_en: Install a giant public sculpture that costs nothing to build and exists only through phones.
works.idea_zh: 安装一座不花建造成本、只在手机中存在的巨型公共雕塑。
works.technique: A hand-made physical form was 3D-scanned and placed at GPS coordinates using an early location-based AR browser (likely Layar), viewable from all sides.
works.technique_zh: 先手工制作实体造型并三维扫描，再用早期的基于位置的 AR 浏览器（很可能是 Layar）放置到 GPS 坐标上，可从各个方向观看。
works.exercise_en: Sculpt a small object from clay, scan it with a phone, and place it in a campus square at large scale using a geolocated AR tool. Twist: design it so it only makes sense from one path through the square.
works.exercise_zh: 用黏土捏一个小物件，用手机扫描，再用基于地理位置的 AR 工具把它放大放置在校园广场上；变体：把它设计成只有沿着某条路线穿过广场时才能看懂。

video.video_title: The Virtual Public Art Project - Christopher Manzione

works.title: In-Place Sketching AR Games
works.description: Prototype games in which players draw walls, holes and characters on paper, and the camera turns the drawing into a playable AR level that updates as they keep sketching.
works.description_zh: 几款原型游戏：玩家在纸上画出墙、洞和角色，摄像头把画作变成可玩的 AR 关卡，而且随着继续作画实时更新。
works.idea_en: Drawing and playing happen on the same sheet at the same time.
works.idea_zh: 画画和玩游戏在同一张纸上同时发生。
works.technique: Sketch recognition classifies hand-drawn symbols into game elements and tracks the paper itself, based on research by Nate Hagbi, Raphael Grasset, Oriel Bergig, Mark Billinghurst and Jihad El-Sana (IEEE VR 2010).
works.technique_zh: 草图识别把手绘符号分类为游戏元素，同时追踪纸张本身；技术源自 Nate Hagbi、Raphael Grasset、Oriel Bergig、Mark Billinghurst 和 Jihad El-Sana 的研究（IEEE VR 2010）。
works.exercise_en: Define three drawn symbols (circle = hole, line = wall, X = goal) and build an AR ball-rolling game whose level is read from a photo of the paper. Twist: let a second player sabotage by drawing during play.
works.exercise_zh: 定义三种手绘符号（圆 = 洞，线 = 墙，X = 终点），做一个 AR 滚球游戏，关卡从纸张照片中读取。变体：允许第二位玩家在游戏过程中动笔搞破坏。

video.video_title: Augmented Reality Hand Sketching Games

works.title: Intangible States (with Stray Dogs)
works.description: A live audiovisual performance where video by Legoman is projection-mapped onto a stage set of stacked boxes and screens, evoking the dream states of an urban nomad.
works.idea_zh: 把城市漂泊者的梦境投影到一堆箱子搭成的舞台上
works.technique: Live VJ software maps video onto each face of stacked boxes using masks and corner-pinning, performed in sync with live electronic music.
works.exercise_zh: 用纸箱堆出舞台，用免费映射软件（如MapMapper/Resolume试用版）把不同视频贴到每个面；变化：现场根据音乐切换每个箱子的画面。

video.video_title: ARCHIVE - Intangible States (by Stray Dogs & Legoman)

works.description_zh: 一场现场视听表演，Legoman 的影像被投影映射到由堆叠箱体和屏幕搭成的舞台布景上，呈现一个城市漂泊者的梦境状态。
works.idea_en: Project an urban drifter's dreams onto a stage built from a pile of boxes.
works.technique_zh: 现场 VJ 软件通过遮罩和四角定位把影像映射到堆叠箱体的各个面上，并与现场电子音乐同步演出。
works.exercise_en: Stack cardboard boxes into a stage and use free mapping software (such as MapMapper or a Resolume trial) to put different videos on each face. Twist: switch each box's image live in response to the music.

works.title: Invizimals: Shadow Zone
works.description: The sequel adds more creatures, new capture challenges and battles that play out around the camera-tracked trap card on the player's table.
works.idea_zh: 续作带来更多隐形生物和围绕陷阱卡的捕捉挑战。

video.video_title: inviZimals™: Shadow Zone Gameplay Trailer E3

works.technique: Marker-based tracking on the trap card anchors creatures and battle effects, with capture challenges requiring the player to move the handheld relative to the marker.
works.exercise_zh: 设计一个需要移动手机围绕标记卡才能完成的捕捉挑战，例如从特定角度对准生物；变体：捕捉时间窗口随生物稀有度缩短。
works.description_zh: 续作加入了更多生物、新的捕捉挑战，以及围绕玩家桌上那张被摄像头追踪的陷阱卡展开的对战。
works.idea_en: The sequel adds more invisible creatures and capture challenges built around the trap card.
works.technique_zh: 对陷阱卡进行基于标记的追踪，以此锚定生物和战斗特效；捕捉挑战要求玩家相对于标记移动掌机。
works.exercise_en: Design a capture challenge that can only be completed by moving the phone around a marker card, for example lining up with the creature from a specific angle. Twist: the capture window gets shorter the rarer the creature is.

works.title: LightSpace
works.description: Depth cameras and projectors make a whole room interactive: pick up a projected photo from a table, carry it on your hand and drop it onto a wall.
works.idea_zh: 把投影的照片从桌上'捧'起来，放在手上走过去，再'倒'到墙上。

video.video_title: LightSpace from Microsoft Research

works.technique: Several calibrated depth cameras and projectors share one room coordinate system, and virtual 'depth camera' projections of the point cloud detect when a hand touches a surface or holds a projected item, so content can move between surfaces and the body.
works.exercise_zh: 用一台投影仪和一个深度相机（或 MediaPipe 检测手掌位置）实现“捡起”投影在桌上的一张照片，让它跟随手掌移动，再“放”到墙上；变体：在搬运过程中让照片发生变化（翻面、变旧或变成声音）。
works.description_zh: 深度相机和投影仪让整个房间都能互动：从桌上拿起一张投影照片，托在手上走过去，再把它放到墙上。
works.idea_en: Scoop a projected photo off the table, carry it in your hand, and pour it onto the wall.
works.technique_zh: 多台经过标定的深度相机和投影仪共享同一个房间坐标系，对点云做虚拟“深度相机”投影，用于检测手何时触碰表面或托着投影物体，从而让内容在各个表面和身体之间移动。
works.exercise_en: With one projector and one depth camera (or MediaPipe palm detection), let people 'pick up' a photo projected on a table, have it follow the palm, and 'drop' it onto the wall. Twist: make the photo change while it is carried (flip over, age, or turn into sound).

works.title: LuminAR
works.description: Natan Linder's robotic desk lamp whose 'bulb' is a projector-camera: the lamp arm moves on its own to project interactive surfaces onto the desk, follow objects and scan documents.
works.idea_zh: 把台灯换成会自己转头的投影机器人，桌面上的任何地方都能变成触控界面。

video.video_title: LuminAR Demos

works.technique: A projector-camera pair is mounted as the head of a motorized multi-joint lamp arm, and computer vision on the camera (with depth sensing) chooses where to point the arm, projecting interfaces onto the desk and scanning objects under it.
works.exercise_zh: 把一台小投影仪和手机固定在台灯支架上，用摄像头检测桌上的纸张或手，把按钮、提示投影到该物体旁边；变体：给台灯设计一种“性格”，比如在你离开时低头、看到新物体时凑过去（可用舵机或手动摆拍演示）。
works.description_zh: Natan Linder 设计的机器人台灯，它的“灯泡”是一套投影仪-摄像头：灯臂会自行移动，把互动界面投到桌面上、跟随物体并扫描文档。
works.idea_en: Swap a desk lamp for a projector robot that turns its own head, so any spot on the desk can become a touch interface.
works.technique_zh: 一对投影仪-摄像头安装在电动多关节灯臂的头部，摄像头上的计算机视觉（配合深度感知）决定灯臂指向哪里，从而把界面投射到桌面上，并扫描下方的物体。
works.exercise_en: Mount a small projector and a phone on a desk-lamp arm, use the camera to detect paper or hands on the desk, and project buttons and hints next to that object. Twist: give the lamp a 'personality', such as bowing its head when you leave or leaning in when it sees a new object (demo with servos or by posing it by hand).

works.title: Night Lights
works.description: YesYesNo turned the five-storey Auckland Ferry Building into an interactive playground: visitors' silhouettes, hand gestures and phones controlled projections amplified across the facade.
works.idea_zh: 把整栋渡轮大楼变成身体的放大镜：人的剪影和手势被投影放大到五层楼高。

video.video_title: night lights

works.technique: Cameras segment visitors' silhouettes and hand gestures (background subtraction plus contour analysis), and phone input is received over the network, all mapped to graphics projection-mapped onto the building facade.
works.exercise_zh: 用 TouchDesigner 或 p5.js 把摄像头里的人影轮廓放大投到教学楼窗户或走廊墙上，挥手触发灯光扫过；变体：加入手机网页控制，让远处的人也能通过手机在墙上“开灯”。
works.description_zh: YesYesNo 把五层楼高的奥克兰渡轮大楼变成了一座互动游乐场：观众的剪影、手势和手机控制着投影，并被放大到整个建筑立面上。
works.idea_en: Turn a whole ferry building into a magnifier for the body, blowing up silhouettes and gestures five storeys high.
works.technique_zh: 摄像头分割出观众的剪影和手势（背景减除加轮廓分析），手机输入则通过网络接收，全部映射为投影映射到建筑立面上的图形。
works.exercise_en: Use TouchDesigner or p5.js to enlarge people's silhouettes from a camera and project them onto classroom-building windows or a hallway wall, with a wave of the hand sending light sweeping across. Twist: add phone web control so people far away can also 'switch on the lights' on the wall.

works.title: Perspective Lyrique
works.description: At the Fête des Lumières in Lyon, members of the public sing or shout into a microphone and the projected face on the old Célestins theatre façade opens its mouth, stretches and deforms with their voice.
works.description_zh: 在里昂灯光节上，观众对着麦克风唱歌或喊叫，投在塞莱斯坦剧院旧立面上的巨大面孔就随着他们的声音张嘴、拉伸、变形。
works.idea_en: Give a building a face and let the crowd's voice control its expression.
works.idea_zh: 给建筑一张脸，让人群的声音控制它的表情。
works.technique: An audio-analysis algorithm maps microphone volume and frequency to the deformation of a 3D mesh of the façade, rendered live and projection-mapped back onto it.
works.technique_zh: 音频分析算法把麦克风的音量和频率映射为建筑立面三维网格的变形，实时渲染后再投影映射回立面上。
works.exercise_en: Project a simple face onto a box or wall and drive its mouth, eyes and wobble from microphone amplitude and pitch in p5.js. Twist: let two microphones control the left and right halves of the face.
works.exercise_zh: 把一张简笔脸投到纸箱或墙面上，用 p5.js 读取麦克风的音量和音高，驱动嘴巴、眼睛和抖动；变体：用两个麦克风分别控制脸的左右两半。

video.video_title: PERSPECTIVE LYRIQUE - 1024 architecture

works.title: Real-time Panoramic Mapping and Tracking on Phones
works.description: The phone builds a 360-degree panorama of its surroundings as you turn and simultaneously tracks orientation against it for outdoor AR.
works.idea_zh: 转一圈手机就建好全景地图，并据此稳定地追踪方向。

video.video_title: Real time Panoramic Mapping and Tracking on Phones

works.technique: Assuming pure rotation, each camera frame is registered against a cylindrical panorama map being built incrementally, so the phone simultaneously extends the map and estimates its 3DOF orientation from it.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机陀螺仪（DeviceOrientation API）在网页中实现“原地转身看”的全景 AR：在 360 度方向上布置虚拟标签，并对照真实场景校准北向；变体：只在某一方向藏一个彩蛋，引导用户转身寻找。
works.description_zh: 当你转动手机时，它会构建周围环境的 360 度全景图，同时以此为参照追踪自身朝向，用于户外 AR。
works.idea_en: Turn the phone around once to build a panorama map, then track direction steadily against it.
works.technique_zh: 在纯旋转的假设下，每一帧相机画面都与正在增量构建的柱面全景图进行配准，手机因此能一边扩展地图，一边据此估计自身的 3DOF 朝向。
works.exercise_en: Use the phone gyroscope (DeviceOrientation API) to build a 'turn on the spot' panoramic AR web page: place virtual labels in all 360 degrees and calibrate north against the real scene. Twist: hide a single easter egg in one direction and lead the user to turn around and find it.

works.title: Rise and Fall
works.description: An interactive front-and-back magazine cover for Boards Magazine: holding the printed cover to a webcam and rotating it steers a story world rendered on top of it.
works.idea_zh: 拿着杂志封面对着摄像头旋转，封面上的世界随之展开故事。

video.video_title: Boards Interactive Magazine - Walkthrough

works.technique: Fiducial marker tracking on the printed cover estimates its 6-DoF pose from a webcam, and the cover's rotation angle drives gravity and scene state in a 3D world rendered on top.
works.exercise_zh: 用 8th Wall 或 AR Foundation 图像追踪识别一张自己设计的海报，海报倾斜角度决定虚拟小人往哪边滑，正反面各一个世界；变体：翻转海报时两个世界的故事会互相影响。
works.description_zh: 为 Boards 杂志设计的正反两面互动封面：把印刷封面举到网络摄像头前旋转，就能操控叠加其上的故事世界。
works.idea_en: Rotate a magazine cover in front of a webcam and the world on it unfolds a story.
works.technique_zh: 对印刷封面上的基准标记进行追踪，通过网络摄像头估计其 6DoF 位姿，封面的旋转角度驱动叠加其上的三维世界中的重力与场景状态。
works.exercise_en: Use 8th Wall or AR Foundation image tracking to recognize a poster you designed, let the poster's tilt decide which way a virtual figure slides, and give the front and back each their own world. Twist: flipping the poster makes the stories of the two worlds affect each other.

works.title: Sandbox (Relational Architecture 17)
works.description: On Santa Monica beach, tiny projections of beachgoers appear in two small sandboxes; when participants reach in, cameras relay their hands live to giant projectors that cover 8,000 m² of beach.
works.idea_zh: 你在小沙盒里伸出的手，被放大投射成覆盖整个海滩的巨手
works.technique: Infrared cameras capture people on the beach and hands over the sandboxes, cross-projecting each feed at opposite scales (tiny people in the box, giant hands on the beach).
works.exercise_zh: 一台手机拍桌上的手、另一台拍操场上的人，互相投到对方的空间里；变化：让小人和大手在投影中能“碰到”彼此并触发声音。

video.video_title: Sandbox

works.description_zh: 在圣莫尼卡海滩上，两个小沙盒里出现海滩游客的微缩投影；当参与者把手伸进沙盒，摄像头会把他们的手实时传给巨型投影仪，投满 8000 平方米的海滩。
works.idea_en: The hand you reach into a small sandbox is projected as a giant hand covering the whole beach.
works.technique_zh: 红外摄像头分别捕捉海滩上的人和沙盒上方的手，并以相反的尺度交叉投影各自的画面（盒子里是微小的人，海滩上是巨大的手）。
works.exercise_en: Have one phone film hands on a table and another film people on the sports field, and project each feed into the other's space. Twist: let the tiny people and the giant hands 'touch' each other in the projection and trigger sounds.

works.title: Sekai Camera for iPad
works.description: Sekai Camera on the iPad: the larger screen becomes a window onto the air-tag layer around the user.
works.idea_zh: 把iPad变成看见城市中'空中标签'的大窗口。

video.video_title: Sekai Camera for iPad

works.technique: The same geotag overlay approach is applied on a larger screen, with the device treated as a handheld window onto the tag layer.
works.exercise_zh: 对比手机和平板上同一个 AR 标签界面，调整标签密度和字号以适配大屏；变体：设计一种只在大屏上才有意义的交互。
works.description_zh: iPad 版 Sekai Camera：更大的屏幕成了一扇窗，让用户看见身边那一层“空中标签”。
works.idea_en: Turn the iPad into a large window for seeing the 'air tags' floating around the city.
works.technique_zh: 沿用同样的地理标签叠加方式，只是换到了更大的屏幕上，把设备当作观看标签图层的手持窗口。
works.exercise_en: Compare the same AR tag interface on a phone and a tablet, and adjust tag density and font size to suit the larger screen. Twist: design an interaction that only makes sense on the big screen.

works.title: Skinput
works.description: An armband of vibration sensors detects finger taps on the forearm and hand; a pico projector shows menus and a game directly on your skin.
works.idea_zh: 用手臂当触摸屏：轻敲皮肤不同位置就能操作投影在身上的菜单。

video.video_title: Skinput: Appropriating the Body as an Input Surface (CHI 2010)

works.technique: Piezoelectric vibration sensors on an armband capture the bio-acoustic signals of taps propagating through bone and soft tissue, and an SVM classifies the tap location from spectral features.
works.exercise_zh: 把手机贴在前臂上，用加速度计记录敲击手臂不同位置的震动，用 Teachable Machine（声音或自定义特征）训练 3 个位置的分类器，并把菜单投影或显示在手臂上；变体：把敲击换成在桌面、墙面等其他身体外物体上。
works.description_zh: 一个装有振动传感器的臂环能检测手指在前臂和手上的敲击，微型投影仪则把菜单和游戏直接投射在皮肤上。
works.idea_en: Use your arm as a touchscreen: tap different spots on your skin to work a menu projected onto your body.
works.technique_zh: 臂环上的压电振动传感器捕捉敲击在骨骼和软组织中传播的生物声学信号，再由 SVM 根据频谱特征判断敲击位置。
works.exercise_en: Strap a phone to your forearm, record accelerometer vibrations from taps at different spots on the arm, train a three-location classifier with Teachable Machine (sound or custom features), and project or display a menu on the arm. Twist: move the taps onto objects outside the body, such as a tabletop or wall.

works.title: Start the Party!
works.description: A PlayStation Move party game in which players see themselves on the TV and the glowing controller in their hand becomes a hair dryer, a fly swatter, a paintbrush or a sword inside the camera image.
works.description_zh: 一款 PlayStation Move 派对游戏：玩家在电视里看到自己，手中发光的手柄在摄像头画面里变成吹风机、苍蝇拍、画笔或宝剑。
works.idea_en: Your own mirror image is the game board, and one tracked stick turns into whatever tool each minigame needs.
works.idea_zh: 自己的镜像就是游戏棋盘，一根被追踪的手柄随小游戏变成需要的任何工具。
works.technique: The PlayStation Eye tracks the glowing Move sphere in 3D and the game replaces it with a virtual prop composited over the live mirrored video.
works.technique_zh: PlayStation Eye 在三维空间中追踪 Move 手柄顶端的发光球，游戏用虚拟道具替换它，并叠加在实时镜像视频上。
works.exercise_en: Build a webcam mirror game in p5.js or Unity: track a bright-colored object by color and replace it with a virtual tool that pops balloons drifting across the video. Twist: switch the tool every 15 seconds so players must change how they move.
works.exercise_zh: 用 p5.js 或 Unity 做一个摄像头镜像游戏：按颜色追踪一个鲜艳物体，把它替换成虚拟工具，去戳破在画面上飘过的气球。变体：每 15 秒切换一次工具，逼玩家改变动作方式。

video.video_title: Start the Party E3 Trailer

works.title: TETRA.TENNIS
works.description: The tennis court of the Paris Masters at Bercy is mapped from above between matches, with lines, grids and 3D illusions that make the flat court fold and break apart.
works.description_zh: 巴黎贝尔西大师赛的网球场在比赛间隙被从上方投影，线条、网格和三维错觉让平坦的球场仿佛折叠、碎裂。
works.idea_en: A sports field is a ready-made canvas whose lines can come alive.
works.idea_zh: 运动场本身就是现成的画布，场地线可以活过来。
works.technique: Overhead projectors aligned to the court's markings play animations that use the known line layout for perspective illusions visible to the audience in the stands.
works.technique_zh: 头顶投影机与球场标线对齐，播放利用已知场地线布局制作的透视错觉动画，供看台观众观看。
works.exercise_en: Map the lines of a basketball or badminton court (or a taped floor plan) from above and animate the lines turning into a maze. Twist: have a player walk the maze while the projection reacts to their position.
works.exercise_zh: 从上方投影篮球场或羽毛球场的场地线（或用胶带贴出的平面），让线条变成一座迷宫；变体：让一名玩家走迷宫，投影根据他的位置做出反应。

video.video_title: TETRA.TENNIS v3.0 - 1024 architecture

works.title: TeslaTouch
works.description: A touch screen that produces variable friction under a sliding finger using electrovibration, so flat images can feel rough, bumpy or sticky.
works.idea_zh: 让平板屏幕表面摸起来有纹理。

video.video_title: TeslaTouch: Electrovibration for Touch Surfaces (ACM UIST 2010)

works.technique: Applies a modulated high voltage to an insulated electrode so electrostatic attraction changes skin friction as the finger moves.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机振动API做一个“触觉纹理”画板：手指滑过不同颜色区域时产生不同节奏的振动；变化：让同伴闭眼只凭触感猜出图案。
works.description_zh: 一块触摸屏利用电振动在滑动的手指下产生可变摩擦力，让平面图像摸起来粗糙、凹凸不平或者发黏。
works.idea_en: Make the surface of a flat screen feel textured.
works.technique_zh: 向绝缘电极施加经过调制的高电压，使静电吸引力在手指移动时改变皮肤所受的摩擦力。
works.exercise_en: Use the phone vibration API to build a 'haptic texture' drawing board where a finger sliding over different colored areas triggers different vibration rhythms. Twist: have a partner close their eyes and guess the pattern by touch alone.

works.title: The 600 Years
works.description: For the 600th anniversary of Prague's Astronomical Clock, the medieval tower seems to crack, fill with gears, burn, rebuild itself and show its own history in a 10-minute mapping watched by thousands in Old Town Square.
works.description_zh: 为庆祝布拉格天文钟 600 周年，这座中世纪钟楼在十分钟的投影中仿佛裂开、塞满齿轮、燃烧、再自我重建，把自己的历史讲给老城广场上成千上万的观众。
works.idea_en: Make a monument narrate its own biography by pretending to take it apart.
works.idea_zh: 假装把一座建筑拆开，让它亲口讲述自己的一生。
works.technique: A precise 3D model of the tower is used to render animations that align to every ledge and window, projected from multiple overlapping high-lumen projectors.
works.technique_zh: 先建立钟楼的精确 3D 模型，依据它渲染与每个檐口和窗户完全对齐的动画，再由多台高亮度投影机重叠投射。
works.exercise_en: Photograph a shoebox 'building' head-on, trace its features in After Effects or p5.js, and make a 30-second mapping in which it breaks apart and reassembles. Twist: tell the building's fictional history in three chapters.
works.exercise_zh: 正面拍摄一个鞋盒做的“建筑”，在 After Effects 或 p5.js 中描出它的结构，做一段 30 秒的投影：它碎开又重新拼好；变体：分三个章节讲述这座建筑虚构的历史。

video.video_title: The 600 Years

works.title: The Leak in Your Hometown
works.description: Point a phone at any BP logo and an AR broken pipe gushes oil out of it, bringing the Deepwater Horizon spill to your own street.
works.idea_zh: 对准任何BP标志，都会喷出AR原油

video.video_title: "The leak in your home town" documentation of BP oil spill app

works.technique: Image (logo) marker tracking in junaio detects any BP logo and anchors an animated broken pipe with an oil particle effect to it.
works.exercise_zh: 选一个你想批评的品牌 logo，用 MindAR 或 8th Wall 图像追踪让它“泄漏”出象征其问题的东西；变体：让泄漏量随观众对准的时间增加，最终淹没整个画面。
works.description_zh: 把手机对准任意一个 BP 标志，就会有一根破裂的 AR 管道从中喷出原油，把深水地平线漏油事件带到你家门口的街道上。
works.idea_en: Point at any BP logo and AR crude oil gushes out of it.
works.technique_zh: junaio 中的图像（标志）标记追踪能识别任何 BP 标志，并在其上锚定一根带有石油粒子特效的破裂管道动画。
works.exercise_en: Pick a brand logo you want to criticize and use MindAR or 8th Wall image tracking to make it 'leak' something that stands for its problem. Twist: let the leak grow the longer viewers point at it until it floods the whole screen.

works.title: Warcraft ARmor
works.description: A marker-based AR demo that dresses the user's body in World of Warcraft-style armour on screen.
works.idea_zh: 把游戏盔甲穿到真人身上

video.video_title: Augmented Reality "Warcraft ARmor"  -- Demo

works.technique: Printed fiducial markers worn on the body are tracked by a webcam, and armour pieces are rendered at each marker's pose.
works.exercise_zh: 在手臂和胸前贴几张打印标记，用 MindAR 给身体“穿”上你设计的盔甲或服装；变体：把盔甲换成代表某种日常压力的装备（作业、通知）。
works.description_zh: 一个基于标记的 AR 演示，在屏幕上给用户的身体穿上《魔兽世界》风格的盔甲。
works.idea_en: Put game armor on a real person.
works.technique_zh: 网络摄像头追踪佩戴在身上的打印基准标记，并在每个标记的位姿处渲染相应的盔甲部件。
works.exercise_en: Stick a few printed markers on your arms and chest and use MindAR to 'dress' your body in armor or clothing you designed. Twist: replace the armor with gear that stands for some everyday pressure (homework, notifications).

works.title: We AR in MoMA
works.description: An uninvited AR exhibition inside MoMA New York: artworks by Manifest.AR members were geolocated into the galleries and visible only via the Layar app.
works.idea_zh: 不请自来，用AR在MoMA里开了一场展览

video.video_title: MoMA NYC augmented reality exhibition

works.technique: Geolocated Layar layers placed virtual works at GPS coordinates inside MoMA, exploiting the fact that the location-based layer could not be controlled by the institution.
works.exercise_zh: 在学校某个正式展厅里用 WebAR 办一场“不请自来”的展览，每人放一件作品并通过二维码传播；变体：作品必须回应展厅中某件真实展品。
works.description_zh: 一场在纽约 MoMA 内部举办的“不请自来”的 AR 展览：Manifest.AR 成员的作品被地理定位到各个展厅中，只有通过 Layar 应用才能看到。
works.idea_en: Show up uninvited and stage an AR exhibition inside MoMA.
works.technique_zh: 通过地理定位的 Layar 图层，把虚拟作品放在 MoMA 内部的 GPS 坐标上，利用了机构无法控制基于位置的图层这一点。
works.exercise_en: Stage an 'uninvited' WebAR exhibition in a formal gallery at your school, with each person placing one work and spreading it via QR codes. Twist: every work must respond to a real piece on display in that gallery.

works.title: White Heat
works.description: A flock of projected 'light-beings', inspired by the Game of Life and Reynolds' boids, reacts to visitors and to a collection of artists' books and evolves over the show.
works.idea_zh: 一群由规则驱动的光之生物，会围着观众和书本聚散演化
works.technique: openFrameworks runs boid flocking plus cellular-automaton rules, using camera-detected visitors as attractors or obstacles.
works.exercise_zh: 用p5.js写boids鸟群，把摄像头检测到的人当作吸引点投影在桌上；变化：在桌上放一本书，鸟群会避开或聚集在书周围。

video.video_title: White Heat

works.description_zh: 一群投影出来的“光之生物”受生命游戏和 Reynolds 的 boids 算法启发，会对观众和一批艺术家书作出反应，并在展期中不断演化。
works.idea_en: A swarm of rule-driven light creatures gathers, scatters and evolves around visitors and books.
works.technique_zh: openFrameworks 运行 boids 群集算法和元胞自动机规则，把摄像头检测到的观众当作吸引点或障碍物。
works.exercise_en: Write a boids flock in p5.js and project it onto a table, treating people detected by the camera as attractors. Twist: place a book on the table and have the flock avoid it or gather around it.

works.title: Word Lens
works.description: Point an iPhone at a sign or menu and the printed Spanish or English text is replaced in place, in the same style, with its translation, running offline in real time.
works.idea_zh: 对准外语招牌，文字当场被替换成母语，像魔法一样。

video.video_title: Introducing Word Lens

works.technique: On-device OCR finds text regions, a dictionary translates them, and the original text is painted over with sampled background color and redrawn in a matching font.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Google ML Kit 或 Tesseract 识别画面中的文字，把它替换成另一种语言或另一句话并贴回原位；变体：把所有标识都替换成反义词。
works.description_zh: 把 iPhone 对准路牌或菜单，上面印着的西班牙语或英语文字会在原位被替换成译文，字体风格保持一致，全程离线实时运行。
works.idea_en: Point at a foreign sign and the words turn into your own language on the spot, like magic.
works.technique_zh: 设备端 OCR 找出文字区域，用词典进行翻译，再用采样得到的背景色覆盖原文，并以匹配的字体重新绘制。
works.exercise_en: Use Google ML Kit or Tesseract to recognize text in the camera view, replace it with another language or another sentence, and paste it back in place. Twist: replace every sign with its antonym.

works.title: Your uncertain shadow (colour)
works.description: Five coloured lamps shine on a white wall; each visitor casts a row of overlapping coloured shadows that move with them, splitting the body into a spectrum.
works.idea_zh: 五盏彩色灯把你的影子分解成一串彩虹
works.technique: Coloured HMI lamps placed side by side produce additive-colour light; blocking one lamp leaves its complementary colour, so each shadow is a different hue.
works.exercise_zh: 用红绿蓝三盏手机灯（或彩色玻璃纸）照白墙，研究影子颜色；变化：用舞蹈动作让彩色影子拼出一个字母。

video.video_title: Olafur Eliasson 'Your Uncertain Shadow (Colour)' 2010

works.description_zh: 五盏彩色灯照在一面白墙上，每位观众都会投下一排相互重叠、随人移动的彩色影子，身体仿佛被拆分成一道光谱。
works.idea_en: Five colored lamps split your shadow into a string of rainbows.
works.technique_zh: 并排放置的彩色 HMI 灯通过加色混合发光；挡住其中一盏灯，就会留下它的补色，因此每个影子都呈现不同的色调。
works.exercise_en: Shine three phone lights in red, green and blue (or use colored cellophane) on a white wall and study the colors of the shadows. Twist: use dance moves to make the colored shadows spell out a letter.

works.title: the concept of ... (here and now)
works.description: A dance piece choreographed not only for the audience's viewpoint but also for camera perspectives, so dancers' bodies combine into impossible figures on the projected image.
works.idea_zh: 同时为观众和摄像机两个视角编舞，让身体在画面里拼成不可能的形体
works.technique: Fixed live cameras film the stage from unusual angles and the feed is projected as a stereoscopic/composited view that only aligns from the camera's perspective.
works.exercise_zh: 固定一台摄像机从上方或侧面拍，让两三位同学在现场摆姿势使画面里拼成一个新形状；变化：观众只能看投影、不能看现场，猜真实站位。

video.video_title: the concept of ... (here and now) – Klaus Obermaier (2010)

works.description_zh: 这支舞作不仅为观众的视角编排，也为摄像机的视角编排，舞者的身体在投影画面中组合成不可能存在的形体。
works.idea_en: Choreograph for both the audience and the camera so bodies merge into impossible shapes on screen.
works.technique_zh: 固定的现场摄像机从不寻常的角度拍摄舞台，画面以立体/合成视图的形式投影出来，只有从摄像机的视角看才会对齐。
works.exercise_en: Fix a camera shooting from above or from the side, and have two or three classmates pose on site so their bodies combine into a new shape on screen. Twist: the audience may only watch the projection, not the live scene, and must guess where everyone is really standing.

works.title: 555 KUBIK
works.description: 'How it would be if a house was dreaming': the cube façade of Hamburg's Galerie der Gegenwart appears to bulge, fold and dissolve under a projected 3D animation.
works.idea_zh: 假如一栋房子在做梦——让方正建筑看起来在弯曲、折叠
works.technique: A 3D model of the façade is animated with fake depth and lighting, then projected from the audience's viewpoint so the illusion of deformation holds.
works.exercise_zh: 用纸盒做建筑，在Blender里做同形状模型的变形动画，从观众角度投影对齐；变化：换一个观看角度，讨论为什么错觉消失。

video.video_title: 555 KUBIK | facade projection

works.description_zh: “假如一栋房子在做梦会是什么样”：在投影的三维动画下，汉堡当代美术馆（Galerie der Gegenwart）的立方体立面仿佛在鼓胀、折叠和消融。
works.idea_en: What if a house were dreaming? Make a boxy building look like it is bending and folding.
works.technique_zh: 对立面的三维模型施加假深度和光照动画，再从观众的视角投影，使变形的错觉得以成立。
works.exercise_en: Build a building from cardboard boxes, animate a deforming model of the same shape in Blender, and project it aligned from the viewer's position. Twist: change the viewing angle and discuss why the illusion disappears.

works.title: AR Tele-Echography (2009)
works.description: A remote doctor guides a local operator's ultrasound probe in real time using AR overlays that show where and how to move it.
works.idea_zh: 远程医生用 AR 叠加指引本地人员操作超声探头。

video.video_title: AR Tele-Echography: Remote Instruction of Ultrasound Probe Operation (2009)

works.technique: Fiducial markers on the probe and patient are tracked with OpenCV, and the remote doctor's target probe pose is streamed and rendered as an overlay guiding the local operator.
works.exercise_zh: 用两台手机，一人在远端屏幕上拖动虚拟箭头，另一人的 AR 画面中同步显示箭头指引他移动桌上的真实物体；变体：用于远程教别人叠一只纸鹤。
works.description_zh: 远程医生借助 AR 叠加信息，实时指导本地操作者移动超声探头，显示应该往哪里、以何种方式移动。
works.idea_en: A remote doctor uses AR overlays to guide a local helper in handling an ultrasound probe.
works.technique_zh: 用 OpenCV 追踪探头和患者身上的基准标记，远程医生设定的目标探头位姿被实时传输过来，并渲染为叠加画面来引导本地操作者。
works.exercise_en: With two phones, have one person drag a virtual arrow on a remote screen while the other's AR view shows the arrow in sync, guiding them to move a real object on the table. Twist: use it to teach someone remotely how to fold a paper crane.

works.title: ARMAR: AR for Maintenance and Repair
works.description: Steve Henderson and Steven Feiner guide a mechanic inside an armored personnel carrier turret with head-worn AR arrows, labels and animated tools, speeding up task localization.
works.idea_zh: 在装甲车炮塔里，头戴AR箭头直接指出下一颗要拧的螺丝。

video.video_title: Augmented Reality for Task Localization in Maintenance of an Armored Personnel Carrier Turret

works.technique: An optically tracked head-worn display renders arrows, labels and animated tool models registered to the vehicle interior, guiding attention to the next task location and demonstrating the procedure in place.
works.exercise_zh: 在手机 AR 中用图像目标定位一台打印机或自行车，为一个 5 步维修流程做箭头、标签和动画扳手指引；变体：当用户视野里看不到目标部件时，显示屏幕边缘的方向提示。
works.description_zh: Steve Henderson 和 Steven Feiner 在装甲运兵车的炮塔内，通过头戴式 AR 显示的箭头、标签和工具动画来指导机械师作业，加快了定位任务位置的速度。
works.idea_en: Inside an armored vehicle turret, head-worn AR arrows point straight at the next bolt to turn.
works.technique_zh: 采用光学追踪的头戴式显示器渲染与车辆内部配准的箭头、标签和工具动画模型，把注意力引向下一个任务位置，并在原位演示操作步骤。
works.exercise_en: In phone AR, use an image target to locate a printer or bicycle and build arrow, label and animated-wrench guidance for a five-step repair procedure. Twist: when the target part is out of view, show a direction hint at the edge of the screen.

works.title: ARhrrrr!
works.description: A zombie shooter on a tabletop city map: from a helicopter view on a mobile device you shoot zombies and can drop real Skittles candies onto the map as explosives.
works.idea_zh: 在桌上的城市地图里打僵尸，扔一颗真彩虹糖就是一枚炸弹。

video.video_title: ARhrrrr - An augmented reality shooter

works.technique: Natural feature tracking of a printed city map provides the camera pose on a GPU-accelerated handheld, and colored blobs (Skittles) placed on the map are detected by color segmentation and turned into explosive game objects.
works.exercise_zh: 用一张打印地图作为图像目标做一个 AR 射击或塔防游戏，并用颜色检测识别玩家放在地图上的真实彩色糖果或积木作为炸弹或障碍；变体：让真实物品的颜色决定它在游戏中的功能。
works.description_zh: 一款在桌面城市地图上进行的僵尸射击游戏：玩家在移动设备上以直升机视角射杀僵尸，还可以把真实的彩虹糖扔到地图上当作炸弹。
works.idea_en: Shoot zombies on a tabletop city map, where each real Skittle you drop is a bomb.
works.technique_zh: 在 GPU 加速的手持设备上，对打印的城市地图做自然特征追踪以获得相机位姿；放在地图上的彩色色块（彩虹糖）通过颜色分割被检测出来，并转换为会爆炸的游戏物体。
works.exercise_en: Use a printed map as an image target to make an AR shooting or tower-defense game, and use color detection to recognize real colored candies or blocks that players put on the map as bombs or obstacles. Twist: let the color of a real object decide its role in the game.

works.title: AntiVJ - SONGDO
works.description: An audiovisual projection performance on architecture in New Songdo City, South Korea.
works.idea_zh: 在韩国新松岛城建筑上的视听投影

video.video_title: AntiVJ - SONGDO

works.technique: Architectural projection mapping with content built from the building's surveyed geometry and synced to a live audio performance.
works.exercise_zh: 用积木或纸盒搭一个“未来城市”模型，投影一段表现这座城市从空白到建成的视听动画；变体：在动画最后让城市慢慢被自然“收回”。
works.description_zh: 在韩国新松岛城建筑上进行的一场视听投影表演。
works.idea_en: An audiovisual projection on the buildings of New Songdo City in South Korea.
works.technique_zh: 建筑投影映射，内容依据建筑的实测几何结构制作，并与现场音频表演同步。
works.exercise_en: Build a 'future city' model from blocks or cardboard boxes and project an audiovisual animation of the city growing from empty ground to completion. Twist: at the end of the animation, let nature slowly 'take back' the city.

works.title: Art of Defense
works.description: A collaborative AR tower defense game played on a physical board with tangible tiles, shown at SIGGRAPH 2009.
works.idea_zh: 用实体板块搭建地图，多人合作玩AR塔防。

video.video_title: Art of Defense:  A collaborative Augmented Reality Game (SIGGRAPH 2009)

works.technique: Tangible tiles carry fiducial markers that are tracked by handheld cameras, and each tile's position and rotation define a tower's placement and aim in a shared tower-defense game rendered over the board.
works.exercise_zh: 用多张带 ArUco 标记的卡片作为“炮塔”，手机 AR 识别卡片位置并在上面显示炮塔，敌人沿虚拟路径进攻；变体：卡片的旋转角度决定炮塔的朝向，两位玩家必须分工摆放。
works.description_zh: 一款在实体棋盘上用可触摸板块进行的协作式 AR 塔防游戏，在 SIGGRAPH 2009 上展出。
works.idea_en: Build the map from physical tiles and play AR tower defense together.
works.technique_zh: 可触摸的板块上带有基准标记，由手持摄像头追踪；每块板的位置和旋转决定了炮塔的摆放和瞄准方向，共享的塔防游戏则渲染在棋盘之上。
works.exercise_en: Use several cards with ArUco markers as 'towers': phone AR recognizes each card's position and shows a tower on it while enemies attack along a virtual path. Twist: each card's rotation sets its tower's facing, and two players must split up the placement.

works.title: Augmented Reality Business Card
works.description: Holding up his printed business card to a webcam makes a 3D video of the artist pop out of it and introduce himself.
works.idea_zh: 举起名片，名片上弹出会说话的3D本人

video.video_title: Augmented Reality Business Card

works.technique: FLARToolKit tracks a square fiducial marker printed on the card in a Flash webcam app, and a video plane of the artist is rendered at the marker's pose with Papervision3D.
works.exercise_zh: 设计一张自己的名片，用 MindAR 让名片上弹出一段抠像的自我介绍视频；变体：让视频中的你对着观众的拿法做出反应（倾斜名片就“摔倒”）。
works.description_zh: 把他的印刷名片举到网络摄像头前，艺术家本人的 3D 视频就会从名片上弹出来做自我介绍。
works.idea_en: Hold up a business card and a talking 3D version of its owner pops out.
works.technique_zh: 在 Flash 网络摄像头应用中，用 FLARToolKit 追踪名片上印的方形基准标记，再用 Papervision3D 在标记位姿处渲染艺术家的视频平面。
works.exercise_en: Design your own business card and use MindAR to make a keyed self-introduction video pop out of it. Twist: have the video of you react to how the viewer holds the card (tilt it and you 'fall over').

works.title: Augmented Reality Marble Game
works.description: A tilting physical board controls virtual marbles rolling through AR mazes seen through a head-worn display.
works.idea_zh: 倾斜手中的真实板子，操控AR里的虚拟弹珠穿越迷宫。

video.video_title: Augmented Reality Marble Game

works.technique: The tracked board's orientation relative to gravity is computed from the marker pose, and that tilt is fed as a gravity vector into a physics engine that rolls virtual marbles through a maze registered to the board.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中把一张打印的迷宫图作为图像目标，读取它相对于桌面的倾斜角度，驱动 Unity 物理引擎让虚拟弹珠滚动；变体：让两个人同时拿着同一块板合作过关。
works.description_zh: 倾斜一块实体板，就能操控虚拟弹珠在 AR 迷宫中滚动，玩家通过头戴式显示器观看。
works.idea_en: Tilt a real board in your hands to steer virtual marbles through an AR maze.
works.technique_zh: 根据标记位姿计算被追踪板子相对于重力的朝向，再把这个倾角作为重力向量输入物理引擎，让虚拟弹珠在与板子配准的迷宫中滚动。
works.exercise_en: In AR, use a printed maze as an image target, read its tilt relative to the table, and drive the Unity physics engine to roll a virtual marble. Twist: have two people hold the same board and clear the level together.

works.title: Augmented Reality Ribbons
works.description: Marker-tracked AR where flowing 3D ribbons spill out of a printed marker and follow its movement, reacting to music.
works.idea_zh: 从标记中涌出、随音乐飘动的AR丝带

video.video_title: Augmented Reality Ribbons

works.technique: A tracked fiducial marker emits procedurally generated ribbon geometry whose points trail the marker's recent positions, with amplitude driven by audio analysis.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MindAR 或 AR.js 让图像标记拖出一条记录其移动轨迹的 3D 丝带，并用麦克风音量控制丝带宽度；变体：把丝带换成由你最近聊天记录中的文字组成的“文字带”。
works.description_zh: 基于标记追踪的 AR：流动的 3D 丝带从印刷标记中涌出，随标记移动，并对音乐作出反应。
works.idea_en: AR ribbons pour out of a marker and sway to music.
works.technique_zh: 被追踪的基准标记发射程序化生成的丝带几何体，丝带上的点沿标记最近的位置拖尾，其振幅由音频分析驱动。
works.exercise_en: Use MindAR or AR.js to make an image marker trail a 3D ribbon that records its path, with microphone volume controlling the ribbon's width. Twist: replace the ribbon with a 'text band' made of words from your recent chats.

works.title: Chase
works.description: An interactive mobile projection from a moving car in which projected characters chase along the street as the vehicle travels.
works.idea_zh: 让投影角色在街景中追逐行驶的汽车
works.technique: Likely the same car-mounted projection rig as Wildlife, with animation playback driven by vehicle motion data.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机投影或小投影仪边走边投，让角色速度与步行速度同步；变化：让观众用手机遥控角色在墙上跳过障碍。

video.video_title: Chase

works.description_zh: 一件从行驶的汽车上进行的互动移动投影作品，车辆前行时，投影出的角色沿着街道一路追逐。
works.idea_en: Projected characters chase a moving car along the street.
works.technique_zh: 大概率与 Wildlife 使用同一套车载投影装置，由车辆运动数据驱动动画播放。
works.exercise_en: Project from a phone projector or a small projector while walking, keeping the character's speed in sync with your walking pace. Twist: let viewers use their phones to make the character jump over obstacles on the wall.

works.title: Decrypted Reflections
works.description: Visitors move an analog array of mirrors to break apart and rearrange a projected generative image, scattering its fragments across the room.
works.idea_zh: 移动一组镜子，把投影的生成图形拆散、反射到空间各处。

video.video_title: Decrypted Reflections

works.technique: A projected generative image hits an array of physically adjustable mirrors, so rotating mirrors redirects fragments of the projection around the room in an analog, non-computed way.
works.exercise_zh: 把投影打到一排可转动的小镜子（或手机屏幕、镜面纸）上，让画面碎片反射到房间各处，大家转镜子重组图像；变体：设计一张只有所有碎片落在同一面墙上时才能读出的秘密信息。
works.description_zh: 观众移动一组模拟的镜子阵列，把投影出的生成图像打散、重新排列，让图像碎片散落在整个房间里。
works.idea_en: Move a set of mirrors to break a projected generative image apart and bounce it all over the room.
works.technique_zh: 投射出的生成图像打在一组可手动调节的镜子上，转动镜子就能以模拟、非计算的方式把投影碎片重新引向房间各处。
works.exercise_en: Project onto a row of small rotatable mirrors (or phone screens, mirror paper) so fragments bounce around the room, and let everyone turn the mirrors to reassemble the image. Twist: design a secret message that can only be read when every fragment lands on the same wall.

works.title: Déshérence (AntiVJ)
works.description: An audiovisual installation in Enghien-les-Bains where projection mapping makes a building façade appear to crack, peel and reassemble in sync with music by Squeaky Lobster.
works.idea_zh: 让建筑立面在投影中剥落、崩塌再重组
works.technique: Façade geometry is measured and modelled, then animations are rendered to that model and projected from a calibrated position so light aligns with each architectural edge.
works.exercise_zh: 给教室一面有门窗的墙拍正面照，在AE/网页里沿着门窗轮廓做“剥落”动画并用投影对齐；变化：让剥落顺序由音乐鼓点触发。

video.video_title: AntiVJ - Déshérence

works.description_zh: 在昂吉安莱班（Enghien-les-Bains）的一件视听装置，投影映射让建筑立面仿佛开裂、剥落并重新拼合，并与 Squeaky Lobster 的音乐同步。
works.idea_en: Make a building facade peel, crumble and reassemble in projection.
works.technique_zh: 先测量立面几何并建模，再针对该模型渲染动画，并从标定好的位置投影，使光线与每一条建筑边缘对齐。
works.exercise_en: Photograph a classroom wall with a door and windows head-on, animate a 'peeling' effect along their outlines in After Effects or a web page, and align it with a projector. Twist: let the drum beats of a piece of music trigger the order of the peeling.

works.title: EyePet
works.description: A virtual monkey-like pet appears on the living-room floor through the PlayStation Eye; players stroke, feed and wash it with their hands and draw toys on paper that it brings to life.
works.idea_zh: 一只会对你的手势做出反应的AR宠物，还能把你画在纸上的东西变成玩具。

video.video_title: EyePet™  trailer

works.technique: A fixed camera uses a marker card to locate the floor, and frame-differencing motion detection lets the player's hand movements near the pet count as touches.
works.exercise_zh: 用网页摄像头和帧差法检测手在画面某区域的移动，让屏幕上的虚拟宠物被“摸”时做出反应；变体：在纸上画一个圆，宠物把它当成球来玩。
works.description_zh: 通过 PlayStation Eye，一只像小猴子的虚拟宠物出现在客厅地板上；玩家可以用手抚摸、喂食和给它洗澡，还能在纸上画玩具，让它把画变成真的。
works.idea_en: An AR pet that reacts to your hand gestures and turns what you draw on paper into toys.
works.technique_zh: 固定摄像头借助一张标记卡定位地面，并用帧差法做运动检测，玩家的手在宠物附近移动就被视为触摸。
works.exercise_en: Use a webcam and frame differencing to detect hand movement in one region of the image, and make an on-screen virtual pet react when it is 'stroked'. Twist: draw a circle on paper and have the pet play with it as a ball.

works.title: Filmmuseum augmented sand sculpture
works.description: An augmented projection that unveiled a five-metre sand sculpture of Amsterdam's future Film Museum building in stages using projection mapping.
works.idea_zh: 用投影在沙雕上逐步“揭幕”未来的电影博物馆大楼。

video.video_title: Filmmuseum- new building introduction

works.technique: Projection mapping aligns projector output to the physical sculpture using a 3D model or manually warped masks, then reveals textures and animations region by region.
works.exercise_zh: 用黏土或纸盒做一个小建筑，用 TouchDesigner 或 MadMapper 的遮罩把投影对准每个面，分阶段“揭幕”；变体：投影讲述这个建筑从建造到废墟的一生。
works.description_zh: 一件增强投影作品：通过投影映射，分阶段为一座五米高的沙雕“揭幕”，沙雕表现的是阿姆斯特丹未来的电影博物馆大楼。
works.idea_en: Use projection to unveil the future film museum on a sand sculpture step by step.
works.technique_zh: 投影映射借助三维模型或手动变形的遮罩，把投影输出与实体雕塑对齐，再逐区域揭示纹理和动画。
works.exercise_en: Make a small building from clay or cardboard, use masks in TouchDesigner or MadMapper to align the projection with each face, and 'unveil' it in stages. Twist: have the projection tell the building's whole life, from construction to ruin.

works.title: Hand from Above
works.description: On BBC Big Screens in Liverpool and beyond, a giant hand reaches into the live camera feed of the square to tickle, stretch, flick and remove unsuspecting passers-by.
works.idea_zh: 广场大屏上一只巨手伸进实时画面，挠痒、拉长、甚至“拎走”路人。

video.video_title: Hand from Above

works.technique: Background subtraction and blob tracking find pedestrians in the live square feed, and a pre-animated giant hand is composited to target a chosen person, warping or removing their pixels.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe 检测监控视角画面里的人，从画面上方伸下一只动画大手去“戳”其中一个人，把他拉长或挤扁；变体：大手只挑低头看手机的人，做一个关于注意力的小恶作剧。
works.description_zh: 在利物浦等地的 BBC 户外大屏上，一只巨手伸进广场的实时摄像画面，给毫无防备的路人挠痒、把他们拉长、弹飞，甚至直接“拎走”。
works.idea_en: A giant hand reaches into the live feed on a square's big screen to tickle, stretch and even lift away passers-by.
works.technique_zh: 背景减除和色块追踪在广场的实时画面中找出行人，预先制作好的巨手动画被合成进来瞄准选中的某个人，对其像素进行变形或移除。
works.exercise_en: Use MediaPipe to detect people in a CCTV-style view and have an animated giant hand reach down from the top of the frame to 'poke' one of them, stretching or squashing them. Twist: the hand only picks people looking down at their phones, making a small prank about attention.

works.title: Invizimals
works.description: A PSP game with a clip-on camera: players scan their surroundings to detect invisible creatures, then trap them on a printed marker card where they fight on the tabletop.
works.idea_zh: 用掌机摄像头在家里'捕捉'隐形怪兽，放在卡片上对战。

video.video_title: Invizimals

works.technique: A printed fiducial card gives the camera pose for tabletop rendering, while a color-detection capture step (pointing the camera at certain hues) is used to spawn creatures.
works.exercise_zh: 用摄像头颜色检测“发现”隐藏生物：对准某种颜色的物体时出现提示，再在图像标记卡上召唤它；变体：不同颜色对应不同属性的生物。
works.description_zh: 一款外接夹式摄像头的 PSP 游戏：玩家扫描周围环境来探测隐形生物，再把它们困在一张印刷标记卡上，在桌面上展开对战。
works.idea_en: Use a handheld's camera to 'catch' invisible monsters at home and battle them on a card.
works.technique_zh: 印刷的基准卡为桌面渲染提供相机位姿，捕捉环节则通过颜色检测（把摄像头对准特定色调）来生成生物。
works.exercise_en: Use camera color detection to 'discover' hidden creatures: a hint appears when you point at an object of a certain color, and then you summon it onto an image-marker card. Twist: different colors map to creatures with different attributes.

works.title: Knee Deep
works.description: Children stomp into projected worlds of different scales with their feet, seeing themselves composited into oceans, cities and planets from impossible points of view.
works.idea_zh: 用脚踏进不同尺度的世界，看见自己踩在海洋、城市甚至星球里。

video.video_title: Knee Deep - Cinekid 2009

works.technique: Chroma keying or background subtraction isolates children's feet and legs from an overhead camera, which are then composited at a different scale into pre-rendered or live 3D worlds.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe 人体分割把同学抠出来，缩放后合成进一张城市航拍或显微镜照片里，投到地上让大家“踩进”画面；变体：每走一步切换一个尺度，从蚂蚁视角到星球视角。
works.description_zh: 孩子们用脚踏进不同尺度的投影世界，从不可能的视角看见自己被合成进海洋、城市和星球之中。
works.idea_en: Step into worlds of different scales and see yourself standing in oceans, cities and even planets.
works.technique_zh: 利用色键抠像或背景减除，从俯拍摄像头画面中分离出孩子的脚和腿，再以不同的比例合成进预渲染或实时的三维世界里。
works.exercise_en: Use MediaPipe body segmentation to cut out a classmate, scale them and composite them into a city aerial photo or a microscope image, then project it on the floor so everyone can 'step into' the picture. Twist: switch scale with every step, from an ant's view to a planet's.

works.title: LEGO Digital Box kiosk
works.description: In LEGO stores, a child holds a sealed LEGO box up to a screen-and-camera kiosk and sees the finished model built and animated on top of the box.
works.description_zh: 在乐高门店里，孩子把一个未拆封的乐高盒子举到带摄像头的展台屏幕前，就能看到拼好的模型在盒子上方组装完成并动起来。
works.idea_en: A closed package previews its own contents in 3D before purchase.
works.idea_zh: 未拆封的包装盒在购买前就能用 3D 展示里面的内容。
works.technique: The kiosk camera recognizes printed box art as a natural-feature target and renders the assembled 3D set on top of it, mirrored on a large screen.
works.technique_zh: 展台摄像头把印刷的包装图案识别为自然特征目标，在其上渲染拼好的 3D 套装，并在大屏上镜像显示。
works.exercise_en: Use a cereal or product box as an image target and show an animated 3D preview of what could be inside. Twist: reveal a different surprise when the box is shaken.
works.exercise_zh: 拿一个麦片盒或商品盒当图像标记，展示盒内可能内容的 3D 动画预览。变体：摇一摇盒子就揭晓一个不同的惊喜。

video.video_title: Lego AR Kiosk

works.title: Layar Reality Browser
works.description: The first mobile AR browser: on an Android phone, the camera view shows geolocated layers of nearby homes for sale, restaurants, ATMs and more, published by anyone through an open API.
works.idea_zh: 世界上第一个手机AR浏览器，把各种地理信息图层叠加在相机画面上。

video.video_title: Re: Layar, worlds first mobile Augmented Reality browser

works.technique: Points of interest from third-party layers are fetched by API and rendered as camera-overlay markers using GPS, compass and accelerometer for bearing and elevation.
works.exercise_zh: 用一个开放数据接口（如 OpenStreetMap）获取附近的咖啡店，用 GPS + 指南针在摄像头画面中按方向显示；变体：只显示你从没去过的地方。
works.description_zh: 第一款手机 AR 浏览器：在 Android 手机上，相机画面中会显示附近待售房屋、餐厅、ATM 等地理定位图层，任何人都可以通过开放 API 发布这些图层。
works.idea_en: The world's first phone AR browser, stacking layers of location data on the camera view.
works.technique_zh: 通过 API 获取第三方图层中的兴趣点，并利用 GPS、指南针和加速度计计算方位与仰角，以相机叠加标记的形式渲染出来。
works.exercise_en: Fetch nearby cafes from an open data API (such as OpenStreetMap) and show them by direction in the camera view using GPS and compass. Twist: show only places you have never been.

works.title: PenLight
works.description: A digital pen with a built-in mini projector overlays digital content, such as building floor-plan layers, directly onto the paper where you are writing.
works.idea_zh: 笔尖自带投影，写在纸上的同时把数字图层投在纸上。

video.video_title: PenLight: Combining a Mobile Projector and a Digital Pen for Dynamic Visual Overlay

works.technique: Tracks the pen's position on dot-pattern paper and projects spatially registered overlays around the pen tip.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机投影仪对准一张打印的平面图，从上方投射“隐藏的水管/电路层”，学生用笔描出；变化：用手机AR替代投影，比较手持与投影的体验。
works.description_zh: 一支内置微型投影仪的数码笔，能把建筑平面图图层等数字内容直接叠加到你正在书写的纸上。
works.idea_en: A pen with its own projector casts digital layers onto the paper while you write.
works.technique_zh: 在点阵纸上追踪笔的位置，并在笔尖周围投射经过空间配准的叠加内容。
works.exercise_en: Aim a phone projector at a printed floor plan and project a 'hidden plumbing/wiring layer' from above for students to trace with a pen. Twist: replace the projector with phone AR and compare the handheld and projected experiences.

works.title: Put a Spell
works.description: A spelling game for children: a 3D panda appears on the iPhone screen above a table, and kids drop real letter cards into blank spaces to spell the word it asks for; the app recognizes and pronounces the letters.
works.description_zh: 一款儿童拼写游戏：iPhone 屏幕里的桌面上出现一只 3D 熊猫，孩子把真实的字母卡片放进空格里拼出它要求的单词，应用会识别并读出这些字母。
works.idea_en: Physical letter cards become the game controller for learning to spell.
works.idea_zh: 实体字母卡片变成学拼写的游戏手柄。
works.technique: Likely marker or card-art recognition identifies each letter card and its slot, while a 3D character is anchored to the table.
works.technique_zh: 很可能通过标记或卡面图案识别每张字母卡及其位置，同时把一个 3D 角色锚定在桌面上。
works.exercise_en: Print letter cards as image targets and make a phone AR scene where a creature appears only when the cards on the table spell its name. Twist: let the creature mispronounce misspelled words so children can hear the mistake.
works.exercise_zh: 把字母卡片打印成图像标记，做一个手机 AR 场景：只有当桌上的卡片拼出某个生物的名字时，它才会出现。变体：拼错时让生物读出错误的发音，让孩子听出哪里错了。

video.video_title: Put a Spell: Learn to spell with augmented reality - Teaser#1

works.title: Sekai Camera science museum navigation
