works.description: Sekai Camera air tags used as a guide inside a science museum, pointing visitors to exhibits through the camera view.
works.idea_zh: 用空中标签在科学馆里为参观者导航。

video.video_title: Sekai Camera to navigate you at a Science Museum ( Tonchidot Japan )

works.technique: Location-tagged labels pointing to exhibits are overlaid on the camera view based on device position and heading, working as indoor wayfinding.
works.exercise_zh: 在教学楼里放几个二维码或图像标记，扫描后在 AR 中显示指向下一个地点的箭头；变体：箭头的样式由上一位访客的评价决定。
works.description_zh: 在科学馆里把 Sekai Camera 的空中标签用作导览，通过相机画面为参观者指向各个展品。
works.idea_en: Guide visitors through a science museum with air tags.
works.technique_zh: 根据设备的位置和朝向，把指向展品的位置标签叠加在相机画面上，实现室内导航。
works.exercise_en: Place a few QR codes or image markers around a teaching building so that scanning one shows an AR arrow pointing to the next spot. Twist: the arrow's style is decided by the previous visitor's rating.

works.title: Shake Menus
works.description: Shake a tangible AR marker to pop up a radial menu around it; menus are anchored to the object in your hand.
works.idea_zh: 摇一摇手里的物体，菜单就在它周围弹出来。

video.video_title: Shake Menus

works.technique: The tracked marker's pose history is analyzed for a rapid back-and-forth motion, and when a shake is detected a radial menu is instantiated in the marker's coordinate frame so it moves with the object.
works.exercise_zh: 用图像追踪卡片或手机加速度计检测“摇一摇”，在卡片周围弹出一个环形 AR 菜单，倾斜卡片选择选项；变体：换成其他物理手势（翻转、敲击）并比较哪种最自然。
works.description_zh: 摇一摇可触摸的 AR 标记，一个环形菜单就会在它周围弹出；菜单锚定在你手中的物体上。
works.idea_en: Shake the object in your hand and a menu pops up around it.
works.technique_zh: 分析被追踪标记的位姿历史，寻找快速来回的运动；一旦检测到摇晃，就在标记的坐标系中生成环形菜单，使其随物体一起移动。
works.exercise_en: Detect a 'shake' with an image-tracked card or the phone accelerometer, pop up a ring-shaped AR menu around the card, and tilt the card to pick an option. Twist: swap in other physical gestures (flip, tap) and compare which feels most natural.

works.title: SixthSense (WUW – Wear Ur World)
works.description: A pendant with a pocket projector, mirror and camera projects interfaces onto walls, paper and hands; colored finger caps are tracked so you can frame a photo with your fingers, dial a phone on your palm or read live data projected onto a newspaper.
works.idea_zh: 把投影仪和摄像头挂在胸前，让整个世界、甚至自己的手掌都变成可用手势操作的屏幕。

video.video_title: SixthSense

works.technique: A webcam tracks colored finger caps by color thresholding and blob tracking, and a pico projector aimed via a mirror renders UI onto whatever surface is in front of the wearer, with the camera and projector roughly co-aligned so gestures map to projected content.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机前置摄像头加 MediaPipe Hands（或给指尖贴彩色胶带做颜色追踪）识别“双手取景框”等 3 个手势，并用小投影仪把对应界面投在桌面或手掌上；变体：只保留一个你每天真正会用的手势功能，并论证它为什么值得“挂在身上”。
works.description_zh: 一个挂在胸前的装置，内含口袋投影仪、镜子和摄像头，能把界面投射到墙面、纸张和手上；系统追踪指尖的彩色指套，你可以用手指框出画面拍照、在手掌上拨号，或看到投射在报纸上的实时数据。
works.idea_en: Hang a projector and camera on your chest so the whole world, even your own palm, becomes a gesture-driven screen.
works.technique_zh: 网络摄像头通过颜色阈值和色块追踪来跟踪彩色指套，经镜子折射的微型投影仪把 UI 渲染到佩戴者面前的任何表面上；摄像头与投影仪大致共轴，因此手势可以对应到投影内容上。
works.exercise_en: Use a phone's front camera with MediaPipe Hands (or colored tape on your fingertips for color tracking) to recognize three gestures such as a two-hand 'viewfinder frame', and use a small projector to cast the matching interface onto the desk or your palm. Twist: keep only one gesture feature you would really use every day, and argue why it deserves to be 'worn on the body'.

works.title: Sniff (with James George)
works.description: A projected dog in a street-facing shop window follows passers-by, reads their gestures as friendly or aggressive and tries to get them to play.
works.idea_zh: 橱窗里的虚拟小狗会跟着路人走，并判断你对它是友好还是凶
works.technique: A camera tracks pedestrians outside the window with openFrameworks and feeds position and gesture speed to a Unity-animated dog with simple behaviour states.
works.exercise_zh: 用摄像头检测人的位置和挥手速度，驱动一只屏幕上的虚拟宠物转头、靠近或躲开；变化：给宠物加“记忆”，同一个人第二次来时反应不同。

video.video_title: Sniff

works.description_zh: 临街橱窗里一只投影出来的狗会跟着路人走，把他们的手势解读为友好或挑衅，并试着让他们陪自己玩。
works.idea_en: A virtual dog in a shop window follows passers-by and judges whether you are friendly or mean to it.
works.technique_zh: 用 openFrameworks 通过摄像头追踪橱窗外的行人，把位置和手势速度传给一只用 Unity 制作动画、带有简单行为状态的狗。
works.exercise_en: Use a camera to detect a person's position and waving speed, and drive an on-screen virtual pet to turn its head, approach or shy away. Twist: give the pet 'memory' so it reacts differently when the same person comes back.

works.title: Space-Distorting AR
works.description: To find points of interest hidden behind buildings or outside the view, the mobile AR scene bends like a fisheye or folds space so distant or occluded places swing into sight.
works.description_zh: 为了找到被建筑挡住或在视野外的兴趣点，移动 AR 画面会像鱼眼一样弯曲，或把空间折叠起来，让远处或被遮挡的地方转进视野。
works.idea_en: Bend space in AR to reveal what is behind or beside you.
works.idea_zh: 在 AR 中弯折空间，把身后和身旁的东西展示出来。
works.technique: Applies egocentric radial distortion and melting-style deformations to a 3D model of the surroundings and its POIs in mobile mixed reality.
works.technique_zh: 在移动混合现实中，对周围环境及兴趣点的三维模型施加以自我为中心的径向变形和“融化”式形变。
works.exercise_en: Take a phone 360 photo of the schoolyard, map it into a tiny-planet view, and mark three hidden spots so classmates can find them faster. Twist: compare with a normal flat map.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机拍一张校园 360 度照片，转换成“小行星”视图，标出三个隐藏地点，看同学能否更快找到；变体：与普通平面地图进行对比。

video.video_title: Space-Distorting Augmented Reality (ISMAR 09)

works.title: Studierstube ES
works.description: Tech demo of TU Graz's handheld AR framework running multiplayer AR games, virtual characters and marker/natural feature tracking on 2009-era phones.
works.idea_zh: 在2009年的手机上就跑起了多人AR游戏和虚拟角色。

video.video_title: Studierstube ES Tech Demo   December 2009

works.technique: A lightweight fixed-point tracking library estimates 6DOF phone pose from square fiducial markers or natural features in real time on 2009-era mobile CPUs, and a scene-graph renderer draws characters over the camera image, with networking for multiplayer.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR.js 或 8th Wall 的标记追踪在一张打印卡上放一个会动的角色，并让两部手机通过网页同步看到同一个角色状态；变体：把运行帧率人为限制到 15fps、分辨率减半，体验 2009 年的约束并据此简化设计。
works.description_zh: 格拉茨工业大学手持 AR 框架的技术演示，在 2009 年前后的手机上运行多人 AR 游戏、虚拟角色，以及标记追踪和自然特征追踪。
works.idea_en: Multiplayer AR games and virtual characters already running on phones in 2009.
works.technique_zh: 一个轻量级的定点运算追踪库，在 2009 年前后的移动 CPU 上根据方形基准标记或自然特征实时估计手机的 6DOF 位姿；场景图渲染器在相机画面上绘制角色，并通过网络支持多人游戏。
works.exercise_en: Use marker tracking in AR.js or 8th Wall to place an animated character on a printed card, and let two phones see the same character state in sync through a web page. Twist: cap the frame rate at 15fps and halve the resolution to feel the constraints of 2009, then simplify the design to match.

works.title: Terrarium
works.description: A sonic ecosystem powered by visitors' voices: sounds enter through vents and are digested by creatures that grow and sustain life in the projected world.
works.idea_zh: 对着装置说话，声音变成养活虚拟生态的食物。

video.video_title: Terrarium - Interactive Installation

works.technique: Microphones feed amplitude and pitch features into an agent-based simulation, where incoming sounds become food particles and creatures grow according to what they consume.
works.exercise_zh: 用 p5.sound 把声音转成掉进投影世界里的“食物”粒子，简单的生物吃到后长大、没吃到会饿死；变体：不同音高是不同食物，大家用声音“喂养”一个共同物种。
works.description_zh: 一个由观众声音驱动的声音生态系统：声音从通风口进入，被生物消化，它们在投影世界中生长并维持生命。
works.idea_en: Talk to the installation and your voice becomes food that keeps a virtual ecosystem alive.
works.technique_zh: 麦克风把振幅和音高特征输入一个基于智能体的模拟系统，进入的声音变成食物粒子，生物根据吃到的东西生长。
works.exercise_en: Use p5.sound to turn sounds into 'food' particles that drop into a projected world, where simple creatures grow when they eat and starve when they do not. Twist: different pitches are different foods, and everyone uses their voices to 'feed' one shared species.

works.title: The EyeWriter
works.description: A low-cost eye tracker that let paralyzed graffiti artist TEMPT1 draw tags with his eyes; the tags were projected live onto buildings across Los Angeles.
works.idea_zh: 用眼睛画涂鸦：瘫痪的涂鸦艺术家靠眼球追踪作画，作品实时投影到城市建筑上。

video.video_title: The EyeWriter

works.technique: An IR-illuminated camera on glasses tracks the dark pupil and corneal glint, and a calibration grid maps the pupil-glint vector to screen coordinates for drawing, with dwell time used as a click.
works.exercise_zh: 用 WebGazer.js 或 MediaPipe 虹膜点做一个只用眼睛画画的网页，用注视停留 1 秒来落笔/抬笔，再投影到墙上；变体：给一位同学设定“不许动手”的限制，让他用眼睛签一个名字。
works.description_zh: 一套低成本眼动仪，让瘫痪的涂鸦艺术家 TEMPT1 能用眼睛画涂鸦标签，这些作品被实时投影到洛杉矶各处的建筑上。
works.idea_en: Graffiti drawn with the eyes: a paralyzed graffiti artist paints by eye tracking, and his work is projected live onto city buildings.
works.technique_zh: 眼镜上带红外照明的摄像头追踪暗瞳孔和角膜反光点，通过标定网格把瞳孔-反光点向量映射为屏幕坐标用于绘画，并以注视停留时间作为点击。
works.exercise_en: Use WebGazer.js or MediaPipe iris landmarks to build a web page for drawing with your eyes only, using a one-second gaze dwell to put the pen down or lift it, then project the result on a wall. Twist: forbid one classmate from using their hands and have them sign their name with their eyes.

works.title: WUW / SixthSense gesture demo reel
works.description: Pranav Mistry's own demo reel of the wearable gestural interface: drawing in the air, projected watches on the wrist, augmented boarding passes and books.
works.idea_zh: 用手指画一个圈就看时间，拿起一本书就看到评分——信息随手势出现在实物上。

video.video_title: WUW / sixthsense - a wearable gestural interface

works.technique: Color-marker fingertip tracking from a chest-mounted webcam drives a gesture vocabulary (air drawing, wrist tap for a watch), while a pico projector renders the response in place on the body or on printed objects.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe Hands 在网页里实现“空中画线”：食指捏合开始画、张手结束，把轨迹投影到墙上或叠加在摄像头画面中；变体：给轨迹加上一种物理属性（会下落、会褪色或会被风吹走）。
works.description_zh: Pranav Mistry 亲自制作的可穿戴手势界面演示片：在空中画画、手腕上投影出手表、增强的登机牌和书籍。
works.idea_en: Draw a circle with your finger to see the time, pick up a book to see its rating: information appears on objects as you gesture.
works.technique_zh: 胸前的网络摄像头通过彩色标记追踪指尖，驱动一套手势词汇（空中绘画、轻点手腕看表），同时微型投影仪把响应内容原位投射到身体或印刷品上。
works.exercise_en: Use MediaPipe Hands to build 'air drawing' in a web page: pinch your index finger to start drawing, open your hand to stop, and project the stroke on a wall or overlay it on the camera view. Twist: give the stroke a physical property (it falls, fades or gets blown away by the wind).

works.title: Wallpaper* Augmented Reality issue
works.description: A set of webcam AR pieces for Wallpaper* magazine's AR issue, bringing printed pages to life with animated 3D artworks.
works.idea_zh: 让设计杂志的纸页在摄像头前长出3D作品

video.video_title: Wallpaper Augmented Reality issue

works.technique: Printed magazine pages act as fiducial or natural-feature markers for a Flash webcam app that renders animated 3D pieces on each page.
works.exercise_zh: 为一本你喜欢的杂志做一页 AR 版面：用图像追踪让版面上的一个元素长成 3D 作品；变体：只有两页并排时才出现的“跨页”作品。
works.description_zh: 为 Wallpaper* 杂志 AR 特刊制作的一组网络摄像头 AR 作品，让印刷页面上长出会动的 3D 艺术作品。
works.idea_en: Make the pages of a design magazine grow 3D artworks in front of a webcam.
works.technique_zh: 印刷的杂志页面作为基准标记或自然特征标记，由 Flash 网络摄像头应用识别，并在每一页上渲染带动画的 3D 作品。
works.exercise_en: Make one AR page for a magazine you like, using image tracking to grow one element of the layout into a 3D piece. Twist: a 'spread' piece that only appears when two pages sit side by side.

works.title: You Fade to Light
works.description: A wall of OLED panels translates the viewer's mirror image into glowing light that lingers and fades as they move.
works.idea_zh: 把你的镜像变成慢慢褪去的光
works.technique: A camera image is downsampled to the OLED grid and each panel's brightness follows the pixel with a slow decay, producing light 'afterimages'.
works.exercise_zh: 用摄像头画面做低分辨率像素镜像，每个像素加余晖衰减；变化：用LED灯带或纸灯笼做成实体版本。

video.video_title: RANDOM INTERNATIONAL | You Fade To Light

works.description_zh: 一面由 OLED 面板组成的墙把观众的镜像转化为发光的光影，随着观众移动，光影会停留片刻再慢慢褪去。
works.idea_en: Turn your mirror image into light that slowly fades away.
works.technique_zh: 摄像头画面被降采样到 OLED 网格的分辨率，每块面板的亮度跟随对应像素变化，并带有缓慢的衰减，从而形成光的“残影”。
works.exercise_en: Make a low-resolution pixel mirror from the camera image and add afterglow decay to each pixel. Twist: build a physical version with LED strips or paper lanterns.

works.title: A Cable Plays
works.description: With Damian Stewart: two performers pin yarn across a game board while an augmented video of the board reveals generative creatures emerging between the strings.
works.idea_zh: 两人在棋盘上拉毛线，增强画面里线与线之间生出新的生命。

video.video_title: A Cable Plays

works.technique: A camera over the board detects the yarn lines (likely via color thresholding and Hough line detection), and the resulting polygon regions spawn generative creatures in the augmented video.
works.exercise_zh: 俯拍一块钉板，两人轮流拉彩色毛线，用 p5.js 检测线条围出的区域，在区域里生出小生物；变体：把它做成对弈游戏，谁围出的区域里的生物吃掉对方谁赢。
works.description_zh: 与 Damian Stewart 合作：两位表演者在一块游戏棋盘上钉拉毛线，而棋盘的增强视频中，线与线之间会浮现出生成式的生物。
works.idea_en: Two people stretch yarn across a game board, and new life grows between the strings in the augmented image.
works.technique_zh: 棋盘上方的摄像头检测毛线（可能通过颜色阈值和霍夫直线检测），由此得到的多边形区域在增强视频中生成生成式生物。
works.exercise_en: Film a pegboard from above while two people take turns stretching colored yarn, use p5.js to detect the areas enclosed by the strings, and spawn small creatures inside them. Twist: turn it into a two-player game where whoever's creatures eat the other's wins.

works.title: ARWeather
works.description: A person wearing an outdoor AR backpack walks freely through simulated rain, snow or hail falling over the real campus.
works.description_zh: 背着户外 AR 背包的人在真实校园里自由走动，身边落下模拟的雨、雪或冰雹。
works.idea_en: Change the weather around one person, wherever they walk.
works.idea_zh: 无论走到哪里，都改变某一个人身边的天气。
works.technique: Renders particle-based precipitation in world coordinates on the Tinmith wearable system, tracked by GPS and head orientation sensors.
works.technique_zh: 在 Tinmith 可穿戴系统上以世界坐标渲染基于粒子的降水效果，靠 GPS 和头部朝向传感器追踪。
works.exercise_en: Build a phone AR effect that makes snow fall only inside a two-metre circle around a placed anchor, then walk in and out of it outdoors. Twist: add sound that grows louder as you enter.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个手机 AR 效果，只在放置锚点周围两米的圆圈内下雪，然后在户外走进走出；变体：加入走进时逐渐变响的声音。

video.video_title: An Augmented Reality Weather System

works.title: ARf
works.description: An AR virtual pet dog on the original iPhone that lives on a marker and can be played with by touch.
works.idea_zh: 在初代iPhone上就能养一只AR虚拟狗。

video.video_title: ARf, an Augmented Reality Virtual Pet on the iPhone

works.technique: A fiducial marker is tracked by the iPhone camera to anchor an animated 3D dog, and touch input on the screen is raycast onto the dog to trigger petting and play behaviors.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 或 8th Wall 在桌面放一个虚拟宠物，实现点击抚摸、拖动喂食两种互动和三种情绪状态；变体：宠物会对你的真实环境做出反应（黑暗时睡觉、听到声音时抬头）。
works.description_zh: 运行在初代 iPhone 上的 AR 虚拟宠物狗，它住在一张标记上，玩家可以通过触摸和它玩耍。
works.idea_en: Raise an AR virtual dog on the very first iPhone.
works.technique_zh: iPhone 摄像头追踪基准标记，以此锚定一只带动画的 3D 小狗；屏幕上的触摸输入通过射线投射落到小狗身上，触发抚摸和玩耍行为。
works.exercise_en: Use AR Foundation or 8th Wall to put a virtual pet on a table, with two interactions (tap to pet, drag to feed) and three emotional states. Twist: have the pet react to your real surroundings (sleeping when it is dark, looking up when it hears a sound).

works.title: AntiVJ - Grote Kerk
works.description: A live audiovisual projection performance on the interior of the Grote Kerk cathedral in Breda.
works.idea_zh: 在大教堂内部进行的现场投影表演

video.video_title: AntiVJ - Grote Kerk

works.technique: Interior projection mapping with multiple projectors warped onto vaults and columns, performed live and synced to audio.
works.exercise_zh: 选一个有拱顶或柱子的室内空间（楼梯间、走廊），用投影现场配合一段声音演出，强调空间的高度；变体：整场只用一种颜色的光，让结构本身成为主角。
works.description_zh: 在布雷达大教堂（Grote Kerk）内部进行的一场现场视听投影表演。
works.idea_en: A live projection performance inside a cathedral.
works.technique_zh: 室内投影映射，多台投影仪经变形校正后投射到拱顶和立柱上，现场演出并与音频同步。
works.exercise_en: Choose an indoor space with vaults or columns (a stairwell, a corridor) and perform a projection live with a piece of sound, emphasizing the height of the space. Twist: use light of only one color for the whole piece so the structure itself becomes the star.

works.title: Audience
works.description: A field of small head-sized mirrors sits idle until a visitor enters; then they all turn to follow and 'look at' that person, so the viewer sees themselves reflected everywhere.
works.idea_zh: 一群镜子像观众一样同时转头盯着你看
works.technique: A camera tracks the chosen visitor's position and each motorised mirror computes the pan/tilt needed to face them.
works.exercise_zh: 用舵机+小镜子做3–5个“眼睛”，用摄像头人脸位置控制它们转向；变化：当有两个人时，镜子会“分成两派”各看一人。

video.video_title: RANDOM INTERNATIONAL | Audience

works.description_zh: 一片与人头差不多大小的小镜子静静待着，直到有观众走进来；这时它们会一齐转向、跟随并“注视”这个人，让观众在四面八方看见自己的倒影。
works.idea_en: A crowd of mirrors turns its heads in unison to stare at you like an audience.
works.technique_zh: 摄像头追踪被选中观众的位置，每面电动镜子据此计算朝向对方所需的水平和俯仰角度。
works.exercise_en: Build three to five 'eyes' from servos and small mirrors, and use the face position from a camera to turn them. Twist: when two people are present, the mirrors 'split into two camps', each watching one person.

works.title: Augmented Space (The Hague City Hall)
works.description: Architectural projection on The Hague city hall that traces and animates the building's own structural lines.
works.idea_zh: 沿着建筑自身结构线投影，让市政厅立面'活'过来

video.video_title: Pablo Valbuena: Augmented space (1) @ Today's Art 2008, The Hague

works.technique: Architectural projection mapping from a surveyed facade model: content is authored along the building's own structural lines so animation traces, splits and redraws the real geometry.
works.exercise_zh: 拍下教室一面墙或门框的正面照片，描出所有结构线，在投影中让这些线逐条亮起、错位、再复原；变体：只动一条线，其他全部静止，看最小改变能带来多大感知差异。
works.description_zh: 在海牙市政厅上进行的建筑投影，沿着建筑自身的结构线描绘并让它们动起来。
works.idea_en: Project along a building's own structural lines to bring a city hall facade to life.
works.technique_zh: 基于实测立面模型的建筑投影映射：内容沿着建筑自身的结构线制作，让动画描摹、拆分并重绘真实的几何形体。
works.exercise_en: Photograph a classroom wall or door frame head-on, trace all its structural lines, and in the projection make the lines light up one by one, shift out of place and return. Twist: move only one line and keep everything else still, to see how much perception a minimal change can shift.

works.title: BOOMBOX
works.description: A giant stack of cubes behind a DJ becomes a mapped sculpture whose faces light up, shift and pulse with the music across a worldwide tour of electronic parties.
works.description_zh: DJ 身后巨大的立方体堆叠成为一座投影雕塑，在全球巡演的电子派对上，各个面随音乐亮起、移动、脉动。
works.idea_en: A stage made of simple boxes becomes a musical instrument of light.
works.idea_zh: 用简单箱体搭成的舞台，变成一件光的乐器。
works.technique: Pre-built cube geometry is mapped with projectors and animated live, with visuals triggered and modulated by the music.
works.technique_zh: 预先搭建的立方体结构由投影机覆盖映射，影像在现场实时演奏，并由音乐触发和调制。
works.exercise_en: Stack six cardboard boxes, map each face in MadMapper or a web mapper, and make a beat-reactive light show where each box is one drum sound. Twist: let the audience rearrange the boxes between songs.
works.exercise_zh: 堆六个纸箱，在 MadMapper 或网页映射工具里映射每个面，做一场随节拍变化的灯光秀，每个箱子对应一种鼓声；变体：每首歌之间让观众重新摆放箱子。

video.video_title: BOOMBOX - 1024 architecture

works.title: Base 8
works.description: A reflection through glass makes a world float in mid-air; as visitors reach in, geometric structures grow between their fingers and out of their hands.
works.idea_zh: 手伸进玻璃反射出的空中世界，几何结构从指缝间长出来。

video.video_title: Base 8

works.technique: A Pepper's ghost setup reflects a screen in angled glass to float graphics in a real volume, while a camera tracks hand positions behind the glass to grow geometry between the fingers.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机加一片斜 45 度的透明亚克力做 Pepper's ghost 小盒子，再用 MediaPipe Hands 让几何结构在手指之间生长；变体：结构只在两只手（可以是两个人的）靠近时才连接起来。
works.description_zh: 玻璃中的反射让一个世界悬浮在半空中；当观众把手伸进去，几何结构会在他们的指缝之间、从他们的手中生长出来。
works.idea_en: Reach into a world floating in a glass reflection, and geometry grows out from between your fingers.
works.technique_zh: 采用佩珀尔幻象（Pepper's ghost）装置，用斜放的玻璃反射屏幕，让图形悬浮在真实空间中；同时摄像头追踪玻璃后面的手部位置，在手指之间生成几何结构。
works.exercise_en: Build a small Pepper's ghost box from a phone and a sheet of clear acrylic angled at 45 degrees, then use MediaPipe Hands to grow geometry between your fingers. Twist: the structures only connect when two hands (possibly from two people) come close.

works.title: Body Paint
works.description: Visitors dance in front of a wall-sized projection and their movements splash and smear fluid paint in real time, turning the body into a brush.
works.idea_zh: 身体就是画笔：在投影墙前舞动，颜料随动作飞溅流淌。

video.video_title: "Body Paint" Installation at "Clicks or Mortar", March 2009

works.technique: Optical flow from a camera provides velocity vectors that inject dye and force into a GPU 2D fluid simulation (ofxMSAFluid), projected at wall scale.
works.exercise_zh: 用 TouchDesigner 或 p5.js 的光流把身体动作变成往流体里注入颜料的力，投到墙上当画布；变体：每个人穿一种颜色的衣服决定颜料颜色，最后合拍一张“全班身体画”。
works.description_zh: 观众在一整面墙大小的投影前舞动，他们的动作实时泼洒、涂抹出流动的颜料，身体就此成为画笔。
works.idea_en: Your body is the brush: dance in front of a projected wall and paint splashes and flows with your moves.
works.technique_zh: 摄像头的光流提供速度向量，把颜料和力注入 GPU 上的二维流体模拟（ofxMSAFluid），并以整面墙的尺度投影出来。
works.exercise_en: Use optical flow in TouchDesigner or p5.js to turn body movement into forces that inject paint into a fluid, and project it on a wall as a canvas. Twist: the color each person wears decides their paint color, and the class finishes with one group 'body painting'.

works.title: BragFish
works.description: A competitive handheld AR fishing game played around a shared physical pond board, exploring social play with co-located phones.
works.idea_zh: 围着一张实体'池塘'比赛钓鱼的多人手持AR游戏。

video.video_title: BragFish: a competitive handheld Augmented Reality game

works.technique: Each handheld tracks a shared printed pond board with markers, rendering fish and lures registered to it, and a networked game state makes players compete co-located around the same physical board.
works.exercise_zh: 把一张打印的池塘图作为共同图像目标，做一个 2–3 人手机 AR 钓鱼游戏，每人只能看到自己的鱼竿和共同的鱼；变体：加入一个只在物理上靠近对手时才能用的“偷鱼”机制。
works.description_zh: 一款围绕共享实体池塘棋盘进行的竞技类手持 AR 钓鱼游戏，探索多部手机在同一现场时的社交游戏方式。
works.idea_en: A multiplayer handheld AR game where players compete at fishing around a physical 'pond'.
works.technique_zh: 每台手持设备都通过标记追踪同一张打印的池塘棋盘，渲染与之配准的鱼和鱼饵；联网的游戏状态让玩家们在同一块实体棋盘周围同场竞技。
works.exercise_en: Use a printed pond picture as a shared image target and make a two- or three-player phone AR fishing game where each person sees only their own rod plus the shared fish. Twist: add a 'steal a fish' move that only works when you are physically close to an opponent.

works.title: Cows vs Aliens
works.description: A multiplayer handheld AR board game where players move around a tabletop map, making physical mobility and social interaction the core mechanic.
works.idea_zh: 多人围着桌子走动玩的AR棋盘游戏，走位本身就是玩法。

video.video_title: Cows Vs  Aliens Mobility and Social Interaction as Key Gameplay Element

works.technique: Each handheld device tracks the shared tabletop map with fiducial markers, so all players see the same registered game world, and players must physically move around the table to reach different areas.
works.exercise_zh: 用一张打印的 A3 地图作为图像目标，做一个 2 人手机 AR 桌游：必须走到桌子另一侧才能看到并点击某些目标；变体：让两人的视角互相遮挡，逼迫玩家移动身体交流。
works.description_zh: 一款多人手持 AR 桌游，玩家需要绕着桌面地图走动，身体移动和社交互动成为核心玩法。
works.idea_en: A multiplayer AR board game played by walking around a table, where moving yourself is the gameplay.
works.technique_zh: 每台手持设备都借助基准标记追踪共享的桌面地图，因此所有玩家看到的是同一个经过配准的游戏世界；玩家必须实际绕着桌子走动才能到达不同区域。
works.exercise_en: Use a printed A3 map as an image target and build a two-player phone AR board game where some targets can only be seen and tapped from the other side of the table. Twist: make the two players' views block each other, forcing them to move their bodies and talk.

works.title: Drawing from Life
works.description: Museum visitors see a life-size projected image of themselves composed entirely of the letters A, C, G and T, the four bases of DNA.
works.idea_zh: 把你的实时镜像写成由DNA四个字母组成的人像
works.technique: Live video is sampled on a grid and each cell is rendered as one of four letters whose size or brightness follows the underlying pixel value (ASCII-art style).
works.exercise_zh: 用p5.js把摄像头画面做成ASCII字符人像，只用A、C、G、T四个字母；变化：换成与主题相关的一个词，让字母随声音大小抖动。

video.video_title: Camille Utterback - Drawing from Life

works.description_zh: 博物馆观众会看到一幅真人大小的自己的投影，整个人像完全由 A、C、G、T 这四个字母组成，也就是 DNA 的四种碱基。
works.idea_en: Write your live mirror image as a portrait made from the four letters of DNA.
works.technique_zh: 对实时视频按网格采样，每个单元格渲染为四个字母之一，字母的大小或亮度随对应像素值变化（类似 ASCII 字符画）。
works.exercise_en: Use p5.js to turn the camera image into an ASCII-character portrait using only the letters A, C, G and T. Twist: switch to a word related to your theme and make the letters jitter with the volume of sound.

works.title: Falling Girl (with Annie Loui)
works.description: An immersive narrative projection of a girl falling slowly past skyscraper windows; cameras place the live audience inside the apartments she passes as she ages during the fall.
works.idea_zh: 观众被实时放进大楼窗户里，成为坠落女孩一生中遇见的人
works.technique: Room cameras capture viewers and composite their live images into window regions of a pre-animated building while the scripted falling-girl animation plays in the centre.
works.exercise_zh: 画一栋有很多窗户的楼，把摄像头拍到的同学实时抠像贴进窗户里，再让一个角色从上往下经过；变化：角色经过谁的窗户就对谁做一个反应动作。

video.video_title: Falling Girl by Scott Snibbe and Annie Loui

works.description_zh: 一件沉浸式叙事投影：一个女孩缓缓坠落，经过摩天大楼的一扇扇窗户；摄像头把现场观众放进她经过的公寓里，而她在坠落中逐渐老去。
works.idea_en: Visitors are placed live into a building's windows and become the people a falling girl meets over her life.
works.technique_zh: 房间内的摄像头拍摄观众，把他们的实时影像合成到一栋预制动画大楼的窗户区域中，同时画面中央播放预先设定好的女孩坠落动画。
works.exercise_en: Draw a building with many windows, key classmates out of the camera feed live and place them in the windows, then have a character pass from top to bottom. Twist: the character makes a reaction gesture toward whoever's window it passes.

works.title: Fractal Flowers
works.description: A virtual garden of generative fractal flowers grows, blooms and dies on a projection, bending and reacting as visitors move in front of it.
works.idea_zh: 一片会因你靠近而弯曲、绽放的分形花园
works.technique: L-system-like generative plant growth runs in real time and a camera tracks visitors' positions to bend or trigger blooms near them.
works.exercise_zh: 在p5.js里写一个递归分形花，摄像头检测到人靠近时花朵朝人弯曲；变化：每个观众的衣服颜色成为新长出花的颜色。

video.video_title: Miguel Chevalier - Fractal Flowers 2023

works.description_zh: 一座由生成式分形花朵组成的虚拟花园在投影中生长、绽放和凋零，当观众在它面前移动时，花朵会弯曲并作出反应。
works.idea_en: A fractal garden that bends and blooms as you come close.
works.technique_zh: 实时运行类似 L 系统的生成式植物生长算法，摄像头追踪观众的位置，让附近的花朵弯曲或开放。
works.exercise_en: Write a recursive fractal flower in p5.js and make the flowers bend toward a person when the camera detects them approaching. Twist: the color of each visitor's clothing becomes the color of the new flowers.

works.title: Generative Graffiti
works.description: With Graffiti Research Lab: particles spawn from the lit windows of the Maritime Hotel in New York, attracted to each other and repelled by dark windows, projected back onto the building.
works.idea_zh: 从酒店亮着灯的窗户里生长出粒子涂鸦，再投回建筑立面。

video.video_title: Generative Graffiti

works.technique: A camera image of the facade is thresholded to find lit windows, which act as particle emitters and attractors while dark windows act as repellers, projected back via camera-projector registration.
works.exercise_zh: 拍一张晚上教学楼的照片，找出亮着的窗户当粒子源，暗窗做排斥点，把动画投回同一面墙或模型上；变体：粒子代表楼里的人的“熬夜气息”，窗户熄灭后粒子会迁移。
works.description_zh: 与 Graffiti Research Lab 合作：粒子从纽约 Maritime Hotel 亮着灯的窗户里诞生，彼此吸引、被暗着的窗户排斥，再被投影回这栋建筑上。
works.idea_en: Particle graffiti grows out of a hotel's lit windows and is projected back onto the facade.
works.technique_zh: 对立面的摄像头画面做阈值处理找出亮着的窗户，把它们作为粒子发射源和吸引点，暗窗则作为排斥点，最后通过相机-投影仪配准投回建筑上。
works.exercise_en: Take a night photo of a teaching building, use the lit windows as particle sources and the dark ones as repellers, and project the animation back onto the same wall or a model. Twist: the particles stand for the 'late-night energy' of the people inside, and they migrate when a window goes dark.

works.title: Mirrors Mirror
works.description: 768 small polished steel mirrors tilt so each reflects a lighter or darker part of the room, composing the viewer's image out of reflections of the space.
works.idea_zh: 用无数小镜子反射房间的明暗，拼出你的样子
works.technique: A camera image controls motors that aim each steel tile toward bright or dark areas of the surrounding room.
works.exercise_zh: 用几块小镜片装在舵机上，让它们把窗外亮光或暗墙反射到观众眼中形成图案；变化：用激光笔验证每块镜片的反射方向。

video.video_title: "Mirrors Mirror" (2008) by Daniel Rozin

works.description_zh: 768 块抛光的小钢镜各自倾斜，分别反射房间里较亮或较暗的部分，用空间本身的反射拼出观众的影像。
works.idea_en: Countless small mirrors reflect the room's light and dark to piece together your image.
works.technique_zh: 摄像头画面控制电机，把每块钢片对准周围房间里较亮或较暗的区域。
works.exercise_en: Mount a few small mirror pieces on servos and make them reflect bright light from a window or a dark wall into the viewer's eyes to form a pattern. Twist: use a laser pointer to check each mirror's reflection direction.

works.title: Natural Feature Tracking at 30Hz on a Mobile Phone
works.description: The first real-time 6DOF tracking of ordinary printed images on a mobile phone, using modified SIFT and Ferns, so AR content can sit on any poster or book.
works.idea_zh: 第一次在手机上实时追踪普通图片，任何海报都能变成AR舞台。

video.video_title: Natural Feature Tracking at 30Hz on a Mobile Phone

works.technique: Keypoints detected in the camera frame are matched to a pre-trained database of the target image using simplified SIFT descriptors and Ferns classifiers, and the resulting correspondences give a robust 6DOF pose that is then refined by frame-to-frame patch tracking.
works.exercise_zh: 用 OpenCV（Python 或 OpenCV.js）实现 ORB 特征匹配 + 单应性估计，把一张图片贴到手机摄像头中的海报上；变体：测试哪种海报图案最难追踪，并设计一张“追踪友好”的海报。
works.description_zh: 首次在手机上实现对普通印刷图像的实时 6DOF 追踪，采用改进的 SIFT 和 Ferns 算法，让 AR 内容可以附着在任何海报或书本上。
works.idea_en: The first live tracking of ordinary pictures on a phone, turning any poster into an AR stage.
works.technique_zh: 在相机画面中检测关键点，用简化的 SIFT 描述子和 Ferns 分类器与预先训练好的目标图像数据库进行匹配，得到的对应关系给出稳健的 6DOF 位姿，再通过帧间图像块追踪加以精化。
works.exercise_en: Implement ORB feature matching plus homography estimation with OpenCV (Python or OpenCV.js) to paste an image onto a poster in the phone camera view. Twist: test which poster patterns are hardest to track, and design a 'tracking-friendly' poster.

works.title: Quickies: Intelligent Sticky Notes
works.description: Handwritten paper sticky notes are captured with a digital pen and RFID so they become searchable, can remind you, and can be found again by the computer.
works.idea_zh: 让最普通的纸质便利贴拥有数字记忆，能被搜索、会主动提醒你。

video.video_title: QUICKIES, intelligent sticky notes

works.technique: A digital pen (Anoto-style dot-pattern paper) captures the handwriting of each note and an RFID tag in the note identifies it, so handwriting recognition turns paper notes into searchable, locatable records.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机拍摄手写便利贴，调用 OCR（如 Tesseract.js 或系统文本识别）存成可搜索列表，并给每张便利贴贴一个二维码或 NFC 标签，扫码即可跳到它的数字记录；变体：让便利贴在某个时间或地点“主动提醒”你。
works.description_zh: 借助数码笔和 RFID 采集手写的纸质便利贴，使它们可以被搜索、能提醒你，还能被电脑重新找到。
works.idea_en: Give the humblest paper sticky note a digital memory so it can be searched and can remind you on its own.
works.technique_zh: 数码笔（Anoto 式点阵纸）记录每张便利贴上的笔迹，便利贴中的 RFID 标签则用来识别它，再通过手写识别把纸质便利贴变成可搜索、可定位的记录。
works.exercise_en: Photograph handwritten sticky notes with a phone, run OCR (such as Tesseract.js or the system's text recognition) to save them as a searchable list, and give each note a QR code or NFC tag that jumps to its digital record when scanned. Twist: have a sticky note 'remind' you on its own at a certain time or place.

works.title: Sekai Camera (TechCrunch50 demo)
works.description: The TechCrunch50 demo of Sekai Camera: point an iPhone at a street or shop and see floating 'air tags' left by other people, with notes, photos and voice memos attached to places.
works.idea_zh: 让人们把文字、照片和声音像气泡一样'留'在真实地点。

video.video_title: SekaiCameraDemoVideo of TechCrunch50

works.technique: GPS position and compass heading determine which geotagged notes lie in the camera's field of view, and tags are drawn as floating labels at their bearing.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机 GPS 和指南针在网页上实现“浮空标签”：朝向某个方向时显示那里的留言；变体：标签字体大小按距离缩放，远处的留言变模糊。
works.description_zh: Sekai Camera 在 TechCrunch50 上的演示：把 iPhone 对准街道或店铺，就能看到其他人留下的漂浮“空中标签”，地点上附着着文字留言、照片和语音备忘。
works.idea_en: Let people leave words, photos and sounds at real places like floating bubbles.
works.technique_zh: 根据 GPS 位置和指南针朝向，判断哪些带地理标签的留言位于相机视野内，并按其方位把标签绘制成漂浮的标注。
works.exercise_en: Use the phone's GPS and compass to build 'floating tags' in a web page that show the messages left in whichever direction you face. Twist: scale tag font size by distance so faraway messages blur.

works.title: The Artvertiser
works.description: Custom binoculars recognise street billboards and replace each advert live with an artwork, turning advertising space into an exhibition surface.
works.idea_zh: 用改装望远镜把街头广告实时替换成艺术作品

video.video_title: THE ARTVERTISER at HACK THE CITY

works.technique: Natural-feature (Ferns keypoint) tracking in OpenCV recognises known billboard images and computes a homography so replacement artwork is warped onto the billboard in the video feed.
works.exercise_zh: 用 8th Wall / MindAR 图像追踪识别校园里的几张海报，实时替换成同学的作品；变体：把替换内容做成对原广告的回应或反讽，而不是简单覆盖。
works.description_zh: 一副特制双筒望远镜能识别街头广告牌，并把每条广告实时替换成艺术作品，把广告空间变成展览墙面。
works.idea_en: Use modified binoculars to swap street ads for artworks in real time.
works.technique_zh: 在 OpenCV 中用自然特征（Ferns 关键点）追踪识别已知的广告牌图像，并计算单应矩阵，把替换用的艺术作品变形贴到视频画面中的广告牌上。
works.exercise_en: Use 8th Wall or MindAR image tracking to recognize a few posters on campus and replace them live with classmates' work. Twist: make the replacement a response to or parody of the original ad rather than a simple cover-up.

works.title: Traces
works.description: A responsive projection with Moritz Waldemeyer that turns visitors' movements into long-exposure-like light trails inspired by car tail-light photography.
works.idea_zh: 人的动作在投影中留下像长曝光车灯一样的光轨。

video.video_title: Traces

works.technique: Background subtraction extracts moving bright regions or silhouettes each frame, which are accumulated into a slowly decaying frame buffer to emulate long-exposure light trails.
works.exercise_zh: 用 p5.js 或 TouchDesigner 做帧累积加衰减（feedback），让人的动作留下长曝光一样的光轨并投影；变体：光轨只记录最慢的动作，快动作会被抹掉。
works.description_zh: 与 Moritz Waldemeyer 合作的一件响应式投影，受汽车尾灯摄影启发，把观众的动作变成类似长曝光的光轨。
works.idea_en: People's movements leave light trails in the projection, like long-exposure car lights.
works.technique_zh: 背景减除在每一帧中提取移动的亮区或剪影，并累积到一个缓慢衰减的帧缓冲中，模拟长曝光光轨。
works.exercise_en: Use frame accumulation with decay (feedback) in p5.js or TouchDesigner so people's movements leave long-exposure light trails, and project them. Twist: the trails record only the slowest movements, and fast ones are wiped out.

works.title: Video Terraform Dance Party
works.description: A webcam performance where the artist's body movements sculpt a 3D landscape around him live on screen.
works.idea_zh: 用舞蹈动作在屏幕中塑造地形

video.video_title: Video Terraform Dance Party (2008)

works.technique: Webcam-based motion tracking (likely colour or frame-difference tracking) maps body positions to height-field deformations of a 3D terrain rendered live around the performer.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe Pose 让双手的高度推起或压下一片 three.js 地形网格，自己在画面中“跳出”一座山；变体：把跳舞过程做成一场一本正经的“地形设计软件”产品演示。
works.description_zh: 一场网络摄像头表演：艺术家的身体动作在屏幕上实时塑造他周围的三维地景。
works.idea_en: Shape terrain on screen with dance moves.
works.technique_zh: 基于网络摄像头的动作追踪（可能是颜色追踪或帧差追踪）把身体位置映射为三维地形高度场的形变，地形在表演者周围实时渲染。
works.exercise_en: Use MediaPipe Pose so the height of your hands pushes up or presses down a three.js terrain mesh, and 'dance out' a mountain on screen. Twist: present the dance as a deadpan product demo for 'terrain design software'.

works.title: AR Façade
works.description: The AI interactive drama Façade re-staged in a physical apartment with AR: the player walks among life-size virtual characters Grace and Trip and speaks to them aloud.
works.idea_zh: 把AI互动剧《Façade》搬进真实公寓，玩家直接对着真人大小的角色说话。

video.video_title: AR Façade: An Immersive and Interactive Narrative Experience

works.technique: A video see-through HMD with tracking renders life-size characters in a physical apartment set, while a hidden operator transcribes the player's speech (Wizard of Oz) into the Façade drama manager that drives the characters.
works.exercise_zh: 在手机 AR 中放一个真人大小的虚拟角色（可用 Mixamo 模型），由一位藏在后台的同学（绿野仙踪法）根据玩家说的话选择角色动画和台词；变体：让角色能“看见”玩家拿起的真实物品并评论它。
works.description_zh: 把 AI 互动剧《Façade》用 AR 搬进一间真实的公寓：玩家在真人大小的虚拟角色 Grace 和 Trip 之间走动，并直接开口和他们说话。
works.idea_en: Move the AI interactive drama Façade into a real apartment, where the player talks straight to life-size characters.
works.technique_zh: 带追踪的视频透视式头显在实体公寓布景中渲染真人大小的角色，同时一名隐藏的操作员把玩家的话转录下来（绿野仙踪法），输入驱动角色的 Façade 剧情管理器。
works.exercise_en: Place a life-size virtual character in phone AR (a Mixamo model works), and have a classmate hidden backstage (Wizard of Oz) pick the character's animations and lines based on what the player says. Twist: let the character 'see' a real object the player picks up and comment on it.

works.title: AR-Jig
works.description: A handheld pin-array 'jig' whose physical profile controls a projected/AR 3D curve, letting designers sculpt digital surfaces with a tangible tool.
works.idea_zh: 用一排可推动的实体针当手工具，直接'刮'出数字曲面。

video.video_title: AR-Jig 2007

works.technique: A handheld tool with an array of linear pins whose displacements are sensed is tracked in space, and the pin profile defines control points that deform a displayed 3D spline surface.
works.exercise_zh: 用一排可滑动的纸条或吸管（手机摄像头识别其高度）作为实体“曲线尺”，读出的轮廓实时生成 three.js 中的样条曲线并旋转成一个花瓶；变体：沿着桌面拖动这把尺子，扫出一整个曲面。
works.description_zh: 一个手持的针阵“夹具”，它的实体轮廓控制投影/AR 中的三维曲线，让设计师可以用一件实体工具来雕塑数字曲面。
works.idea_en: Use a row of pushable physical pins as a hand tool to scrape out a digital surface directly.
works.technique_zh: 一个带有一排直线针的手持工具在空间中被追踪，每根针的位移都会被感测，针阵的轮廓定义控制点，从而使显示出的三维样条曲面发生形变。
works.exercise_en: Use a row of sliding paper strips or straws (with the phone camera reading their heights) as a physical 'curve ruler', turn the profile into a live spline in three.js, and revolve it into a vase. Twist: drag the ruler along the table to sweep out a whole surface.

works.title: Abundance
works.description: At night a camera on San Jose City Hall watches people walking across the plaza and projects a responsive animation of their paths onto the building's rotunda.
works.idea_zh: 广场上行人的路径被实时画成巨大的建筑投影
works.technique: A roof-mounted camera tracks pedestrians from above and their trajectories drive a generative animation projected onto the cylindrical façade.
works.exercise_zh: 从教学楼高处俯拍操场，把行人轨迹实时画成彩色流线投到墙上；变化：两条轨迹交叉时生成一朵“花”。

video.video_title: Camille Utterback - Abundance

works.description_zh: 夜晚，圣何塞市政厅上的摄像头注视着穿过广场的行人，把他们路径的响应式动画投射到建筑的圆形大厅外墙上。
works.idea_en: The paths of people crossing a plaza are drawn live as a giant projection on the building.
works.technique_zh: 安装在屋顶的摄像头从上方追踪行人，他们的轨迹驱动一段生成式动画，投射到圆柱形立面上。
works.exercise_en: Film the sports field from high up in a teaching building and draw pedestrians' paths live as colorful flow lines projected on a wall. Twist: when two paths cross, a 'flower' grows.

works.title: Augmented Sculpture v1.2
works.description: A white geometric sculpture is overlaid with precisely mapped projected light, so edges, planes and shadows appear to move, fold and rebuild the physical form.
works.idea_zh: 用精确投影让静止的白色体块产生时空变形

video.video_title: Pablo Valbuena, Augmented Sculpture v. 1.2

works.technique: A projector is calibrated to a white polyhedral sculpture whose exact 3D model is known, so rendered light and shadow on each face can simulate edges and planes moving over the static form.
works.exercise_zh: 用白色纸板折出两三个几何体，在 MadMapper 或 TouchDesigner 中逐面对齐投影，只用黑白线条让体块看起来在折叠和重组；变体：让一个面“缺失”——投成与背景同色，看它是否消失。
works.description_zh: 一件白色几何雕塑被叠加上精确映射的投影光，边缘、平面和阴影仿佛在移动、折叠，重新构建着这一实体形态。
works.idea_en: Precise projection makes still white blocks warp through space and time.
works.technique_zh: 投影仪针对一件已知精确三维模型的白色多面体雕塑进行标定，因此每个面上渲染的光影都能模拟边缘和平面在静止形体上移动。
works.exercise_en: Fold two or three geometric solids from white cardboard, align the projection face by face in MadMapper or TouchDesigner, and use only black and white lines to make the blocks look like they fold and rebuild. Twist: make one face 'go missing' by projecting the background color onto it, and see whether it disappears.

works.title: Central Mosaic
works.description: Shadows of passers-by are recorded and replayed as silhouettes that shrink and move outward into a fractal mosaic as newer recordings take the centre.
works.idea_zh: 每个路人的影子先占据中心，再被新来者推向边缘，成为分形马赛克
works.technique: Silhouette recordings are laid out in a recursive, self-similar tiling where each new clip pushes older clips one level outward and smaller.
works.exercise_zh: 把录下的剪影片段做成递归四分网格，新片段进中心、旧的向外缩小；变化：按录制时间给每层上不同颜色，形成“时间年轮”。

video.video_title: Central Mosaic (2007) by Scott Snibbe

works.description_zh: 路人的影子被记录下来并以剪影形式回放；随着新的录像占据中心，旧的剪影不断缩小、向外移动，形成一幅分形马赛克。
works.idea_en: Each passer-by's shadow takes the center until newcomers push it to the edge of a fractal mosaic.
works.technique_zh: 剪影录像以递归的自相似方式平铺排列，每段新片段都会把旧片段向外推一层并缩小。
works.exercise_en: Arrange recorded silhouette clips in a recursive quad grid, with new clips entering the center and old ones shrinking outward. Twist: color each layer by recording time to form 'growth rings of time'.

works.title: Delicate Boundaries
works.description: Small bugs made of light crawl out of a computer screen and onto the hands and arms of people who touch it.
works.idea_zh: 光做的小虫从屏幕里爬出来，爬到触碰它的人手上。

video.video_title: Delicate Boundaries

works.technique: A camera looking at the screen and arms detects hand contact and arm contours, and a projector calibrated to the same space lets agent-based bugs walk off the screen and follow those contours.
works.exercise_zh: 屏幕上养一群小虫，用 MediaPipe Hands 检测手指触碰屏幕边缘后，让虫子“爬”到投影到手臂上的画面中；变体：虫子在你手上待久了会生出你没想到的东西。
works.description_zh: 光做成的小虫从电脑屏幕里爬出来，爬到触碰屏幕的人的手上和手臂上。
works.idea_en: Little bugs made of light crawl out of the screen and onto the hands of whoever touches it.
works.technique_zh: 对着屏幕和手臂的摄像头检测手的接触和手臂轮廓，一台标定到同一空间的投影仪让基于智能体的虫子走出屏幕、沿着这些轮廓爬行。
works.exercise_en: Keep a swarm of bugs on screen, and when MediaPipe Hands detects a finger touching the screen edge, have the bugs 'crawl' into imagery projected onto the arm. Twist: bugs that stay on your hand too long grow into something you did not expect.

works.title: Expedition Schatzsuche (Museum AR Quest)
works.description: A handheld AR treasure hunt in a Vienna museum: children explore exhibits with PDAs that reveal virtual characters and puzzles on markers.
works.idea_zh: 孩子们举着PDA在博物馆里寻宝，展品旁浮现虚拟角色和谜题。

video.video_title: Museum Augmented Reality Quest   Expedition Schatzsuche

works.technique: Handheld PDAs track printed fiducial markers placed next to exhibits and overlay virtual characters and puzzle clues, with a game state machine sequencing the quest across the museum.
works.exercise_zh: 在校园或教学楼中贴 5 个图像标记，用 8th Wall 或 AR.js 做一个串联寻宝：每个标记出现一个角色和一条线索，指向下一个地点；变体：线索需要结合真实展品或环境细节才能解开。
works.description_zh: 维也纳一家博物馆里的手持 AR 寻宝游戏：孩子们拿着 PDA 探索展品，标记上会浮现虚拟角色和谜题。
works.idea_en: Kids hunt for treasure in a museum with PDAs, and virtual characters and puzzles appear beside the exhibits.
works.technique_zh: 手持 PDA 追踪放在展品旁的打印基准标记，叠加虚拟角色和谜题线索，并由游戏状态机串联起整个博物馆的探险流程。
works.exercise_en: Put five image markers around a campus or teaching building and use 8th Wall or AR.js to build a linked treasure hunt: each marker shows a character and a clue pointing to the next spot. Twist: the clues can only be solved using details of real exhibits or the surroundings.

works.title: Funky Forest
works.description: An interactive projected forest ecosystem: children grow trees by pressing their bodies into the forest and use physical logs and pillow 'rocks' to divert a digital stream to water them.
works.idea_zh: 孩子用身体种树、用实物“木头”改变投影河流的方向来灌溉森林。

video.video_title: Funky Forest - Interactive Ecosystem

works.technique: Overhead and frontal cameras segment children's bodies and tracked physical objects, which act as emitters and obstacles in a 2D fluid/particle stream simulation projected onto the floor and walls.
works.exercise_zh: 在地面投影一条流动的粒子小溪，用摄像头识别纸箱或书本作为可移动的挡板，引导水流去浇灌屏幕边上的树；变体：树长大的样子取决于它喝到的水来自哪几个同学。
works.description_zh: 一个互动投影森林生态系统：孩子们把身体压进森林来种树，并用实物木头和枕头“石头”改变一条数字溪流的方向来浇灌树木。
works.idea_en: Kids plant trees with their bodies and use real 'logs' to redirect a projected river to water the forest.
works.technique_zh: 俯拍和正面摄像头分割出孩子的身体以及被追踪的实物，这些都作为发射源和障碍物，参与投影在地面和墙面上的二维流体/粒子溪流模拟。
works.exercise_en: Project a flowing particle stream on the floor, use a camera to recognize cardboard boxes or books as movable barriers, and guide the water to trees at the edge of the screen. Twist: how a tree grows depends on which classmates the water it drank came from.

works.title: Ghost Pole Propagator
works.description: Visitors' silhouettes are reduced to skeletal centerline 'ghost poles' projected large on a wall, echoing their posture as calligraphic stick figures.
works.idea_zh: 把人的剪影提炼成骨架般的线条投影在墙上。

video.video_title: Ghost Pole Propagator I (2007, documented 2012; 1080p)

works.technique: Binary silhouettes are thinned by morphological skeletonization into centerline pixels, which are vectorized into poles and rendered as calligraphic strokes.
works.exercise_zh: 用 OpenCV 骨架化或 MediaPipe Pose 连线，把人的姿势变成书法笔画投到墙上，并保留前几秒的残影；变体：让全班依次摆姿势，拼出一个自己发明的“身体字母表”。
works.description_zh: 观众的剪影被简化成骨架般的中心线“幽灵杆”，大尺度投影在墙上，像书法般的火柴人一样复现他们的姿态。
works.idea_en: Distill a person's silhouette into skeleton-like lines projected on the wall.
works.technique_zh: 通过形态学骨架化把二值剪影细化成中心线像素，再矢量化为杆状线段，以书法笔画的形式渲染出来。
works.exercise_en: Use OpenCV skeletonization or MediaPipe Pose connections to turn a person's pose into calligraphic strokes projected on a wall, keeping afterimages from the last few seconds. Twist: have the class pose one after another to assemble a 'body alphabet' of your own invention.

works.title: Interactive Focus and Context Visualization for AR
works.description: A magic-lens style AR view that reveals hidden internal parts of a real object (e.g. a car engine) while preserving key edges of the outside for depth cues.
works.idea_zh: 像透视镜一样看见物体内部，同时保留外壳轮廓帮你判断深度。

video.video_title: Interactive Focus and Context Visualization for Augmented Reality

works.technique: Renders hidden virtual structure inside a focus region and composites real-world edges extracted from the video as context to keep occlusion cues.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机AR在一个真实纸盒上叠加“内部结构”3D模型，并用描边保留盒子外轮廓，对比有无轮廓时的深度感；变化：让透视区域跟随手指移动。
works.description_zh: 一种魔术透镜式的 AR 视图，能揭示真实物体（例如汽车发动机）内部隐藏的部件，同时保留外部的关键边缘作为深度线索。
works.idea_en: See inside an object like an X-ray lens while keeping the shell outline to help you judge depth.
works.technique_zh: 在焦点区域内渲染隐藏的虚拟结构，并把从视频中提取的真实世界边缘作为上下文合成进来，以保留遮挡线索。
works.exercise_en: In phone AR, overlay a 3D model of the 'internal structure' on a real cardboard box, keep the box's outer outline with a stroke, and compare the sense of depth with and without the outline. Twist: make the see-through region follow your finger.

works.title: Interstitial Fragment Processor
works.description: The negative spaces between and within visitors' shadows are cut out and dropped as elastic red and blue objects that fall and collide with sound.
works.idea_zh: 把人与人影子之间的空隙变成会掉落、弹跳、发声的实体。

video.video_title: Interstitial Fragment Processor

works.technique: Silhouettes from background subtraction are analysed for enclosed holes (contour hierarchy / connected components), and those negative-space regions become rigid bodies in a 2D physics engine.
works.exercise_zh: 用摄像头抠出人影，找到人影中间“围出来”的空洞（如叉腰时手臂和身体间的洞），把空洞变成掉落碰撞的彩色块并发声；变体：大家合作用身体围出一个指定形状（心、星）才能释放它。
works.description_zh: 观众影子之间及影子内部的负空间被剪下，化作富有弹性的红色和蓝色物体掉落下来，碰撞时发出声音。
works.idea_en: Turn the gaps between people's shadows into solid things that fall, bounce and make sounds.
works.technique_zh: 分析背景减除得到的剪影，找出其中被围合的孔洞（轮廓层级/连通域），这些负空间区域在二维物理引擎中成为刚体。
works.exercise_en: Cut out people's shadows from a camera image, find the holes enclosed inside them (like the gap between arm and body with hands on hips), and turn those holes into colored blocks that fall, collide and make sounds. Twist: everyone must cooperate to enclose a given shape (a heart, a star) with their bodies to release it.

works.title: L.A.S.E.R. Tag
works.description: Graffiti Research Lab's system for tagging buildings with a green laser pointer: a camera tracks the laser dot and a high-powered projector paints it as giant graffiti on the facade.
works.idea_zh: 用激光笔在整栋楼上“喷涂鸦”，摄像头追踪光点、投影仪实时画出巨大笔迹。

video.video_title: GRL-LASER_TAG-R&D

works.technique: A camera watches the building, thresholds for the bright green laser dot, maps its position through a camera-to-projector homography, and draws strokes at that point with the projector.
works.exercise_zh: 用摄像头追踪激光笔或手机手电的亮点，经四点标定后在投影墙上画出粗笔触（p5.js/TouchDesigner）；变体：笔触会根据画的速度变成不同笔刷，比如慢写滴墨、快写喷漆。
works.description_zh: Graffiti Research Lab 开发的系统，可以用绿色激光笔给建筑“涂鸦”：摄像头追踪激光点，大功率投影仪把它在立面上画成巨大的涂鸦。
works.idea_en: Tag a whole building with a laser pointer: a camera tracks the dot and a projector paints giant strokes in real time.
works.technique_zh: 摄像头对着建筑，通过阈值找出明亮的绿色激光点，经相机-投影仪单应矩阵映射其位置，再由投影仪在该点绘制笔画。
works.exercise_en: Use a camera to track the bright dot of a laser pointer or phone flashlight and, after four-point calibration, paint thick strokes on a projected wall (p5.js or TouchDesigner). Twist: the stroke changes brush with drawing speed, dripping ink when slow and spraying paint when fast.

works.title: Out of Bounds
works.description: An 'x-ray torch' at the Design Museum London: shining a handheld light on the wall projects what lies behind it, as if boring through the museum's walls.
works.idea_zh: 拿着“X光手电筒”照墙，就能看到墙后面隐藏的空间。

video.video_title: Out of Bounds

works.technique: A camera tracks the position of the handheld torch's light spot on the wall, and the projector reveals a hidden image layer only inside a circular mask at that position.
works.exercise_zh: 用摄像头追踪手电筒在墙上的光斑，投影只在光斑处显示一张“墙后面”的图（管道、老鼠、隔壁教室）；变体：墙后的世界会慢慢察觉被照，开始躲避光。
works.description_zh: 伦敦设计博物馆里的一支“X 光手电筒”：用手持光源照向墙面，就会投出墙后面的景象，仿佛钻透了博物馆的墙壁。
works.idea_en: Shine an 'X-ray flashlight' at the wall to see the hidden space behind it.
works.technique_zh: 摄像头追踪手电筒在墙上的光斑位置，投影仪只在该位置的圆形遮罩内显示一层隐藏的图像。
works.exercise_en: Use a camera to track a flashlight's spot on the wall and project a 'behind the wall' image (pipes, mice, the classroom next door) only inside the spot. Twist: the world behind the wall slowly notices it is being watched and starts to dodge the light.

works.title: Peg Mirror
works.description: 650 cylindrical wooden pegs with angled cut faces rotate so their shading forms the viewer's portrait in a circular composition.
works.idea_zh: 木钉旋转斜切面，用阴影拼出人像
works.technique: Each peg's cut face catches different light depending on rotation; a camera image sets each peg's angle via motors.
works.exercise_zh: 把斜切的木块或纸筒装在舵机上，比较不同角度的明暗，再用摄像头控制做3×3原型；变化：改为控制声音的“听觉镜子”。

video.video_title: "Peg Mirror" (2007) by Daniel Rozin

works.description_zh: 650 根带斜切面的圆柱形木钉各自旋转，用斜面上的明暗在圆形构图中拼出观众的肖像。
works.idea_en: Wooden pegs turn their angled faces to build a portrait out of shadows.
works.technique_zh: 每根木钉的切面随旋转角度不同而接收到不同的光线；摄像头画面通过电机设定每根木钉的角度。
works.exercise_en: Mount angled-cut wooden blocks or paper tubes on servos, compare how light and dark they look at different angles, then build a 3x3 prototype controlled by a camera. Twist: turn it into an 'audio mirror' that controls sound instead.

works.title: Reface [Portrait Sequencer]
works.description: A face-tracking mirror that records slices of visitors' eyes, brows and mouths and remixes them into endless 'exquisite corpse' composite faces; blinking advances the combinations.
works.idea_zh: 像“拼贴人头”游戏的魔镜：把不同观众的眼、眉、嘴实时拼成新面孔，眨眼即切换。

video.video_title: Face-Scrambling Interactive Artwork

works.technique: Face tracking aligns each visitor's face to a canonical frame, horizontal strips (eyes, nose, mouth) are recorded as video slices, and blink detection triggers recombination of strips from different people.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe Face Mesh 对齐人脸，把眼、鼻、嘴三条横带分别存下来，眨眼就随机拼一张全班的“合成脸”；变体：拼接规则由情绪决定，比如只拼所有人在笑时的嘴。
works.description_zh: 一面人脸追踪镜子，记录观众眼睛、眉毛和嘴巴的片段，把它们重新混编成无穷无尽的“精致尸体”式合成人脸；眨一下眼，组合就会切换。
works.idea_en: A magic mirror like an exquisite-corpse game: it mixes different visitors' eyes, brows and mouths into new faces live, and a blink switches them.
works.technique_zh: 人脸追踪把每位观众的脸对齐到标准坐标系，将横向条带（眼睛、鼻子、嘴巴）录制为视频切片，眨眼检测则触发把不同人的条带重新组合。
works.exercise_en: Align faces with MediaPipe Face Mesh, save three horizontal strips (eyes, nose, mouth) separately, and let each blink randomly assemble a 'composite face' from the whole class. Twist: let emotion set the splicing rule, such as using only mouths caught while everyone is smiling.

works.title: The Eye of Judgment
works.description: Physical trading cards laid on a 3x3 mat are read by the PlayStation Eye, and the creatures on them rise up as animated 3D monsters that fight on the TV image of the table.
works.idea_zh: 把实体卡牌对战升级：卡片上的怪兽在电视里的桌面上立体现身开战。

video.video_title: The Eye of Judgment PlayStation 3 Trailer - E3 2007 Trailer

works.technique: CyberCode markers on each card are decoded by an overhead camera to identify the card and its grid cell, and animated creatures are rendered on the video of the mat.
works.exercise_zh: 制作 4 张带不同图像标记的卡片，放在 2×2 格子上时召唤对应角色，并根据相邻关系判定胜负；变体：卡片旋转方向决定角色面朝哪边。
works.description_zh: 实体集换卡牌放在一张 3×3 的垫子上，由 PlayStation Eye 读取，卡上的生物化作带动画的 3D 怪兽站起来，在电视画面中的桌面上展开战斗。
works.idea_en: Level up physical card battles: the monsters on the cards appear in 3D and fight on the table shown on TV.
works.technique_zh: 俯拍摄像头解码每张卡上的 CyberCode 标记，识别卡片及其所在格子，并在垫子的视频画面上渲染带动画的生物。
works.exercise_en: Make four cards with different image markers that summon matching characters when placed on a 2x2 grid, and decide the winner from which cards sit next to each other. Twist: a card's rotation decides which way its character faces.

works.title: Video Dress (for Hussein Chalayan)
works.description: A dress embedded with thousands of LEDs plays soft, low-resolution video of sea and flowers across its surface, so the garment becomes a moving screen worn on the body.
works.description_zh: 一条嵌入数千颗 LED 的裙子，表面播放柔和的低分辨率海浪和花朵影像，服装成了穿在身上的移动屏幕。
works.idea_en: Clothing as a display: the body carries its own moving image.
works.idea_zh: 把衣服当显示屏：身体携带着自己的动态影像。
works.technique: LED matrices sewn under a diffusing fabric layer are driven as a flexible low-resolution display playing prerecorded video.
works.technique_zh: 缝在柔光面料下的 LED 矩阵被当作柔性低分辨率显示器，播放预录视频。
works.exercise_en: Tape an LED strip or a phone flashlight array under a piece of translucent fabric and design a 10-second 'video' that suits the garment. Twist: make the pattern react to the wearer's movement with a phone accelerometer.
works.exercise_zh: 把 LED 灯带或几部手机的闪光灯贴在半透明布料下，为这件“衣服”设计一段 10 秒的“视频”；变体：用手机加速度计让图案随穿着者的动作变化。

video.video_title: Hussein Chalayan's Video Dress

works.title: Visuo-Haptic Augmented Reality
works.description: Wearing a video see-through headset, a user paints on a virtual object while a haptic stylus lets them feel its surface exactly where they see it.
works.description_zh: 戴着视频透视头显的用户在虚拟物体上作画，触觉笔让他在看到的地方准确地摸到物体表面。
works.idea_en: See and touch the same virtual object in the same place.
works.idea_zh: 在同一个位置，同时看见并触摸同一个虚拟物体。
works.technique: Co-locates a PHANToM-style haptic device with graphics rendered in a video see-through HMD, which outperformed half-mirror setups in the study.
works.technique_zh: 把 PHANToM 类触觉设备与视频透视头显中渲染的图形放在同一位置；实验中，这种方式的表现优于半透镜方案。
works.exercise_en: Anchor a virtual pot in phone AR on top of a real cup, then paint the pot on screen while your other hand feels the cup. Twist: offset the virtual pot by a few centimetres and note when touch and sight stop matching.
works.exercise_zh: 在手机 AR 中把一个虚拟陶罐锚定在真实杯子上，一只手在屏幕上给陶罐上色，另一只手摸着杯子；变体：让虚拟陶罐偏离几厘米，记录何时触觉与视觉开始对不上。

video.video_title: Visuo-Haptic Augmented Reality

works.title: Weave Mirror
works.description: 768 C-shaped laminated prints rotate like woven strands to form a basket-like live reflection of the viewer.
works.idea_zh: 像编织一样把你的影像“织”出来
works.technique: Camera pixels drive motors that rotate each gradient-printed C-shape, exposing darker or lighter portions of the print.
works.exercise_zh: 打印一张黑白渐变纸条，贴在可旋转的圆柱上，用摄像头亮度控制旋转角度；变化：用颜色渐变代替黑白，做彩色镜像。

video.video_title: "Weave Mirror" (2007) by Daniel Rozin

works.description_zh: 768 个 C 形覆膜印刷片像编织的线股一样旋转，形成一幅如同篮筐编织般的观众实时镜像。
works.idea_en: Weave your image into being, strand by strand.
works.technique_zh: 摄像头像素驱动电机，旋转每个印有渐变的 C 形片，露出印刷面上较暗或较亮的部分。
works.exercise_en: Print a black-to-white gradient strip, wrap it around a rotating cylinder, and use camera brightness to control the rotation angle. Twist: use a color gradient instead of black and white to make a color mirror.

works.title: Webcam Piano
works.description: A webcam turns the space in front of a screen into an invisible grid of notes; body movement plays harmonious, classical-sounding music visualized as fluid.
works.idea_zh: 摄像头把空气变成隐形钢琴，挥动身体就能演奏和谐的音乐。

video.video_title: Webcam Piano 1.0 with fluids

works.technique: Frame differencing or optical flow over a grid of screen cells detects motion per cell, and each active cell triggers a note quantised to a musical scale, visualised with a fluid simulation.
works.exercise_zh: 用 p5.js 把摄像头画面切成 8×8 格子，哪格有运动就按五声音阶弹对应音符；变体：换一套音阶和音色，让一种特定动作（如扫地）变成一首歌。
works.description_zh: 网络摄像头把屏幕前的空间变成一张看不见的音符网格；身体的动作会奏出和谐的、带古典韵味的音乐，并以流体的形式呈现出来。
works.idea_en: A webcam turns the air into an invisible piano, so waving your body plays harmonious music.
works.technique_zh: 在屏幕单元格网格上用帧差或光流检测每个单元格内的运动，每个被激活的单元格触发一个量化到音阶上的音符，并用流体模拟进行可视化。
works.exercise_en: Use p5.js to split the camera image into an 8x8 grid and play the matching pentatonic note wherever there is motion. Twist: switch the scale and timbre so one specific action (such as sweeping the floor) becomes a song.

works.title: levelHead
works.description: A spatial memory game: tilting a real cube with printed markers moves a tiny character through rooms that appear inside the cube on screen.
works.idea_zh: 手中的方块里藏着多个房间，转动实物方块来引导小人

video.video_title: Julian Oliver : levelHead -  Interactive Game 2007

works.technique: ARToolKit fiducial markers on each cube face give the cube's 6DoF pose, and the tilt angle drives a physics-based character moving between rooms rendered inside the cube.
works.exercise_zh: 打印一个每面贴着不同图像标记的纸盒，用 MindAR 或 AR Foundation 在盒内渲染小房间，倾斜盒子让小球滚到下一个房间；变体：把房间做成自己童年记忆中的空间，走完才能拼出一个故事。
works.description_zh: 一款空间记忆游戏：倾斜一个印有标记的真实方块，就能让一个小人穿过屏幕上方块内部的一个个房间。
works.idea_en: Several rooms hide inside a cube in your hand, and turning the real cube guides a little figure through them.
works.technique_zh: 方块每个面上的 ARToolKit 基准标记给出方块的 6DoF 位姿，倾斜角度驱动一个基于物理的角色在方块内部渲染的房间之间移动。
works.exercise_en: Print a paper box with a different image marker on each face, use MindAR or AR Foundation to render small rooms inside it, and tilt the box to roll a ball into the next room. Twist: make the rooms spaces from your childhood memories, so a story comes together only once you have gone through them all.

works.title: AntiVJ - projection on building
works.description: An early experiment projecting live visuals onto a building and playing with its existing architecture, a seed of the AntiVJ label's mapping style.
works.idea_zh: 早期把实时视觉投到建筑上并与其结构互动的实验

video.video_title: AntiVJ - projection on building

works.technique: Early manual projection mapping: live VJ software output is masked and keystoned by hand to fit building features, with visuals designed around the existing architecture.
works.exercise_zh: 用一台投影仪和 VJ 软件（Resolume / TouchDesigner），手动遮罩一面有窗户的外墙并现场演一段 3 分钟的视觉；变体：每扇窗户都成为一个独立的“角色”，彼此之间传递图形。
works.description_zh: 一次把实时影像投射到建筑上、并与其既有结构互动的早期实验，也是 AntiVJ 厂牌投影映射风格的起点。
works.idea_en: An early experiment projecting live visuals onto a building and playing with its structure.
works.technique_zh: 早期的手动投影映射：现场 VJ 软件的输出经手工遮罩和梯形校正以贴合建筑特征，画面围绕既有建筑结构来设计。
works.exercise_en: Use one projector and VJ software (Resolume or TouchDesigner) to hand-mask an outside wall with windows, and perform a 3-minute visual set live. Twist: make each window an independent 'character' that passes graphics to the others.

works.title: Close-Up (ShadowBox 2)
works.description: The viewer's shadow on a screen is filled with up to 800 tiny surveillance videos of people who recently looked at the piece — and the viewer is recorded for the next person.
works.idea_zh: 你的影子里装满了之前看过这件作品的人的监控视频
works.technique: A camera records each viewer while their silhouette mask reveals a mosaic of previously recorded viewer clips; the database keeps the most recent 10,000.
works.exercise_zh: 用摄像头边录每个来访者，边把人影轮廓填满之前录下的小视频网格；变化：影子只显示与当前观众同一天来访的人。

video.video_title: Close-Up

works.description_zh: 观众投在屏幕上的影子里，填满了多达 800 段最近看过这件作品的人的微型监控视频，而观众自己也会被录下来，留给下一个人。
works.idea_en: Your shadow is filled with surveillance videos of everyone who looked at the piece before you.
works.technique_zh: 摄像头录下每位观众，同时用他们的剪影遮罩显露出由此前录制的观众片段组成的马赛克；数据库保留最近的 10000 段。
works.exercise_en: Use a camera to record each visitor while filling their silhouette with a grid of small videos recorded earlier. Twist: the shadow shows only people who visited on the same day as the current viewer.

works.title: Eye Contact (ShadowBox 1)
works.description: A display shows hundreds of tiny videos of people lying down; when a viewer is detected, all of them wake up and turn to stare directly at the viewer.
works.idea_zh: 你一出现，屏幕里的上百个人同时醒来盯着你
works.technique: A built-in camera detects the viewer's presence and silhouette, switching each video tile from its idle loop to a 'turn and look' clip.
works.exercise_zh: 让每位同学录一段“睡着→转头看镜头”的视频拼成网格，用摄像头检测到人就触发；变化：只有影子覆盖的格子里的人会醒来。

video.video_title: Eye Contact

works.description_zh: 一块显示屏上排列着数百段人们躺着的微型视频；一旦检测到有观众，他们会全部醒来，转过头直直地盯着观众。
works.idea_en: The moment you show up, hundreds of people on the screen wake up together and stare at you.
works.technique_zh: 内置摄像头检测观众的出现及其剪影，把每个视频格子从待机循环切换到“转头注视”的片段。
works.exercise_en: Have each classmate record a 'fall asleep, then turn to look at the camera' clip, assemble them into a grid, and trigger it when the camera detects a person. Twist: only the people in cells covered by a shadow wake up.

works.title: Footfalls
works.description: Stomping on the floor makes cascades of bouncy virtual objects fall from a six-metre projection; visitors catch and throw them with their silhouettes.
works.idea_zh: 跺脚越用力，天上掉下的虚拟物体越多，还能用影子接住扔回去。

video.video_title: Footfalls (2006) by Golan Levin and Zachary Lieberman

works.technique: Floor-mounted contact microphones detect stomp onsets and amplitude, spawning physics objects, while camera-based silhouette extraction provides collision boundaries for catching them.
works.exercise_zh: 用笔记本麦克风检测跺脚或拍手的音量峰值，每次峰值从投影墙顶部掉下一批物体，人的轮廓能接住它们；变体：不同力度掉下不同东西，比如轻跺落花、重跺落石。
works.description_zh: 在地板上跺脚，六米高的投影中就会落下一连串富有弹性的虚拟物体；观众可以用自己的剪影接住它们、再扔回去。
works.idea_en: The harder you stomp, the more virtual objects fall from the sky, and you can catch them with your shadow and throw them back.
works.technique_zh: 安装在地板上的接触式麦克风检测跺脚的起始时刻和振幅，据此生成物理对象；同时基于摄像头的剪影提取为接住这些物体提供碰撞边界。
works.exercise_en: Use a laptop microphone to detect volume peaks from stomps or claps, dropping a batch of objects from the top of the projected wall at each peak, and let people's outlines catch them. Twist: different strengths drop different things, such as petals for a light stomp and rocks for a hard one.

works.title: Hand of God
works.description: An indoor commander points at a map on a tabletop, and the outdoor AR user sees a giant 3D hand descend from the sky to show where to go or what to pick up.
works.description_zh: 室内指挥者在桌面地图上指点，户外的 AR 用户就会看到一只巨大的三维手从天而降，指示该去哪里或拿什么。
works.idea_en: Remote guidance delivered as a giant hand reaching down from the sky.
works.idea_zh: 把远程指导变成一只从天空伸下来的巨手。
works.technique: Captures the indoor user's hand and props on the tabletop as 3D video and renders them geolocated and scaled up in the outdoor user's Tinmith view.
works.technique_zh: 把室内用户在桌面上的手和道具捕捉为三维视频，按地理位置放大后渲染到户外用户的 Tinmith 视图中。
works.exercise_en: Have an indoor student point at a printed campus map on a video call, then show a giant hand image anchored above the pointed spot in the outdoor partner's phone AR. Twist: let the indoor student drop small toy props that appear outdoors.
works.exercise_zh: 让室内学生在视频通话中指着打印的校园地图，户外同伴的手机 AR 就在被指的位置上方显示一只巨手图像；变体：让室内学生放下小玩具道具，它们会出现在户外。

video.video_title: HOG-2006-pointing_gesture.mpg

works.title: Le Sacre du Printemps (The Rite of Spring)
works.description: A solo dancer is filmed by stereo cameras and turned in real time into a stereoscopic 3D projection that the audience watches with 3D glasses alongside a live orchestra.
works.idea_zh: 把舞者实时变成立体3D影像，让观众戴3D眼镜看“被重塑的身体”
works.technique: Stereo camera pairs capture the dancer and real-time software transforms the image into generative stereoscopic geometry projected with polarised 3D projection.
works.exercise_zh: 用两台手机并排拍同学跳舞，合成红蓝立体图并加上实时特效；变化：让音乐节拍控制身体的碎裂程度。

video.video_title: The Rite of Spring - Klaus Obermaier, Yuka Oishi & Ars Electronica Futurelab, Le Sacre du Printemps

works.description_zh: 一位独舞者被立体摄像机拍摄，并实时转化为立体 3D 投影，观众戴上 3D 眼镜，在现场管弦乐团的伴奏下观看。
works.idea_en: Turn a dancer into a live stereoscopic 3D image so the audience watches a 'reshaped body' through 3D glasses.
works.technique_zh: 成对的立体摄像机捕捉舞者，实时软件把影像转换为生成式的立体几何图形，再通过偏振 3D 投影呈现。
works.exercise_en: Film a classmate dancing with two phones side by side, combine the footage into a red-cyan anaglyph and add live effects. Twist: let the music's beat control how much the body shatters.

works.title: Third Person (ShadowBox 4)
works.description: The viewer's shadow is drawn entirely out of the verbs of a dictionary in English, Spanish or French, like a portrait written in actions.
works.idea_zh: 用词典里所有的动词拼出你的影子肖像
works.technique: Camera silhouette masking selects which cells of a dense text grid are rendered, with word size varying with distance from the screen.
works.exercise_zh: 在p5.js里把摄像头剪影区域用文字填满（用班级自选的一组词）；变化：离屏幕越近，词越小、越密。

video.video_title: Third Person

works.description_zh: 观众的影子完全由一部英语、西班牙语或法语词典中的动词构成，就像一幅用动作书写的肖像。
works.idea_en: Build your shadow portrait out of every verb in the dictionary.
works.technique_zh: 摄像头剪影遮罩决定密集文字网格中哪些单元格被渲染出来，文字大小随观众与屏幕的距离而变化。
works.exercise_en: In p5.js, fill the silhouette area from the camera with text (a set of words the class picks). Twist: the closer you get to the screen, the smaller and denser the words become.

works.title: Wildlife
works.description: A tiger is projected from a moving car onto the buildings it passes; the tiger runs alongside, speeding up and slowing down with the car and stopping when it stops.
works.idea_zh: 从行驶的汽车上把老虎投在街边建筑上，让它跟着车一起奔跑
works.technique: A sensor on the wheel measures rotation and sets the playback frame rate of the tiger's run cycle, which a car-mounted projector throws onto passing façades.
works.exercise_zh: 把投影仪放在推车或自行车上，用编码器/手机加速度计控制跑步动画的帧率，沿走廊投射；变化：速度过快时动物会“累倒”。

video.video_title: wildlife

works.description_zh: 一只老虎从行驶的汽车上被投射到沿途经过的建筑上；老虎在车旁奔跑，随着车加速、减速，车停下时它也停下。
works.idea_en: Project a tiger from a moving car onto roadside buildings so it runs alongside the car.
works.technique_zh: 车轮上的传感器测量转动，并据此设定老虎奔跑循环动画的播放帧率，再由车载投影仪投射到经过的建筑立面上。
works.exercise_en: Put a projector on a cart or bicycle, use an encoder or phone accelerometer to control the frame rate of a running animation, and project it along a corridor. Twist: the animal 'collapses from exhaustion' when you go too fast.

works.title: Daisies
works.description: A floor projection of daisies that wilt and die under visitors' feet and quickly grow back after they walk away; version 2.0 grows algorithmically generated flowers.
works.idea_zh: 花会在你脚下枯萎，离开后又重新长回来。

video.video_title: Daisies

works.technique: An overhead camera with background subtraction detects where feet are on the floor projection, and a per-flower state (height, health) decays under occlusion and regrows over time.
works.exercise_zh: 用俯拍摄像头和地面投影做一片会被踩倒、离开后慢慢长回来的草地（p5.js 或 TouchDesigner）；变体：每个人踩过后长出的花形状由他停留的时间决定。
works.description_zh: 投射在地面上的雏菊会在观众脚下枯萎死去，人走开后又很快重新长出来；2.0 版本则会生长出由算法生成的花朵。
works.idea_en: Flowers wilt under your feet and grow back after you leave.
works.technique_zh: 俯拍摄像头配合背景减除，检测脚在地面投影上的位置；每朵花都有自己的状态（高度、健康值），被遮挡时逐渐衰减，并随时间重新生长。
works.exercise_en: Use an overhead camera and floor projection to make a patch of grass that gets trampled and slowly grows back after people leave (p5.js or TouchDesigner). Twist: the shape of the flowers that grow after someone walks over depends on how long they stayed.

works.title: Drawn
works.description: Ink drawn by hand on paper is lifted off the page by software that alters the live video signal, so painted forms appear to come alive and can be pushed around by the hand.
works.idea_zh: 纸上墨迹被摄像头“抓起”，手画的形状立刻活过来、能被手拨动。

video.video_title: drawn (installation)

works.technique: Background subtraction and thresholding segment dark ink blobs from an overhead camera of the paper, converting them into physics bodies that are rendered back over the live video, with the hand tracked as a separate occluding mask.
works.exercise_zh: 用摄像头俯拍白纸，在 openFrameworks 或 p5.js 里把墨迹阈值分割成轮廓，变成会掉落、能被手推开的物体；变体：让墨迹根据笔画粗细决定是漂走还是沉下去。
works.description_zh: 在纸上手绘的墨迹被软件从纸面上“提”起来：软件改变实时视频信号，让画出的形状仿佛活了过来，还能被手推来推去。
works.idea_en: A camera 'lifts' ink off the paper, so hand-drawn shapes come alive and can be nudged by hand.
works.technique_zh: 俯拍纸面的摄像头通过背景减除和阈值处理分割出深色墨迹色块，把它们转换为物理刚体并重新渲染到实时视频上，手则作为单独的遮挡遮罩进行追踪。
works.exercise_en: Film a sheet of white paper from above, threshold the ink into contours in openFrameworks or p5.js, and turn them into objects that fall and can be pushed by hand. Twist: let stroke thickness decide whether an ink shape floats away or sinks.

works.title: Make Like a Tree
works.description: A projected forest in which each visitor's recorded shadow returns as a ghostly figure walking between the trees and fading into the distance.
works.idea_zh: 你的影子变成森林里的幽灵，在树之间游荡远去
works.technique: Recorded silhouettes are re-inserted into a layered forest image at different depths and scales, with depth-dependent fading to suggest distance.
works.exercise_zh: 拍一张多层景深的风景图，把同学录下的剪影按远近缩放插入不同图层；变化：影子越远越透明，并随时间慢慢“走进”画面深处。

video.video_title: Make Like a Tree (2005) by Scott Snibbe

works.description_zh: 一片投影森林，每位观众被录下的影子都会以幽灵般的身影重新出现，在树木之间行走，渐渐消失在远方。
works.idea_en: Your shadow becomes a ghost in the forest, wandering off between the trees.
works.technique_zh: 录下的剪影以不同的深度和比例重新插入分层的森林图像中，并根据深度渐隐来暗示距离。
works.exercise_en: Take a landscape photo with several layers of depth and insert classmates' recorded silhouettes into different layers, scaled by distance. Twist: shadows grow more transparent the farther they are and slowly 'walk' deeper into the picture over time.

works.title: Messa di Voce (installation)
works.description: Installation version of the 2003 performance: visitors' voices are visualized as projected bubbles and shapes that emerge from their mouths and can be pushed with their bodies.
works.idea_zh: 说话和唱歌的声音从嘴里“长出”可见的图形，并能用身体推动。

video.video_title: Messa di Voce (Installation, 2005)

works.technique: Camera tracking locates each visitor's head/mouth position, and real-time audio analysis (amplitude, pitch, spectral features) generates projected shapes emitted from that point, which then collide with body silhouettes.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe 找到嘴的位置，用 p5.sound 分析音量和音高，从嘴里吐出不同形状的泡泡并投到墙上；变体：给元音 a/e/i/o/u 各设计一种形状，让大家用声音“写字”。
works.description_zh: 2003 年同名表演的装置版本：观众的声音被可视化为从嘴里冒出的投影泡泡和图形，并且可以用身体推动。
works.idea_en: Speech and song grow visible shapes out of your mouth that you can push with your body.
works.technique_zh: 摄像头追踪定位每位观众头部和嘴部的位置，实时音频分析（振幅、音高、频谱特征）生成从该点发出的投影图形，这些图形随后与身体剪影发生碰撞。
works.exercise_en: Use MediaPipe to find the mouth, analyze volume and pitch with p5.sound, and blow bubbles of different shapes out of the mouth, projected on a wall. Twist: design one shape for each vowel (a, e, i, o, u) and have everyone 'write' with their voice.

works.title: PlayAnywhere
works.description: Andy Wilson's compact front-projected tabletop: a projector and camera on a small cart turn any table into a touch and object-sensing surface for games, maps and photo sharing.
works.idea_zh: 一台小推车上的投影+摄像头，把任何桌子变成可触控的游戏桌。

video.video_title: PlayAnywhere

works.technique: A short-throw projector and an IR camera with IR illumination sense finger touches by analyzing shadows and contact, and use visual codes and optical flow to detect objects and paper on an ordinary table.
works.exercise_zh: 把小投影仪和手机摄像头装在支架上俯视桌面，通过手指与其影子的距离判断“触摸”，实现一个投影的拼图或地图拖动；变体：让桌上的真实物品（杯子、钥匙）成为游戏中的障碍物。
works.description_zh: Andy Wilson 设计的紧凑型前投式桌面系统：小推车上的投影仪和摄像头能把任何一张桌子变成可感知触摸和物体的表面，用于玩游戏、看地图和分享照片。
works.idea_en: A projector and camera on a small cart turn any table into a touch-enabled game table.
works.technique_zh: 短焦投影仪加上带红外照明的红外摄像头，通过分析阴影和接触来感知手指触摸，并利用视觉编码和光流检测普通桌面上的物体和纸张。
works.exercise_en: Mount a small projector and a phone camera on a stand looking down at a table, judge a 'touch' from the distance between a finger and its shadow, and build a projected jigsaw puzzle or draggable map. Twist: make real objects on the table (cups, keys) act as obstacles in the game.

works.title: Scrapple
works.description: Everyday objects placed on a table are read as marks on a live musical score; the scanned table plays them as sound while projection augments the objects with graphics.
works.idea_zh: 桌上随手摆的物件就是乐谱，实时演奏并被投影标注。

video.video_title: Scrapple (Introductory Overview, 2005)

works.technique: An overhead camera segments objects on the table (background subtraction and blob detection), treating the x-axis as time and the y-axis as pitch like a spectrogram score, with a scanning playhead that sonifies blobs and projection highlighting them.
works.exercise_zh: 俯拍桌面，用 p5.js 检测物体色块，横轴当时间、纵轴当音高，一条播放线扫过时发声并投影高亮；变体：规定只能用厨房用品作曲，给全班演奏一段 30 秒“早餐乐”。
works.description_zh: 摆在桌上的日常物品被读作一份实时乐谱上的音符；扫描桌面时把它们演奏成声音，同时投影为这些物品叠加上图形。
works.idea_en: Whatever you toss on the table becomes a score that plays live and gets marked up by projection.
works.technique_zh: 俯拍摄像头分割桌上的物体（背景减除加色块检测），像频谱图乐谱一样把横轴当作时间、纵轴当作音高，一条扫描的播放头把色块转成声音，投影则将它们高亮显示。
works.exercise_en: Film the table from above, detect object blobs in p5.js with the horizontal axis as time and the vertical axis as pitch, and play and highlight them by projection as a playhead sweeps across. Twist: compose using only kitchen items and play the class a 30-second 'breakfast tune'.

works.title: Shadow Bag
works.description: The projector captures a viewer's shadow and re-projects it with unpredictable variations: sometimes a true shadow, sometimes a disembodied copy that runs toward or away from them.
works.idea_zh: 影子不再听话：有时跟随你，有时离开你独自行动
works.technique: A camera silhouette buffer is replayed with randomly chosen transforms (delay, offset, scale, direction) chosen per interaction.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个影子投影程序，随机切换“正常、延迟、镜像、逃跑”四种模式；变化：让同学猜当前是哪种规则。

video.video_title: Shadow Bag (2005) by Scott Snibbe

works.description_zh: 投影仪捕捉观众的影子，再以难以预料的变化重新投射出来：有时是真实的影子，有时是一个脱离身体的副本，朝观众跑来或从观众身边跑开。
works.idea_en: Your shadow stops obeying: sometimes it follows you, sometimes it walks off on its own.
works.technique_zh: 摄像头的剪影缓冲按每次互动随机选取的变换（延迟、偏移、缩放、方向）进行回放。
works.exercise_en: Build a shadow projection program that randomly switches among four modes: normal, delayed, mirrored and running away. Twist: have classmates guess which rule is active.

works.title: Subtitled Public
works.description: In an empty room a surveillance system detects each visitor and projects a random third-person verb onto their chest; the only way to get rid of your word is to touch someone else, who then takes it.
works.idea_zh: 每个人身上被投上一个动词标签，只有触碰别人才能把它传出去
works.technique: Overhead camera tracking follows each person and steers projections of text onto their body, swapping labels when two tracked blobs touch.
works.exercise_zh: 用俯拍摄像头追踪同学，在每人身上投一个词；两人碰到时交换词语；变化：把词换成同学自己写的形容词，观察标签如何流动。

video.video_title: Subtitled Public - Mexico City - 2005

works.description_zh: 在一个空房间里，监控系统检测到每位来访者，并在他们胸前投射一个随机的第三人称动词；想摆脱自己的词，唯一的办法是触碰别人，由对方接过去。
works.idea_en: Everyone gets a verb label projected on their body, and the only way to pass it on is to touch someone else.
works.technique_zh: 俯拍摄像头追踪每个人，引导文字投影落在其身体上，当两个被追踪的色块相互接触时交换标签。
works.exercise_en: Track classmates with an overhead camera and project a word onto each person, swapping words when two people touch. Twist: replace the words with adjectives the classmates wrote themselves, and watch how the labels flow.

works.title: The Voices of Oakland
works.description: An audio-AR walking tour of Atlanta's historic Oakland Cemetery where dramatized voices of the people buried there tell their stories at their graves.
works.idea_zh: 走进墓园，墓主人的声音在他们的墓前讲述自己的故事。

video.video_title: The Voices of Oakland experience

works.technique: GPS position triggers location-based audio segments and the narrative is structured as an interactive tour where the user chooses which story branches to hear at each grave.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机网页 + Geolocation API 在校园里设置 4 个地理围栏，走到某处自动播放一段同学录制的“这里发生过的故事”；变体：内容根据你来的方向或停留时间分叉。
works.description_zh: 在亚特兰大历史悠久的奥克兰公墓进行的音频 AR 徒步导览，由演员演绎的逝者之声在各自墓前讲述他们的故事。
works.idea_en: Walk into a cemetery and hear the people buried there tell their own stories at their graves.
works.technique_zh: 由 GPS 位置触发基于地点的音频片段，叙事被组织为一段互动导览，用户在每座墓前选择要收听哪条故事分支。
works.exercise_en: Use a phone web page and the Geolocation API to set up four geofences on campus, so that arriving at a spot automatically plays a classmate's recording of 'a story that happened here'. Twist: the content branches depending on the direction you came from or how long you stay.

works.title: Under Scan (Relational Architecture 11)
works.description: Town squares are flooded with white light; as pedestrians walk, video portraits of local people appear inside their shadows, look up at them, and vanish when they leave.
works.idea_zh: 走在广场上，你的影子里会出现一个陌生人抬头看你
works.technique: Computer vision tracks pedestrians from above and predicts their path, so projectors place a video portrait precisely inside each person's shadow a moment ahead of them.
works.exercise_zh: 在地面投白光，用摄像头找到人影位置，把同学事先录好的抬头视频投在影子里；变化：影子停留越久，视频里的人说出越长的一句话。

video.video_title: Underscan

works.description_zh: 城镇广场被白光笼罩；行人走过时，当地人的视频肖像会出现在他们的影子里，抬头看着他们，人一离开就消失不见。
works.idea_en: Walk across the square and a stranger appears in your shadow, looking up at you.
works.technique_zh: 计算机视觉从上方追踪行人并预测其路径，使投影仪能提前一刻把视频肖像精确地投进每个人的影子里。
works.exercise_en: Project white light onto the ground, use a camera to find where shadows are, and project classmates' pre-recorded 'looking up' videos inside them. Twist: the longer a shadow stays, the longer the sentence the person in the video speaks.

works.title: Visceral Cinema: Chien
works.description: Scenes from Buñuel and Dalí's Un Chien Andalou are projected; viewers' shadows enter the film and take over the role of the character pulling a grand piano.
works.idea_zh: 观众的影子走进超现实主义电影，替代主角演出
works.technique: Live camera silhouettes are composited into pre-segmented film footage so that the shadow triggers and drives key moments of the scene.
works.exercise_zh: 选一段经典电影片段，用摄像头剪影把同学“放进”画面并触发下一个镜头；变化：只有当影子做出与原角色相同姿势时画面才继续。

video.video_title: Visceral Cinema: Chien (2005) by Scott Snibbe
